  For the next 24 hours, the vigilante can spend a morale point as an immediate action to roll a Charisma-based skill check or a Will saving throw again after rolling the die but before learning the consequences; he must take the second result even if it is lower.

Compel Alacrity.name: 受迫疾奔（Compel Alacrity）
Compel Alacrity.description: 一種精神上的壓迫感使得目標超越了自己的身體極限來回避敵人。當受術者開始自己的回合時，如果身處在敵人的觸及範圍內的話，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。受術者能夠以自由動作移動10尺，而且不會引發敵人的藉機攻擊。催眠師每具有5個等級，受術者的移動距離便能夠增加5尺，最高為20級時的30尺。受術者在以此方式移動時，移動的距離不能超過自身的速度。但通過該詭計而進行的移動不會計入該輪內受術者的移動速度內。

Competition Subdomain.name: Competition Subdomain（Competition Subdomain）
Competition Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ns2zo6qgd9co02uf]{跳躍術}
  • 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.2dtcvrqh1z9k05dq]{Animal Aspect, Greater}
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.z0duc2v2n3ioynta]{高等英雄氣概}

Complex Countermeasures.name: Complex Countermeasures（Complex Countermeasures）
Complex Countermeasures.description:
The psychic can spend 1 point from her phrenic pool to increase by 2 the DCs of concentration checks or caster level checks the linked spell requires enemies to attempt. For example, if the linked spell were nondetection, the DC of the caster level check for using a divination on the warded creature or item would increase. This increase also applies to checks to dispel, counterspell, or identify the linked spell. The bonus applies while the spell is cast and lasts for the spell閳ユ獨 duration (if appropriate), to a maximum of 24 hours.

  The psychic can choose to spend 2 points from her phrenic pool to instead increase the linked spell閳ユ獨 DCs by 4.

Composite Specialization.name: 複合熟稔（Composite Specialization）
Composite Specialization.description: 16級起，操念使變得十分善於製作複合念襲。她會讓所有複合念襲的超載消耗降低1點。但她無法將複合念襲的消耗降低至0點以下。

Concealed Strike.name: Concealed Strike（Concealed Strike）
Concealed Strike.description:
Whenever the vigilante attacks an opponent with a concealed weapon that his target wasn閳ユ獩 aware of, he can attempt a Bluff check to feint that opponent as a move action.

  If he has the @Compendium[pf1.feats.tocde3sKG1O3GKgd]{精通虛招} feat, he attempts this check as a free action instead.

  A vigilante must be at least 6th level to select this talent.

Concealing Veil.name: Concealing Veil（Concealing Veil）
Concealing Veil.description: When this trick is triggered, the subject is affected by a nondetection spell for 1 round per mesmerist level.

Conflicted Identity.name: Conflicted Identity（Conflicted Identity）
Conflicted Identity.description: The vigilante閳ユ獨 mind is in a constant state of turmoil, which makes him even more ethically and morally fluid than other vigilantes. When targeted by a harmful spell or effect that would affect the vigilante in his current identity but not his other identity (or when he would suffer a lesser effect in his other identity), he has a 50% chance of being affected as though he were in his other identity. This chance is rolled when the spell or effect is cast or triggered and before any spell resistance roll, if applicable. For example, if a vigilante has a lawful-neutral social identity and a neutral vigilante identity, he has a 50% chance of taking only half damage from a chaos hammer spell while in his social identity, since he would always take only half damage from a chaos hammer spell when in his vigilante identity.

Congeal.name: Congeal（Congeal）
Congeal.description: The witch can make the water in a 10-foot radius around her sludgy and viscous for 1 minute, causing it to function as difficult terrain for all swimming creatures except herself. This also provides partial cover against physical effects that pass through the affected area.

Conjuration Resonant School.name: 咒法靈器（Conjuration Resonant School）
Conjuration Resonant School.description:
咒法靈器允許秘學士使用傳送或呼喚生物的魔法。

  靈器（Implements）：碗、火盆、羅盤、小塑像、燈籠、鏡子。

Conjure Implement.name: 臨時靈器（Conjure Implement）
Conjure Implement.description: 你可以消耗1點心智點將一符合要求的物品臨時轉化成你已學靈器學派的靈器。臨時靈器可以正常當做靈器使用，且會成為本體物品的精製品版本。就算你未在日初選擇該靈器，它亦可可以用來施放異能法術。若你同學派有多餘一個的靈器，在轉化臨時靈器時就決定臨時靈器負責哪一套法術。臨時靈器無法被填充心智點，因此無法用來施放靈器之力。臨時靈器持續每秘學士等級10分鐘的時間。

Conjured Armor.name: 護甲構形（Conjured Armor）
Conjured Armor.description: 通過從精神力池中花費1點精神力，異能者能夠讓所有由聯結法術呼喚（conjures）或召喚（summons）出的任何生物的AC獲得+2偏斜加值。該效果持續時間為每個施法者等級1輪，或者直至生物消失為止，以較早發生者為準。此項精神增幅僅能聯結到咒法系（呼喚）或咒法系（召喚）法術上。此偏斜加值在8級時提升至+3點，在15級提升至+4點。

Connaissance.name: Connaissance（Connaissance）
Connaissance.description: You can spend a full-round action to attune yourself to the spirit world, gaining the benefit of a @Compendium[pf1.spells.2vb5orfcy57lrfmc]{片刻預知} spell with the insight bonus equal to one half your oracle level (minimum 1). You may use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), but you may only have one connaissance effect active at a time.

Connection Channel.name: 呼喚浮游靈（Connection Channel）
Connection Channel.description: 在7級時，只要他擁有一件與死者相關的事物，通靈者就可以不受場地限制的使用呼喚地縛靈能力召喚死者之魂。如果參與此降靈會的成員中有比通靈者本人更熟悉死者的人存在，那麼在決定Call Spirit法術的DC時，可以使用他的熟悉程度而非通靈者的。

Conspiracies Patron.name: Conspiracies Patron（Conspiracies Patron）
Conspiracies Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.afoxrj4mjkhq0cp1]{Lock Gaze}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.80f89nrksbofs5vx]{Disguise Other}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.m1rmcpcaixcpz9ib]{巧言術}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.pyr472hvqn8c8es2]{Hypercognition}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.q070n0zoq3zojpas]{支配人類}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.1m5rpvirt48brv71]{說服徽記}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.aqeaxoaozlv9vg35]{靈視}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ukacuu0cvdjkqxwu]{Frightful Aspect}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.xuuzj9lr2xbwaim4]{神威如獄}

Constrict (2 pts).name: Constrict (2 pts)（Constrict (2 pts)）
Constrict (2 pts).description:
An eidolon gains powerful muscles that allow it to crush those it grapples. Whenever the eidolon successfully grapples a foe using the grab evolution, it deals additional damage equal to the amount of damage dealt by the attack used by the grab evolution.

  This evolution is only available to eidolons of the serpentine base form.

Constrict (UC) (2 pts).name: Constrict (UC) (2 pts)（Constrict (UC) (2 pts)）
Constrict (UC) (2 pts).description:
Requirements: Serpentine base form, grab evolution.

  The eidolon gains powerful muscles that allow it to crush those it grapples. Whenever the eidolon successfully grapples a foe using the grab evolution, it deals additional damage equal to the amount of damage dealt by the attack the grab evolution is tied to.

Constructive Dyes.name: Constructive Dyes（Constructive Dyes）
Constructive Dyes.description: The alchemist閳ユ獨 dyes congeal and solidify, allowing him to make physical objects from them. The alchemist can expend two uses of his daily bombs to create a nonmagical object, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.jsvjsax2eabrlx8g]{次級造物術}, using his alchemist level as the spell閳ユ獨 caster level. The alchemist must be at least 8th level and have the divine inks discovery before selecting this discovery.

Consume Primal Magic.name: Consume Primal Magic（Consume Primal Magic）
Consume Primal Magic.description:
When the arcanist encounters a primal magic event, as an immediate action she can attempt to consume its power, as the consume spells class feature. The arcanist must succeed at a Fortitude save equal to 10 + the CR of the primal magic event, or she fails to consume the event and is staggered for 1d4 rounds.

  The arcanist must have the swift consume exploit to select this exploit.

Consume the Enemy.name: Consume the Enemy（Consume the Enemy）
Consume the Enemy.description:
As a full-round action that is considered an evil act and provokes attacks of opportunity, you can bite a helpless living or freshly killed creature, dealing 1d3 points of damage. By consuming the creature閳ユ獨 flesh, you gain a +1 profane bonus on saving throw DCs for all spells, spell-like abilities, and supernatural abilities you use against creatures of the same type (and subtype, if humanoid or outsider) as the cannibalized creature. This effect lasts for a number of minutes equal to 1/2 your cleric level or until you use this ability against a different creature. At 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th level, this bonus increases by 1 (+5 maximum). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Touch of Evil power of the Evil Domain.

Consummate Liar.name: 精湛騙術（Consummate Liar）
Consummate Liar.description: 催眠師的所有唬騙檢定上獲得相當於他催眠師等級1/2的加值（最低為1）。此外，即便催眠師沒有寓守於攻（Combat Expertise）專長、智力也沒有達到13點，他也有資格選取精通虛招（Improved Feint）和高等虛招（Greater Feint）專長。在選擇其他將精通虛招和高等虛招專長作為先決條件的專長時，他也可以忽略寓守於攻專長和智力13這兩項的前提要求。

Contagious Rage.name: Contagious Rage（Contagious Rage）
Contagious Rage.description:
The barbarian howls during combat, agitating nearby fauna. Willing animals and magical beasts within 30 feet of the barbarian gain the benefits of the rage spell for as long as she maintains her rage. After the barbarian閳ユ獨 rage ends, creatures affected by her rage are fatigued for the same number of rounds as the barbarian.

  A barbarian must be at least 6th level to choose this rage power.

Control the Herd.name: Control the Herd（Control the Herd）
Control the Herd.description: At 2nd level, the cavalier can direct multiple animals with one forceful command. The cavalier can handle a number of nonhostile, riderless animals equal to his cavalier level with a single use of the Handle Animal skill, so long as the commanded animals can see or hear the cavalier. The handled animals must all be ordered to perform the same trick. If an animal in the group does not know the trick the cavalier is commanding them to perform, the cavalier is considered to be pushing that animal. The cavalier cannot use this ability on animals more than two size categories smaller than he is. Using this ability requires a move action, though if the cavalier is pushing any animal as described above, it requires a full-round action.

Convert Wand.name: Convert Wand（Convert Wand）
Convert Wand.description: An arcanist can spend 1 point from her arcane reservoir as a full-round action to convert one wand that is in her possession into a wand of a cure spell with the same spell level and caster level (a cure spell is any spell with 閳ユ竷ure閳?in its name). For example, she could convert a wand of stone shape into a wand of cure serious wounds. This alteration lasts for 1 minute, after which the wand reverts to its original function. Charges expended while the wand was altered are still expended when it reverts.

Cooperation Subdomain.name: Cooperation Subdomain（Cooperation Subdomain）
Cooperation Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.mmc8z9bzozgeg4dm]{借技術}
  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.etskn140auk6cjj2]{共享語言}
  • 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.lisojmynoblunlex]{協調行動}

Corpse Puppet.name: Corpse Puppet（Corpse Puppet）
Corpse Puppet.description:
Element void; Type utility (Sp); Level 4; Burn 0

  You draw upon negative energy to animate a nearby corpse as a zombie or a fast zombie (your choice). You can animate a zombie only if its Hit Dice are no greater than your kineticist level 閳?4.

  Each round on your turn, you must take a move action to guide the zombie, or it reverts to a corpse (but retains any damage if you later turn it into a zombie again with this utility talent). By accepting 1 point of burn, you can pour a bit of your own sentience into the zombie, allowing it to persist for 1 round per kineticist level without requiring additional actions on your part, or until the next time your burn is removed if the zombie has half your maximum zombie Hit Dice or fewer.

  At 12th level, you can animate a zombie with a number of Hit Dice no greater than your kineticist level 閳?2.

  At 16th level, you can animate a zombie with a number of Hit Dice no greater than your kineticist level.

Corrupting Aura.name: Corrupting Aura（Corrupting Aura）
Corrupting Aura.description:
At 9th level, you can surround yourself with an aura of corrupting energy for a number of rounds per day equal to your sorcerer level.

  Any creature within 10 feet of you takes 1d6 points of nonlethal damage + 1 for every 2 sorcerer levels you possess, and it is sickened for 1 round. In addition, any creature within the aura that attempts casting a divine spell must succeed at a caster level check (DC 15 + double the level of the spell) or lose the spell. You can use this ability once per day at 9th level, twice per day at 17th, and three times per day at 20th.

Corruption Subdomain.name: Corruption Subdomain（Corruption Subdomain）
Corruption Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.zqj5qzyl46af27v0]{暗示術}
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.p613n5sqbfpq22un]{Bestow Curse, Greater}

Counterspell Mastery.name: Counterspell Mastery（Counterspell Mastery）
Counterspell Mastery.description: 6級開始，你獲得 @Compendium[pf1.feats.V8GIvVaAofyw9xIl]{精通反制} 作為獎勵專長。每天1次，可以用一個直覺動作去反制敵人的法術（取代原本的準備動作）。你必須要使用高於對手法術等級至少1級的法術啟用這個能力。6級時你每天可以使用這個能力1次，每多4級你可以再多使用1次。

Counterspell Primal Magic.name: Counterspell Primal Magic（Counterspell Primal Magic）
Counterspell Primal Magic.description:
The arcanist can attempt to counter a primal magic event as if counterspelling a magical effect. This requires a Spellcraft check with a DC of 10 + the CR of the primal magic event. If she succeeds, the event is dispelled per @Compendium[pf1.spells.gmgwyjfpeuuc4t4o]{解除魔法}.

  The arcanist must have the counterspell exploit to select this exploit.

Covenguard.name: Covenguard（Covenguard）
Covenguard.description: At 16th level, you can cast @Compendium[pf1.spells.lsboosfk26m0ycqv]{降咒} three times per day as a spell-like ability. You count as a hag for the purposes of joining a coven; the coven must contain at least one hag.

Covetous Curse.name: Covetous Curse（Covetous Curse）
Covetous Curse.description:
You find yourself drawn to the luster of wealthy living. You must wear fine nonmagical clothing and jewelry worth at least 50 gp + 100 gp per character level you have beyond 1st. If you do not have sufficient wealth to purchase this additional equipment, you feel a strong desire (but are not compelled) to sell existing items or steal from others to obtain it. You are sickened whenever you do not meet this requirement; you are also sickened for 24 hours after anything worth 25 gp x your character level or more is taken from you against your will. Use Magic Device becomes a class skill for you.

  At 5th level, you gain a +4 insight bonus on Appraise checks, Spellcraft checks to identify magic items, and Use Magic Device checks.

  At 10th level, you add @Compendium[pf1.spells.rxk9rk8gvqau3f3l]{鬼斧神工} to your list of spells known.

  At 15th level, you add half your oracle level to your CMD against stealAPG combat maneuvers and to the DC of Sleight of Hand checks to take items from you.

Create Primal Event.name: Create Primal Event（Create Primal Event）
Create Primal Event.description:
The arcanist can twist the magic of an area, forcing primal magic events to occur there. As a standard action, she can spend 2 points from her arcane reservoir to create a 10-foot-by-10-foot area of primal magic at a point within 30 feet. The arcanist can increase the size of the area to 20-foot-by-20-foot by spending 2 additional points from her arcane reservoir.

  The primal magic effect remains for 1 minute.

Crocodile Aspect.name: Crocodile Aspect（Crocodile Aspect）
Crocodile Aspect.description:
The crocodile lurks in the water, unseen until it lunges forth with its powerful jaws.

Minor Form: You gain a +2 competence bonus on Swim checks and grapple combat maneuver checks.

  This bonus increases to +4 at 8th level and +6 at 15th level.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a crocodile. While in this form, you gain a swim speed of 30 feet, low-light vision, a bite attack (1d8) with the grab ability, and a tail slap attack (a secondary natural attack that deals 1d12 points of damage).

  At 8th level, once per minute as a free action, you can increase your land speed by 20 feet for 1 round.

  At 15th level, you gain Improved Natural Attack with your bite attack, and when you successfully grapple a foe, you can knock your grappled foe prone.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Bite (B, P, S), tail slap (B)

Cruel Thicket.name: Cruel Thicket（Cruel Thicket）
Cruel Thicket.description:
As a standard action, you can cause the ground in a 5-foot-radius burst centered on you to sprout twisting, thorny vines. Any creature moving through it must travel at half speed or take bleed damage equal to half your cleric level; if you activate this ability in an area with numerous plants (grass, weeds, trees, etc.), the area also becomes difficult terrain. These effects last for 1 minute, after which the vines crumble to dust. Creatures able to move through natural undergrowth unhindered ignore the effects of this ability. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Wooden Fist power of the Plant Domain.

Cryokinetic Stasis.name: Cryokinetic Stasis（Cryokinetic Stasis）
Cryokinetic Stasis.description:
Element water; Type utility (Sp); Level 8; Burn 1

  You encase yourself or a willing target in an icy sheen, placing the target in a state of suspended animation, as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.qptzjtg2m9cqnuwh]{永恆靜滯} except fire spells and spell-like abilities of 3rd level or higher count as if the caster used dispel magic against the stasis. Otherwise, no other force or effect can harm the target.

Cult Totem, Greater.name: Cult Totem, Greater（Cult Totem, Greater）
Cult Totem, Greater.description:
While the barbarian is raging, when she takes hit point damage that would render her dying or dead, she remains conscious and raging until the end of her next turn after taking that damage, though she is disabled during that turn. She becomes dying or dead at the end of her next turn as normal for her current hit point total. This ability has no effect if the barbarian dies from a cause other than hit point damage, such as from a death effect or if her Constitution damage exceeds her Constitution score.

  A barbarian must be at least 10th level and have the lesser cult totem and cult totem rage powers to select this rage power.

Cult Totem, Lesser.name: Cult Totem, Lesser（Cult Totem, Lesser）
Cult Totem, Lesser.description: While the barbarian is raging, any morale bonuses or bonuses for flanking she gains on attacks rolls are added to her damage rolls instead of her attack rolls. They are still morale bonuses, and they don閳ユ獩 stack with other morale bonuses on damage rolls.

Cult Totem.name: Cult Totem（Cult Totem）
Cult Totem.description:
The barbarian can make an attack of opportunity against a creature within her reach who damages an ally of the barbarian with a melee attack. Only the enemy, not the barbarian閳ユ獨 ally, needs to be within the barbarian閳ユ獨 melee reach in order for the barbarian to make this attack of opportunity. Once the barbarian makes an attack of opportunity against a creature with this ability, she can閳ユ獩 use this ability to make an attack of opportunity against the same creature for 24 hours.

  A barbarian must be at least 6th level and have the lesser cult totem rage power to select this rage power.

Cunning Feint.name: 狡黠虛招（Cunning Feint）
Cunning Feint.description: 俠客可以以一個移動動作或是在整輪攻擊時放棄第一次攻擊次數來發動虛招。在他達到8級時，每當俠客成功的對一個敵人發動虛招，該敵人就會在俠客的下一回合開始前一直在防禦等級上失去敏捷加值。

Currentcaller.name: Currentcaller（Currentcaller）
Currentcaller.description: At 16th level, as a swift action up to three times per day when underwater, at the start of your turn you can call up a current with a speed up to 20 feet in the direction of your choice in your space (moving with you) that lasts until the end of your turn.

Curse Blessing: Hexing Attack.name: Curse Blessing: Hexing Attack（Curse Blessing: Hexing Attack）
Curse Blessing: Hexing Attack.description: You can touch one weapon and enhance it to inflict a minor curse on the next target it strikes. The struck target must succeed at a Will saving throw or take a 閳? penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, or ability checks (warpriest閳ユ獨 choice) for 1 minute.

Curse Blessing: Retributive Curse.name: Curse Blessing: Retributive Curse（Curse Blessing: Retributive Curse）
Curse Blessing: Retributive Curse.description:
At 10th level, as a swift or immediate action, you can inflict a curse on any adjacent creature that scores a critical hit against you or deals precision damage to you. The target must succeed at a Will saving throw or be cursed. Select one of the following effects: the target takes a 閳? penalty to one ability score of your choice (the ability cannot be reduced below 1); the target takes a 閳? penalty on attack rolls, saving throws, ability checks, and skill checks; each turn, the target has a 25% chance of taking no action (otherwise, it acts normally). This curse lasts for 1 hour.

  A creature can be subjected to only one instance of retributive curse at a time. This otherwise functions as bestow curse.

Curse Breaker.name: Curse Breaker（Curse Breaker）
Curse Breaker.description:
Element void; Type utility (Sp); Level 4; Burn 0
Prerequisite emptiness

  The power of void protects you from curses and allows you to remove or suppress them. You gain a +4 bonus on saving throws against curses and hexes. You can accept 1 point of burn as a standard action to attempt a caster level check to remove a curse on yourself or another as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.o87h8gjxevcbztgd]{移除詛咒}. If the curse normally could not be removed by remove curse, you can instead suppress the curse until the next time your burn is removed with a successful caster level check.

  When your burn is removed, you can choose not to remove the burn you spent in this way to continue suppressing the curse without interruption.

  If you die, any curse suppressed in this way returns instantly.

Curse Conduit.name: Curse Conduit（Curse Conduit）
Curse Conduit.description: At 20th level, you gain immunity to negative energy damage and all spells with the curse descriptor. Whenever you confirm a critical hit with a melee weapon, you can immediately target your opponent with a @Compendium[pf1.spells.lsboosfk26m0ycqv]{降咒} spell or spell-like ability as a free action.

Curse Mastery.name: Curse Mastery（Curse Mastery）
Curse Mastery.description: At 13th level, you have made the accursed magic of the hags your own. You become immune to spells of the curse subschool and curse effects. Furthermore, the DCs of your spells with the curse descriptor increase by 1, and you can apply the overpowering mind and synaptic shock phrenic amplifications to spells with the curse descriptor so long as you have learned those amplifications.

Curse of Dampening.name: Curse of Dampening（Curse of Dampening）
Curse of Dampening.description:
You diminish one target within 30 feet as a standard action, making its attacks weaker. Whenever the target would roll to deal damage with an attack or spell, it deals the minimum amount of damage. This curse lasts for 1 round per 2 oracle levels you have (minimum 1). A successful Will saving throw negates this effect. This is a mind-affecting curse effect.

  You can use this revelation once per day, plus one additional time at 11th level and 15th level. You must be at least 7th level before selecting this revelation.

Curse of Faltering.name: Curse of Faltering（Curse of Faltering）
Curse of Faltering.description:
As an immediate action when an enemy within 30 feet threatens a critical hit, the shaman can force the creature to reroll its original attack roll with a penalty equal to the shaman閳ユ獨 Charisma modifier. The target can attempt a Will save to negate this ability.

  Whether or not the save is successful, the creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 24 hours. This is a curse effect.

Curse of Isolation.name: Curse of Isolation（Curse of Isolation）
Curse of Isolation.description:
The shaman makes an enemy within 30 feet keenly feel its status outside the tribe. For a number of rounds equal to the shaman閳ユ獨 level, the target gains no benefit from flanking or the aid another action, and it doesn閳ユ獩 benefit from morale bonuses. The target can attempt a Will save to negate this ability.

  Whether or not the save is successful, the creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 24 hours. This is a curse effect.

Curse of Nonviolence.name: Curse of Nonviolence（Curse of Nonviolence）
Curse of Nonviolence.description:
The witch can curse a creature to prevent it from attacking innocents. If the target fails its Will save, it cannot take violent actions or do anything destructive against any creature with fewer Hit Dice than itself. If another creature takes hostile action against the cursed creature, the cursed creature can act normally in regard to that creature only.

  This is an abjuration effect.

  The curse is permanent but can be removed with a @Compendium[pf1.spells.myg2b9ww43nnlbr2]{破除結界}, @Compendium[pf1.spells.suel7sgnztenv551]{神蹟術}, or @Compendium[pf1.spells.nnj51dwfkwd15ngj]{祈願術} spell. Whether or not the save is successful, a creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 1 day.

Cursed Bomb.name: Cursed Bomb（Cursed Bomb）
Cursed Bomb.description:
When an alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it deliver a debilitating curse. A creature that takes a direct hit from a cursed bomb must succeed at a Will save or be affected by @Compendium[pf1.spells.lsboosfk26m0ycqv]{降咒}.

  An alchemist must be at least 12th level to select this discovery.

Cursed Sanction.name: 制裁詛咒（Cursed Sanction）
Cursed Sanction.description: 一個結界會在受術者受到攻擊時，對敵人施以詛咒。在植入該項詭計時，一個可見的環形符文會出現在受術者的額頭上。當受術者被攻擊或者成為需要進行攻擊檢定的法術目標時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。攻擊者會在攻擊檢定、豁免、屬性檢定以及技能檢定上承受-4減值，持續時間為每催眠師等級1分鐘（意志豁免，通過則無效）。這些懲罰也會應用至觸發詭計的攻擊檢定上。這是一個詛咒（curse）效果。

Cursed Wound.name: Cursed Wound（Cursed Wound）
Cursed Wound.description:
The witch can curse a living creature, preventing it from healing completely. For a number of days equal to 3 + the witch閳ユ獨 Intelligence modifier (minimum 1), whenever the victim is the target of a conjuration (healing) spell or magical healing effect, the caster of the healing effect must succeed at a caster level check (DC = 11 + the witch閳ユ獨 level) to end the hex. If the check fails, the healing effect functions as normal, except it cannot remove the last 10 points of damage the victim suffered. Similarly, natural healing, fast healing, and regeneration fail to cure the victim閳ユ獨 last 10 points of damage. Thus, the victim閳ユ獨 effective maximum number of hit points is 10 fewer than normal. A successful Will save reduces the duration of this hex to 1 round.

  At 5th level, the victim of this hex also takes a 閳? penalty on Fortitude saving throws to avoid contracting a disease or poison from an injury. This is a curse effect and can be removed by @Compendium[pf1.spells.o87h8gjxevcbztgd]{移除詛咒}.

Cyclone Infusion.name: 氣旋（Cyclone Infusion）
Cyclone Infusion.description:
元素：氣；類別：塑形注能；等級：4；超載：3

  關聯念襲類別：突風，風捲雪，沙塵暴，風雷擊

  豁免：反射，通過則減半

  你創造出一團循著環形衝卷的氣流。所有位於以你為中心、半徑20尺爆發範圍內的生物和物體都會受到傷害，數值為你的念襲正常傷害的一半。該豁免DC基於敏捷。

Cytillesh BomB.name: Cytillesh BomB（Cytillesh BomB）
Cytillesh BomB.description: When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can infuse it with cytillesh extract. Cytillesh bombs deal 1d4 points of damage, plus 1d4 points of damage for every odd-numbered level, instead of 1d6. Creatures that take a direct hit from a cytillesh bomb are sickened for 1 round per alchemist level unless they succeed at Fortitude saves. If a creature is rendered unconscious from this bomb or any other attack before it is able to remove the sickened condition, the victim loses all memory from the last hour and cannot form new memories for 8 hours. The lost and prevented memories might return later as dreams, and can be restored with a @Compendium[pf1.spells.anya5qwdjhdfyk8u]{復原術} spell. This discovery doesn閳ユ獩 stack with other discoveries that alter an alchemist閳ユ獨 bomb.

Daemon Totem, Greater.name: Daemon Totem, Greater（Daemon Totem, Greater）
Daemon Totem, Greater.description:
If the barbarian kills an intelligent creature with a CR equal to at least half her character level while raging, she heals 5 hit points. If she is already at her maximum number of hit points, she instead gains 5 temporary hit points, which don閳ユ獩 stack if she kills multiple creatures.

  A barbarian must be at least 10th level and have the lesser daemon totem and daemon totem rage powers to select this rage power.

Daemon Totem, Lesser.name: Daemon Totem, Lesser（Daemon Totem, Lesser）
Daemon Totem, Lesser.description: While raging, the barbarian gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against acid damage, death effects, disease, and poison. This bonus increases by 1 for each daemon totem rage power the barbarian has, excluding this one.

Daemon Totem.name: Daemon Totem（Daemon Totem）
Daemon Totem.description:
While the barbarian is raging, her melee attacks impose a temporary negative level on her opponent on a successful critical hit. After 1 hour, these temporary negative levels disappear automatically without a saving throw).

  A barbarian must be at least 6th level and have the lesser daemon totem rage power to select this rage power.

Damage Reduction (3 pts).name: Damage Reduction (3 pts)（Damage Reduction (3 pts)）
Damage Reduction (3 pts).description:
An eidolon's body becomes resistant to harm, granting it damage reduction. Choose one alignment: chaotic, evil, good, or lawful. The eidolon gains DR 5 that can be bypassed by weapons that possess the chosen alignment. The alignment must be opposite to one of the alignments possessed by the eidolon.

  At 12th level, this protection can be increased to DR 10 by spending 2 additional evolution points.

  The summoner must be at least 9th level before selecting this evolution.

Damage Reduction (UC) (3 pts).name: Damage Reduction (UC) (3 pts)（Damage Reduction (UC) (3 pts)）
Damage Reduction (UC) (3 pts).description:
Requirements: Summoner level 15th, damage reduction granted by the eidolon閳ユ獨 subtype.

  The eidolon閳ユ獨 body becomes more resistant to harm. Increase the damage reduction granted by the eidolon閳ユ獨 subtype by 5.

Dampen Presence.name: Dampen Presence（Dampen Presence）
Dampen Presence.description: A rogue who selects this talent gains Dampen Presence (Pathfinder Player Companion: Dungeoneer閳ユ獨 Handbook 10) as a bonus feat. The rogue does not need to meet the feat閳ユ獨 prerequisites. The rogue is also considered to have the Skill Focus (Stealth) feat for the purpose of satisfying the prerequisites of any feat that lists Dampen Presence as a prerequisite.

Dampening Infusion.name: Dampening Infusion（Dampening Infusion）
Dampening Infusion.description:
Element void; Type substance infusion; 等級 1; Burn 1
Associated Blasts negative, void
Saving Throw Will negates

  Your kinetic blast swirls with darkness, making it harder for your foes to see. This otherwise functions as dazzling infusion.

Dance of Disorienting Shadows.name: Dance of Disorienting Shadows（Dance of Disorienting Shadows）
Dance of Disorienting Shadows.description: A rogue with this talent can attempt a Perform (dance) check in place of a combat maneuver check when attempting a reposition combat maneuver.

Dance of Whirling Water.name: Dance of Whirling Water（Dance of Whirling Water）
Dance of Whirling Water.description:
You dance through the battlefield with all the grace and power of the waves, sweeping up enemies and tossing them away with the powers of air and water entwined. Whenever you succeed at an Acrobatics check to move through an enemy閳ユ獨 square, you gain a competence bonus equal to half your oracle level (minimum +1) on trip combat maneuvers against that creature until the start of your next turn.

  At 11th level, you gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.UnmST9BvRhxT4vq3]{旋風攻擊} as a bonus feat, and you can make bull rush combat maneuvers in place of any of the attacks granted by Whirlwind Attack; you cannot move with enemies bull rushed this way.

Danger Sight.name: 危險預兆（Danger Sight）
Danger Sight.description: 以一個直覺動作，你消耗1點心智點保護自己免受傷害。你可以在成為一次攻擊的目標時或對抗特殊能力、法術或陷阱需要進行豁免檢定時使用該能力。如此做會讓你的AC或者豁免檢定獲得等同於1/2秘學士等級的洞察加值。該加值只對立刻到來的一次攻擊或你進行的豁免檢定有效，且若在該輪結束前未使用掉該效果的話，該保護效果會消失。你必須至少3級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Danger Word.name: Danger Word（Danger Word）
Danger Word.description: At 2nd level, the cavalier can ready his allies for impending danger. As a standard action, he can ready all allies within 30 feet of the danger ahead, granting a bonus on a single type of saving throw (Fortitude, Reflex or Will) that he chooses when he grants this boon. At any point in the next minute, when these allies fail a saving throw of that type, they can choose to reroll the saving throw with a +4 competence bonus as an immediate action, but must take the results of the reroll even if it is worse. He can use this ability up to three times per day, once for each type of saving throw.

Dark Apothecary.name: Dark Apothecary（Dark Apothecary）
Dark Apothecary.description: The witches of ancient Iblydos were masters of herbalism, crafting potent drugs and poisons. The witch receives a +4 insight bonus on checks to craft and apply poison.

Dark Defense.name: Dark Defense（Dark Defense）
Dark Defense.description: At 5th level, light and darkness become your allies, moving around you to protect you from your enemies. You gain a +2 deflection bonus to Armor Class against any attack while you benefit from concealment against that attack. If you have full concealment from that attack, this deflection bonus increases to +4.

Dark Half.name: 黑暗半身（Dark Half）
Dark Half.description: 通過讓黑暗力量佔據自身，你能夠以迅捷動作進入一種以殘忍作為本能的狀態。當你的黑暗半身顯現出來之時，你的異能者法術（psychic spells）的DC會增加1點，意志豁免獲得+2士氣加值，而且變得免疫恐懼（fear）效果。當你處於黑暗半身佔據主導的狀態中，每當你施放造成傷害的法術時，你能夠讓一個由於法術而承受傷害的生物受到1點出血（bleed）傷害。出血傷害的數值會在5級增加至2點，並在13級增加至1d6點。當你喚出黑暗半身時，你無法使用任何以魅力、敏捷或智力為基礎的技能（但是特技、飛行、威嚇和騎術不受限制）。也不能使用除了施放異能者法術、使用精神增幅、或者嘗試恢復自我之外，任何需要耐心或專注的能力。你能夠以自由動作嘗試恢復自我，但是這麼做必須成功進行一次DC為10 + 你的施法者等級的專注檢定。如果檢定失敗，則會讓黑暗半身持續處於主導地位，而且在1輪內無法再次嘗試恢復自我。每日喚出黑暗半身的輪數為3 + 你的異能者等級的一半 + 你的魅力調整值；當這些輪數消耗完時，便會恢復自我，此時不需要進行專注檢定。

Dark Tapestry Spirit Manifestation.name: Dark Tapestry Spirit Manifestation（Dark Tapestry Spirit Manifestation）
Dark Tapestry Spirit Manifestation.description:
Upon reaching 20th level, the shaman becomes an unnatural spirit of the Dark Tapestry. She gains damage reduction 5/閳?and immunity to acid, critical hits, and sneak attacks. While she retains much of her original appearance, several minor cosmetic changes leave no doubt as to her now-alien nature. Her eyes might appear as solid spheres of blackness, her fingers might writhe like tentacles, or her legs might bend backward at the knees.

Once per day, the shaman can cast @Compendium[pf1.spells.n3lp01euzcdmtbw5]{形體變化} as a spell-like ability without requiring a material component, but the form the shaman assumes via this spell-like ability is never something that looks of natural origin to the shaman閳ユ獨 home world.

Dark Tapestry Spirit.name: Dark Tapestry Spirit（Dark Tapestry Spirit）
Dark Tapestry Spirit.description:
A shaman who selects the Dark Tapestry spirit is often a misanthropic loner. While she may well work with others, she rarely does so of her own volition. Instead, she seeks out the aid of a small group (such as a party of adventurers) as a result of an obscure vision or other influence from the Dark Tapestry that she might not fully comprehend. More often, though, a Dark Tapestry shaman is encountered not as a member of a group, but as the leader of a cult in a remote region閳ユ敄hese shamans, of course, work best as NPC villains and not as PCs.

The spirits of the Dark Tapestry have often been known to whisper dangerous secrets to mortals who dwell on sane worlds. Such spirits might be found anywhere touched by the light of baleful stars, but they are most frequently found lurking around unfathomably ancient ruins of aberrant civilizations with links to the Dark Tapestry. On Golarion, these spirits can often be found near old ruins in Osirion or the Sodden Lands, although they are also quite active throughout the county of Versex in Ustalav. Many shamans who invoke the spirits of the Dark Tapestry also worship one or several of the Outer Gods or Great Old Ones of the Elder Mythos, be it out of fear or misinformed adoration. Other entities associated with the Dark Tapestry, particularly the Dominion of the Black, seem less likely to be associated with that realm閳ユ獨 spirits, so it may well be that the spirits that shamans call upon when they turn to the Dark Tapestry for power are in fact the idle thoughts of horrors such as Nyarlathotep, Yog-Sothoth, or even Azathoth.

Spirit Magic Spells: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ja005kj1gh7g0dnk]{熵光護盾} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.gl524v9qd5jji2ex]{Contact Entity I} (2nd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.6g7x08y9nl7vlffv]{Contact Entity II} (3rd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wralcmyi4tdcai24]{黑觸手} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.0n789r9rokr1ktd1]{Contact Entity III} (5th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.66vvhyiy5q8yzbq2]{弱智術} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.6kn3xjxysd4b3t6a]{Contact Entity IV} (7th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.s6q72tw2zra9sycu]{精神錯亂} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.4qriqew7d2ot7wr5]{Interplanetary Teleport} (9th).

  Spirit Animal: The shaman閳ユ獨 spirit animal has an alien physiology, including twitching tentacles, additional but blind eyes, or strangely deformed limbs. The spirit animal gains the shaman閳ユ獨 choice of a swim speed or a climb speed equal to its highest speed, and one of its natural weapons increases in reach by 5 feet. If it did not have a natural weapon, it gains a tentacle attack as a secondary natural weapon with 5-foot reach. Damage for this tentacle is standard for a creature of the spirit animal閳ユ獨 size (1d2 for a Tiny spirit animal, or 1d3 for a Small one).

Dark Tapestry Subdomain.name: Dark Tapestry Subdomain（Dark Tapestry Subdomain）
Dark Tapestry Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2nd -@Compendium[pf1.spells.26vm5jhjkxpq1xm3]{召喚怪物 II}
  • 5th - @Compendium[pf1.spells.hd7ukybisvv7j5r6]{召喚怪物 V}
  • 7th - @Compendium[pf1.spells.s6q72tw2zra9sycu]{精神錯亂}

Dark Wings.name: Dark Wings（Dark Wings）
Dark Wings.description:
At 12th level, when entering a bloodrage you can choose to have batlike wings grow from your back, giving you a fly speed of 60 feet with average maneuverability.

  At 16th level, your fly speed increases to 80 feet with good maneuverability.

Darkness Bomb.name: Darkness Bomb（Darkness Bomb）
Darkness Bomb.description: When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it suppress light sources on the target. This extinguishes nonmagical light sources carried by the target and dispels magical light sources for 1 round/level as @Compendium[pf1.spells.jdsvncnna6oy189a]{深幽黑暗術}.

Darkness Infusion, Greater.name: Darkness Infusion, Greater（Darkness Infusion, Greater）
Darkness Infusion, Greater.description:
Element void; Type substance infusion; Level 6; Burn 4
Prerequisite darkness infusion
Associated Blasts gravity, negative, void
Saving Throw none

  Your blast creates supernatural darkness, as per the darkness infusion, except it acts as deeper darkness and counts as a 6th-level darkness spell.

Darkness Infusion.name: Darkness Infusion（Darkness Infusion）
Darkness Infusion.description:
Element void; Type substance infusion; Level 3; Burn 2
Associated Blasts gravity, negative, void
Saving Throw none

  Your kinetic blast creates darkness. Treat each square of the path of your ranged attack kinetic blast, the target square of your melee attack kinetic blast, or the area of your area of effect kinetic blast as the center of a darkness effect that lasts until the end of your next turn.

  This effect counts as a 3rd-level darkness spell.

Dawning Realization.name: Dawning Realization（Dawning Realization）
Dawning Realization.description:
At 8th level, you can impart a shared vision of unfathomable ineffability to a living creature you touch as a standard action, after which your turn immediately ends. You are dazed and the target confused for 1 round by what you both learn. On the following round, you are both staggered for 1 round by the ramifications of your discovery. On the third round, you are confused and the target dazed for 1 round as you attempt to regain your bearings. Each round, the target can attempt a Will save with a DC equal to 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier to negate that round閳ユ獨 effects for both of you, though the effect does not end until the end of the third round. This is a mindaffecting effect that you can use a number of times per day equal to 1/2 your class level.

  This power replaces the Aura of Madness power of the Madness Domain.

Dazing Touch (CLE).name: 暈眩之觸(牧師)（Dazing Touch (CLE)）
Dazing Touch (CLE).description: 通過一次近戰接觸攻擊，你能夠使活物暈眩1輪。HD超過你牧師等級的生物不受影響。你每天可以使用此能力次數“3+感知修正”。

Dazing Touch (WIZ).name: 暈眩之觸(法師)（Dazing Touch (WIZ)）
Dazing Touch (WIZ).description: 你能夠用一個近戰接觸攻擊導致一個生物暈眩1輪。當目標生物的HD高於你法師等級時無效。你每天可以使用此能力次數為“3+智力修正”。

Dazzling Infusion.name: Dazzling Infusion（Dazzling Infusion）
Dazzling Infusion.description:
Element fire, wood; Type substance infusion; Level 1; Burn 1
Associated Blasts blue flame, fire, plasma, positive, verdant
Saving Throw Will negates

  Your kinetic blast shines brightly, making it harder for your foes to see. If your blast hits a foe (and penetrates SR if applicable), that foe must succeed at a Will save or be dazzled for 1 minute, whether or not it takes damage from the blast. You can reduce the blast閳ユ獨 damage by half to increase the DC of this save by 2.

Deadly Earth Infusion.name: 死地（Deadly Earth Infusion）
Deadly Earth Infusion.description:
元素：土；類別：塑形注能；等級：6；超載：4

  前置：增距（extended range）

  關聯念襲類別：巖擊，熔岩流，轟鋼，硬泥團

  豁免：無

  你將念力注入腳下，向距離自身120尺的任意一點為中心，半徑20尺範圍的泥土表面（earthen surface）使用力量，如果你使用的是轟鋼（Metal Blast），此注能會影響金屬表面（metal surface）作為替代。被影響區域的地面變得扭曲變形。當你創造死地時，所有在區域內接觸地面的生物和物體都會無豁免地承受傷害，數值為你的念襲正常傷害的四分之一。無論何時，進入區域的生物都會承受正常念襲傷害數值一半的傷害，在回合結束時仍處於區域內的生物也是如此。整個區域都被視為困難地形（difficult terrain）。這個注能的持續輪數等同於你的體質調整值，或者直至你再次使用死地為止。

Deadly Excretions.name: Deadly Excretions（Deadly Excretions）
Deadly Excretions.description:
When using his toxic skin ability, the alchemist can choose to excrete a Constitution poison instead of a Dexterity poison. This poison works the same as the normal grippli toxic skin poison except that a failed save deals 1 point of Constitution damage.

  The alchemist must be at least 8th level and must have the toxic skin racial trait before selecting this discovery.

Death Interrupted.name: Death Interrupted（Death Interrupted）
Death Interrupted.description:
A witch with this grand hex can pluck a dead creature閳ユ獨 soul from the River of Souls and store it in her familiar for safekeeping and eventual resurrection. In order to use this ability, the witch must be adjacent to the target dead creature and her own familiar, and the ally閳ユ獨 soul must be free and willing to return at the witch閳ユ獨 behest. When the witch touches the creature閳ユ獨 remains (some small portion of the creature閳ユ獨 body must still exist, and it may have been dead for any amount of time), its soul enters the body of the witch閳ユ獨 familiar as per familiar melding, as if the witch閳ユ獨 familiar were the target閳ユ獨 familiar. The creature閳ユ獨 soul can remain within the witch閳ユ獨 familiar for up to 1 hour per class level the witch has. During this time, the witch can telepathically communicate with the creature閳ユ獨 soul (though the soul cannot do anything else), and the witch can return the ally to life. Doing so is a standard action that returns the creature閳ユ獨 soul to its body, brings it back to life with a number of hit points equal to 5d8 + 1 hit point per the witch閳ユ獨 caster level. The witch must be within 300 feet of the creature閳ユ獨 body to return it to life. If a creature閳ユ獨 soul is in the witch閳ユ獨 familiar and this effect expires, or if the witch attempts to return the creature to life but is out of range, the creature remains dead.

  Once a creature has benefited from this hex, it cannot benefit from it again for 24 hours.

Deathcall.name: Deathcall（Deathcall）
Deathcall.description:
The witch閳ユ獨 presence makes death more likely for wounded foes. Creatures within 120 feet of the witch take a 閳? penalty on checks to stabilize when dying.

  At 8th level, this penalty changes to 閳?, and at 16th level, it changes to 閳?.

Deathless Frenzy.name: Deathless Frenzy（Deathless Frenzy）
Deathless Frenzy.description:
While raging, you ignore the effects of being at 0 or fewer hit points until you have been at 0 or fewer hit points for 1 round, at which point the appropriate consequences for your current hit point total take effect. Even death can be postponed this way, potentially allowing you to survive if you receive sufficient healing before the round is up.

  You must be at least 12th level to select this rage power.

Debilitating Gloom.name: Debilitating Gloom（Debilitating Gloom）
Debilitating Gloom.description:
A creature struck by the gloom must make a successful Fortitude save or take a penalty to its Strength equal to 1d4 + 1 per 2 alchemist levels (maximum of 1d4+5) for 1 round per alchemist level. A target閳ユ獨 Strength score cannot drop below 1. This penalty does not stack with itself.

  An alchemist must be at least 6th level before selecting this discovery.

Decadence Patron.name: Decadence Patron（Decadence Patron）
Decadence Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.e2ito0vg49gmlpqi]{Negative Reaction}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.5k28oftzs0bezve3]{Demand Offering}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.p8dbns0wei8eayas]{蛇紋法印}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.smbkd2yobhshbpqf]{魅惑怪物}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ifcnx1yyw6e7ousm]{託夢術}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.mvgg3g6zs5iutjj9]{Envious Urge}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ni0okhagwuk0jbe9]{Waves of Ecstasy}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.xlzqpkl8fpm3sn4u]{愛與和平}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.kikowbnn4h6anegq]{Symbol of Strife}

Deceitful Trick.name: Deceitful Trick（Deceitful Trick）
Deceitful Trick.description:
The vigilante can perform a dirty trick combat maneuver in place of his first attack during a full attack. He can take a 閳? penalty on his check in order to inf lict two different conditions on his foe if he succeeds at his check. If the vigilante is successful, the target can remove both conditions as a standard action.

  A vigilante must have Greater Dirty Trick and Improved Dirty Trick in order to select this vigilante talent.

Deception Subschool.name: Deception Subschool（Deception Subschool）
Deception Subschool.description:
Some illusionists rely more on their natural talents and less on flashy figments. Focused arcane schools replace one or more powers granted by a wizard閳ユ獨 arcane school.

  相關學派： Illusion.

  Replacement Powers: This subschool replaces the blinding ray and extended illusions powers of the illusion school.

Deceptive Flourish.name: Deceptive Flourish（Deceptive Flourish）
Deceptive Flourish.description: You gain a +2 enhancement bonus on 唬騙 and Disguise skill checks. This bonus increases by 1 for every 5 wizard levels you have, up to a maximum of +6 at 20th level. At 20th level, you gain the benefits of @Compendium[pf1.spells.8nrt26t37v7koqr8]{誤導術} (Will DC = 20 + your Intelligence modifier) or @Compendium[pf1.spells.awia42zci8nufpfl]{回避偵測} permanently. At will as a standard action, you can change which of the two spells is active, and each time you activate @Compendium[pf1.spells.8nrt26t37v7koqr8]{誤導術}, you can choose a new creature or object as the secondary object.

Deceptive Shapes.name: Deceptive Shapes（Deceptive Shapes）
Deceptive Shapes.description: At 5th level, you learn the hag閳ユ獨 art of concealing your true face to get what you want. You can change into any Small or Medium humanoid at will as @Compendium[pf1.spells.kouqz0pm1xl8xilm]{變身術}, though you don閳ユ獩 gain any special abilities or ability score adjustments. You can閳ユ獩 replicate a specific person using this ability.

Decisive Strike.name: 果斷出擊（Decisive Strike）
Decisive Strike.description: 以一個迅捷動作，你可以通過增加1點共鳴為代價，使得所有處於你周圍30尺內且可以聽見和看見你的盟友在本輪內發動一次近戰或遠程攻擊。你可以選擇以標準動作發動本能力，從而給予這些隊友一個額外的標準動作而非一次攻擊。

Deeds.name: Deeds（Deeds）
Deeds.description:
銃士花費勇毅值來實現炫技。大多數炫技使銃士獲得一些短暫的加值或效果，但也有一些提供更長時間的持續性效果。一些炫技在銃士擁有至少1點勇毅值時持續生效。下面列出了銃士的基本炫技。銃士只能使用等於或低於她等級的炫技。除非特別說明，炫技通常都可以連續多次使用，只要花費對應該動作的適當勇毅值即可。

  銃士炫技:

  狙擊之眼 (Ex): 1級時，銃士可以在她的火器的第一個射程增量後瞄準接觸AC。使用本動作在第一個射程增量後的每個增量花費1點勇毅值。銃士在使用本動作時，仍舊在第一個射程增量後的每個增量受到攻擊檢定-2減值。

  銃士閃避 (Ex): 1級時，銃士在規避遠程攻擊時獲得驚豔竅門。當受到遠程攻擊時，銃士可以通過直覺動作，消耗1點勇毅以移動5尺，針對此次攻擊的AC將獲得+2加值。此移動並非5尺快步，會引發藉機攻擊。銃士也可以不移動而是臥倒，並使針對此次攻擊的AC獲得+4加值。銃士只能在穿著輕甲或無甲，且負載不超過輕載時使用此炫技。

  快速清膛 (Ex): 1級時，銃士可以用一個標準動作移除一件她目前正在使用的火器的破損狀況，只要該狀況是由於槍械啞火而造成。她只能在目前的勇毅值為1點以上時使用此動作。銃士也可以主動消耗1點勇毅值，以移動動作來完成此炫技。

  把握主動 (Ex): 3級時，只要銃士擁有至少1點勇毅值，她便在先攻檢定上獲得+2加值。若她同時擁有“即時備戰”專長，且她的雙手空閒且不受約束、火器也未被隱藏起來，她便可以拔出一把火器作為先攻檢定的一部分。

  槍柄打擊 (Ex): 3級時，銃士可以用她的火器的槍托或手柄以標準動作進行一次奇襲打擊。此動作令她視為擅長將該火器作為近戰武器般使用，並將該火器的增強加值應用於攻擊和傷害檢定。槍柄打擊所造成的傷害為鈍擊類型，大小由火器的尺寸決定。單手火器造成1d6點傷害（小體型生物為1d4），雙手火器造成1d10點傷害（小體型生物為1d8）。無論銃士體型如何，該攻擊的重擊倍率都是20/x2。若攻擊命中，銃士可以通過一個自由動作進行戰技攻擊檢定，以將目標擊倒。使用此炫技花費1點勇毅值。

  萬用射擊 (Ex): A3級時，只要銃士擁有至少1點勇毅值，就可以做出下列的射擊效果。每種射擊效果可應用於單次的火器攻擊，但銃士必須在攻擊前聲明使用何種效果。

  • 破鎖: 銃士可以用攻擊檢定對抗一把鎖，該鎖須在她的火器的第一個射程增量內。小型鎖通常擁有7點AC，更大的鎖則擁有更高的AC。鎖依其品質在對抗此攻擊的AC上獲得加值。簡易鎖擁有+10加值，中級鎖擁有+15加值，優質鎖為+20，卓越鎖則為+30。秘法鎖在對抗此攻擊的AC上獲得+10加值。若命中，則鎖被破壞，而目標可以如同未上鎖一般被打開。若未命中，則鎖被破壞，但目標被卡住，而仍舊視為被鎖住。該死鎖可以繼續使用本動作、解除裝置技能、或擊破DC來解鎖，但對應的DC或AC增加10。鑰匙、密碼或類似的機械方法對死鎖不再有效，但敲擊術仍舊能夠繞過鎖具起效，而秘法鎖的創造者也仍舊可以通過該法術的防護開鎖。
  • 射飛無主物品: 銃士可以用攻擊檢定對抗一個超小型或更小的無主物品，該物品須在她的火器的第一個射程增量中。一個超小型物品擁有5點AC，微型為7點，超微型為11點。若命中，銃士的該次攻擊並不傷害到該物品，但可以由射擊的起點將其向遠處移動15尺。若未命中，則銃士正常傷害該物品。
  • 止血: 銃士可以進行一次火器攻擊，並將火熱的槍管壓在一個鄰近生物身上以便為一個流血傷口。作為造成傷害的替代，該次射擊會結束受影響生物身上的一個流血效果。銃士在使用此動作時無需進行攻擊檢定；她可以向空中射擊，但該次射擊仍需正常花費彈藥。

  致命射擊 (Ex): 7級時，銃士可以通過一個整輪動作，對單體目標進行一次傾注全力的精確打擊。她用火器攻擊進行一次攻擊，但進行由基本攻擊加值決定的多次投骰，如同正常整輪攻擊般從高到低排列。若其中任一次攻擊投骰成功，則視為射擊命中；每一次額外的成功攻擊追加基於火器傷害骰的傷害。舉例而言，7級銃士持滑膛槍進行兩次攻擊且命中，在計算其他傷害前將以2d12取代1d12作為基本傷害骰。基於精準攻擊的傷害和基於武器特性的額外傷害（如熾焰）可以加至傷害，但不會因多次成功投骰而疊加。若其中一次攻擊進入重擊威脅，銃士採用最高基本攻擊加值-5來確認重擊，額外的每次造成重擊威脅的攻擊將使重擊確認中的減值下降1（最小為0）。只有當全部攻擊投骰都落入啞火範圍，銃士才會在致命射擊中遭受啞火。她不能在使用雷筒或其他霰彈火器攻擊錐形區域時使用此炫技。銃士使用此炫技須消耗1點勇毅值。

  驚異射擊 (Ex): 7級時，至少擁有1點勇毅值的銃士可以通過一個標準動作，刻意使一次本應命中的火器攻擊失手，令攻擊目標在下一輪行動開始前陷入措手不及狀態。

  精確瞄準 (Ex): 7級時，銃士可以通過一個整輪動作，對目標身體的特定位置進行一次火器攻擊，並獲得下列基於該目標肢體部分的對應效果。若某生物並不擁有某項列出的肢體部分，則無法瞄準此肢體。本炫技無論瞄準何部位均花費1點勇毅值。免疫偷襲的生物同樣免疫這些效果。

  • 手臂: 攻擊命中時，目標不受任何傷害，但掉落一樣你所選擇的手持物品，即使該物品被雙手持有。帶鎖鐵手套持有的物品不會因此掉落。
  • 頭部: 攻擊命中時，目標正常受到傷害，並困惑1輪。這是影響心靈效果。
  • 腿部: 攻擊命中時，目標正常受到傷害並被擊倒。有四條以上腿或免疫摔絆的生物對此效果免疫。
  • 軀幹: 瞄準軀幹會令攻擊的重擊範圍翻倍。
  • 翅膀: 攻擊命中時，目標正常受到傷害且須通過DC為20的飛行技能檢定，失敗則墜落20尺。

  傷口出血 (Ex): 11級時，當銃士用火器攻擊命中一個活物時，她可以用一個自由動作花費1點勇毅值來令該次攻擊造成額外出血傷害。出血傷害值等於銃士的敏捷修正。或者替代性的，銃士可以花費2點勇毅值來造成1點力量、敏捷或體質值的出血傷害（隨銃士選擇）。免疫偷襲傷害的生物同樣免疫任意類型的出血傷害。

  裝填專家 (Ex): 11級時，每當銃士在破損的槍械啞火時，她可以花費1點勇毅值來使槍械免於爆炸，但它仍舊保持破損狀態。

  閃電裝填 (Ex): 11級時，至少擁有1點勇毅值的銃士可以通過迅捷動作為單手或雙手火器的單筒進行裝填，每輪1次。若她已有“快速裝填”專長或使用鍊金定裝彈（或兩者兼備），她可通過自由動作進行上述裝填。此外，使用此炫技不會招致藉機攻擊。

  閃避精通 (Ex): 15級時，至少擁有1點勇毅值的銃士獲得“反射閃避”、“直覺閃避”和“精通直覺閃避”等盜賊職業能力。在計算“精通直覺閃避”能力時，用銃士等級取代盜賊等級。

  威嚇射擊 (Ex): 15級時，銃士可以消耗1點勇毅值朝天鳴槍，使30尺半徑爆發範圍內所有生物如同受到“恐懼術”效果。此效果意志豁免DC為“10+1/2銃士等級+感知修正”。

  槍手之幸 (Ex): 15級時，銃士可以消耗勇毅值重投豁免或技能檢定。重投豁免和技能檢定分別消耗1點和2點勇毅值。銃士必須接受重投結果，即便更糟。此炫技消耗的勇毅值點數，無法通過“純正勇毅”能力、“標誌動作”專長或其他類似效果所降低。

  詐死偽裝 (Ex): 19級時，若銃士的生命值將要被降至0點以下，她可以消耗所有目前勇毅值（至少1點）使生命值降至1。

  死亡射擊 (Ex): 19級時，每當銃士造成重擊，她可以花費1點勇毅值來選擇造成正常傷害，且目標需進行強韌豁免檢定，DC等於“10+1/2銃士等級+敏捷修正”。豁免檢定失敗則目標死亡。這是即死效果，使用本炫技不會使銃士通過造成重擊來恢復勇毅值。

  暈眩射擊 (Ex): 19級時，每當銃士攻擊命中，她可以花費2點勇毅值，迫使對方進行DC為“10+1/2銃士等級+感知修正”的強韌豁免，失敗則震懾1輪。免疫重擊的生物同樣免疫本效果。

Deep Cover.name: Deep Cover（Deep Cover）
Deep Cover.description:
When you prepare your spells, you can also choose one cover identity閳ユ敋hether that of a real person or a fictitious one. You can assume the disguise of your cover identity in half the normal amount of time. When targeted by a spell or effect that would compromise your chosen disguise (such as detect evil, detect thoughts, or zone of truth), as an immediate action you can force the creature using the ability to attempt a Will save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier). If the creature fails, it gains false information in keeping with your cover identity. You can use this false information ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Lore Keeper power of the Knowledge Domain or the Copycat power of the Trickery Domain.

Deep Fury.name: Deep Fury（Deep Fury）
Deep Fury.description: At 20th level, you gain tremorsense 120 feet in water, as well as evasion and immunity to cold and pressure damage. You have these benefits constantly, even when not in bloodrage.

Defensive Instinct.name: 防禦本能（Defensive Instinct）
Defensive Instinct.description:
2級時，當不穿甲、沒有使用盾牌、沒有過度負重、且而保持意識時（conscious），變形者將其感知調整值（如果有）加在她的AC與CMD上。如果她穿著非金屬護甲或者使用非金屬盾牌時，她則將其一半的感知調整值加在她的AC與CMD上（最小為0）。另外，4級起和之後每4級，變形者的此AC與CMD加值額外+1（直到20級最大+5）。

  這些加值在變形者對抗接觸攻擊或者措手不及時依然起效。當她無法動作或者無助時她將失去此加值。這些加值不與武僧的AC加值職業能力疊加。

Defensive Prognostication.name: 自衛預言（Defensive Prognostication）
Defensive Prognostication.description: 在施放預言系法術（divination spell）時，異能者能夠一窺自身的未來。通過在施放預言系法術時從精神力池中花費1點精神力，異能者的AC能夠獲得+2洞察加值，持續的輪數等同於聯結法術的等級。她也能夠花費2點精神力作為替代，來使得加值提升至+4點。此項精神增幅僅能聯結到預言系法術上。

Deflection Field.name: 反射力場（Deflection Field）
Deflection Field.description: 當異能者施放一個讓他在AC上獲得偏斜加值的聯結法術時，他可以支付2點精神力來自動反射接下來的第一次失手的遠程攻擊。這次反射攻擊檢定使用原來的攻擊骰數值，再加上等同異能者的施法者等級的環境加值。

Defoliant Bomb.name: Defoliant Bomb（Defoliant Bomb）
Defoliant Bomb.description:
These poisonous bombs clear away foliage, dealing extra damage to plant creatures.

When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it deal extra damage against plant creatures but less damage against other creatures. Against creatures with the plant type, a defoliant bomb deals 1d8 points of damage, plus 1d8 points of damage for every odd-numbered level the alchemist possesses, instead of 1d6. Against all other creatures, the defoliant bomb only deals 1d4 points of damage, plus 1d4 points of damage for every odd-numbered level, instead of 1d6. This is a poison effect. A defoliant bomb kills all normal vegetation in the target's square and its splash area; any plant-based difficult terrain in the affected area becomes normal terrain.

Defy Elements.name: Defy Elements（Defy Elements）
Defy Elements.description:
Choose one energy type (acid, cold, fire, electricity, or sonic). You gain resistance 5 to the selected energy type.

  At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, you can choose an additional energy type for which to gain resistance 5, or you can choose a previously chosen energy type and increase that resistance by 5 (to a maximum resistance of 20 for any one energy type).

Deinonychus Aspect.name: 恐爪龍擬態（Deinonychus Aspect）
Deinonychus Aspect.description:
恐爪龍善於從埋伏中衝出，用爪擊造成嚴重痛苦的傷勢。這擬態向變形者灌注了突擊敵人並在戰鬥中搶先行動的增強能力。

  次級形態：你的先攻檢定獲得+2加值。8級時，這個加值提升至+4。15級起，這個加值提升至+6。

  專攻形態：你變身為一隻恐爪龍（怪物圖鑑 pg. 84），當處於該形態時，你獲得60尺基本移動速度、昏暗視覺、靈敏嗅覺（30尺）、1d8傷害的齧咬攻擊、2個1d8傷害的爪擊攻擊（你的爪擊攻擊可以應用變形者利爪的傷害）和猛撲。8級時，你獲得2個1d4傷害的前爪抓（foreclaw）攻擊（此攻擊不能應用變形者利爪的傷害）和在特技檢定獲得+4種族加值。15級時，你的AC獲得+1閃避加值和獲得跳躍攻擊作為獎勵專長。

Deinonychus.name: Deinonychus（Deinonychus）
Deinonychus.description:
The deinonychus is adept at racing from ambush to deliver grievous wounds with its talons. This aspect infuses the shifter with an enhanced ability to surprise foes and strike first in battle.

Minor Form: You gain a +2 bonus on Initiative checks.

  This bonus increases to +4 at 8th level and +6 at 15th level.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a deinonychus (Bestiary 84). While in this form, you gain a base speed of 60 feet, low-light vision, scent (30 feet), a bite attack (1d8 damage), and two talon attacks (1d8 damage; your talon attacks can use your shifter claws damage), and pounce.

  At 8th level, you gain two foreclaw attacks (1d4 damage; these attacks cannot use your shifter claws damage) and a +4 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks.

  At 15th level, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC and Spring Attack as a bonus feat.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Bite (B, P, S), talon (S)

Deity.name: 神祇（Deity）
Deity.description: 1級起，你要信仰一個神祇。你的陣營與你所信仰的神祇的陣營之間，差距不能超過1階，否則你會失去所有精神境界的獎勵法術和境界之力。

Delayed Spells.name: Delayed Spells（Delayed Spells）
Delayed Spells.description: At 8th level, you can delay the effects of a spell you cast by up to 1 round per inquisitor level. You choose the duration of the delay when you cast the spell and can cause the spell to take effect immediately during the period of delay by concentrating as a standard action. You can use this ability once per day plus an additional time per day for every 4 inquisitor levels you have beyond 8th.

Delicious Fright.name: Delicious Fright（Delicious Fright）
Delicious Fright.description:
The witch can feed on the fear of her victim. The target of this hex becomes shaken for a number of rounds equal to 3 + the witch閳ユ獨 Intelligence modifier. As long as the witch remains within 30 feet of her target, she gains a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and a +1 morale bonus on saving throws as long as this effect persists.

  A successful Will save reduces the duration of this hex to 1 round. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.

Deliver Touch Spells (SPI).name: Deliver Touch Spells (SPI)（Deliver Touch Spells (SPI)）
Deliver Touch Spells (SPI).description:
The phantom can deliver touch spells for the spiritualist when fully manifested in incorporeal or ectoplasmic form. The spiritualist and the phantom need not be in contact to accomplish this, but the phantom must be within 30 feet and the spiritualist must be able to see the phantom. If the spiritualist is 12th level or higher, the phantom can deliver touch spells within 50 feet of the spiritualist. The spiritualist can cast the spell, and then the phantom can deliver the touch as an immediate action.

  If the touch spell deals damage, the phantom must make the attack roll. The phantom can閳ユ獩 hold the charge of a touch spell cast by the spiritualist using this ability. If the spell is delivered to the phantom, it must touch a target or the spell is lost.

  If the spell allows you to touch up to six willing targets, the phantom can accomplish this with an immediate action, but all of the willing targets must be within the phantom閳ユ獨 melee reach at the time.

Demand Attention.name: Demand Attention（Demand Attention）
Demand Attention.description: The first time each round that you deal sneak attack damage to an opponent, you can forgo sneak attack damage to distract the creature. The target must succeed at a Will save (DC = 10 + the number of sneak attack dice sacrificed + your Charisma modifier) or become distracted until the start of your next turn. Distracted opponents are entirely focused on you, and pay little attention to their surroundings; they are not considered to be observing other characters within 30 feet, allowing them to attempt Stealth checks to hide. A distracted opponent automatically fails Perception checks against creatures more than 30 feet away.

Demand Subjugation.name: Demand Subjugation（Demand Subjugation）
Demand Subjugation.description:
At 8th level, you can force a defeated creature to accept a binding pact as a condition of its surrender, as if you are using lesser geas, except the creature must have a number of Hit Dice equal to or less than your cleric level. At 16th level, this ability functions as per geas/quest. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Staff of Order power of the Law Domain.

Demodand Subdomain.name: Demodand Subdomain（Demodand Subdomain）
Demodand Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.zujht80bgjdk9cyb]{陣營武器} (chaos or evil only)
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.fijw9aq7ltt8w7j6]{Corrosive Consumption}

Demolition Charge.name: Demolition Charge（Demolition Charge）
Demolition Charge.description:
When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it deal damage to an object as if by a sunder combat maneuver. If the item is worn or held by an opponent, the item is considered the direct target, and the wearer/holder takes splash damage from the blast. If the object is unattended, a demolition charge deals an additional 2d6 points of damage on a direct hit. This bonus doesn閳ユ獩 affect the bomb閳ユ獨 splash damage.

  An alchemist must be at least 8th level before selecting this discovery.

Demon Lantern.name: Demon Lantern（Demon Lantern）
Demon Lantern.description: Once per day when she casts dancing lights, the rogue can conjure a single demon閳ユ獨 lantern instead of the usual four lights. A demon lantern acts in all ways as a hypnotic pattern spell cast by a wizard, except it also casts light as a torch and it fascinates only a single target whose Hit Dice do not exceed the rogue閳ユ獨 class level. The save DC of this effect is equal to 11 + the rogue閳ユ獨 Intelligence modifier. The rogue must have an Intelligence score of at least 11 to select this talent. A rogue must have selected the minor magic rogue talent and selected dancing lights as her spell of choice or otherwise be able to cast dancing lights before choosing this talent.

Demonic Curse.name: Demonic Curse（Demonic Curse）
Demonic Curse.description:
Your heart is cursed with the pull of the Abyss. You cannot cast spells with the good or lawful descriptors, nor can you summon good or lawful creatures. Good and lawful creatures instinctively distrust you, and you take a 閳? penalty on all Diplomacy checks against such creatures. You gain a +2 bonus on all Bluff and Intimidate checks. Diplomacy is not a class skill for you, but Bluff or Intimidate (choose one) is.

  At 5th level, you gain a +4 bonus to all saving throws against fear effects.

  At 10th level, you gain immunity to poison.

  At 15th level, any weapon you wield is treated as chaotic and evil for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction.

Desert Mirage.name: Desert Mirage（Desert Mirage）
Desert Mirage.description:
Air and fire shroud you from your enemies閳?vision and superheat your strikes in combat. You can surround yourself with heated air as a swift action, gaining concealment (as per the blur spell).

  At 7th level while you are using this ability, your melee attacks each deal an additional 2 points of fire damage. You can use this ability for 1 minute per oracle level per day; this duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments.

  You must be at least 3rd level to select this revelation.

Designer Poison.name: Designer Poison（Designer Poison）
Designer Poison.description: The alchemist can create special poisons that are more effective against certain creatures. When crafting a poison, the alchemist can choose a single creature type (and subtype, if appropriate) from the ranger閳ユ獨 favored enemy list. Against creatures of the chosen type, the poison閳ユ獨 saving throw DC is increased by 4. Against all other creatures, it is reduced by 2. The alchemist must choose the creature type and subtype (if appropriate) while crafting the poison and afterward cannot change this choice.

Desire Sight.name: Desire Sight（Desire Sight）
Desire Sight.description:
As a standard action, you can learn the desires of any creature you can see within 100 feet, as if you had concentrated until the third round of detect desires. As usual for detect desires, the target can attempt a Will save to negate the effect.

  You can use this ability once per day at 1st level, plus one additional time per day at 5th level and for every 5 levels beyond 5th.

Despair.name: Despair（Despair）
Despair.description:
When a creature within 30 feet rolls for an attack, a save against a fear effect, or a skill check, you can flood its mind with a feeling of hopelessness as an immediate action before the roll is made. The target takes a 閳? penalty on the roll. The penalty increases by 1 for every 6 psychic levels you have beyond 1st, to a maximum of 閳? at 19th level. If the target fails its attack roll, save, or skill check, you regain 1 point in your phrenic pool.

  You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. This is a mind-affecting emotion effect.

Destined Bloodrager Bloodline.name: Destined Bloodrager Bloodline（Destined Bloodrager Bloodline）
Destined Bloodrager Bloodline.description:
Your bloodline is destined for great things. When you bloodrage, you exude a greatness that makes all but the most legendary creatures seem lesser.

獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.O0e0UCim27GPKFuW]{頑強}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.ehqx8txNRGMaNOPt]{堅忍}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{精通先攻}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.O0jbkTJcIji9BNiF]{威逼}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.R3a1OV18RwDJftvq]{領導力}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.0bZf3SDkvVOe2ujH]{閃電反射}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.n250dFlbykAIAg5Z]{武器專攻}

  獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.sz7j540uypmqqvti]{護盾術} (7th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.18kryvj2dfuymk9d]{朦朧術} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.1vh2ewwvzvxunoxk]{防護能量傷害} (13th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lvzq2mwkqmozolpl]{行動自如} (16th)

Destructive Roots.name: Destructive Roots（Destructive Roots）
Destructive Roots.description:
You can root yourself to your current spot and cause the world around you to fall apart. As a standard action, you can cause the ground in a 5-foot radius burst centered on you to crumble and rupture, becoming difficult terrain. As a move action on subsequent rounds, you can continue to concentrate on this area as though concentrating on a spell; doing so increases the radius of difficult terrain by 5 feet (maximum 30-foot-radius). You immediately cease concentrating if you move from the square you started in when you activated this ability. Difficult terrain created by this ability remains for 24 hours before returning to its original state.

  You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Detect Thoughts.name: 偵測思想（Detect Thoughts）
Detect Thoughts.description: 2級起，異能者能夠以類法術能力每日使用一次偵測思想（Detect Thoughts）。她還可以花費任意一個未使用的1級或更高等級的法術位來施放偵測思想。若她這麼做的話，便會使用消耗掉的法術位的等級來判斷意志豁免DC。當異能者獲得該能力時，如果已經知曉了偵測思想的話，那麼她可以習得一個不同的1級法術來取代偵測思想，失去原本的法術並更換為新的法術。

Detonation Infusion.name: Detonation Infusion（Detonation Infusion）
Detonation Infusion.description:
Element fire; Type form infusion; Level 4; Burn 3
Associated Blasts blue flame, fire
Saving Throw Reflex half

  Flames explode outward from your body, dealing your blast damage to all creatures and objects within a 20- foot radius.

Developed Poison Immunity.name: Developed Poison Immunity（Developed Poison Immunity）
Developed Poison Immunity.description: When this talent is taken, select a single animal or plant poison that the rogue has been poisoned with but survived. The rogue automatically succeeds at all Fortitude saves against exposure to the selected poison.

Devotion (SPI).name: 忠誠(喚魂師)（Devotion (SPI)）
Devotion (SPI).description: 在對抗附魔系法術和效果時，魅影的意志豁免獲得+4士氣加值。

Devotion Patron.name: Devotion Patron（Devotion Patron）
Devotion Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.21bxbzdaawjrnvyo]{神恩}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.25ey7spdaj72yioz]{Martyr's Bargain}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.73han2zqxg59u18g]{魔化防具}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.zq7xi7l5vgpqu7rt]{Magic Weapon, Greater}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.gmugktarbieojt59]{焰擊術}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.8xjcrqg79ugxu5qu]{群體牛之力量}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.rzjl9l12j9ab4z6g]{Bestow Grace of the Champion}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.n0vm6or4nwaylpfa]{聖潔靈光}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.klcvk9ct1l7mhjwp]{群體醫療術}

Didactic Strike.name: Didactic Strike（Didactic Strike）
Didactic Strike.description:
When the investigator activates his studied strike, he can end his studied combat and choose not to deal his studied strike damage. He is instead able to show any allies within 30 feet who can see him a weak spot on the target. Until the beginning of the investigator閳ユ獨 next turn, each affected ally閳ユ獨 first attack that hits the target deals additional damage equal to one-third the investigator閳ユ獨 level.

  He can end this effect as an immediate action to instead cause an affected ally閳ユ獨 first successful attack to deal the investigator閳ユ獨 studied strike damage. This additional damage is precision damage and does not affect creatures that are immune to sneak attacks.

Dimension Door (4 pts).name: Dimension Door (4 pts)（Dimension Door (4 pts)）
Dimension Door (4 pts).description:
An eidolon learns to cast @Compendium[pf1.spells.ojwg1ki98tq8xyh9]{次元門} as a spell-like ability once per day. The caster level for this evolution is equal to the eidolon's Hit Dice. The save DC for this spell is 10 + 1/2 the eidolon's HD + the eidolon's Charisma modifier. The eidolon must have a Charisma score of at least 14 to take this evolution.

  The summoner must be at least 13th level before selecting this evolution.

Directed Bomb.name: Directed Bomb（Directed Bomb）
Directed Bomb.description: The alchemist can cause his bombs to splash in a 15-foot cone instead of a 5-foot-radius burst. The alchemist chooses the direction of the cone. If the attack misses, roll an additional 1d8 to determine the direction of the blast from where the bomb lands. This discovery can’t be combined with the explosive bomb discovery.

Dirty Strikes (UC).name: Dirty Strikes (UC)（Dirty Strikes (UC)）
Dirty Strikes (UC).description: The monk fights dirty with his style strike, attempting to strike in places where his attack will negatively impact his foes閳?performance in combat. If the attack hits, the monk can perform a free dirty trick combat maneuver against the target of this strike (using the base attack bonus of the attack used to hit the foe) with a 閳? penalty. This dirty trick combat maneuver does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

Disappear.name: Disappear（Disappear）
Disappear.description: You can become invisible as per the spell as a standard action. The invisibility lasts for 1 round per inquisitor level or until you attack. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Disarming Flirtation.name: Disarming Flirtation（Disarming Flirtation）
Disarming Flirtation.description: You can attempt a Charisma check to entice a target that could be sexually attracted to you into letting you speak for up to 1 minute when it would otherwise be unwilling to consider your words. The DC of this Charisma check is equal to 10 + the target閳ユ獨 Wisdom modifier. If successfully used in combat, this ability instead functions as a successful feint and the target cannot take any actions that would attack you as long as it is denied its Dexterity bonus against you.

Discord.name: Discord（Discord）
Discord.description:
The witch can make an animal or humanoid within 30 feet distrust another creature within line of sight. The target閳ユ獨 attitude toward the other creature decreases by one step. A successful Will save negates this effect. The effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to the witch閳ユ獨 Intelligence modifier. The duration can be extended with the cackle hex. Whether or not the save is successful, a creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 1 day.

  At 8th level, this effect decreases the attitude of the target creature by two steps. This is a mind-affecting charm effect.

Discreet Inquiries.name: Discreet Inquiries（Discreet Inquiries）
Discreet Inquiries.description:
The vigilante can attempt Diplomacy checks to gather information without being obvious he is seeking any, whether by buying the silence of informants or by talking foes into revealing information without realizing they are doing so. While the vigilante is in his area of renown, gathering information in this way takes 2d4 hours and costs 2d4 gp. Anyone who might take notice of the information gathering does not notice unless she succeeds at a Sense Motive check opposed by the vigilante閳ユ獨 Bluff check.

  The vigilante gains a +4 bonus on this Bluff check.

Disease (UC) (4 pts).name: Disease (UC) (4 pts)（Disease (UC) (4 pts)）
Disease (UC) (4 pts).description:
Requirements: Aberrant, daemon, demon, or devil subtype or the undead appearance evolution; summoner level 7th.

  One of the eidolon閳ユ獨 natural weapons carries a disease chosen from the following list:

  • bubonic plague,
  • filth fever,
  • leprosy,
  • red ache, or
  • shakes.

  Each hit forces a saving throw against the disease閳ユ獨 normal effects. The disease has no onset, however. The save DC equals 10 + 1/2 the eidolon閳ユ獨 Hit Dice + the eidolon閳ユ獨 Constitution modifier. The eidolon can expose a creature to its disease no more than once per round.

  By spending 2 additional evolution points, you can instead choose the following additional diseases:

  • demon fever (only if the eidolon has the demon subtype),
  • devil chills (only if the eidolon has the devil subtype), or
  • slimy doom.

Disease Use.name: Disease Use（Disease Use）
Disease Use.description: A rogue with this talent can apply filth from garbage, a sewer, a city street, a polluted area, or long-unwashed clothing or fur to a weapon as a standard action. Doing so causes the weapon to inflict filth fever (Pathfinder RPG Core Rulebook 557) on its next strike. The rogue does not risk exposure to this disease unless she is damaged by the weapon. After a successful attack with the weapon, the filth is dispersed and must be reapplied.

Disemboweling Tusks.name: Disemboweling Tusks（Disemboweling Tusks）
Disemboweling Tusks.description:
While raging, when you confirm a critical hit with your gore attack, you deal 1d4 points of Constitution damage in addition to the normal damage for the gore attack.

  You must be at least 10th level to select this rage power.

Disintegrating Infusion.name: 分解注能（Disintegrating Infusion）
Disintegrating Infusion.description:
元素：以太；類別：性質注能；等級：6；超載：4

  關聯念襲類別：力場彈

  豁免：強韌，通過則部分生效；見後文

  你能夠使用力場彈轟殺目標。在對抗生物時，你的念襲造成兩倍於正常傷害的數值，但是目標可以進行豁免來使傷害降低至正常數值的一半（對於增強後的念襲傷害總量來說為四分之一）。任何生命值被念襲降低至0點以下的生物會被完全分解，就如同解離術（Disintegrate）一般。你也可以如同使用解離術一般，使用注能念襲破壞力場效果或物體，但是你以此方式摧毀的每個力場效果或10立方尺的非生命物質，都必然讓你承受1點超載，而且這個超載無法被注能熟稔（Infusion Specialization）或念力凝聚（Gather Power）之類的效果所降低。

Disorientation (Stare).name: 迷失（Disorientation (Stare)）
Disorientation (Stare).description: 催眠注視的減值還能應用至攻擊檢定上。

Disorienting Touch.name: Disorienting Touch（Disorienting Touch）
Disorienting Touch.description: At 1st level, as a melee touch attack, you can cause a creature to doubt its sense of depth and direction. The target is sickened for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your sorcerer level (minimum 1). Multiple touches do not stack, but they do add to the duration. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Dispelling Pulse.name: 驅散脈衝（Dispelling Pulse）
Dispelling Pulse.description: 異能者能夠從精神力池中花費3點精神力，來讓解除魔法的力量縈繞在目標型法術（targeted spell）上。若目標被聯結法術命中、或者在對抗聯結法術的豁免中失敗的話，它會如同受到了異能者施放的目標型解除魔法（targeted dispel magic）一般受到影響。該效果僅能解除與聯結法術等級相同或更低等級的法術。若聯結法術本身不需要進行攻擊檢定，也不允許進行豁免檢定的話，目標能夠嘗試一次意志豁免檢定來避免解除魔法的效果（也僅限於避免該效果）；計算DC時使用聯結法術的等級（外加所有其他可以應用的加值，就如同聯結法術原本便允許進行意志豁免一般）。此項精神增幅僅能聯結到以一個生物或物體（one creature or object）為目標的法術上。

Dispelling Strikes.name: Dispelling Strikes（Dispelling Strikes）
Dispelling Strikes.description:
At 1st level, when you confirm a critical hit against a target, you can also attempt to dispel the target as if you had cast @Compendium[pf1.spells.gmgwyjfpeuuc4t4o]{解除魔法} as a bloodrager spell and used the targeted dispel function. You can dispel only a single magical effect per use of this ability, and you can use this ability against a particular creature only once per day.

  At 8th level, you gain a +2 bonus on your dispel check when using this ability.

  At 20th level, you can attempt to dispel all magical effects on your target when using this ability.

Disquiet (Stare).name: Disquiet (Stare)（Disquiet (Stare)）
Disquiet (Stare).description: The target of the hypnotic stare is shaken while in areas of total darkness.

Disrupt Animation.name: Disrupt Animation（Disrupt Animation）
Disrupt Animation.description: You can use @Compendium[pf1.spells.oyu8efso7sio8arn]{打擊死靈} as a spell-like ability, adding your wisdom modifier to the damage. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Disrupt Connection.name: Disrupt Connection（Disrupt Connection）
Disrupt Connection.description:
The hexer disrupts the connection between a summoned creature within 30 feet and its master. The summoned creature must succeed at a Will save or be confused for 1d4 rounds. While it閳ユ獨 confused in this way, during any round in which the percentile die roll to determine the creature閳ユ獨 confusion result is 76閳?00, the affected creature instead acts as if the hexer had summoned it (attacking the hexer閳ユ獨 enemies or performing such other tasks that the hexer can communicate to it).

  At 8th level, this hex causes the summoned creature to act as if the hexer had summoned it on a result of 51閳?00.

  At 16th level, this hex causes the summoned creature to act this way on a result of 26閳?00.

  The cackle hex extends the duration of this hex by 1 round. Once a creature has been the target of this hex, that creature is immune to this hex for 24 hours.

Disruptive (BAR).name: 擾法者(野蠻人)（Disruptive (BAR)）
Disruptive (BAR).description: 狂暴時野蠻人獲得“擾法者”作為獎勵專長。野蠻人必須習得【迷信】才能選擇此狂暴之力。野蠻人必須至少8級才能選擇這個狂暴之力。

Disruptive (MAG).name: 擾法者(魔戰士)（Disruptive (MAG)）
Disruptive (MAG).description:
前提：魔戰士等級6

  效果：魔戰士得到@Compendium[pf1.feats.QaMwiDFQdDwycTUO]{擾法者} 作為獎勵專長。

Dissipating Rage.name: Dissipating Rage（Dissipating Rage）
Dissipating Rage.description: When the barbarian rages, her feverish frenzy and hot breath burn or blow fog, smoke and similar effects away from her. The barbarian and creatures adjacent to her do not gain concealment from obfuscating effects like fog or precipitation. Magical effects that require more than a strong wind to dissipate are not affected by this rage power.

Distant Spellstrike.name: Distant Spellstrike（Distant Spellstrike）
Distant Spellstrike.description:
The range of any spell the magus delivers through a ranged weapon attack increases to the maximum range of the weapon if that is greater than the spell閳ユ獨 range.

  The magus must be at least 12th level and must have ranged spellstrike to select this arcana.

Distortion.name: 扭曲（Distortion）
Distortion.description: 該靈器可以扭曲持有者的形態和位置，保護不受傷害。以一個標準動作，持有者可以獲得隱蔽失手率，失手率等於每填充入2心智點5%（最高為5%+每2秘學士等級5%）。持續到持有者進行下一次攻擊。若失手率達到50%，繼續填充心智點不會再增加失手率，而是持有者獲得隱形術的所有效果。識破隱形、真知術或類似能力可以忽視該能力的給予的失手率。

Distracted (Stare).name: Distracted (Stare)（Distracted (Stare)）
Distracted (Stare).description: The hypnotic stare penalty also applies to concentration checks.

Distracting Pattern.name: Distracting Pattern（Distracting Pattern）
Distracting Pattern.description: At 9th level, you can distort the scenery around you for a number of rounds equal to your sorcerer level. This ability provides a 20% miss chance on ranged attacks made against you and grants you a bonus on 隱匿 checks equal to 1/2 your sorcerer level. You can use this ability once per day at 9th level, twice per day at 17th level, and three times per day at 20th level.

Distributed Body.name: Distributed Body（Distributed Body）
Distributed Body.description: At 15th level, anytime you are struck by a critical hit or a sneak attack, there is a 25% chance that your nanites scatter and reincorporate around the attack, negating the extra damage and causing the attack to deal damage as normal instead.

Div Bloodline.name: Div Bloodline（Div Bloodline）
Div Bloodline.description:
You can trace your ancestry to one of the foul, corrupted genies known as divs.

  本職技能: @JournalEntry[dfjwbMEdt062TJtE]{知識}：位面.

  獎勵法術:

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.oj36nfak6jc2s5ky]{易容術} (3rd),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.648x72rflah0ggyz]{愚者之觸} (5th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jdsvncnna6oy189a]{深幽黑暗術} (7th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lsboosfk26m0ycqv]{降咒} (9th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jdp0mts5razk0qms]{疫病蟲群} (11th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.sxyiwj0z95piv96i]{解離術} (13th),
