  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.s6q72tw2zra9sycu]{精神錯亂} (15th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.a5gcbpwfhu4hh5ic]{地震術} (17th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.nnj51dwfkwd15ngj]{祈願術} (19th).

  獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.pmAO1Sni8xx71pLF]{盲斗},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.SUACufUXl12sUvnQ]{詐欺師},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.77gXSucrxfrE9yWk]{法術強效},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{精通先攻},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.iAbIGhm7T2OK9Brt]{鋼鐵意志},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.0bZf3SDkvVOe2ujH]{閃電反射},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.L10V7jTzmMYz62zz]{談判專家},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.FUW5mIXHNBBIQ1Sq]{猛力攻擊}.

  血統奧秘: Whenever you deal damage to more than one creature with a spell that affects an area, the save DCs of your spells increase by 1 for 1d4 rounds.

Div Resistances.name: Div Resistances（Div Resistances）
Div Resistances.description: At 3rd level, you gain fire resistance 5 and a +2 bonus on saving throws against poison. At 9th level, your resistance to fire increases to 10 and your bonus on saving throws against poison increases to +4.

Divination Resonant School.name: 預言靈器（Divination Resonant School）
Divination Resonant School.description:
預言靈器專注於先見能力和遠距離觀察。

  靈器（Implements）：書、水晶球、護目鏡、哈羅牌、頭帶、透鏡、占卜板。

Divine Alchemy.name: Divine Alchemy（Divine Alchemy）
Divine Alchemy.description:
You can perform a 1-minute ritual that infuses a flask of water with one of your prepared spells, creating an improvised potion that lasts until consumed or the next time you prepare spells. You can use this ability only with spells that target one or more creatures, and the maximum spell level you can infuse in this way is equal to 1 + 1 for every 4 cleric levels you have. These potions are treated as alchemist extracts for the purpose of your domain spells. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Artificer's Touch power from the Artifice Domain or the Hand of the Acolyte power from the Magic Domain.

Divine Challenge.name: Divine Challenge（Divine Challenge）
Divine Challenge.description:
As a swift action, you can challenge a visible foe within 30 feet, gaining a +1 sacred bonus to your AC against that creature閳ユ獨 attacks and a bonus equal to 1/2 your cleric level on Bluff skill checks to feint against it. These bonuses last for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your cleric level. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Battle Rage power of the War Domain.

Divine Demand.name: Divine Demand（Divine Demand）
Divine Demand.description:
At 6th level, you can petition your divine patron for far greater power than you deserve. Activating this ability is a swift action that you must use as you cast a spell that has a reduced (but not negated) effect on a successful save. The saving throw DC of the spell increases by 2, and you gain a +2 bonus on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance with the spell. Any creature that succeeds at the saving throw instead avoids the effect entirely. If half or more of the targets are unaffected, you become shaken for a number of rounds equal to the spell閳ユ獨 level. If all of the targets are unaffected, you instead lose the ability to cast divine spells, channel energy, and use domain powers for 1d4+1 rounds; you can end this loss as a full-round action by loudly apologizing to your patron deity as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity. You can use this ability once per day at 6th level, and one additional time per day for every 4 levels beyond 6th.

  This power replaces the Divine Presence power of the Glory Domain or the Leadership power of the Nobility Domain.

Divine Energy.name: 神力能量（Divine Energy）
Divine Energy.description: 你能夠將法術能量轉化為治療傷害或造成傷害法術（cure or inflict spells）。該能力的功能與牧師自發施放治療傷害或造成傷害法術的能力相似，你能夠轉化的法術類型和牧師能力一樣取決於你的陣營。在判斷任何其他效果的功能時，治療傷害或造成傷害法術不被視為在你的異能者法術列表中。每日你能夠轉化的法術數量為每個能夠施法的法術等級至多一個法術。每當你使用該能力轉化一個法術時，你的精神力池會恢復1點精神力。每日以此方式恢復的精神力數量等同於你的感知調整值。

Divine Inks.name: Divine Inks（Divine Inks）
Divine Inks.description: The alchemist can develop special pigments and combine them with his alchemical reagents to create unique dyes that cling to the empty space around him, allowing him to paint images in the air to fool his enemies. By expending two daily uses of his bombs, he can use the dyes to create an image in a space adjacent to him, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.kq916lznxo0ig68v]{無聲幻影}, using his alchemist level as the spell閳ユ獨 caster level. The image he creates remains for a number of minutes equal to his alchemist level. He can dismiss this image as a standard action.

Divine Surge.name: 大祭司神力（Divine Surge）
Divine Surge.description: 本能力與大法師英靈的大法師魔術相同，但以牧師/先知列表替換法師/術士列表，你的法術視為神術，並且你需要一件法器來施放法術。

Dolphin Aspect.name: Dolphin Aspect（Dolphin Aspect）
Dolphin Aspect.description:
The aspect of the dolphin imparts clever mastery of the seas. Shifters with this aspect also embody the size and ferociousness of large dolphins, such as orcas.

Minor Form: You gain a +4 competence bonus on Knowledge checks to identify creatures閳?abilities and weaknesses.

  This bonus increases to +6 at 8th level and +8 at 15th level.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a Large dolphin, but your space is 10 feet instead of 5 feet. While in this form, you gain a swim speed of 60 feet, blindsense with a range of 10 feet, low-light vision, a bite attack (1d8), and the ability to hold your breath for a number of minutes equal to 6 times your Constitution score before you risk drowning.

  At 8th level, the range of your blindsense increases to 20 feet.

  At 15th level, the range of your blindsense increases to 60 feet and your swim speed increases to 80 feet.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Bite (B, P, S), Slam (B)

Dolphin.name: Dolphin（Dolphin）
Dolphin.description:
The aspect of the dolphin imparts clever mastery of the seas. Shifters with this aspect also embody the size and ferociousness of large dolphins, such as orcas.

Minor Form: You gain a +4 competence bonus on Knowledge checks to identify creatures閳?abilities and weaknesses.

  This bonus increases to +6 at 8th level and +8 at 15th level.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a Large dolphin, but your space is 10 feet instead of 5 feet. While in this form, you gain a swim speed of 60 feet, blindsense with a range of 10 feet, low-light vision, a bite attack (1d8), and the ability to hold your breath for a number of minutes equal to 6 times your Constitution score before you risk drowning.

  At 8th level, the range of your blindsense increases to 20 feet.

  At 15th level, the range of your blindsense increases to 60 feet and your swim speed increases to 80 feet.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Bite (B, P, S), Slam (B)

Dominate Technology.name: 支配科技（Dominate Technology）
Dominate Technology.description: 在十三級的時候，你可以將你的心靈和一件科技物品相結合並暫時控制它，即使你並沒有創造過它或者是創造過其它像它一樣的東西。每天一次，你可以對一個構裝體施放控制構裝UM（就和法術一樣），除了每輪用於維持對構裝體的法術辨識檢定等於15+構裝體的HD。如果在你使用該能力的時候，你必須要用法術辨識來對抗構裝體的製造者的話，你將會在你的法術辨識檢定上有一個-5的罰值。

Doomsayer.name: Doomsayer（Doomsayer）
Doomsayer.description:
As a standard action, you can utter a dire prophecy that strikes fear in your enemies and causes them to become shaken. To be affected, an enemy must be within 30 feet and able to hear you. This effect persists as long as the enemy is within 30 feet and you use a move action each round to continue your doomsaying. This ability cannot cause a creature to become frightened or panicked, even if the target was already shaken from another effect. This is a mind-affecting fear effect that relies on audible components.

  At 15th level, continuing your doomsaying each round is a swift action instead.

  You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Double Time.name: 專業趕工（Double Time）
Double Time.description: 俠客的社交身份是一位手藝精熟的工匠或是藝術家而不是有閒錢的富商和貴族，他必須要在兼職俠客之餘努力工作來確保自己的秘密行動可以繼續——長此以往，他練就了能依靠加班加點完成日常工作的訣竅。擁有本天賦的俠客每天只需工作6小時而非正常的8小時來通過手藝活專業技能進行工作，如果他在指定的手藝或專業技能上擁有社會人之優雅天賦的好處，那麼這個工作時間可以再降低到每天4小時。俠客必須擁有一項符合其職業表現的社交身份才能選擇本天賦。

Draconic Bloodrager Bloodline.name: Draconic Bloodrager Bloodline（Draconic Bloodrager Bloodline）
Draconic Bloodrager Bloodline.description:
At some point in your family閳ユ獨 history, a dragon interbred with your bloodline. Now, the sublime monster閳ユ獨 ancient power fuels your bloodrage.

獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.pmAO1Sni8xx71pLF]{盲斗}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Zeq6RWYv5otvg8q7]{順勢斬}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.fVRnBIHR4Jq6btvm]{強韌加強}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{精通先攻}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.FUW5mIXHNBBIQ1Sq]{猛力攻擊}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.7zJTztNW7hdaqjKc]{技能專攻} (Fly),
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.8snLqsJN4LLL00Nq]{健壯}

  獎勵法術:

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.sz7j540uypmqqvti]{護盾術} (7th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.tkjnm3lw7ni82tag]{抵抗能量傷害} (10th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.7d6sv5ecvi7kho3m]{飛行術} (13th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.be88e90guqbi1q1z]{恐懼術} (16th)

  At 1st level, you must select one of the chromatic or metallic dragon types. Once chosen, this cannot be changed. A number of your bloodline powers deal damage and grant resistances based on your dragon type, as noted below.

Dragon Type Energy Type Breath Shape
Black Acid 60-foot line
Blue Electricity 60-foot line
Green Acid 30-foot cone
Red Fire 30-foot cone
White Cold 30-foot cone

Gold Fire 30-foot cone
Silver Cold 30-foot cone

Draconic Claws.name: Draconic Claws（Draconic Claws）
Draconic Claws.description: Starting at 1st level, you can grow claws as a free action. These claws are treated as natural weapons, allowing you to make two claw attacks as a full attack action using your full base attack bonus. Each of these attacks deals 1d4 points of damage plus your Strength modifier (1d3 if you are Small). At 5th level, these claws are considered magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming DR. At 7th level, the damage increases by one step to 1d6 points of damage (1d4 if you are Small). At 11th level, these claws deal an additional 1d6 points of damage of your energy type on a successful hit. You can use your claws for a number of rounds per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

Draconic Resilience.name: Draconic Resilience（Draconic Resilience）
Draconic Resilience.description:
The shaman grants a creature she touches some of the magically resilient nature of dragons, causing the creature to be immune to magical sleep effects for a number of rounds equal to the shaman閳ユ獨 level.

  At 7th level, the creature is also immune to paralysis for this duration.

  Once a creature has benefited from the draconic resilience hex, it cannot benefit from this hex again for 24 hours.

Draconic Resistances.name: Draconic Resistances（Draconic Resistances）
Draconic Resistances.description:
At 4th level, you gain resistance 5 against your energy type and a +1 natural armor bonus to AC.

  At 8th level, your energy resistance increases to 10 and your natural armor bonus increases to +2.

  At 16th level, your natural armor bonus increases to +4.

Dragon Final Revelation.name: Dragon Final Revelation（Dragon Final Revelation）
Dragon Final Revelation.description: Upon reaching 20th level, your draconic destiny unfolds. You gain immunity to paralysis, sleep, and damage of your energy type. You count as a dragon for the purposes of spells and magical effects. If you have the breath weapon revelation, you can use your breath weapon an unlimited number of times per day, though no more often than once every 1d4+1 rounds.

Dragon Magic.name: Dragon Magic（Dragon Magic）
Dragon Magic.description:
Your draconic power grants you a limited form of access to arcane magic. Select one spell from the sorcerer/wizard spell list that is 2 levels lower than the highest-level spell you can cast, or two spells that are both at least 3 levels lower. You can cast each of the selected spells once per day as a spell-like ability.

  At 11th level, you can cast each selected spell twice per day.

Dragon Mystery.name: Dragon Mystery（Dragon Mystery）
Dragon Mystery.description:
Upon selecting this mystery, the oracle must select an energy type (acid, cold, electricity, or fire) to be her associated element, which impacts several revelations.

本職技能: An oracle with the dragon mystery adds Fly, Intimidate, Perception, and Knowledge ：神秘 to her list of class skills. She can take ranks in Fly even if she does not have a method of flying under her own power.

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.9tww9fc9049h6iqc]{驚恐術} (2nd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.tkjnm3lw7ni82tag]{抵抗能量傷害} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.7d6sv5ecvi7kho3m]{飛行術} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.be88e90guqbi1q1z]{恐懼術} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.4k9bh8ny1il2oner]{法術抗力} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.niqxt53lhxrjfaty]{反魔場} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jbqo4o2b2tmdz7wv]{真知術} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.fv14vemq9gduhyhu]{Form Of The Alien Dragon III} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.xuuzj9lr2xbwaim4]{神威如獄} (18th).

Dragon Senses.name: Dragon Senses（Dragon Senses）
Dragon Senses.description:
Your senses take on a keen draconic edge. You gain either darkvision with a range of 60 feet or low-light vision.

  At 5th level, you can select darkvision with a range of 60 feet or low-light vision if you do not yet have both, or you can add 60 feet to the range of your darkvision.

  At 11th level, you gain blindsense with a range of 30 feet. If you already have blindsense, you instead increase its range by 30 feet.

  At 15th level, you gain either the scent ability or a +4 bonus on Perception checks.

Dragon Subdomain.name: Dragon Subdomain（Dragon Subdomain）
Dragon Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.mjxpdh9jlmr92f1q]{斗轉星移}
  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.cdedzw5d9ui73ua7]{龍息術}
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.iqcjiyi9leldfzxt]{巨龍形態 I}

Dragon's Breath.name: Dragon's Breath（Dragon's Breath）
Dragon's Breath.description: The psychic can spend 2 points from her phrenic pool to change a linked spell that has a line or burst area of effect into a 30-foot cone that emanates from the psychic閳ユ獨 mouth as a breath weapon.

Dragonbreath.name: Dragonbreath（Dragonbreath）
Dragonbreath.description:
At 4th level, you can use a breath weapon once per day as a standard action. When you gain this ability, choose what kind of damage your breath weapon deals: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. Once you make this choice, you can閳ユ獩 change it later. Your breath weapon fills a 15-foot cone and deals 3d6 points of damage; this damage increases by 1d6 points at every even-numbered level you gain beyond 4th level. A creature hit by your dragonbreath attack can attempt a Reflex save (DC = 10 + half your class level + your Wisdom modifier) to take half damage. At 9th level, you can use this ability two times per day, and at 14th level, you can use it three times per day.

  This power replaces the Serpent Companion power of the Scalykind Domain.

Dragonfly Aspect.name: Dragonfly Aspect（Dragonfly Aspect）
Dragonfly Aspect.description:
The aspect of the dragonfly offers the ability to make quick, darting attacks at foes.

Minor Form: You gain an enhancement bonus of +10 feet to your base speed when charging.

  This bonus increases to +20 feet at 8th level and +30 feet at 15th level.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a giant dragonfly. While in this form, you gain a fly speed of 60 feet (average), darkvision with a range of 60 feet, and a bite attack (2d6) with the grab ability.

  At 8th level, you gain Flyby Attack as a bonus feat, and your fly speed improves to 60 feet (good).

  At 15th level, your fly speed increases to 80 feet (perfect), and if you charge while flying, you gain a +4 bonus on grapple combat maneuver checks for 1 round.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Bite (B, P, S), wing (B)

Drain Vibrancy.name: Drain Vibrancy（Drain Vibrancy）
Drain Vibrancy.description:
At 13th level, you can drain the color and vitality from the world around you. Three times per day, as a standard action you can drain vibrancy within a 30-foot radius, causing the area and all creatures within it to become pale and sallow. Each living creature in the area must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + half your psychic level + your Wisdom modifier) or take 1 temporary negative level as their life force drains away.

  If you閳ユ獧e at least 17th level, a creature that fails its saving throw takes 2 temporary negative levels instead.

Draining Gloom.name: Draining Gloom（Draining Gloom）
Draining Gloom.description:
A creature struck by a direct hit with the gloom must make a successful Fortitude save or gain 1 negative level.

  An alchemist must be at least 8th level and must have the debilitating gloom discovery before selecting this discovery.

Draining Infusion.name: 虹吸注能（Draining Infusion）
Draining Infusion.description:
元素：通用；類別：性質注能；等級：1；超載：1

  關聯念襲類別：任意簡易念襲

  豁免：強韌，通過則部分生效；見後文

  你能夠從敵人那裡抽取元素能量或者物質，以此來加強你的下一次攻擊。當你使用虹吸注能時，你的念襲效果只會影響和你的念襲元素相符的生物亞種，比如火衝（fire blast）僅能傷害火系亞種（fire subtype）的生物。在對抗此類生物時，你的念襲會以接觸AC為目標（若念襲需要進行攻擊檢定），而且總是允許法術抗力（spell resistance）生效。由於你要從目標體內抽取能量，因此你的念襲不會獲得元素滿溢（Elemental Overflow）加值或者體質調整值。目標能夠嘗試強韌豁免，來使得傷害數值降低至正常的四分之一。虹吸注能會忽略任何生物具有的傷害減免、抗力和免疫。若至少有一個生物在對抗虹吸注能的豁免中失敗的話，那麼在你的下個回合結束之前，你可以將任意一個念襲原力的總超載消耗降低1點，若該能力是超自然能力則可以降低2點。如果你在應用上述超載降低之前再次使用虹吸注能的話，仍舊可以通過虹吸注能造成傷害，但是超載消耗的降低數額不會疊加。

Draining Touch.name: Draining Touch（Draining Touch）
Draining Touch.description:
As a standard action, you can make a melee touch attack to drain vitality from a creature. If the attack hits, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + half your psychic level + your Wisdom modifier) or take 1d2 points of Charisma damage. If a creature is affected, the colors of its skin, hair, and eyes dull and become less vibrant.

  Whether or not the save is successful, a creature cannot be the target of this power again for 24 hours. You regain 1 point in your phrenic pool each time you successfully drain a creature this way.

  You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Wisdom modifier.

Dread Bomb.name: Dread Bomb（Dread Bomb）
Dread Bomb.description:
Your anguish bombs are tainted with fear and dread. Creatures who take damage from your anguish bombs become frightened for 1d6 rounds. A target that succeeds at a Will saving throw is instead shaken for a single round.

  An alchemist must be 6th level and have the anguish bomb class feature or the anguish bomb discovery before selecting this discovery.

Dream Discipline.name: 夢境境界（Dream Discipline）
Dream Discipline.description:
通過在夢境中遨遊的方式，你挖掘著精神伸出更為強大的一隅。你的意識能擴展到他人的夢境中，這使得你能夠探究昏迷之人的心境或者噩夢與恐懼所處的區域。

精神力池屬性 魅力

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.3plb67e51webutdz]{睡眠術} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.j7mhkhixnvd0amye]{Oneiric Horror} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.qgmlu83z2l84kjde]{深度睡眠} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ntcb8hjlxps8v212]{夢游} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.siv3ub7hbmcklf8c]{夢魘} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.pzwe3gxjz8gthyaj]{夢之衣} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.btccs4sjo2nog1a0]{幻化靈體} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.759y8xzdg3unvt6s]{Dream Voyage} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.esugpfcs3zwbujt1]{Microcosm} (18th).

Dream Leech.name: 汲取夢境（Dream Leech）
Dream Leech.description: 當你與正在昏睡（sleeping）或昏迷（unconscious）的生物相鄰時，你能夠以迅捷動作來抽取該生物的夢境，這會讓你通過自身的精神獲知一些新資訊。該生物能夠嘗試一次意志豁免以使得該效果無效；這些生物總是被視為非自願的。不會做夢的生物免疫該效果。若受術者的豁免失敗，那麼在接下來的24小時內，你能夠在對抗受術者的下一個唬騙、交涉或威嚇檢定中獲得+4加值，而且你的精神力池會恢復1點精神力。每日使用該能力的次數等同於你的魅力調整值，但是每個小時內僅能使用1次，每日對同一個生物也僅能使用1次。

Drug Resistance.name: 毒品耐性（Drug Resistance）
Drug Resistance.description: 當你攝入毒品（drugs）時，僅會受到半額的屬性傷害（最低1點）。你還能在避免對毒品成癮（becoming addicted to a drug）和戒斷毒癮（overcome being addicted）的豁免檢定中獲得+4加值。詳細規則請見藥物與成癮（Drugs and Addiction；出自GMG）。

Drugged.name: Drugged（Drugged）
Drugged.description:
The witch can combine her magic with her poisons to weaken her enemies閳?minds. When the witch creates a poison, she can require the target of the poison to attempt a Will save rather than a Fortitude save.

  The witch must use this hex when she crafts the poison, and once used, the hex can閳ユ獩 be undone without remaking the poison.

Dual Amplification.name: 雙重增幅（Dual Amplification）
Dual Amplification.description: 當異能者使用此項高等精神增幅時，她要選擇另外兩個自己已知的精神增幅或者高等精神增幅，並將它們應用至相同的聯結法術上。她必須從精神力池中花費1點精神力才能夠這麼做，在此之上還要花費另外兩個精神增幅所需要的完整消耗。她無法將相同的精神增幅重複應用至聯結法術上，即便該項精神增幅本身具有多個不同的效果也不行。

Dual Bond.name: 雙重附身（Dual Bond）
Dual Bond.description: 在17級時，喚魂師每天可以使用附體顯形的輪數提升到3+喚魂師的等級x2輪。

Dual Identity.name: 雙重身份（Dual Identity）
Dual Identity.description:
俠客懂得自己必須在公眾面前隱藏他冷酷而真實的鬥士生活，這樣他在以社交名流的形象周旋於名利場與貴族圈子時才能做到如魚得水，不受掣肘。這個能力可以讓俠客同時維持兩種身份：一個是文明的社會一員，另一個則是技巧嫻熟而狡詐的戰士。為了維持這個秘密，俠客通常有兩個名字，他在社交圈使用的真實姓名，以及他在打擊敵人時在他們之中散佈恐慌的俠客稱號。觀察者對這兩個名字其中之一所進行的知識檢定結果並不會揭露出俠客另一個身份的訊息，除非俠客的隱藏身份被公之於眾。

  在每天開始時，俠客可以任意選擇這兩個身份之一作為他出現在人前的形象，即他的社交/俠客身份。從某一身份轉換到另一個隱藏的身份需要俠客花費一分鐘時間，並且這個轉換過程必須避開其他生物的注意以保持俠客身份的機密性。俠客轉換身份這一過程並不僅僅是換身衣服那麼簡單（當然，一些必要的變裝也是轉換俠客身份時不可缺少的部分）；在轉換身份時，俠客通常需要化妝，戴上假髮和麵具以及改變一些其他顯著的個人特徵。除了外在的改變，俠客轉換身份的過程也涉及內在的自我調整和重新進入角色——使用通過諸如易容帽（Hat of Disguise）這樣可以迅速改變外貌的魔法物品事實上不能加快俠客轉換身份的速度。俠客的大多數社交天賦職業能力要求俠客處於他的社交身份形象時才能使用，並且如果俠客在社交身份的形象下使用他的俠客天賦職業能力，他可能會暴露自己的真實身份。

  雖然本質上是同一個人，但是俠客的雙重身份允許他的社交身份和俠客身份可以分別擁有不同的陣營（每個身份一個）。當他處於某一身份時，俠客在受到法術，魔法物品和其他基於陣營判斷效果的能力影響時視為屬於該陣營。而為了達到某個專長，職業要求或其他能力的先決條件時，俠客的兩個身份的陣營需要同時滿足需求才行。俠客的兩個身份之間的陣營必須在每個陣營軸上相差一級以內。舉例而言，一個擁有守序中立社交身份的俠客，他的俠客身份必須屬於以下陣營之一：守序善良，守序中立，守序邪惡，絕對中立，中立善良或中立邪惡。如果俠客成為一個會改變其陣營效果的目標，那麼他的兩個身份的兩個陣營會同時受到改變。

  任何嘗試探知或其他方式定位俠客的嘗試，僅僅會在嘗試探知他的生物確定探知俠客的目前所使用的身份（或是，如果這個探知者瞭解俠客的雙重身份）時才會生效。如果他使用的是該生物不知道的那個身份那麼嘗試探知他的法術或效果不產生效果，除了一片黑暗外一無所獲，就像目標不正確或不存在一樣。

Dual Spirit.name: Dual Spirit（Dual Spirit）
Dual Spirit.description: At 20th level, you gain immunity to mind-affecting effects. Whenever you successfully employ a possession effect (such as @Compendium[pf1.spells.8ai7fslz4zu8xe9s]{魔魂壺} or possession), you remain in complete control of your body and the body of your possessed target.

Duels Subdomain.name: Duels Subdomain（Duels Subdomain）
Duels Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.uk340huvgyg1z8yh]{Warding Weapon}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.mkn0jklea8knq1lz]{Dance of a Hundred Cuts}
  • 8環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ai9o7xqyftbf9ses]{Dance of a Thousand Cuts}

Dust to Dust.name: Dust to Dust（Dust to Dust）
Dust to Dust.description:
Once per day as a standard action, you can cause the weapons around you to shatter in their wielders閳?hands. When you use this ability, attempt a single sunder combat maneuver, using your caster level in place of your base attack bonus and your Charisma modifier in place of Strength. Every creature except you in a 10-foot radius that is wielding a manufactured weapon is targeted by the same attempt. You deal an amount of damage to each weapon affected equal to 1d4 鑴?your Charisma modifier (minimum 1d4). At 11th level, this damage increases to 1d6 鑴?your Charisma modifier (minimum 1d6).

  At 10th level, you can use this ability twice per day.

Earth Child.name: Earth Child（Earth Child）
Earth Child.description:
Element earth; Type utility (Su); Level 3; Burn 閳?/p>

  Blending your form with crystal, you have transmuted yourself into something akin to an oread. You keep your original racial abilities (including your ability score adjustments, but not your movement speed) and also gain all oread racial abilities (including an oread閳ユ獨 movement speed and the outsider [native] type) except for ability score adjustments. You have the crystalline form alternate racial trait (Pathfinder RPG Advanced Race Guide 144) instead of earth affinity, but cannot otherwise choose alternate racial traits.

Earth Climb.name: 攀巖（Earth Climb）
Earth Climb.description:
元素：土；類別：通用（Su）；等級：2；超載：0

  憑藉著自身和大地之間的聯繫，你將身體稍稍融入石質和土質的表面，當你在此類表面上攀爬時，會獲得等同於你的基礎陸上速度的攀爬速度。

Earth Crawler.name: Earth Crawler（Earth Crawler）
Earth Crawler.description: At 15th level, you gain a burrow speed of 30 feet. Additionally, as long as you are surrounded by at least 5 feet of dirt or natural stone on all sides, you gain fast healing 10. You can heal a number of hit points per day equal to 10 鑴?your sorcerer level with this ability.

Earth Glide (Kobold).name: 潛地(狗頭人)（Earth Glide (Kobold)）
Earth Glide (Kobold).description: 15級起，你獲得等同於你基本速度的“潛地”通用怪物能力。這並不會賦予你在土地中呼吸的能力，因此在使用該能力時你需要屏息或者使用替代方法來呼吸。

Earth Tongue.name: Earth Tongue（Earth Tongue）
Earth Tongue.description:
Element earth; Type utility (Sp); Level 8; Burn 0
Prerequisite greater tremorsense, tremorsense

  You are constantly capable of speaking to rocks and stones, including natural and worked stone, as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.wgm8mm1za909pwch]{石言術}. This ability is always active, and rocks and stones might speak to you before you speak to them if they have something to say.

Earth Totem, Greater.name: Earth Totem, Greater（Earth Totem, Greater）
Earth Totem, Greater.description: While raging, the barbarian閳ユ獨 skin becomes as hard as stone. If the barbarian is hit with a manufactured weapon while raging, the weapon takes an amount of damage equal to half that dealt to the barbarian (ignoring damage reduction).

Earth Totem.name: Earth Totem（Earth Totem）
Earth Totem.description: While raging, the barbarian can burrow through sand, loose soil, or gravel at a speed of 20 feet. This does not give the barbarian the ability to breathe underground. Loose material collapses behind the target 1 round after it leaves the area.

Earth Walk.name: 土行（Earth Walk）
Earth Walk.description:
元素：土；類別：通用（Su）；等級：1；超載：－

  由於你自身和土元素進行了較低程度的融合，所以當你站在土製表面（earthen surface）上時，能夠忽略由於岩石（rocks）、土（earth）或泥（mud）產生的困難地形（difficult terrain），而且當你身處此類表面上時，用於對抗讓你發生移動或摔絆的CMD、以及用於保持平衡的特技檢定可以獲得元素滿溢（Elemental Overflow）提供的加值。

Earthmeld.name: Earthmeld（Earthmeld）
Earthmeld.description:
Element earth; Type utility (Sp); Level 4; Burn 0
Prerequisite earth climb

  You meld a creature into stone, where it can listen to conversations without being detected. This functions as the @Compendium[pf1.spells.dkv9v4verb82fmpx]{融身入石} spell, except it can work on any willing creature, not just you, and it lasts for 10 minutes per kineticist level or until you use earthmeld again. The melded creature, not you, decides when to step out of the stone.

  You can accept 1 point of burn to increase the duration of an earthmeld until the next time you recover burn. Such increased earthmelds don閳ユ獩 end if you use earthmeld again, allowing you to maintain multiple earthmelds.

Earthquake Blessing: Stone's Base.name: Earthquake Blessing: Stone's Base（Earthquake Blessing: Stone's Base）
Earthquake Blessing: Stone's Base.description: You can touch an ally to bless it with the stalwart resilience of stone. For 1 minute, the creature gains a +4 bonus to its CMD against maneuvers that would move the ally or knock it prone.

Earthquake Blessing; Earth Hammer.name: Earthquake Blessing; Earth Hammer（Earthquake Blessing; Earth Hammer）
Earthquake Blessing; Earth Hammer.description: At 10th level, you can touch a weapon to bless it with the force of a mighty earthquake for 1 minute. When the weapon hits a creature, the target must succeed at a Reflex save or fall prone; either way, the creature is immune to this ability for 24 hours.

Eclipsing Rage, Greater.name: Eclipsing Rage, Greater（Eclipsing Rage, Greater）
Eclipsing Rage, Greater.description:
Whenever the barbarian rages, the light level within 20 feet of her lowers by two steps instead of one. She still can閳ユ獩 decrease the light level below normal darkness with this ability.

  A barbarian must be at least 10th level and have the eclipsing rage power to choose this rage power.

Eclipsing Rage.name: Eclipsing Rage（Eclipsing Rage）
Eclipsing Rage.description:
While the barbarian is raging, the light level within 10 feet of her lowers by one step. She can閳ユ獩 decrease the light level below normal darkness with this ability. Multiple barbarians with this rage power don閳ユ獩 further reduce the light level.

  A barbarian must be at least 6th level to choose this rage power.

Ectoplasmic Armor.name: Ectoplasmic Armor（Ectoplasmic Armor）
Ectoplasmic Armor.description:
You can conjure armor made of ectoplasm that grants you a +4 armor bonus to AC. In addition, this armor functions as if it had the ghost touch special ability.

  At 7th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the armor bonus increases by 2.

  You can use this armor for 1 hour per day per oracle level. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-hour increments.

Ectoplasmic Bomb.name: Ectoplasmic Bomb（Ectoplasmic Bomb）
Ectoplasmic Bomb.description: The alchemist can infuse her bombs with a special unction that damages incorporeal creatures and reveals the presence of undead creatures hiding in the area. Incorporeal creatures struck by an ectoplasmic bomb take full damage from the bomb. In addition, squares in the affected area of the bomb begin to faintly glow in the spaces where undead creatures have traveled in the last minute, including undead benefiting from invisibility or other forms of obscurity (such as @Compendium[pf1.spells.btccs4sjo2nog1a0]{幻化靈體}), effectively creating a glowing trail. Any undead creatures in the affected area at the time of the explosion likewise glow faintly. This glowing effect lasts for 1 minute, and is otherwise identical to @Compendium[pf1.spells.bl71og1gklwncmt7]{妖火}.

Ectoplasmic Bonded Manifestation.name: Ectoplasmic Bonded Manifestation（Ectoplasmic Bonded Manifestation）
Ectoplasmic Bonded Manifestation.description:
When a spiritualist uses this ability and chooses ectoplasmic form, she gains an ectoplasmic shield that protects her without restricting her movement or actions. She gains a +4 shield bonus to Armor Class; this bonus applies to incorporeal touch attacks. The ectoplasmic shield has no armor check penalty or arcane spell failure chance.

  At 8th level, the spiritualist also sprouts a pair of ectoplasmic tendrils from her body. Once per round as either a swift or a standard action (spiritualist閳ユ獨 choice), the spiritualist can use one or both tendrils to attack creatures within her melee reach (using the attack bonus and damage dice of her ectoplasmic manifested phantom) or to manipulate objects. She can even use that action to have one tendril make an attack and the other manipulate an object, as long as that object can be manipulated with one hand.

  At 13th level, the phantom閳ユ獨 ectoplasm clings to the spiritualist like a suit of armor. This grants the spiritualist a +6 armor bonus to AC without imposing an armor check penalty, an arcane spell failure chance, or any reduction in speed.

  At 18th level, the spiritualist can take a full-round action to attack all creatures within her melee reach with her tendrils (using the attack bonus and damage dice of her ectoplasmic manifested phantom). When she does, she rolls the attack roll twice, takes the better of the two results, and uses that as her attack roll result against all creatures within her melee reach. If the better attack roll threatens a critical hit, the spiritualist chooses one target that she hit to confirm the critical hit against. The other attacks that hit are considered normal hits rather than critical threats.

Ectoplasmic Damage Reduction.name: 靈質態傷害減免（Ectoplasmic Damage Reduction）
Ectoplasmic Damage Reduction.description: 靈質態的魅影獲得傷害減免5/揮砍。在喚魂師達到5級時，魅影的DR類型變更為DR5/魔法。在10級時，魅影的DR提升到DR10/魔法。在15級時，這個數值提升到DR15/魔法，在20級時，魅影的DR變更為DR15/-。

Ectoplasmic Phase Lurch.name: 靈質態相位移動（Ectoplasmic Phase Lurch）
Ectoplasmic Phase Lurch.description: 靈質態的魅影可以通過本能力穿越牆壁和類似的有型障礙物，但它必須穿過這一障礙並且在其外部結束自己的行動輪。靈質態的魅影並不能使用本能力穿越實體生物，並且在它穿越障礙物時，魅影的速度減半。如何被靈質態魅影穿越的物體平面會留下一層稀薄的靈質黏液，持續1分鐘時間。

Education Subdomain.name: Education Subdomain（Education Subdomain）
Education Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.sq6nz4vdj7qlzrdl]{Know The Enemy}
  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.743anqr1ahefv8zd]{狐之狡黠}
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.eg3i21asvo69mbma]{Battlemind Link}
  • 8環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.y4881ol4t79wj7sf]{Circle Of Clarity}

Eerie Disappearance.name: Eerie Disappearance（Eerie Disappearance）
Eerie Disappearance.description: As a full-round action, the rogue can move up to her speed. If she successfully reaches a location that offers her cover or concealment, any creature observing her must attempt a Perception check opposed by the rogue閳ユ獨 Stealth check. On a failed check, the observer loses track of the rogue and fails to note where she moved to. The rogue does not take a penalty on this Stealth check for moving up to her speed. At the end of her movement, the rogue can attempt an Intimidate check to demoralize all foes within 60 feet who were aware of her at any point during her movement and are unaware of her current location. She rolls the Intimidate check only once and compares her result to the DC for each opponent. The rogue must be at least 6th level to select this talent.

Eldritch Blast.name: Eldritch Blast（Eldritch Blast）
Eldritch Blast.description:
You can damage foes with a bolt of raw magical energy. Make a ranged touch attack against any foe within 30 feet. On a hit, you deal 1d8 points of force damage, +1 point of damage per two oracle levels. At 10th level, the bolt閳ユ獨 range increases to 60 feet.

  You may use this revelation a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Eldritch Conduit.name: Eldritch Conduit（Eldritch Conduit）
Eldritch Conduit.description: Survival in the Mana Wastes between the nations of Nex and Geb can depend heavily on locating sufficient magical equipment, which sometimes involves stealing power from a wand or scroll to power a more necessary one. As a full-round action, a rogue with this talent can use two potions, two wands, or two scrolls. Each item is expended or loses a charge as if used normally. The rogue chooses to gain the magical effect of one, but calculates its effects using the caster level of the other. The rogue must still succeed at a Use Magic Device check to operate scrolls or wands unless some other ability allows him to do so, but makes only one skill check to operate both items.

Electric Eel Aspect.name: Electric Eel Aspect（Electric Eel Aspect）
Electric Eel Aspect.description:
The aspect of the electric eel imparts the ability to charge attacks with electricity and to slip effortlessly out of danger.

Minor Form: Your attacks deal 1 point of electricity damage in addition to their normal damage.

  This additional electricity damage increases to 1d3 at 8th level and 1d6 at 15th level.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of an electric eel. While in this form, you gain a swim speed of 30 feet, low-light vision, electricity resistance 5, a bite attack (1d6), and a tail attack (a secondary natural touch attack that deals 1d6 points of electricity damage).

  At 8th level, your electricity resistance increases to 10 and you gain a +4 racial bonus on Escape Artist checks.

  At 15th level, on a critical hit with your tail attack, the creature struck must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + half your shifter level + your Constitution modifier) or be stunned for 1d4 rounds.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Bite (B, P, S), tail slap (B)

Electric Eel.name: Electric Eel（Electric Eel）
Electric Eel.description:
The aspect of the electric eel imparts the ability to charge attacks with electricity and to slip effortlessly out of danger.

Minor Form: Your attacks deal 1 point of electricity damage in addition to their normal damage.

  This additional electricity damage increases to 1d3 at 8th level and 1d6 at 15th level.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of an electric eel. While in this form, you gain a swim speed of 30 feet, low-light vision, electricity resistance 5, a bite attack (1d6), and a tail attack (a secondary natural touch attack that deals 1d6 points of electricity damage).

  At 8th level, your electricity resistance increases to 10 and you gain a +4 racial bonus on Escape Artist checks.

  At 15th level, on a critical hit with your tail attack, the creature struck must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + half your shifter level + your Constitution modifier) or be stunned for 1d4 rounds.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Bite (B, P, S), tail slap (B)

Elemental Aegis.name: Elemental Aegis（Elemental Aegis）
Elemental Aegis.description:
When you take this revelation, choose one element: air, earth, fire, or water. You can conjure an enveloping, protective force made of this element that grants you a +4 armor bonus to AC (this manifests as a solid rush of air over your body, rocky plates covering your skin, and the like).

  At 7th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by 2.

  You can use this armor for 1 hour per day per oracle level. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-hour increments.

  At 13th level, you receive an additional boon depending on the element you chose. If you chose air, you gain a +2 bonus on Reflex saving throws. If you chose earth, you gain a +2 bonus to CMD. If you chose fire, you gain fire resistance 2 (this stacks with any other fire resistance you have). If you chose water, you gain a +4 bonus on Swim checks.

Elemental Allies.name: Elemental Allies（Elemental Allies）
Elemental Allies.description:
The beings tied to the fundamental elements can hear your calls plainly when you seek aid from them. When casting summon monster spells to summon elementals with the air, earth, fire, or water subtype, you can cast the spell as a standard action instead of a casting time of 1 round.

  You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your oracle level.

  You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Elemental Bloodrager Bloodline.name: Elemental Bloodrager Bloodline（Elemental Bloodrager Bloodline）
Elemental Bloodrager Bloodline.description:
The power of the elements resides in you, and at times you can hardly control its fury. This influence comes either from an elemental outsider in your family history or from a moment when you or your ancestors were exposed to a powerful elemental force or cataclysm.

獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Zeq6RWYv5otvg8q7]{順勢斬}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.JreaiTHdyWFNj3Tb]{閃避}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.fVRnBIHR4Jq6btvm]{強韌加強}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{精通先攻}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.0bZf3SDkvVOe2ujH]{閃電反射}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.FUW5mIXHNBBIQ1Sq]{猛力攻擊}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.n250dFlbykAIAg5Z]{武器專攻}

  獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lndeaqm2j2nvgm6p]{燃燒之手}* (7th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.q4ixxjb4v281g2xv]{灼熱射線}* (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.1vh2ewwvzvxunoxk]{防護能量傷害} (13th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.pawbnw1nm4f0b98e]{元素身軀I} (16th)

  Spells marked with an asterisk [*] always deal a type of energy damage determined by your element, regardless of the spell閳ユ獨 normal effects. In addition, the subtype of these spells changes to match the energy type of your element.

  At first level, you must select an element: air, earth, fire, or water. Once chosen, this cannot be changed. A number of your abilities deal damage and grant resistances based on your element, as noted below.

Element Energy Type Elemental Movement
Air Electricity Fly 60 feet (good)
Earth Acid Burrow 30 feet
Fire Fire +30 feet base land speed
Water Cold Swim 60 feet

Elemental Channeling.name: Elemental Channeling（Elemental Channeling）
Elemental Channeling.description:
You can heal and harm elemental beings. You gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.f5rgOsdDlseGr4o5]{元素導能} (your choice of air, earth, fire, or water) as a bonus feat. You gain the cleric閳ユ獨 channel energy ability, as a cleric of your oracle level, but only to use @Compendium[pf1.feats.f5rgOsdDlseGr4o5]{元素導能}. The DC for this effect is 10 + half your oracle level + your Charisma modifier.

  At 5th, 10th, and 15th level, you gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.f5rgOsdDlseGr4o5]{元素導能} with one of the remaining elemental subtypes as a bonus feat.

  You can take other feats to add to this ability, such as @Compendium[pf1.feats.1HfwfBOSWtdxFQ2s]{精通導能}, but not feats that alter this ability, such as @Compendium[pf1.feats.ieww7CP6JK5pwtpg]{陣營導能}. This revelation閳ユ獨 effects do not stack with levels in other classes that grant the channel energy ability.

Elemental Defense.name: 元素護體（Elemental Defense）
Elemental Defense.description: 2級起，操念使獲得自身所選元素的護身原力（護身原力的內容刊載於16頁）。

Elemental Destabilizers.name: Elemental Destabilizers（Elemental Destabilizers）
Elemental Destabilizers.description:
The alchemist is able to concoct reactive chemical compounds that affect elementals like poisons. The alchemist can craft poisons that affect only outsiders with the elemental subtype, bypassing their inherent immunity. Magical effects that negate poisons still apply. If a creature fails its saving throw, the poison acts as normal, but it may have no effect on the creature depending on the effect of the poison (such as dealing fire damage to a fire elemental).

  An alchemist must be at least 8th level before selecting this discovery.

Elemental Exile.name: Elemental Exile（Elemental Exile）
Elemental Exile.description:
Element universal; Type utility (Sp); Level 8; Burn 1
Saving Throw Will negates; SR yes

  You transport a single creature you touch to the plane associated with your element. Precise accuracy regarding a particular arrival location on the intended plane is almost impossible. The creature appears 5 to 500 miles (5d%) from your intended destination. Elemental exile transports creatures instantaneously and then ends. The creature must find other means to travel back (such as casting @Compendium[pf1.spells.q3st18udsalnyz5v]{異界傳送} or using elemental exile again).

Elemental Final Revelation.name: Elemental Final Revelation（Elemental Final Revelation）
Elemental Final Revelation.description: Upon reaching 20th level, your body undergoes an internal elemental shift, and you become a living conduit of the Elemental Planes. Your external appearance remains the same, although you may take on certain cosmetic elemental traits (such as smoldering hair or pebble-like skin). You become immune to critical hits and precision damage such as from sneak attacks. You no longer need to breathe, eat, or sleep.

Elemental Focus.name: 元素念力（Elemental Focus）
Elemental Focus.description:
1級起，操念使要挑選一種首要元素（primary element）作為自己專攻的類別。該種元素會決定操念使如何從靈界位面（Ethereal Plane）汲取原始能量，並會賦予她特定原力（wild talents）的選擇權以及額外的本職技能。操念使可以選擇以太（心靈念力）、氣（大空念力）、土（地脈念力）、火（赤炎念力）或水（流水念力）。她會獲得自身所選元素的基礎通用原力（基礎心靈念力、基礎大空念力、基礎地脈念力、基礎赤炎念力或基礎流水念力）作為獎勵原力（bonus wild talent）。

  詳細內容請見後面的元素章節（Elements 14頁）中，關於各類元素所提供的特殊能力。

Elemental Gap.name: Elemental Gap（Elemental Gap）
Elemental Gap.description:
Element universal; Type utility (Sp); Level 3; Burn 0
Saving Throw Will negates; SR yes

  You use your element to halt a creature associated with your element, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.d8hypv6zdyan3rzr]{怪物定身術} except it requires concentration to maintain, and it works only on creatures with a subtype matching one of your elements (for example, a pyrokineticist could use it on creatures of the fire subtype).

  At any time, you can accept 1 point of burn to remove the need to concentrate.

Elemental Imbalance Curse.name: Elemental Imbalance Curse（Elemental Imbalance Curse）
Elemental Imbalance Curse.description:
You wield an element閳ユ獨 might, but you are vulnerable to its opposite. Choose air, earth, fire, or water. If you select air, you gain vulnerability to acid, cannot benefit from any acid resistance or immunity, and cannot cast spells with the acid or earth descriptors. If you select earth, you gain vulnerability to electricity, cannot benefit from any electricity resistance or immunity, and cannot cast spells with the air or electricity descriptors. If you select fire, you gain vulnerability to cold, cannot benefit from any cold resistance or immunity, and cannot cast spells with the cold or water descriptors. If you select water, you gain vulnerability to fire, cannot benefit from any fire resistance or immunity, and cannot cast spells with the fire descriptor.

As you advance in level, add the following spells to your oracle spells known based on your chosen element.

  At 1st level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.lndeaqm2j2nvgm6p]{燃燒之手} (fire), @Compendium[pf1.spells.ik9u3eel5vfwrtb5]{油膩術} (earth), @Compendium[pf1.spells.ohy0ty2dawfaaqwd]{水流衝擊} (water), or @Compendium[pf1.spells.33pe0bge7b7aq3io]{電爪} (air) to your spells known.

  At 5th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.10nnddmxvgxo78og]{Frigid Touch} (water), @Compendium[pf1.spells.ec2zmvdzi4m3puh4]{閃光塵} (earth), @Compendium[pf1.spells.plou8h168bfn5hq6]{浮空術} (air), or @Compendium[pf1.spells.q4ixxjb4v281g2xv]{灼熱射線} (fire) to your spells known.

  At 10th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.1moeejp3mch70ys5]{球形閃電} (air), @Compendium[pf1.spells.wvpa1pt2gyh75g3x]{石化之觸} (earth), @Compendium[pf1.spells.t1uhggjfimtabp4v]{冰風暴} (water), or @Compendium[pf1.spells.92hth51cs9oi0nfe]{火牆術} (fire) to your spells known.

  At 15th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.6vfauefzzmwl4az7]{連環閃電} (air), @Compendium[pf1.spells.0cbreqkr1vp7meyi]{游蕩烈焰} (fire), @Compendium[pf1.spells.361rc74674l3zt9a]{石化術} (earth), or @Compendium[pf1.spells.ol05jfb606v0lzj9]{冰封法球} (water) to your spells known.

Elemental Movement (Air).name: 元素移動(氣)（Elemental Movement (Air)）
Elemental Movement (Air).description: 15級時，你獲得60尺飛行速度（機動性中等）

Elemental Movement (BLO).name: 元素移動(血脈狂怒者)（Elemental Movement (BLO)）
Elemental Movement (BLO).description:
8級起，你獲得一種特殊移動類型或者速度加值，具體與你所選擇的元素相關。如下表所示：

元素 能量類型 元素移動
氣 電擊 60尺飛行（良好）
土 強酸 30尺挖掘
火 火焰 基礎速度+30尺
水 寒冷 60尺游泳

Elemental Mutagen.name: Elemental Mutagen（Elemental Mutagen）
Elemental Mutagen.description:
The alchemist chooses an element (air, earth, fire, or water). Whenever the alchemist imbibes a mutagen, he gains resistance 5 to the associated energy type and a +2 competence bonus on an associated skill check. This resistance increases by 5 and the competence bonus by 2 for each of the following discoveries the alchemist possesses: grand mutagen, greater mutagen, and true mutagen.

The elements and their associated energies and skills are air (electricity, Fly), earth (acid, Climb), fire (fire, Acrobatics), and water (cold, Swim). An alchemist can select this discovery up to four times, but must choose a different element each time. An alchemist can gain the benefits of only one elemental mutagen at a time, selected when he imbibes the mutagen.

Elemental Mystery.name: Elemental Mystery（Elemental Mystery）
Elemental Mystery.description:
本職技能: An oracle with the elemental mystery adds Acrobatics, Climb, Stealth, and Swim to her list of class skills.

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.pau0ejk30fs1eebl]{忍受環境} (2nd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.tkjnm3lw7ni82tag]{抵抗能量傷害} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.q35l6m4pggb4y98v]{元素光環} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.pawbnw1nm4f0b98e]{元素身軀I} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.yldjnorgbx4jsldz]{元素身軀II} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.hd32fuc6e7j4isbn]{元素形態 III} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.v42t5kpxc8mvd615]{元素形態 IV} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wniqskqkk0cubu9u]{創造半位面} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.pfy97qyneoa391ek]{元素集群} (18th).

Elemental Overflow.name: 元素滿溢（Elemental Overflow）
Elemental Overflow.description:
3級起，無論操念使是否進行超載，身體都會充滿她所選擇的能量，這會讓她發出盈盈的火光、毛孔滲出水珠或者經受其他與元素相應的效果。此外，她會在使用念襲的攻擊檢定中獲得加值，數值與她目前已經具有的超載總點數相同，最高為她所具有的每3個操念使等級+1點。操念使還會在使用念襲造成的傷害檢定中獲得加值，數值為攻擊檢定獲得的加值的兩倍。操念使可以通過進行1整輪的專注來抑制元素滿溢帶來的視覺效果，但是這麼做會也壓制該能力帶來的所有其他的好處。在操念使下一次使用任何原力時，視覺效果和好處都會立刻恢復。

  隨著操念使的體內匯聚了越來越多的元素，她會開始獲得更多強大的優勢。在6級起，每當操念使具有至少3點超載點數時，她便會在兩項自己選擇的體能屬性（physical ability scores）上獲得+2體型加值。她還會有一定的概率免受重擊或偷襲的效果，具體概率為5% x 她目前所具有的超載點數。11級起，每當操念使具有至少5點超載點數，她在一項體能屬性上獲得的加值會提升至+4體型加值，其他兩項體能屬性則會獲得+2體型加值。16級起，每當操念使具有至少7點超載點數時，這些加值提升為對一項體能屬性提供+6體型加值，對第二項體能屬性提供+4體型加值，對最後一項體能屬性提供+2體型加值，具體哪一項屬性獲得哪個加值由操念使自行選擇。

Elemental Resistance (Acid).name: 元素抗力(酸蝕)（Elemental Resistance (Acid)）
Elemental Resistance (Acid).description: 3級開始，你獲得10點酸蝕抗力。9級時提升為20點。

Elemental Resistance (Cold).name: 元素抗力(寒冷)（Elemental Resistance (Cold)）
Elemental Resistance (Cold).description: 3級開始，你獲得10點寒冷抗力。9級時提升為20點。

Elemental Resistance (Electricity).name: 元素抗力(電擊)（Elemental Resistance (Electricity)）
Elemental Resistance (Electricity).description: 3級開始，你獲得10點電擊抗力。9級時提升為20點。

Elemental Resistance (Fire).name: 元素抗力(火焰)（Elemental Resistance (Fire)）
Elemental Resistance (Fire).description: 3級開始，你獲得10點火焰抗力。9級時提升為20點。

Elemental Totem, Lesser.name: Elemental Totem, Lesser（Elemental Totem, Lesser）
Elemental Totem, Lesser.description:
The barbarian selects one elemental type (air, earth, fire, or water). Once selected, this choice cannot be changed. While raging, the barbarian gains a +1 bonus on saving throws against spells with the selected elemental descriptor. This bonus increases by 1 at 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter, to a maximum of +6 at 20th level. The barbarian gains access to the elemental totem rage power matching the element she selected. To select a standard elemental totem power, the barbarian must be at least 6th level and must have selected the appropriate element when she gained the lesser elemental totem rage power. In order to gain the greater elemental totem power, she must be 10th level and have already selected the standard elemental totem of that type.

  A barbarian cannot select from more than one group of totem rage powers (for example, a barbarian that selects the air totem rage power cannot later choose to gain any of the fire totem rage powers).

Elemental Transmission.name: Elemental Transmission（Elemental Transmission）
Elemental Transmission.description:
Element earth, fire, water; Type utility (Sp); Level 5; Burn 0
Saving Throw Will negates; SR yes

  You reach out to a creature with which you are familiar by using a conduit through an elemental plane. By concentrating for 10 minutes, you create one end of the conduit in a manifestation of your chosen element, such as a fire, pool of water, or section of earth, which must be at least 2 feet in diameter. If the creature you are attempting to contact is within earshot of a similar elemental manifestation and on the same plane, the conduit forms successfully, allowing both sides to see a likeness of the other. You can hear and talk to each other, though you cannot perceive anything else from the other side of the connection. If the creature is not within earshot of a similar elemental manifestation, you can maintain your concentration to wait until the creature comes close enough to such a feature.

  The connection lasts until you stop concentrating on it, use this ability again, or until the creature moves away from the conduit.

Elemental Trap Infusion.name: Elemental Trap Infusion（Elemental Trap Infusion）
Elemental Trap Infusion.description:
Element universal; Type form infusion; Level 3; Burn 2
Associated Blasts any
Saving Throw Reflex half, see text

  You touch an area of natural ground, drawing up elemental energy that roils just below the surface, ready to explode when stepped on. This 5-foot square detonates when triggered by a weight of 10 pounds or more, affecting all creatures within 10 feet of the trap with your simple blast (or composite blast, if you have it). Any creature other than the one that triggered the elemental trap can attempt a Reflex save for half damage. The elemental trap lasts until the next time you use this wild talent or until it triggers. This counts as a magical trap with a Perception and Disable Device DC equal to 10 + your kineticist level + your Dexterity modifier.

  You can accept 2 points of burn, which cannot be reduced with gather power, to make a new trap without dismissing any previous traps. If you do, the trap lasts until the next time you recover burn.

Elemental Whispers, Greater.name: Elemental Whispers, Greater（Elemental Whispers, Greater）
Elemental Whispers, Greater.description:
Element universal; Type utility (Su); Level 3; Burn 0
Prerequisite elemental whispers

  Your friendship with the elements has grown. You gain your choice of a wysp or Small elemental of your primary element as an improved familiar, without needing to meet any of the usual prerequisites for gaining such a familiar. Unlike with elemental whispers, this improved familiar acts in all ways like a familiar: it閳ユ獨 always manifested, it has hit points equal to 1/2 your own, and so on. You no longer receive the familiar benefits from the original creature you selected.

  If your improved familiar dies, you can still contact its voice in your mind and gain the Alertness feat, but you can閳ユ獩 cause it to manifest. If you pay the usual costs for replacing a familiar, you manifest a new form for your elemental friend.

Elemental Whispers.name: Elemental Whispers（Elemental Whispers）
Elemental Whispers.description:
Element universal; Type utility (Su); Level 1; Burn 0

  You form a friendship with a fragment of your element. The element speaks back to you empathically, like a familiar. Pick a type of creature usually allowed as a familiar when you gain this wild talent. You gain the Alertness feat and the special abilities granted by a familiar of that type. As a standard action, you can give the voice of the element the body of such a creature, using elemental matter of the appropriate element within 30 feet.

  As long as you concentrate, the familiar can take actions as a normal animal of its type, and it can move any distance away from you, though if it takes any damage or you cease concentrating, it returns to your mind. You lose Alertness while the familiar is manifested in this way. The familiar gains abilities as usual for a familiar of its type, though it never gains the ability to speak with animals of its kind.

Elephant Aspect.name: Elephant Aspect（Elephant Aspect）
Elephant Aspect.description:
The elephant is a symbol of both power and wisdom in Garund and Vudra. Shifters who take this aspect learn the value of applying their strength with precision. An elephant閳ユ獨 alternate attacks are gore (P) and slam (B).

Minor Form: You gain a +4 enhancement bonus on bull rush and overrun combat maneuver checks.

  At 8th level, this bonus increases to +6, and at 15th level it increases to +8.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a Large adolescent elephant (as an elephant, but with a space of 10 feet). While in this form, you gain low-light vision, scent, a gore attack (1d6 damage), and a slam attack (1d8 damage) with a 5-foot reach. You also gain a +2 racial bonus to Strength and to natural armor. While in this form, you can carry a Medium bipedal creature on your back, allowing you to act as the creature閳ユ獨 mount.

  At 8th level, you gain trample, as the universal monster rule, dealing your shifter claw damage.

  At 15th level, you gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.dn2KgHFQRbuoNRx0]{精通衝撞} as a bonus feat, and your racial bonus to Strength and natural armor increases to +4.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Gore (P), slam (B)

Elephant.name: Elephant（Elephant）
Elephant.description:
The elephant is a symbol of both power and wisdom in Garund and Vudra. Shifters who take this aspect learn the value of applying their strength with precision. An elephant閳ユ獨 alternate attacks are gore (P) and slam (B).

Minor Form: You gain a +4 enhancement bonus on bull rush and overrun combat maneuver checks.

  At 8th level, this bonus increases to +6, and at 15th level it increases to +8.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a Large adolescent elephant (as an elephant, but with a space of 10 feet). While in this form, you gain low-light vision, scent, a gore attack (1d6 damage), and a slam attack (1d8 damage) with a 5-foot reach. You also gain a +2 racial bonus to Strength and to natural armor. While in this form, you can carry a Medium bipedal creature on your back, allowing you to act as the creature閳ユ獨 mount.

  At 8th level, you gain trample, as the universal monster rule, dealing your shifter claw damage.

  At 15th level, you gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.dn2KgHFQRbuoNRx0]{精通衝撞} as a bonus feat, and your racial bonus to Strength and natural armor increases to +4.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Gore (P), slam (B)

Elysium's Call.name: Elysium's Call（Elysium's Call）
Elysium's Call.description:
With a touch, you can imbue creatures with the spirit of Elysium, lifting their spirits and freeing them from bonds. The creatures touched can immediately reroll any failed saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities of the enchantment (charm) and enchantment (compulsion) subschools. In addition, targets receive a +2 sacred bonus on such saving throws and a +2 sacred bonus on CMB checks to escape a grapple. Finally, targets can ignore up to 5 feet of difficult terrain each round, as if they had the Nimble Moves feat. These bonuses last for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum 1), although the saving throw reroll only applies when the creature is touched. You can use this ability for a number of rounds per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Touch of Chaos power granted by the Chaos Domain.

Ember.name: Ember（Ember）
Ember.description: At 1st level, when making a 工藝： check involving metal, you can expend any number of uses of this ability (up to half your sorcerer level, minimum one use) to gain a circumstance bonus on the check equal to twice the number of uses expended. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Emboldening Strike.name: Emboldening Strike（Emboldening Strike）
Emboldening Strike.description: When a rogue with this talent hits a creature with a melee attack that deals sneak attack damage, she gains a +1 circumstance bonus on saving throws for every 2 sneak attack dice rolled (minimum +1) for 1 round.

Emotional Bond.name: 情感紐帶（Emotional Bond）
Emotional Bond.description: 你能夠在自己與盟友之間建立一條情感連接，這使得你能夠監測到他們的情緒狀態。建立連接需要你和所有受術者進行長達10分鐘、且不得間斷的專注，期間盟友必須一直位於距你10尺的範圍內。可以以此方式連接的盟友數量等同於你的魅力調整值。情感紐帶會持續至下一次恢復你的每日法術、或者你自己陷入昏迷、或者成員自願以自由動作中段連接為止。若連接中斷，你能夠隨意構築新的連接，不過這需要再讓成員共同花費10分鐘進行專注。情感紐帶讓你能夠監控情緒，感覺到盟友變得憤怒、驚訝、困惑、恐懼或喜悅，但這不會讓他們對特定的細節進行溝通。若有受術者死亡或移動到和你所在位面不同的位面的話，針對該名生物的連接便會被切斷。只要你和其他受術者位於相同的位面中，你們之間的距離不會影響到情感紐帶。4級起，這種連接還會賦予你關照術（Status）的好處，它會告知你所有情感紐帶的受術者的狀態。

Emotional Push.name: 情緒推湧（Emotional Push）
Emotional Push.description: 你能在孤注一擲的場合下，從自身的情緒中爆發出強大的力量，而你的盟友也可以通過情感紐帶呼喚你，從而保護自身。當你或一個情感紐帶的受術者必須嘗試一次豁免檢定時，嘗試豁免的人能夠以直覺動作在豁免中獲得加值，該加值的數值等同於你的魅力加值。該能力每日可以使用一次，你每具有4個異能者等級，便可以額外增加一次每日使用次數。由於情感聯繫是如此地直接，所以盟友使用該能力並不需要得到你的允許，但是當該能力的使用次數被消耗時，你本人也能夠察覺到。若盟友成功通過了豁免檢定，你的精神力池會恢復1點精神力。

Emotionally Distant.name: Emotionally Distant（Emotionally Distant）
Emotionally Distant.description: At 5th level, your emotions have atrophied such that you rarely have any genuine feelings at all. You gain a +4 bonus on saving throws to resist charm, emotion, and fear effects.

Empowered Consciousness.name: 強化意識（Empowered Consciousness）
Empowered Consciousness.description: 在20級時，當喚魂師的魅影處於她的意念空間中時，喚魂師將免疫影響心靈的效果和可能導致佔據的效果與法術（如法術魔魂壺）。

Emptiness.name: Emptiness（Emptiness）
Emptiness.description:
Element void; Type defense (Su); 等級 閳? Burn 0

  Your body becomes an empty husk, fueled by an internal void. You gain negative energy resistance 2, a 5% chance to ignore critical hits and sneak attacks, and a +1 bonus on Will saves against emotion effects.

  By accepting 1 point of burn, you can increase the resistance to negative energy by 2, the chance to ignore critical hits and sneak attacks by 5%, and the bonus on Will saves against emotion effects by 1 until the next time your burn is removed. The chance of ignoring critical hits and sneak attacks granted by this wild talent stacks with the chance granted by elemental overflow to a maximum of 100%.

  When you accept burn while using a void wild talent, your bonus on Will saves applies against all mind-affecting effects for 1 round. You can dismiss and restore this effect as an immediate action.

Empty Mind.name: 空靈禪心（Empty Mind）
Empty Mind.description: 在13級，你可以通過專注虛空，清除自己的疑慮與不安。你可以支付1點精神力，通過一個自由動作解除目盲，困惑，暈眩，耳聾，恍惚，或震懾狀態。

Enchanting Words.name: Enchanting Words（Enchanting Words）
Enchanting Words.description: The mesmerist can trigger this trick whenever the subject attempts a Diplomacy or Intimidate check to adjust a creature閳ユ獨 attitude. The subject can use the mesmerist閳ユ獨 Charisma modifier instead of her own Charisma modifier on the check. If the subject uses Intimidate, the adjustment in attitude lasts an additional number of minutes equal to 10 鑴?the mesmerist閳ユ獨 Charisma modifier (minimum of 10 additional minutes).

Enchantment Resonant School.name: 附魔靈器（Enchantment Resonant School）
Enchantment Resonant School.description:
附魔靈器讓秘學士可以混淆心智魅惑敵人。

  靈器（Implements）：香爐、王冠、頭盔、樂器、項鍊。

Enduring Earth.name: 持久之土（Enduring Earth）
Enduring Earth.description:
元素：土；類別：通用（Su）；等級：4；超載：－

  當你使用巖擊（earth blasts）、土系的原力（earth wild talents）或者包含土元素的複合念襲時，如果它的持續時間超過1輪，則會延長至兩倍。

Enduring Ritual.name: Enduring Ritual（Enduring Ritual）
Enduring Ritual.description:
As a swift action when you cast a spell with a duration of at least 1 minute per caster level, you can increase the spell閳ユ獨 effective caster level by 1 for the purpose of determining its duration and preventing attempts to dispel it. The effective caster level increases by an additional 1 for every 10 cleric levels you have (maximum +3). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Hand of the Acolyte power of the Arcane Domain.

Enduring Toxin.name: Enduring Toxin（Enduring Toxin）
Enduring Toxin.description:
The alchemist can alter the properties of a poison, causing it to persist longer in the victim閳ユ獨 body. Altering a dose of poison in the way takes 1 hour, requires the expenditure of raw materials worth half the poison閳ユ獨 market price, and exposes the alchemist to the poison, thereby affecting him if he is not immune. This doubles the poison閳ユ獨 maximum duration.

  An alchemist must be at least 8th level before selecting this discovery.

Enemies' Bane.name: Enemies' Bane（Enemies' Bane）
Enemies' Bane.description:
As a swift action, the shaman imbues a single weapon she閳ユ獨 wielding with the bane weapon special ability, choosing the type of creature affected each time she does. The effect lasts for 1 minute. If the weapon already has the bane weapon special ability of the type chosen, the additional damage dealt by bane increases to 4d6.

  The shaman can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Charisma modifier.

Enemy Ground.name: Enemy Ground（Enemy Ground）
Enemy Ground.description:
The witch curses a target with clumsiness when in dangerous terrain. The target takes a 閳? penalty on Acrobatics checks to move over slippery or uneven surfaces and to avoid attacks of opportunity while moving through threatened squares. This effect lasts for 1 minute. On a successful Will save, the penalty is reduced by half and the duration is only 1 round.

  At 8th level, this penalty increases to 閳?.

Energize Weapon Infusion.name: Energize Weapon Infusion（Energize Weapon Infusion）
Energize Weapon Infusion.description:
Element air, fire, void, water; Type form infusion; Level 1; Burn 1
Associated Blasts blue flame, cold, electric, fire, negative
Saving Throw none

  Choose a manufactured weapon in your hand (not an unarmed strike or natural attack); if the weapon is a double weapon, you must choose one of its ends to receive this benefit. You imbue the chosen weapon with your elemental energy as part of an attack action, charge action, or full-attack action to add extra damage to each of your attacks with that weapon until the beginning of your next turn. Your attacks with the chosen weapon during that action deal 1d6 additional points of damage.

  At 7th level and every 6 levels thereafter, this bonus damage increases by 1d6 points.

  Blue flame blasts deal double this additional damage. The additional damage is of the same type as the infused blast閳ユ獨 damage. This additional damage ignores spell resistance and doesn閳ユ獩 apply any modifiers to your kinetic blast閳ユ獨 damage (such as your Constitution modifier).

Energy Absorbtion.name: Energy Absorbtion（Energy Absorbtion）
Energy Absorbtion.description: At 6th level, you gain an amount of energy absorption equal to 3 times your wizard level per day. Whenever you take energy damage, apply immunity, vulnerability (if any), and resistance first and apply the rest to this absorption, reducing your daily total by that amount. Any damage in excess of your absorption is applied to you normally.

Energy Attacks (2 pts).name: Energy Attacks (2 pts)（Energy Attacks (2 pts)）
Energy Attacks (2 pts).description:
An eidolon's attacks become charged with energy. Pick one energy type: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. All of the eidolon's natural attacks deal 1d6 points of energy damage of the chosen type on a successful hit.

  The summoner must be at least 5th level before selecting this evolution.

Energy Attacks (UC) (2 pts).name: Energy Attacks (UC) (2 pts)（Energy Attacks (UC) (2 pts)）
Energy Attacks (UC) (2 pts).description:
Requirements: Summoner level 5th.

  The eidolon閳ユ獨 attacks become charged with energy. Select one energy type: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. All of the eidolon閳ユ獨 natural attacks deal 1d6 points of energy damage of the chosen type on a successful hit.

Energy Blast.name: 能量爆發（Energy Blast）
Energy Blast.description: 以一個引發藉機攻擊的標準動作，你消耗2點心智點製造出一股能量爆炸。距離100尺，造成5d6點+5級後每2秘學士等級1d6點（7級6d6,9級7d6，等等，最高19級12d6）能量傷害爆發對20尺半徑內每個生物有效，受影響者可以進行反射豁免檢定以減半受傷。每次你釋放能量爆發時，必須決定該次能量類型（酸、寒冷、電擊或火焰）。你必須至少5級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Energy Composite Blast.name: Energy Composite Blast（Energy Composite Blast）
Energy Composite Blast.description: Composite blasts combine elements to form a new blast. When a kineticist gains a new element through expanded element, she gains access to all composite blasts for which she qualifies. Most composite blasts are either physical or energy blasts, like simple blasts. Physical composite blasts deal an amount of damage equal to 2d6+2 + the kineticist閳ユ獨 Constitution modifier, increasing by 2d6+2 for every 2 kineticist levels beyond 1st; energy composite blasts deal an amount of damage equal to 2d6 + 1/2 the kineticist閳ユ獨 Constitution modifier, increasing by 2d6 for every 2 kineticist levels beyond 1st.

Energy Font.name: 能量焦點（Energy Font）
Energy Font.description: 你獲得引導能量能力，每天可使用的次數等同於1+你的魅力調整值。在你降靈大祭司時，選擇你要引導正能量還是負能量，這個選擇須與英靈的信仰一致。除此之外，如果你選擇正能量，則把每一環的通靈者法術加入對應的治療傷害法術；如果你選擇負能量，則把每一環的通靈者法術加入對應的造成傷害法術。

Energy Kinetic Blade.name: Energy Kinetic Blade（Energy Kinetic Blade）
Energy Kinetic Blade.description:
Element(s) universal; Type form infusion; 等級 1; Burn 1
Associated Blasts any
Saving Throw none

  You form a weapon using your kinetic abilities. You create a non-reach, light or one-handed weapon in your hand formed of pure energy or elemental matter. (If you閳ユ獧e a telekineticist, you instead transfer the power of your kinetic blast to any object held in one hand.) The kinetic blade閳ユ獨 shape is purely cosmetic and doesn閳ユ獩 affect the damage dice, critical threat range, or critical multiplier of the kinetic blade, nor does it grant the kinetic blade any weapon special features. The object held by a telekineticist for this form infusion doesn閳ユ獩 prevent her from using gather power.

  You can use this form infusion once as part of an attack action, a charge action, or a full-attack action in order to make melee attacks with your kinetic blade. Since it閳ユ獨 part of another action (and isn閳ユ獩 an action itself), using this wild talent doesn閳ユ獩 provoke any additional attacks of opportunity. The kinetic blade deals your kinetic blast damage on each hit (applying any modifiers to your kinetic blast閳ユ獨 damage as normal, but not your Strength modifier). The blade disappears at the end of your turn. The weapon deals the same damage type that your kinetic blast deals, and it interacts with Armor Class and spell resistance as normal for a blast of its type. Even if a telekineticist uses this power on a magic weapon or another unusual object, the attack doesn閳ユ獩 use any of the magic weapon閳ユ獨 bonuses or effects and simply deals the telekineticist閳ユ獨 blast damage. The kinetic blade doesn閳ユ獩 add the damage bonus from elemental overflow.

Energy Kinetic Blast.name: Energy Kinetic Blast（Energy Kinetic Blast）
Energy Kinetic Blast.description:
At 1st level, a kineticist gains a kinetic blast wild talent of her choice. This kinetic blast must be a simple blast that matches her element. Simple blasts are listed with their corresponding elements.

  As a standard action, the kineticist can unleash a kinetic blast at a single target up to a range of 30 feet. She must have at least one hand free to aim the blast (or one prehensile appendage, if she doesn閳ユ獩 have hands). All damage from a kinetic blast is treated as magic for the purpose of bypassing damage reduction. Kinetic blasts count as a type of weapon for the purpose of feats such as @Compendium[pf1.feats.n250dFlbykAIAg5Z]{武器專攻}. The kineticist is never considered to be wielding or gripping the kinetic blast (regardless of effects from form infusions; see Infusion), and she can閳ユ獩 use @Compendium[pf1.feats.26k1Gi7t5BoqxhIj]{要害打擊} feats with kinetic blasts. Even the weakest kinetic blast involves a sizable mass of elemental matter or energy, so kinetic blasts always deal full damage to swarms of any size (though only area blasts deal extra damage to swarms). A readied kinetic blast can be used to counterspell any spell of equal or lower level that shares its descriptor. A kinetic blast that deals energy damage of any type (including force) has the corresponding descriptor.

  Each simple blast is either a physical blast or an energy blast.

  Physical blasts are ranged attacks that deal an amount of damage equal to 1d6+1 + the kineticist閳ユ獨 Constitution modifier, increasing by 1d6+1 for every 2 kineticist levels beyond 1st. Spell resistance doesn閳ユ獩 apply against physical blasts.

  Energy blasts are ranged touch attacks that deal an amount of damage equal to 1d6 + 1/2 the kineticist閳ユ獨 Constitution modifier, increasing by 1d6 for every 2 kineticist levels beyond 1st.

  Composite blasts combine elements to form a new blast. When a kineticist gains a new element through expanded element, she gains access to all composite blasts for which she qualifies. All composite blasts are listed after the kineticist elements.

  Most composite blasts are either physical or energy blasts, like simple blasts.

  Physical composite blasts deal an amount of damage equal to 2d6+2 + the kineticist閳ユ獨 Constitution modifier, increasing by 2d6+2 for every 2 kineticist levels beyond 1st.

  Energy composite blasts deal an amount of damage equal to 2d6 + 1/2 the kineticist閳ユ獨 Constitution modifier, increasing by 2d6 for every 2 kineticist levels beyond 1st.

  • A complete listing of kinetic blasts and composite blasts can be found within the Kineticist Elements page, here: Kineticist Elements

Energy Ray.name: 能量射線（Energy Ray）
Energy Ray.description: 以一個引發藉機攻擊的標準動作，你消耗1點心智點釋放出純粹的能量，遠程接觸攻擊一個目標。該射線射程為30尺。造成能量傷害1d6+1級後每2秘學士等級1d6（3級2d6,5級3d6，等等，最高19級10d6）點。每次你釋放能量射線時，必須決定該次能量類型（酸、寒冷、電擊或火焰）。

Energy Ward.name: 能量守衛（Energy Ward）
Energy Ward.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點讓能量保護自身。當你使用該靈器之力時，選擇酸、寒冷、電擊或火焰一種。你獲得所選能量的10點能量抗力，並且當你被近戰武器或天生武器命中時，攻擊者受到1d6點所選能量類型的傷害。用長觸及武器的攻擊者不會受到該能量傷害。13級和19級時，抗力增加5點，最高19級時20點。能量守衛持續每秘學士等級1輪。你必須至少7級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Enervating Infusion.name: Enervating Infusion（Enervating Infusion）
Enervating Infusion.description:
Element void; Type substance infusion; Level 7; Burn 4
Associated Blasts negative, void
Saving Throw Fortitude negates

  Your kinetic blast drains life force. Foes that take damage from your infused blast also take 1 temporary negative level. Negative levels from this infusion fade after 24 hours and never become permanent.

Engulfing Winds.name: 吞噬之風（Engulfing Winds）
Engulfing Winds.description:
元素：氣；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：3；超載：0

  前置：風捲之衣（enveloping winds）

  你把包裹在身上的氣流化為強大的屏障。直至你的下個回合開始為止，你會失去風捲之衣帶來的好處，但是由此可以創造出一堵風牆，就如同風牆術（Wind Wall）一般。你能夠承受1點超載來使風牆的持續時間延長至每個操念使等級1輪。

Enhance Venom.name: Enhance Venom（Enhance Venom）
Enhance Venom.description:
The barbarian adds her Constitution modifier to the DC of any poison she delivers using viper閳ユ獨 kiss or viper閳ユ獨 breath (see below).

  A barbarian must have viper閳ユ獨 breath and viper閳ユ獨 kiss to select this rage power.

Enhanced Inflictions.name: Enhanced Inflictions（Enhanced Inflictions）
Enhanced Inflictions.description: You recognize that harming your enemies is sometimes the only way to help your allies, and so your wrath is particularly fierce. Whenever you cast an inflict spell (a spell with the word 閳ユ笅nflict閳?in the name), the maximum amount of damage dealt by the spell is based on your oracle level, not the limit based on the spell. For example, an 11th-level oracle of succor with this revelation can cast inflict light wounds to deal 1d8+11 points of damage instead of the normal 1d8+5 maximum.

Enhanced Senses.name: 增強感官（Enhanced Senses）
Enhanced Senses.description: 你的思維能夠以極高的效率處理感官刺激，令你在大多類人生物都無法理解的世界中覺醒。你獲得通用怪物規則（Universal Monster Rules）中的靈敏嗅覺（Scent）能力。以一個標準動作，你能從精神力池中花費1點精神力來增幅你的嗅覺，獲得持續1分鐘的盲感30尺。11級時，你的盲感持久生效，而且你能以一個標準動作，你能從精神力池中花費1點精神力來獲得持續1分鐘的盲視30尺。

Enlarge.name: Enlarge（Enlarge）
Enlarge.description:
As a swift action you can enlarge yourself for 1 round, as if you were the target of the @Compendium[pf1.spells.jnlr9cuepka1l26e]{變巨術} spell. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Wooden Fist power of the Plant Domain.

Enlightenment Discipline.name: 啟蒙境界（Enlightenment Discipline）
Enlightenment Discipline.description:
Your quest for enlightenment has opened your eyes to new concepts and heights of spiritual awareness. You seek learning that allows you to evolve in mind and spirit, improving your next incarnation.

精神力池屬性 感知

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.f9adpo6szijchpva]{Acute Senses} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.llxrra87kbofmyhl]{鑑定術} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.6kmkxepwgsbta6ui]{銳耳術/鷹眼術} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.5wmn4airvkprv3gp]{Thoughtsense} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.qr6qcx8zqum6jhc4]{贖罪術} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ln4jpuurxbrfxw5j]{Arcane Sight, Greater} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.y4881ol4t79wj7sf]{Circle Of Clarity} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.0kppkhsencd6tzvh]{防護法術} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.xuuzj9lr2xbwaim4]{神威如獄} (18th).

Ensnare the Soul.name: Ensnare the Soul（Ensnare the Soul）
Ensnare the Soul.description: Your magic turns others into zombie-like servants. Add @Compendium[pf1.spells.tjog6bufg5b08lvq]{魅惑人類} and @Compendium[pf1.spells.q070n0zoq3zojpas]{支配人類} to your spell list. Creatures affected by either spell become listless and pale, appearing dead to observers (DC 20 Heal or Perception check to determine the creature is not undead). Affected creatures are slow to take any action unless you specifically direct them to do so. They are not mindless or helpless, however, and defend themselves if attacked.

Entangling Curse.name: Entangling Curse（Entangling Curse）
Entangling Curse.description:
The shaman entangles a creature within 30 feet for a number of rounds equal to the shaman閳ユ獨 Charisma modifier (minimum 1). A successful Reflex saving throw negates this effect.

  Whether or not the save is successful, the creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.

Entangling Infusion.name: 糾纏注能（Entangling Infusion）
Entangling Infusion.description:
元素：土或水；類別：性質注能；等級：2；超載：2

  關聯念襲類別：風捲雪，霜打，巖擊，冰槍，熔岩流，轟鋼，硬泥團，沙塵暴

  豁免：反射，通過則無效

  你的念襲會用元素物質包裹敵人。每當由糾纏注能加強的念襲對敵人造成傷害時，該名敵人會被糾纏（entangled）1分鐘。敵人能夠以標準動作進行一次逃脫或力量檢定（使用與對抗你的念襲時相同的DC）嘗試移除此狀態，或者對纏繞在身上的物質造成你的操念使等級兩倍的傷害（此物質的硬度為0點）也可以移除糾纏。若敵人在已經被糾纏注能所糾纏的同時，再次在對抗糾纏注能的豁免中失敗的話，體積增加的元素物質會固定在地面上，導致敵人被困在原處，就如同被固定物體（immobile object）繫住一般。

Entrancing Aura.name: Entrancing Aura（Entrancing Aura）
Entrancing Aura.description:
At 8th level, you can emit an imperceptible 30-foot aura of distraction as a standard action for a number of rounds equal to your cleric level. These rounds need not be consecutive. Enemies within this aura take a 閳? penalty on Perception checks and are treated as though they had 2 fewer Hit Dice (minimum 1 Hit Die) for the purpose of your effects that would give them the fascinated condition. At 16th level, they are instead treated as if they had 3 fewer Hit Dice for such effects.

  This power replaces the Charming Smile power of the Charm Domain.

Entrepeneur.name: Entrepeneur（Entrepeneur）
Entrepeneur.description: Select any one Intelligence-, Wisdom-, or Charisma-based skill other than Perception or Use Magic Device. The vigilante can use the selected skill to earn money as if he were using a Profession skill. If he selects Perform or Profession, the vigilante instead gains the skill unlock powers for those skills as appropriate for his number of ranks in that skill (Pathfinder RPG Pathfinder Unchained 82). If he has the social grace social talent, he can apply this benefit to all skills selected with the social grace talent.

Entropy Patron.name: Entropy Patron（Entropy Patron）
Entropy Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ud4xukzhan89qhm4]次級困惑術}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.kvfggbo0tr5gklxu]{Plague Carrier}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.w0nnnapmxd8u3auq]{Babble}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ni93l43asrq29ytd]{游蕩星塵}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.66vvhyiy5q8yzbq2]{弱智術}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.niqxt53lhxrjfaty]{反魔場}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.s6q72tw2zra9sycu]{精神錯亂}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.picot3viqlfo8arm]{攝魂徽記}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.4qriqew7d2ot7wr5]{Interplanetary Teleport}

Entropy Subdomain.name: Entropy Subdomain（Entropy Subdomain）
Entropy Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ja005kj1gh7g0dnk]{熵光護盾}
  • 3rd閳?@Compendium[pf1.spells.gmgwyjfpeuuc4t4o]{解除魔法}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.n0bsyxchnigkkuqo]{困惑術}
  • 7環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.rlfd7f64wgjfvg6e]{灰飛煙滅}

Enveloping Winds.name: 風捲之衣（Enveloping Winds）
Enveloping Winds.description:
元素：氣；類別：護身原力（Su）；等級：－；超載：0

  你讓一股湍急的氣流時刻環繞著自己，劈啪作響的電弧夾雜其間，兩者都會從遠程攻擊下保護著你。所有由實體武器（physical weapons）對你做出的攻擊都會承受20%的失手率，不過由巨大武器（massive weapons）對你進行的攻擊不受影響，比如巨人或投石器發射的礫石。該能力對射線攻擊（ray attacks）沒有效果。在2級起，你每具有5個操念使等級，這個失手率便會再增加5%。通過承受1點超載，你能夠使失手率增加5%，直至你所承受的超載得以移除為止。你可以繼續承受超載，來讓失手率得到進一步提升，最高達到75%。每當你使用氣原力（air wild talent）並承受超載時，洶湧的能量會穿過你的身體，並使得包圍著你的氣流變得能夠影響射線攻擊這樣的非實體遠程攻擊（non-physical ranged attacks），持續1輪。你能夠以直覺動作解消或恢復該效果。

Environmental Weapon.name: Environmental Weapon（Environmental Weapon）
Environmental Weapon.description:
When the vigilante gains this talent, he must select one type of terrain from the ranger閳ユ獨 list of favored terrains. While in this terrain, as a swift action the vigilante can find an improvised weapon if there are any loose or moveable objects around (subject to the GM閳ユ獨 discretion). He doesn閳ユ獩 take a penalty for using these improvised weapons. For example, if the vigilante selected the urban environment, he might attack a foe with a chair, an empty bottle, or even a door.

  At 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th levels, the vigilante can select an additional type of terrain.

Erosion Curse.name: Erosion Curse（Erosion Curse）
Erosion Curse.description:
The shaman summons the powers of nature to erode a construct or object within 30 feet. This erosion deals 1d6 points of damage per 2 shaman levels, ignoring hardness and damage reduction. If used against a construct or an object in another creature閳ユ獨 possession, the construct or the creature possessing the object can attempt a Reflex saving throw to halve the damage.

  Once an object or a construct is damaged by this erosion, it cannot be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.

Eruption Infusion.name: 噴發（Eruption Infusion）
Eruption Infusion.description:
元素：火；類別：塑形注能；等級：3；超載：2

  前置：增距（extended range）

  關聯念襲類別：藍焰擊，火衝，熔岩流，蒸灼

  豁免：反射，通過則減半

  你的念襲會以距離你120尺範圍內的任意位置為中心，從地面以柱狀噴發出來。柱狀噴射會影響半徑10尺、從地面向上延伸40尺高的柱狀區域內的所有生物和物體。由噴發注能增強的能量性質的念襲會對每個目標造成正常傷害，不過物理性質的念襲則會造成一半傷害。該豁免DC基於敏捷。
