Erupt.name: Erupt（Erupt）
Erupt.description:
As a swift action, you cause flaming shards of rock to erupt from your body. These shards deal 1d6 points of damage per 2 oracle levels (minimum 1d6) to all creatures in a 10-foot-radius burst (Reflex half ). Half of this damage is fire damage and the other half is piercing damage. The shards create difficult terrain for 1 round.

  You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day at 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter.

Espionage Subdomain.name: Espionage Subdomain（Espionage Subdomain）
Espionage Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.k3a8fr763ejcm4gl]{Anonymous Interaction}
  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.wek2dovt5lf9twu2]{靜默之域}
  • 8環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.blvetbc929cfx4m8]{心靈屏障}

Essence of Fire.name: Essence of Fire（Essence of Fire）
Essence of Fire.description: At 20th level, you become immune to fire damage. In addition, your bloodrager damage reduction increases by 5. If you don閳ユ獩 have bloodrager damage reduction, you gain DR 10/magic instead. You have these benefits constantly, even while you are not bloodraging.

Eternal Opposition.name: Eternal Opposition（Eternal Opposition）
Eternal Opposition.description:
Samsaran only.

  While most imperial dragons, undead, and other long-enduring foes can count on outlasting their mortal adversaries, the samsaran slayer has pledged to oppose their machinations across all his lifetimes. When his studied target is of the dragon, fey, outsider, or undead type, the slayer gains a +2 insight bonus to his AC against its attacks and on saving throws against its abilities.

Eternal Past.name: Eternal Past（Eternal Past）
Eternal Past.description: At 15th level, you gain an immersive mindscape. This functions as a permanent @Compendium[pf1.spells.c14tjrds5emxk417]{Create Mindscape, Greater} spell, except it must appear as a lost civilization, and you do not target any other creatures when the mindscape is created. You can open a conduit to your mindscape as a standard action at will (per the mindscape door spell), allowing you or other creatures to enter or leave. The mindscape is only as detailed as your knowledge of the lost civilization but still holds valuable secrets. The mindscape functions as a library for all 知識skills; while within your mindscape, you can spend 1d4 hours researching to use a @JournalEntry[dfjwbMEdt062TJtE]{知識}：歷史 check in place of any other 知識check.

Ethereal Patron.name: Ethereal Patron（Ethereal Patron）
Ethereal Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.aa0w7tk852iqn3ni]{偵測死靈}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.nokru6mxk9p3r513]{識破隱形}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.clo5w5mow21nln10]{靈質捕網}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.c3revq5uj4vtqzxb]{Condensed Ether}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.jmtzhbgzqpboahhn]{Ethereal Envelope}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.btccs4sjo2nog1a0]{幻化靈體}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.8fyg16j34uruuy45]{靈質噴發}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.7aq3g5gcbviba7hq]{Ethereal Envelopment}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.gw9bes9othfqm7mi]{同游靈界}

Etheric Tether.name: 靈界聯結（Etheric Tether）
Etheric Tether.description:
在1級時，喚魂師可以通過自己使魅影與靈界產生牽引，令它可以以靈質態或虛靈態的狀態維繫在物質位面。當魅影受到足以將它打回靈界位面的傷害時，喚魂師可以無需任何動作，犧牲自己任意數量的生命值來回復魅影受到的傷害。喚魂師每支付1點生命值便可以回覆魅影受到的1點傷害，這能使魅影免於因為傷害被放逐。

  然而，這種聯繫也是有限制的。每當魅影完全顯形時，它與喚魂師之間的距離必須保持在50尺以內才不會對雙方產生任何影響與負擔；喚魂師可以嘗試延伸自己與魅影間的牽引，但前提條件是魅影必須保持在靈質態；每當喚魂師開始自己的行動輪但她的魅影距離她的距離超過50尺（但小於100尺）時，喚魂師必須努力維持自己與魅影間的牽引（通過一個會導致藉機攻擊的整輪動作），否則靈質態的魅影會立刻被捲回靈界，無法在接下來24小時內顯形。這個專注效果與專注法術類似，它的有效法術環數相當於1x喚魂師與魅影間每間隔50尺外的10尺距離（最多為6）。如果這個專注檢定失敗，魅影會返回喚魂師的意念中。

  如果靈質態的魅影離開喚魂師的距離大於100尺，或虛靈態的魅影離開喚魂師的距離大於50尺，或是離開喚魂師的效果線超過1輪/每喚魂師等級的時間，喚魂師與魅影間的聯結會自動切斷魅影將被捲回靈界位面，在接下來的24小時內無法顯形。

  關於本限制的更多內容請見後章的魅影部分。

Evasive.name: 反射閃避（Evasive）
Evasive.description: 俠客敏捷的身手使他難以被範圍性的效果吞沒。俠客獲得反射閃避能力，在12級時，他還會獲得精通反射閃避能力。只有選擇詭秘獵手之道的俠客才能選擇本天賦。

Everyman.name: 千幻（Everyman）
Everyman.description: 俠客可以通過自己的百變社交天賦變裝成隨意的一個普通人，但這個人必須是平凡的農民，工人或小市民。在偽裝成這個人的時候俠客可以在易容技能檢定上獲得+20環境加值，任何嘗試定位該人的法術和能力有50%的概率定位到俠客身上而非這個個體本身，而對俠客施放的預言系法術與能力會將他顯示為俠客所偽裝的那個人。雖然這個能力並不會為俠客提供任何關於他所偽裝的那個人的任何訊息，但俠客的嫻熟扮演技巧仍然可以在他裝扮該人的唬騙檢定上提供+10環境加值。俠客必須達到11級並且擁有百變社交天賦才能選擇本天賦。

Evil Eye (BLO).name: Evil Eye (BLO)（Evil Eye (BLO)）
Evil Eye (BLO).description: At 1st level, you can curse an opponent with a wicked glance. As a standard action, you can afflict one target within 30 feet that you can see, causing it to take a 閳? penalty to AC and on attack rolls for 1 round per class level or until the target hits you with an attack. The target can negate this effect with a successful Will saving throw (DC = 10 + half your bloodrager level + your Charisma modifier). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Evocation Resonant School.name: 塑能靈器（Evocation Resonant School）
Evocation Resonant School.description:
塑能靈器直接創造出能量來毀滅或防禦。

  靈器（Implements）：手套、權杖、法杖、魔杖。

Evolving Aspect.name: Evolving Aspect（Evolving Aspect）
Evolving Aspect.description: At 8th level, you gain Aspect of the Beast as a bonus feat even if you don閳ユ獩 meet the prerequisites. As normal for the feat, you must choose one of the manifestations, and you gain its benefits even while not bloodraging. When you enter a bloodrage, you can choose a second manifestation to affect you simultaneously for the duration of your bloodrage.

Execution Inquisition.name: Execution Inquisition（Execution Inquisition）
Execution Inquisition.description: 神授力量: Your deity guides you when you deliver death to your chosen targets.

Executioner's Strike.name: Executioner's Strike（Executioner's Strike）
Executioner's Strike.description: At 8th level, your precision in combat has become incredible, and you can strike a lethal blow if your target cannot defend itself properly. Once per day, you can make an attack as a standard action against your chosen victim. If the attack hits and the victim is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC against you, any critical threats are automatically confirmed.

Exoskeleton.name: Exoskeleton（Exoskeleton）
Exoskeleton.description: As a swift action, you can grow an exoskeleton that grants you a +1 enhancement bonus to your natural armor and 1d4 temporary hit points + 1 for every 2 cleric levels you have. The natural armor bonus increases by 1 for every 5 cleric levels you have. The exoskeleton retracts after 1 round, ending its benefits. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Expanded Awareness.name: 擴展意識（Expanded Awareness）
Expanded Awareness.description: 通過一個移動動作，你可以專注於你的感官，並獲得以下感知能力之一：盲感（10尺），黑暗視覺（30尺），昏暗視覺，或者靈敏嗅覺。這能力持續每異能者等級1輪。你每天可以使用本能力的次數等同你的感知調整值。11級時，你可以使用擴展意識能力獲得看破黑暗（怪物通用能力）或感知思維（OA法術）。15級時，你可以通過本能力獲得生命感知（怪物通用能力）。

Expanded Defense.name: 防禦擴充（Expanded Defense）
Expanded Defense.description:
元素：通用；類別：通用（Su）；等級：4；超載：－

  從你在元素擴展（Expanded Element）中選擇的元素裡挑選一種。你會獲得這個元素的護身原力（defense wild talent）。你可以多次選取這個原力，每次選取都要選擇不同的元素類型。

Expanded Element.name: 元素擴展（Expanded Element）
Expanded Element.description:
7級起，操念使學會了如何使用其他元素或者強化了對自身所選元素的認識。操念使能夠選擇任意元素，包括她的首要元素（primary element）。如果還有的話，她會獲得此類元素中自身還未具有的簡易念襲原力（simple blast wild talent）。她還會獲得所有滿足先決條件的複合念襲原力（composite blast wild talents），外加元素擴展的基礎原力（basic wild talent），舉例說明：如果操念使選擇氣（air），則會獲得基礎大空念力（basic aerokinesis）。複合念襲（composite blast）的額外規則和描述詳見本書的15頁。操念使不會獲得元素擴展的護身原力（defense wild talent）。

  若操念使的元素擴展和首要元素不同，那麼在判斷操念使是否能夠選取元素擴展的原力時，視為她的等級比正常低4級。

  若操念使選擇強化自己對已經具有的元素的認知，那麼她會獲得一個出自此類元素的額外通用原力（additional utility wild talent）或者注能，就如同在她的注能（Infusion）和原力（Wild Talents）職業能力中進行選擇一般。

  15級起，操念使可以選擇選取一種新元素或者擴展自身對已有元素的認知。除非操念使在7級時選擇的是自己的首要元素，否則她不能選擇元素擴展能力在7級所選擇的那個元素類型。操念使會按照上文所述獲得所有元素擴展帶來的好處。無論如何，如果操念使在7級和15級都選擇自己的首要元素作為元素擴展，那麼她會精通操控此類元素作為替代。對於此類元素的原力，操念使在攻擊檢定、傷害檢定、施法者等級和DC均會獲得+1加值。

Experience Across Ages.name: Experience Across Ages（Experience Across Ages）
Experience Across Ages.description:
Samsaran only.

  Once per day, a samsaran slayer can draw upon insights from his previous lifetimes to help identify a foe or recall a key piece of information. As a swift action, the slayer can attempt a Knowledge check as if he had a number of ranks in the appropriate Knowledge skill equal to his slayer level.

  A slayer can use this talent one additional time per day for every 5 slayer levels he has.

Expert Cypher.name: Expert Cypher（Expert Cypher）
Expert Cypher.description: A rogue with this ability can attempt a Linguistics check to decipher a single page of text as a full-round action instead of taking 1 minute as normal. In addition, when the rogue attempts a Use Magic Device check to cast a spell from a scroll, she is treated as though she had the minimum score in the appropriate ability score to cast that spell. Finally, the rogue can choose to add her Intelligence modifier to her Use Magic Device skill checks instead of her Charisma modifier.

Exploit Weakness.name: Exploit Weakness（Exploit Weakness）
Exploit Weakness.description: At 14th level, the inquisitor learns to take advantage of any opportunity that presents itself. Whenever the inquisitor scores a critical hit, she ignores any damage reduction the target might have. In addition, if the target has regeneration, the creature loses regeneration on the round following the critical hit and can die normally during that round. Creatures whose regeneration always functions are immune to this ability. Finally, if the inquisitor deals energy damage to a creature with vulnerability to that energy type, she deals +1 point of damage per die rolled.

Explosion Infusion.name: 爆破（Explosion Infusion）
Explosion Infusion.description:
元素：火；類別：塑形注能；等級：7；超載：4

  前置：增距（extended range）

  關聯念襲類別：藍焰擊，火衝

  豁免：反射，通過則減半

  你將能量集中於空間中的一點，創造出可控的爆炸。你能夠以距離自己120尺範圍內的任意一點為中心引發爆炸，而且你可以將爆炸的擴散半徑設定為5尺、10尺、15尺或20尺。所有爆炸範圍內的生物和物體都會受到你的念襲傷害。該豁免DC基於敏捷。

Explosive Calligraphy.name: Explosive Calligraphy（Explosive Calligraphy）
Explosive Calligraphy.description:
The alchemist can create especially volatile pigments that detonate when agitated. This requires expending one daily use of his bombs, but otherwise functions as @Compendium[pf1.spells.o4ywdvsm1oty8blq]{爆裂符文} except that it deals damage as one of the alchemist閳ユ獨 bombs. The alchemist can expend an additional daily use of his bombs to apply one discovery that applies to his bombs, such as acid bomb or dispelling bomb, to the runes created with this discovery.

  An alchemist must be at least 6th level before selecting this discovery.

Expose Weaknesses.name: Expose Weaknesses（Expose Weaknesses）
Expose Weaknesses.description: The vigilante is able to use sneaky tricks to make it easier to damage a foe, whether it is throwing a bit of fine dust of cold iron over a fey creature or melting a glob of silver onto a lycanthrope閳ユ獨 hide. The vigilante can add the ability to reduce a creature閳ユ獨 damage reduction or hardness by 10 to the list of options when attempting a dirty trick combat maneuver check (Advanced Player閳ユ獨 Guide 320). This does not stack with itself, and it does not work against creatures with DR/閳?

Extended Range Infusion.name: 增距（Extended Range Infusion）
Extended Range Infusion.description:
元素：通用；類別：塑形注能；等級：1；超載：1

  關聯念襲類別：任意

  豁免：無

  你的念襲能夠攻擊到120尺內的任意一個目標。

Extinguishing Strike.name: Extinguishing Strike（Extinguishing Strike）
Extinguishing Strike.description: When a rogue with this talent hits a creature with a melee attack that deals sneak attack damage, any nonmagical light sources worn or carried by the creature (such as lit torches, lanterns, or sunrods) are automatically extinguished. Once per day, the rogue can use this ability to also attempt a dispel check (as per dispel magic) against any magical sources of light a target carries, using her rogue level as the caster level.

Extra Earthcraft.name: Extra Earthcraft（Extra Earthcraft）
Extra Earthcraft.description: The rogue gains 2 additional earthcraft points each day. The rogue must have the earthcraft ability to select this talent.

Extra Feat (2 pts).name: Extra Feat (2 pts)（Extra Feat (2 pts)）
Extra Feat (2 pts).description:
The eidolon gains an extra feat. It must meet the prerequisites of the feat. 

  A Summoner must have the Twinned Summoner archetype in order to select this evolution.

Extra Feat (UC) (2 pts).name: Extra Feat (UC) (2 pts)（Extra Feat (UC) (2 pts)）
Extra Feat (UC) (2 pts).description:
Requirements: Twinned eidolon.

  The eidolon gains an extra feat. It must meet the prerequisites of the feat.

Extradimension Subschool.name: Extradimension Subschool（Extradimension Subschool）
Extradimension Subschool.description:
相關學派： Conjuration.

  Replacement Powers: This subschool replaces the summoner閳ユ獨 charm power of the conjuration school.

Extreme Range Infusion.name: 增程（Extreme Range Infusion）
Extreme Range Infusion.description:
元素：通用；類別：塑形注能；等級：3；超載：2

  前置：增距（extended range）

  關聯念襲類別：任意

  豁免：無

  你的念襲能夠攻擊到480尺內的任意一個目標。

Eye of the Moon.name: Eye of the Moon（Eye of the Moon）
Eye of the Moon.description: Your connection to the moon makes you supernaturally perceptive. You gain darkvision to a range of 60 feet. At 11th level, as a standard action, you can focus on a specific object or area (the size of which can be no greater than a 10-foot-by-10-foot square) and see it as though with true seeing as long as the moon is shining on it. Moonless nights, cloudy skies, and shadows interfere with this ability.

Eyes of the Void, Greater.name: Eyes of the Void, Greater（Eyes of the Void, Greater）
Eyes of the Void, Greater.description:
Element void; Type utility (Su); Level 5; Burn 閳?br>Prerequisite eyes of the void

  You can see in darkness, as per the monster special ability.

Eyes of the Void.name: Eyes of the Void（Eyes of the Void）
Eyes of the Void.description:
Element void; Type utility (Su); Level 2; Burn 閳?/p>

  You gain darkvision with a range of 60 feet (if you already have darkvision, your darkvision閳ユ獨 range increases by 30 feet).

Face in the Crowd (ROG).name: Face in the Crowd (ROG)（Face in the Crowd (ROG)）
Face in the Crowd (ROG).description: A rogue with this talent can blend into groups easily. Opposed Perception and Sense Motive checks take a –2 penalty when made against the rogue’s Bluff, Disguise, Sleight of Hand, or Stealth checks if she’s within 30 feet of at least two non-hostile characters of her apparent creature type. This penalty increases to –4 if she’s within 30 feet of at least eight such creatures or is currently in a square occupied by a crowd.

Face in the Crowd (WIZ).name: Face in the Crowd (WIZ)（Face in the Crowd (WIZ)）
Face in the Crowd (WIZ).description:
At 1st level as a standard action, you can cause yourself to appear so normal, mundane, and unexceptional that you blend in to your surroundings. All creatures within 30 feet treat you as if you belonged there, effectively ignoring you. Creatures outside of this area may notice that you appear out of place, but as soon as they approach within 30 feet they are affected by the magic and no longer think something is amiss. If you interact with an affected creature in any way, it gains a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your wizard level + your Intelligence modifier) to disbelieve the illusion and notice you. The effect lasts for a number of minutes equal to your wizard level, or until the illusion is dispelled. The minutes do not need to be consecutive, but must be used in 1-minute increments. This is a mind-affecting phantasm effect.

  This ability does not turn you invisible and opponents are not considered flat-footed. It does not allow you to disguise yourself as a specific individual, type of person, or member of another race, so you cannot blend into a group of uniformed guards or appear as a member of an individual’s family, and a human cannot blend into a group of gnolls. You can blend in with any group made up of different types of people, such as a crowd of courtiers in a king’s throne room, and you can disguise yourself (either through magic or more mundane means) to appear as a specific type of person or another race (such as a uniformed guard or a gnoll) before using this ability.

Faith Discipline.name: 信仰境界（Faith Discipline）
Faith Discipline.description:
你相信是一種更高層次的力量激發了你的精神能力。你的精神能力或許真的來源於諸神的贈禮，但也可能僅僅是被你自身的信仰所強化，沒人能夠確認真相為何物。在很多方面，你都類似於神術施法者，而祈禱也往往會融入施放異能者法術的過程中。

精神力池屬性 感知

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wa0zb2pncesmm9lz]{祝福術} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.avofn5q2v0f0qxjy]{靈能武器} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.73han2zqxg59u18g]{魔化防具} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.io8sg720zjd0tdj2]{信仰戍衛} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.p2kosvizylhy8vfa]{通神術} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.21yha04trfhj0ehd]{心智手術} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.glt6uk3n6g6l2p6l]{高等探知} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.0wamdkl9gp19l55w]{高等異界盟友} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.suel7sgnztenv551]{神蹟術} (18th).

Faith-Stealing Strike.name: Faith-Stealing Strike（Faith-Stealing Strike）
Faith-Stealing Strike.description: You can make a single melee attack using your highest base attack bonus against a creature capable of casting divine spells. If you damage the creature, it must succeed at a Will save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier) or be unable to cast any divine spells for 1 round. If you do not damage your target with the attack, this ability is expended with no effect. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Faked Death.name: 偽造死相（Faked Death）
Faked Death.description: 受術者看起來好像死了一般，但實際上本人已經悄悄溜走。當受術者由於一次攻擊而受到傷害時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。受術者看起來好像倒下並死亡，這個效果就如同預置幻影（Programmed Image）一般；但實際上她會如同隱形術（Invisibility）一般隱形，持續的輪數等同於催眠師的等級，或者直至受術者進行攻擊為止。一旦受術者再次變得可見，死屍的幻象就會消失無蹤。這些均為幻術系（illusion）效果，若有生物與虛假的屍體發生互動的話，它就可以嘗試一次意志豁免，成功則不會相信該效果。虛假屍體是一個虛假幻覺（figment）；而隱形是一個五官幻覺（glamer）。

Falcon Aspect.name: 獵鷹擬態（Falcon Aspect）
Falcon Aspect.description:
獵鷹能感覺到一切，並具有速度追捕甚至最難以捉摸的獵物。採取這擬態的變形者獲得了對荒野進行察覺和偵察的增強能力──幾乎沒有一丁點動靜能逃脫此變形者的耳目。

  次級形態：你的察覺檢定獲得+4表現加值。8級時，這個加值提升至+6。15級時，這個加值提升至+8。

  專攻形態：你變身為一隻小型獵鷹（見本書 pg. 179）。當處於該形態時，你獲得1d4傷害的齧咬攻擊、2個1d3傷害的爪抓攻擊、60尺飛行速度（良好）、昏暗視覺和基於視覺的察覺檢定時獲得+4種族加值。8級時，你獲得120尺黑暗視覺和察覺檢定上的種族加值提升至+6。15級時，你獲得60尺盲感和你的飛行速度提升至90尺（完美）。

Falcon.name: Falcon（Falcon）
Falcon.description:
The falcon senses all and has the speed to hunt down even the most elusive prey. Those who take this aspect gain enhanced abilities to perceive and reconnoiter the wilderness閳ユ攳ittle escapes this shifter閳ユ獨 attention.

Minor Form: You gain a +4 competence bonus on Perception checks.

  This bonus increases to +6 at 8th level and +8 at 15th level.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a Small falcon (see page 179). While in this form, you gain a base speed of 30 feet, a bite attack (1d4 damage), two claw attacks (1d3 damage), a fly speed of 60 feet (good), low-light vision, and a +4 racial bonus on vision-based Perception checks.

  At 8th level, you gain darkvision with a range of 120 feet, and your racial bonus on Perception checks increases to +6.

  At 15th level, you gain blindsense with a range of 60 feet and your fly speed increases to 90 feet (perfect).

Alternate Natural Attacks: Bite (B, P, S), talon (S)

False Attacker.name: False Attacker（False Attacker）
False Attacker.description: Whenever the rogue strikes a foe from hiding, she can attempt a Bluff check as an immediate action (opposed by the target閳ユ獨 Sense Motive or Perception check, whichever has a higher bonus) before rolling damage to convince the foe that another creature was the attacker. This Bluff check applies the normal modifiers for convincing a creature of a falsehood, but can be accomplished with just physical trickery (a shared language is not required). If the Bluff is successful, and the rogue maintains concealment or cover, the rogue閳ユ獨 stealth does not end.

False Face.name: False Face（False Face）
False Face.description: Like oni who take mortal shapes to infiltrate society, some ninjas can mold their flesh to pass unsuspected. A ninja with this trick gains the change shape (any Small or Medium humanoid, @Compendium[pf1.spells.kouqz0pm1xl8xilm]{變身術}) universal monster rule as long as she has at least 1 ki point.

False Flanker.name: 虛假夾擊者（False Flanker）
False Flanker.description: 催眠師的虛影突然出現，就好像他在和受術者共同戰鬥一般。當受術者移動進入的方格或者回合開始時所在的方格會威脅到一個敵人時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。催眠師的幻術複製體會出現在與該名敵人相鄰、且未被佔用的空間內。在判斷夾擊時，這個幻象被視為威脅到該名敵人，但它其實並不能真正做出攻擊。幻象會在詭計被觸發的那回合結束後消失。這是一個幻術系（illusion）虛假幻覺（figment）效果，而且與虛假夾擊者產生相互作用的生物能夠嘗試一次豁免檢定，成功則不相信該效果。

False Hospitality.name: False Hospitality（False Hospitality）
False Hospitality.description:
The witches of Iblydos are known for greeting travelers with warmth only to reveal their powers once their enemies have lowered their defenses.

  A witch can use this hex to gain the benefits of @Compendium[pf1.spells.7c8nufdm0pj4bgep]{花言巧語} with a caster level equal to the witch閳ユ獨 level. This hex can be used once per day.

False Spellcaster.name: False Spellcaster（False Spellcaster）
False Spellcaster.description: The investigator can modify her extracts to be delivered as oils she can apply covertly to her skin. She can fake verbal or somatic components as she uses an extract this way to trick observers into thinking she cast a spell to produce the extract閳ユ獨 effect. She attempts a Bluff check to determine how convincing the ruse is. If observers attempt to determine the spell she is casting, those who succeed at a Spellcraft check opposed by her Bluff check realize the truth. Whether or not an observer recognizes what is going on, the DC to identify the effect of the extract is equal to 20 + the extract閳ユ獨 spell level. If the investigator has the infusion alchemist discovery, she can deliver her infusions with a range of touch, but the hint of residue grants targets a +2 bonus on the opposed Spellcraft check to realize she is not truly casting spells.

Fan of Flames Infusion.name: 炎之扇（Fan of Flames Infusion）
Fan of Flames Infusion.description:
元素：火；類別：塑形注能；等級：1；超載：1

  關聯念襲類別：藍焰擊，火衝

  豁免：反射，通過則減半

  你的念襲在扇形火焰中延伸，傷害15尺錐形範圍內的所有生物和物體。該豁免DC基於敏捷。

Fantastic Stride.name: Fantastic Stride（Fantastic Stride）
Fantastic Stride.description:
The vigilante gains @Compendium[pf1.feats.ugQyUpqPBDsqLyra]{跳躍攻擊} as a bonus feat, ignoring its prerequisites. At 10th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the vigilante can designate one additional creature when he uses Spring Attack. The  vigilante閳ユ獨 movement this round does not provoke attacks of opportunity from any of these secondary creatures.

  A vigilante must be at least 6th level to select this talent.

Fascinate (Sor).name: 迷魂曲調(術士)（Fascinate (Sor)）
Fascinate (Sor).description: 3級開始，你可以通過表演技能檢定，使一個或多個生物被你迷魂。這類似吟遊詩人的“迷魂曲”能力，不過豁免DC為“10+1/2術士等級+魅力修正”，並且持續每等級1輪。3級時，你每天可使用此能力1次，8級時2次，13級時3次，18級時4次。

Fast Circles.name: 法陣速寫（Fast Circles）
Fast Circles.description: 16級起，秘學士可以更快地繪出法陣。他可以選擇用一個整輪動作畫出魔法陣，此法會讓法陣的持續時間降低為每秘學士等級1分鐘（使用異界接觸能力繪製的法陣例外，依然是正常的10分鐘）。若用此法繪製束縛法陣，持續時間為每秘學士等級1輪。

Fast Healing (4 pts).name: Fast Healing (4 pts)（Fast Healing (4 pts)）
Fast Healing (4 pts).description:
An eidolon's body gains the ability to heal wounds very quickly, giving it fast healing 1. The eidolon heals 1 point of damage each round, just like natural healing. Fast healing does not restore hit points lost due to starvation, thirst, or suffocation, nor does it allow the eidolon to regrow lost body parts (or to reattach severed parts). Fast healing functions as long as the eidolon is alive. This fast healing does not function when the eidolon is not on the same plane as its summoner.

  This healing can be increased by 1 per round for every 2 additional evolution points spent (maximum 5).

  The summoner must be at least 11th level before selecting this evolution.

Fast Healing (UC) (4 pts).name: Fast Healing (UC) (4 pts)（Fast Healing (UC) (4 pts)）
Fast Healing (UC) (4 pts).description:
Requirements: Summoner level 11th.

  The eidolon閳ユ獨 body gains the ability to heal wounds very quickly, giving it fast healing 1. The eidolon heals 1 point of damage per round, just like via natural healing. Fast healing does not restore hit points lost due to starvation, thirst, or suffocation, nor does it allow the eidolon to regrow lost body parts (or to reattach severed parts). Fast healing functions as long as the eidolon is alive.

  This fast healing does not function when the eidolon is not on the same plane as its summoner.

  This healing can be increased by 1 point per round for every 2 additional evolution points spent (to a maximum of 5 points per round).

Fate Patron.name: Fate Patron（Fate Patron）
Fate Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.wa7p5zwwl1p0rt92]{喪志術}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ja1p1uuf8fp6fiox]{Anticipate Peril}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.fp5r5razueuqj8z8]{引導之手}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.scyklgov72pvw884]{Blessing Of Fervor}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.gn1u9cjc9phsczec]{Forbid Action, Greater}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.4br9puuneexco5hx]{觸發術}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.uze75g9ayg8icipx]{Jolting Portent}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.hi72gh3dlf7a1qyt]{迷宮術}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.nnj51dwfkwd15ngj]{祈願術}

Favored Beat.name: Favored Beat（Favored Beat）
Favored Beat.description:
The investigator is familiar with a specific community in which she gains the benefits of renown. She gains the @Compendium[pf1.class-abilities.6xRCEzFhje8h3fb6]{Renown} vigilante social talent (Pathfinder RPG Ultimate Intrigue 12). This community can be an entire settlement or portions of a settlement (such as a particular district or neighborhood) depending on the population, as allowed by the renown social talent. Anytime she could select another investigator talent, the investigator can also select from the following list of social talents (from pages 10閳?3 of Ultimate Intrigue), using her investigator level as her vigilante level for the purposes of meeting prerequisites: @Compendium[pf1.class-abilities.Zu3Amhv4wWbqHr8f]{Celebrity Discount}, @Compendium[pf1.class-abilities.YlQrG9WeIKOsviud]{Celebrity Perks}, @Compendium[pf1.class-abilities.tZgzLbbc4fkdhQUH]{Gossip Collector}, @Compendium[pf1.class-abilities.Z76OgmEJuaUZtHdV]{Great Renown}, @Compendium[pf1.class-abilities.9kMoMFT33197l6fD]{Incredible Renown}, and @Compendium[pf1.class-abilities.GjlhYlp5qLXZ5U0b]{Loyal Aid}.

  For the purpose of vigilante social talents, the investigator does not have a vigilante identity and is always considered to be in her social identity.

Favored Maneuver.name: 偏好戰技（Favored Maneuver）
Favored Maneuver.description: 俠客特別訓練過一種戰技的用法。俠客獲得對此戰技的精通戰技專長（如果這種戰技有對應的相關專長的話）。除此之外，當俠客在施展一個戰技時，如果他的目標未意識到俠客存在，那麼俠客在戰技攻擊檢定上獲得+2環境加值。俠客可以多次選擇本天賦，每次選擇均需要獲得一個不同的戰技類型。

Favored Terrain (RNG).name: 偏好地形(遊俠)（Favored Terrain (RNG)）
Favored Terrain (RNG).description:
3級時，遊俠可以從偏好地形列表中選擇一種地形。處在該類地形時，遊俠的先攻檢定和知識（地理）、察覺、隱匿和生存檢定+2。遊俠在其偏好地形上旅行時不會留下任何痕跡並且無法被追蹤（如果他刻意想要留下痕跡也是可以的）。在8級時和之後每5級，遊俠可以額外選擇一種偏好地形。此外，每次增加偏好地形時，可以指定將針對任意一種偏好地形的檢定加值再+2（如果願意的話，也可指定剛剛選擇的偏好地形）。如果某種特定地形同時屬於多種偏好地形，遊俠的加值無法疊加，只能使用較高的值作為加值。

表：遊俠偏好地形
偏好地形
寒地（冰面，冰川，雪地和苔原）
沙漠（沙地和荒地）
森林（常綠林和落葉林）
叢林
山脈（包括丘陵）
平原
位面（從主物質位面之外選擇一種）
沼澤
地下（洞穴與地下城）
都市（建築物，街道和下水道）
水（水面上及水面下）

Favored Terrain (ROG).name: Favored Terrain (ROG)（Favored Terrain (ROG)）
Favored Terrain (ROG).description: The rogue selects one terrain from the ranger’s favored terrain list; she gains this as a favored terrain, as the ranger class feature. If the rogue also has or later takes the hide in plain sight advanced talent (Pathfinder RPG Ultimate Combat 71), her favored terrain must match a terrain she has selected for that advanced talent. If the rogue has ranger levels, her effective ranger level is equal to her ranger level + 5 for purposes of improving the bonuses from this favored terrain and gaining new favored terrains. A rogue must be at least 5th level to select this talent.

Fear Subdomain.name: Fear Subdomain（Fear Subdomain）
Fear Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.9tww9fc9049h6iqc]{驚恐術}
  • 3rd閳?@Compendium[pf1.spells.j71cjhkj0697faj3]{恐嚇術}
  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.be88e90guqbi1q1z]{恐懼術}.

Fearsome Guise.name: 恐怖幻象（Fearsome Guise）
Fearsome Guise.description: 受術者被罩上了一層幻影，使其呈現出他人的樣貌，之後還可以在合適的時候呈現出可怖怪物的形態。在這項詭計被植入時，受術者的外觀會如同易容術（Disguise Self）一般得到改變。當受術者攻擊一個生物時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。幻象會讓受術者短暫呈現出怪物的容貌，之後便會結束。催眠師能夠嘗試一次威嚇檢定以挫敗士氣（demoralize），挫敗的目標為觸發詭計的攻擊目標。對目標進行挫敗士氣的嘗試所需要承受的限制（目標要位於30尺範圍內，而且要能夠看和聽到嘗試威嚇檢定的生物）也適用於詭計的受術者。這是一個幻術系（illusion）五官幻覺（glamer）效果。

Feast of Blood.name: Feast of Blood（Feast of Blood）
Feast of Blood.description:
While raging, the barbarian may feast on the organs of her foes and absorb their power. After successfully ripping out a creature閳ユ獨 vital organ, the barbarian may eat the organ within 1 minute of extracting it as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity. Once the organ is consumed, the barbarian recovers a number of hit points equal to the Hit Dice of the organ閳ユ獨 owner. In addition, the barbarian gains any energy immunities or resistances the victim had, though the effectiveness of these resistances is halved (for instance, a barbarian who eats the heart of a creature with resist cold 10 would gain resist cold 5; energy immunities are reduced to resist energy 20). This energy resistance lasts for a number of rounds equal to half the Hit Dice of the creature whose organ was consumed.

  A barbarian must have the bloody fist rage power to select this rage power.

  A barbarian must be at least 14th level to select this rage power.

Feasting Bite.name: Feasting Bite（Feasting Bite）
Feasting Bite.description:
This rage power is available to half-orc barbarians. When the barbarian confirms a critical hit with her bite attack, she regains a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

  The barbarian must have the bloody bite rage power and either the animal fury rage power or a natural bite attack before selecting this power. Activating this ability consumes 1 round of rage.

Feign Innocence.name: 扮無辜（Feign Innocence）
Feign Innocence.description: 俠客的社交身份看起來是如此的純潔無辜以至於極少有人會懷疑他是個會做壞事的傢伙。每當俠客在他擁有聲譽影響的地區活動，他就會獲得一個非魔法的法術無辜眼神（Innocence）APG效果。俠客必須達到5級並且擁有聲譽社交天賦才能選擇本天賦。

Feint from Shadows.name: Feint from Shadows（Feint from Shadows）
Feint from Shadows.description: A rogue with this talent can feint in combat using a ranged weapon against a target within 30 feet and cause the opponent to lose his Dexterity modifier against her next melee or ranged attack. The rogue must have concealment (but not full concealment) from the target of the feint.

Feral Shifting.name: Feral Shifting（Feral Shifting）
Feral Shifting.description: As a swift action, the arcanist can spend 1 point from her arcane reservoir to gain either a bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage (1d4 points of damage if she is Small) or two claw attacks that deal 1d4 points of damage (1d3 points of damage if she is Small) for a number of minutes equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1). These are primary natural attacks.

Ferocious Beast, Greater.name: Ferocious Beast, Greater（Ferocious Beast, Greater）
Ferocious Beast, Greater.description:
While the barbarian is raging, her animal companion shares the benefits of the barbarian閳ユ獨 rage powers that are constant in effect. It gains no benefit from rage powers that require actions to activate, even if they are free actions.

  A barbarian must have the ferocious beast rage power and be at least 8th level to select this rage power.

Ferocious Beast.name: Ferocious Beast（Ferocious Beast）
Ferocious Beast.description: While the barbarian is raging, her animal companion also gains the benefits of rage (including greater rage, mighty rage, and tireless rage), though the barbarian must spend 1 additional round of rage per round if her companion begins or ends its turn adjacent to her, and 2 additional rounds of rage per round if not.

Ferocity Discipline.name: 狂野境界（Ferocity Discipline）
Ferocity Discipline.description:
你與潛意識中最原始的部分聯繫起來。你的訓練讓您解放動物般的感官和力量。

精神力池屬性 感知

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ja1p1uuf8fp6fiox]{Anticipate Peril} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.05i5rxwim12hwktu]{牛之力量} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.vqfrp8t0c1lw1jna]{英雄氣概} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lvzq2mwkqmozolpl]{行動自如} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.knyako6zopc1chrv]{石膚術} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.9pbl3ktd5oqejl19]{轉變術} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ln4jpuurxbrfxw5j]{Arcane Sight, Greater} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.blvetbc929cfx4m8]{心靈屏障} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.vl7yer8k1leyuxld]{預警術} (18th).

Ferocity.name: 兇猛（Ferocity）
Ferocity.description: 5級起，你的求生欲變得越發兇猛。你獲得通用怪物規則（Universal Monster Rules）中的兇猛（Ferocity）能力。當你的hp為0或負數時，你的力量和敏捷獲得+4士氣加值，以及強韌豁免獲得+2士氣加值。8級起，你的hp為0或負數時不會陷入恍惚狀態，並在hp為0負數時自動穩定。

Fey Blood, Greater.name: Fey Blood, Greater（Fey Blood, Greater）
Fey Blood, Greater.description: While raging, as long as the barbarian moves at least 10 feet, she gain the effects of @Compendium[pf1.spells.18kryvj2dfuymk9d]{朦朧術} for 1 round.

Fey Bloodrager Bloodline.name: Fey Bloodrager Bloodline（Fey Bloodrager Bloodline）
Fey Bloodrager Bloodline.description:
One of your ancestors was fey, or the fey realm somehow intermixed with your bloodline. It affects your bloodrage in tricky and surprising ways.

獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.h9nHYLxXvIXBTmup]{戰斗反射}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.JreaiTHdyWFNj3Tb]{閃避}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{精通先攻}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.0bZf3SDkvVOe2ujH]{閃電反射}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.R7L4SlGRlnThqFrP]{靈活移動}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Mz8ZG6nqW3NKFZhK]{快步跟進}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.O0jbkTJcIji9BNiF]{威逼}

  獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.2nn2tshkn4p7k25l]{糾纏術} (7th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.5nr9o7o0it6ewf17]{狂笑術} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.s9amdo5398alb5p0]{加速術} (13th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.n0bsyxchnigkkuqo]{困惑術} (16th)

Fey Mutagen.name: Fey Mutagen（Fey Mutagen）
Fey Mutagen.description: The alchemist gains the ability to create a fey mutagen, a mixture that lends him some of the grace and power of the First World. When imbibed, a fey mutagen grants a +2 alchemical bonus to the alchemist閳ユ獨 Dexterity and Charisma, a 閳? penalty to his Strength, and DR 2/cold iron. This otherwise works like the standard mutagen class feature and interacts with other effects as though it were a mutagen.

Feywise.name: Feywise（Feywise）
Feywise.description:
Your whimsy grants you protection from fey mischief. You gain the resist nature閳ユ獨 lure druid class feature. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus on Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks against fey.

  You must be at least 3rd level to select this revelation.

Fiendish Appearance (3 pts).name: Fiendish Appearance (3 pts)（Fiendish Appearance (3 pts)）
Fiendish Appearance (3 pts).description:
The eidolon appears as a fiendish creature and manifests some of the abilities of a fiend. Spells and effects that target creatures with the evil subtype or have specific effects against such creatures affect the eidolon as if it had that subtype. The eidolon gains a +2 bonus on saving throws against acid, disease, fire, and poison spells and effects. It also gains an amount of spell resistance equal to 5 + its HD against spells with the good descriptor. The summoner must be evil-aligned to select this evolution.

At 7th level, by spending 2 additional evolution points, the summoner increases the bonus on saving throws to +4 and extends the spell resistance to affect any spells and spell-like abilities cast by good creatures.

At 12th level, by spending 2 additional evolution points, the eidolon gains immunity to acid, disease, fire, and poison. Its spell resistance increases to an amount of equal to 11 + its HD. (The summoner must pay for the 7th-level upgrade before paying for this 12th-level upgrade.)

Fiendish Probiscus.name: Fiendish Probiscus（Fiendish Probiscus）
Fiendish Probiscus.description: The arcanist can spend 1 point from his arcane reservoir as a standard action to grow a long, articulated proboscis covered with small spiky hairs. The appendage grows from the arcanist閳ユ獨 face and houses a highly flexible, muscular tongue tipped with a cartilaginous barbed quill. The proboscis lasts for 1 round per arcanist level, during which time the arcanist cannot speak or use verbal components. The arcanist can end this exploit閳ユ獨 effects early as a swift action. As a standard action, the arcanist can attack a target with the proboscis閳ユ獨 tongue. This is a primary natural weapon with a 10-foot reach. Attacks with the tongue resolve as a touch attack. If the arcanist uses his tongue and hits a creature capable of casting spells or using spell-like abilities, he drains a portion of the target閳ユ獨 magical ability and adds 1 point to his arcane reservoir (points gained in excess of the reservoir閳ユ獨 maximum are lost). If the arcanist hits a creature that cannot cast spells or use spell-like abilities, the tongue instead drains a portion of the target閳ユ獨 life force and heals the arcanist of 1d6 points of damage. Regardless of the target閳ユ獨 ability to use magic, the tongue閳ユ獨 unnerving siphoning of magical or life energy causes the struck creature to become sickened for 1 round.

Fiery Conduit.name: Fiery Conduit（Fiery Conduit）
Fiery Conduit.description: You can deliver touch spells to burning creatures within 30 feet without actually touching them. For the purposes of this ability, burning creatures include creatures that have caught on fire, creatures taking ongoing fire damage, and creatures with the fire subtype or that are polymorphed into such creatures. You must succeed at a ranged touch attack to affect an unwilling target.

Final Asepct.name: Final Asepct（Final Asepct）
Final Asepct.description: At 20th level, a shifter gains access to a fifth aspect, and when she uses shifter閳ユ獨 aspect, she can assume the minor forms of all her aspects and the shifter can use her major and minor forms at will.

Fire Brand.name: Fire Brand（Fire Brand）
Fire Brand.description: An alchemist with this discovery can expend one daily bomb use to apply the bomb reagents to his weapon as a swift action. A weapon treated this way deals fire damage as if it had the flaming weapon special ability. At 10th level, the weapon is treated as if it had the flaming burst weapon special ability. The bomb reagents continue burning for 1 minute or until extinguished by dousing the weapon in water. An alchemist can use this ability with natural weapons, but he takes 1d6 points of fire damage per round for each natural weapon treated.

Fire Corridor.name: Fire Corridor（Fire Corridor）
Fire Corridor.description:
Element fire; Type utility (Sp); Level 5; Burn 1

  You create a passage through a fire or pool of lava. The passage is 5 feet wide and 8 feet high. It is 10 feet long, plus 5 feet longer for every 3 kineticist levels you have. Any heat generated by the fire or lava through which the passage passes is radiated outwards, making the passage comfortable and safe.

  The passage lasts for 1 hour, though you can end the effect at any time as a free action. If this effect ends while a creature is inside the tunnel, that creature is affected by the fire or lava as normal.

Fire Sculptor.name: 塑火者（Fire Sculptor）
Fire Sculptor.description:
元素：火；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：1；超載：0

  你能夠改變火的形狀或者調整火勢的蔓延。以標準動作，你能夠從正在蔓延的火焰（ongoing fire）中移動每操念使等級5平方尺的火焰，並將它放置在與這些火焰相鄰的任意方格中。舉例說明：4級的操念使能夠從20尺x20尺的大火中間移走4個相鄰方格的火焰，並防止到火焰的邊緣，以便創造出供人逃生的安全路徑。在你改變形狀之後，火焰仍會繼續蔓延下去。

Fire Steed.name: Fire Steed（Fire Steed）
Fire Steed.description:
Element fire; Type utility (Sp); Level 2; Burn 0

  You imbue a willing animal, magical beast, or other creature that can serve as a suitable mount with elemental power from the Plane of Fire, wreathing it in flames for 1 round. You can accept 1 point of burn to increase the duration to 1 round per kineticist level you have. The mount gains fire resistance 10 and its speed increases by 10 feet.

  Creatures other than you who touch the mount, attack the mount with a natural weapon or unarmed strike, or attempt to mount the creature take 1d6 points of fire damage every round they are in contact with the mount.

Fire Totem, Greater.name: Fire Totem, Greater（Fire Totem, Greater）
Fire Totem, Greater.description: While raging, the barbarian can envelope herself in a cloud of smoke that fills a 10-foot-radius sphere and follows her as she moves. Creatures in the affected area must succeed at Fortitude saves each round or suffer the effects of breathing heavy smoke. The barbarian is immune to the smoke閳ユ獨 effects, including vision obstruction. She can end this smoke as a free action, or it can be dispersed by wind in the same manner as a @Compendium[pf1.spells.g33euis7yi9pwddy]{雲霧術} spell.

Fire Totem.name: Fire Totem（Fire Totem）
Fire Totem.description: While the barbarian is raging, any opponent that confirms a critical hit against her with a piercing or slashing melee weapon is sprayed with liquid fire. (Creatures with reach weapons are immune.) The attacker takes 1d6 points of fire damage per barbarian level (Reflex halves; DC 10 + 1/2 the barbarian閳ユ獨 level + the barbarian閳ユ獨 Con modifier).

Fire's Fury.name: 狂怒之炎（Fire's Fury）
Fire's Fury.description:
元素：火；類別：通用（Su）；等級：1；超載：－

  當你使用火衝（fire blasts）或者包含火元素的複合念襲時，將你的元素滿溢（Elemental Overflow）加值加到傷害上。若念襲在正常情況下便會將兩倍於元素滿溢的加值加到傷害上，那麼這些效果也會疊加。

Firesight.name: 火之視域（Firesight）
Firesight.description:
元素：火；類別：通用（Su）；等級：3；超載：－

  你能夠看透火焰（flames）和煙（smoke），就如同它們都是透明的一般。被點燃（on fire）的生物或者具有火系亞種（fire subtype）的生物在對抗你的時候，都無法從隱蔽（concealment）或全隱蔽（total concealment）中獲益。

Fist Subdomain.name: Fist Subdomain（Fist Subdomain）
Fist Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.xco22162bwgxn7pj]{克敵機先}
  • 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.bgtmki0xl4xl4y91]{Magic Fang, Greater}
  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.lmst00dtapf4xhya]{Force Punch}

Fist of the Avenger.name: 復仇之拳（Fist of the Avenger）
Fist of the Avenger.description: 如果他尚未獲得精通徒手打擊專長的話，那麼俠客獲得精通徒手打擊作為獎勵專長。除此之外，每當俠客使用自己的拳頭或鐵手套發動攻擊並命中，那麼他可以將自己的俠客等級的一半（最少+1，最高+5）加到這次攻擊的傷害上。只有選擇復仇騎士之道的俠客才可以選擇本天賦。

Flame Control.name: Flame Control（Flame Control）
Flame Control.description: The arcanist can spend 1 point from her arcane reservoir to move or extinguish one 5-foot square per arcanist level of an ongoing nonmagical fire. If she chooses to move a portion of the fire, it must be moved to a square contiguous with that fire. If she also expends a spell slot of at least 3rd level when activating this ability, she can attempt to dispel a magical fire effect, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.gmgwyjfpeuuc4t4o]{解除魔法}.

Flame Jet, Greater.name: Flame Jet, Greater（Flame Jet, Greater）
Flame Jet, Greater.description:
Element fire; Type utility (Sp); Level 5; Burn 閳?br>Prerequisite flame jet

  You can use flame jet as a move action and can emanate a mild jet of flame, allowing you to hover without spending an action.

Flame Jet.name: 火焰噴進（Flame Jet）
Flame Jet.description:
元素：火；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：3；超載：0

  以標準動作，你在身後發噴射出爆發性的火焰，這會推動你向著直線方向移動至多60尺，這也包括向著空中移動；任何向上進行的移動都被算作消耗了雙倍的移動距離。若你在半空中結束自己的回合的話，那麼除非你再次使用火焰噴進，否則便會在下個自己的回合墜落。

Flame Shield.name: 熾焰護盾（Flame Shield）
Flame Shield.description:
元素：火；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：5；超載：1

  前置：炎之血肉（searing flesh）

  閃耀的火焰環繞著你，直至你所承受的超載得以移除為止。當你的炎之血肉生效時，任何使用近戰攻擊命中你的生物都會受到等同於你的操念使等級一半的火焰傷害，除非對方使用的是長觸及武器。若該名生物還受到了來自炎之血肉的傷害，那麼它的火焰抗力僅能在對抗兩個效果的總傷害時生效一次。你還會獲得溫暖火焰護盾（warm fire shield）降低寒冷傷害的保護效果。如果你受到造成寒冷傷害的攻擊，並且此次攻擊的數值大於你的操念使等級的兩倍（在應用熾焰護盾的保護之前），那麼此次攻擊會在熾焰護盾的保護生效之後熄滅護盾，使得熾焰護盾效果提前結束。

Flame Trap.name: Flame Trap（Flame Trap）
Flame Trap.description:
Element fire; Type utility (Sp); Level 2; Burn 0

  You lay a fiery trap on a container, ensuring the destruction of sensitive documents while punishing those who would steal your secrets. In order to weave the trap, you must spend 10 minutes in contact with the container you wish to trap. At the end of that time, the container is trapped until the next time you use this wild talent or until it triggers. Any creature other than you who opens the container takes damage as from your fire blast (or blue flame blast, if you have it). The damage affects the creature automatically if it is touching the container, but if it opens the container from within 30 feet, it can attempt a Reflex save to negate the damage, and if it opens the container from farther still, it takes no damage.

  Whether or not the creature that opened the container takes damage, your kinetic blast damage also affects any items within the container that you choose, as well as the container, if you wish it, and leaves all other items undamaged.

  This counts as a magical trap with a Perception and Disable Device DC equal to 10 + your kineticist level + your Dexterity modifier. You can accept 1 point of burn when using flame trap to make a new trap without dismissing any previous traps. If you do, the trap lasts until the next time you recover burn.

Flash Infusion.name: 閃光注能（Flash Infusion）
Flash Infusion.description:
元素：火；類別：性質注能；等級：4；超載：3

  關聯念襲類別：藍焰擊，火衝，太陽風

  豁免：意志，通過則無效

  你的念襲散發的強光能夠晃瞎敵人。每當注能念襲命中敵人而且克服它的法術抗力時，該名敵人必須成功進行意志豁免，否則便會目盲（blinded）1輪，無論它本身是否應為念襲而承受傷害均為如此。你可以通過將念襲的傷害減半來使得上述豁免的DC增加2點。

Fleet Charge.name: 狂飆猛進（Fleet Charge）
Fleet Charge.description: 你可以通過一個迅捷動作和一個整輪動作移動相當於你的最大移動速度的距離然後發動一次整輪攻擊。本能力不可與瞬襲能力同時使用。當你開始移動時，你就視為開始了一個整輪動作，即使接下來的情況迫使你在結束移動時無法完成攻擊也是一樣。

Fleet in Shadows.name: Fleet in Shadows（Fleet in Shadows）
Fleet in Shadows.description:
The mesmerist can trigger this trick whenever the target enters an area with dim or darker light. The subject can move double its normal speed (up to an additional 30 feet) for 1 round, but only while moving through areas of dim or darker light.

  Additionally, the subject can move at its normal speed and use the bonus speed from this trick in areas of total darkness, even if it cannot see.

Fleeting Glance.name: 眼難及（Fleeting Glance）
Fleeting Glance.description: 在9級時，你能夠每天隱形等同於你術士等級的輪數。這項能力等同於“高等隱形術”。隱形的時間不必連續。

Flesh Mend.name: 肉體修復（Flesh Mend）
Flesh Mend.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點通過接觸治療一名活物。目標受到1d8+你秘學士等級點的治療。你3級後每有4個等級，治療量就增加1d8，最高19級時5d8+19點治療。該效果對不死生物無效。你必須至少3級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Flesh Rot.name: 肉體腐爛（Flesh Rot）
Flesh Rot.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點對一活物進行一次近戰接觸攻擊，使其肉體腐爛凋零。若攻擊命中，目標受到1d8+每秘學士等級1點的傷害。3級之後每有4個秘學士等級，該傷害增加1d8（最高19級時5d8）。若近戰接觸攻擊未命中，該能力浪費掉，沒有效果。你必須至少3級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Flesh of Stone.name: 頑石之膚（Flesh of Stone）
Flesh of Stone.description:
元素：土；類別：護身原力（Su）；等級：－；超載：0

  你的皮膚變得宛如岩石一般堅硬，它可以減弱大多數攻擊造成的衝擊。你獲得DR 1/精金。這個DR會在2級之後的每2個操念使等級增加1點。通過承受1點超載，你能夠讓DR增加1點，直至你所承受的超載得以移除為止，此DR最高等同於你的操念使等級。每當你使用土原力（earth wild talent）並承受超載時，洶湧的能量會穿過你的身體，使得你的傷害減免由DR/精金變為DR/－，持續1輪。你能夠以直覺動作解消或恢復該效果。

Flesh of Wood.name: Flesh of Wood（Flesh of Wood）
Flesh of Wood.description:
Element wood; Type defense (Su); 等級 閳? Burn 0

  Your skin toughens like timber and can turn aside some blows. You gain a +1 enhancement bonus to your existing natural armor bonus. By accepting 1 point of burn, you can increase this enhancement bonus by 1. For every 3 levels beyond 2nd, you can accept 1 additional point of burn to further increase this enhancement bonus by 1 (to a maximum of +7 at 17th level).

  Whenever you accept burn while using a wood wild talent, phytokinetic power causes your full natural armor bonus to apply to your touch AC for 1 round. You can dismiss and restore this effect as an immediate action.

Flesh-Eating Bomb.name: Flesh-Eating Bomb（Flesh-Eating Bomb）
Flesh-Eating Bomb.description: The alchemist can create bombs that devour living matter. The alchemist閳ユ獨 bomb deals damage one die step higher than normal (regular bombs deal d8s, concussive bombs deal 1d6, and so on), but they have no effect on inorganic matter. In addition, a creature with at least a +1 armor bonus to AC is less likely to be harmed; such creatures in the bomb閳ユ獨 splash radius take no damage on a successful Reflex save, and the target of a direct hit can attempt a Reflex save against the bomb閳ユ獨 save DC to take only half damage.

Flicker.name: Flicker（Flicker）
Flicker.description:
You can flicker from sight for a short time, allowing you to escape or set up a prank. As a swift action, you can disappear for 1 round per oracle level. This ability functions as invisibility.

  You can use this revelation a number of times per day equal to half your oracle level (minimum 1).

Flight (2 pts).name: Flight (2 pts)（Flight (2 pts)）
Flight (2 pts).description:
An eidolon grows large wings, like those of a bat, bird, insect, or dragon, gaining the ability to fly. The eidolon gains a fly speed equal to its base speed. The eidolon's maneuverability depends on it size. Medium or smaller eidolons have good maneuverability. Large eidolons have average maneuverability, while Huge eidolons have poor maneuverability.

  For 2 additional evolution points, the eidolon flies by means of magic. It loses its wings, but its maneuverability increases to perfect. Flying via magic means makes this a supernatural ability.

  The eidolon's fly speed can be increased by spending additional evolution points, gaining a 20-foot increase to fly speed for each additional point spent.

  The summoner must be at least 5th level before selecting this evolution.

Flight (UC) (2 pts).name: Flight (UC) (2 pts)（Flight (UC) (2 pts)）
Flight (UC) (2 pts).description:
Requirements: Summoner level 5th.

  The eidolon grows large wings, like those of a bat, bird, insect, or dragon, gaining the ability to fly. The eidolon gains a fly speed equal to its base speed. The eidolon閳ユ獨 maneuverability depends on its size. Medium or smaller eidolons have good maneuverability. Large eidolons have average maneuverability, while Huge eidolons have poor maneuverability.

  For 2 additional evolution points, the eidolon flies by means of magic. It loses its wings, but its maneuverability increases to perfect. If the eidolon flies by magic, this is a supernatural ability.

  The eidolon can increase its fly speed by spending additional evolution points, gaining a 20-foot increase to its fly speed for each additional point spent.

Flight Hex.name: Flight Hex（Flight Hex）
Flight Hex.description:
The witch grows lighter as she gains power, eventually gaining the ability to fly.

  At 1st level, the witch can use feather fall at will and gains a +4 racial bonus on Swim checks.

  At 3rd level, she can cast levitate once per day.

  At 5th level, she can fly, as per the spell, for a number of minutes per day equal to her level.

  These minutes do not need to be consecutive, but they must be spent in 1-minute increments. This hex only affects the witch.

Flight Response.name: Flight Response（Flight Response）
Flight Response.description: When a barbarian with this rage power attempts a saving throw against a fear effect, she can enter a rage as an immediate action (as long as she would normally be able to enter rage). This consumes 3 rounds of the barbarian閳ユ獨 daily allotment of rage rounds, but the barbarian can maintain the rage each round on her turn normally. Any benefits from the barbarian閳ユ獨 rage apply immediately, so she gains her bonus on Will saves against the effect that required the initial saving throw. Unlike most rage powers, this rage power閳ユ獨 effects are useful only when the barbarian is not raging, so a skald can閳ユ獩 grant this rage power to allies with raging song.

Floating Breath (UC).name: Floating Breath (UC)（Floating Breath (UC)）
Floating Breath (UC).description:
A monk with this ki power can spend 1 point from his ki pool as a swift action to balance on the air, hovering in place, until the end of his next turn.

  This power does not allow the monk to fly or otherwise move into the air; he must jump or use some other ability to reach his position. This otherwise functions as @Compendium[pf1.spells.e4v1uv8hexeu9sxj]{凌空而行}.

  A monk must be 8th level before selecting this power.

Floating Lotus.name: Floating Lotus（Floating Lotus）
Floating Lotus.description:
The witch can conjure a large lotus flower that floats by her side for a number of minutes per day equal to her level. This duration doesn閳ユ獩 need to be consecutive, but must be spent in 1-minute increments. While summoned, the witch can use the lotus to cross water as if she was affected by @Compendium[pf1.spells.g2obld7y0lpyztes]{水面行走}. She can also use the flower for short bursts of flight, gaining a +10 enhancement bonus on Acrobatics checks when attempting high jumps and long jumps.

  This bonus increases by 10 at 5th level, and again at 9th level.

Flood Blessing: Lasting Breath.name: Flood Blessing: Lasting Breath（Flood Blessing: Lasting Breath）
Flood Blessing: Lasting Breath.description: You can touch an ally to bless it with an extra reserve of breath. For 1 minute, while the ally holds its breath, standard and full-round actions don閳ユ獩 decrease the number of rounds the ally can hold its breath (see page 445 of Pathfinder RPG Core Rulebook).

Flood Blessing: Tsunami Burst.name: Flood Blessing: Tsunami Burst（Flood Blessing: Tsunami Burst）
Flood Blessing: Tsunami Burst.description: At 10th level, when you are hit by a melee attack, you can invoke this blessing as an immediate action. A wave of water blasts out from you at your attacker, attempting a bull rush combat maneuver check using your CMB but adding your Wisdom modifier instead of your Strength modifier.

Flotsam Subdomain.name: Flotsam Subdomain（Flotsam Subdomain）
Flotsam Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.x23pz2agjub1eh89]{完全修復術}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.b8lt1275mz4ez4d8]{強效造物術}
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.k9iu3d82hlo7coct]{活化物體}

Flowing Step.name: Flowing Step（Flowing Step）
Flowing Step.description:
Fire閳ユ獨 hunger and water閳ユ獨 flow grant you swiftness and elegance, and you move with breathtaking purpose and grace. You can increase your base speed by 10 feet.

  At 7th level, while using this ability, you can use Acrobatics to move at full speed through threatened squares or other creatures閳?squares without increasing the DC by 10.

  At 11th level, while using this ability, you can walk on liquid as if using water walk, and you are immune to damage caused by proximity to (but not immersion in) lava, magma, and similarly heated stone.

  You can use this ability for 1 hour per day per oracle level. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-hour increments.

  Oracles with the lame oracle curse cannot select this revelation.

Flowing Subdomain.name: Flowing Subdomain（Flowing Subdomain）
Flowing Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ns8jbp0ilbvbvuif]{貓之優雅}
  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.lvzq2mwkqmozolpl]{行動自如}
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.h4nlrm44ubsyzuhz]{液體形態}
  • 8環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.blvetbc929cfx4m8]{心靈屏障}

Flurry of Blasts Infusion.name: 連擊（Flurry of Blasts Infusion）
Flurry of Blasts Infusion.description:
元素：通用；類別：塑形注能；等級：3；超載：2

  前置：增距（extended range）

  關聯念襲類別：任意

  豁免：無

  取代單發的念襲，你能對120尺內的目標發射兩發念襲，每發都如同你的操念使等級為1級一般造成傷害（使你的念襲傷害增加的效果或能力均不適用）。10級起，你能夠使用連擊注能發射三發；在16級增加至四發並在20級達到五發。若你正處於增加全力攻擊動作（fullattack action）的攻擊次數的效果影響下，比如加速術（Haste）或類似的魔法效果，你的連擊注能所能發射的念襲數量也會增加1次。

  任意兩個目標之間的距離不得超過30尺。你必須在投擲任何攻擊檢定之前將所有的念襲分配給目標。在第一個念襲後任何命中相同目標的念襲均會增加1d6點傷害；傷害承受的加值和減值均不適用。若你使用了需要進行豁免檢定的性質注能，每個目標僅需要嘗試一次豁免（即便它受到多次攻擊），但是它會在豁免中承受一個減值，該減值等同於第一發之後命中的念襲次數。若你使用了需要進行施法者等級檢定或者戰技檢定的性質注能，那麼你僅需要進行一次檢定，並以此來對抗每個目標，但是你會在檢定中對特定目標獲得加值，數值等同於第一發之後連擊念襲對該目標的命中次數。若你使用了推行性質注能（pushing substance infusion），在第一發之後對相同目標每命中1發，推行距離便會再增加5尺。

Focus Powers.name: 靈器之力（Focus Powers）
Focus Powers.description: 1級時，秘學士習得所選兩個靈器學派的，並可在所選學派的靈器之力中自選一個習得。每當秘學士習得一個新的靈器學派時，他會自動習得該靈器學派的。另外，3級及之後每2個等級，秘學士可在已知靈器學派的靈器之力列表中習得一個靈器之力。秘學士只用通過消耗心智點來使用靈器之力。除非另有說明，任何靈器之力的豁免DC都等於10+1/2秘學士職業的等級+秘學士智力調整值。秘學士無法重複習得同一個靈器之力。某些靈器之力需要達到一定秘學士等級方可選擇。

Focused Blast Infusion.name: Focused Blast Infusion（Focused Blast Infusion）
Focused Blast Infusion.description:
Element universal; Type form infusion; Level 2; Burn 2
Associated Blasts any
Saving Throw none

  You focus your blast in a concentrated attack. You gain a +1 enhancement bonus on your attack roll with the blast and your caster level check to overcome spell resistance. You can increase the burn cost of this infusion by 2 to increase the enhancement bonus by 1, to a maximum of +5 for 10 burn. You can reduce your blast閳ユ獨 total damage by half to reduce the burn cost of this infusion by half as well.

Focused Force.name: 力場聚焦（Focused Force）
Focused Force.description: 在施放力場法術（force spell）時，異能者能夠通過從精神力池花費1點精神力強化法術的傷害。法術的傷害骰增大1級（1d4變為1d6，1d6變為1d8，1d8變為1d10，或者1d10變為1d12）。這會增加每個將要投擲的骰子大小，因此對於原本造成4d6+3點力場傷害的法術來說，將會造成4d8+3點力場傷害作為替代。此項精神增幅僅能聯結到造成力場傷害的法術上，而且該傷害必須包含傷害投骰。已經使用d12骰子作為傷害骰的法術不受此項精神增幅的影響。

Focused Poison.name: Focused Poison（Focused Poison）
Focused Poison.description:
The slayer can focus his poison delivery to be especially deadly to his studied target. When the slayer studies a target, he can immediately reduce the number of additional studied targets he can maintain. Reducing this number does not require an action.

  For each target reduced in this way, the DC of poisons used against his studied target increases by 1.

  The slayer must be at least 6th level and have the poison use talent to select this talent.

Focused Summoning.name: Focused Summoning（Focused Summoning）
Focused Summoning.description: When an arcanist is on a plane other than the Material Plane, she can expend 1 point from her arcane reservoir as part of casting a spell that summons a single outsider native to that plane. If she does so, the outsider閳ユ獨 attacks bypass all types of DR that it has. For example, a nabasu demon, which has DR/cold iron or DR/good, would bypass both DR/cold iron and DR/good.

Focusing Attack.name: Focusing Attack（Focusing Attack）
Focusing Attack.description: When a rogue selects this talent, she must choose the confused, shaken, or sickened condition. When the rogue has the selected condition and hits a creature with a melee attack that deals sneak attack damage, the rogue no longer has that condition. A rogue can take this talent up to three times. Each time, she must select a different condition that she is able to remove from herself with a melee attack that deals sneak attack damage. Even if the rogue has taken this talent multiple times, she can remove only a single effect on herself with each melee attack that deals sneak attack damage.

Foe Collision.name: Foe Collision（Foe Collision）
Foe Collision.description:
The vigilante can shove one of his foes into another. When the vigilante deals hidden strike damage to a corporeal foe with a melee attack, he can also deal an amount of nonlethal damage equal to his reduced hidden strike damage to an opponent adjacent to the first (even if the second opponent is out of his reach). The damage is bludgeoning damage, and if the colliding foe has any natural attacks, the damage is also considered magic, evil, or any other type of damage the natural attack deals. Unlike normal vigilante talents that affect hidden strikes, this vigilante talent applies in all cases when the target is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC.

  Only a stalker vigilante can select this talent.

Foe Throw Infusion.name: 拋敵（Foe Throw Infusion）
Foe Throw Infusion.description:
元素：以太；類別：塑形注能；等級：3；超載：2

  關聯念襲類別：念動

  豁免：強韌，通過則無效；見後文

  你的念動（telekinetic blast）能夠投擲大型或更小的生物，以取代無主物體；你能夠增加1點超載來影響具有更大體型的生物。若你嘗試用來投擲的生物成功通過強韌豁免，那麼它可以免受整個念襲的影響。否則當你的念襲命中時，被投擲的生物和目標均會承受來自念動的全額傷害，被投擲的生物還會俯臥（prone）在沿著投擲路徑上最後一個可佔據空間裡。若你的念襲未命中（miss），被投擲的生物能夠選擇佔據目標周圍30尺內的任意空間，它不會倒地（fall prone），而且它僅會由你的念襲承受正常傷害的一半。投擲期間進行的移動不會引起藉機攻擊。

Follow Along.name: Follow Along（Follow Along）
Follow Along.description: A rogue with this talent is familiar enough with enchantment magic to fool it, using spellcasters閳?complacency to set them up for a surprise attack. Whenever she succeeds at a saving throw against an enchantment effect, the rogue learns the spell閳ユ獨 effect on a failed save, allowing her to play along and pretend to have failed her save. If she does so, the spellcaster does not learn that she succeeded at her saving throw, even if she was the only target, though she must succeed at an opposed Bluff check against a spellcaster閳ユ獨 Sense Motive check to determine whether she is under the enchantment閳ユ獨 effects. While this ruse is in place, the spellcaster is flat-footed against the rogue閳ユ獨 first attack. If the spellcaster sees the rogue perform (or fail to perform) an action that would be impossible if she were under the enchantment閳ユ獨 effect, he automatically discovers her ruse.

Fool's Privilege.name: Fool's Privilege（Fool's Privilege）
Fool's Privilege.description:
You can use this power as a swift action when you fail a Bluff, Diplomacy, or Intimidate check outside of combat. You suffer no negative effects due to the failed check, and the next round you can attempt the check again without the usual penalty for a failed attempt. You can use this ability once per day, and one additional time per day for every 4 levels beyond 1st.

  This power replaces the Copycat power of the Trickery Domain.

Force Barrier.name: 力場屏障（Force Barrier）
Force Barrier.description:
元素：以太；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：5；超載：0

  前置：力場結界（force ward）

  你能夠創造出一個固定的力場球體或半球，包圍在你所在的方格或多個方格外。力場屏障在所有其他方面都如同力牆術（Wall of Force）一般。啟動該能力是標準動作，屏障會持續至你的下個回合開始為止。每一輪，就在屏障恰好要消失之前，你能夠通過承受1點超載來延長它的持續時間。若有攻擊設法摧毀了力場屏障，那麼你會立即承受1點超載。

Force Hook Infusion.name: 力場鉤（Force Hook Infusion）
Force Hook Infusion.description:
元素：以太；類別：塑形注能；等級：3；超載：2

  關聯念襲類別：力場彈

  豁免：無

  你的力場彈會勾住目標，並將你拽到向目標旁邊。該效果的功能如同力場鉤鏈（Force Hook Charge；UM）一般，除了它的範圍和傷害依舊按照你的力場彈（force blast）計算。

Force Ward.name: 力場結界（Force Ward）
Force Ward.description:
元素：以太；類別：護身原力（Su）；等級：－；超載：0

  你讓一層力場結界常駐在身上。你獲得臨時生命值，數值等同於你的操念使等級。你總是會首先失去這些臨時生命值，即便同時仍有其他臨時生命值在生效也是如此。如果一次攻擊所造成的傷害比目前力場結界帶來的臨時生命值剩餘量還低的話，此次攻擊會正常減少你的臨時生命值，但是在判斷以失手（miss）或命中（hit）為條件觸發的能力時，此次攻擊被視為失手。這些臨時生命值會以每分鐘1點的速度進行再生。通過以標準動作承受1點超載，你能夠讓力場結界提供的臨時生命值上限得到提升，提升的量為你的操念使等級的一半，直至你所承受的超載得以移除為止。若你重複使用該能力，那麼對此上限的提升會進行疊加。每當你以此方式承受2點超載時，力場結界的再生速率便會增加每分鐘1點。每當你使用以太原力（aether wild talent）並承受超載時，便會從穿過體內的以太中吸取部分能量，以此來讓你的力場結界恢復一定量的臨時生命值，具體數量等同於你的角色等級，至多達到它的目前上限為止。你能夠以直覺動作解消或恢復該效果，但是這麼做不會改變已有的臨時生命值數量，而且在未啟動的情況下，力場結界不會自動再生臨時生命值。

Force of Habit.name: Force of Habit（Force of Habit）
Force of Habit.description: At 5th level, you are so accustomed to complex tasks that you can maintain focus on multiple mental foci simultaneously. If you spend 1 point from your phrenic pool as you cast a psychic spell that requires concentration, you can maintain concentration on that spell as a swift action. In addition, you can cast other psychic spells while concentrating on that spell.

Forced Alliance.name: 強迫結盟（Forced Alliance）
Forced Alliance.description: 以一個標準動作，你可以改變一個活物的心智，讓目標將你視為朋友和盟友。若目標與你是同一種生物類型，該能力只消耗1點心智點；若非同一種生物類型，則消耗2點心智點。目標可進行一次意志豁免免除該效果。若豁免失敗，目標將視你為盟友並不會嘗試傷害你（不過你的盟友不會受到保護）。你可以試圖讓目標直接幫助你，但如此做會讓目標在他每回合結束時再進行意志豁免，成功則結束效果。正常情況下該效果持續每秘學士等級1輪。這是一個影響心靈的魅惑效果。你必須至少5級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Forebear's Reserves.name: Forebear's Reserves（Forebear's Reserves）
Forebear's Reserves.description: At 8th level, you can reroll a saving throw once during a bloodrage. You must decide to use this ability after the die is rolled but before the GM reveals the result. You must take the second result, even if it閳ユ獨 worse.

Forest Siege.name: Forest Siege（Forest Siege）
Forest Siege.description:
Element wood; Type utility (Sp); Level 9; Burn 0

  You can transform available plant life into a besieging army. This functions as @Compendium[pf1.spells.u0dx0en9u171f7t0]{Siege of Trees, Greater}, except you need to concentrate or the effect ends, and you can change targets as a free action.

  If you accept 1 point of burn, you can prolong the effect without the need for concentration until the next time you recover burn, but you need to spend a standard action to change targets.

Forge and Fire.name: Forge and Fire（Forge and Fire）
Forge and Fire.description: At 3rd level, you gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.4hNO4OAWYF5vXphH]{制造魔法武器和防具} as a bonus feat. In addition, whenever you cast a nonpermanent, noninstantaneous spell that improves or enhances a manufactured weapon, you can also give that weapon the flaming special ability for the spell閳ユ獨 duration (This has no effect if the weapon already has the flaming special ability).

Forgotten Presence.name: Forgotten Presence（Forgotten Presence）
Forgotten Presence.description:
Once per day as an immediate action, you can cause a creature to forget that you were present for the last minute per oracle level, including forgetting all actions you took during that time, unless it succeeds at a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Charisma modifier). Effects such as modify memory can restore the lost memories.

  At 15th level, you can use this ability twice per day.

  You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Form of the Beast.name: Form of the Beast（Form of the Beast）
Form of the Beast.description:
As a standard action, you can assume the form of a Small or Medium animal, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.tjdfluulncmqacc3]{野獸形態 I}.

  At 9th level, you can assume the form of a Tiny or Large animal, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.774kmgcb7ygviht0]{野獸形態II}.

  At 11th level, you can assume the form of a Diminutive or Huge animal or a Small or Medium magical beast, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.w88ddxpu89qcr5c0]{野獸形態III}.

  At 13th level, you can assume the form of a Tiny or Large magical beast, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.br37848gchetel0q]{野獸形態 IV}.

  You can use this ability once per day, but the duration is 1 hour/level.

  You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Form of the Dragon.name: Form of the Dragon（Form of the Dragon）
Form of the Dragon.description:
Your kinship with dragonkind allows you to take on the form of a dragon. As a standard action, you can assume the form of a Medium dragon, as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.iqcjiyi9leldfzxt]{巨龍形態 I}.

  At 15th level, you can assume the form of a Large dragon, as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.5icj4nasrlgqojqm]{巨龍形態 II}.

  At 19th level, you can assume the form of a Huge dragon, as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.6qpg42rj70oi4css]{巨龍形態 III}.

  You can use this ability once per day, but the duration is 10 minutes per oracle level.

  If you are at least 15th level and choose to have this ability function as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.iqcjiyi9leldfzxt]{巨龍形態 I}, the duration is instead 1 hour per oracle level.

  You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation. Rather than form of the dragon spells, you can choose for this revelation to act as @Compendium[pf1.spells.g3d29t4amz91ewy5]{Form Of The Alien Dragon I}, @Compendium[pf1.spells.k59ax9hxy83o19bn]{Form Of The Alien Dragon II}, and @Compendium[pf1.spells.fv14vemq9gduhyhu]{Form Of The Alien Dragon III} (see page 29) or @Compendium[pf1.spells.tjokidgeh3dy9mv0]{Form Of The Exotic Dragon I}, @Compendium[pf1.spells.gwyeoo4ksso71zfo]{Form Of The Exotic Dragon II}, and @Compendium[pf1.spells.0nm8l17dcr7oi7c3]{Form Of The Exotic Dragon III} (see page 30). This choice must be made when you first gain this revelation, and cannot be changed.

Fortification Subdomain.name: Fortification Subdomain（Fortification Subdomain）
Fortification Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.78kwl5t99j9e8tzh]{人類定身術}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.l83djt5019ujasjh]{石牆術}
  • 9環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ijwcwnt3oatnfghq]{虹光法牆}

Fortified Position.name: Fortified Position（Fortified Position）
Fortified Position.description: Whenever the rogue gains a bonus on Reflex saves due to cover, she gains an equal bonus on Fortitude saves.

Fortress of Sorrow.name: Fortress of Sorrow（Fortress of Sorrow）
Fortress of Sorrow.description:
At 13th level, you can mentally construct an extraplanar retreat on the Astral Plane. This ability functions as @Compendium[pf1.spells.r4znakt4ukpebsxg]{Create Demiplane, Lesser} with a caster level equal to your psychic level, with the following adjustments: you need no focus to create the fortress of sorrow; the demiplane is permanent until dismissed by you; you cannot create more than one demiplane with this ability or add to the plane閳ユ獨 area by casting the spell again; the light level on the demiplane is dim, though light sources affect it normally; and you cannot bring other creatures to your demiplane.

  Once per day, you can enter your demiplane (as @Compendium[pf1.spells.q3st18udsalnyz5v]{異界傳送}), and once per day, you can return in a similar manner, arriving at the same spot you left from (or the nearest available space).

Fossil Form.name: Fossil Form（Fossil Form）
Fossil Form.description:
At the beginning of your turn as a swift action, you can infuse your flesh with minerals, granting you cumbersome security. Until the beginning of your next turn, you are staggered, gain hardness 2, and gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against petrification. This hardness increases by 2 and your saving throw bonus increases by 1 for every 4 cleric levels you have. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Acid Dart power of the Earth Domain.

Founders' Blessing.name: Founders' Blessing（Founders' Blessing）
Founders' Blessing.description: The rogue can call upon the mystical legacies of the Council. Once per day, she can choose a skill in which she has no ranks. After she spends 10 minutes communing with these mystical spirits, they grant her a luck bonus equal to her rogue level with that skill, and she can attempt checks with that skill as if she were trained in its use. The effects of founder閳ユ獨 blessing last for 8 hours.

Foxfire Infusion.name: Foxfire Infusion（Foxfire Infusion）
Foxfire Infusion.description:
Element fire, wood; Type substance infusion (Sp); Level 3; Burn 2
Prerequisite foxfire or positive blast
Associated Blasts blue flame, fire, positive
Saving Throw Will partial

  Your blast leaves behind flickering flames that reveal the target閳ユ獨 location as per faerie fire for 1 minute (or until your next turn if the target succeeds at its save). This effect occurs even if the foe doesn閳ユ獩 take damage, as long as the attack overcomes spell resistance (if any). You can reduce the blast閳ユ獨 damage by half to increase the DC of this saving throw by 2.

  A creature can remove the revealing flames early by taking a full-round action to extinguish them.

Foxfire.name: Foxfire（Foxfire）
Foxfire.description:
Element fire, wood; Type utility (Sp); Level 2; Burn 0
Prerequisite fire blast or positive blast
Saving Throw none; SR yes

  You surround a creature with glowing flames that outline it, as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.bl71og1gklwncmt7]{妖火}. If you use foxfire with positive energy, the flames don閳ユ獩 give off heat. If you use it with fire, the flames still aren閳ユ獩 hot enough to deal damage immediately, but the illuminated creature counts as being under the effects of severe heat and must succeed at a Fortitude save against nonlethal damage after 10 minutes.

  A creature can extinguish the foxfire automatically as a full-round action.

Fractured Mirror.name: Fractured Mirror（Fractured Mirror）
Fractured Mirror.description:
By sending phantom selves across the battlefield, one may fight as many. When a ninja with this trick uses the shadow clone ninja trick, she gains an additional clone for every 3 ninja levels she has, to a maximum of eight clones. In addition, while she has shadow clones deployed, the ninja can cause any number of her clones to split from herself as part of a move action. The shadow clones move up to the ninja閳ユ獨 speed at her will each time she uses a move action to move. Shadow clones separated in this way are not considered part of the shadow clone trick until they return to the ninja閳ユ獨 square, though they can still be destroyed while separated. Shadow clones separated from the ninja have an AC equal to the ninja閳ユ獨 AC 閳?5 and cannot take any actions, though they can provide flanking. Shadow clones do not occupy any space and a creature can freely enter a shadow clone閳ユ獨 square.

  The ninja must have the shadow clone ninja trick to select this trick.

Fragmentation Infusion.name: 爆碎（Fragmentation Infusion）
Fragmentation Infusion.description:
元素：土或水；類別：塑形注能；等級：7；超載：4

  前置：增距（extended range）

  關聯念襲類別：巖擊，冰槍，轟鋼

  豁免：無或 反射，通過則減半；見後文

  你投擲出不牢固的固態球體，它會炸碎成數不清的破片。嘗試一次遠程攻擊檢定對抗120尺內的一個目標。若你命中，目標受到你的念襲傷害且無需豁免。所有半徑20尺爆發範圍內的其他生物和物體會受到正常數值一半的傷害，而且能夠嘗試一次反射豁免來讓傷害再次減半。若對目標的攻擊失手，念襲將不會產生效果。該豁免DC基於敏捷。

Free in Body.name: 自由之軀（Free in Body）
Free in Body.description: 在受到拘束時，受術者能輕而易舉地從中滑脫出來。在受術者在自己的回合開始時，若她被擒抱或者受到一個妨礙移動的效果——這包括麻痺（paralysis）、重霧術（solid fog）、緩慢術（slow）以及蛛網術（web）——影響的話，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。受術者會在1分鐘內獲得行動自如（Freedom of Movement）法術的好處。

Freedom of Movement (UC).name: Freedom of Movement (UC)（Freedom of Movement (UC)）
Freedom of Movement (UC).description:
A monk with this ability can spend 1 ki point as a swift action to gain the effects of @Compendium[pf1.spells.lvzq2mwkqmozolpl]{行動自如} for 1 round.

  The monk must be at least 8th level before selecting this ki power.

Friend of Fire.name: Friend of Fire（Friend of Fire）
Friend of Fire.description: At 3rd level, you gain fire resistance 10. At 5th level, when in contact with flame or a burning object (including a flaming weapon, lantern, or torch), add 1 per die to any healing effect of which you are the target. At 9th level, your fire resistance increases to 20. At 20th level, you gain immunity to fire.

Friend to Nature.name: Friend to Nature（Friend to Nature）
Friend to Nature.description: At 9th level, once per day you can create a spear of pure light and throw it at a creature within 60 feet as a standard action. This is a ranged touch attack that uses your Charisma modifier in place of your Dexterity modifier to determine the attack bonus. The spear deals 1d6 points of damage per sorcerer level and ignores all damage reduction and hardness. This damage increases to 1d8 points of damage per sorcerer level against an evil creature. At 13th level, you can use this ability twice per day. At 17th level, you can use this ability three times per day.

Friendship Subdomain.name: Friendship Subdomain（Friendship Subdomain）
Friendship Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.menqakfoa1ftvi3f]{護衛他人}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.zuqlok69lapqc6lg]{心靈連線}

Frightening Appearance.name: 駭人現身（Frightening Appearance）
Frightening Appearance.description:
在11級時，每當擁有本能力的俠客嘗試對一個完全沒有意識到他的存在（條件見上驚愕現身）的敵人發動一次攻擊時，俠客可以選擇以一個自由動作嘗試一次威嚇檢定來挫敗他攻擊的目標以及所有距離他10尺內且可以看到俠客的這次攻擊的敵人的士氣。這次威嚇檢定必須在對俠客原本目標的攻擊檢定發動和獲得結果前進行，並且俠客只骰一次威嚇檢定來針對所有上述的生物發動威嚇。如果這次威嚇檢定成功挫敗了俠客所攻擊目標的士氣，那麼他除了會如常的陷入戰慄狀態外海會再驚懼（Frightened）一輪，除非該目標再通過一個DC=（10+俠客的等級的一半+他的魅力調整值）的意志檢定。

  一旦某個生物成為了駭人現身的目標（無論他是俠客的攻擊目標還是旁觀者，以及俠客的威嚇是否成功），他都會免疫同一個俠客的駭人現身能力24小時。本能力的效果與驚愕現身能力的好處疊加。駭人現身是一個影響心靈的恐懼效果。

Frightful Presence (3 pts).name: Frightful Presence (3 pts)（Frightful Presence (3 pts)）
Frightful Presence (3 pts).description:
An eidolon becomes unsettling to its foes, gaining the frightful presence ability. The eidolon can activate this ability as part of an offensive action, such as a charge or attack. Opponents within 30 feet of the eidolon must make a Will save or become shaken for 3d6 rounds. The DC of this save is equal to 10 + 1/2 the eidolon's HD + the eidolon's Charisma modifier. If the eidolon has at least 4 more Hit Dice than an opponent, that opponent becomes frightened instead. Foes with more HD than the eidolon are immune to this effect.

  The summoner must be at least 11th level before selecting this evolution.

Frightful Presence (UC) (3 pts).name: Frightful Presence (UC) (3 pts)（Frightful Presence (UC) (3 pts)）
Frightful Presence (UC) (3 pts).description:
Requirements: Summoner level 11th.

  The eidolon becomes unsettling to its foes, gaining the frightful presence ability. The eidolon can activate this ability as part of an offensive action, such as a charge or attack. Opponents within 30 feet of the eidolon must succeed at a Will save or become shaken for 3d6 rounds. The DC of this save is equal to 10 + 1/2 the eidolon閳ユ獨 Hit Dice + the eidolon閳ユ獨 Charisma modifier. If the eidolon has at least 4 more Hit Dice than an opponent that fails this save, that opponent becomes frightened instead.

  Foes with more Hit Dice than the eidolon are immune to this effect.

Frigid Blast.name: Frigid Blast（Frigid Blast）
Frigid Blast.description:
The shaman gains cold resistance 10. In addition, as a standard action, she can summon an icy blast in a 20-foot-radius burst originating from a point she can see within 30 feet. This blast deals cold damage equal to 1d6 per shaman level she has to each creature caught in the burst. Each target can attempt a Reflex saving throw to halve this damage.

  The shaman can use this ability three times per day, but she must wait at least 1d4 rounds between each use.

Frog Aspect.name: 青蛙擬態（Frog Aspect）
Frog Aspect.description:
青蛙擬態賦予了在空中跳躍與在水中游泳的強大靈活性，以及在戰鬥中的驚奇戰術。

  次級形態：你的游泳檢定和跳躍的特技檢定獲得+4表現加值。8級時，這個加值提升至+6。15級時，這個加值提升至+8。

  專攻形態：你變身為一隻大型青蛙（參照怪物圖鑑 pg. 135 巨蛙，但是你只佔據10尺）。當處於該形態時，你獲得30尺游泳速度、昏暗視覺、靈敏嗅覺（30尺）、一個附帶攫抓能力的1d6傷害的齧咬攻擊和所有跳躍檢定均視為已進行了助跑。8級時，你獲得舌舔攻擊。15級時，你的游泳速度提升至60尺。此外，你的舌舔攻擊的觸及提升至30尺，並且你的舌舔攻擊可以造成等同你的變形者利爪傷害的鈍擊傷害。

From the Ashes.name: 浴火重生（From The Ashes）
From the Ashes.description:
元素：火；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：9；超載：2

  當你即將由於生命值傷害而陷入昏迷（fall unconscious）或死亡時，你能夠以直覺動作突然化身為火焰，只留下一堆灰燼，大多數攻擊和效果都不能影響這些灰燼，不過解離術（disintegrate）或類似的魔法能夠摧毀它。在你的下個回合開始時，只要灰燼沒有被完全摧毀，你就可以在大多數灰燼所在的方格重生，你會受到觸發效果的傷害，不過你也會恢復每操念使等級5點的生命值。

Frost Spirit Manifestation.name: Frost Spirit Manifestation（Frost Spirit Manifestation）
Frost Spirit Manifestation.description:
Upon reaching 20th level, the shaman becomes a being of ice and snow. The shaman gains immunity to cold. She can also apply any one of the following feats to any spell with the cold descriptor that she casts without increasing the spell閳ユ獨 level or casting time: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.9mcYid7xJY9NiySx]{法術增遠}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.btXWioB3SKJv8YEG]{法術延時}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.2YuxcUNFMPNBpekG]{法術默發}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.jVFjMIyQD6TOAsmj]{法術定發}

  She doesn閳ユ獩 need to have these feats to use this ability.

Frost Spirit.name: Frost Spirit（Frost Spirit）
Frost Spirit.description:
Far to the north, Erutaki tribes have adapted to life in the bitter cold of the Crown of the World. The frost spirit is seen by some Erutaki as a protector of their way of life, and shamans who commune with the spirit are shown great respect in their communities.

A shaman who selects the frost spirit has coarse white hair and always feels cold to the touch.

Spirit Magic Spells: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.grgpvfexq2dh31fq]{Frostbite} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jgx8sur7w4k93mql]{元素之觸} (cold only) (2nd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.q35l6m4pggb4y98v]{元素光環} (cold only) (3rd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.t1uhggjfimtabp4v]{冰風暴} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.hd7ukybisvv7j5r6]{召喚怪物 V} (ice elementals only) (5th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ol05jfb606v0lzj9]{冰封法球} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.qubzqiz5mqs8tbqr]{Ice Body} (7th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.8jq1atxonnerix55]{極冰射線} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ezpm33cvtlq8aswa]{Icy Prison, Mass} (9th).

  Spirit Animal: The shaman閳ユ獨 spirit animal is covered in a light layer of glimmering frost, and its breath comes out as mist regardless of the temperature. The animal has resistance 5 to cold and electricity.

Fueled by Vengeance.name: Fueled by Vengeance（Fueled by Vengeance）
Fueled by Vengeance.description: While raging, whenever you deal weapon damage to a creature that dealt damage to you since the end of your last turn, add 1 round to your remaining number of rounds of rage for the current day. You can gain no more than 1 extra round of rage each round. You must be at least 6th level to select this rage power.

Furious Barrage.name: Furious Barrage（Furious Barrage）
Furious Barrage.description:
The barbarian is treated as having the @Compendium[pf1.feats.NABgOSBRECIREaha]{快速射擊} feat, but only for the purpose of attacking with thrown weapons. She need not meet the feat閳ユ獨 prerequisites.

  A barbarian must be at least 4th level and must have the furious draw rage power before selecting this power.

Furious Draw.name: Furious Draw（Furious Draw）
Furious Draw.description: The barbarian is treated as having the @Compendium[pf1.feats.WKIVfdosc5SqYzmP]{即時備戰} feat.
