Fused Consciousness.name: 意識融合（Fused Consciousness）
Fused Consciousness.description: 在10級時，只要她的魅影處於顯形狀態，喚魂師就可以一直獲得連覺能力的好處，以及該情感羈絆的魅影在技能等級和對抗影響心靈的法術時所獲得的加值。最後，當喚魂師通過分享意識能力將一個影響自己心靈的法術傳遞到魅影時，她可以在魅影已經顯形的情況下這麼做，但她的魅影也會立刻返回喚魂師的意念之中。

Future Gaze.name: 未來一瞥（Future Gaze）
Future Gaze.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點短暫看到未來。該能力如同占卜術一般運作，使用秘學士等級作為施法者等級。

Gather Power.name: 念力凝聚（Gather Power）
Gather Power.description: 若操念使的雙手都空著（或者對於非常規的操念使來說，她所擁有的所有可用於抓握的肢體都空著），她能夠以移動動作凝聚能量或元素物質。念力凝聚會創造出異常醒目且肉眼可視的能量或物質，並以操念使為中心，在半徑20尺範圍內環繞著她。念力凝聚會使她在同一輪內使用的念襲原力（blast wild talent）所需要的超載總消耗降低1點。操念使可以花費1整輪進行念力凝聚作為替代，這樣會使得她在下個回合內使用的念襲原力（blast wild talent）所需要的超載總消耗降低2點（最低降至0點）。若她這麼做，還可以在下個回合以移動動作進一步念力凝聚，並使得此回合的超載消耗合計降低3點。若操念使在唸力凝聚期間或之後，使用念襲釋放力量之前受到傷害的話，則必須進行專注檢定（DC = 10 + 受到的傷害 + 念襲的有效法術等級），失敗則會引發力量的失控，導致她自身承受一定點數的超載，具體點數等同於操念使使用念力凝聚原本所能降低的超載消耗。該能力永遠無法讓原力的超載消耗降低至0點以下。

Gator Wrangle.name: Gator Wrangle（Gator Wrangle）
Gator Wrangle.description: The vigilante gains a +8 bonus to his CMD against grapple combat maneuvers when using the grab ability, and he halves all damage from constrict attacks. When attacking a creature that is grappling him, an avenger vigilante deals an additional amount of damage equal to half his vigilante level.

Gaze.name: Gaze（Gaze）
Gaze.description: At 1st level, you can harness the power of the medusa through your gaze. As a standard action, choose a creature within your line of sight who is within 30 feet of you. The creature must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or have its speed halved for a number of rounds equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1 round). The DC of this save is equal to 10 + half your bloodrager level + your Constitution modifier.

Gearbreaker.name: Gearbreaker（Gearbreaker）
Gearbreaker.description:
Once per round while raging, whenever the barbarian makes an attack against a construct, she can ignore an amount of that construct閳ユ獨 hardness equal to her barbarian level. This ability must be used before the attack roll is made.

  A barbarian must have the smasher rage power before selecting this rage power. This power stacks with hard hitter.

Ghoul Bloodline.name: Ghoul Bloodline（Ghoul Bloodline）
Ghoul Bloodline.description:
Your connection to the hungering undead shapes your magic.

  本職技能: 隱匿.

獎勵法術:

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.mczdgwo3xl8c6e26]{衰弱射線} (3rd),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.23pgt0f34obki95q]{Feast Of Ashes} (5th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.3efy1ico48ccrzni]{吸血鬼之觸} (7th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.be88e90guqbi1q1z]{恐懼術} (9th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.y2byo50vj2hrltl4]{Hungry Earth} (11th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ukuyfbufbglbzfco]{地動術} (13th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wkp8u7xl1dgpk362]{操控死靈} (15th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.flrn1xmm2wfrxbkf]{邪惡靈光} (17th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wplgawb6aznjx7se]{女妖之嚎} (19th).

獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.QvlxYVVsBDlykPKe]{Arcane Strike},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.u7rGDZUL296QIuA0]{戰斗施法},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.FUW5mIXHNBBIQ1Sq]{猛力攻擊},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.7zJTztNW7hdaqjKc]{技能專攻} (@JournalEntry[dfjwbMEdt062TJtE]{知識}：宗教),
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.V2zY7BltkpSXwejy]{法術專攻}(necromancy),
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.8snLqsJN4LLL00Nq]{健壯},
  •  Warren Digger*,
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.vWiTqHC4Y3Xn1Pme]{武器嫻熟}.

血統奧秘: Whenever you cast a spell of the necromancy school that deals hit point damage, you are healed of 1 hit point per spell level.

Ghoul Curse.name: Ghoul Curse（Ghoul Curse）
Ghoul Curse.description:
While your actual dietary needs don閳ユ獩 change, you crave the flesh of sentient creatures. You can only go without food for 12 hours before you begin to starve, and when you do starve, the DC of the Constitution check to avoid taking damage increases by 5. If you feed on fresh, raw flesh (no older than 1 hour) from a creature of your own race, you gain a +1 morale bonus on all saving throws for 24 hours.

  At 5th level, you add @Compendium[pf1.spells.5u43heihlrtuc58y]{食屍鬼之觸} to your list of 2nd-level oracle spells known.

  At 10th level, you become immune to paralysis and disease.

  At 15th level, you gain the effects of heroes閳?feast whenever you feed on the raw flesh of a sentient creature, and the effects of this heroes閳?feast double if the flesh you eat comes from a member of your own race (this effect applies no more often than once per day).

Ghoulish Aspect.name: Ghoulish Aspect（Ghoulish Aspect）
Ghoulish Aspect.description: At 20th level, you take on aspects of the nature and appearance of ghouls. You no longer feel the need to eat and are immune to hunger (though you are still able to consume flesh if you choose to). You gain immunity to cold, nonlethal damage, paralysis, and sleep. You also gain DR 5/閳? Additionally, you gain the stench ability with a radius of 10 feet. Creatures that fail their Fortitude saving throws are sickened for 1d6+4 minutes. Use half your sorcerer level instead of half your racial Hit Dice to determine the saving throw DC.

Ghoulish Claws.name: Ghoulish Claws（Ghoulish Claws）
Ghoulish Claws.description: Starting at 1st level, you can grow claws as a free action. These claws are treated as natural weapons, allowing you to make two claw attacks as a full attack using your full base attack bonus. Each of these attacks deals 1d4 points of damage + your Strength modifier (1d3 if you are Small). At 5th level, creatures damaged with your claw attack are paralyzed for 1 round, as the ghoul ability (Fort negates). At 7th level, the duration of the paralysis increases to 1d4+1 rounds, and the claws are considered magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming DR. You can use your claws for a number of rounds per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. These rounds do not need to be consecutive. If you閳ユ獧e a ghoul with this bloodline, instead of gaining this ability, your levels in sorcerer stack with your racial Hit Dice when determining the DC of your paralysis and disease special abilities.

Giant Wasp Aspect.name: Giant Wasp Aspect（Giant Wasp Aspect）
Giant Wasp Aspect.description:
The aspect of the wasp grants flight and a venomous sting, as well as great mental resistance. A giant wasp閳ユ獨 alternate attack is sting (P).

Minor Form: You gain a +4 bonus on Will saves against mind-affecting affects.

  This bonus increases to +6 at 8th level and +8 at 15th level.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a giant wasp. This ability uses the vermin shape spell, rather than beast shape, for the purposes of wild shape. While in this form, you gain a fly speed of 40 feet (clumsy), and swarms and vermin do not attack you unless magically commanded to do so.

  At 8th level, this fly speed increases to 60 feet (average), and you gain a sting attack usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier, which applies the following poison.

Wasp Venom (Ex) Sting閳ユ攰njury; save Fort DC = 10 + half your shifter level + your Constitution modifier; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d3 Dex damage; cure 2 consecutive saves.

At 15th level, your fly speed increases to 80 feet (good), and you can attempt to gain control of a mindless swarm as a full-round action. To gain control of the swarm, you must succeed at a Charisma check against a DC of 10 + the swarm閳ユ獨 CR. You can direct the swarm to disperse, remain in a designated location, or attack an opponent. This control lasts for a number of rounds equal to half your shifter level.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Sting (P)

Gift of Claw and Horn.name: Gift of Claw and Horn（Gift of Claw and Horn）
Gift of Claw and Horn.description:
As a swift action, you gain a natural weapon. The natural weapon lasts for a number of rounds equal to half your oracle level (minimum 1). You must choose a bite, claw, or gore attack. These attacks deal the normal damage for a creature of your size (Pathfinder RPG Bestiary 302).

  At 5th level, your natural weapon gains a +1 enhancement bonus. This bonus increases by +1 at 10th, 15th, and 20th level.

  At 11th level, you gain two natural weapons at a time. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Gift of Consumption.name: Gift of Consumption（Gift of Consumption）
Gift of Consumption.description:
The witch curses a creature to share any effects that target her vitality. Whenever the witch is exposed to an effect that requires her to attempt a Fortitude save, as an immediate action she can curse a creature within 30 feet to share the effect. The hexed creature must also attempt a Fortitude save at the same DC as the witch閳ユ獨, and on a failure it is subject to the same effects as the witch. Regardless of the outcome of the saving throw, the creature can閳ユ獩 be targeted by this hex again for 1 day.

  This hex does not function with effects that require additional types of saves, such as phantasmal killer.

Gift of Will.name: 意志贈禮（Gift of Will）
Gift of Will.description: 催眠師從強大的精神力量分出了一部分用於強化盟友的心智。當受術者嘗試一次意志豁免檢定或者一次察言觀色檢定、或者受術者成為了一次用於挫敗士氣的威嚇檢定的目標時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。在豁免豁免檢定的情況下，受術者能夠使用催眠師的意志豁免加值，以取代自身的加值。在察言觀色檢定或威嚇檢定的情況下，受術者能夠將催眠師的魅力加值作為士氣加值加到檢定或DC上。催眠師不能為自己植入該項詭計。

Gift of the Ancients.name: Gift of the Ancients（Gift of the Ancients）
Gift of the Ancients.description:
At 4th level, you gain a +2 resistance bonus on saving throws against gaze attacks and to resist poison. You also gain a +2 competence bonus on Perception checks.

  At 8th level, these bonuses increase by 2.

Gills (1 pt).name: Gills (1 pt)（Gills (1 pt)）
Gills (1 pt).description: An eidolon has gills and can breathe underwater indefinitely.

Gills (UC) (1 pt).name: Gills (UC) (1 pt)（Gills (UC) (1 pt)）
Gills (UC) (1 pt).description: The eidolon has gills and can breathe underwater indefinitely.

Gills.name: Gills（Gills）
Gills.description:
An alchemist with this discovery grows a set of gills that allow him to breathe water in addition to breathing air. When on land, the alchemist risks his gills drying out and must bathe his gills with 1/2 gallon of water every 24 hours he is out of the water or take 1 point of Constitution damage every hour thereafter.

  An alchemist must be at least 4th level before selecting this discovery.

Glassfoot Bomb.name: Glassfoot Bomb（Glassfoot Bomb）
Glassfoot Bomb.description: When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it cover the ground in volatile jagged crystals in addition to its normal effects. These crystals act like caltrops, evaporating into a smelly but harmless gas in 2d6 rounds.

Glib Facade.name: Glib Facade（Glib Facade）
Glib Facade.description: Once per day, a rogue with this advanced talent can use @Compendium[pf1.spells.7c8nufdm0pj4bgep]{花言巧語} as a spelllike ability, using her rogue level as the spell閳ユ獨 caster level. A rogue must have the innocent facade rogue talent before selecting this talent.

Glib Lie.name: 從容妄言（Glib Lie）
Glib Lie.description: 11級起，催眠師能夠欺騙尋求真實的魔法（truth-detecting magic）。使用此類魔法的生物在對抗催眠師時，必須進行一次施法者等級檢定來對抗數值為15 + 催眠師的施法者等級的DC，就如同催眠師受到花言巧語（Glibness）法術的影響一般；失敗意味著魔法無法偵測出催眠師的謊言，或者無法迫使他說真話。該能力不會讓催眠師獲得花言巧語（Glibness）法術為唬騙檢定提供的加值。

Glimmering Infusion.name: Glimmering Infusion（Glimmering Infusion）
Glimmering Infusion.description: The alchemist can expend any prepared extract to produce a cube of glowing motes that act as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.ec2zmvdzi4m3puh4]{閃光塵}. The area must be adjacent to the alchemist and covers one 5-foot square per level of extract sacrificed, and the effect閳ユ獨 save DC is calculated using the level of the sacrificed extract. The alchemist must have the infusion discovery to choose this discovery.

Globe of Negation.name: 否決之球（Globe of Negation）
Globe of Negation.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗3點心智點創造一個固定的否決之球。球體直徑10尺並取消一切向球內施放或穿過球體的法術效果。它運作如同法術無效結界，但可對任何環級的法術有效。球體可否決的法術總環級數等同於你秘學士等級，上限達到後球體破碎。當一法術被否決之球影響時，否決之球現在份額已不足以完全取消該法術時，球體被吸收部分效力後破碎，該法術被弱化；任何被該法術影響的單位在對抗該法術的豁免檢定上獲得+4環境加值。否決之球持續輪數等於秘學士等級。它對法術源發點在球體內的法術沒有效果——只對施放進球體的法術或越過球體的法術有效。你必須至少11級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Gloom Magic.name: Gloom Magic（Gloom Magic）
Gloom Magic.description: A rogue with this talent gains the ability to cast darkness two times per day as a spell-like ability. The darkness created by this ability does not impair the rogue閳ユ獨 vision. The caster level for this ability is equal to the rogue閳ユ獨 level. A rogue must have an Intelligence score of at least 12 and the minor magic rogue talent before choosing this talent.

Glorious Presence.name: 光彩照人（Glorious Presence）
Glorious Presence.description: 靈器提高持有者的氣質形象。靈氣內每填充有2點心智點，持有者所有基於魅力的技能檢定和能力檢定就獲得+1表現加值，最高為1+每4秘學士等級1點。

Glutinous Gloom.name: Glutinous Gloom（Glutinous Gloom）
Glutinous Gloom.description:
The gloom creates an area in its splash radius that functions as @Compendium[pf1.spells.j9qpy0d585f8lpm4]{蛛網術}. The webbing lasts for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 the alchemist閳ユ獨 level.

  An alchemist must be at least 6th level before selecting this discovery.

Go with the Flow.name: Go with the Flow（Go with the Flow）
Go with the Flow.description:
You can touch a creature as a standard action to suppress its strong emotions. The target is affected as the calm emotions spell, except it can still take violent actions and violent actions against the target do not end the effect. This effect lasts a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum 1). You can use this ability a number times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Icicle power of the Water Domain.

God-Meddled Curse.name: God-Meddled Curse（God-Meddled Curse）
God-Meddled Curse.description:
The isle of Iblydos is populated and watched over by hero-gods, some of whom are known for entangling mortals in their own affairs. The gods閳?interference in your life has left you with strange, unpredictable powers dependent on divine whim. Bizarre side effects occur whenever you are affected by a spell from a divine caster閳ユ攩or better or for worse. Once per round, when a creature casts a divine spell including you as a target, roll 1d20 and consult the table below. The effect resulting from this roll begins at the end of that enemy閳ユ獨 turn. This effect targets only you, even if other creatures were included as targets of the triggering spell.

  At 5th level, you gain a +2 competence bonus on saving throws to resist divine spells.

  At 10th level, you become immune to the confused condition.

  At 15th level, you gain a +4 competence bonus on saving throws to resist mind-affecting effects.

God-Meddled Effects

d20 Effect
1 You provoke an attack of opportunity from one enemy adjacent to you. If no enemy is adjacent, the closest enemy can move its full movement speed in your direction as a free action. If multiple enemies qualify, the GM determines which creature attacks or moves. This movement does not trigger attacks of opportunity.
2-3 Your movement speed is halved for 1 round.
4-5 You are deafened for 1 round.
6-7 You are knocked prone.
8-10 You shrink by one size category for 1 round, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.2y9e1l6zso9tdg0a]{縮小術}.
11-13 You grow by one size category for 1 round, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.jnlr9cuepka1l26e]{變巨術}.
14-15 Your caster level is treated as 1 higher for the purpose of spell durations for 1 round.
16-17 Creatures in squares adjacent to you are pushed 10 feet away from the space you occupy.
18-19 You are able to understand all languages for 1 round.
20 You gain the benefits of @Compendium[pf1.spells.s9amdo5398alb5p0]{加速術} for 1 round.

Godclaw Blessing: Command Obedience.name: Godclaw Blessing: Command Obedience（Godclaw Blessing: Command Obedience）
Godclaw Blessing: Command Obedience.description: You can touch an ally and say a quick word to remind her of her obligations, granting her a new saving throw against each enchantment effect that currently affects her. If the saving throw is successful, the enchantment effect immediately ends. This power affects only effects that allow a saving throw.

Godclaw Blessing: Tactical Readiness.name: Godclaw Blessing: Tactical Readiness（Godclaw Blessing: Tactical Readiness）
Godclaw Blessing: Tactical Readiness.description: At 10th level, you can rally your allies within 30 feet, allowing each to immediately do one of the following as a free action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity: remove the flat-footed condition, take a 5-foot step, draw a weapon, ready a shield, or gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC for 1 round. You can affect a number of allies equal to your Wisdom bonus. These actions do not count against your allies閳?total movement or actions on their next turn.

Godclaw Final Revelation.name: Godclaw Final Revelation（Godclaw Final Revelation）
Godclaw Final Revelation.description: Upon reaching 20th level, you can cast detect chaos, detect law, and discern lies at will as spell-like abilities, using your oracle level as your caster level. You no longer take armor check penalties for wearing armor, and your armor閳ユ獨 maximum Dexterity bonus increases by 5. Once per day, you can cast @Compendium[pf1.spells.1zyixa5b6aw7npub]{粉碎掌} as a spell-like ability without requiring a focus component, treating your oracle level as your caster level. This hand manifests as a massive, spiked gauntlet.

Godclaw Mystery.name: Godclaw Mystery（Godclaw Mystery）
Godclaw Mystery.description:
本職技能: An oracle with the Godclaw mystery adds Bluff, Intimidate, Knowledge ：地方, and Perception to her list of class skills.

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.9tww9fc9049h6iqc]{驚恐術} (2nd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.y69de8y5ddrhuue5]{怪物暈眩術} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.78kwl5t99j9e8tzh]{人類定身術} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.8zeulunjetwrdgwj]{秩序之怒} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.myg2b9ww43nnlbr2]{破除結界} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.aoov6nqfm195txdb]{飛擊掌} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.7e22urxux6i2mua5]{律言} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lzj5umxjvogvpg6b]{秩序護盾} (16th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.esia6azb5g68tfs7]{禁錮術} (18th).

Gore (2 pts).name: Gore (2 pts)（Gore (2 pts)）
Gore (2 pts).description: An eidolon grows a number of horns on its head, giving it a gore attack. This attack is a primary attack. The gore deals 1d6 points of damage (1d8 if Large, 2d6 if Huge).

Gore (UC) (2 pts).name: Gore (UC) (2 pts)（Gore (UC) (2 pts)）
Gore (UC) (2 pts).description:
Requirements: Agathion, daemon, demon, devil, div, elemental, protean, or psychopomp subtype.

  The eidolon grows a number of horns on its head, giving it a gore attack. This attack is a primary attack. The gore deals 1d6 points of damage (1d8 if Large, 2d6 if Huge).

Gossip Collector.name: 飛短流長（Gossip Collector）
Gossip Collector.description: 俠客為自己製造了一張流言的傳遞網絡，他總是可以在第一時間掌握自己身邊來來去去的最新小道訊息。當俠客希望獲取關於一個話題的情報時，他只需要花費1d2小時而非通常的1d4小時時間來蒐集訊息。如果俠客身處在他擁有聲譽影響的地區之中時，他只需要花費1d4x10分鐘時間就可以蒐集訊息，並且如果他用於蒐集訊息的檢定結果比檢定DC高出10點，那麼他無需花費任何時間就可以知道自己想要的訊息——謠言自己傳到了俠客的耳朵裡。但是，俠客無法在某一地區中打聽當地人並不知道的訊息，即使是在他擁有聲譽影響的地區也不行。

Gossip Guru.name: Gossip Guru（Gossip Guru）
Gossip Guru.description:
You sit in a web of intrigue like a spider, subtly tracing the course of rumors and gossip in order to understand the ties that bind those around you. You can use the @Compendium[pf1.spells.piwj11ynlsji0i7a]{Rumormonger} spell once per day as a spell-like ability, using your oracle level as your caster level. Each time you do so, it ends the duration of any previous activation.

  At 11th level, you can use this ability three times per day, and at 15th level, you can use it at will, but regardless, each use still ends the duration of any previous activation.

  You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Got Your Back.name: Got Your Back（Got Your Back）
Got Your Back.description: Once per round as an immediate action, you may expend an attack of opportunity to attempt an aid another check to improve an ally閳ユ獨 attack. You and your ally must both be flanking the same opponent. This counts as an attack of opportunity.

Grab (2 pts).name: Grab (2 pts)（Grab (2 pts)）
Grab (2 pts).description: An eidolon becomes adept at grappling foes, gaining the grab ability. Pick bite, claw, pincers, slam, tail slap, or tentacle attacks. Whenever the eidolon makes a successful attack of the selected type, it can attempt a free combat maneuver check. If successful, the eidolon grapples the target. This ability only works on creatures of a size one category smaller than the eidolon or smaller. Eidolons with this evolution receive a +4 bonus on CMB checks made to grapple.

Grab (UC) (2 pts).name: Grab (UC) (2 pts)（Grab (UC) (2 pts)）
Grab (UC) (2 pts).description:
The eidolon becomes adept at grappling foes, gaining the grab ability. Select one of the following attacks: bite, claw, pincers, slam, tail slap, or tentacle. Whenever the eidolon makes a successful attack of the selected type, it can attempt a free combat maneuver check. If successful, the eidolon grapples the target.

  This ability works only on creatures at least one size category smaller than the eidolon.

  Eidolons with this evolution gain a +4 bonus on combat maneuver checks to grapple.

Grand Fey Mutagen.name: Grand Fey Mutagen（Grand Fey Mutagen）
Grand Fey Mutagen.description: The alchemist閳ユ獨 fey mutagen now grants a +6 alchemical bonus to Dexterity and Charisma, a 閳? penalty to his Strength, DR 10/cold iron, and the druid閳ユ獨 woodland stride class feature. In addition, he can choose not to allow spells and effects to affect him if they would not be capable of affecting both his original creature type and the fey creature type. An alchemist must be at least 16th level and must have the greater fey mutagen discovery before selecting this discovery.

Grand Inspiring Mutagen.name: Grand Inspiring Mutagen（Grand Inspiring Mutagen）
Grand Inspiring Mutagen.description: The alchemist閳ユ獨 inspiring cognatogen now grants a +4 dodge bonus to AC and a +4 bonus to Reflex saving throws; a 閳? penalty to Strength and Constitution; and the effects of having the item lore, tenacious inspiration, and underworld inspiration investigator talents. An alchemist must be at least 16th level and have the greater inspiring cognatogen discovery to select this discovery.

Grand Rasugen.name: Grand Rasugen（Grand Rasugen）
Grand Rasugen.description:
The alchemist閳ユ獨 rasugen now grants a +6 alchemical bonus on all saving throws, 4 temporary hit points per alchemist level, and immunity to disease, mind-affecting effects, and poison. The alchemist takes a 閳? penalty to Intelligence and a 閳? penalty to Charisma and Wisdom as long as the grand rasugen persists.

  An alchemist must be at least 16th level and have the greater rasugen discovery before selecting this discovery.

Grappling Infusion.name: 擒獲注能（Grappling Infusion）
Grappling Infusion.description:
元素：通用；類別：性質注能；等級：5；超載：3

  關聯念襲類別：任意

  豁免：無

  你的雲形（cloud）、死地（deadly earth）、或築牆（wall）念襲會長出觸手固定住你的敵人。每當一個生物由於注能念襲而受到傷害時，你能夠嘗試一次戰技檢定來讓念襲擒抱該名敵人。你在此次檢定中的加值等同於2 + 你的操念使等級 + 你的體質調整值（念襲被視為超大型生物）。念襲僅會擒抱敵人；它無法執行擒抱戰技中的其他共用，比如壓制或移動目標。若念襲已經擒抱住一個敵人，那麼它能夠如常在維持擒抱的戰技檢定中獲得+5加值。你只有在使用雲形（cloud）、死地（deadly earth）、或築牆（wall）這三種塑形注能時使用擒獲注能。

Grasping Chains.name: Grasping Chains（Grasping Chains）
Grasping Chains.description:
At 4th level, chains cover your body and extend from your arms, grasping at the air around you and granting you a +4 bonus on Climb skill checks.

  At 9th level, this bonus increases to +8 and you gain a Climb speed equal to 1/2 your base speed.

Grasping Gloom.name: Grasping Gloom（Grasping Gloom）
Grasping Gloom.description:
The gloom creates an area equal to double its splash radius that functions as @Compendium[pf1.spells.wralcmyi4tdcai24]{黑觸手}. The effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to half the alchemist閳ユ獨 level.

  An alchemist must be at least 8th level before selecting this discovery.

Grave Touch (SOR).name: 墓穴之觸(術士)（Grave Touch (SOR)）
Grave Touch (SOR).description: 1級開始，作為標準動作，你能通過一次近戰接觸攻擊使一個活物戰慄，此效果持續每兩個術士等級1輪（至少為1）。如果你對戰慄中的生物使用此能力將導致1輪驚懼（如果該生物HD小於你的術士等級）。你能夠每天使用此能力次數為“3+魅力修正”。

Grave Touch (WIZ).name: 墓穴之觸(法師)（Grave Touch (WIZ)）
Grave Touch (WIZ).description: 作為標準動作，你能通過一次近戰接觸攻擊使一個活物戰慄，此效果持續法師等級一半的輪數（至少1輪）。如果你對戰慄中的生物使用此能力，將導致它驚懼1輪（如果該生物HD小於你的法師等級）。你每天能夠使用此能力次數為“3+智力修正”。

Gravity Control, Greater.name: Gravity Control, Greater（Gravity Control, Greater）
Gravity Control, Greater.description:
Element void; Type utility (Sp); Level 5; Burn 0
Prerequisite gravity control

  You have greater control over gravity, as per greater flame jet.

Gravity Control.name: Gravity Control（Gravity Control）
Gravity Control.description:
Element void; Type utility (Sp); Level 3; Burn 0

  You use your gravitic abilities to move yourself, as per flame jet.

Gravity Master.name: Gravity Master（Gravity Master）
Gravity Master.description:
Element void; Type utility (Sp); Level 9; Burn 0
Prerequisite gravity control, greater gravity control

  You can create areas of altered gravity. This functions as @Compendium[pf1.spells.3bdfw5f15hwcxlth]{反重力}, but you can choose for the gravity in the area to pull toward any direction (not just up).

  If you use this wild talent, any previous use of this wild talent expires immediately.

Grazing Shot.name: Grazing Shot（Grazing Shot）
Grazing Shot.description: The following rogue talent is available to drow rogues. Particularly deft rogues can strike two foes with one well-placed shot. As a standard action, a rogue with this talent can fire a hand crossbow at an enemy who is granted cover by another opponent. Make one ranged attack roll and compare the result to each opponent閳ユ獨 AC. Each hit deals 1 point of damage. Any special weapon properties or precision damage apply to only a single target, but any poison applied to the bolt affects all targets struck. An unchained rogue can select this talent.

Grease Bomb.name: Grease Bomb（Grease Bomb）
Grease Bomb.description:
When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it create a grease slick upon detonation. When a grease bomb detonates, it coats an area equal to the bomb閳ユ獨 splash radius in grease (as the @Compendium[pf1.spells.ik9u3eel5vfwrtb5]{油膩術} spell) for 1 round per level. The DC of the Reflex save to avoid falling after a failed Acrobatics check is equal to 10 + 1/2 the alchemist閳ユ獨 level + the alchemist閳ユ獨 Intelligence modifier. A grease bomb can閳ユ獩 affect items or armor.

  An alchemist must be at least 6th level before selecting this discovery.

Great Renown.name: 高級聲譽（Great Renown）
Great Renown.description: 俠客的多重身份變得更為有名，人們開始紛紛傳說他的翩翩風度（和英雄事蹟）。俠客現在可以在人口數量最多不超過5000人的地區或社群（通常相當於一個大市鎮）或是靈感人口不超過2000人（相當於小鎮）的地區或社群中建立聲譽。他通過社交身份而獲得的好處不會變化，但他在俠客身份下在威嚇技能上的加值提升到+6。俠客必須達到7級並且擁有聲譽社交天賦才能選擇本天賦。

Greater Anathema.name: Greater Anathema（Greater Anathema）
Greater Anathema.description:
The ability reduction of the investigator閳ユ獨 anathemas increases to 10, and he adds DR/閳?and regeneration to the list of abilities he can lower with an anathema. In addition, when an investigator creates an anathema, he can designate a specific kind of creature (such as vampires) in addition to the creature type. When used against this specific foe, the DC of the save against the anathema is 2 higher than the component poison.

  An investigator must have the anathema investigator talent to select this talent.

Greater Chimeric Aspect.name: 高等奇美拉擬態（Greater Chimeric Aspect）
Greater Chimeric Aspect.description: 14級起，當變形者使用她的變形者擬態能力進入一個次級形態，她可以選擇至多三種擬態並同時展現三者的次級形態。

Greater Constructive Dyes.name: Greater Constructive Dyes（Greater Constructive Dyes）
Greater Constructive Dyes.description:
The alchemist expands the set of objects he can create with his constructive dyes. The alchemist can expend one additional use of his daily bombs when using his constructive dyes discovery to create objects, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.b8lt1275mz4ez4d8]{強效造物術}.

  The alchemist must be at least 10th level and have the constructive dyes and divine inks discoveries before selecting this discovery.

Greater Divine Inks.name: Greater Divine Inks（Greater Divine Inks）
Greater Divine Inks.description:
The alchemist閳ユ獨 unique dyes allow him to create lifelike images. If he expends an additional daily use of his bombs, the image he creates with the divine inks discovery also produces sound, smell, and heat, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.7rx66m98dwo18fy8]{強效幻影}.

  The alchemist must be at least 6th level and must have the divine inks and improved divine inks discoveries before selecting this discovery.

Greater Draining Gloom.name: Greater Draining Gloom（Greater Draining Gloom）
Greater Draining Gloom.description:
A creature struck by the gloom must succeed at a Fortitude save or gain 1d4 negative levels.

  An alchemist must be at least 12th level and must have the debilitating gloom and draining gloom discoveries before selecting this discovery.

Greater Fey Mutagen.name: Greater Fey Mutagen（Greater Fey Mutagen）
Greater Fey Mutagen.description:
The alchemist閳ユ獨 fey mutagen now grants a +4 alchemical bonus to Dexterity and Charisma, a 閳? penalty to his Strength, DR 5/ cold iron, and the druid閳ユ獨 woodland stride class feature.

  An alchemist must be at least 12th level and must have the fey mutagen discovery before selecting this discovery.

Greater Fire Steed.name: Greater Fire Steed（Greater Fire Steed）
Greater Fire Steed.description:
Element fire; Type utility (Sp); Level 8; Burn 0
Prerequisite fire steed, improved fire steed

  When using fire steed, the mount gains immunity to fire and its speed increases by an additional 10 feet. In addition, when the mount takes a run action, it can run up steep slopes at its normal speed and down steep slopes without its rider needing to attempt a Ride check.

Greater Gift of Consumption.name: Greater Gift of Consumption（Greater Gift of Consumption）
Greater Gift of Consumption.description:
The witch can more effectively redirect effects to her proxy chosen by the gift of consumption hex. When the witch succeeds at her Fortitude save against an effect that she has redirected to a proxy, the hexed creature takes a 閳? penalty on its Fortitude save against the redirected effect. If the witch ever fails a Fortitude save or intentionally exposes herself to an effect that requires a Fortitude save, such as by ingesting a poison, she can redirect that effect to affect only the hexed creature, though the hexed creature can still attempt a saving throw to resist the effects. Once she has redirected an effect to another creature in this way, that creature cannot be affected by the gift of consumption hex again for 24 hours.

  The witch must have the gift of consumption hex to select this hex.

Greater Gloom Magic.name: Greater Gloom Magic（Greater Gloom Magic）
Greater Gloom Magic.description: A rogue with this talent gains the ability to cast deeper darkness once each day as a spell-like ability. The darkness created by this ability does not impair the rogue閳ユ獨 vision. The caster level for this ability is equal to the rogue閳ユ獨 level. A rogue must have an Intelligence score of at least 13 and the gloom magic and minor magic rogue talents before choosing this talent.

Greater Ki Venom.name: Greater Ki Venom（Greater Ki Venom）
Greater Ki Venom.description:
A ninja with this trick can further improve her ki venom. The ninja can spend 2 ki points to increase the damage die to a d8 or spend 2 ki points to change the ability damage dealt to Constitution damage.

  The ninja must have the ki venom ninja trick before selecting this trick.

Greater Mask Misery.name: 掩飾災厄（Greater Mask Misery）
Greater Mask Misery.description: 這項詭計就如同掩飾苦難（Mask Misery）一般，不過它還能用於忽略高級狀態（Greater Conditions）。催眠師必須已經選取了掩飾苦難催眠師詭計，才能夠選取掩飾災厄。

Greater Plague Bomb.name: Greater Plague Bomb（Greater Plague Bomb）
Greater Plague Bomb.description: The effects of the smoke created by an alchemist閳ユ獨 bomb duplicates the effects of @Compendium[pf1.spells.hv1vqeuh5eji28rz]{Contagion, Greater} instead of @Compendium[pf1.spells.g33euis7yi9pwddy]{雲霧術}, filling an area equal to twice the bomb閳ユ獨 splash radius for 1 round per level. An alchemist must be at least 16th level and must possess the plague bomb and smoke bomb discoveries before selecting this discovery.

Greater Rasugen.name: Greater Rasugen（Greater Rasugen）
Greater Rasugen.description:
The alchemist閳ユ獨 rasugen now grants a +4 alchemical bonus on all saving throws, 3 temporary hit points per alchemist level, and immunity to mindaffecting effects. The alchemist takes a 閳? penalty to Intelligence as long as the greater rasugen persists.

  An alchemist must be at least 12th level and able to brew a rasugen before selecting this discovery.

Greater Spirit Channeling.name: Greater Spirit Channeling（Greater Spirit Channeling）
Greater Spirit Channeling.description: At 13th level, when you open your body to a wandering spirit, you also gain that wandering spirit閳ユ獨 greater spirit ability as long as you are in a metamorphosed form.

Greater Spiritual Interference.name: 高等魅影加護（Greater Spiritual Interference）
Greater Spiritual Interference.description: 在12級時，每當喚魂師的盟友處於他以靈質態顯形的魅影的觸及範圍內時，這些盟友都可以在自己的防禦等級上獲得+2盾牌加值，在所有的豁免檢定上獲得+2環境加值，並且喚魂師從魅影加護能力受到的加值提升到+4。當魅影被擒抱，無助或失去意識時喚魂師也會失去這些加值。每當喚魂師的盟友處於他以虛靈態顯形的魅影周圍30尺範圍之內時，這些還會在對抗影響心靈的效果時在所有的豁免檢定上獲得+2環境加值，並且喚魂師從魅影加護能力受到的加值提升到+4。這個加值屬於超自然能力並會在魅影失去意識時同時失去。

Greed Subdomain.name: Greed Subdomain（Greed Subdomain）
Greed Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.g17ayjso7j8s8l2l]{Masterwork Transformation}
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.8z4tlk1fojr9t9yb]{銅牆鐵壁}
  • 8環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.wniqskqkk0cubu9u]{創造半位面}

Green Tongue, Greater.name: Green Tongue, Greater（Green Tongue, Greater）
Green Tongue, Greater.description:
Element wood; Type utility (Su); Level 7; Burn 0
Prerequisite green tongue

  You can spend 10 minutes in any outdoor location that would be valid for commune with nature in order to contact and chat with fey and leshy spirits, allowing you to gain three pieces of information as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.icjrw9y6pa1uatlz]{問道自然}.

Green Tongue.name: Green Tongue（Green Tongue）
Green Tongue.description: The rogue gains Aklo, Aquan, Auran, Giant, Ignan, Sylvan, or Terran as a bonus language. In addition, the rogue can attempt a DC 15 Linguistics check to communicate basic concepts with magical beasts and monstrous humanoids with which she does not share a common language.

Greensight.name: Greensight（Greensight）
Greensight.description:
Element wood; Type utility (Su); Level 4; Burn 0

  You can see through plant material as if you had greensight as per the universal monster rule with a range of 60 feet.

Grig Jig.name: Grig Jig（Grig Jig）
Grig Jig.description: Once per day, the rogue can weave a bit of old Varisian magic into her footwork, dancing with an infectious passion that compels another nearby to join in. The rogue can target one humanoid within 30 feet and attempt a Perform (dance) check as a full-round action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity. Her target must succeed at a Will save (DC equal to the rogue閳ユ獨 Perform [dance] check) or it begins to dance uncontrollably. So long as the rogue continues to spend a full-round action dancing each round, the affected target does so as well. If the target is attacked or otherwise in immediate danger while dancing, the effect ends. Each round on its turn, the target can attempt an Acrobatics or Perform (dance) check or a Will save (target閳ユ獨 choice) against the rogue閳ユ獨 Perform (dance) check to end the effect. A target who resists the jig can not be affected by the same rogue閳ユ獨 jig for 24 hours. The grig jig is a mind-affecting effect. The rogue must have an Intelligence score of at least 12 to select this talent. A rogue can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day for every 5 rogue levels she possesses.

Grit (GUN).name: 勇毅(銃士)（Grit (GUN)）
Grit (GUN).description:
銃士用英勇行為在世界上留下印記。一些銃士聲稱她們屬於某種槍械的神秘之道，但更可能的是火器那不穩定且危險的天性簡單地削減了她們的不幸和疏忽。不管如何，所有銃士都擁有勇毅能力。用遊戲術語而言，勇毅值是一個表示銃士在戰鬥中完成驚人動作的能力的指標。在每天開始時，銃士在勇毅值上獲得等於其感知修正的點數（至少為1）。勇毅值在一天當中不停上下浮動，但一般不能高於銃士的感知修正（至少為1），不過一些專長和魔法物品可能會影響這一最大值。銃士花費勇毅值來完成炫技（見下文），並通過下述方式恢復勇毅值。

  火器重擊（Critical Hit with a Firearm）：每當銃士在白熱化戰鬥中使用火器重擊併成功確認時，她恢復1點勇毅值。對無助或無知覺的生物、或對生命骰數低於銃士人物等級一半的生物造成重擊，並不會恢復勇毅值。

  一槍致命（Killing Blow with a Firearm）：每當銃士在白熱化戰鬥中使用火器將一個生物的生命值降至0或更低時，她恢復1點勇毅值。破壞一個目標或其他無主物品，擊殺無助、無知覺、或者生命骰數低於銃士人物等級一半的生物，並不會恢復勇毅值。

Grit (ROG).name: Grit (ROG)（Grit (ROG)）
Grit (ROG).description: A rogue with this talent gains the Amateur Gunslinger feat and one grit feat of her choice. She must fulfill the prerequisites of the grit feat in order to choose it. A rogue must have the firearm training talent before choosing this one.

Ground Breaker, Greater.name: Ground Breaker, Greater（Ground Breaker, Greater）
Ground Breaker, Greater.description:
When using the ground breaker rage power, the barbarian can extend the radius of the effect by 5 feet. This rage power can be selected up to three times, and its effects stack.

  A barbarian must have the ground breaker rage power and be at least 8th level before selecting this rage power.

Grounding Goo.name: Grounding Goo（Grounding Goo）
Grounding Goo.description: The alchemist閳ユ獨 bomb applies a sticky residue after any damage from the bomb is resolved. If a creature damaged by the bomb has a nonmagical fly speed, its flight is severely impaired, and it takes a penalty equal to the alchemist閳ユ獨 level on Fly checks for 1 minute.

Guarded Life, Greater.name: Guarded Life, Greater（Guarded Life, Greater）
Guarded Life, Greater.description:
When using the guarded life rage power, 1 additional hit point of lethal damage per barbarian level is converted to nonlethal damage.

  A barbarian must have the guarded life rage power and be at least 6th level before selecting this rage power.

Guardian Spirit.name: Guardian Spirit（Guardian Spirit）
Guardian Spirit.description:
A guardian spirit is an exemplar of protection and defense.

  
Spirit Bonus: When you channel a guardian, your spirit bonus applies to AC and on Constitution checks, Fortitude saves, and Reflex saves.

  Seance Boon: You gain a +1 bonus to CMD.

  Favored Locations: City walls, forts, gates, keeps.

  Influence Penalty: You are incredibly cautious and guarded in all things, and your caution sometimes gets in the way. When attacking, you always fight defensively, and when casting a spell, you always cast defensively. Because of your focus on defense, you take a penalty on damage rolls equal to your spirit bonus.

  Taboos: Choose one: you must always protect others from danger when you can (including defeated enemies, but not enemies that are an active threat to you and others); you must keep your body in fit physical condition, and you break this taboo every time you drop below half your maximum hit points; you must speak no words and use no abilities with the sonic descriptor, and you break this taboo if you become enraged, frightened, or panicked.

Guardian of the North.name: Guardian of the North（Guardian of the North）
Guardian of the North.description:
As a standard action, the shaman assumes the form, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.br37848gchetel0q]{野獸形態 IV}, of one of the following animals: dire bear, dire tiger, mastodon, or woolly rhinoceros.

  The duration of this transformation is 1 hour per level.

  The shaman can use this ability once per day.

Guardian of the Tribe.name: Guardian of the Tribe（Guardian of the Tribe）
Guardian of the Tribe.description: The shaman can cast a harmless spell with a range of touch on a member of her tribal bond as long as that creature is within 30 feet. The shaman can use this ability a number of times per day equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1). In addition, she is constantly aware of the condition of all members of her tribal bond ability, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.4ya1fs9tyvsqnwqx]{關照術}.

Guardian's Shield.name: Guardian's Shield（Guardian's Shield）
Guardian's Shield.description: You gain proficiency in heavy armors and shields (including tower shields).

Guided Eyes.name: Guided Eyes（Guided Eyes）
Guided Eyes.description:
Perception is always a class skill for you. In addition, whenever you make a skill check to see through a disguise or find something that is hidden or concealed, you gain a +4 sacred bonus on the check.

  This power replaces the Sun's Blessing power of the Sun Domain.

Guise of Life.name: Guise of Life（Guise of Life）
Guise of Life.description:
An undead vigilante with this talent gains an additional social identity in the form of one living creature identical to the vigilante閳ユ獨 appearance in life. Successful Knowledge checks reveal information about the vigilante as if he were a living creature, and he counts as living for the purpose of divination spells and effects. He gains no other benefit from appearing to be a living creature, and remains vulnerable to positive energy and spells that effect undead.

  The vigilante must be a corporeal undead creature to select this talent. Humanoid vigilantes with the negative energy affinity racial trait can also select this talent, gaining a human social identity.

Guise of Unlife.name: Guise of Unlife（Guise of Unlife）
Guise of Unlife.description:
A vigilante with this talent gains an additional social identity in the form of an undead version of one of his existing social identities, such as a ghoul, vampire, or zombie. Successful Knowledge checks reveal information about the vigilante as if he were undead, and he counts as undead for the purpose of divination spells and effects. He gains no other benefit from appearing to be an undead creature, and remains vulnerable to negative energy and spells that effect the living.

  The vigilante must be a living creature to select this talent.

Gusting Infusion.name: 疾風注能（Gusting Infusion）
Gusting Infusion.description:
元素：氣；類別：性質注能；等級：1；超載：1

  關聯念襲類別：突風，風捲雪，沙塵暴，風雷擊

  豁免：強韌，通過則無效

  經過你注能的氣流能夠讓念襲如同持續時間立即（instantaneous）的造風術（Gust of Wind）一般生效。如果你的念襲具有明確的路徑，那麼你能夠承受2點額外的超載或者將念襲的傷害降至0點，來使得造風術的效果在這條路徑上維持1輪。

Hag Bloodrager Bloodline.name: Hag Bloodrager Bloodline（Hag Bloodrager Bloodline）
Hag Bloodrager Bloodline.description:
Hags interbreed with other races frequently, and those children who escape their grasp may pass their heritage on to later generations before it reemerges. The potent humors that accompany hag blood are better suited to a bloodrager閳ユ獨 ferocity than to traditional spellcasting.

獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.pmAO1Sni8xx71pLF]{盲斗}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.SUACufUXl12sUvnQ]{詐欺師}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.fVRnBIHR4Jq6btvm]{強韌加強}
  • Improved Natural Attack,
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.O0jbkTJcIji9BNiF]{威逼}
  • Mother閳ユ獨 Gift.

  獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.to1cdmyh5rtfyg2s]{寒冷之觸} (7th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.k7cf5gshkp8xxqux]{目盲/耳聾術} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lsboosfk26m0ycqv]{降咒} (13th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.smbkd2yobhshbpqf]{魅惑怪物} (16th)

Hag Fortitude.name: Hag Fortitude（Hag Fortitude）
Hag Fortitude.description:
At 4th level, you become immune to mundane and magical diseases.

  At 8th level, you also become immune to poison.

Hag Transformation.name: Hag Transformation（Hag Transformation）
Hag Transformation.description:
At 12th level, your form grows more twisted and powerful while bloodraging, but clumsy, blind aggression clouds your mind. Your morale bonus to Strength increases by 2, and you gain low-light vision and darkvision (60 feet), but you take a 閳? penalty to both Dexterity and Wisdom for the duration of your bloodrage.

  At 16th level, you apply your morale bonus on Will saving throws while bloodraging to Fortitude and Reflex saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities.

Hag-Called Discipline.name: Hag-Called Discipline（Hag-Called Discipline）
Hag-Called Discipline.description:
A hag閳ユ獨 call echoes through your mind like a siren閳ユ獨 song, enticing you to surrender and become something horrible. Even after you閳ユ獫e resisted the call or even killed your hag mother, those echoes remain, shaping your mind into something else and telling you who you were meant to be. While you閳ユ獧e almost certainly a changeling, you might be a latent psychic who came into accidental psychic contact with a hag閳ユ獨 call through a changeling associate, or your dreams might have long been infested by a night hag閳ユ獨 machinations.

精神力池屬性 魅力

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wjdhmfdgwrevax3w]{凶兆} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.v3d3lnjj7ks0ztii]{注目術} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lsboosfk26m0ycqv]{降咒} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.smbkd2yobhshbpqf]{魅惑怪物} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.w2yf0ksu14e91uae]{三相} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.fxwycv6d7xwzua4t]{隱匿之紗} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.578t0lra5ll3aifs]{操控天氣} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.xmkvpl56appk20cl]{錮魂術} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.66s5qm8kwycgobce]{支配怪物} (18th).

Hairpin Trick.name: Hairpin Trick（Hairpin Trick）
Hairpin Trick.description: The rogue is skilled at making do with anything she can find. She takes no penalty on Disable Device checks for using improvised tools, and can attempt such checks without any tools at a 閳? penalty. She treats all non-improvised thieves閳?tools as masterwork and doubles the bonus she gets from masterwork thieves閳?tools from +2 to +4.

Hallucinogenic Aura.name: 致幻靈光（Hallucinogenic Aura）
Hallucinogenic Aura.description: 13級起，一個精神力場從你體內輻射開來，碰觸周圍生物的意識。任何距你30尺以內的生物必須成功進行一次意志豁免，否則會困惑（confused）1d4輪。成功豁免該效果的生物會在接下來的24小時內免疫你的致幻靈光。而豁免失敗的生物在處於因為此靈光而受到的困惑狀態時，不需要繼續進行豁免，而且一旦困惑狀態結束，也會在24小時內免疫該靈光。這是個影響心靈（mind-affecting）的效果。你自己以及其他異能者也免疫致幻靈光。你能夠製作一種解藥，來讓飲用者可以免受你的靈光影響。製作一劑解藥需要1小時的時間，還需要成功通過DC 15的工藝（鍊金術）檢定。一劑解藥的效果能夠持續一個月。

Hamstring Strike.name: Hamstring Strike（Hamstring Strike）
Hamstring Strike.description: Anytime a rogue with this talent successfully hits an opponent with a sneak attack, she may forgo her sneak attack damage to try to hamstring her opponent. If the attack succeeds, the rogue deals weapon damage as normal, but instead of the rogue dealing sneak attack damage, the target is knocked prone and is unable to take move actions during its next turn. A successful Fortitude save (DC = 10 + 1/2 the rogue閳ユ獨 level + the rogue閳ユ獨 Dexterity modifier) negates this effect.

Hardened Fists.name: Hardened Fists（Hardened Fists）
Hardened Fists.description: At 1st level, you can make your fists grow large, callused, and gnarled as a free action. Your unarmed strikes deal damage as though you were one size category larger, deal lethal damage, and do not provoke attacks of opportunity. If you have claws, they are affected instead, and they deal damage as though you were one size category larger. You can use this ability for a number of rounds per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

Harrow Bloodline.name: Harrow Bloodline（Harrow Bloodline）
Harrow Bloodline.description:
Just as knowledge of the harrow has passed from generation to generation since time immemorial, so too has a deep spiritual connection to the otherworldly forces bound by the harrow passed through the ages. Your connection to the mysterious deck grants you magical power over the cards of the harrow, visions of the future, and the ability to call down ephemeral forces.

  本職技能: @JournalEntry[dfjwbMEdt062TJtE]{知識}：歷史.

  獎勵法術:

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wjdhmfdgwrevax3w]{凶兆} (3rd),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.d1wxnax51cecplm4]{占卜術} (5th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.hpdynlxhfnop2wm4]{Harrowing} (7th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ed7fvzc2p4m6n7a2]{幽影咒法術} (9th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.68ngvzmzvadhf6vs]{異界探知} (11th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.b5mz8voksps5g4yq]{通曉傳奇} (13th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ew8hm1fndppz1ezx]{Harrowing, Greater} (15th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.2vb5orfcy57lrfmc]{片刻預知} (17th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.3wdx7fjulsohi1lk]{怪影殺手} (19th).

  獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Q1cY8r0Pvb66pMG0]{警覺},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.tD76K8QGco9scT0r]{制造奇物},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.btXWioB3SKJv8YEG]{法術延時}, 
  • Fortune Teller, 
  • Harrowed, 
  • Mage閳ユ獨 Tattoo,
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.7zJTztNW7hdaqjKc]{技能專攻} (知識：歷史).

血統奧秘: Whenever you cast a divination spell that requires a percentage roll, add 5 to the result of your roll. In addition, you can roll the percentage dice twice and use the result you prefer. Your maximum percentage chance of receiving a meaningful and accurate reply for divination spells is 100%, instead of the usual 90%.

Harrow Strike.name: Harrow Strike（Harrow Strike）
Harrow Strike.description: Once per day while making a sneak attack against a creature, you can draw a random card from a harrow deck you own. If your attack hits, instead of dealing sneak attack damage as normal, you deal a number of points of ability damage equal to your number of sneak attack dice. The ability score damaged is the score affiliated with the suit of the harrow card drawn. You can use this ability an additional time per day at 15th level and 20th level.

Harrowed Home.name: Harrowed Home（Harrowed Home）
Harrowed Home.description: At 15th level, your otherworldly connection is so strong that your subconscious cleaves off a small portion of the Harrowed Realm for use as your own private sanctuary. Your harrowed home is created the first time you use this ability, and is decorated as a garish reflection of your personality. Thereafter, you always visit this same home. You can place a portal to your harrowed home once every 24 hours, but placing a new portal destroys the previous one, and you can not move the entrance while you are inside. As long as you are not in your harrowed home, time ceases to pass for anything and anyone still in your pocket dimension; creatures cannot move, objects do not decay, and everything remains exactly the same as you left it the last time you visited the plane. Time continues as normal whenever you are inside your harrowed home. This ability is otherwise identical to @Compendium[pf1.spells.kqftgm3bi2dqj92l]{法師豪宅}.

Harrowing Curse.name: Harrowing Curse（Harrowing Curse）
Harrowing Curse.description:
The witch can curse a target creature by touching it with a card randomly drawn from a harrow deck she owns. The target is affected as if by the spell @Compendium[pf1.spells.lsboosfk26m0ycqv]{降咒} using the witch閳ユ獨 caster level, except that the witch can decrease only the ability score that corresponds to the suit of the card drawn. Whether or not the save is successful, a creature cannot be targeted by this hex more than once in 24 hours.

  At 15th level, this hex acts as a major curse spell (Pathfinder RPG Ultimate Magic 215).

  A witch with the cartomancer archetype can combine this hex with her spell deck閳ユ獨 deliver touch spell ability.

Harsh Judgement.name: Harsh Judgement（Harsh Judgement）
Harsh Judgement.description:
A vigilante with this talent can pronounce judgment upon his foes as per the inquisitor class feature (see page 38 of the Pathfinder RPG Advanced Player閳ユ獨 Guide). He can choose from among the following inquisitor judgments: destruction, piercing, purity, and smiting. For the purpose of determining the bonuses provided by this ability, the vigilante閳ユ獨 level stacks with levels in any other classes that grant judgment or harsh judgment. The vigilante can use this ability once per day plus an additional time per day at 4th level and every 3 levels thereafter (up to a maximum of seven times per day at 19th level).

  Only a vigilante with the Zealot archetype can select this talent.

Hateful Aura.name: Hateful Aura（Hateful Aura）
Hateful Aura.description:
At 8th level, you can emit a 30-foot aura of hatred for a number of rounds per day equal to your cleric level. These rounds need not be consecutive. Enemies within this aura must attempt a Will save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier). Characters who fail their save are filled with hatred, and cannot consider other characters allies for the purpose of any actions or use any teamwork feats. The effect ends immediately if the creature leaves the aura, you end the aura as a free action, or you expend all rounds of this ability.

  This power replaces the Destructive Aura power of the Destruction Domain.

Hatred Subdomain.name: Hatred Subdomain（Hatred Subdomain）
Hatred Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.jdj4sfwksjgy2mqf]{Murderous Command}
  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.1gz3zdpxu7uic5ky]{狂怒斗篷}

Haunt Channeler.name: 制祟者（Haunt Channeler）
Haunt Channeler.description: 在3級時，通靈者已經足夠熟悉精魂存在，以至於他可以自然地解決作祟靈。在對抗作祟時，通靈者總是可以在突襲輪中行動，並且他的接觸足以將一部分作祟消化掉——對作祟造成每兩個通靈者等級1d6點傷害，如同正能量攻擊的效果；通靈者還可以詢問作祟一個問題，但是作祟可以自由選擇回答的方式。最後，通靈者還可以放棄自己對抗作祟效果的豁免檢定，把作祟整個吸入體內。如果通靈者這樣做，他本人承受作祟的效果，但其他應該被影響的生物則不會受到作祟影響，並且作祟會在24小時內控制通靈者的身體。此時每分鐘一次，通靈者可以嘗試通過一個成功的意志檢定（DC=20+通靈者等級的一半）擺脫作祟的控制。

Haunted Discipline.name: Haunted Discipline（Haunted Discipline）
Haunted Discipline.description:
You attract the attention of spirits as naturally as a lodestone attracts iron filings. Testing your power leads you to develop some control over undead forces, despite the inherent defenses such creatures have against psychic abilities. Meanwhile, those spirits clinging to your life essence become increasingly protective, channeling their abilities to aid you and warn of threats. Psychics of this discipline are most common in Ustalav and Shenmen, where so many spirits are stuck in the transition between life and death.

精神力池屬性 魅力

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.aa0w7tk852iqn3ni]{偵測死靈} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.y4ztvvswf2uuwuqo]{Calm Spirit} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.f98kluovmjf6w7d5]{死靈定身術} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ykb7nby9eovw8jyo]{Speak With Haunt} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wr96kbh0sqxecx63]{毀滅武器} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lllhr9py6w44cxjm]{亡靈歸亡} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.btccs4sjo2nog1a0]{幻化靈體} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.0j2cb0iv0695a45i]{Possession, Greater} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.gw9bes9othfqm7mi]{同游靈界} (18th).

Head (2 pts).name: Head (2 pts)（Head (2 pts)）
Head (2 pts).description:
An eidolon grows an additional head. The eidolon does not gain any additional natural attacks for the additional head, but the additional head does allow the eidolon to take other evolutions that add an additional attack to a head (such as a bite, gore, or breath weapon).

  This evolution can be selected more than once.

Heads Up.name: Heads Up（Heads Up）
Heads Up.description: When you make a Perception check, as an immediate or swift action you can allow one adjacent ally to act as if they had also made a Perception check with the same result.

Healing Bomb.name: Healing Bomb（Healing Bomb）
Healing Bomb.description: When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it heal damage instead of dealing it. Creating a healing bomb requires the alchemist to expend an infused extract or potion containing a cure spell. A creature that takes a direct hit from a healing bomb is healed as if she had imbibed the infusion or potion used to create the bomb. Creatures in the splash radius are healed for the minimum amount of damage the cure spell is capable of healing. A healing bomb damages undead instead of healing them.

Healing Burst.name: Healing Burst（Healing Burst）
Healing Burst.description:
Element aether, void, water, wood; Type utility (Sp); Level 4; Burn 1
Prerequisite kinetic healer or void healer
Saving Throw none; SR yes

  You use kinetic healer or void healer (whichever you have, or either if you have both) to heal all creatures in a 30-foot radius around you. Healing burst heals half as much damage as normal, unless your healing amount is based on positive blast, in which case it heals the full amount. Unlike kinetic healer, you must accept the burn yourself. This counts as kinetic healer for the purpose of the kinetic chirurgeon archetype (the 17th-level metahealer ability heals the kinetic chirurgeon twice閳ユ攼nce for half and once for full).

Healing Fire.name: Healing Fire（Healing Fire）
Healing Fire.description: At 15th level, you can channel energy twice per day as a cleric of half your level. Instead of using this ability to damage undead, you can convert the positive energy to flame and deal an equivalent amount of fire damage instead.

Healing Hex.name: Healing Hex（Healing Hex）
Healing Hex.description:
A witch can soothe the wounds of those she touches. This acts as a @Compendium[pf1.spells.xoc3vhg3btmfjauq]{治療輕傷} spell, using the witch's caster level.

  Once a creature has benefited from the healing hex, it cannot benefit from it again for 24 hours.

  At 5th level, this hex acts like @Compendium[pf1.spells.e67esdjp4nojtbr7]{治療中度傷}.

Heart of Fire.name: Heart of Fire（Heart of Fire）
Heart of Fire.description:
At 4th level, you gain fire resistance 5. Whenever you are subjected to a magical healing effect from a cure spell, you regain 1 additional hit point per die rolled.

  At 8th level, your fire resistance increases to 10, and you regain 2 additional hit points per die rolled when you are healed by a cure spell.

Heart's Desire.name: Heart's Desire（Heart's Desire）
Heart's Desire.description: At 8th level, you receive divine guidance on the goals of your political allies and rivals. Once per day, you can use @Compendium[pf1.spells.p2kosvizylhy8vfa]{通神術} as a spell-like ability using your inquisitor level as your caster level, but only to ask questions about others閳?goals.

Heat Adaptation.name: 適應高溫（Heat Adaptation）
Heat Adaptation.description:
元素：火或水；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：1；超載：0

  你會持續性地收到忍受環境（endure elements）的保護，不過僅限用於對抗高溫（hot temperatures）。你會獲得一定數量的火焰抗力，具體數值等同於目前超載數值的兩倍。

Heat Wave.name: 熱浪（Heat Wave）
Heat Wave.description:
元素：火；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：3；超載：1

  前置：適應高溫（heat adaptation），炎之血肉（searing flesh）

  你創造出發光發熱的靈光，這會扭曲你周圍的空氣。直至你所承受的超載得以移除為止，你能夠以迅捷動作開啟或終止熱浪靈光。你周圍30尺內的溫度得到提升，提升的數量為每個操念使等級5華氏度，最高把溫度提升至120華氏度。若你將溫度至少提高到90華氏度；所有距離你5尺內的生物做出的攻擊都會由於隱蔽（concealment）而承受20%的失手率。你自己免疫這些效果，免疫火焰（immune to fire）或者受到忍受環境（Endure Elements）的好處的生物也免疫該效果。

Heavy Training.name: 重裝訓練（Heavy Training）
Heavy Training.description: 如果俠客尚未擅長重甲的話，那麼俠客獲得擅長重甲作為獎勵專長，同時如果他擁有著甲如膚俠客天賦的話這個天賦的效果也能影響重甲。在16級時，如果俠客擁有著甲如膚天賦，那麼他的移動速度不再因為穿戴重甲而降低。只有選擇復仇騎士之道的俠客才可以選擇本天賦。

Hellbound Curse.name: Hellbound Curse（Hellbound Curse）
Hellbound Curse.description:
Infernal influence grants you profane insight and weighs on your soul. You cannot cast spells with the good or chaotic descriptors, and you can閳ユ獩 summon good or chaotic creatures. Good and chaotic creatures instinctively distrust you, and you take a 閳? penalty on all Diplomacy checks against such creatures. You gain a +2 bonus on all Bluff and Intimidate checks.

  At 5th level, you gain a +4 bonus to all saving throws against charm effects.

  At 10th level, you gain immunity to fire.

  At 15th level, any weapon you wield is treated as lawful and evil for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction.

Hellfire Bomb.name: Hellfire Bomb（Hellfire Bomb）
Hellfire Bomb.description:
This discovery is available to tiefling alchemists.

  When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can have it act as an explosive bomb, but deal half of its damage as fire damage and half as unholy damage that is not subject to fire resistance or immunity. An alchemist must be at least 9th level and have the explosive bomb discovery before selecting this discovery.

Hellfire Ray.name: Hellfire Ray（Hellfire Ray）
Hellfire Ray.description: When an arcanist uses the flame arc exploit, she can spend 1 additional point from her arcane reservoir to draw the flames from Hell. If she does so, half of the damage she deals is fire, and the other half results directly from unholy power that is not subject to fire resistance. Good creatures that take damage from a hellfire ray must succeed at a Will saving throw or be sickened for 1d4 rounds.

Heralding Bloom.name: Heralding Bloom（Heralding Bloom）
Heralding Bloom.description:
A witch can compel a plant within 30 feet to spread a message, which must be 25 words or fewer and in a language the witch speaks. This message can閳ユ獩 contain verbal spell components, command words, or other magical effects. An intelligent plant that閳ユ獨 targeted can attempt a Will save to negate the effect. If the save fails, the plant is magically compelled to 閳ユ笩peak閳?this message in an audible voice, repeating it each time one or more intelligent creatures to whom the message has not yet been repeated comes within range, until 24 hours after the hex has been placed. The plant under the effect of the hex does not gain any special intelligence from this hex or gain any ability to understand the message if it does not normally understand the language the message is delivered in, and it is in no way otherwise compelled to act in any way it would not normally.

  A witch can have a number of heralding blooms active equal to her witch level + her Charisma modifier.

Herbal Antivenom.name: Herbal Antivenom（Herbal Antivenom）
Herbal Antivenom.description:
Element wood; Type utility (Sp); Level 4; Burn 0

  Your body can produce the herbal remedies necessary to counter almost any poison. You gain a +5 alchemical bonus on saving throws against poison, as if you were always under the effect of antitoxin. You can use the treat poison action from the Heal skill as a standard action with a mere touch, without a healer閳ユ獨 kit, and even on yourself; if you succeed, you grant the touched creature a +5 alchemical bonus against that specific instance of poison in addition to the normal +4 bonus from treat poison.

  You can accept 1 point of burn while using the treat poison action in this way to also produce the effects of @Compendium[pf1.spells.6l904edkt8jv9jor]{中和毒性}.

Herbal Compound.name: Herbal Compound（Herbal Compound）
Herbal Compound.description: A ninja with this trick can consume specially prepared herbs to strengthen her mind. The ninja can spend 1 ki point and smoke, eat, or inject an herbal compound as a move action. The ninja takes a 閳? penalty to AC and on Reflex saves but gains a +4 alchemical bonus on Will saves for 10 minutes per ninja level.

Hex of Lignification.name: Hex of Lignification（Hex of Lignification）
Hex of Lignification.description:
The shaman causes a creature within 30 feet to turn into a twisted, treelike shape for 2 rounds. The target gains hardness 5 but is staggered, and can negate the effect with a successful Fortitude saving throw.

  Whether or not the target succeeds at its save, it can閳ユ獩 be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.

Hidden Magic.name: Hidden Magic（Hidden Magic）
Hidden Magic.description:
You gain the Conceal Spell feat as a bonus feat without needing to meet the prerequisites.

  At 7th level, you can also hide your use of spell trigger items using the Conceal Spell feat, though onlookers receive a +2 bonus on their skill checks to pierce your subterfuge.

  At 11th level, you can even hide the use of spell completion items using the Conceal Spell feat, though in this case, onlookers receive a +5 bonus on their skill checks to pierce your subterfuge.

Hidden Mind.name: Hidden Mind（Hidden Mind）
Hidden Mind.description: A rogue with this talent uses various devious techniques, including mental exercises and dusting her clothing with a small amount of lead, to protect herself from divinations, with the same benefits as if she cast nondetection on herself with a caster level equal to her rogue level.

Hide in Plain Sight (RNG).name: 視線躲藏(遊俠)（Hide in Plain Sight (RNG)）
Hide in Plain Sight (RNG).description: 17級或更高等級的遊俠在其偏好地形中，即使在被注意時也可以使用隱匿技能。

Hide in Plain Sight (ROG).name: 視線躲藏(盜賊)（Hide in Plain Sight (ROG)）
Hide in Plain Sight (ROG).description: 擁有此能力的盜賊可以從遊俠的偏好地形中選擇一種，他成為在該種地貌中的躲藏大師。在該種地形中，他就算被注意到也能使用隱匿技能。他可以重複選擇此能力，每次需選擇不同的偏好地形。

Hide in Plain Sight (VIG).name: 視線躲藏(俠客)（Hide in Plain Sight (VIG)）
Hide in Plain Sight (VIG).description: 俠客即使在被注意到的情況下也可以進行潛行技能檢定。只要距離昏暗光照環境10尺之內，俠客就可以在沒有任何掩體可以利用的情況下隱藏自己的身形。但是他不能躲在自己的影子裡。只有達到8級並且選擇詭秘獵手之道的俠客才能選擇本天賦。

Hierophant Spirit.name: 大祭司英靈（Hierophant Spirit）
Hierophant Spirit.description:
大祭司英靈是神使的典範，以自己的虔誠引導純粹的信仰之力。

  英靈同調：每當你降靈大祭司時，你在感知檢定，基於感知的技能檢定和意志豁免檢定上獲得加值。

  降靈獎勵：你的治療法術和能力對每一個目標增加2點治療。這個能力對魔法物品以及快速治療和類似效果無效。

  偏好降靈區域：教會，聖堂，神聖森林，神社。

  共鳴懲罰：你的英靈希望敵人有機會懺悔自己曾經犯下的過錯（或是等著一個活祭品上桌），因此你必須在攻擊時選擇造成非致命傷害。除此之外，你在對其他的信仰人群進行的魅力檢定和基於魅力的技能檢定上承受相當於你的英靈同調加值數量的減值 -除了嘗試說服他人改宗以外。

  禁忌：選擇下列禁忌之一：

  -你極為尊崇自然的美好和天然的秩序，以至於棄絕金屬護甲與盾牌。

  -你必須遵守英靈信仰的聖武士或反聖武士準則。

  -你不可說謊（包括唬騙，模稜兩可似是而非，或是有意欺詐），如果一個人詢問你應該你知道答案的問題，你必須原封不動的告知他。

High Jumper.name: High Jumper（High Jumper）
High Jumper.description:
When a ninja with this trick makes a high jump, the DC for that jump is half the normal DC.

  The ninja must have the acrobatic master trick before taking this talent.

Hive Curse.name: Hive Curse（Hive Curse）
Hive Curse.description:
You were exposed at a young age (perhaps even before you were born) to the alien species known as the hive, but this exposure did not result in a full-blown infestation by these otherworldly monsters. Others (including animals) find the unsightly spines and rough growths that periodically emerge from your flesh to be disturbing and distracting, and you take a 閳? penalty on Bluff, Diplomacy, Handle Animal, and Ride checks. Once per day as a standard action, you can cough up an ovoid, leathery sphere that can be hurled as a flask of acid, though it becomes inert after 24 hours.

  At 5th level, you gain the benefits of @Compendium[pf1.spells.pau0ejk30fs1eebl]{忍受環境} in hot environments and are immune to infestations (save for those from the hive itself ).

  At 10th level, your skin deformities grow numerous enough to increase your natural armor bonus by 1.

  At 15th level, you gain acid resistance 20.

Holy Bombs.name: Holy Bombs（Holy Bombs）
Holy Bombs.description:
When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it deal good divine damage. Evil creatures that take a direct hit from a holy bomb must succeed at a Fortitude save or be staggered on their next turn. Against neutral creatures, holy bombs deal half damage, and such targets are not affected by their staggering effect. Holy bombs have no effect on good-aligned creatures.

  An alchemist must be at least 8th level before selecting this discovery.

Holy Water.name: Holy Water（Holy Water）
Holy Water.description: The arcanist can unleash a jet of holy water by expending 1 point from her arcane reservoir. This creates a 30-foot line of water that deals damage equal to 1d8 points of damage plus the arcanist閳ユ獨 Charisma modifier, plus an additional 1d8 points of damage for every 2 levels beyond 1st (to a maximum of 10d8 at 19th level) to each target in the line that would normally take damage from holy water. Creatures in the area of effect can attempt a Reflex saving throw to halve the damage.

Hooves (1 pt).name: Hooves (1 pt)（Hooves (1 pt)）
Hooves (1 pt).description:
An eidolon has a pair of sharp hooves at the end of its limbs, giving it two hoof attacks. These attacks are secondary attacks. The hooves deal 1d4 points of damage (1d6 if Large, 1d8 if Huge). The eidolon must have the limbs evolution to take this evolution. This evolution can only be applied to the limbs (legs) evolution once. Alternatively, the eidolon can replace the claws evolution from its base form with these hoof attacks (this still costs 1 evolution point).

  This evolution can be selected more than once, but the eidolon must possess an equal number of limbs evolutions.

Horrific Glimpse.name: Horrific Glimpse（Horrific Glimpse）
Horrific Glimpse.description:
Once per day, the shaman can gain the effects of @Compendium[pf1.spells.68ngvzmzvadhf6vs]{異界探知} after 1 hour of meditation. No components are required in order to use this ability, but the shaman does not get to select which plane she contacts. Instead, this version of the spell contacts an alien mind from somewhere in the Dark Tapestry, be it a hive mind of alien monstrosities, the disembodied sentience of a dead planet, or even the slumbering and insane mind of a Great Old One or Outer God. The shaman must succeed at a DC 16 Wisdom check rather than an Intelligence check to avoid a decrease in Intelligence or Charisma when using this ability. If she fails the check, her Intelligence and Charisma scores each fall to 8 for 5 weeks, as the alien minds thus contacted prove as destructive to mortal thoughts as direct contact with the most powerful of deities. The types of answers provided by the horrific glimpse, be they true answers, ignorance, lies, or random answers, are considered equal to those of a greater deity if the questions being asked concern the Material Plane, but they are equal to those of a demigod if the questions posed concern any other plane.

Also once per day (but only after first using this ability as per contact other plane), the shaman can reveal a fragment of this horrific vision to another creature, as per >phantasmal killer, except that the target takes 1d4+1 points of Wisdom damage regardless of the results of any of its saving throws. The body of a creature slain by this effect is always hideously mutilated and savaged, making spells like speak with dead useless.

Horse Aspect.name: Horse Aspect（Horse Aspect）
Horse Aspect.description:
The aspect of the horse grants speed and maneuverability. A horse閳ユ獨 alternate attack is hoof (B).

Minor Form: You gain the @Compendium[pf1.feats.ehqx8txNRGMaNOPt]{堅忍} feat as well as an enhancement bonus of +5 feet to your base speed.

  At 8th level, you gain the @Compendium[pf1.feats.bXeW4kLCErPBFpNB]{飛跑} feat. If you already have the @Compendium[pf1.feats.bXeW4kLCErPBFpNB]{飛跑} feat, you instead can run at 6 times your base speed when using the Run feat.

  At 15th level, your enhancement bonus to your base speed increases to +15.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a horse. While in this form, you gain a base speed of 50 feet, low-light vision, scent (30 feet), and the ability to move before and after an attack, as if you had the @Compendium[pf1.feats.liPAO5urMI9chctT]{騎乘掠擊} feat.

  At 8th level, you can move through threatened squares without provoking attacks of opportunity, and you gain trample, as the universal monster rule, dealing your shifter claw damage.

  At 15th level, you gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.go4xOiSUP8R1QJ5N]{精通闖越} as a bonus feat, even if you do not meet the prerequisites.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Hoof (B)

Hshurha's Veil.name: Hshurha's Veil（Hshurha's Veil）
Hshurha's Veil.description: When raging, the barbarian can use Stealth, and she gains a bonus equal to 1/2 her barbarian level on Stealth checks plus the benefits of concealment against ranged attacks and attacks of opportunity.

Hubris Subdomain.name: Hubris Subdomain（Hubris Subdomain）
Hubris Subdomain.description:
替代神授力量 You gain Intimidate as a class skill; this replaces the Glory domain閳ユ獨 increased save DC to resist channel positive energy.

  替代領域法術

  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.uv3bvuerhe0furhu]{Hollow Heroism}
  • 7環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.nyafit6oz90jqakn]{Hollow Heroism, Greater}
  • 9環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.xuuzj9lr2xbwaim4]{神威如獄}.
  • If you are evil, replace the domain spells @Compendium[pf1.spells.hl9l92qfalq6c55z]{祝福武器} and @Compendium[pf1.spells.n0vm6or4nwaylpfa]{聖潔靈光} with @Compendium[pf1.spells.ibk7jrc5rwubpia6]{援助術} and @Compendium[pf1.spells.flrn1xmm2wfrxbkf]{邪惡靈光} respectively.

Hurricane Queen.name: Hurricane Queen（Hurricane Queen）
Hurricane Queen.description:
Element air; Type utility (Su); Level 9; Burn 閳?/p>

  You are one with the hurricane. Your enveloping winds defense wild talent has an additional 25% chance of deflecting nonmagical ranged attacks, and your total deflection chance can exceed the usual cap of 75%.

  All wind and weather (including creatures using the whirlwind monster ability) affect you and your attacks only if you wish them to do so; for example, you could shoot arrows directly through a tornado without penalty.

Hypnotic Stare.name: 催眠注視（Hypnotic Stare）
Hypnotic Stare.description: 催眠師可以用迅捷動作將自己的目光聚焦在30尺內的一個生物上。使該生物在意志豁免會受到-2減值。該減值在8級時變為-3點。催眠師在同一時間只能將目光維持在一個敵人身上；該能力會一直持續到催眠師注視一個新目標、敵人死亡、敵人移動至與催眠師相距30尺之外的位置、或者催眠師昏迷（unconscious）或死亡（dies）為止。催眠師可以從目標的精神中移除受到催眠師注視的記憶；除非催眠師允許，否則目標不會記得曾經受到過該能力影響（也不會意識到自己正在被該能力影響）。催眠注視是一個異能效果（psychic effect），它在更高程度上依賴的是催眠師的意志聚焦，而非目標對受到注視產生的回應。因此無法使用通常用來對付凝視攻擊（gaze attack）的方式來應對催眠注視。催眠師甚至可以在自己目盲（blinded）時使用該能力，但必須通過DC20的專注檢定才能這麼做。注視一個生物需要催眠師保持專注，因此如果他使用凝視攻擊（gaze attack）或類似能力的話，就必須將能力的目標定為催眠注視的受術者，或者自發結束催眠注視。多個催眠師的催眠注視所帶來的減值不會疊加，該能力也不會與女巫的邪眼巫術（evil eye hexes）疊加。這是一個影響心靈（mind-affecting）的效果。

Hypothermia.name: Hypothermia（Hypothermia）
Hypothermia.description:
The shaman afflicts a creature within 30 feet with hypothermia. The target must attempt a Fortitude saving throw. On a failed save, the target is fatigued for 2 rounds.

  At 8th and 16th levels, the duration of this hex is extended by 1 round.

  Whether or not the save is successful, the creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.

Ice Path.name: 冰霜之徑（Ice Path）
Ice Path.description:
元素：水；類別：通用（Su）；等級：6；超載：0

  前置：冰行者（icewalker）

  你把空氣中的水汽凝結，讓自己可以通過在冰上行走來行進到空中，就如同使用凌空而行（Air Walk）一般，這會在你的身後留下一條冰霜之徑，但是它在融化之前僅能存在1輪。

Ice Sculptor.name: 塑冰者（ice Sculptor）
Ice Sculptor.description:
元素：水；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：4；超載：0

  你可以將冰（ice）和雪（snow）塑造成新的形狀，就如同塑石術（Stone shape）一般，不過該能力僅限於影響冰和雪，以取代影響石頭。

Ice Shape.name: Ice Shape（Ice Shape）
Ice Shape.description:
You are able to sculpt ice and snow into almost any shape. This ability functions like @Compendium[pf1.spells.g1evszmk8wfgnsv5]{塑石術}, but targeting only ice and snow, not stone.

  You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Ice Splinter.name: Ice Splinter（Ice Splinter）
Ice Splinter.description:
As a standard action, the shaman can shoot razor-sharp icicles at an enemy within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack. This barrage deals 1d6 points of piercing damage + 1 point for every 2 shaman levels she has.

  The shaman can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Charisma modifier.

  At 11th level, any weapon she wields is treated as a frost weapon.

Iceplant.name: Iceplant（Iceplant）
Iceplant.description:
This hex grants the witch and her familiar a +2 natural armor bonus and the constant effects of @Compendium[pf1.spells.pau0ejk30fs1eebl]{忍受環境}.

  The effect leaves the witch閳ユ獨 skin thick and stiff to the touch.

Iconoclastic Strike.name: Iconoclastic Strike（Iconoclastic Strike）
Iconoclastic Strike.description:
When the investigator deals damage with a studied strike, she can perform a sunder combat maneuver as a free action against the creature the studied strike damaged. If the object targeted is a holy symbol or divine scroll, this sunder does not provoke attacks of opportunity and deals maximum damage on a successful check.

  An investigator must be at least 13th level to select this talent.

Illuminating Answers.name: 啟發性解答（Illuminating Answers）
Illuminating Answers.description: 你能夠從通過魔法而獲得的訊息中提取更深層次的真理，即便這些訊息只是似是而非的語句也沒關係。當你使用法術或類法術能力，它的效果能夠讓你獲得問題的答案——比如占卜術（Augury）、血之訊息APG（Blood Biography）或異界探知（Contact Other Plane）——且至少得到了一個答案時，精神力池會恢復1點精神力。即便你得到的是錯誤或模凌兩可的答案時，也能夠恢復精神力。每日以此方式恢復的精神力數量至多等同於你的感知調整值。

Illusion Resonant School.name: 幻術靈器（Illusion Resonant School）
Illusion Resonant School.description:
幻術靈器讓秘學士扭曲感官阻礙觀察。

  靈器（Implements）：水晶、帽子、面具、稜鏡、戒指。

Imagination Subdomain.name: Imagination Subdomain（Imagination Subdomain）
Imagination Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.kq916lznxo0ig68v]{無聲幻影}
  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.27o3msobhyghmfid]{弱效幻影}
  • 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.7rx66m98dwo18fy8]{強效幻影}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ifcnx1yyw6e7ousm]{託夢術}

Immediate Change.name: 飛速變裝（Immediate Change）
Immediate Change.description: 俠客現在只需要通過一個移動動作就可以轉換身份，他也無需花費額外的時間去調整角色和打扮。俠客必須達到13級並且擁有快速變裝社交天賦才能選擇本天賦。

Immolation.name: Immolation（Immolation）
Immolation.description:
At 3rd level, you gain the ability to surround yourself in fire as a swift action. This fire burns for a number of rounds per day equal to your character level plus your Charisma bonus. These rounds do not have to be consecutive.

  Any unarmed attacks you make while affected by immolation deal an additional 1d6 points of fire damage, and any creature that ends its turn adjacent to you while you閳ユ獧e affected by immolation also takes 1d6 points of fire damage.

Immunity (2 pts).name: Immunity (2 pts)（Immunity (2 pts)）
Immunity (2 pts).description:
An eidolon's body becomes extremely resilient to one energy type, gaining immunity to that type. Pick one energy type: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. The eidolon gains immunity to that energy type.

  This evolution can be selected more than once. Its effects do not stack. Each time it applies to a different energy type.

  The summoner must be at least 7th level before selecting this evolution.

Immunity (UC) (2 pts).name: Immunity (UC) (2 pts)（Immunity (UC) (2 pts)）
Immunity (UC) (2 pts).description:
Requirements: Summoner level 7th.

  The eidolon閳ユ獨 body becomes extremely resilient to one energy type. Select one energy type: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. The eidolon gains immunity to that energy type.

  This evolution can be selected more than once. Its effects do not stack. Each time it applies to a different energy type.

Imp Familiar.name: Imp Familiar（Imp Familiar）
Imp Familiar.description: At 7th level, you gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.oRJlgRLS32fmoQpy]{進階魔寵} as a bonus feat, and must take an imp as a familiar. The imp replaces your current familiar.

Impale Infusion.name: 貫通（Impale Infusion）
Impale Infusion.description:
元素：土或水；類別：塑形注能；等級：3；超載：2

  關聯念襲類別：巖擊，冰槍，轟鋼

  豁免：無

  你將元素物質延伸為長而尖銳的釘狀形態，並用它沿著一條線貫穿數名敵人。進行單次攻擊檢定對抗30尺線形區域內的每個生物或物體，以最近的目標開始。若結果為重擊威脅，則僅對第一個被你命中的目標進行重擊確認。計算每個被你命中的目標所受到的傷害，從距離你最近的目標開始。若你的攻擊命中目標，但是無法對目標造成物理傷害（physical damage），那麼尖刺便無法繼續貫穿敵人，注能念襲無法繼續生效。由貫通注能加強的念襲能夠穿透固體障礙（penetrate solid barriers），但是它必須造成足夠的傷害來摧毀障礙才能繼續前進。受到注能的巖擊（Earth Blast）和轟鋼（Metal Blast）總是會造成穿刺傷害。

Impelling Disarm.name: Impelling Disarm（Impelling Disarm）
Impelling Disarm.description:
Once per rage, the barbarian can make a disarm attempt against a target in place of a melee attack. This attempt does not provoke attacks of opportunity. If successful, the barbarian sends the target閳ユ獨 weapon flying閳ユ攨ither straight at the target, or spinning away to strike another foe up to 20 feet away. This ranged attack counts as throwing a weapon that isn閳ユ獩 designed to be thrown, even if the weapon disarmed is a thrown weapon. The barbarian makes a ranged attack, which doesn閳ユ獩 provoke attacks of opportunity, at either the target of his disarm maneuver or another creature within 20 feet. If the barbarian is aiming for the disarmed creature, the foe doesn閳ユ獩 count as being in melee for determining any penalty on the ranged attack from throwing a ranged weapon into melee. If the ranged attack hits, the disarmed weapon deals damage as if the barbarian had thrown it. The barbarian can choose to aim the disarmed weapon at a square rather than at a foe.

  A barbarian must be at least 4th level to select this rage power.

Implement Mastery.name: 靈器專家（Implement Mastery）
Implement Mastery.description: 20級時，秘學士習得一件靈器的精義。他選擇一個靈器學派。當他使用該靈器學派的靈器之力時，抵抗該靈器之力的DC增加4，在計算效果和持續時間時有效秘學士等級也增加4。另外，他獲得額外4點心智點，只能用來填充進所選學派的靈器中。這4點心智點無法用來挪作他用，只能用來釋放該靈器學派的靈器之力。該靈器學派的靈器中若至少有一點心智點留存，則該靈器的硬度增加20點。

Implements.name: 靈器（Implements）
Implements.description:
1級時，秘學士習得2個靈器學派。在2級及之後每4級，他都可以習得一個新的靈器學派，最高18級時習得7個靈器學派。每個習得的靈器學派都可為每環法術新增一個同學派秘學士法術已知。未習得的靈器學派所包含的法術將不視為處於秘學士的法術列表中。因此秘學士無法使用未習得靈器學派相關法術的法術觸發型物品和法術完成型物品，除非通過使用魔法裝置技能來發動。秘學士可以重複習得一個靈器學派以獲得該學派的更多法術已知。

  每個靈器學派都像徵著一系列物品。每天，秘學士都需要在已習得靈器學派的靈器列表上各選擇一個物品，作為當日的靈器。秘學士只有在保有當日靈器的情況下，才能施放該學派的法術。當他習得一個靈器學派多次時，需要指定更多的靈器來施放法術，每個靈器都符合一套該學派的已知法術。靈器無需是魔法物品，非魔法靈器在穿戴時不視為佔用魔法物品裝備槽。非魔法物品的靈器對秘學士來說大多為具有歷史價值的古物或者對個人來說意義重大，比如古佛指骨、賢王權杖碎片、嚴師家人的顱骨或先祖的玻璃假眼。

  當秘學士施法時，必須掌握對應的靈器，並且將靈器展示給目標或效果區域。這個行為是施法的一部分，不需要額外的動作來完成。如果秘學士缺少對應的靈器，他也可以嘗試施放對應法術，但必須通過DC=20+法術環數的專注檢定。在沒有對應靈器的情況下施放的法術必定使用最低可用施法者等級（1環法術施法者等級1，2環法術施法者等級4，以此類推）。

  每個靈器學派都有一種。會直接加入秘學士習得的靈器之力表中。此外，每個靈器學派都會提供系列靈器之力供秘學士選擇。

Impossible Bloodline.name: Impossible Bloodline（Impossible Bloodline）
Impossible Bloodline.description:
You can see beyond the mundane, and are capable of visualizing the improbable, and even the impossible. If this expanded perception doesn閳ユ獩 drive you mad, you may learn to make the impossible into reality.
