Labyrinthine Words.name: Labyrinthine Words（Labyrinthine Words）
Labyrinthine Words.description: You add your Wisdom modifier in addition to your Charisma modifier on Bluff checks to lie and Diplomacy checks to influence other creatures.

Large (4 pts).name: Large (4 pts)（Large (4 pts)）
Large (4 pts).description:
An eidolon grows in size, becoming Large. The eidolon gains a +8 bonus to Strength, a +4 bonus to Constitution, and a +2 bonus to its natural armor. It takes a 閳? penalty to its Dexterity. This size change also gives the creature a 閳? size penalty to its AC and on attack rolls, a +1 bonus to its CMB and CMD, a 閳? penalty on Fly skill checks, and a 閳? penalty on Stealth skill checks. If the eidolon has the biped base form, it also gains 10-foot reach. Any reach evolutions the eidolon possesses are added to this total. The eidolon must be Medium to take this evolution. The summoner must be at least 8th level before selecting this evolution.

If 6 additional evolution points are spent, the eidolon instead becomes Huge. The eidolon gains a +16 bonus to Strength, a +8 bonus to Constitution, and a +5 bonus to its natural armor. It takes a 閳? penalty to its Dexterity. This size change also give the creature a 閳? size penalty to its AC and attack rolls, a +2 bonus to its CMB and CMD, 10-foot reach, a 閳? penalty on Fly skill checks, and a 閳? penalty on Stealth skill checks. If the eidolon has the biped base form, its reach increases to 15 feet (10 feet for all other base forms). Any reach evolutions the eidolon possesses are added to this total. These bonuses and penalties replace, and do not stack with, those gained from becoming Large.

  The summoner must be at least 13th level before selecting this option.

The ability increase evolution costs twice as much (4 evolution points) when adding to the Strength or Constitution scores of a Large or Huge eidolon.

Large (UC) (4 pts).name: Large (UC) (4 pts)（Large (UC) (4 pts)）
Large (UC) (4 pts).description:
Requirements: Summoner level 8th (13th for Huge), Medium size.

  The eidolon grows in size, becoming Large. The eidolon gains a +4 bonus to Strength, a +2 bonus to Constitution, and a +2 bonus to its natural armor. It takes a 閳? penalty to Dexterity. This size change also gives the creature a 閳? size penalty to AC and on attack rolls, a +1 bonus on combat maneuver checks and to CMD, a 閳? penalty on Fly checks, and a 閳? penalty on Stealth checks. If the eidolon has the biped base form, it also gains a reach of 10 feet. Any reach evolutions the eidolon possesses are added to this total.

If 6 additional evolution points are spent, the eidolon instead becomes Huge. The eidolon gains a +8 bonus to Strength, a +4 bonus to Constitution, and a +5 bonus to its natural armor. It takes a 閳? penalty to Dexterity. This size change also gives the creature a 閳? size penalty to AC and on attack rolls, a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks and to CMD, a 10-foot reach, a 閳? penalty on Fly checks, and a 閳? penalty on Stealth checks. If the eidolon has the biped base form, its reach increases to 15 feet instead of 10 feet. Any reach evolutions the eidolon possesses are added to this total. These bonuses and penalties replace, and do not stack with, those gained from becoming Large.

The ability increase evolution costs twice as much (4 evolution points) when adding to the Strength or Constitution scores of a Large or Huge eidolon.

Last Ditch Effort.name: Last Ditch Effort（Last Ditch Effort）
Last Ditch Effort.description: Once per day, a rogue with this ability who accidentally activates a trap while attempting to disarm it may immediately attempt another Disable Device check to disarm it, albeit at a 閳? penalty. The result of the second check is taken even if the result is lower.

Lasting Tinctures.name: Lasting Tinctures（Lasting Tinctures）
Lasting Tinctures.description: The alchemist knows how to make tinctures that last much longer than normal. The durations of the effects of any tinctures the alchemist brews using the Craft skill are doubled. When the alchemist uses this discovery to brew a longer-lasting tincture, the tincture imposes its normal penalties on the alchemist even if the alchemist has an ability that reduces tinctures閳?penalties (such as the substance tolerance ability of the fermenter alchemist archetype presented in this section). An alchemist with this discovery can brew tinctures with normal durations.

Lava Walk.name: Lava Walk（Lava Walk）
Lava Walk.description:
You can walk across lava, magma, and similarly heated stone at your normal movement speed. You are immune to any fire damage caused by the surface while you walk above it, even if it radiates damage at a distance. While using lava walk, you never slip or fall from poor or slippery footing. You can use lava walk for 1 minute per day per oracle level. This duration doesn閳ユ獩 need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments.

  You must be at least 3rd level to select this revelation.

Lay to Rest.name: Lay to Rest（Lay to Rest）
Lay to Rest.description:
The witch may target a single undead creature with this hex as if with an @Compendium[pf1.spells.lllhr9py6w44cxjm]{亡靈歸亡} spell. A Will save negates this effect.

  Whether or not the save is successful, a creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 1 day.

Leadership.name: Leadership（Leadership）
Leadership.description: 在8級時，你獲得 @Compendium[pf1.feats.R3a1OV18RwDJftvq]{領導力} 作為額外專長。此外，只要你一直遵守你的神祇的教義（若你不信仰特定神祇則改為神聖信條），你的領導力數值就擁有+2加值。

Leap and Bound.name: Leap and Bound（Leap and Bound）
Leap and Bound.description:
A vigilante with this talent adds his Strength bonus on Acrobatics checks in addition to his Dexterity modifier. He is always treated as having a running start when jumping, and his high jumps are treated as long jumps when determining the DC. When the vigilante jumps, he does not fall until the end of his turn, allowing him to attack or perform other actions in midair. If the vigilante grapples a creature capable of bearing his weight, he does not fall, instead remaining adjacent to the creature as it moves.

  A vigilante must be at least 10th level to select this talent.

Leathery Skin.name: Leathery Skin（Leathery Skin）
Leathery Skin.description: At 3rd level, you gain cold resistance 5 and a +1 natural armor bonus to AC. At 9th level, your cold resistance increases to 10 and natural armor bonus increases to +2. At 15th level, your natural armor bonus increases to +4.

Leave an Opening.name: Leave an Opening（Leave an Opening）
Leave an Opening.description:
The vigilante閳ユ獨 hidden strike leaves an unbalancing opening in a foe閳ユ獨 defenses, setting up the foe to be attacked again. At the beginning of the foe閳ユ獨 next turn, if the vigilante threatens the foe, the foe provokes an attack of opportunity from the vigilante. Multiple attacks against the same foe don閳ユ獩 create multiple attacks of opportunity in the same round (but attacks against several foes can cause each to provoke one attack of opportunity).

  Only a stalker vigilante can select this talent.

Legacy Conduit.name: Legacy Conduit（Legacy Conduit）
Legacy Conduit.description: At 16th level, when using the legacy style bloodline power, you can expend a spell slot as a swift action to share the benefits of the selected style feat with all allies within 30 feet. The benefits last for 1 round per level of the spell slot expended. Allies must still enter the style閳ユ獨 stance as a swift action.

Legacy Style.name: Legacy Style（Legacy Style）
Legacy Style.description: At 8th level, select any one style feat. You can use this style feat while bloodraging; however, if you do not meet all of the style feat閳ユ獨 prerequisites, you must expend a spell slot when entering the style閳ユ獨 stance, and the benefits last for only 1 round per level of the spell slot expended or for the duration of your bloodrage, whichever is shorter. If you already have this style feat, you can enter the style閳ユ獨 stance as part of the free action to bloodrage.

Legacy Weapon.name: 武器饋贈（Legacy Weapon）
Legacy Weapon.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點觸摸一個武器給予它增強加值。該加值等於1+每6個秘學士等級1點（最高18級+4）。本能力給予的增強加值可以與武器本身的疊加，但最高不得超過+5。你也可以不直接給予武器增強加值而是給予武器特殊屬性，用特殊屬性等效增強加值替換你本應給予的增強加值同額數值。在被賦予特殊屬性前，目標物必須至少有+1增強加值（來自物品本身或武器饋贈能力）。一般而言，該能力的增強加值持續1分鐘。

Legend Subdomain.name: Legend Subdomain（Legend Subdomain）
Legend Subdomain.description:
替代神授力量 In campaigns that use the optional hero point system (Pathfinder RPG Advanced Player閳ユ獨 Guide 322), you gain Hero閳ユ獨 Fortune (Advanced Player閳ユ獨 Guide 324) as a bonus feat. Otherwise, you gain Marked for Glory (Pathfinder RPG Mythic Adventures 69) as a bonus feat, even if you do not meet its prerequisites.

  替代領域法術

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ibk7jrc5rwubpia6]{援助術}, 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.3wcvosazm31i8758]{Contagious Zeal}
  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.dm52jk1e37b05v9d]{正義狂熱}
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.p4h6ocn0axh59xrc]{Unshakable Zeal}
  • If you are evil, replace the domain spells @Compendium[pf1.spells.erndkoe44rgj0lob]{聖光擊}, @Compendium[pf1.spells.osi62mwn6rpkwlm6]{聖劍術}, and @Compendium[pf1.spells.n0vm6or4nwaylpfa]{聖潔靈光} with @Compendium[pf1.spells.okui7mft5bquqfrg]{邪影擊}, @Compendium[pf1.spells.ftrg3ira8jwicetv]{Unholy Sword}, and @Compendium[pf1.spells.flrn1xmm2wfrxbkf]{邪惡靈光} respectively.

Legendary Archmage.name: 傳奇大法師（Legendary Archmage）
Legendary Archmage.description: 每天一次，你可以施放任意一個在法師/術士列表內的法術，無需使用法術位，無視環數限制，也不會增加英靈的共鳴。

Legendary Champion.name: 傳奇勇士（Legendary Champion）
Legendary Champion.description: 每當你降靈勇士時，你就可以獲得兩個戰鬥專長（每次降靈可更改）。在決定專長的先決條件和它們的效果時，將你的通靈者等級視為你的基礎攻擊加值。在選擇這兩個專長時，你還可以將你的通靈者等級視為某一滿基礎攻擊加值（如戰士，野蠻人，殺手）的等級以決定先決條件。

Legendary Guardian.name: 傳奇守護者（Legendary Guardian）
Legendary Guardian.description: 每天一次，你可以以一個即時動作忽略對你發動的單次攻擊，包括目標為你或是範圍包括你的法術效果。但是你無法保護其他生物。

Legendary Hierophant.name: 傳奇大祭司（Legendary Hierophant）
Legendary Hierophant.description: 每天一次，你可以召喚一次神蹟，這個效果必須符合不消耗鑽石塵的法術奇蹟術的限制，影響與奇蹟術相同。這個英靈所侍奉的神祇或其他類似存在決定是否賜予你這個神蹟。

Legendary Marshal.name: 傳奇統帥（Legendary Marshal）
Legendary Marshal.description: 你在使用較弱的英靈時使用靈力奔湧不會再增加任何共鳴，但這樣使用靈力奔湧會使它的增加數值永久性固定為1d6，無法通過任何途徑提升。較弱英靈的靈力奔湧仍然受到每輪最多一次的限制，但不再造成任何共鳴增長，也不計入其他可以避免共鳴增加而使用靈力奔湧的次數中。

Legendary Trickster.name: 傳奇詭術師（Legendary Trickster）
Legendary Trickster.description: 每天一次，你在進行一次技能檢定時可以不必投骰，直接選擇一個隨意d20的結果。除此之外，你可以隨意變化自身的形象，如同法術高等變形術（Greater Polymorph）的效果，但你無法變形成一個特定角色的樣子。

Legislation Subdomain.name: Legislation Subdomain（Legislation Subdomain）
Legislation Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.mmdypasgl5us00wb]{Forbid Action}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.gn1u9cjc9phsczec]{Forbid Action, Greater}
  • 9環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.fjekm39re35y3kot]{Hold Monster, Mass}

Leshy Caller.name: Leshy Caller（Leshy Caller）
Leshy Caller.description:
You can spontaneously swap out any of your domain spells for a summon nature閳ユ獨 ally spell of the same level or lower, to a maximum of summon nature閳ユ獨 ally VII. If you do, you must use the spell to summon one or more leshys. Add leaf leshy, gourd leshy, fungus leshy, seaweed leshy, and lotus leshy to your summon nature閳ユ獨 ally I, II, III, IV, and V lists, respectively. You count as a plant creature for the purpose of creating leshys (Pathfinder RPG Bestiary 3 176).

As a standard action, you can grant a single leshy within 30 feet a +4 sacred bonus on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Wooden Fist power of the Plant Domain.

Leshy Subdomain.name: Leshy Subdomain（Leshy Subdomain）
Leshy Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.6ho3wsspkqkhypt0]{樹化術}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.icjrw9y6pa1uatlz]{問道自然}

Leshy Summoning Hex.name: Leshy Summoning Hex（Leshy Summoning Hex）
Leshy Summoning Hex.description: The witch counts as a plant creature for the purpose of growing leshys. She adds leaf leshys, gourd leshys, fungus leshys, seaweed leshys, and lotus leshys to the list of creatures she can summon with @Compendium[pf1.spells.kyo0kwhw2jhuztju]{召喚怪物 I}, @Compendium[pf1.spells.26vm5jhjkxpq1xm3]{召喚怪物 II}, @Compendium[pf1.spells.1zmn8vqy3s5l9kiv]{召喚怪物 III}, @Compendium[pf1.spells.aqri3zf6mzgd4di6]{召喚怪物 IV}, and @Compendium[pf1.spells.hd7ukybisvv7j5r6]{召喚怪物 V}, respectively.

Lethal Grace.name: 致命優雅（Lethal Grace）
Lethal Grace.description: 俠客的攻擊兼具破壞性的蠻力和巧妙的運用平衡與速度，在他想要的時候能夠造成可怕的創傷。俠客獲得武器嫻熟作為獎勵專長。如果他已經擁有了武器嫻熟專長，那麼俠客可以轉而獲得一個他在獲得武器嫻熟的那個等級上滿足先決條件的任意專長。當俠客使用武器嫻熟專長，以自己的敏捷調整值決定攻擊加值但是以力量調整值決定傷害加值的情況下，他可以在傷害檢定上獲得相當於他的俠客等級一半的加值。這個加值不會因為俠客使用雙手武器或是副手使用武器攻擊而受到任何影響。

Lethality (Stare).name: Lethality (Stare)（Lethality (Stare)）
Lethality (Stare).description: The hypnotic stare penalty also applies to the target閳ユ獨 Fortitude saves versus poison and diseases.

Levitation Buffer.name: 念力救援（Levitation Buffer）
Levitation Buffer.description: 催眠師的念力會突然襲向受術者周邊的敵人，從而讓她避開威脅。當一名敵人移動至與受術者相鄰的位置、或者當受術者的回合開始時有一個或更多敵人與其相鄰時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。催眠師能夠讓受術者身邊相鄰的所有敵人漂浮到空中，或者把敵人推離受術者。抬起敵人會讓他們的移動速度減半，並且在對抗衝撞（rush）、拖拽（drag）和移位（reposition）的嘗試時CMD受到-4減值（意志豁免，通過則無效）。移動速度的減少和CMD受到的減值不會與惡意浮空（Hostile Levitation；UC）法術帶來的懲罰疊加。推離敵人需要催眠師嘗試一次衝撞戰技檢定，使用他的等級 + 他的魅力調整值作為該次檢定的CMB。成功以該詭計從受術者身邊推開的任何敵人都按照衝撞的正常規則進行判定。

Life Link (SHA).name: Life Link (SHA)（Life Link (SHA)）
Life Link (SHA).description:
The shaman creates a bond between herself and another creature within 30 feet. Each round at the start of the shaman閳ユ獨 turn, if the bonded creature is wounded for 5 or more hit points below its maximum hit points, it heals 5 hit points and the shaman takes 5 points of damage. The shaman can have one bond active per shaman level. The bond continues until the bonded creature dies, the shaman dies, the distance between her and the bonded creature exceeds 100 feet, or the shaman ends it as an immediate action.

  If the shaman has multiple bonds active, she can end as many as she wants with the same immediate action.

Life Revier.name: Life Revier（Life Revier）
Life Revier.description: The mesmerist can trigger this trick when the subject attempts an Intelligence or Knowledge check to remember a previous experience. The subject receives flashes of her entire life up to this point. She can use the mesmerist閳ユ獨 Charisma modifier in place of her Intelligence modifier on the check, and she can attempt the check untrained. The subject cannot learn information that she has not previously read, heard, or otherwise experienced at some point during her life when using this ability.

Lifesense (4 pts).name: Lifesense (4 pts)（Lifesense (4 pts)）
Lifesense (4 pts).description:
An eidolon can pinpoint living creatures with ease. The eidolon notices and locates living creatures within 60 feet, just as if it possessed the blindsight evolution.

  The eidolon must possess the undead appearance evolution to take this evolution.

  The summoner must be at least 11th level before selecting this evolution.

Light Matrix.name: 光之矩陣（Light Matrix）
Light Matrix.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點創造出聽從命令環繞你的光球。光球如同光亮術一般發光。光球可以命令停留在你肩膀上一同移動。以一個移動動作，你可以直接命令它移動最遠到離你30尺的位置。若它距離你超過30尺，會立刻返回肩膀上盤旋。若你至少有5級，你可以命令它（如上移動動作）對30尺內一個生物進行近戰接觸攻擊。若攻擊命中，目標必須進行強韌豁免檢定，失敗則目盲1d4輪。若攻擊命中，無論目標豁免是否成功，光球消失。光之矩陣持續每秘學士等級1小時。同一時間你無法用用多餘1個的光球。若你在有效期間再次使用該能力，第一個光球立刻消失。

Lightning Rod.name: Lightning Rod（Lightning Rod）
Lightning Rod.description:
As a swift action when you cast a spell with the electricity descriptor, you can designate one creature within line of sight. The spell閳ユ獨 damage against that creature increases by 50%, as if affected by the Empower Spell feat. This additional damage results from divine power that is not subject to being reduced by electricity resistance, and you take an equal amount of electricity damage immediately after you cast the spell. The spell can deal this additional damage only once, even if it could affect the target multiple times. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level and one additional time per day for every 4 cleric levels you have beyond 8th.

  This power replaces the Electricity Resistance power granted by the Air Domain.

Limbs (2 pts).name: Limbs (2 pts)（Limbs (2 pts)）
Limbs (2 pts).description:
An eidolon grows an additional pair of limbs. These limbs can take one of two forms. They can be made into legs, complete with feet. Each pair of legs increases the eidolon's base speed by 10 feet. Alternatively, they can be made into arms, complete with hands. The eidolon does not gain any additional natural attacks for an additional pair of arms, but it can take other evolutions that add additional attacks (such as claws or a slam). Arms that have hands can be used to wield weapons, if the eidolon is proficient.

  This evolution can be selected more than once.

Limbs (UC) (2 pts).name: Limbs (UC) (2 pts)（Limbs (UC) (2 pts)）
Limbs (UC) (2 pts).description:
The eidolon grows an additional pair of limbs. These limbs can take one of two forms. They can be made into legs, complete with feet. Each pair of legs increases the eidolon閳ユ獨 base speed by 10 feet.

  Alternatively, they can be made into arms, complete with hands. The eidolon does not gain any additional natural attacks for an additional pair of arms, but it can take other evolutions that add additional attacks (such as claws or slam). Arms that have hands can be used to wield weapons, if the eidolon is proficient.

  This evolution can be selected more than once.

Lingering Plague.name: Lingering Plague（Lingering Plague）
Lingering Plague.description:
Any creature that must make a save against a disease caused by the alchemist閳ユ獨 extract or other class ability must make a second save 1 round later to avoid doubling the duration of the disease effect. If the disease doesn閳ユ獩 have a duration, this discovery reduces its onset time and frequencies by half.

  An alchemist must be at least 8th level before selecting this discovery.

Lingering Poison.name: Lingering Poison（Lingering Poison）
Lingering Poison.description: A rogue with this talent can have a poison remain inert until a later time. When she delivers a contact or injury poison, instead of the poison閳ユ獨 normal onset time, the rogue can delay the poison閳ユ獨 effects until up to 1 day from when it is delivered (minimum 1 round). The delayed poison can be detected as normal by spells such as detect poison and similar abilities.

Lingering Spirits.name: Lingering Spirits（Lingering Spirits）
Lingering Spirits.description:
Numerous minor spirits find themselves attracted to you. Your connection with these spirits allows you to manifest any of the following spell-like abilities as a swift action: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.p8lm7khq3ynyif21]{法師之手}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.mtxqp85izkb20djq]{幻音術}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.z3ysa1xxmzgj14sd]{Grave Words}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.f6k11j4pvmkka4e9]{Telekinetic Projectile}

  You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Lingering Venom.name: Lingering Venom（Lingering Venom）
Lingering Venom.description:
Poisons that the investigator personally applies to weapons and traps, or otherwise inflicts upon foes, require one additional successful save to cure.

  An investigator must be at least 5th level to select this talent.

Link (SPI).name: 連結(喚魂師)（Link (SPI)）
Link (SPI).description: 魅影與喚魂師共享精神連結，並允許他們在任何距離互相溝通（只要他們在同一個位面）。溝通是一個自由動作，允許喚魂師隨時對魅影下達指令。此外，喚魂師的魔法物品也會干涉魅影——這使得喚魂師與其魅影共享魔法物品的裝備位。譬如，當喚魂師佩戴一隻戒指，那麼她的魅影也最多隻能佩戴一隻戒指。若兩者發生衝突，喚魂師的魔法物品依然生效，而魅影的則會失效。魅影必須有合適的肢體來裝備魔法物品。

Linked Reaction.name: 應激聯結（Linked Reaction）
Linked Reaction.description: 一種集體意識聯通了催眠師和一名盟友，讓他們能夠共享彼此的反應力。當受術者或者催眠師被突襲（surprised）且另一方沒有被突襲時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計（即便在通常情況下催眠師由於被突襲而無法執行動作，他也能觸發這項詭計）。催眠師以及受術者都可以在這個突襲輪（surprise round）中行動。催眠師不能為自己植入該項詭計。

Lion Aspect.name: Lion Aspect（Lion Aspect）
Lion Aspect.description:
Lions hunt in prides, cooperating to bring down large opponents and defend their territory. A lion閳ユ獨 alternate attack is bite (B, P, S).

Minor Form: You gain a +4 competence bonus on Intimidate checks.

  This bonus increases to +6 at 8th level and +8 at 15th level.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a dire lion. While in this form, you gain a base speed of 40 feet, low-light vision, and scent (30 feet). Once per day for every 2 shifter levels you have, you can utter a mighty roar, allowing you to attempt an Intimidate check with a +5 circumstance bonus to demoralize enemies within 30 feet. Allies gain a +1 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls against creatures affected by this ability.

  At 8th level, you gain one of the following teamwork feats as a bonus feat: Outflank, Pack Attack, Paired Opportunists, or Shake It Off. You can grant allies within 30 feet the benefits of this feat as a swift action for a number of rounds equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  At 15th level, you provide a flanking bonus to any ally who threatens the same opponent as you do, and you can change places with an adjacent ally as a move action that does not provoke an attack of opportunity, as if using the Swap Places feat.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Bite (B, P, S)

Live On.name: 苟延殘喘（Live On）
Live On.description: 5級起，你能夠使用聖療（lay on hands），就如同你是一名等級為異能者等級-3的聖武士一般。你還可以使用恩惠（Mercy），就如同你是一名等級為異能者等級-3的聖武士一般。通過苦痛精神境界獲得的聖療和恩惠僅能以你自己為目標。該能力與其他來源獲得的聖療能力疊加。

Living Capacitor.name: Living Capacitor（Living Capacitor）
Living Capacitor.description:
Element air; Type utility (Sp); Level 2; Burn 0

  You store electricity damage you take within your body, as if you constantly had @Compendium[pf1.spells.0g0pgsbjns61ovln]{Body Capacitance} active. Once you discharge this electricity damage via a touch attack, you must take electricity damage again before you can discharge it again.

Living Paradox.name: Living Paradox（Living Paradox）
Living Paradox.description: At 20th level, your outward appearance remains the same, but beneath your skin lies not flesh and blood but clockwork gears, miniature galaxies, or something equally uncanny. You gain immunity to disease and poison. You take no additional damage from bleed effects, critical hits, and sneak attacks.

Living Pigment.name: Living Pigment（Living Pigment）
Living Pigment.description: The alchemist infuses his inks and dyes with a spark of animating force. As a standard action, he can expend one daily use of his bombs and a 1st-level extract he has prepared to create a creature, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.kyo0kwhw2jhuztju]{召喚怪物 I}, using his level as the spell閳ユ獨 caster level. The extract is expended as if the alchemist had consumed it. The alchemist can expend a higher-level extract when using this ability to create a creature using a summon monster spell of a level equal to the level of extract expended. For example, if the alchemist expends a 4th-level extract, he can create a creature as if using @Compendium[pf1.spells.aqri3zf6mzgd4di6]{召喚怪物 IV}. Additionally, the alchemist can expend an additional use of his daily bombs when creating a creature in this way to grant the creature the celestial or fiendish template. The alchemist must have the divine inks discovery before selecting this discovery.

Living Shield.name: 人盾（Living Shield）
Living Shield.description: 如果俠客正擒抱著一個生物且他自己被一次攻擊指定為目標，那麼俠客可以以一個即時動作，對被他擒抱的生物發動一次戰技檢定（這個戰技檢定不視為擒抱戰技檢定）將正在被他擒抱的生物拉到自己身前。如果戰技檢定成功，那麼被俠客擒抱的這個生物會成為這次攻擊的新目標；如果戰技檢定失敗，那麼被擒抱的生物會立刻逃脫並且俠客正常被攻擊。這個天賦必須在俠客被宣告為一次攻擊的目標，但攻擊者的攻擊檢定結果得出之前使用。

Living Swarm.name: Living Swarm（Living Swarm）
Living Swarm.description: At 20th level, you and the machines within you become one. Your nanites consume and replicate your body, allowing swift and radical physical alterations with little more than a thought. You become immune to bleed effects, diseases, and poisons, and gain DR 5/閳? At will, you can break down your body and move in a shimmering stream of flying nanites, as if affected by @Compendium[pf1.spells.mqdoexj35atgqafn]{氣化形體}.

Lizard Aspect.name: 蜥蜴擬態（Lizard Aspect）
Lizard Aspect.description:
蜥蜴擬態是迅捷且優雅運動的代名詞，給予了能以驚人靈活性與平衡性來突進急轉的能力。

  次級形態：你的特技檢定獲得+4表現加值。8級時，這個加值提升至+6。15級時，這個加值提升至+8。

  專攻形態：你變身為一隻靈敏的色彩斑斕的巨大蜥蜴（如同怪物圖鑑 pg. 194 巨傘蜥，但有如下改動）。當處於該形態時，你獲得40尺基本移動速度、昏暗視覺、靈敏嗅覺（30尺）、附帶攫抓能力的1d8傷害的齧咬攻擊（主要天生武器）和附帶摔絆的1d6傷害的尾掃攻擊（次要天生武器）。8級時，你的基本移動速度提升至60尺和獲得30尺攀爬速度。15級時，你獲得齧咬和尾掃的精通天生武器攻擊專長，並且你的尾掃攻擊的觸及提升至10尺。

Location Channel.name: 呼喚地縛靈（Location Channel）
Location Channel.description: 在5級時，通靈者可以在某人死去——或是他曾經生活過的地點執行一次特殊的降靈儀式，暫時將死者的魂靈喚回並寄宿在他的體內，使生者可以與他交流。這個能力的效果相當於一個法術Call Spirit（見本書），不過死者之魂只能停留相當於每通靈者等級1輪的時間，並且憑依在通靈者的身體上而不是獨立以遊魂的狀態現形。每當通靈者嘗試呼喚地縛靈後，他將在24小時內無法呼喚同一個魂靈。降靈後每輪之中通靈者都可以通過一個一個成功的意志檢定（DC=20+通靈者等級的一半）結束地縛靈的憑依。

Loci Sentry.name: 區域哨兵（Loci Sentry）
Loci Sentry.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點創造出守衛區域的哨兵。區域最大半徑為10尺+每秘學士等級5尺。當有生物進入區域內時，由你靈魂顯化的哨兵立刻出現並攻擊入侵者。受影響者必須通過意志豁免，失敗則眩暈1輪。你會立刻得知哨兵被觸發。哨兵最高持續每秘學士等級1小時，或直到被觸發。當你設定哨兵時，你可以設定任意數目的生物免疫哨兵不會觸發它。

Lore Discipline.name: 學識境界（Lore Discipline）
Lore Discipline.description:
通過收集專門的訊息和閱讀各類神秘學相關的著作和書籍，你習得了適宜的技巧和儀式用以強化自身的精神能力。力量會隨著你的研究和知識的積累而日益變強，而不是憑藉著自身的本能來強化。

精神力池屬性 感知

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jcs7ba5depdyitey]{通曉語言} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.pyr472hvqn8c8es2]{Hypercognition} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.gmgwyjfpeuuc4t4o]{解除魔法} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.vrzgrnmiz8kmz6di]{Mind Probe} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.nv20ki8uteao1vqv]{Retrocognition} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.b5mz8voksps5g4yq]{通曉傳奇} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ln4jpuurxbrfxw5j]{Arcane Sight, Greater} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.2vb5orfcy57lrfmc]{片刻預知} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.q8nety5obvbbd5xs]{Divide Mind} (18th).

Low-Light Vision (1 pt).name: Low-Light Vision (1 pt)（Low-Light Vision (1 pt)）
Low-Light Vision (1 pt).description: An eidolon gains low-light vision, enabling it to see twice as far as a human in conditions of dim light.

Loyal Aid.name: 忠誠助手（Loyal Aid）
Loyal Aid.description: 俠客擁有一群對他忠心耿耿的夥伴，這些盟友可以幫他蒐集情報，掩飾他的雙重身份，或是打理些俠客無暇顧及的事務。如果俠客身處在他擁有聲譽影響的地區之中時，他會在用於蒐集訊息的交涉檢定上獲得相當於他的俠客等級一半的加值。

Loyalty Subdomain.name: Loyalty Subdomain（Loyalty Subdomain）
Loyalty Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.eu4u4mr1naoiqohz]{移除恐懼}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.l1zl69j95ad7l9dn]{高等命令術}

Luminous Form.name: Luminous Form（Luminous Form）
Luminous Form.description:
You can transform your body into churning light, granting you the effects of blur and causing your body to shed light as a sunrod.

  At 7th level, creatures that end their turn adjacent to your luminous form become blinded for 1 round (Fortitude negates).

  At 13th level, creatures that end their turn adjacent to your luminous form are blinded for 1d4 rounds (Fortitude reduces to 1 round).

  At 18th level, your luminescence is as bright as natural sunlight, and creatures affected by natural sunlight are so affected if they end their turn adjacent to your luminous form.

  You can maintain your luminous form for up to 1 minute per day per oracle level; this duration need not be continuous, but it must be used in 1-minute increments. You can forgo the blur and blinding aspects of this ability to instead simply shed light as a torch, though this still counts against the ability閳ユ獨 duration for the day.

Lunar Final Revelation.name: Lunar Final Revelation（Lunar Final Revelation）
Lunar Final Revelation.description: Upon reaching 20th level, you become an avatar of the primal world閳ユ攽art humanoid, part beast. Once per day, you can transform into a lycanthrope of your choice for a number of hours equal to your Charisma modifier, gaining all the powers of a natural lycanthrope of that type, including the ability to change shape between human, animal, and hybrid form. In addition, you become immune to mind-affecting and language-dependent effects, as well as effects that specifically target only humanoids.

Lunar Mystery.name: Lunar Mystery（Lunar Mystery）
Lunar Mystery.description:
本職技能: An oracle with the lunar mystery adds Acrobatics, Knowledge (Nature), Perception, and Survival to her list of class skills.

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.dol5wzpsk7m6gxsc]{Fumbletongue} (2nd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ech2cibcsmsms9s7]{Dust Of Twilight} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.8u1xa5javcxc6szk]{狂暴術} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.2mh7g81k30bv7b5m]{精神錯亂} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.knjoprwzcm3jygwk]{狼之型} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.cxp0vodhvuwnfmye]{Litany Of Madness} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.8rf2ucrtzmxooyw6]{Lunar Veil} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.1btrja5u0cz66cy8]{Blood Mist} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.0mt9mso6wdhfafpo]{Polar Midnight} (18th).

Lycanthropy Curse.name: Lycanthropy Curse（Lycanthropy Curse）
Lycanthropy Curse.description:
You suffer from a minor form of lycanthropy. The exact animal your body and mind are aligned with can vary, but you should choose an animal that matches your faith thematically. In times of stress or unease, you cannot speak閳ユ攼nly growl and snarl like an animal. This ability works similarly to the tongues curse, but whenever you are in combat, you cannot speak at all. This does not interfere with spellcasting but does apply to spells that are language dependent. A character under the effects of speak with animals can understand you, and you can communicate with such characters normally. You can speak with animals when in this condition. Choose one type of animal commonly associated with lycanthropy (such as rats, wolves, or bears); you gain a +4 bonus on Handle Animal checks with these creatures.

  At 5th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.pg7dbmuuaksxhp3v]{魅惑動物} to your list of 1st-level oracle spells known and @Compendium[pf1.spells.0324zq42g3fu4kko]{動物信使} to your list of 2nd-level oracle spells known.

  At 10th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.tjdfluulncmqacc3]{野獸形態 I} to your list of 3rd-level oracle spells known and @Compendium[pf1.spells.774kmgcb7ygviht0]{野獸形態II} to your list of 5th-level oracle spells known.

  At 15th level, you gain damage reduction 5/silver, and if you already have this type of damage reduction, it increases in value by 5 (to a maximum of DR 15/silver).

Mad Rush.name: 一往無前（Mad Rush）
Mad Rush.description: 當他發動衝鋒時，俠客可以在衝鋒結束時發動整輪攻擊，但作為代價他會直到自己的下回合開始前在防禦等級上承受-4減值（與正常衝鋒的-2AC罰值疊加）。只有達到12級並且選擇復仇騎士之道的俠客才能選擇本天賦。

Maddening Whispers.name: Maddening Whispers（Maddening Whispers）
Maddening Whispers.description:
At will as a standard action, the shaman can invoke whispers from spirits of the Dark Tapestry to speak directly into the mind of a single target within 30 feet. These whispers utilize no known language, yet the victim nevertheless feels convinced that, somehow, it was almost able to comprehend the message. The target must succeed at a Will saving throw or be confused for 1 round.

  At 8th level and again at 16th level, the confusion caused by this hex lasts for 1 additional round.

  Whether or not the save is successful, the shaman cannot target that creature with this hex again for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting effect.

Maelstrom Infusion.name: Maelstrom Infusion（Maelstrom Infusion）
Maelstrom Infusion.description:
Element water; Type substance infusion; Level 8; Burn 4
Prerequisite extended range
Associated Blasts charged water, water
Saving Throw Reflex partial

  You create a 20-foot-radius whirling maelstrom in a body of water within 120 feet (the area of the maelstrom does not include any squares in the radius that aren閳ユ獩 in the water). Any creature in the maelstrom immediately takes one-quarter your blast閳ユ獨 normal damage regardless of whether it succeeds at its save. A creature that succeeds at its Reflex save can choose to exit the area at the closest space.

  A creature in the maelstrom must succeed at a DC 35 Swim check in order to swim, and any creature that enters the maelstrom or ends its turn in the maelstrom takes half your blast閳ユ獨 normal damage. As a free action at the beginning of your turn, you can position each creature in the maelstrom anywhere you choose within the affected area.

  This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to your Constitution modifier or until you use this infusion again. You can use grappling infusion with this infusion.

Maelstrom Jump.name: Maelstrom Jump（Maelstrom Jump）
Maelstrom Jump.description: The arcanist can call upon the randomness of the Maelstrom to move in unpredictable ways. She can expend 1 point from her arcane reservoir as a swift action to gain the benefits of @Compendium[pf1.spells.ja005kj1gh7g0dnk]{熵光護盾} for 1 minute and move 10 feet in a random direction. For the next minute, she moves 10 feet in a random direction at the end of each of her turns. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity or count against her movement for the round. If the movement would end her movement in an occupied space, she instead travels to the nearest unoccupied space.

Mage of the Veil Subschool.name: Mage of the Veil Subschool（Mage of the Veil Subschool）
Mage of the Veil Subschool.description:
Rather than controlling the elements or transforming the environment, mages of the veil focus on much more subtle magic閳ユ攤lending into their surroundings to watch, observe, and gather secrets, or fading from view completely for the sake of solitude. Most graduates of this college become spies, scouts, or infiltrators.

  相關學派： Illusion.

  Requirements: A mage of the veil must select disguise self as one of his spells known at 1st level.

  本職技能: A mage of the veil gains 唬騙, Disguise, and 隱匿 as class skills.

  Replacement Powers: This subschool replaces the blinding ray and invisibility field powers of the illusion school.

Magic Attacks (1 pt).name: Magic Attacks (1 pt)（Magic Attacks (1 pt)）
Magic Attacks (1 pt).description:
An eidolon is infused with magic, allowing it to treat all of its natural attacks as if they were magic for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

  If the summoner is 10th level or higher, all of the eidolon's weapons are treated as the alignment of the eidolon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Magic Attacks (SPI).name: Magic Attacks (SPI)（Magic Attacks (SPI)）
Magic Attacks (SPI).description:
When the phantom manifests in ectoplasmic form, it treats its slam attacks as if they were magic for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction.

  If the spiritualist is 10th level or higher, all of the phantom閳ユ獨 weapons are treated as the alignment of the phantom for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Magic Attacks (UC) (1 pt).name: Magic Attacks (UC) (1 pt)（Magic Attacks (UC) (1 pt)）
Magic Attacks (UC) (1 pt).description:
The eidolon is infused with magic, allowing it to treat all of its natural attacks as if they were magic for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

  If the summoner is 10th level or higher, all of the eidolon閳ユ獨 natural attacks are treated as the alignment of the eidolon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Magic Circles.name: 魔法陣（Magic Circles）
Magic Circles.description: 8級起，秘學士習得繪製魔法陣的方法。繪製魔法陣時，他必須擁有粉筆、鹽、血、銀粉或其他合適的物質在手（然而也有在軟性地面如泥土或黏土上用畫陰文的方式畫魔法陣的方法）。繪製魔法陣需要1分鐘並消耗1點心智點（靈器內心智點或共用心智點皆可）。完成後，魔法陣如同永久的反陣營法陣一般運作，但需完成時選擇對抗的具體陣營。該魔法陣無法對抗秘學士所處的陣營（比如秘學士為守序善良，則他畫的魔法陣無法是反善良法陣或反守序法陣）。該法陣在被物理破壞（比如圖紋被塗抹或鹽粉被吹散）前一直存在。只有活物可以物理破壞法陣，環境效果不會破壞它。秘學士同一時間只有一個魔法陣可以生效。若他繪製第二個魔法陣，第一個將會立刻失去效果。該魔法陣能力不能用來對內以禁錮異界生物。

Magic Item Skill.name: 魔裝知識（Magic Item Skill）
Magic Item Skill.description: 2級起，秘學士的魔裝知識讓他可以更輕鬆啟動魔法裝置。他的使用魔法裝置技能檢定獲得等同於1/2秘學士等級的加值。

Magical Familiarity.name: Magical Familiarity（Magical Familiarity）
Magical Familiarity.description:
The vigilante taps into a past life閳ユ獨 arcane secrets. He selects a 0-level spell from the sorcerer/wizard spell list. The vigilante can cast the chosen spell three times per day as a spell-like ability, using his vigilante level as his caster level.

  At 6th level, he chooses a second 0-level spell that he can also use three times per day as a spell-like ability.

  At 12th level, in addition to these 0-level spells, he chooses a 1st-level spell that he can cast once per day as a spell-like ability.

  At 18th level, he can cast his 1st-level spell three times per day and his 0-level spells at will.

  The vigilante must have an Intelligence score of at least 10 to select this talent.

Magical Hoarder.name: Magical Hoarder（Magical Hoarder）
Magical Hoarder.description:
At 13th level, whenever a creature within 30 feet of you casts a spell intended to benefit its targets, you can spend 1 point from your phrenic pool as an immediate action to include yourself as a target of that spell. If the creature is not your ally, you must be able to clearly see the spell閳ユ獨 effects and you must succeed at a Spellcraft check (DC = 15 + the spell閳ユ獨 level) to identify the spell before using this ability.

  If you are not within the normal range of the spell, then you must spend 1 additional point from your phrenic pool to use this ability.

  If the spell has a range of personal, then you must instead spend 2 additional phrenic points from your pool to use this ability.

  This ability does not affect spells with an instantaneous or permanent duration.

Magma Form.name: Magma Form（Magma Form）
Magma Form.description:
As a standard action, you can assume the form of a Small magma elemental, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.pawbnw1nm4f0b98e]{元素身軀I}. You gain the same abilities as if you had chosen an earth elemental閳ユ獨 form, except your earth glide functions as the earth glide ability of a magma elemental.

  At 9th level, you can assume the form of a Medium magma elemental, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.yldjnorgbx4jsldz]{元素身軀II}.

  At 11th level, you can assume the form a Large magma elemental, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.hd32fuc6e7j4isbn]{元素形態 III}.

  At 13th level, you can assume the form of a Huge magma elemental, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.v42t5kpxc8mvd615]{元素形態 IV}.

  You can use this ability once per day, but the duration is 1 hour per oracle level.

  You must be at least 7th level to choose this revelation.

Magnetic Infusion.name: 磁化注能（Magnetic Infusion）
Magnetic Infusion.description:
元素：氣或土；類別：性質注能；等級：3；超載：2

  關聯念襲類別：帶電水，電刺，轟鋼，太陽風，風雷擊

  豁免：無

  你的念襲會讓敵人產生輕微的磁性。每當注能念襲對一個敵人造成傷害後，直至你的下個回合結束之前，金屬武器（包括金屬念襲）對該名敵人做出的攻擊會獲得+4加值，而且敵人會在避免金屬物體的反射豁免檢定中承受-4減值。

Magnetism, Greater.name: Magnetism, Greater（Magnetism, Greater）
Magnetism, Greater.description:
Element air, earth; Type utility (Sp); Level 9; Burn 0
Prerequisite magnetic infusion, magnetism
Saving Throw none; SR no

  You can repel or attract metal objects in a vast line with a magnetism so strong that there is no hope of escaping. This functions as @Compendium[pf1.spells.oeemcnfjod9zd7my]{驅離金石}, except only for metal objects, and you can also pull the objects toward you instead of pushing them away. The effect lasts for 1 round, and the pulling version of the effect can閳ユ獩 pull objects into the air unless they are already airborne.

  You can accept 1 point of burn to increase the duration to 1 round per kineticist level you have.

Magnetism.name: Magnetism（Magnetism）
Magnetism.description:
Element air, earth; Type utility (Sp); Level 3; Burn 0
Prerequisite magnetic infusion
Saving Throw none; SR yes

  You can push and pull metal objects using magnetism. This functions as telekinetic maneuvers but you can make only bull rush and drag combat maneuvers, and can do so only against metal objects or creatures.

  If you use this ability on an attended metal object, you must exceed the creature閳ユ獨 CMD as normal, and if it閳ユ獨 holding the object, it must drop it or this ability pushes or pulls the creature.

Major Ameliorating.name: Major Ameliorating（Major Ameliorating）
Major Ameliorating.description:
The witch can touch a creature to suppress or protect it from more debilitating negative conditions. Each time she uses this hex, the witch either chooses the blinded or deafened condition, or chooses a type of effect: curse, disease, or poison. If the target is or later becomes afflicted with the chosen condition or effect, that condition or effect is suppressed for a number of minutes equal to the witch閳ユ獨 level. Alternatively, for 24 hours the witch can grant her target a +4 circumstance bonus on saving throws against effects that cause any two of the above conditions or effects (witch閳ユ獨 choice; she can choose any combination of conditions or effects, as long as she chooses only two total).

  At 15th level, the witch can choose up to two total conditions or types of effects to suppress or three total conditions or types of effects to grant a circumstance bonus against each time she uses the major ameliorating hex.

  Once a creature has benefited from this hex, it cannot benefit from it again for 24 hours.

Major Amplifications.name: 高等精神增幅（Major Amplifications）
Major Amplifications.description: 在11級以及之後的每4個等級，異能者都可以高等精神增幅中進行選擇，以取代精神增幅列表中的選項。

Major Magic (3 pts).name: Major Magic (3 pts)（Major Magic (3 pts)）
Major Magic (3 pts).description:
An eidolon learns to cast a major spell as a spell-like ability. Select one spell from the following list: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wh9zc2reqneafxro]{強酸箭}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.e67esdjp4nojtbr7]{治療中度傷}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.tsndfcfijmgxs37p]{黑暗術}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.y69de8y5ddrhuue5]{怪物暈眩術}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.d8yy4njnr25hacek]{滑翔術}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.oylikodnyku2zewu]{隱形術} (self only), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.fxz69pwpqt9b6uss]{次等復原術}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.plou8h168bfn5hq6]{浮空術}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.27o3msobhyghmfid]{弱效幻影}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.q4ixxjb4v281g2xv]{灼熱射線}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.nokru6mxk9p3r513]{識破隱形}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.3mfmhx8avu7h3iom]{蛛行術}

  This spell can be cast once per day as a spell-like ability.

At 10th level, this spell can be cast three times per day by spending 2 additional evolution points. The caster level for this evolution is equal to the eidolon's Hit Dice 閳?2. The save DC for this spell is 10 + 1/2 the eidolon's HD + the eidolon's Charisma modifier. The eidolon must have a Charisma score of at least 12 and must possess the minor magic evolution to take this evolution.

  The summoner must be at least 7th level before selecting this evolution.

  This evolution can be selected more than once. Each time an eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a new spell from the above list.

Maker's Call (UC).name: 主宰呼喚(掉鏈)（Maker's Call (UC)
Maker's Call (UC).description: 6級起，以標準動作，召喚師能夠將幻靈召喚到自己的身邊。這個效果的功能就如同任意門（Dimension Door）一般，使用召喚師的施法者等級。在使用該能力之後，幻靈會出現在與召喚師相鄰的位置（如果所有與召喚師相鄰的空間都被佔據，則儘可能地靠近召喚師）。若幻靈在該能力的範圍之外，則該次能力被浪費掉。召喚師在6級時每日能夠使用1次主宰呼喚，在6級之後的每4個等級，該能力的每日使用次數會額外增加1次。

Malignant Poison.name: Malignant Poison（Malignant Poison）
Malignant Poison.description: As a full-round action, the alchemist can increase the save DC of any poison by 4 and increase its duration by 2 frequency increments (for example, large scorpion venom lasts 8 rounds instead of 6 and drow poison lasts 4 minutes instead of 2). Additionally, malignant poisons take effect immediately and do not have an onset time. This alchemical change lasts until the poison閳ユ獨 extended duration ends or for a number of minutes equal to the alchemist閳ユ獨 level, whichever comes first. After that, the poison reverts back to its original state. An alchemist must be at least 10th level before selecting this discovery.

Malleable Flesh.name: Malleable Flesh（Malleable Flesh）
Malleable Flesh.description:
Whether through mutation or alchemy, some vigilantes have flesh that is as moldable as clay and as fluid as ink. A vigilante with this talent gains the shapechanger subtype and the compression universal monster rule. In addition, the vigilante can alter his appearance as @Compendium[pf1.spells.oj36nfak6jc2s5ky]{易容術}, except that the changes are physical rather than illusory. However, aspects of the vigilante閳ユ獨 aesthetic persist in all forms, halving the bonus on Disguise checks gained from this effect and from seamless guise.

  At 12th level, the vigilante can pass through narrow openings, even mere cracks, along with any item he wears or carries (to a maximum of his light load).

Mammoth Hide.name: Mammoth Hide（Mammoth Hide）
Mammoth Hide.description:
The shaman can touch a willing ally and cause its skin to thicken and sprout thick, shaggy fur. The creature gains a +2 enhancement bonus to natural armor and cold resistance 5 for 10 minutes.

  At 9th level, the enhancement bonus increases to +3 and the cold resistance to 10.

  At 15th level, this enhancement bonus increases to +4 and the cold resistance to 15.

  The shaman can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Charisma bonus.

Mammoth Spirit Manifestation.name: Mammoth Spirit Manifestation（Mammoth Spirit Manifestation）
Mammoth Spirit Manifestation.description: At 20th level, the shaman can transform into any animal listed under the megafauna or elephant heading. This ability works as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.br37848gchetel0q]{野獸形態 IV}, but the shaman can activate and dismiss the ability as often as she likes and the duration is permanent.

Mammoth Spirit.name: Mammoth Spirit（Mammoth Spirit）
Mammoth Spirit.description:
A shaman who selects the mammoth spirit is abnormally tall and stocky, with thick shaggy hair. When she uses a special ability of this spirit, her muscles ripple and flex, and her stature seems even greater than before. At times, particularly when she uses her most powerful abilities, a ghostly image of a mammoth may seem to rise around her as a visible aura of ghostly power.

Spirit Magic Spells: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jnlr9cuepka1l26e]{變巨術} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.05i5rxwim12hwktu]{牛之力量} (2nd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.8u1xa5javcxc6szk]{狂暴術} (3rd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.knyako6zopc1chrv]{石膚術} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.w88ddxpu89qcr5c0]{野獸形態III} (5th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.hzkaqaa8n6ygwmub]{Tar Pool} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jjmoi5qbwkbguzbn]{召喚自然盟友 VII} (7th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ukacuu0cvdjkqxwu]{Frightful Aspect} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.0mt9mso6wdhfafpo]{Polar Midnight} (9th).

  Spirit Animal: The shaman閳ユ獨 spirit animal appears more primal and prehistoric than an ordinary animal of its kind. It gains a +2 inherent bonus to its Strength score. The spirit animal loses this bonus when it manifests as a megafauna companion from the true spirit ability.

Maneuver Mastery (ORA).name: 戰技熟稔(先知)（Maneuver Mastery (ORA)）
Maneuver Mastery (ORA).description: 選擇一種類型的戰技。當使用你選擇的戰技時，將你的先知等級當做你的基本攻擊加值計算戰技加值。7級你獲得精通專長（例如“精通摔絆”）以給你的戰術提供加值。11級你獲得高級專長（例如“高級摔絆”）給你的戰術進一步提供加值。你不需要達到這類專長的先決條件。

Maneuvering Dodge.name: Maneuvering Dodge（Maneuvering Dodge）
Maneuvering Dodge.description: Whenever a foe of the rogue閳ユ獨 size or larger misses the rogue with a melee attack, the rogue gains a +2 bonus on any Acrobatics, Climb, Fly, and Swim checks she attempts for 1 round. At 8th level, this bonus increases to +4.

Manifest Memory.name: Manifest Memory（Manifest Memory）
Manifest Memory.description: At 20th level, you can overlay portions of your mindscape onto the world around you. This functions as the @Compendium[pf1.spells.82vi1xife3nlu8a0]{海市蜃樓} spell, except all structures and terrain created must be places appearing within your mindscape. You can use this ability at will, but you can maintain only a single manifest memory at any one time. You can allow any creature you can see who has previously entered your mindscape to automatically disbelieve the illusion as a free action.

Manifold Tricks.name: 多重詭計（Manifold Tricks）
Manifold Tricks.description: 5級起，催眠師能夠同時保有兩個被植入的詭計。自5級之後，催眠師每擁有4個催眠師等級，同時保有的被植入的詭計數量就可以再增加1個。每個生物在同一時間仍舊只能成為一個詭計的受術者。若同時被植入的詭計數量已經達到極限，催眠師仍要植入新的詭計的話，他必須選擇一個已經植入的詭計，讓這個詭計在未被觸發的情況下被解消掉（被解消的詭計仍舊會消耗催眠師詭計的每日使用次數）。

Mantis Aspect.name: Mantis Aspect（Mantis Aspect）
Mantis Aspect.description:
The aspect of the mantis imparts uncanny patience and unsettling speed.

Minor Form: You gain Lunge as a bonus feat.

  At 12th level, your reach increases by 5 feet.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a giant mantis. While in this form, you gain darkvision with a range of 60 feet, a +2 racial bonus on initiative checks, and two primary claw attacks (1d6) with the grab ability.

  At 8th level, you can always act in the surprise round, but if you fail to notice your foes, you act last, regardless of your initiative result (you act in the normal order in subsequent rounds).

  At 15th level, whenever you roll for initiative, you can roll three times and use any one of the results.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Bite (B, P, S)

Mantle Against Chaos.name: Mantle Against Chaos（Mantle Against Chaos）
Mantle Against Chaos.description: You can use @Compendium[pf1.spells.md6ltvqh9paadsm4]{Protection From Chaos} on yourself or another creature as a spell-like ability. You can use this ability for a number of minutes per day equal to your inquisitor level (minimum 1). This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be used in 1 minute increments.

Many Guises (NIN).name: Many Guises (NIN)（Many Guises (NIN)）
Many Guises (NIN).description:
A ninja with this trick gains the vigilante social talent of the same name.

  The ninja must have the deep cover ninja trick before selecting this trick.

Many Guises.name: 百變（Many Guises）
Many Guises.description: 俠客維持著一些路人的假身份。當俠客選擇轉換自己的身份時，他可以在俠客身份和社交身份之外選擇第三種身份：一般人身份。一般人身份沒有獨立的設定和背景，俠客可以在選擇成為一般人的時候自己隨意創造一個屬於他的身份，並且在他不再偽裝成一般人的時候可以立刻忘記自己一般人的身份設定。處於一般人身份的時候俠客不能獲得社交身份和俠客身份為他提供的好處，但他可以偽裝成屬於自己種族的一個平頭百姓（比如工人，農民，等等），一般人身份視為屬於絕對中立陣營。當處於該身份的時候俠客可以在偽裝成與他同種族的普通人的易容檢定上獲得+20環境加值。在此時，用來探知他的法術和能力（無論探知目標的俠客本身還是他的一般人身份）會自動失敗。俠客必須將自己偽裝的儘可能普通和平凡才能進入一般人身份，雖然一些魔法物品（比如易容帽）可以為他提供一些幫助，但俠客的一般人身份永遠不能超出一個社會或是較大社群中最平凡無奇的那個群體的程度（由GM裁定）。俠客必須達到5級才能選擇本天賦。

Many Roads.name: Many Roads（Many Roads）
Many Roads.description: You gain an insight bonus on Fly and Survival checks equal to 1/2 your oracle level. Further, you learn to speak and read three languages in addition to those you already know.

Many Throw Infusion.name: 多重念動（Many Throw Infusion）
Many Throw Infusion.description:
元素：以太；類別：塑形注能；等級：8；超載：4

  前置：增距（extended range）

  關聯念襲類別：念動

  豁免：無

  你操控大量物體並同時將它們投擲出去。你能夠使用你的念動做出攻擊檢定對抗120尺內的複數目標，數量等同於你的操念使等級，但是任意兩個目標之間的距離不得超過30尺。

Marksman's Shot.name: Marksman's Shot（Marksman's Shot）
Marksman's Shot.description: Those who seek to slay with a single shot must have keen eyes and perfect poise. As an attack action, the slayer makes a single ranged attack at his highest attack bonus with a ranged weapon he wields. The target of the attack must be the slayer閳ユ獨 studied target. On a successful hit, the slayer doubles the number of sneak attack dice applied to the attack; if the attack was not a sneak attack, this benefit does not apply.

Marshal Spirit.name: 統帥英靈（Marshal Spirit）
Marshal Spirit.description:
統帥英靈擁有超群的領導能力，懂得人心，一呼百應。

  英靈同調：每當你降靈統帥時，你在魅力檢定，基於魅力的技能檢定和靈力湧動投骰上獲得加值。若你在魅力檢定或基於魅力的技能檢定上使用靈力湧動，這允許此加值［注：指英靈同調，因為原本是同源不疊］在計算總結果時應用2次。

  降靈獎勵：獲得一個其他英靈職階的降靈獎勵，如果你召開降靈會，則每一個參與者都可以選擇一個任意降靈獎勵。

  偏好降靈區域：會議室，舞臺，劇院，宮廷。

  共鳴懲罰：你過於關注他人而往往漏掉一些重要的事正在發生。你在感知檢定和基於感知的技能檢定上承受相當於你的英靈同調加值數量的減值。除此之外，如果你不是盟友隊伍（至少是名義上的）領導者，你失去英靈同調和降靈獎勵的好處。

  禁忌：選擇下列禁忌之一：

  -你和你的盟友必須至少放走一個逃跑的敵人，讓他們去宣揚你們的恐怖（如果他是跑去發出警告則不在此列）。

  -你必須確保每一個盟友都能從危險中平安撤離，你不能犧牲任何盟友來達到目的，包括召喚生物。

  -你必須竭力頌揚你和盟友的濫強故事，即使有時候需要保持低調也是一樣。

Marshall's Order.name: Marshall's Order（Marshall's Order）
Marshall's Order.description: You can use your spirit surge on attack rolls, saving throws, ability checks, concentration checks, and skill checks rolled by you or any allies who participated in your seance as long as you have line of sight and line of effect, and are within 30 feet of the chosen ally. You can still use spirit surge only once per round.

Martial Discipline.name: Martial Discipline（Martial Discipline）
Martial Discipline.description: Through meditation and study of monastic forms of combat, you have learned a lethal form of unarmed combat. You gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.2aTFNMs3pW6nUBlr]{精通徒手打擊} as a bonus feat, even if you do not meet the prerequisites. You gain the unarmed strike damage of a monk of your oracle level. If you also have monk levels, those levels stack for the purpose of determining your unarmed strike damage.

Martyr's Resistances.name: Martyr's Resistances（Martyr's Resistances）
Martyr's Resistances.description:
At 4th level, you gain fire resistance 5 and you gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against fear and pain effects.

  At 8th level, your fire resistance increases to 10, and the bonus on saving throws against fear and pain effects increases to +4.

Martyred Bloodrager Bloodline.name: Martyred Bloodrager Bloodline（Martyred Bloodrager Bloodline）
Martyred Bloodrager Bloodline.description:
One of your ancestors paid the ultimate price for her beliefs. This distant relative martyred herself out of a devout dedication to some specific cause, and that sacrifice has infused you with power that you can use for good閳ユ攼r for ill. When you bloodrage, an inspiring fury conjures echoes of your forebear閳ユ獨 incredible determination and selfless dedication, both offering you protection and amplifying your ability to punish any who dare incur your wrath.

獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.O0e0UCim27GPKFuW]{頑強}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.ehqx8txNRGMaNOPt]{堅忍}
  • Heroic Defiance,
  • Heroic Recovery,
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.R3a1OV18RwDJftvq]{領導力}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.L10V7jTzmMYz62zz]{談判專家}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.8snLqsJN4LLL00Nq]{健壯}

  獎勵法術:

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.pau0ejk30fs1eebl]{忍受環境} (7th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.c81jnlmi4976g7sz]{Surmount Affliction} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.vqfrp8t0c1lw1jna]{英雄氣概} (13th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.scyklgov72pvw884]{Blessing Of Fervor} (16th)

Mask Misery.name: 掩飾苦難（Mask Misery）
Mask Misery.description: 受術者能夠在承受一個狀態之前短暫忽視它。當受術者受到接觸療法（Touch Treatment）能力中列出的一個次級狀態（Minor Conditions）影響時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。受術者能夠在1d4輪內忽略該狀態帶來的效果，在此之後受術者會承受完整的效果。除了觸發該項詭計的狀態以外，該能力對任何正在影響受術者的狀態沒有效果，即便這些效果也在接觸療法職業能力中列出了也一樣。受術者忽略觸發詭計的效果的輪數也被算在效果的持續時間內；如果掩飾苦難的持續時間比效果還長，那麼受術者就完全不會受到該狀態的影響。若一個產生多重狀態的效果觸發了該項詭計，那麼受術者會忽略所有合適的狀態。若催眠師的等級為6級或更高的話，則可以將中級狀態（Moderate Conditions）加到掩飾苦難可以忽略的狀態中，而且該項詭計會完全終止次級狀態（Minor Conditions），以取代原本的暫時壓制。催眠師不需要具有接觸療法（Touch Treatment）就能使用或選取該項催眠師詭計。

Masquerade.name: 假面化妝（Masquerade）
Masquerade.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點將外貌變成所觸碰的生物的樣子。若目標生物對你不友善，你需要進行近戰接觸攻擊檢定，不過目標不能進行豁免檢定來抵抗。你在易容檢定上獲得10+秘學士等級的加值，但只對易容成觸碰生物的外貌有效。該加值不與易容術的加值疊加。當你處於該能力效果時，可以隨時通過標準動作觸碰別的生物改變自己的樣貌。你可以隨時結束該能力效果。該能力持續每秘學士等級10分鐘，但你可以隨時消耗額外1點心智點重置時效。你必須至少7級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Master Bloodsmith.name: Master Bloodsmith（Master Bloodsmith）
Master Bloodsmith.description:
At 16th level, you can affect up to two items simultaneously with your bloodsmith bloodline power.

  At 20th level, you can affect up to three items.

Master of the Deep.name: Master of the Deep（Master of the Deep）
Master of the Deep.description:
As a standard action, the barbarian commands an aquatic creature to do her bidding. The barbarian selects a creature with the aquatic type within 30 feet and gives a terse command from those listed in the command spell. Alternatively, if the creature has an Intelligence of 1 or 2, the barbarian may instead command the creature to attack the closest creature to it as a standard action. The creature must succeed at a Will save (DC equal to 10 + half the barbarian閳ユ獨 level + her Strength modifier) or obey the command to the best of its ability on its next turn. Once a creature has attempted a saving throw against master of the deep (successful or not), it is immune to this power for 24 hours. This ability is a mind-affecting effect, but it is not language dependent; the creature need not understand the barbarian giving the command.

  A barbarian must be at least 8th level before selecting this power.

Master of the Veil.name: Master of the Veil（Master of the Veil）
Master of the Veil.description: At 8th level, you can create an illusion that hides the appearance of yourself and any number of allies within 30 feet for 1 round per wizard level. This ability otherwise functions like the spell @Compendium[pf1.spells.fxwycv6d7xwzua4t]{隱匿之紗}. The rounds do not need to be consecutive.

Master's Yoke.name: Master's Yoke（Master's Yoke）
Master's Yoke.description:
At 8th level, you can attempt to assert your dominance over any visible creature within 30 feet by declaring the target your property. The target can resist this effect with a successful Will save (DC = 10 + half your class level + your Wisdom modifier). If the target fails the save, it is affected as if by dominate monster for a number of rounds equal to half your class level. The target can choose to ignore any order you give and instead take 2 points of Constitution damage and become staggered for 1 round. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and an additional time per day for every 4 levels beyond 8th. This is a language-based mind-affecting effect.

  This power replaces the Staff of Order power of the Law Domain.

Master-Thought Koan (UC).name: Master-Thought Koan (UC)（Master-Thought Koan (UC)）
Master-Thought Koan (UC).description:
A monk with this ability can spend an additional 2 ki points when using either the breaking-down koan or building-up koan ki powers. When combined with master-thought koan, breaking-down koan affects a number of characters of your choice within 30 feet equal to the monk閳ユ獨 wisdom modifier. When combined with master-thought koan, building-up koan can be used on an ally within 30 feet.

  A monk must be at least 12th level and have either the breaking-down koan or the building-up koan ki power before selecting this ki power.

Masterful Tricks.name: 大師詭計（Masterful Tricks）
Masterful Tricks.description: 12級起，催眠師能夠選擇後述大師詭計中選擇一個來替代一個催眠師詭計。在之後的每2個等級，他都可以選擇一個大師詭計來替代一個催眠師詭計。使用大師詭計會消耗2次催眠師詭計職業能力的使用次數，而非1次。【譯註：大師詭計的第一句描述為“At 12th level, a mesmerist can choose one of the following masterful tricks in place of a mesmerist trick. He gains an additional masterful trick every 2 levels thereafter.”前半句表達的是替換，而後半句卻說額外獲取。因為感覺原文可能哪裡出問題又找不到相關勘誤，所以以第一句替換的描述為準。】

Material Mastery.name: Material Mastery（Material Mastery）
Material Mastery.description: Your superior knowledge of the nature of matter enables you to ignore spell requirements more easily when crafting magic items. By expending an extract of the same school and level as a spell prerequisite when crafting a magic item, you take only a 閳? penalty for ignoring that requirement, instead of 閳?.

Medicine Subdomain.name: Medicine Subdomain（Medicine Subdomain）
Medicine Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.nji43xhlbpr4hk6o]{Diagnose Disease}
  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.0wahvj06h5eak2fk]{Placebo Effect}

Medusa Bloodrager Bloodline.name: Medusa Bloodrager Bloodline（Medusa Bloodrager Bloodline）
Medusa Bloodrager Bloodline.description:
No magical creature is more iconic in Iblydan lore than the medusa. Perhaps your lineage traces back to a medusa, or an ancestor survived a medusa閳ユ獨 petrifying gaze and was forever changed by the experience. However the medusa閳ユ獨 influence entered your bloodline, when you bloodrage, you gain fearsome and ancient powers.

獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Q1cY8r0Pvb66pMG0]{警覺}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.pmAO1Sni8xx71pLF]{盲斗}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.fVRnBIHR4Jq6btvm]{強韌加強}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{精通先攻}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.2aTFNMs3pW6nUBlr]{精通徒手打擊}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.O0jbkTJcIji9BNiF]{威逼}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.8snLqsJN4LLL00Nq]{健壯}

  獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.9tww9fc9049h6iqc]{驚恐術} (7th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.tkjnm3lw7ni82tag]{抵抗能量傷害} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.78kwl5t99j9e8tzh]{人類定身術} (13th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.knyako6zopc1chrv]{石膚術} (16th)

Meek Facade.name: 怯弱表象（Meek Facade）
Meek Facade.description: 受術者會由於魔法而看起來弱小異常，由此驅使敵人對她發動攻擊。當受術者對一個生物做出一次攻擊並且失手（即便這是在全力攻擊中的一次攻擊，而且其他攻擊都命中了也可以）時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。該名敵人必須攻擊受術者，而且受術者在對抗觸發詭計的那次攻擊的敵人時，AC會獲得+2閃避加值。這些效果都僅會持續1輪。催眠師每擁有5個等級，AC的加值便會增加1點。這是一個影響心靈（mind-affecting）的脅迫（compulsion）效果。

Megafauna Companion.name: Megafauna Companion（Megafauna Companion）
Megafauna Companion.description: The shaman閳ユ獨 spirit animal transforms into a megafauna animal companion, using the shaman閳ユ獨 shaman level as her effective druid level. The shaman must choose an arsinoitherium, baluchitherium, brontotherium, chalicotherium, deinotherium, elasmotherium, glyptodon, mastodon, megaloceros, megatherium, uintatherium, or another mammalian megafauna (including most dire animals) that has animal companion statistics. It retains its Intelligence score and the special abilities it gains from the spirit animal class feature, but it also has the statistics and abilities of an animal companion. If the animal companion is dismissed, lost, or dies, it can be replaced in the same way as a normal spirit animal.

Melancholy Bomb.name: Melancholy Bomb（Melancholy Bomb）
Melancholy Bomb.description: Your anguish bombs are filled with memories of sadness and regret. Creatures who take damage from your anguish bombs are also affected as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.zt7cje76dck9hwp9]{極度絕望} for 1 round per alchemist level, or a single round if the target succeeds at a Will saving throw. An alchemist must be 10th level and have the anguish bomb class feature or the anguish bomb discovery before selecting this discovery.

Memory Palace.name: 記憶宮殿（Memory Palace）
Memory Palace.description:
13級起，你在精神層面上構築起超維度的圖書館，並以此來儲存精神世界中代表著你所學到的知識的具現體。該法術的功能如同法師豪宅（Mage's Magnificent Mansion）一般，但是具有以下改變：記憶宮殿所佔的空間大小等同於數量相當於異能者等級個10尺邊長的立方體；你的記憶宮殿中只有書櫃和可供你與訪客研習時使用的書桌和沙發，不會包含其他的傢俱；記憶宮殿裡也沒有食物，不過這裡包含著數個隱身僕役，數量等同於你的異能者等級的一半，它們僅會作為圖書管理員而工作。每當你召喚圖書館時，其中的版面都會保持一致，不過你可以在每次獲得新的等級時、或者花費15分鐘進行專注之後改變它的外觀。你能夠在心中重塑記憶宮殿，因此你不需要喚出記憶宮殿就可以改變它。每日僅能夠創造一次記憶宮殿。

  當你獲得該能力時，選擇一種類型的知識技能。任何人——包括你自己——在你的記憶宮殿中研習均會在此類知識技能檢定中獲得+4環境加值，而且對於在此類知識上未受訓的人來說，你的記憶宮殿還被視同為一間圖書館。當你沒有在記憶宮殿中尋求知識時（包括沒有呼喚出記憶宮殿的時候），你也會在前面所選擇的那項知識技能中獲得+2環境加值。在14級以及之後的每個等級中，你都能夠選擇另一個知識技能，並將你的記憶宮殿的圖書館加值應用在上面。

Mental Discord.name: 心智不諧（Mental Discord）
Mental Discord.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點擾亂30尺內一個活物的內心。目標必須進行一次意志豁免，成功免除效果。若豁免失敗，目標無法專注任何法術效果，且在施法時必須通過DC=15+雙倍法術環級的專注檢定。若法術包括思維成分，該專注檢定承受-4罰值。當目標處於該效果影響下時，所有意志豁免承受-2罰值。該效果持續每秘學士等級1輪。

Mental Fallback.name: 接管意識（Mental Fallback）
Mental Fallback.description: 精神指令被埋藏在受術者的內心深處，這讓她能在遭受精神控制之時讓催眠師接管身體。當受術者受到了由敵人制造的魅惑（charm）或脅迫（compulsion）效果時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。受術者會如同受到了催眠師施放的法術影響一般，以取代受到敵人影響。舉例說明：假設受術者被敵人施放的魅惑怪物（Charm Monster）法術影響，但是該名敵人無法給受術者下達命令，而此時催眠師卻能命令受術者。若魅惑或脅迫效果會導致懲罰或狀態，比如困惑術（Confusion）、極度絕望（Crushing Despair）或人類定身術（Hold Person）這樣的效果的話，受術者能夠忽略其中任何由催眠師選擇的懲罰或狀態。該項詭計能劫持魅惑或脅迫效果的輪數等同於催眠師的等級，或者直至觸發詭計的效果持續時間結束為止，以較早發生者為準。催眠師不能為自己植入該項詭計。

Mental Focus.name: 心智點（Mental Focus）
Mental Focus.description:
秘學士每日可選擇將自己的心智點填充進所選靈器中，根據填充進的數值和對應靈器學派發動不同的特殊能力。秘學士的心智點等於秘學士等級+智力調整值，每日恢復至滿。他可以任意分配自己的心智點到各靈器中。若某靈器遺失或被摧毀，填充進該靈器的心智點亦會消失，不過下一次恢復心智點時會正常恢復。

  填充進了心智點的靈器會根據學派不同給予不同的共鳴之力，並且秘學士可以通過消耗靈器內的心智點啟用該學派中已習得的靈器之力。共鳴之力給予的加值會根據填充的心智點數目不同而增減，但該加值只會在每日最初填充心智點時決定，而不會因使用靈器之力消耗掉心智點後隨之減少共鳴之力的加值。但若靈器內所有心智點皆用盡，該靈器學派所賦予的共鳴之力將會失去，直到重新填充心智點為止。

  靈器將會為該靈器的佔有者提供共鳴之力，因此秘學士可以將填充好心智點的靈器借給盟友以給予盟友共鳴之力。如此做會讓秘學士自己很難施放一系列法術，並且無法通過該靈器使用靈器之力，直到他尋回靈器或重新恢復心智點。

  秘學士每天一次只會在進行至少8小時睡眠後恢復心智點。之後必須花費1小時時間準備靈器和填充心智點。每次恢復心智點時，之前未曾用掉的心智點將會消失。

  秘學士可以選擇將心智點留存在自己體內，而非填充進靈器中，稱為共用心智點。用共用心智點啟動靈器之力時，會消耗更多點數。任何秘學士用共用心智點啟動使用（或維持）的靈器之力，會消耗雙倍的心智點數額。共用心智點可以用來啟動使用任何靈器學派中已習得的靈器之力，但不會對共鳴之力造成影響。任何沒有在日初填充入心智點的靈器將不會給予共鳴之力。

Mental Placidity.name: 心平氣和（Mental Placidity）
Mental Placidity.description: 以直覺動作，你能夠在將要嘗試的意志豁免檢定中獲得+2加值。這個加值在對抗附魔系（enchantment）法術或效果時提升至+4點。任何嘗試豁免檢定以對抗同一個效果的盟友會在意志豁免檢定中獲得+1加值，如果該效果為附魔系效果則為+2加值。若你成功通過豁免，那麼你的精神力池會恢復1點精神力。每日能夠使用該能力恢復的精神力數量等同於你的感知調整值。

Mental Potency.name: 心智潛能（Mental Potency）
Mental Potency.description: 5級起，催眠師能夠使用精神效果影響更多數量的生物或者更為強大的存在。他所施放的每個附魔系（enchantment）或幻術系（illusion）法術所能影響的生命骰限制以及總生命骰數量均會增加1個。對於由催眠師所施放的附魔系和幻術系法術來說，如果這個法術目標數量多於一個生物的話，該法術能夠影響的生物數量也會增加一個（因此目標為“每等級一個生物”的法術會受到影響，但是目標為“一個生物”的法術就不會受到影響）。舉例說明：5級的催眠師所施放的睡眠術（Sleep）能夠影響共計5個生命骰的生物，催眠術（Hypnotism）能夠影響2d4 + 1個生命骰的生物，七彩噴射（Color Spray）法術所產生的效果會以“3個生命骰或更低”、“4或5個生命骰”以及“6個生命骰或更多”來分類。額外生命骰的數量或者影響生物數量的增加會在5級之後的每5個等級再增加1個，最高為20級時的增加4個。

Merciful Foliage.name: Merciful Foliage（Merciful Foliage）
Merciful Foliage.description:
Element wood; Type utility (Su); Level 2; Burn 0

  The First World is a place of rampant life, and you can use some of its energy to ease the danger of your attacks. You can deal nonlethal damage without taking a penalty on attack rolls with your wood blasts or composite blasts that include wood.

Mercy Patron.name: Mercy Patron（Mercy Patron）
Mercy Patron.description:

  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.d4oubr5bdoo8w1ev]{鷹之威儀}

Merge Forms (UC).name: 融合型態(掉鏈)（Merge Forms (UC)
Merge Forms (UC).description:
16級起，以整輪動作，召喚師能夠接觸他的幻靈，之後兩者融為一體。這種變化也包含了召喚師的所有裝備。當兩者以此方式進行融合時，召喚師會受到保護免受傷害，而且無法成為法術或效果的目標。所有目前以召喚師為目標的效果和法術均被壓制（suspended），直至召喚師從幻靈中分離出來為止（不過在此期間仍舊計算持續時間）。

  召喚師在融入幻靈體內之後，仍舊可以通過操控幻靈施放法術。任何用於這些法術的材料成分均取自召喚師的裝備，儘管這些材料目前無法直接取出也沒有影響。召喚師在融合形態下能夠直接指揮幻靈的所有動作，能夠通過幻靈的感官進行感知，還能夠通過幻靈的聲音進行交談。

  召喚師每日能夠使用該能力的輪數等同於他的召喚師等級。他能夠隨時以迅捷動作結束該效果。若可能的話，召喚師會出現在與幻靈相鄰的空間裡。若幻靈在召喚師融入其體內的期間返回原屬位面，那麼召喚師會被立即排出，受到4d6點傷害，並且被震懾（stunned）1輪。

Mesmeric Mirror.name: 催眠鏡像（Mesmeric Mirror）
Mesmeric Mirror.description: 一個幻象出現在受術者周圍，讓她能夠擺脫攻擊。當受術者被攻擊（attacked）或者成為了一個需要攻擊檢定的法術的目標時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。一個受術者的複製體會出現，攻擊者必須隨機決定擊中哪個目標，就如同鏡影術（Mirror Image）一般。催眠師每擁有5個職業等級，就能夠額外產生一個幻象，最高為20級時的5個幻象。每個幻象均會持續每個催眠師等級1分鐘，或者直至被摧毀為止。這是一個幻術系（illusion）虛假幻覺（figment）效果。

Mesmeric Pantomime.name: 催眠啞劇（Mesmeric Pantomime）
Mesmeric Pantomime.description: 通過精心編排盟友的身體運作，催眠師能夠將自己的身體技巧賦予盟友。當受術者嘗試一次基於力量或基於敏捷的技能檢定時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。受術者可以使用催眠師在技能檢定上的加值來取代自己的加值，或者獲得相當於催眠師魅力調整值的士氣加值，以能為結果帶來較高調整的一方為準。催眠師不能為自己植入該項詭計。

Mesmerist Tricks.name: 催眠師詭計（Mesmerist Tricks）
Mesmerist Tricks.description:
催眠師可以與他的盟友之間設立催眠聯結，在他們的意識中植入可以在稍後觸發的魔法暗示。催眠師每日可以植入的催眠師詭計數量等同於1/2他的催眠師等級（最低為1）外加他的魅力加值（若有的話）。催眠師在同時只能保有一個被植入的催眠師詭計，植入一個新詭計會結束已經植入的詭計（催眠師仍舊會失去植入先前那個詭計時所花費的使用次數）。

  為了植入一個催眠師詭計，催眠師必須用一個標準動作接觸自己或一名自願的生物。同一時間，一個生物僅能成為一個催眠師詭計的受術者。催眠師能以自由動作在滿足詭計的觸發條件（見各催眠師詭計的描述）時觸發一個已植入的詭計，即使此時並非催眠師的回合也可以。催眠師在觸發詭計時，受術者必須位於中距範圍內（100尺 + 每等級10尺）。催眠師能通過一種敏銳的心靈感應聯繫來監察詭計的觸發條件，因此他不需要有視覺線相連就能觸發催眠師詭計——但任何會阻礙心靈感應的情況也能阻止詭計的發動。一個已經植入的催眠師詭計會持續至催眠師再次恢復每日法術為止。

  被觸發的催眠師詭計不再處於植入狀態，直至催眠師再次植入詭計為止，它便無法被再次觸發。被觸發的詭計所帶來的效果之持續時間為立即（instantaneous）或者標註在詭計的描述中。催眠師詭計（mesmerist trick）或大師詭計（masterful trick）的豁免檢定DC或技能檢定DC為10 + 1/2催眠師等級 + 催眠師的魅力調整值。

  催眠師在1級時知曉一個催眠師詭計，在2級以及之後的每2級均學會另一個詭計（最高為20級的11個）。催眠師詭計的每個每日使用次數可以用於植入任意一個催眠師已知的詭計。除非在催眠師詭計的具體描述中另有說明，否則每個催眠師詭計僅能被催眠師選取一次。

Mesmerizing Elementalist.name: Mesmerizing Elementalist（Mesmerizing Elementalist）
Mesmerizing Elementalist.description:
Element universal; Type utility (Su); Level 1; Burn 0
Prerequisite nagaji

  You gain the hypnotic gaze nagaji alternate racial trait. If you already have this trait, add +1 to the trait閳ユ獨 save DC instead. You can use the hypnotic gaze racial trait by accepting 1 point of burn, even if you have no daily uses of that racial trait remaining.

Metacharge.name: Metacharge（Metacharge）
Metacharge.description: As an Arcane crafter, you gain a bonus feat at 3rd level, which must be an item creation feat or metamagic feat. You must still meet all prerequisites for a bonus feat, including caster level minimums. When using metamagic feats to create magic items, your skill and understanding of the principles involved in the item閳ユ獨 creation give you a +2 bonus on the skill check made to create the item.

Metakinesis.name: 超念（Metakinesis）
Metakinesis.description: 5級起，操念使獲得通過承受超載來如同使用超魔專長（metamagic feats）一般調整念襲的能力。通過承受1點超載，操念使能夠把她的念襲進行強效，就如同使用了法術強效（Empower Spell）專長一般。9級起，通過承受2點超載，她能夠把念襲進行極效，就如同法術極效（Maximize Spell）專長一般。13級起，通過承受3點超載，她能夠瞬發念襲，就如同使用法術瞬發（Quicken Spell）專長一般。17級起，通過承受4點超載，操念使能夠使用同一個標準動作將她的念襲使用2次，如果她在此基礎上結合使用超念進行瞬發，則可以以迅捷動作做到雙發。當她使用雙發念襲時，所有調整，比如超念和注能，都會應用到兩發念襲上，但是操念使僅需要支付單次的超載消耗。

Metakinetic Master.name: 超念大師（Metakinetic Master）
Metakinetic Master.description: 19級起，操念使選擇一種超念，比如強效或瞬發。她會將此類超唸的超載消耗降低1點（最低降至0點）。

Method to the Madness.name: Method to the Madness（Method to the Madness）
Method to the Madness.description: The alchemist has learned to channel his madness into one of his alchemist class abilities. When the alchemist takes this discovery, he chooses one of either bombs or extracts. If he selects bombs, he uses his Charisma bonus in place of his Intelligence bonus when determining the bonus to damage and the saving throw DCs of his bombs. If the alchemist selects extracts, he uses his Charisma bonus in place of his Intelligence bonus to calculate bonus extracts per day. The alchemist must have the madness extraordinary ability to take this discovery. This discovery can be taken twice, allowing the alchemist to select both bombs and extracts.

Metmorphosis.name: Metmorphosis（Metmorphosis）
Metmorphosis.description:
By meditating for 1 hour, you can trigger a slow, physical metamorphosis that takes 24 hours to complete (during which you do not gain the benefits of this new form). This ability cannot change your type or subtype, grant new abilities or natural weapons, or change your size category, but otherwise allows you to transform your appearance into anything possible for creatures of your type and subtype. You gain a +1 enhancement bonus to one physical ability score of your choice (Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution) while in this altered form. This bonus increases by 1 for every 5 psychic levels you have. Your shape and ability score bonus persist until you assume a new form or your current altered form ends.

  When meditating to begin your metamorphosis, you can spend 1 point from your phrenic pool either to change your size category to Small or Medium, or to gain a new ability from those provided by the alter self spell. If you do so, your altered form lasts only 1 hour per level.

Mien of Despair.name: Mien of Despair（Mien of Despair）
Mien of Despair.description: When a rogue with this talent successfully demoralizes an opponent using the Intimidate skill or performs a successful feint against an opponent, the opponent loses any morale bonuses and cannot benefit from any morale bonuses for 1d4+1 rounds.

Might of the Fallen.name: Might of the Fallen（Might of the Fallen）
Might of the Fallen.description:
The shaman can call upon the ancestral heroes of her family to bolster ailing allies. As a standard action, the shaman can cure 1 point of temporary ability damage affecting the creature touched.

  At 7th level, this increases to 1d4 points of temporary ability damage.

  Once a creature has been the target of this hex, it cannot be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.

Might of the Godclaw.name: Might of the Godclaw（Might of the Godclaw）
Might of the Godclaw.description:
You gain Deific Obedience (Pathfinder Campaign Setting Inner Sea Gods 210) as a bonus feat, even if you don閳ユ獩 meet its prerequisites. When you gain the feat, choose one Godclaw deity; you can perform that deity閳ユ獨 daily obedience to gain its benefits. Whenever you would gain one of your deity閳ユ獨 boons, you can instead gain the benefits of another Godclaw deity閳ユ獨 obedience. You can choose to gain the benefits of a maximum of four Godclaw deities閳?obediences if you choose to forgo all three of your god閳ユ獨 boons. You never need to spend more than 1 hour per day to perform your obedience.

  You must be at least 3rd level to select this revelation.

Mighty Ambush.name: Mighty Ambush（Mighty Ambush）
Mighty Ambush.description:
Once per round, when the vigilante succeeds at a hidden strike, he can instantly drop the damaged enemy unconscious for 1d4 rounds. A successful Fortitude saving throw negates this effect (DC = 10 + 1/2 the vigilante閳ユ獨 class level + the higher of the vigilante閳ユ獨 Strength and Dexterity modifiers). Whether or not a creature閳ユ獨 saving throw is successful, it can閳ユ獩 be affected by that vigilante閳ユ獨 mighty ambush again for 24 hours.

  Only a stalker vigilante of at least 10th level can select this talent.

Mighty Bash.name: Mighty Bash（Mighty Bash）
Mighty Bash.description: At 2nd level, the cavalier does not provoke attacks of opportunity when she attacks foes while unarmed so long as she is dealing nonlethal damage. In addition, the cavalier閳ユ獨 unarmed strikes deal more nonlethal damage than usual; she is treated as having a number of monk levels equal to her cavalier level for the purpose of determining how much nonlethal damage her unarmed strikes deal. For example, a 12th-level cavalier of the order of the hammer would deal 2d6 points of nonlethal damage with her unarmed strike. The cavalier must still select the @Compendium[pf1.feats.2aTFNMs3pW6nUBlr]{精通徒手打擊} feat if she wants to deal lethal damage with her unarmed strike, and lethal damage dealt with her unarmed strike is not increased by this ability.

Mimic Metamagic.name: 模擬超魔（Mimic Metamagic）
Mimic Metamagic.description: 當異能者獲得此項精神增幅時，她要選擇兩個超魔專長（metamagic feats）；她不必具有這些專長便可以進行選擇。當異能者施放法術時，能夠從自己的精神力池中花費精神力，使得自身選擇的一個超魔專長應用至聯結法術上，而且還不會增加法術等級或施法時間。異能者所要花費的精神力為超魔專長在正常情況下增加的法術等級的兩倍（最低為2點）。若超魔專長本身在自發施法者使用時，會以標準規則之外的不同方式調整法術的施法時間——比如法術瞬發（Quicken Spell），那麼這也會相應地改變施法時間。在使用這項精神增幅時，異能者仍舊能夠將自身已知的超魔專長應用至法術上，如常增加施法時間和法術等級。此項精神增幅僅能聯結到異能者所選擇的超魔專長在正常情況下可以影響的法術上，而且僅有在異能者能夠施放等級足夠高的法術時，才能夠將超魔專長應用至聯結法術上。舉例說明：11級的異能者可以花費8點精神力來將法術瞬發應用至1級法術上，但是無法以此方式瞬發2級法術，因為她還不能夠施放6級法術。該能力不需要任何可用的相關等級的法術位，也就是說，例子中的異能者即便用完了當日的5級法術位，也可以使用此項精神增幅來瞬發1級法術。異能者可以多次選取此項精神增幅，每次選擇都可以選取兩個超魔專長來新增到此項精神增幅可用的超魔專長列表中。

Mind Barrier.name: 念力護壁（Mind Barrier）
Mind Barrier.description: 以一個迅捷動作，你消耗1點心智點創造出純粹的精神能量護盾，保護自己免受傷害。該護盾抵消每秘學士等級2點的傷害。護盾持續到你下一輪開始或直到耗盡。舉個例子，5級秘學士的念力護壁抵消10點傷害；如果被命中受到12點傷害，則護壁耗盡抵消10點，角色僅受2點傷害。你也可用直覺動作啟動念力護壁，此舉會消耗2點心智點而非1點。

Mind Eye.name: 心之眼（Mind Eye）
Mind Eye.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點創造出心眼——你可以通過它來看聽的魔力傳感器。心眼隱形，體型為超微型，AC18。只要對心眼造成傷害就會摧毀它，但它只會被法術或魔法武器所傷。心眼飛行速度60尺有著完美機動性，可以離開你最高1英里遠。你必須用標準動作專注於控制心眼移動和接收傳送過來的感官。通過心眼看如同自己親眼看，因此可應用你擁有的感官能力（暗視或識破隱形）。心眼持續每秘學士等級1分鐘。你必須至少5級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Mind Fear.name: 恐懼之心（Mind Fear）
Mind Fear.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點喚起一個活物心中的恐懼。目標必須距離你30尺以內，且可進行意志豁免檢定免除該效果。若豁免失敗，HD小於等於你的目標將會驚懼1d4輪，HD大於你的目標則只戰慄1d4輪。這是一個影響心靈的恐懼效果。

Mind Heist.name: 劫取思維（Mind Heist）
Mind Heist.description: 5級起，你能夠潛入昏睡目標（sleeping target）的潛意識中。你能夠以類法術能力向著任何與你相鄰的昏睡生物施放偵測思想（Detect Thoughts）。此外，對於你所施放的託夢術（Dream）、弱效託夢術ARG（Minor Dream）和夢魘（Nightmare）的目標來說，你會如同花費3輪時間研究了目標一般獲得偵測思想的好處。若你施放了窺視夢境（Dream Scan；見本書第四章），那麼你能夠了解到自身是否從夢境中獲取到了錯誤訊息。成功通過意志豁免會使得劫取思維無效。每日使用該能力的次數等同於你的魅力調整值。

Mind Over Gravity.name: 御體於心（Mind Over Gravity）
Mind Over Gravity.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點給予自己60尺飛行速度，機動性完美。該效果持續每秘學士等級1分鐘。你必須至少7級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Mind Patron.name: Mind Patron（Mind Patron）
Mind Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ojtxej8ir6nycrtr]{Mindlink}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.sh36xp1aey9ipk65]{Mental Block}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.90xaelj2ncuzq62n]{Mindscape Door}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.nn4gjuby3uovsv78]{Create Mindscape}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.v8jb71nag8rwiwps]{Psychic Asylum}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.c14tjrds5emxk417]{Create Mindscape, Greater}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.21yha04trfhj0ehd]{心智手術}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.2vb5orfcy57lrfmc]{片刻預知}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.esugpfcs3zwbujt1]{Microcosm}

Mind Slumber.name: 心理睡眠（Mind Slumber）
Mind Slumber.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點，讓30尺內一個活物陷入心理睡眠。目標必須進行一次意志豁免檢定，成功則免除該效果。若豁免失敗，目標會陷入心理睡眠，將現實世界視為自己的夢境。目標不會倒地，但會丟掉所有持握的東西。該狀態下目標不會進行任何動作，但並非無助——她還是能察覺到夢中的危險。目標在受到任何傷害立刻清醒之前，會一直睡眠最多等於秘學士等級的輪數。在目標每輪結束時，都可進行意志豁免檢定以嘗試結束效果。目標可以被搜身或檢查而不會清醒，但無法在不驚醒目標的情況下將目標移出方格。無論目標豁免成功與否，目標免疫該效果24小時。你必須至少3級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Mind Steed.name: 心念鐵蹄（Mind Steed）
Mind Steed.description: 以標準動作，你消耗1點心智點召喚出幽靈馬來。幽靈馬可中型可大型，如同法術坐騎術一般運作。若你至少為5級秘學士，幽靈馬的基本陸地移動速度增加20尺。若你至少為9級秘學士，你可以額外消耗1點心智點，讓幽靈馬獲得60尺飛行速度，機動性良好，但如此做會讓幽靈馬的持續時間縮短為每秘學士等級1分鐘。

Mind's Eye.name: Mind's Eye（Mind's Eye）
Mind's Eye.description:
Some psychics train their visual and psychic senses, binding them together into a unified focus to better guide their ranged spells and place them with uncanny precision. While casting a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, the psychic can spend 2 points from her phrenic pool and gain a +4 insight bonus on the attack roll.

  The psychic can spend 1 additional point to ignore penalties from cover (but not total cover).

Mindshield.name: 心智護盾（Mindshield）
Mindshield.description: 異能者能夠從精神力池中花費1點精神力，來使得聯結法術的目標獲得強化，法術目標的意志豁免獲得+2士氣加值，持續時間為每個異能者等級1輪（最高10輪）。異能者能夠花費2點精神力作為替代，來使得加值增加至+4點。若聯結法術影響的生物數量超過1名，那麼異能者便可以選擇為每個她想要附加此項精神增幅的額外生物花費1點精神力。異能者必須選擇為每個生物花費1點還是2點的精神力（來決定心智護盾的效果）；她無法為不同的目標分別提供不同的加值。

Mindtech Discipline.name: 心靈科技境界（Mindtech Discipline）
Mindtech Discipline.description:
你生來就和電子機械以及類似的科技物品有著聯繫，而且還能與它們進行交流。你能讓你的精神力像流水一樣穿過這些科技物品。你可以使用你身邊的科技來增強和集中你的精神力量——即使有些種類的科技對於其他人來說並不是那麼明顯。

精神力池屬性 感知

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.iag7mp0kgnmql2mz]{Technomancy} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lygujduijp64f0wj]{Protection From Technology} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.vhnguobyolslgepm]{Irradiate} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.1yt3bidqyhkdf6a1]{Malfunction} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wp6qm9gnjxoqww4h]{Lightning Arc} (10th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wph6xwqvqekl7ph9]{Destroy Robot} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.snrnhiwqet5dmas0]{Memory Of Function} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ijwcwnt3oatnfghq]{虹光法牆} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.7mstq5c76h3e6zzx]{時間靜止} (18th).

Mindtouch.name: 觸探心智（Mindtouch）
Mindtouch.description: 異能者能夠從精神力池中花費1點精神力，來窺探一個目標的精神，不過前提是該目標受到了聯結法術的影響。若目標在對抗聯結法術的豁免中失敗、或者被法術命中的話，異能者能夠偵測它的表層思維，就如同偵測思想（Detect Thoughts）法術第三輪的效果一般。若聯結法術本身並不需要進行攻擊檢定或者豁免檢定的話，目標便可以嘗試一次意志豁免來避免偵測思想的效果（也僅限避免偵測思想的效果）；豁免DC的按照聯結法術的等級進行計算（外加所有其他可以應用的加值，就如同聯結法術原本便允許進行意志豁免一般）。此項精神增幅僅能聯結到影響一個目標或一片區域的法術上。若聯結法術能夠影響多名生物，異能者能夠通過為每個初始目標之外的額外生物分別額外花費1點精神力來偵測複數目標的思想。異能者必須在施放法術時決定受此精神增幅影響的目標，並消耗相應的精神力。這是個影響心靈（mind-affecting）的效果。

Minor Figment.name: 弱效幻象（Minor Figment）
Minor Figment.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點創造出弱效幻象。該能力如同幻音術或者弱效幻影之一一般運作。一般而言，該能力持續輪數等於秘學士等級。若秘學士等級為7級或更高，幻象持續分鐘等於秘學士等級，且你可以提出詳細的要求後，改變幻象顯現的內容一次。

Minor Magic (2 pts).name: Minor Magic (2 pts)（Minor Magic (2 pts)）
Minor Magic (2 pts).description:
An eidolon learns to cast a minor spell as a spell-like ability. Select one spell from the following list: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lndeaqm2j2nvgm6p]{燃燒之手}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jcs7ba5depdyitey]{通曉語言}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.xoc3vhg3btmfjauq]{治療輕傷}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.17eskras8cjynj10]{偵測混亂}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.tr7m97npkbgm4wp7]{偵測邪惡}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.mkgysr5o92kxxn59]{偵測善良}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jo67xdocgdmk5hhh]{偵測秩序}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.49yc9dpr4kvgki2s]{魔法飛彈}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.tuh5vc2bojaws3ig]{隱霧術}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.kq916lznxo0ig68v]{無聲幻影}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.c11olzqztodz5o5x]{漸隱術}
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.0onqjy8gfgop1xsi]{腹語術}

  This spell can be cast once per day as a spell-like ability.

  At 7th level, this spell can be cast three times per day by spending 2 additional evolution points. The caster level for this evolution is equal to the eidolon's Hit Dice 閳?2. The save DC for this spell is 10 + 1/2 the eidolon's HD + the eidolon's Charisma modifier. The eidolon must have a Charisma score of at least 11 and must possess the basic magic evolution to take this evolution.

The summoner must be at least 4th level before selecting this evolution. This evolution can be selected more than once. Each time an eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a new spell from the above list.

Minor Prophecy.name: Minor Prophecy（Minor Prophecy）
Minor Prophecy.description: The witch can call on her prophetic ancestors to cast @Compendium[pf1.spells.d1wxnax51cecplm4]{占卜術} once per day. She can spend a full hour casting the spell to negate the need for material components, but this reduces the accuracy of the spell by 5%.

Mirage.name: 海市蜃樓（Mirage）
Mirage.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點將一片區域覆蓋上幻象，讓你改變區域內的景象。你可以影響最多每秘學士等級5尺立方的區域，將區域內景色改變成你所想的一樣，具體如何改變由GM判斷。你可以，例如，隱藏門或者過道，讓桌子上放慢食物，甚至創造一個坑的幻象。你無法用該能力讓物品或者生物隱形，但你可以改變物品或生物的外貌來隱藏它們。該法術如同強效幻影，那些與幻影有任意物理互動的生物可以進行意志豁免來看穿海市蜃樓。你必須至少5級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Mirrored Retreat.name: Mirrored Retreat（Mirrored Retreat）
Mirrored Retreat.description:
