Once per day as a full-round action, your form ripples and releases seven illusory duplicates, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.4jsss37x0pplib8f]{鏡影術}, and then you can move up to your speed in any direction, while the duplicates move in seven other directions. The duplicates continue to retreat in their chosen direction, avoiding walls and other barriers but unable to open doors or interact with objects. The duplicates last for 1 minute per oracle level or until they take damage (they have the same AC as your touch AC and the same Reflex save as you, and they are immune to effects that allow a Fortitude or Will save). You can use this ability an additional time per day at 11th level and every 4 levels thereafter. This is a figment effect.

  You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Misdirection Mastery.name: Misdirection Mastery（Misdirection Mastery）
Misdirection Mastery.description:
You gleefully evade attacks and confound foes with your capricious misdirection. You receive Misdirection Tactics as a bonus feat.

  At 10th level, you receive Misdirection Redirection as a bonus feat.

  At 15th level you receive Misdirection Attack as a bonus feat.

  You do not need to meet the prerequisites to receive these feats.

  You must be at least 3rd level to select this revelation.

Misdirection.name: 方向誤導（Misdirection）
Misdirection.description: 你讓受術者的攻擊產生了偏移，敵人因為對攻擊軌跡的誤判而難以招架。當受術者作出一次攻擊或者使用了一個需要攻擊檢定的法術時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。催眠師要嘗試一次唬騙檢定來進行虛招（feint），對抗受術者攻擊的單個目標。和普通的虛招不同，該能力可以用於非近戰攻擊。若虛招成功，目標在對抗觸發詭計的攻擊時會失去AC上的敏捷加值。目標不會由於該能力而承受催眠師或受術者在通常的虛招或唬騙檢定上能附加的任何額外效果。這是一個幻術系（illusion）五官幻覺（glamer）效果。

Mists Shroud.name: Mists Shroud（Mists Shroud）
Mists Shroud.description:
The shaman touches a willing creature (including herself ) and enshrouds that creature in mist. This grants the creature concealment as the @Compendium[pf1.spells.18kryvj2dfuymk9d]{朦朧術} spell. The mist dissipates after it causes an attack to miss because of concealment or after 1 minute, whichever comes first.

  At 8th and 16th levels, the mist lasts for one additional attack.

  A creature affected by this hex cannot be affected by it again for 24 hours.

Mnemonic Cache.name: 記憶之匣（Mnemonic Cache）
Mnemonic Cache.description:
你能夠熟記一段訊息，並在以後完美地回憶起來。記憶之匣大致能夠存儲10頁的書面訊息，這包含圖像和地圖，或者30分鐘的等量音樂或演講。（記憶音樂並不能讓你獲得相應的演奏能力。）你能夠存儲的記憶量會在2級以及之後的每個異能者等級中得到提升，每級增加5頁或者5分鐘的容量。同一時間，你只能將一頁訊息存入記憶之匣中。在你回想訊息時，這些訊息並不會就這樣消失，但是當你將新的一頁訊息存入記憶之匣，被替換的原有那頁訊息會變為不完美的記憶。記憶魔法文字（比如卷軸或法術書上的某一頁文字）不會讓你獲得模仿、複製或保留文字中的魔法的能力。你可以把法術的文字重新寫出，用以讓依靠法術書準備法術的其他人來準備法術，不過這對於他人來說就好像在使用借來的魔法書一般。若你正通過心靈溝通和其他生物進行交流（比如使用心靈連線）的話，則可以通過自由動作直接將訊息傳入他人的大腦。對於該名生物來說，這些訊息就好像普通的記憶一般，並沒有那麼清晰準確。

  你能夠用記憶之匣嘗試隔絕一個文字型魔法陷阱（written magical trap）並將其摧毀，比如爆裂符文（Explosive Runes）或蛇紋法印（Sepia Snake Sigil）。這被視同為實用解除裝置檢定解除一個魔法陷阱，就好像你具有尋找陷阱（Trapfinding）職業能力一般。你在這個檢定中的加值等同於你的解除裝置技能調整值，或者5 + 你的異能者等級 + 你的感知調整值，以較高者為準。若檢定成功，這個陷阱便會被抹除（erased）和摧毀，以取代原本的被解除掉。該能力不能摧毀徽記（Symbol）陷阱；它僅對與書面內文（written text）相關的陷阱生效。

Mnemonic Esoterica.name: 記憶秘籍（Mnemonic Esoterica）
Mnemonic Esoterica.description: 回想起你前世的記憶，你獲得比大多數異能者所學更多的知識。選擇單一個施法職業，每天一次，當你準備法術時，你從這個職業的法術列表中選擇一個法術加入到你當天的已知法術和職業法術列表中，持續24小時。此法術必須比你可以施放的最高環級的法術低一環，你可以將它視為異能魔法來施放。每當你獲得新等級的時候，你可以在你準備法術時把目前所選的施法職業替換成另外一個。

Mobile Blast Infusion.name: 靈動（Mobile Blast Infusion）
Mobile Blast Infusion.description:
元素：通用；類別：塑形注能；等級：3；超載：2

  關聯念襲類別：任意

  豁免：反射，通過則無效

  你將一團元素物質、能量球或物體送往30尺內的特定方格里，對方格內的所有生物造成正常數值的四分之一的傷害（對於能量念襲來說則是正常傷害的一半）。靈動念襲會持續下去，直至你以自由動作主動解消、你失去意識、或者移動至距離靈動念襲30尺之外的位置為止。每輪在你的回合內，你能夠以移動動作把靈動念襲移動至範圍內的另一個方格內；無論如何，它每輪都會繼續對最後停下的方格內的所有敵人造成傷害——如果這些生物沒能通過豁免檢定的話。同一時間只能有單個由你操控的靈動念襲存在著。若靈動念襲的總超載消耗在使用念力凝聚（Gather Power）之前減免之後便降低到了0點，那麼它便不會有持續時間的限制。否則，靈動念襲的持續輪數等同於你的體質調整值，而且在與靈動念襲存在的輪數數量相同的分鐘數內無法創造出另一個靈動念襲。靈動念襲總是會發出聲響且肉眼可見。該豁免DC基於敏捷。

Mobile Wall.name: Mobile Wall（Mobile Wall）
Mobile Wall.description: At 2nd level, the cavalier receives @Compendium[pf1.feats.Mz8ZG6nqW3NKFZhK]{快步跟進} as a bonus feat. He can use this feat while mounted by succeeding at a DC 15 Ride check, directing his mount to move rather than himself. The cavalier gains a +1 bonus to his CMD against attempts to tumble through squares he threatens. At 6th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by an additional +1.

Mockery.name: Mockery（Mockery）
Mockery.description:
The vigilante gains Antagonize as a bonus feat. He can target a creature with the Intimidate version of Antagonize twice each day, rather than just once.

  At 12th level, the effects of the Intimidate version of Antagonize last a number of rounds equal to the vigilante閳ユ獨 Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

Mockingbird.name: 百舌鳥（Mockingbird）
Mockingbird.description: 俠客可以模仿幾乎任何種類的聲音，甚至是動物的叫聲和其他奇怪的聲音都可以。並且，俠客可以將自己發出的的聲音投射出一段距離。這個能力的效果如同法術幻音術，腹語術和扭曲嗓音（Vocal Alteration）UM的集合。俠客必須達到5級才能選擇本天賦。

Modify Onset.name: Modify Onset（Modify Onset）
Modify Onset.description: At 3rd level, you can increase the onset time of poisons you use by up to 1 hour per level. At 9th level, you can alter a poison so that it does not have an onset time, but you can trigger it as a swift action to take effect at any time, regardless of distance. If you do not trigger this poison within 1 week of poisoning a target, the poison dissipates harmlessly. The poison can be detected and removed before it is triggered using any normal methods of detecting and removing poison.

Molten Wings.name: Molten Wings（Molten Wings）
Molten Wings.description:
At 12th level, when entering a bloodrage you can choose to have wings of flame sprout from your back, giving you a fly speed of 60 feet with average maneuverability.

  At 16th level, your fly speed increases to 80 feet with good maneuverability.

Monkey Aspect.name: 猿猴擬態（Monkey Aspect）
Monkey Aspect.description:
猴子是專精於機動性和雙手靈活性的攀爬騙子。

  次級形態：你的攀爬檢定獲得+4表現加值。8級時，這個加值提升至+6。15級時，這個加值提升至+8。

  專攻形態：你變身為一隻大型猿猴（參照怪物圖鑑 pg. 17 兇暴猿）。當處於該形態時，你獲得30尺攀爬速度、昏暗視覺、靈敏嗅覺（30尺）、1d6傷害的齧咬攻擊、2個1d6傷害的爪擊攻擊和你仍然可以用你的手持用（wield）武器，持握（hold）物品，並如常操作物品。8級時，你的攀爬速度提升至50尺，並且你可以用你的尾巴持握（hold）和操作物品就好像你有了第三隻手，但你不能用它持用（wield）武器或盾牌。15級時，你獲得撕扯攻擊，當你的兩個正常變形者利爪均攻擊命中敵人後，造成的額外傷害等同變形者利爪攻擊加上1.5倍力量調整值。

Monkey's Paws.name: Monkey's Paws（Monkey's Paws）
Monkey's Paws.description:
The vigilante gains a climb speed equal to his base speed and a +4 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks.

  The vigilante must have the rooftop infiltrator talent and be at least 5th level to select this talent.

Monsoon Subdomain.name: Monsoon Subdomain（Monsoon Subdomain）
Monsoon Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.478jgozgfbt20u0q]{水流爆發}
  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.7yf67b7y4byj96w7]{操縱水位}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.9s5oseou738k2qif]{Fickle Winds}
  • 9環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ltda70etgwje43x6]{津波}

Monstrous Graft.name: Monstrous Graft（Monstrous Graft）
Monstrous Graft.description: The alchemist can replace up to four of his own amputated limbs with those of a monstrous beast of the same size category. If the grafted limb is an arm, the alchemist gains either a climb speed of 15 feet or a claw or slam natural attack that deals 1d6 points of damage (1d4 for a Small alchemist). If the grafted limb is a leg, the alchemist gains one of the following benefits: a +5 bonus to land speed, a swim speed of 15 feet, or a +5 bonus on Acrobatics checks when jumping. For each limb the alchemist replaces in this manner, he takes a 閳? penalty to Wisdom as he loses his sense of self. Derros are immune to this penalty.

Moon Subdomain.name: Moon Subdomain（Moon Subdomain）
Moon Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.bl71og1gklwncmt7]{妖火}
  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.2mh7g81k30bv7b5m]{精神錯亂}
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ifcnx1yyw6e7ousm]{託夢術}

Moon Totem, Greater.name: Moon Totem, Greater（Moon Totem, Greater）
Moon Totem, Greater.description:
While raging, the barbarian ignores the miss chance for concealment and treats total concealment as concealment.

  She must have the moon totem rage power and be at least 10th level to select this rage power.

Moon Totem, Lesser.name: Moon Totem, Lesser（Moon Totem, Lesser）
Moon Totem, Lesser.description: While raging, the barbarian gains darkvision with a range of 30 feet. If the barbarian already has darkvision, the range of her darkvision increases by 30 feet while she is raging.

Moon Totem.name: Moon Totem（Moon Totem）
Moon Totem.description:
While raging, the barbarian gains a bonus equal to half her level on Perception checks to pinpoint the location of an unseen creature, and unseen attackers gain no bonus on attacks against the barbarian.

  A barbarian must have the lesser moon totem rage power and be at least 6th level to select this rage power.

Moonbeam.name: Moonbeam（Moonbeam）
Moonbeam.description:
You can fire a ray of moonlight as a ranged touch attack at any creature within 30 feet. This ray deals 1d6 points of damage + 1 for every 2 oracle levels you possess. In addition, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save or become blinded for 1 round.

  You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

Moonlight Script.name: Moonlight Script（Moonlight Script）
Moonlight Script.description:
Once per night while you sleep, your hands produce mysterious writing that pertains to the future.

  At 1st level, the prophetic writing manifests as an @Compendium[pf1.spells.d1wxnax51cecplm4]{占卜術} spell with 90% effectiveness.

  At 5th level, the writing takes the form of a @Compendium[pf1.spells.pwueht12qqo0268e]{預言術} with 90% effectiveness.

  At 8th level, the writing manifests as a casting of @Compendium[pf1.spells.p2kosvizylhy8vfa]{通神術} with no material component required.

Moral Crisis.name: Moral Crisis（Moral Crisis）
Moral Crisis.description: As a standard action, you can target a living creature within 30 feet of you, reminding it of its moral failings. The target must succeed at a Will save or be staggered for a number of rounds equal to your oracle level. The target can attempt a new saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end this effect. This is a mind-affecting emotion effect.

More for Me.name: More for Me（More for Me）
More for Me.description:
When another character within 30 feet casts a spell with a range greater than touch, you can attempt a caster level check as an immediate action (DC = 15 + the spell閳ユ獨 level). If you succeed at the check, you receive the spell閳ユ獨 benefit instead of one of the spell閳ユ獨 intended targets (chosen by you). If you are already a target of the spell, you are affected as though you were targeted by the same spell twice (which may or may not benefit you; remember that bonuses from the same source do not stack). This ability does not grant you knowledge of the spell being cast. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Copycat power of the Trickery Domain.

Morphic Form.name: 形態構成（Morphic Form）
Morphic Form.description:
5級起，當你讓黑暗半身佔據主導時，你會獲得DR 5。每當你喚出自己的黑暗半身時，都會變換傷害減免，使它可以被某種隨機的傷害類型所克服，具體見下表。

   %d 傷害減免類型

  1 - 35 DR 5/鈍擊

  36 - 60 DR 5/寒鐵

  61 - 100 DR 5/魔法

Morphic Mask.name: Morphic Mask（Morphic Mask）
Morphic Mask.description:
The vigilante閳ユ獨 physical form in his vigilante identity can differ significantly from that of his social identity, within the norms for his race閳ユ敄his can include changes to the vigilante閳ユ獨 proportions, coloration, gender characteristics, and other physical characteristics. This increases the vigilante閳ユ獨 bonus from seamless guise by 2 for every significant change, as per the Disguise skill. The vigilante always assumes the same form when using this ability.

  A vigilante with multiple natural forms, such as a kitsune, can alter each of his forms using this talent.

Morphic Weaponry.name: Morphic Weaponry（Morphic Weaponry）
Morphic Weaponry.description:
The vigilante can shape his body into weaponry. This acts as the oozemorph shifter閳ユ獨 morphic weaponry ability, treating the vigilante閳ユ獨 level as his shifter level.

  The vigilante must have the shapechanger subtype to select this talent.

Mother's Embrace.name: Mother's Embrace（Mother's Embrace）
Mother's Embrace.description:
The hag閳ユ獨 call grows stronger as you grow more desperate, promising protection and release if only you would succumb. When you would fail a Will save, you can add 1d4 to your result; whether or not this causes you to succeed at the saving throw, you take 2 points of Wisdom damage.

  When you perform an act of cruelty, you regain 1 phrenic pool point. You can use each aspect of this ability a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

Mother's Eye.name: Mother's Eye（Mother's Eye）
Mother's Eye.description:
The witch can see through plant matter, as the greensight universal monster ability (Pathfinder RPG Bestiary 4 295), for a number of minutes per day equal to her witch level.

  These minutes do not need to be consecutive, but must be spent in 1-minute increments.

Mount (1 pt).name: Mount (1 pt)（Mount (1 pt)）
Mount (1 pt).description:
An eidolon is properly skilled and formed to serve as a combat-trained mount. The eidolon must be at least one size category larger than its rider.

  This evolution is only available to eidolons of the quadruped and serpentine base forms.

Mount (UC) (1 pt).name: Mount (UC) (1 pt)（Mount (UC) (1 pt)）
Mount (UC) (1 pt).description:
Requirements: Daemon, demon, devil, elemental, or protean subtype; quadruped or serpentine base form.

  The eidolon is properly skilled and formed to serve as a combat-trained mount.

  The eidolon must be at least one size category larger than its rider.

Mountain Patron.name: Mountain Patron（Mountain Patron）
Mountain Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.879sdozw7ca7ci9k]{石拳術}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.gqtg9ruv8kkd0knf]{召岩術}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.g1evszmk8wfgnsv5]{塑石術}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.hfyycpn0wdimx1n9]{刺石術}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.l83djt5019ujasjh]{石牆術}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.361rc74674l3zt9a]{石化術}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.wgm8mm1za909pwch]{石言術}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.oeemcnfjod9zd7my]{驅離金石}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.o8jhvddxgunzx94i]{巨石碾壓}

Mountainside Ambush.name: Mountainside Ambush（Mountainside Ambush）
Mountainside Ambush.description:
Samsaran only.

  Fighting in the mountains of Zi Ha has trained samsaran slayers to strike the unwary with deadly attacks from above. If a slayer deals sneak attack damage to a creature that is unaware of his presence while he is standing on higher ground than his target, he does not have to roll sneak attack damage; instead, the sneak attack deals maximum damage. The samsaran must be standing on solid ground to use this ability.

Mouse Aspect.name: 老鼠擬態（Mouse Aspect）
Mouse Aspect.description:
老鼠擬態提供了能進入到難以到達的地方，同時避開許多攻擊與效果的能力。

  次級形態：你獲得反射閃避（evasion），如同盜賊職業能力。12級時，此能力提升至精通反射閃避，如同高級盜賊天賦。

  專攻形態：你變身為一隻超小型老鼠（參照怪物圖鑑 pg. 232 兇暴鼠，但是你擁有2.5尺佔據和0尺觸及）。當處於該形態時，你獲得20尺攀爬速度、20尺游泳速度、昏暗視覺、靈敏嗅覺（30尺）、1d4傷害的齧咬攻擊和在攀爬和游泳檢定上使用你的敏捷調整值取代力量調整值。8級時，你的攀爬和游泳速度均提升至40尺。15級時，當你穿過或離開一個生物的威脅區域（threatened area）或進入它的空間時，不會引起藉機攻擊，但當你離開它的空間時仍會引起藉機攻擊。

Mucilaginous Gloom.name: Mucilaginous Gloom（Mucilaginous Gloom）
Mucilaginous Gloom.description: The gloom leaves a chilly gray residue that turns each square in its splash radius into difficult terrain. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to the alchemist閳ユ獨 level.

Mud Witch.name: Mud Witch（Mud Witch）
Mud Witch.description:
A witch with this hex can assume the form of viscous brown mud. The witch閳ユ獨 type changes to ooze and she is able to squeeze through even the smallest cracks, but she can閳ユ獩 make attacks or cast spells with verbal, somatic, material, or focus components while in this form, and she loses her supernatural abilities. If the witch has a touch spell ready to use, that spell is discharged harmlessly when she uses this hex. While the witch is in mud form, her speed becomes 10 feet and she gains a swim speed of 20 feet. The witch gains DR 10/slashing and cold resistance 10.

  At 10th level, while the witch is in mud form, her speed increases to 20 feet and her swim speed increases to 40 feet. She can use this ability for a number of minutes per day equal to her level.

  The duration doesn閳ユ獩 need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments. This hex affects only the witch.

  The witch must have the swamp hag hex to select this hex.

Murksight.name: Murksight（Murksight）
Murksight.description:
The witch can see through natural fog, mist, and rain without penalty, ignoring any concealment bonuses gained from such effects. If the effect is created by magic, the witch can see up to 15 feet without penalty, with normal penalties and effects applying beyond that distance.

  This ability functions underwater as well, allowing the witch to see in murky water as though it were clear.

  This does not allow the witch to see anything she could not see otherwise, such as an invisible creature.

Mutable Flesh.name: Mutable Flesh（Mutable Flesh）
Mutable Flesh.description: At 3rd level, once per day when you cast a transmutation spell with a duration of 1 minute per level that affects only you, you can increase its duration to 10 minutes per level. At 9th level, you can increase the duration to 1 hour per level.

Mutagen (Discovery).name: 突變藥劑(科研發現)（Mutagen (Discovery)）
Mutagen (Discovery).description: 選擇此能力的鍊金術師得到“突變藥劑”職業特性。此能力詳見鍊金術師基礎職業。【譯註：這是給某些職業變體補回“突變藥劑”特性用的。】

Mystic Veil.name: Mystic Veil（Mystic Veil）
Mystic Veil.description:
Samsaran only.

  Samsaran slayers are adept at obscuring the passes of their mountain homes from intruders. The slayer can cast @Compendium[pf1.spells.kq916lznxo0ig68v]{無聲幻影} as a spell-like ability once per day for every 2 slayer levels he has, using his slayer level as his caster level. The slayer uses his Intelligence modifier on concentration checks when using this ability, and the DC to disbelieve the illusion is equal to 11 + the slayer閳ユ獨 Intelligence modifier.

  The slayer must have an Intelligence score of at least 11 to select this talent.

Naga Bloodrager Bloodline.name: Naga Bloodrager Bloodline（Naga Bloodrager Bloodline）
Naga Bloodrager Bloodline.description:
The blood of the powerful, serpentine aberrations known as nagas runs through your veins, fueling your bloodrage.

獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Q1cY8r0Pvb66pMG0]{警覺}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.u7rGDZUL296QIuA0]{戰斗施法}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.h9nHYLxXvIXBTmup]{戰斗反射}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.JreaiTHdyWFNj3Tb]{閃避}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.0bZf3SDkvVOe2ujH]{閃電反射}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.FUW5mIXHNBBIQ1Sq]{猛力攻擊}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.f5FPqAYWlKj3zCIY]{隱秘}

  獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.mczdgwo3xl8c6e26]{衰弱射線} (7th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.oylikodnyku2zewu]{隱形術} (10th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.m84969gni5iu4bdt]{閃電束} (13th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.vdh0yuzpjwhky6kr]{毒擊術} (16th)

Naga Defenses.name: Naga Defenses（Naga Defenses）
Naga Defenses.description:
At 8th level, when entering a bloodrage, you gain a +2 enhancement bonus to your natural armor bonus and a +4 bonus on saves against poison.

  At 16th level, the bonus to your natural armor increases to +4 and the bonus on saves against poison increases to +8.

  At 20th level, the bonus to your natural armor increases to +6, and you gain immunity to poison.

Naga Form.name: Naga Form（Naga Form）
Naga Form.description: At 16th level, when entering a bloodrage, you can assume the form of a naga (as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.p8mgf91fcmsi0kdk]{Naga Shape III}).

Naga Thoughts.name: Naga Thoughts（Naga Thoughts）
Naga Thoughts.description: At 20th level, when entering a bloodrage, you become immune to charm effects and all forms of mind reading, you gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against other mind-affecting effects, you gain the effects of the spell @Compendium[pf1.spells.nokru6mxk9p3r513]{識破隱形}, and you can use @Compendium[pf1.spells.xllxylvvqr82o2d5]{偵測思想} at will.

Nanite Bloodline.name: Nanite Bloodline（Nanite Bloodline）
Nanite Bloodline.description:
Your conception was marked by alien influences.

  本職技能(s): @JournalEntry[dfjwbMEdt062TJtE]{知識}：工程.

  獎勵法術:

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.oj36nfak6jc2s5ky]{易容術} (3rd),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.22xn589bmr7ginow]{Defensive Shock} (5th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.mqdoexj35atgqafn]{氣化形體} (7th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.frp3ioj2ny5br5ti]{Miasmatic Form} (9th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wuispaydz8jvw3io]{Echolocation} (11th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.h4nlrm44ubsyzuhz]{液體形態} (13th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.u0qadkpm7dglk6kz]{Magnetic Field}(15th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.mkrjbrp57yfdqrx0]{鋼筋鐵骨} (17th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.n3lp01euzcdmtbw5]{形體變化} (19th).

  獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.pmAO1Sni8xx71pLF]{盲斗},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.NFxHebU1XhEs5WJh]{寓守於攻},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.JreaiTHdyWFNj3Tb]{閃避},
  •  Eldritch Heritage, 
  • Expanded Arcana,
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.711B9WNFgpdDKKf2]{精通卸武},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.0bZf3SDkvVOe2ujH]{閃電反射},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.7zJTztNW7hdaqjKc]{技能專攻} (知識：工程).

  血統奧秘: Whenever you cast a spell from the transmutation school and target only yourself, increase the spell閳ユ獨 duration by 50%. This does not stack with metamagic feats or abilities such as @Compendium[pf1.feats.btXWioB3SKJv8YEG]{法術延時}.

Nanite Resurgence.name: Nanite Resurgence（Nanite Resurgence）
Nanite Resurgence.description:
At 9th level, once per day as an immediate action upon being reduced to one-quarter your maximum hit points, you can force the mechanical swarm living inside you to keep you alive. This ability functions like a @Compendium[pf1.spells.u7y6niex9e7tbhyp]{轉靈強愈劑} spell using your sorcerer level as the caster level, except it is an extraordinary ability and cannot be dispelled.

  At 17th level, you can use this ability twice per day (though using this ability twice in one 24-hour period entails a chance of system shock and death; see the spell閳ユ獨 description for more details).

  At 20th level, you never die of system shock from using this ability.

Nanite Strike.name: Nanite Strike（Nanite Strike）
Nanite Strike.description:
At 1st level as a free action, you can cause nanites to flow from your body and coat the striking end of any manufactured melee weapon you wield. When you hit with a melee attack using this weapon, some of the nanites infect the blood of the victim (Poison閳ユ攰njury; save Fort DC 10 + 1/2 your sorcerer level + your Con modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1 Str damage; cure 1 save).

  At 5th level, weapons you use with this ability are treated as magical for the purposes of overcoming DR, and the poison also deals 1 point of Constitution damage. At 7th level, the damage increases to 1d2 points of Constitution damage and 1d2 points of Strength damage. At 11th level, the cure becomes two successful saves.

  You can use this ability for a number of rounds per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier; these rounds need not be consecutive.

Nanite Surge.name: Nanite Surge（Nanite Surge）
Nanite Surge.description:
At 3rd level, once per day as an immediate action, you can cause your nanites to surge, granting you a bonus equal to 3 + your sorcerer level on any one d20 roll; this ability must be activated before the roll is made. If you already possess the nanite surge ability from another source (such as from being an android), you can use your nanite surge an additional time per day.

  At 9th level, you can use this ability an additional time per day.

Nature's Gifts.name: Nature's Gifts（Nature's Gifts）
Nature's Gifts.description: Once per day, the shaman can command trees and other plants to yield magical berries and fruit. This ability functions as @Compendium[pf1.spells.k4whhwm1dsz2upkm]{神莓}, except the maximum number of hit points it can restore to a subject in a 24-hour period from this hex is equal to the shaman閳ユ獨 Charisma modifier (minimum 1 hit point per day).

Nature's Thorns.name: Nature's Thorns（Nature's Thorns）
Nature's Thorns.description: At 16th level, creatures that hit you in melee (other than those using manufactured reach weapons) take 4d6 points of piercing damage. A creature takes this damage only on its first successful attack against you in a combat round, and not on subsequent attacks in that round.

Necromancy Resonant School.name: 死靈靈器（Necromancy Resonant School）
Necromancy Resonant School.description:
死靈靈器從死靈魔法中汲取操控死者傷害活物的力量。

  靈器（Implements）：骨骼、硬幣、玩偶、鼓、長袍、骷髏頭。

Necromantic Focus.name: 死靈專精（Necromantic Focus）
Necromantic Focus.description: 靈器給予持有者更強的操控不死之力。靈氣內每填充入1點心智點，持有者就可以額外操控2HD的不死生物（最高額外為4X秘學士等級個HD）。施法者釋放創造不死生物的死靈系法術時，可以將該靈器作為額外的器材施法懲罰。如此做會創造出額外HD的不死生物，額外HD數額等於可額外控制的不死生物HD數（計算該效果在褻瀆術等雙倍HD限制之後）。另外，靈器內每填充有4點心智點，不死生物對抗持有者的法術時豁免檢定就承受-1罰值。

Necromantic Servant.name: 死靈僕人（Necromantic Servant）
Necromantic Servant.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點喚起一個人類骷髏或人類殭屍，為你服務每秘學士等級10分鐘或直到被摧毀。該僕人hp等於你最大hp的一半（不計入臨時hp或其它臨時調整）。它使用你的基本攻擊加值，傷害獲得1/2秘學士等級的加值。5級時，當死靈僕人被摧毀時，若你在它中距範圍內（100尺+每等級10尺），你可以用直覺動作消耗1點心智點讓死靈僕人回覆滿生命值。9級時，你可以選擇給予它血腥或燃燒簡易範本（如果是骷髏）或快速簡易範本（如果是殭屍）。13級時，當你用直覺動作為僕人回覆生命值時，它會分裂成兩個。最多可同時存在等於你1/2秘學士等級個數的死靈僕人。17級時，你選擇一個團隊專長，你所有死靈僕人都會獲得該團隊專長。

Neutralizing Bomb.name: Neutralizing Bomb（Neutralizing Bomb）
Neutralizing Bomb.description:
When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to give it the potential to end certain ongoing effects instead of dealing damage. Each creature in the splash radius can attempt a new saving throw against any poison afflicting it and any ongoing conditions or ongoing acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. (If an effect did not allow a saving throw, this bomb doesn閳ユ獩 allow affected creatures to attempt one.) Success counts as one successful save toward ending poison and immediately ends other conditions. Exposed poison in the splash radius is also rendered harmless. A creature with poison abilities that is directly struck by the bomb finds those abilities useless for 1d4 rounds unless it succeeds at a Fortitude saving throw.

  This discovery doesn閳ユ獩 stack with any other that modifies bombs.

Night Terror.name: Night Terror（Night Terror）
Night Terror.description:
You send your spirit to torment another being閳ユ獨 dreams. Once per day, you may target a creature with the effects of a @Compendium[pf1.spells.siv3ub7hbmcklf8c]{夢魘} spell. Instead of the spell閳ユ獨 normal damage, you make a full attack, using your Charisma modifier in place of your Strength modifier, against the victim閳ユ獨 touch AC. You deal 1d10 damage for each successful hit.

  You must be at least 11th level before selecting this revelation.

Nightblindness (Stare).name: Nightblindness (Stare)（Nightblindness (Stare)）
Nightblindness (Stare).description: The darkvision range of the hypnotic stare閳ユ獨 target decreases by 10 feet.

Nightmare (Stare).name: Nightmare (Stare)（Nightmare (Stare)）
Nightmare (Stare).description: The target of the hypnotic stare rolls twice on all Will saves versus fear, taking the lower result.

Nightmares Patron.name: Nightmares Patron（Nightmares Patron）
Nightmares Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.3plb67e51webutdz]{睡眠術}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.xllxylvvqr82o2d5]{偵測思想}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.j7mhkhixnvd0amye]{Oneiric Horror}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.6efjgs1qvmj6yxqv]{魅影殺手}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.siv3ub7hbmcklf8c]{夢魘}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.laz5zb1cdfb9jzit]{Dream Travel}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ylewzn5nlzy7ugdm]{Symbol Of Weakness}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.21r9ptvsjo99o3yw]{短訊暗示}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.0mt9mso6wdhfafpo]{Polar Midnight}

Nimble Walker.name: Nimble Walker（Nimble Walker）
Nimble Walker.description: At 20th level, you gain a +5 racial bonus on Reflex saving throws and on Acrobatics checks made to move through a creature閳ユ獨 threatened area or through its space. You also gain the ability to breathe while passing through earth using your earth glide ability.

Nine-Tailed Kineticist.name: Nine-Tailed Kineticist（Nine-Tailed Kineticist）
Nine-Tailed Kineticist.description:
Element universal; Type utility (Su); Level 1; Burn 0
Prerequisite kitsune

  You can cast a spell-like ability granted to you by any Magical Tail feat you have by accepting 1 point of burn, even if you have no daily uses of that spell-like ability remaining. You must be able to use wild talents of a level equal to the number of extra tails required to use a spell-like ability granted by a Magic Tail feat to use this ability to cast that spell-like ability (for example, you would need to be 15th level and able to use 8th-level wild talents to use this talent to cast the dominate person spell-like ability granted by Magical Tail).

  In addition, you can learn a Magical Tail feat that you qualify for in place of gaining a new infusion or utility wild talent.

No Breath (4 pts).name: No Breath (4 pts)（No Breath (4 pts)）
No Breath (4 pts).description:
An eidolon no longer needs to breathe. The eidolon does not breathe, and is immune to effects that require breathing (such as inhaled poison). This does not give immunity to cloud or gas attacks that do not require breathing.

  The summoner must be at least 11th level before selecting this evolution.

No Breath.name: No Breath（No Breath）
No Breath.description:
Element void; Type utility (Su); Level 2; Burn 閳?br>Prerequisite emptiness

  You gain no breath, as per the universal monster ability, and you can survive in the vacuum of space.

No Place Like Home.name: No Place Like Home（No Place Like Home）
No Place Like Home.description:
The witch fills an ally with the safety he feels at home or inflicts pangs of homesickness to hamper an enemy閳ユ獨 defenses. She chooses a target for the hex within 30 feet. If she chooses an ally, that ally gains a +2 dodge bonus to AC against traps and on Reflex saves against traps. If she chooses an opponent, that opponent takes a 閳? penalty to AC against traps and on Reflex saves against traps. Either way, the effects last for 1 minute. The target can attempt a Will save to negate the effects of the hex.

  At 8th level, the bonus or penalty increases to 4.

  At 16th level, the bonus or penalty increases to 6.

  A creature targeted by this hex cannot be targeted again by this hex for 1 day.

Noble Visage.name: Noble Visage（Noble Visage）
Noble Visage.description:
You gain a +1 bonus on Charisma checks and Charisma-based skill checks against creatures that share your creature type (and subtype, if you are a humanoid). This bonus increases by 1 for every 5 levels you possess.

As a standard action, you can touch an ally to grant her your noble visage bonus against creatures that share her creature type (or subtype) for 1 minute. When you use this ability, you lose your noble visage bonus for 1 minute. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Inspiring Word power of the Nobility Domain.

Nostrum.name: Nostrum（Nostrum）
Nostrum.description:
When the alchemist creates an infusion, he can mask a delayed poison within the mixture. A nostrum can contain only an ingested poison, and the save DC of the poison is reduced by 2. The poison takes effect a number of hours after being imbibed equal to the alchemist閳ユ獨 Intelligence bonus (minimum 0) decided by the alchemist at the creation of the nostrum. The poison within a nostrum can be detected as normal by spells such as detect poison and similar abilities. Until the nostrum is consumed or destroyed, it continues to occupy one of the alchemist閳ユ獨 daily extract slots.

  An alchemist must have the infusion discovery before selecting this discovery.

Nothing Can Stop Me.name: 打倒一切（Nothing Can Stop Me）
Nothing Can Stop Me.description: 每輪一次，當俠客在進行移動時，他可以以自由動作發動一次攻擊來擊碎擋在在他前進路線上的無主物品，比如門和桌子。如果俠客造成的傷害成功地摧毀了該物品，那他可以接著繼續移動；如果他未能擊破該物品，那麼俠客的移動會被迫停止。俠客的這次攻擊視為他移動動作的一部分並且不計入他在該輪的攻擊次數。如果俠客不小心打的是一個生物（比如一隻偽裝成物品的擬形怪），那麼俠客的攻擊嘗試自動失手，他被迫停止移動（但俠客仍然可能在結束移動後正常對該生物發動攻擊）。只有選擇復仇騎士之道的俠客才能選擇本天賦。

Notorious Fool.name: Notorious Fool（Notorious Fool）
Notorious Fool.description:
While in his social identity, the vigilante can feign absentmindedness, clumsiness, drunkenness, or eccentricity very convincingly. When he fails an opposed Sleight of Hand or Stealth check while in his social identity, he can immediately attempt a Bluff check opposed by the onlookers閳?Sense Motive checks to appear as though he had only blundered or stumbled in a spectacular fashion. If he succeeds at this Bluff check, the onlookers do not realize the vigilante was attempting the action that prompted him to attempt a Sleight of Hand or Stealth check, although being in the wrong place or behaving in an inappropriate manner may still have negative consequences.

  This talent is ineffective against any onlooker who has already witnessed the vigilante faking a blunder within the last 24 hours.

Numb to the Pain.name: Numb to the Pain（Numb to the Pain）
Numb to the Pain.description: You gain a morale bonus equal to your Charisma bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting spells and effects. This bonus cannot exceed your psychic level.

Numerical Alchemy, Greater.name: Numerical Alchemy, Greater（Numerical Alchemy, Greater）
Numerical Alchemy, Greater.description:
The investigator can calculate his movements and account for his reactions to danger or unexpected situations with lightning speed. He can expend a use of inspiration to mix an extract as a standard action.

  The investigator must have the numerical alchemy talent and be at least 11th level to select this talent.

Numerical Alchemy.name: Numerical Alchemy（Numerical Alchemy）
Numerical Alchemy.description: The investigator閳ユ獨 skill with mental mathematics allows him to know exactly which muscle movements are necessary to mix an extract in the quickest, most efficient way. The investigator can expend one use of inspiration to mix an extract in 1 round (as opposed to 1 minute).

Numerical Strike, Greater.name: Numerical Strike, Greater（Numerical Strike, Greater）
Numerical Strike, Greater.description:
Once per day, when the investigator has confirmed a critical hit with a studied strike, he can deal the strike閳ユ獨 maximum damage instead of rolling damage as normal. This includes the damage dealt by the successful attack as well as the additional damage from the studied strike. He can expend a use of inspiration to use this ability a second time per day. Using this ability doesn閳ユ獩 require an action.

  The investigator must have the numerical strike talent and be at least 13th level to select this talent.

Numerical Strike, Masterful.name: Numerical Strike, Masterful（Numerical Strike, Masterful）
Numerical Strike, Masterful.description:
The investigator can use both numerical strike and greater numerical strike three times per day. The investigator doesn閳ユ獩 need to expend uses of inspiration to use either ability, but he can never use either more than three times per day each.

  The investigator must have the numerical strike and greater numerical strike talents and be at least 17th level to select this talent.

Numerical Strike.name: Numerical Strike（Numerical Strike）
Numerical Strike.description:
Once per day when the investigator has confirmed a critical hit with a studied strike, he can deal average damage instead of rolling damage as normal. This includes the damage dealt by the successful attack as well as the additional damage from the studied strike.

  He can expend a use of inspiration to use this ability a second time per day.

  Using this ability doesn閳ユ獩 require an action.

  The investigator must be at least 5th level to select this talent.

Oaken Skin.name: Oaken Skin（Oaken Skin）
Oaken Skin.description:
At 4th level, when entering a bloodrage, your skin thickens like bark and you gain a +2 enhancement bonus to your natural armor.

  At 8th level and every 4 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by 1.

Obey.name: 服從（Obey）
Obey.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點靈器之力命令一個活物遵守你的命令。該效果如同命令術法術一般。目標必須在你30尺以內且能聽懂你的命令。目標可進行意志豁免免除該效果。若目標與你為同一生物類型，該次豁免承受-2罰值。

Object Reading.name: 觸物感知（Object Reading）
Object Reading.description: 2級起，秘學士習得如何通過調查物品閱讀訊息。用此法調查物品需要他花費1分鐘時間操弄該物品。若物品為魔法物品，他會知道它的特性和命令字，如同成功使用偵測魔法並且法術辨識檢定成功一般。若秘學士職業等級低於物品的施法者等級，他將不會揭露出詛咒物品的存在。如果物品有任何歷史意義，秘學士可得知一部分關於過去的訊息（由GM決定）。最後，若某物品距離最後一次使用時的天數不超過每秘學士等級1天，他可得知該物品最後一個使用者的部分訊息。這種訊息可以是使用者外表的一瞥，關於最後一次使用時的短暫景象或者最後一次使用時使用者的心情。由GM決定到底會獲得何種什麼訊息。這種效果類似於psychometry異能技能解放（見本書196頁），但無需技能檢定且可以任意使用。

Object Seer.name: 物尋其源（Object Seer）
Object Seer.description: 以一個整輪動作，你消耗1點心智點觀察到一件你所擁有物品的過去。你可以詢問一個必須關於該物品的問題，比如“你的力量是什麼”、“你最後一個主人的身份”或“發生事件時你在哪”這樣。你會從物品的精神印象中獲得答案，大多數時候都是模糊不清的影像或誤導。該能力其它方面如同通神術法術。你必須至少7級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Obliterate Memory.name: Obliterate Memory（Obliterate Memory）
Obliterate Memory.description:
As a standard action, you can target a creature within 30 feet and eliminate all memory of an event the target experienced, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.5ll7q13p0skbgonc]{修改記憶}. A target can attempt a Will save to negate this effect. In addition, you can cause an account of the memory erased by this ability to appear on a blank page of any book you are carrying.

  You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day at 15th level.

  You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

Obscuring Blow.name: Obscuring Blow（Obscuring Blow）
Obscuring Blow.description: Once per day, the rogue can forgo her potential to deal sneak attack damage to attempt to cloud an opponent閳ユ獨 vision. She must declare the use of obscuring blow before she makes the attack. If the attack hits, it does normal damage but, instead of dealing sneak attack damage (and any effect that triggers when the rogue deals sneak attack damage), the target treats all other creatures as if they had concealment, suffering a 20% miss chance on all attack rolls for a number of rounds equal to half the rogue閳ユ獨 level. A successful Fortitude saving throw reduces this effect to 1 round. The DC of this saving throw is equal to 10 + 1/2 the rogue閳ユ獨 level + the rogue閳ユ獨 Intelligence modifier.

Obscurity.name: Obscurity（Obscurity）
Obscurity.description:
The vigilante is relatively unknown socially. In fact, he makes a point of keeping the life of his social identity as ordinary as possible. This social talent functions exactly as the renown social talent, but instead of improving the starting attitude of all NPCs within the community, it empowers the vigilante so that he no longer needs to succeed at Disguise checks to appear as his social identity while assuming that identity within his area of obscurity. He still has to attempt Disguise checks when NPCs within this settlement are confronted with indisputable proof that the vigilante could be more than he appears to be, such as when he uses a vigilante talent while in his social identity. This social talent counts as renown for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of social talents that list renown as a prerequisite and can be improved by such talents.

  A vigilante with this talent cannot select renown, nor can he select any social talent that requires him to be famous (such as celebrity discount or celebrity perks).

Occult Dungeoneer.name: Occult Dungeoneer（Occult Dungeoneer）
Occult Dungeoneer.description: Street thieves in Absalom expect wares to be securely locked, and sometimes it takes high-quality tools and magic training to ensure there閳ユ獨 a meal at the end of the day. A rogue with this ability can use spell-trigger and spell-completion items as if the following spells were on a spell list to which he has access: detect secret doors, detect traps, knock, locate object, and obscure object. If the spell-trigger device allows a wielder to apply his own caster level (such as with a staff ), the rogue may use his class level as his caster level. The rogue may also use knock as a supernatural ability once per day, using his rogue level as his caster level.

Occult Final Revelation.name: Occult Final Revelation（Occult Final Revelation）
Occult Final Revelation.description: Upon reaching 20th level, you become one with the spirits. You become immune to death effects, exhaustion, fatigue, nausea, negative levels, and the sickened condition. You can cast @Compendium[pf1.spells.lnahlmp5mih2ongh]{星界投射} and @Compendium[pf1.spells.jbqo4o2b2tmdz7wv]{真知術} once per day as spell-like abilities without requiring material components. Should you die, you rise again 2d4 days later as a ghost.

Occult Mystery.name: Occult Mystery（Occult Mystery）
Occult Mystery.description:
本職技能: An oracle with the occult mystery adds Bluff, Disguise, Knowledge ：神秘, and Use Magic Device to her list of class skills.

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jhyb2ana8jrk2lut]{隱形仆役} (2nd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.oplskt3tgws8ujv8]{幽靈手}(4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.6kmkxepwgsbta6ui]{銳耳術/鷹眼術} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.g66w32kdup1f43bp]{探知} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.68ngvzmzvadhf6vs]{異界探知} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.0w3hvcp3gb2bhtv5]{投影術} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.aqeaxoaozlv9vg35]{靈視} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.2vb5orfcy57lrfmc]{片刻預知} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lnahlmp5mih2ongh]{星界投射} (18th).

Occulted Soul.name: Occulted Soul（Occulted Soul）
Occulted Soul.description: A ninja with this trick can still her mind to bypass magical detection. The ninja can spend 1 ki point to cast @Compendium[pf1.spells.awia42zci8nufpfl]{回避偵測} on herself as a spell-like ability, with a caster level equal to her ninja level.

Octopus Aspect.name: Octopus Aspect（Octopus Aspect）
Octopus Aspect.description:
The octopus is a cunning hunter, able to contort its malleable body with ease.

Minor Form: You gain a +4 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks.

  It increases to +6 at 8th level and +8 at 15th level.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of an octopus. While in this form, you gain the aquatic subtype, a swim speed of 30 feet, low-light vision, a bite attack (1d3), a tentacles attack (no damage) with the grab ability, and Multiattack as a bonus feat.

  At 8th level, you gain the jet ability (200 feet).

  At 15th level, you gain the ability to produce an ink cloud (see below) and deal an amount of bludgeoning damage with your tentacles attack equal to the damage dealt by your shifter claws.

Ink Cloud (Ex): While within water, you can emit a 10-foot-radius sphere of ink once per minute as a swift action. This ink provides total concealment and persists for 1 minute.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Bite (B, P, S), tentacle (B)

Omnikinesis.name: 萬力全能（Omnikinesis）
Omnikinesis.description: 20級起，操念使會超越不同元素間的界限，可以按照自身的意志塑造一切。通過承受1點超載（在她所選擇的任何念襲所要求的超載之外），她能夠使用任意自身並不瞭解的念襲原力（blast wild talent）。通過以標準動作承受1點超載，她能夠選擇將任何已知的原力變為任意一個類別相同的其他原力（比如簡易念襲或護身原力），持續24小時，這會忽略任何關於元素的要求或者制約（但並不能無視其他先決條件和制約）。

One Body, Two Minds.name: One Body, Two Minds（One Body, Two Minds）
One Body, Two Minds.description: At 15th level, once per day, you can improve the effectiveness of a single spell by having your possessing spirit channel that spell. The spell acts as though it were affected by both the @Compendium[pf1.feats.2YuxcUNFMPNBpekG]{法術默發} and @Compendium[pf1.feats.jVFjMIyQD6TOAsmj]{法術定發} metamagic feats. If the spell chosen is a mind-affecting spell, it also benefits from the @Compendium[pf1.feats.btXWioB3SKJv8YEG]{法術延時} metamagic feat. This ability does not use up a spell slot higher than the level of the base spell, nor does it increase the level of the base spell.

One of Those Faces.name: One of Those Faces（One of Those Faces）
One of Those Faces.description: Each day, you can use disguise self as a spell-like ability for up to 10 minutes per character level. This duration need not be continuous, but it must be used in 10-minute increments. Additionally, once you have used this ability, whenever you use it for the next 24 hours you must take the same alternate appearance.

One with Nature.name: One with Nature（One with Nature）
One with Nature.description: At 16th level, creatures of the animal or plant types don閳ユ獩 attack you unless compelled to do so by magic or you attack them first. Three times per day, you can transport yourself from one tree to another tree, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.6x6epf4g5wgzl1gh]{融身入林} with half the transport range. Moving from one tree to another in this manner is a move action. You gain these abilities even while not bloodraging.

Oneiromancy.name: 圓夢（Oneiromancy）
Oneiromancy.description: 以標準動作，你能夠干預昏睡生物的精神。你向著昏睡生物的精神中植入一段潛意識，這需要嘗試一次交涉或威嚇檢定來改變該生物的態度或者提出一個要求（request a service）。若檢定成功，當該生物醒來時，它的行為舉止會按照你說的來表現，不過這也要遵循交涉或威嚇技能的正常限制。圓夢的目標不會意識到自己遭受了操控，但如果你對目標進行的交涉檢定失敗，它對你的起始態度可能會變得更差，就如同正常情況一般。你必須與昏睡的生物相鄰才能使用該能力。作為一種選擇，你可以在施放託夢術（Dream）、弱效託夢術ARG（Minor Dream）或夢魘（Nightmare）時，以施法的一部分使用該能力。在此情況下，圓夢的效果會在法術施放時發生。每日使用該能力的次數為3 + 你的魅力調整值。不會做夢的生物免疫該效果。

Ongoing Defense.name: 持續防護（Ongoing Defense）
Ongoing Defense.description: 異能者能夠增強那些強化自身心智防護力的法術，延長它們的持續時間。她能夠在施放任何智能壁壘（Intellect Fortress），精神屏障（Mental Barrier），思維護盾（Thought Shield）或意志鋼塔（Tower of Iron Will）法術（均出自本書）的時候，從精神力池中花費1點精神力，來使得法術的持續時間延長1輪。

Ooze Blight.name: Ooze Blight（Ooze Blight）
Ooze Blight.description: A target hit by the alchemist閳ユ獨 bomb loses the split special quality for 1d4 rounds. In addition, against creatures with the ooze type, this bomb deals untyped damage that bypasses all resistances.

Order of the Reins.name: Order of the Reins（Order of the Reins）
Order of the Reins.description:
The cavaliers of the order of the reins hold a strong rapport not just with their mounts, but with all tamed and domesticated animals on Golarion. From camels and horses to teams of sled dogs, these cavaliers hold themselves honor-bound to protect these creatures for their labor and loyalty. Cavaliers of the order of the reins often serve as the commanders of caravans or other expeditions, using their unique skills to ensure that the caravan and its wares safely reach their intended markets.

守則： The cavalier must do everything in his power to keep a caravan or traveling group safe once he has agreed to protect it. He must see that any allied animal injured under his watch is healed, or personally give it a merciful death if survival is not an option. He must not let any animal under his command suffer needlessly.

挑戰： Whenever an order of the reins cavalier issues a challenge, all allied animals, animal companions, familiars, and mounts within 60 feet gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls and a +2 bonus to AC against the target. This bonus increases by 1 for every additional 4 levels the cavalier has.

技能： An order of the reins cavalier adds Appraise and Perception to his list of class skills. Any animal that the cavalier is riding can use the cavalier閳ユ獨 Handle Animal modifier in place of its own Acrobatics and Swim skill modifiers as long as the cavalier is mounted on it.

Order of the Scales.name: Order of the Scales（Order of the Scales）
Order of the Scales.description:
Members of this cavalier order serve the cause of legal integrity. Many order of the scales cavaliers track down and apprehend fleeing lawbreakers so that these vagrants may answer for their crimes and make good on their debts. They often serve as judges or stakeholders, and work to ensure that wherever a bargain is made閳ユ敋hether it is monetary, a life debt, or an oath to be upheld閳ユ攤oth ends make good on their promises.

守則：The cavalier must fulfill all binding agreements he makes with others. If a bargain becomes impossible to fulfill, he must satisfactorily compensate all aggrieved or adversely affected parties involved in the bargain. When serving as a judge or arbiter, the cavalier must make fair, impartial judgments, and if unable to do so, must recuse himself at the earliest possibility. If authorized to enforce an agreement, the cavalier must wholeheartedly strive to accomplish this, remaining unswayed by threats, bribery, and other deterrents.

挑戰： Whenever an order of the scales cavalier issues a challenge, he receives a +1 morale bonus on combat maneuvers and attacks of opportunity made against the target of his challenge. This bonus increases by 1 for every 4 levels the cavalier possesses.

技能： An order of the scales cavalier adds Knowledge ：地方 (Int) and Linguistics (Int) to his list of class skills. He gains a bonus equal to half his level (minimum +1) on Sense Motive checks to determine whether someone is bluffing and to determine whether a creature閳ユ獨 behavior is being inf luenced by an enchantment.

Order of the Songbird.name: Order of the Songbird（Order of the Songbird）
Order of the Songbird.description:
Samurai of the order of the songbird are artists, scholars, and poets. They treat battle as a beautiful art form; many of these samurai seek pacifistic means of defeating their foes. Even samurai of this order who kill their opponents do so with respect, considering such a fight to be an act of poetic tragedy. These samurai are most common in lands where beauty is treasured, such as Hwanggot, Jinin, and Tianjing.

守則： The samurai must never destroy art unless doing so is part of an artful act or performance of her own. She must respect the skill of her opponents and never desecrate or purposefully humiliate a foe. If she takes a sapient life, she must create a piece of art, performance, or poem in honor of the fallen creature or creatures in order to memorialize what she has taken from the world.

挑戰： An order of the songbird samurai gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC and a +1 sacred bonus on saves against the attacks and abilities of the target of her challenge. This bonus increases by 1 for every 4 class levels the samurai has. The samurai must be wearing light or no armor, not using a shield, and carrying no more than a light load to gain this benefit.

技能： An order of the songbird samurai adds Knowledge ：宗教 (Int) and Perform (Cha) to her list of class skills. The samurai adds half her level to Craft checks and Profession (gardener) checks.

Orderly Casting.name: Orderly Casting（Orderly Casting）
Orderly Casting.description: The arcanist can tie her spells to the rigid order of Axis, giving them predictable results. As a swift action, she can spend 1 point from her arcane reservoir. For the next minute, her spells deal damage as if she had rolled exactly average on all of the dice, rounded down. To find the average, treat the arcanist as if she had rolled 2-1/2 on all d4s, 3-1/2 on all d6s, 4-1/2 on all d8s, 5-1/2 on all d10s, and 6-1/2 on all d12s. For example, if a 3rd-level arcanist used this exploit and cast burning hands, the spell would deal a total of 7 points of damage.

Oscillation (Stare).name: Oscillation (Stare)（Oscillation (Stare)）
Oscillation (Stare).description: The target of the hypnotic stare treats all enemies beyond 30 feet (except the mesmerist) as having concealment (20% miss chance).

Outside Contact.name: 異界接觸（Outside Contact）
Outside Contact.description:
8級起，秘學士將知曉一名特定異界生物的真名。該異界生物的HD不能超過3。當秘學士繪製魔法陣時，他可以額外消耗1點心智點讓魔法陣改為對內防護，並於陣內呼喚出該異界生物，如同使用次級異界束縛。該生物最多被束縛10分鐘。時限內，秘學士可以與它進行交易以獲得訊息。他需要支付至少20gp（或至少價值這個數值的該生物感興趣的物品）。交易需要秘學士以一次交涉或威嚇檢定對抗該生物的察言觀色檢定開始。檢定結果成功5點或更高會將代價降低為10gp。失敗則代價增長為30gp，而失敗5點或更多會讓該生物逃離而得不到任何訊息（或是吞了代價）。所要獲得的訊息必須是可以通過預言術法術獲得的訊息。該訊息一定是正確的，但經常為隱語或暗喻。交易談妥後該生物需要1d3小時來收集訊息，並在之後返回魔法陣內完成交易。就算該生物與秘學士為同一陣營，也會對如此驅使感到憤怒。在訊息與代價皆交付完畢後，魔法陣會失去效果，該生物返回它的本源位面。

  12級及之後的每4級時，秘學士將會得知一個額外的同類型或非同類異界生物的聯繫方式。儘管同一時間他只能呼喚來一名異界生物，但他在8級後每有4個等級，就可以額外詢問一個問題（最高20級時4個問題），而代價不變。不過，所有問題必須互相之間有所關聯。

  16級時，若選擇不詢問問題，秘學士可以讓該生物給自己親身所知的友善生物傳遞一段訊息作為替代。或者，秘學士可以拜託該生物幫忙運送不重於1磅的一件物品。此兩種用法都需要進行前文所述的技能對抗檢定。兩種傳送都需要1d4小時，但若接受者在秘學士1裡以內（或者接受者在視線內），則傳送耗時降低為1d6分鐘。秘學士必須精準無誤地描述接受者的外貌和姓名。該能力無法將物品傳送到地點上，也無法傳送給對秘學士敵對的生物或敵人手上。

Overbearing Assault (UC).name: Overbearing Assault (UC)（Overbearing Assault (UC)）
Overbearing Assault (UC).description: The monk attacks relentlessly, backing his foe into a corner. If the attack hits, the monk can perform a free reposition combat maneuver against the target of the strike (using the base attack bonus of the attack used to hit the foe) with a 閳? penalty. This reposition attempt does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

Overflowing Grace.name: Overflowing Grace（Overflowing Grace）
Overflowing Grace.description: When you heal a creature to full hit points or a creature already at full hit points with your positive or negative energy, that creature gains a +1 sacred bonus on attack rolls, skill checks, ability checks, and saving throws for 1 round. The bonus is sacred if you use positive energy and profane if you use negative energy. If you destroy or kill one or more creatures with positive or negative energy, you gain a +1 bonus of the same type on attack rolls, skill checks, ability checks, and saving throws for 1 round.

Overpowering Mind.name: 意念壓迫（Overpowering Mind）
Overpowering Mind.description: 異能者能夠從精神力池中花費2點精神力，來使得聯結法術的意志豁免DC增加1點。8級起，她能夠選擇花費4點精神力來使得DC增加2點。15級起，她能夠選擇花費6點精神力來使得DC增加3點。此項精神增幅僅能聯結到具有影響心靈（mind-affecting）描述符、而且需要進行意志豁免的法術上。

Owl Aspect.name: 夜梟擬態（Owl Aspect）
Owl Aspect.description:
夜梟擬態是沉默安靜的。這個掠食者在黑夜中無聲地滑翔，隱匿攻擊的大師。

  次級形態：你的隱匿檢定獲得+4表現加值。8級時，這個加值提升至+6。15級時，這個加值提升至+8。

  專攻形態：你變身為一隻中型貓頭鷹（見本書 pg. 181）。當處於該形態時，你獲得60尺飛行速度（一般）、2個1d6傷害的爪擊攻擊、60尺黑暗視覺和隱匿檢定+2種族加值。8級時，你獲得飛躍攻擊（怪物圖鑑 pg. 315）作為獎勵專長，並且黑暗視覺提升至120尺。15級時，你能變成大型貓頭鷹形態並獲得攫抓專長（怪物圖鑑 pg. 316）的好處，但是你只能用它擒抱比體型你細至少一個級別的生物，而且你還能在使用此能力時擠壓（squeeze）一個被擒抱的生物，無論它的體型如何。

Owl's Sight.name: Owl's Sight（Owl's Sight）
Owl's Sight.description:
The vigilante gains low-light vision. If he already has low-light vision, he gains a +4 competence bonus on Perception checks in low light.

  The vigilante also gains a +2 competence bonus on Sleight of Hand and Stealth checks at night.

Pack Range.name: Pack Range（Pack Range）
Pack Range.description:
When a barbarian with this rage power enters a rage, any barbarian within 30 feet who also has this rage power can enter a rage. A barbarian that enters a rage outside of her turn spends 1 round of rage immediately and then spends another round of rage to maintain her rage at the beginning of her next turn.

  A barbarian must be at least 6th level to choose this rage power.

Pageantry Discipline.name: Pageantry Discipline（Pageantry Discipline）
Pageantry Discipline.description:
The act of ritual, no matter how ostentatious, can be a route to mental strength. By engaging in esoteric and intricate routines, you have unlocked potent psychic power.

精神力池屬性 魅力

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wa0zb2pncesmm9lz]{祝福術} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.6orhthk4g27rncuu]{安定心神} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jcr72piqo6g549e1]{緩慢術} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.xuuzj9lr2xbwaim4]{神威如獄} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.weyfn0mg2oifasq1]{偽裝術} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.op40qjf9oohlx5nu]{英雄宴} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.kqftgm3bi2dqj92l]{法師豪宅} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.zi1fpl4essgw5bbc]{神聖化身} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ueuz3ymuz8pxpzr6]{Heroic Invocation} (18th).

Pain Discipline.name: 苦痛境界（Pain Discipline）
Pain Discipline.description:
心智會阻礙你那與生俱來的精神能量的自由流動。只有在承受苦痛時，你才能釋放出強大的力量。

精神力池屬性 魅力

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ijtqp1h3hka5kive]{Persuasive Goad} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jy64xofud29j5ju6]{痛苦打擊} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.3efy1ico48ccrzni]{吸血鬼之觸} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.1dkzhi78je32sbrr]{Pain Strike, Mass} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.4jddpsd5pkky0qjg]{Synapse Overload} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.nqrpfidjuzllqa9z]{Inflict Pain, Mass} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.9f3hf9h3j8q8062b]{力竭波} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.e8zen5nzixnt7bde]{凋死術} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.6yeorbvt5ysym3nh]{Suffocation, Mass} (18th).

Pain Wave.name: 痛苦波動（Pain Wave）
Pain Wave.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點創造出痛苦波。該波命中半徑20尺爆發範圍內所有活物，爆發點在你100尺以內。所有活物都會被痛苦纏繞，在每秘學士等級1輪的時間內進入噁心狀態。受影響的生物可以進行意志豁免檢定，成功則將噁心時間降低為1輪。這是一個影響心靈的痛苦效果。你必須至少7級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Pain is Power.name: Pain is Power（Pain is Power）
Pain is Power.description:
At 8th level, after taking damage from any source, you may attempt a DC 25 concentration check as an immediate action. If you succeed, you gain the benefits of a blessing of fervorAPG spell for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your cleric level. If you fail, this ability is expended with no effect. You can use this ability once at 8th level, plus an additional time for every 4 levels you are beyond 8th.

  This power replaces the Scythe of Evil power of the Evil Domain or the Staff of Order power of the Law Domain.

Painful Reminder.name: 回味痛苦（Painful Reminder）
Painful Reminder.description: 從你的上個回合開始算起，如果你用法術對敵人造成了傷害，則能夠以迅捷動作讓該名敵人承受1d6點非致命傷害（nonlethal damage）。每日能夠使用該能力的次數等同於3 + 你的魅力調整值。此傷害會在8級提升至2d6點，並且在15級時提升至3d6點。

Painful Stare.name: 痛苦注視（Painful Stare）
Painful Stare.description: 若催眠師的催眠注視（Hypnotic Stare）的目標被一次造成傷害的攻擊命中的話，催眠師能夠讓目標承受額外的傷害，數值相當於催眠師的職業等級的一半（最低為1點）。催眠師能夠以自由動作使用該能力，而且即便不在自己的回合內也可以使用。若催眠師使用該能力增加自身造成的傷害，那麼額外傷害會增加，增加量為催眠師每擁有3個職業等級增加1d6點。該傷害為精準傷害（precision damage）而且不會隨著重擊而翻倍。催眠師每輪僅能觸發一次該能力，不過單個生物可能會在一輪內被多個催眠師的痛苦注視所傷害。

Painful Strike.name: Painful Strike（Painful Strike）
Painful Strike.description: At 1st level, when you confirm a critical hit, the target is sickened for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your bloodrager level (minimum 1). During this time, the creature must succeed at a concentration check (DC = 15 + the spell閳ユ獨 level) in order to cast a spell.

Pale Horse.name: Pale Horse（Pale Horse）
Pale Horse.description:
You can summon a @Compendium[pf1.spells.zpwd0f19q1lm04p3]{魅影駒}, as the spell, to serve you for a number of hours per day equal to your oracle level. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-hour increments.

  You must be at least 5th level to select this revelation.

Papercraft Tools.name: Papercraft Tools（Papercraft Tools）
Papercraft Tools.description: Traditional thieves閳?tools might be suspicious, but no guard looks twice at a common deck of cards. So long has the rogue has access to a deck of cards, she can destroy one card to attempt a single Disable Device check as if she had a set of thieves tools. If she uses a harrow card for this purpose, she can treat the card as a set of masterwork thieves閳?tools (granting her a +2 circumstance bonus on the Disable Device check), though the card is still destroyed after use.

Pariah.name: Pariah（Pariah）
Pariah.description: The witch can cause a creature within 60 feet to be shunned by its allies for a number of rounds equal to the witch閳ユ獨 Intelligence modifier. Any other creature attempting to directly assist the target with a harmless spell or aid another action must attempt a Will save. If the save succeeds, the aiding creature is unaffected by this hex. If the save fails, the aiding creature can閳ユ獩 follow through, the action is lost, and the aiding creature can閳ユ獩 directly aid the target for the duration of this hex. This hex does not prevent the target from benefiting from area of effect spells.

Pass the Torch.name: Pass the Torch（Pass the Torch）
Pass the Torch.description: Once per day as a swift action, you can channel the energy of the apocalypse into your body, causing you to ignite. You take 1d4 points of fire damage when you activate this ability and again at the beginning of your turn until you end the effect. Any creature that begins its turn adjacent to you takes 1d6 points of fire damage as the fire spreads, plus 1 additional point of fire damage for each previous round you have had this ability active. For example, adjacent creatures take 1d6+5 points of damage if you have had this ability active for 5 rounds. You can use this ability for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your oracle level, and you can end this ability as a free action. At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, you can use this ability one additional time per day.

Past Life Evoker.name: Past Life Evoker（Past Life Evoker）
Past Life Evoker.description:
Element universal; Type utility (Su); Level 2; Burn 0
Prerequisite samsaran

  Once per day, you can accept 1 point of burn to choose one simple blast wild talent belonging to any element. You gain the chosen simple blast wild talent for 1 minute, using your kineticist level 閳?2 to determine the blast talent閳ユ獨 damage.

  The simple blast wild talent you gain in this way does not allow you to meet any prerequisites.

Past-Life Memories.name: 前世記憶（Past-Life Memories）
Past-Life Memories.description: 你的知識技能檢定獲得等同你異能者等級一半的加值（最少為1），即使未受訓，你也可以進行知識檢定。

Path of the Snake.name: Path of the Snake（Path of the Snake）
Path of the Snake.description:
Once per day, as a standard action, you can become incorporeal. While in this form, you gain a +10 bonus on Stealth checks and can move in any direction and through any object (except for those made of force). You can take no action other than to move while in this form. You remain in this form for a number of rounds equal to your oracle level, but you can end this effect prematurely with a standard action.

  At 15th level, you can use this ability twice per day.

  You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

Patient Insight.name: 耐心洞察（Patient Insight）
Patient Insight.description: 當你嘗試進行醫療，知識，察言觀色，或生存技能檢定時，你可以支付1點精神力來骰擲2次檢定並使用較高的結果。

Peace Patron.name: Peace Patron（Peace Patron）
Peace Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.yk5bgi6j9kbtigof]{聖域術}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.6orhthk4g27rncuu]{安定心神}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.xhd6734dulevnwef]{風牆術}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.k3zn13pbr5tr9zac]{驅逐術}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.z8hhy7qitegvb7a4]{Serenity}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.r37k9siiazcdqkc7]{回返真言}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.5h7qpvgnqof7oku7]{力場監牢}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.xlzqpkl8fpm3sn4u]{愛與和平}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.1mi4y3g4n8adtfl3]{嫌惡術}

Peacebond.name: Peacebond（Peacebond）
Peacebond.description:
A witch can use this hex on a creature to prevent it from drawing a weapon for a number of rounds equal to the witch閳ユ獨 level. This hex has no effect on natural weapons or weapons already in a creature閳ユ獨 hands, but does prevent an archer from drawing arrows.

  A Will save negates this effect, and whether or not the save is successful, a creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 1 day.

Peafowl Aspect.name: Peafowl Aspect（Peafowl Aspect）
Peafowl Aspect.description:
Peafowl are popular ornamental birds due to their spectacular colors, and they are often symbols of royalty or the divine. A shifter using the alternate natural attacks rules on page 8 of Pathfinder Player Companion: Wilderness Origins can select a bite (B, P, S) or tail slap (B) attack.

Minor Form: You gain a +2 enhancement bonus to your Charisma score.

  At 8th level the bonus increases to +4, and at 15th level it increases to +6.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a Small peafowl. While in this form you gain low-light vision, a fly speed of 40 feet (clumsy), two talon attacks (1d3 damage), and a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks. A peafowl can閳ユ獩 use its fly speed to hover and must end any flying move action by landing or perching on a solid surface. A peafowl can perform a captivating dance targeting all creatures within a 15-foot cone. Each creature in the cone that can see your dance must succeed at a Will save (DC = 10 + half your shifter level + your Charisma modifier) or be stunned for 1 round.

  At 8th level, the stunned effect lasts for 2 rounds, and at 15th level the duration increases to 4 rounds. Whether or not it succeeds at the initial save, a creature cannot be affected by this ability again for 24 hours.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Bite (B, P, S), tail slap (B)

Peerless Speed.name: Peerless Speed（Peerless Speed）
Peerless Speed.description:
At 3rd level, you can tap into the power of the Astral閳ユ獨 enhanced magical nature to gain the ability to accelerate your spellcasting dramatically.

  Once per day as a swift action, you can cast one cantrip you know as though it were augmented by the @Compendium[pf1.feats.wFoLrh5FeeqBXsQ8]{法術瞬發} metamagic feat, without altering the cantrip閳ユ獨 level.

  At 5th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the maximum level of the spell you can augment with this ability increases by 1, to a maximum of an 8th-level spell at 19th level. If you use this ability while on the Astral Plane or on any plane whose enhanced magic trait allows you to cast a spell as if augmented by @Compendium[pf1.feats.wFoLrh5FeeqBXsQ8]{法術瞬發}, you can instead choose to augment the spell as though you had applied the @Compendium[pf1.feats.77gXSucrxfrE9yWk]{法術強效} or @Compendium[pf1.feats.J1yi4hFKYdXqZE3h]{法術極效} metamagic feats instead.

Penetrating Bite.name: Penetrating Bite（Penetrating Bite）
Penetrating Bite.description:
When using the animal fury rage power while raging, the barbarian閳ユ獨 bite is able to pierce most resistances.

  At 4th level, her bite is treated as a magic weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

  At 7th level, her bite is also treated as cold iron and silver for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

  At 10th level, her bite is also treated as a chaotic weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

  At 16th level, her bite is treated as an adamantine weapon for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction and bypassing hardness.

  A barbarian must have the animal fury rage power and be at least 4th level to select this rage power.

Penetrating Charge.name: Penetrating Charge（Penetrating Charge）
Penetrating Charge.description: A penetrating charge is a bomb specifically designed to disable locks and similar mechanisms, though not other means of sealing a door, a container, or other sorts of devices. As a full-round action, the alchemist can place a penetrating charge on a lock. Instead of dealing damage, the penetrating charge seeps into the mechanism and eats away at it, granting a +5 circumstance bonus on any subsequent Disable Device checks against the mechanism. A creature can spend 10 minutes and attempt an appropriate Craft check (DC 15) to fix the lock and remove this bonus.

Penetrating Infusion.name: Penetrating Infusion（Penetrating Infusion）
Penetrating Infusion.description:
Element air, fire, water; Type substance infusion; Level 2; Burn 2
Associated Blasts blue flame, cold, electric, fire
Saving Throw none

  The intensity of your blasts allows you to break through your foes閳?resistances. Treat your foe閳ユ獨 cold, electricity, or fire resistance as if it were 5 lower for the purpose of determining the infused blast閳ユ獨 damage; this doesn閳ユ獩 stack with the reduction from searing flame.

  You can increase the burn cost of this infusion to further reduce the foe閳ユ獨 resistance against the infused blast by 5 per additional point of burn accepted. This has no effect on creatures with immunity.

Perfect Aid.name: Perfect Aid（Perfect Aid）
Perfect Aid.description:
You can effortlessly give aid to your allies, whether that means providing them with help attacking or defending them in the heat of combat. You gain Bodyguard as a bonus feat, and whenever you use the aid another action to provide a bonus on attack rolls or to AC to one of your allies, the bonus you provide increases by 1. This bonus increases by 1 at 4th level and every 5 oracle levels thereafter (to a maximum of +5 at 19th level). It doesn閳ユ獩 stack with other feats or class features that improve the bonus you provide when using the aid another action.

  This revelation also counts as the Combat Expertise feat, but only for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of the Swift Aid feat and any feat that lists Swift Aid as a prerequisite.

Perfect Body.name: Perfect Body（Perfect Body）
Perfect Body.description: Some practitioners of psychic techniques extend their training to improve their bodies as well as their minds. When the psychic casts a linked transmutation spell, she can spend 1 point from her phrenic pool to gain a +2 bonus on her next Reflex or Fortitude save.

Perfect Fall.name: 貓落（Perfect Fall）
Perfect Fall.description: 只要俠客在墜落時身邊有觸手可及的牆壁或其他支點，俠客就不會承受任何墜落傷害；即使俠客找不到這些支點，他在墜落時也只承受一半傷害且不會倒地。

Perfect Vulnerability.name: 直取要害（Perfect Vulnerability）
Perfect Vulnerability.description: 以一個標準動作，俠客可以發動一次精確的突襲直擊敵手的心臟。這次攻擊對抗目標的接觸防禦等級而非正常防禦等級，而且目標在防禦等級上失去敏捷加值。一旦一個敵人成為了俠客直取要害的目標，他就會在接下來的24小時內免疫同一個俠客的直取要害攻擊。俠客必須要達到8級才能選擇本天賦。

Perfected Form.name: Perfected Form（Perfected Form）
Perfected Form.description:
You maintain an unshakable sense of who you are, and no force can compel you to be anything else. You gain a +1 sacred (if your patron is good or neutral) or profane (if your patron is evil) bonus on saving throws against polymorph, petrification, and transmutation effects. This bonus increases by 1 for every 5 cleric levels you have (maximum +5). Once per day when you succeed at a saving throw against such an effect, you can gain a surge of self-confidence as an immediate action that grants you a number of temporary hit points equal to your cleric level and a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, skill checks, and saving throws; both effects last for 1 minute.

  This power replaces the Liberation power of the Liberation Domain or the Strength Surge power of the Strength Domain.

Petrification Subdomain.name: Petrification Subdomain（Petrification Subdomain）
Petrification Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.wvpa1pt2gyh75g3x]{石化之觸}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.knyako6zopc1chrv]{石膚術}
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.361rc74674l3zt9a]{石化術}
  • 8環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.g52zx1t1giteg5h1]{雕像術}

Petrifying Strike.name: Petrifying Strike（Petrifying Strike）
Petrifying Strike.description: Whenever the rogue damages a creature with one of her sneak attacks, she also deals 2 points of Dexterity damage to that creature as its body petrifies.

Phantasmagoric Display.name: Phantasmagoric Display（Phantasmagoric Display）
Phantasmagoric Display.description: The shaman can cast @Compendium[pf1.spells.ijwcwnt3oatnfghq]{虹光法牆} and @Compendium[pf1.spells.mb819hvwpk0zmw53]{虹光噴射}, each once per day with a caster level equal to her shaman level.

Phantasmal Assault.name: Phantasmal Assault（Phantasmal Assault）
Phantasmal Assault.description:
At 13th level, you learn to harness your psychic force against all forms of haunts and undead creatures. Your mind-affecting spells that deal damage can now be used against haunts and undead normally immune to mind-affecting effects (including mindless undead). These spells are treated as though they dealt positive energy damage. This affects only spells that deal purely psychic-based damage (such as psychic crush, mind thrust, or synapse overload); effects based on physical effects (such as telekinetic projectile or telekinetic storm) don閳ユ獩 benefit from this ability. Additional non-damaging effects from such spells don閳ユ獩 affect the haunt, unless it would be normally affected.

  When you use a mind-affecting effect that deals damage against a possessed creature, the possessing entity takes a 閳? penalty on the saving throw against the mind-affecting attack.

Phantom Limb.name: Phantom Limb（Phantom Limb）
Phantom Limb.description:
The alchemist can manifest a ghostly, incorporeal arm that juts out from his torso. This phantom limb does not grant the alchemist any extra attacks or actions per round, and it cannot hold or grab anything (including incorporeal objects). The alchemist may use his phantom limb to make a touch attack against a foe as a standard action, scraping away at the very fibers of the victim閳ユ獨 soul. This attack deals 1d4 points of damage per alchemist level (Fortitude half ). Creatures that are immune to incorporeal attacks are immune to this damage, but otherwise the damage bypasses all forms of damage reduction except DR/ epic. The alchemist may suppress or activate this ability as a free action, and can use his phantom limb for a number of rounds per day equal to 3 + his Intelligence modifier (these rounds need not be consecutive).

  An alchemist must be at least 8th level to select this discovery.

Phantom Recall.name: 魅影呼喚（Phantom Recall）
Phantom Recall.description:
在6級時，以一個迅捷或即時動作發動，喚魂師可以立刻使自己的魅影在身側顯形或返回意念空間。這個能力的效果類似於法術次元門，使用她的喚魂師等級作為法術的施法者等級。當喚魂師以此法顯形魅影時，魅影會出現在她的一個鄰接方格（或是距離最近的方格，如果喚魂師的鄰接方格被佔據的話）。

  當喚魂師以此法將魅影收回意念中時，她可以用同一個地址啟動附體顯形能力，但這樣做會額外消耗一輪附體顯形的持續時間。

  在6級時，喚魂師每天可以使用一次本能力；在之後她每提升4個喚魂師等級時再增加一次。

Phantom Stampede.name: Phantom Stampede（Phantom Stampede）
Phantom Stampede.description:
The shaman summons a host of ghostly herd beasts to trample a single creature. These phantom beasts affect only the target creature, which is buffeted and pummeled by their passing. The creature takes no damage from the ability, but takes a 閳? penalty to its CMD against bull rush, overrun, and trip attempts. Additionally, spellcasters under the effect of this ability take a 閳? penalty on concentration checks. The target receives no saving throw to negate this effect.

  This effect lasts a number of rounds equal to the shaman閳ユ獨 level.

  The creature can閳ユ獩 be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.

Phantom.name: 魅影（Phantom）
Phantom.description:
在開始冒險時，喚魂師便擁有一隻隨侍於她，擁有強大的力量和多變能力的精魂生物——魅影。魅影必須永遠地跟隨以意念塑造與連結它的喚魂師，它必須選擇停留在喚魂師的意念中，或是後者希望它以靈質態（Ectoplasmic）或是虛靈態（Incorporeal）的形象顯形。魅影的陣營總是與喚魂師相同，並且它會說所有他的喚魂師主人的語言。在與喚魂師締結羈絆以後，魅影可以暫時寄居在喚魂師的意識中（見下：共享意識能力），只將自己的一部分投射到現世（見下：附體顯形能力）或完全的顯形。完全顯形的魅影被視為從靈界位面召喚而來生物，但在它生命被降到低於負的體質值之前它不會被送回原屬位面。

  使魅影顯形的的儀式耗時1分鐘。當它顯形時，喚魂師必須以一個會導致藉機攻擊的整輪動作決定自己的魅影的顯形形態（靈質態或虛靈態）。當它顯形的時候，魅影保持在上一次顯形時的生命點數，除非它是被殺死的；被殺死的魅影重新顯形時它具有最大生命值的一半。魅影無法自然恢復傷勢，只有醫療魔法或是當它在處於靈質態時進行的合適的醫療技能檢定才能恢復它的生命值。顯形後的魅影會留到喚魂師用一個標準動作讓它返回自己的意念空間內或是被放逐會靈界。如果魅影被放逐到靈界，那麼它需要24小時才能找到回到喚魂師意念的道路。

  當它完全顯形以後，魅影不能藉由法術解除魔法被送回靈界位面，但是法術驅逐術(Dismissal)與放逐術（Banishment）仍如常運作。當喚魂師失去意識時或睡眠時，魅影將立刻自動返回她的意念中如果喚魂師死亡，她的魅影會被打回靈界位面，並且無法與喚魂師重聚，直到喚魂師被複活後過去了24小時。當居留在喚魂師的意念中時，魅影無法被任何手段（無論是法術還是能力）驅逐或放逐——它被喚魂師的異能力量保護著。

  完全顯形的魅影可以使用符合其體形的護甲和物品（但它不能使用武器）。所有魅影持有，攜帶或穿著的物品在它返回喚魂師的意念時都會掉一地，並且如果魅影再次顯形時要使用它們，它必須重新一件件裝備這些物品。

  從某種意義上來說，魅影是一種傲嬌的生物，它不情願和其他召喚生物共事。如果魅影的喚魂師主人同時擁有幻靈或其他召喚生物，魅影將拒絕顯形（無論是完全還是部分顯形）。除此之外，如果在它顯形以後魅影的主人召喚了一個生物，那麼它會立刻回到喚魂師的意念中，在那個幻靈或類似的召喚生物離開前絕不出現。

  完全顯形的魅影擁有獨立的屬性值，HD，豁免加值與技能點數，這些資料會隨著喚魂師的等級增長而同時增長。見本職業後章的魅影介紹部分。

Pheremones.name: Pheremones（Pheremones）
Pheremones.description: The alchemist exudes an imperceptible musk that grants him a permanent +3 competence bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, and Intimidate checks.

Philologist.name: Philologist（Philologist）
Philologist.description: A rogue with this talent can reroll any Linguistics skill check made to decipher writing in an unfamiliar language, and never risks drawing a false conclusion from a failed Wisdom check after a failed Linguistics check. A rogue with this talent is allowed only one reroll per inscription, message, or text encountered.

Philosopher's Touch.name: Philosopher's Touch（Philosopher's Touch）
Philosopher's Touch.description:
As a standard action, you can expend 1 point of mental focus and touch a weapon, causing it to gain the properties of a special material. You can cause the weapon to be treated as cold iron or silver for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction for 1 minute per occultist level you possess.

  At 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter, you can touch an additional weapon as part of using this ability to grant that weapon the same benefit (still expending only 1 point of mental focus).

  At 11th level, you can cause any weapon affected by this ability to act as if it were adamantine instead (but only for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction, not for overcoming hardness).

Phoenix Bloodline.name: Phoenix Bloodline（Phoenix Bloodline）
Phoenix Bloodline.description:
One of your ancestors bore witness to a phoenix閳ユ獨 resurrection and formed a bond with the magical creature.

  The resurrecting flames still course through your veins, surging with power.

  本職技能: 知識(Arcana).

  獎勵法術:

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.qcjskol4ac3eemhy]{七彩噴射} (3rd),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.nokru6mxk9p3r513]{識破隱形} (5th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.1i8b1v3dngkxj6jp]{反邪惡法陣} (7th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.92hth51cs9oi0nfe]{火牆術} (9th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.myg2b9ww43nnlbr2]{破除結界} (11th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.pgsw180d62ekw83m]{Path Of The Winds} (13th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.hfca2lb4tlmrzoxm]{火焰紋章} (15th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ijwcwnt3oatnfghq]{虹光法牆} (17th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.qk3oeq4awbc1smjw]{火焰之軀} (19th).

  獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.JreaiTHdyWFNj3Tb]{閃避}, 
  • Elemental Focus (fire),
  •  Fast Healer,
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{精通先攻},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.iAbIGhm7T2OK9Brt]{鋼鐵意志},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.R7L4SlGRlnThqFrP]{靈活移動},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.wFoLrh5FeeqBXsQ8]{法術瞬發},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.7zJTztNW7hdaqjKc]{技能專攻} (@JournalEntry[dfjwbMEdt062TJtE]{知識}：奧秘).

  血統奧秘: When casting any spell that deals fire damage, you can instead heal your targets. The spell deals no damage, and living creatures affected by the spell instead regain a number of hit points equal to half the fire damage the spell would normally deal.

Phoenix Bloodrager Bloodline.name: Phoenix Bloodrager Bloodline（Phoenix Bloodrager Bloodline）
Phoenix Bloodrager Bloodline.description:
One of your ancestors may have witnessed the fiery resurrection of a phoenix or been healed by the grace of this legendary bird. Whatever the case, the flames of the phoenix burn brightly within your soul, filling you with an inextinguishable vitality that can withstand the most harrowing of assaults. When you bloodrage, vibrant energy boils forth from beneath your skin, granting you both the soothing warmth to heal a friend閳ユ獨 wounds and the brutal power to burn flesh from bone. Your rage is an awesome and terrible thing to behold, as the raw power of your untamed life force can allow you to pull yourself back from the grasp of death itself.

獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.h9nHYLxXvIXBTmup]{戰斗反射}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.JNlMhMhcDO8wkXiw]{重擊專攻}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.O0e0UCim27GPKFuW]{頑強}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.JreaiTHdyWFNj3Tb]{閃避}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.ehqx8txNRGMaNOPt]{堅忍}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{精通先攻}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.R7L4SlGRlnThqFrP]{靈活移動}

  獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lndeaqm2j2nvgm6p]{燃燒之手} (7th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.fxz69pwpqt9b6uss]{次等復原術} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.norn02g8zdsspf2j]{治療重傷} (13th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.nfm6i9z9r3n2fku7]{火焰護盾} (16th)

Phoenix Fire.name: Phoenix Fire（Phoenix Fire）
Phoenix Fire.description: The power of the phoenix brings righteous destruction to any who oppose it. At 20th level, while bloodraging, you gain the following effects: your melee attacks deal an additional 2d6 points of fire damage, any enemies within 20 feet of you must succeed at a Reflex save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your bloodrager level + your Constitution modifier) or take 4d6 points of fire damage at the start of their turn, and any creature that attacks you with a natural or non-reach weapon takes 1d6 points of fire damage (no save) with each successful hit.

Photokinetic Infusion.name: Photokinetic Infusion（Photokinetic Infusion）
Photokinetic Infusion.description:
Element wood; Type substance infusion; Level 1; Burn 1
Prerequisite positive blast
Associated Blasts positive
Saving Throw none

  Your blast damages living creatures with light. This deals normal damage to undead creatures but also deals minimum damage (1 point of damage per d6, can閳ユ獩 be increased by the 9th-level improvement to metakinesis) to living creatures.

  Undead creatures that are particularly vulnerable to sunlight, such as vampires, take 1 extra point of damage per die from the infused blast.

Phrenic Amplifications.name: 精神增幅（Phrenic Amplifications）
Phrenic Amplifications.description: 異能者開發出一種被稱為精神增幅的特殊技巧來強化施法。異能者可以在使用精神魔法施放一個法術的時候啟動一個精神增幅，這會對法術的效果或施法過程進行調整。被施放的法術稱為聯結法術（linked spell）。每當異能者施放一個法術時，她僅能啟動一個精神增幅，而且這麼做是施放該法術的動作的一部分。除非精神增幅的說明中註明了僅能與某些特定種類的法術進行聯結，否則異能者可以對任何異能者法術（psychic spell）使用任何已知的精神增幅。異能者會在1級獲得一個精神增幅，從後述列表中進行選擇。在3級以及之後的每4個等級，異能者都能夠再學會一個新的精神增幅。每個精神增幅僅能被選擇一次。一旦選定了精神增幅，便無法更改。精神增幅需要異能者從精神力池花費1點或更多點的精神力才能夠生效。

Phrenic Pool.name: 精神力池（Phrenic Pool）
