Phrenic Pool.description: 異能者具有一個由超自然精神能量組成的能量池，在施放異能者法術（psychic spells）時，異能者能夠從精神力池中抽取精神力對法術加以操控。精神力池的最高上限為異能者等級的1/2 + 她的感知或魅力調整值，具體使用哪個調整值取決於異能者的精神境界（psychic discipline）。精神力池會在經過8個小時休息或冥想後的每個早晨恢復；這些小時不必連續。根據精神境界的不同，異能者可能具有其他向精神力池補充精神力的方法或情況。超過精神力池上限的精神力會被浪費掉。

Phrenic Strike.name: 精神打擊（Phrenic Strike）
Phrenic Strike.description: 只要異能者的精神力池裡至少還有1點精神力，他就可以通過一次徒手打擊代替原來的接觸攻擊來引導一個距離為接觸的聯結法術。除非靈能者的徒手打擊不會引發藉機攻擊，否則這次徒手打擊依舊會引發對手的藉機攻擊。

Physical Composite Blast.name: Physical Composite Blast（Physical Composite Blast）
Physical Composite Blast.description: Composite blasts combine elements to form a new blast. When a kineticist gains a new element through expanded element, she gains access to all composite blasts for which she qualifies. Most composite blasts are either physical or energy blasts, like simple blasts. Physical composite blasts deal an amount of damage equal to 2d6+2 + the kineticist閳ユ獨 Constitution modifier, increasing by 2d6+2 for every 2 kineticist levels beyond 1st; energy composite blasts deal an amount of damage equal to 2d6 + 1/2 the kineticist閳ユ獨 Constitution modifier, increasing by 2d6 for every 2 kineticist levels beyond 1st.

Physical Kinetic Blade.name: Physical Kinetic Blade（Physical Kinetic Blade）
Physical Kinetic Blade.description:
Element(s) universal; Type form infusion; 等級 1; Burn 1
Associated Blasts any
Saving Throw none

You form a weapon using your kinetic abilities. You create a non-reach, light or one-handed weapon in your hand formed of pure energy or elemental matter. (If you閳ユ獧e a telekineticist, you instead transfer the power of your kinetic blast to any object held in one hand.) The kinetic blade閳ユ獨 shape is purely cosmetic and doesn閳ユ獩 affect the damage dice, critical threat range, or critical multiplier of the kinetic blade, nor does it grant the kinetic blade any weapon special features. The object held by a telekineticist for this form infusion doesn閳ユ獩 prevent her from using gather power.

You can use this form infusion once as part of an attack action, a charge action, or a full-attack action in order to make melee attacks with your kinetic blade. Since it閳ユ獨 part of another action (and isn閳ユ獩 an action itself), using this wild talent doesn閳ユ獩 provoke any additional attacks of opportunity. The kinetic blade deals your kinetic blast damage on each hit (applying any modifiers to your kinetic blast閳ユ獨 damage as normal, but not your Strength modifier). The blade disappears at the end of your turn. The weapon deals the same damage type that your kinetic blast deals, and it interacts with Armor Class and spell resistance as normal for a blast of its type. Even if a telekineticist uses this power on a magic weapon or another unusual object, the attack doesn閳ユ獩 use any of the magic weapon閳ユ獨 bonuses or effects and simply deals the telekineticist閳ユ獨 blast damage. The kinetic blade doesn閳ユ獩 add the damage bonus from elemental overflow.

Physical Kinetic Blast.name: Physical Kinetic Blast（Physical Kinetic Blast）
Physical Kinetic Blast.description:
At 1st level, a kineticist gains a kinetic blast wild talent of her choice. This kinetic blast must be a simple blast that matches her element. Simple blasts are listed with their corresponding elements.

  As a standard action, the kineticist can unleash a kinetic blast at a single target up to a range of 30 feet. She must have at least one hand free to aim the blast (or one prehensile appendage, if she doesn閳ユ獩 have hands). All damage from a kinetic blast is treated as magic for the purpose of bypassing damage reduction. Kinetic blasts count as a type of weapon for the purpose of feats such as @Compendium[pf1.feats.n250dFlbykAIAg5Z]{武器專攻}. The kineticist is never considered to be wielding or gripping the kinetic blast (regardless of effects from form infusions; see Infusion), and she can閳ユ獩 use @Compendium[pf1.feats.26k1Gi7t5BoqxhIj]{要害打擊} feats with kinetic blasts. Even the weakest kinetic blast involves a sizable mass of elemental matter or energy, so kinetic blasts always deal full damage to swarms of any size (though only area blasts deal extra damage to swarms). A readied kinetic blast can be used to counterspell any spell of equal or lower level that shares its descriptor. A kinetic blast that deals energy damage of any type (including force) has the corresponding descriptor.

  Each simple blast is either a physical blast or an energy blast.

  Physical blasts are ranged attacks that deal an amount of damage equal to 1d6+1 + the kineticist閳ユ獨 Constitution modifier, increasing by 1d6+1 for every 2 kineticist levels beyond 1st. Spell resistance doesn閳ユ獩 apply against physical blasts.

  Energy blasts are ranged touch attacks that deal an amount of damage equal to 1d6 + 1/2 the kineticist閳ユ獨 Constitution modifier, increasing by 1d6 for every 2 kineticist levels beyond 1st.

  Composite blasts combine elements to form a new blast. When a kineticist gains a new element through expanded element, she gains access to all composite blasts for which she qualifies. All composite blasts are listed after the kineticist elements.

  Most composite blasts are either physical or energy blasts, like simple blasts.

  Physical composite blasts deal an amount of damage equal to 2d6+2 + the kineticist閳ユ獨 Constitution modifier, increasing by 2d6+2 for every 2 kineticist levels beyond 1st.

  Energy composite blasts deal an amount of damage equal to 2d6 + 1/2 the kineticist閳ユ獨 Constitution modifier, increasing by 2d6 for every 2 kineticist levels beyond 1st.

  • A complete listing of kinetic blasts and composite blasts can be found within the Kineticist Elements page, here: Kineticist Elements

Physical Push.name: 體能強化（Physical Push）
Physical Push.description: 通過引導精神力量，你能夠讓身體展現出更強的體能。當你嘗試力量、敏捷或體質屬性檢定或者基於上述屬性的技能檢定時，能夠在檢定中獲得加值，該加值的數值等同於你的感知加值。每日能夠使用該能力的次數等同於你的感知調整值。使用該能力是嘗試此類檢定的動作（若有的話）的一部分。若成功通過檢定，你的精神力池便會恢復1點精神力。

Physical Regression.name: 實體迴歸（Physical Regression）
Physical Regression.description: 在13級，每天一次，你可以支付2點精神力，通過一個標準動作，你變化成你的其中一個前世。該能力如同變形術，但其距離為個人，且持續時間為每施法者等級10分鐘。

Pickled Quasit.name: Pickled Quasit（Pickled Quasit）
Pickled Quasit.description:
The alchemist has learned how to seal a quasit in a bottle, which he can prepare for use as an extract. When the alchemist activates the extract, he throws the bottle at a square within 30 feet, releasing the quasit. The quasit is not under the alchemist閳ユ獨 control, but is otherwise treated as a summoned creature. The quasit remains for 1 round per caster level, then collapses into its associated elements. If the alchemist has the infusion discovery, another character can use the infused specimen. Creating a pickled quasit requires a 4th-level extract.

  An alchemist must be at least 10th level to select this discovery.

Pierce the Darkness.name: Pierce the Darkness（Pierce the Darkness）
Pierce the Darkness.description: The rogue can extend her senses of hearing and smell in darkness or when blinded. She gains blindsense out to a range of 5 feet, but only against creatures concealed by darkness or her own blindness. She still suffers the normal miss chance for attacking creatures with concealment.

Pillar.name: Pillar（Pillar）
Pillar.description:
Element earth, water, wood; Type utility (Sp); Level 3; Burn 0
Prerequisite kinetic cover

  You create a 5-foot-by-5-foot pillar of ice, packed dirt, or tangled roots with a height of up to 15 feet. This takes 1 full round, during which time the ground within the affected area rumbles conspicuously, but it rises only at the end of the round. You can閳ユ獩 create a pillar in an area occupied by or adjacent to any creatures unless all such creatures are willing, and if an unwilling creature moves into the area before the pillar finishes rising, it can disrupt and foil the pillar. As the pillar springs into existence, willing creatures and objects within the affected area are lifted with it.

The pillar can閳ユ獩 be used to crush creatures or objects against the ceiling; if insufficient room is available for the pillar and any creatures or objects on it, the pillar reaches only the maximum possible height. You can閳ユ獩 create a pillar under a Large or larger creature.

The pillar has AC 4, hardness 0, and 3 hit points per kineticist level. Scaling the pillar閳ユ獨 rough edges requires a successful DC 15 Climb check. When destroyed, when you create a new pillar, or when a number of rounds equal to your Constitution bonus (minimum 1) have elapsed, the pillar crumbles, melts, or withers away, gently lowering anything on it back to the ground.

Pincers (1 pt).name: Pincers (1 pt)（Pincers (1 pt)）
Pincers (1 pt).description:
An eidolon grows a large pincers at the end of one pair of its limbs, giving it two pincer attacks. These attacks are secondary attacks. The pincers deal 1d6 points of damage (1d8 if Large, 2d6 if Huge). Eidolons with the grab evolution linked to pincers gain a +2 bonus on CMB checks made to grapple. The eidolon must have the limbs (arms) evolution to take this evolution. Alternatively, the eidolon can replace the claws from its base form with pincers (this still costs 1 evolution point).

  This evolution can be selected more than once, but the eidolon must possess an equal number of the limbs evolution.

Pincers (UC) (1 pt).name: Pincers (UC) (1 pt)（Pincers (UC) (1 pt)）
Pincers (UC) (1 pt).description:
Requirements: Agathion, daemon, demon, devil, div, elemental, protean, or psychopomp subtype.

  An eidolon grows large pincers at the ends of one pair of its limbs, giving it two pincer attacks. These attacks are secondary attacks. The pincers deal 1d6 points of damage (1d8 if Large, 2d6 if Huge). Eidolons with the grab evolution linked to their pincers gain a +2 bonus on combat maneuver checks to grapple.

  The eidolon must have the limbs (arms) evolution to take this evolution. Alternatively, the eidolon can replace the claws from its base form with pincers (this still costs 1 evolution point).

  This evolution can be selected more than once, up to the number of limbs (arms) evolutions the eidolon possesses.

Pitiful Foe.name: Pitiful Foe（Pitiful Foe）
Pitiful Foe.description:
You can temporarily curse one target within 30 feet as a standard action, making it pitiful and ineffective in battle. While this ability is in effect, the target is never considered to be threatening you or your allies, even if it is armed and you or your allies are standing in a square into which it can make a melee attack. If the target rolls a natural 20 on an attack roll or saving throw, the attack or saving throw is not an automatic success (as would be normal) and whether it is successful is instead determined normally. Additionally, the target automatically fails all rolls to confirm critical hits. This curse lasts for 1 round per 2 oracle levels you have (minimum 1). A successful Will saving throw negates this effect. This is a mind-affecting curse effect.

  You can use this revelation once per day, plus one additional time at 7th and 15th levels.

Plague Subdomain.name: Plague Subdomain（Plague Subdomain）
Plague Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.c3iz720zjv922b6j]{Ray of Sickening}
  • 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ppeb97nxg1rmdpme]{疫病術}
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.7l7wofgz2iafjsdr]{Plague Storm}
  • 8環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.e8zen5nzixnt7bde]{凋死術}

Plague Vector.name: Plague Vector（Plague Vector）
Plague Vector.description:
The effects of the alchemist閳ユ獨 plague bomb operate as normal except for the following changes. The chosen disease閳ユ獨 save DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 the alchemist閳ユ獨 level + his Intelligence modifier. Any creatures affected by the chosen disease become vectors for it, spreading the disease to any creatures they come in physical contact with for a number of days equal to the alchemist閳ユ獨 Intelligence modifier (minimum 1). The save DC to avoid contracting the disease from the vector is the same as the DC used for this discovery.

  An alchemist must be at least 14th level and must have the plague bomb discovery to select this discovery.

Plague's Caress.name: Plague's Caress（Plague's Caress）
Plague's Caress.description: At 1st level, you can make a melee touch attack as a standard action that causes a living creature閳ユ獨 flesh to break out into rancid-smelling pustules and sores for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your sorcerer level (minimum 1 round). These sores cause the victim to become sickened for the duration of the effect; this is a disease effect. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Plagued Curse.name: Plagued Curse（Plagued Curse）
Plagued Curse.description:
You suffer from minor ailments and sicknesses. While you struggle to resist new diseases, you have grown accustomed to the many inconveniences of sickness. You take a 閳? penalty on all saving throws against disease or infestation effects, but you are immune to the sickened condition.

  At 5th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.y7aqxf7alib6ld6t]{皰疹咒} to your list of 2nd-level oracle spells known.

  At 10th level, increase the save DC of any disease effect you create by +2, and you raise the number of saves required to recover naturally from these diseases by 1.

  At 15th level, you are immune to the effects of disease and infestations, but you can still function as a carrier for sickness.

Planar Knowledge.name: Planar Knowledge（Planar Knowledge）
Planar Knowledge.description: As an infernal binder, you gain a +3 bonus on @JournalEntry[dfjwbMEdt062TJtE]{知識}：位面 checks.

Planar Scent.name: Planar Scent（Planar Scent）
Planar Scent.description: You can intuitively sense disruptions in the cosmos. This ability functions as a constant detect magic, but only for effects of the conjuration (calling), conjuration (summoning), conjuration (teleport), and illusion (shadow) subschools. You gain a +2 insight bonus on Spellcraft checks to identify such effects.

Planar Ward.name: 位面結界（Planar Ward）
Planar Ward.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗2點心智點在周身包裹上位面結界。非本位面的生物攻擊你時承受-4攻擊罰值，且你在對抗該種生物的法術、類法術、超自然能力時的豁免檢定上獲得+4環境加值。該結界持續1分鐘。

Planar haze.name: Planar haze（Planar haze）
Planar haze.description:
You can fill an area with the smoky miasma of the Outer Rifts. Once per day when you cast a spell that has an area, as a swift action you may also fill that area with a thick haze that acts as @Compendium[pf1.spells.tuh5vc2bojaws3ig]{隱霧術}, except it originates at the center of your spell effect and cannot expand beyond the spell閳ユ獨 area.

  At 10th level, the haze functions as @Compendium[pf1.spells.g33euis7yi9pwddy]{雲霧術}.

  You may use this ability one additional time per day at 7th level, and one additional time per day at 14th level.

Plant Disguise.name: Plant Disguise（Plant Disguise）
Plant Disguise.description:
Element wood; Type utility (Sp); Level 4; Burn 0

  You can assume the shape of an immobile plant, as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.6ho3wsspkqkhypt0]{樹化術} but transforming into any ordinary Small or Medium plant.

Plant Patron.name: Plant Patron（Plant Patron）
Plant Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.2nn2tshkn4p7k25l]{糾纏術}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.3fkwj6d8s65ufwar]{加速毒發}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.7jqqoorcwq9ro81m]{步步生蓮}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.0sssdtv0tkbns2r3]{喘息之林}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.6x6epf4g5wgzl1gh]{融身入林}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ipc85wy0f0lmr0l4]{驅離木材}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.qt0xmkag6ahtvesm]{活化植物}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.szzwom7utm3sm15z]{操控植物}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.bp4s030vn5iwwf58]{蔓生術}

Plant Puppet.name: Plant Puppet（Plant Puppet）
Plant Puppet.description:
Element wood; Type utility (Sp); Level 5; Burn 0

  You can control plants, causing them to attack your foes. This functions as the aether puppet wild talent, except it controls plants instead of objects.

  At 12th level, you can grant hardness 5 to Large and larger animated plants.

Poetic Inspiration.name: Poetic Inspiration（Poetic Inspiration）
Poetic Inspiration.description: At 8th level, an order of the songbird samurai can speak a few words as a swift action, inspiring allies to great deeds. Allies within 30 feet who can hear the samurai gain a competence bonus equal to her Charisma modifier on attack and weapon damage rolls for 1 round. This ability can be used once per combat.

Poetic Vengeance.name: Poetic Vengeance（Poetic Vengeance）
Poetic Vengeance.description:
You constantly plot and scheme to take your revenge against those who wrong you. Once per day as an immediate action, after an enemy successfully affects you with an attack (whether with a spell, a physical attack, or any other sort of attack), you can force the enemy to take half the effects of its own attack unless it succeeds on a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Charisma modifier). Any damage from the attack is halved, and non-damaging effects have a 50% chance to apply. If the non-damaging effect has a DC, the enemy receives a saving throw against it, at either the DC of the original effect or the DC of this ability, whichever is lower.

  At 10th level, you can use this ability twice per day, and at 20th level you can use it three times per day.

Poison (2 pts).name: Poison (2 pts)（Poison (2 pts)）
Poison (2 pts).description:
An eidolon secretes toxic venom, gaining a poison attack. Pick one bite or sting attack. Whenever the selected attack hits, the target is poisoned. 

  Eidolon poison閳ユ敄ype poison (injury); save Fort negates; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d4 Str damage; cure 1 save. The save DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 the eidolon's HD + the eidolon's Constitution modifier. For 2 additional evolution points, this poison deals Constitution damage instead. This poison can be used no more than once per round.

  The summoner must be at least 7th level before selecting this evolution.

Poison (UC) (2 pts).name: Poison (UC) (2 pts)（Poison (UC) (2 pts)）
Poison (UC) (2 pts).description:
Requirements: Summoner level 7th; daemon, demon, devil, elemental, or protean subtype; bite or sting evolution.

  The eidolon secretes toxic venom, gaining a poison attack. Select one bite or sting attack. Whenever the selected attack hits, the target is poisoned.

Eidolon Poison: Injury; save Fort negates; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d4 Str damage; cure 1 save.

The save DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 the eidolon閳ユ獨 Hit Dice + the eidolon閳ユ獨 Constitution modifier.

  For 2 additional evolution points, this poison deals Constitution damage instead. This poison can be used no more than once per round.

Poison Fangs.name: Poison Fangs（Poison Fangs）
Poison Fangs.description:
At 12th level, you gain the poison special attack, tied to your bite attack. Your poison is as follows:

  bite閳ユ攰njury; save Fort DC = 10 + 1/2 your bloodrager level + your Constitution modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Con damage; cure 1 save.

Poison Lore.name: Poison Lore（Poison Lore）
Poison Lore.description: An investigator has a deep understanding and appreciation for poisons. At 2nd level, he cannot accidentally poison himself when applying poison to a weapon. If the investigator spends 1 minute physically examining the poison, he can attempt a @JournalEntry[dfjwbMEdt062TJtE]{知識}：自然 check to identify any natural poison or @JournalEntry[dfjwbMEdt062TJtE]{知識}：神秘 check to identify any magical poison (DC = the poison閳ユ獨 saving throw DC). Lastly, once a poison is identified, he can spend 1 minute and attempt a 工藝： (alchemy) check (DC = the poison閳ユ獨 saving throw DC) to neutralize 1 dose of the poison. Success renders the dose harmless. The investigator has no chance of accidentally poisoning himself when examining or attempting to neutralize a poison.

Poison Resistance (INV).name: 毒性抗力(調查員)（Poison Resistance (INV)）
Poison Resistance (INV).description: 在2級時，調查員在所有對抗毒素的豁免檢定上獲得+2加值。在5級時，這個加值上升為+4，在8級時上升為+6。在11級時，調查員將免疫毒素。

Poison Use (ALC).name: 用毒(鍊金術師)（Poison Use (ALC)）
Poison Use (ALC).description: 鍊金術師學習過如何安全的使用毒藥，從2級開始，鍊金術師在給武器上毒時不會因意外而中毒。

Poison Use (ROG).name: Poison Use (ROG)（Poison Use (ROG)）
Poison Use (ROG).description: The rogue is trained in the use of poison, and can’t accidentally poison herself when applying poison to a weapon.

Poisoned Explosive.name: Poisoned Explosive（Poisoned Explosive）
Poisoned Explosive.description:
When an alchemist creates a bomb, he can apply a dose of contact or injury poison to it, as if applying poison to a weapon. If the poisoned bomb hits its target, the bomb deals damage as normal, but the target must also succeed at a saving throw against the poison or be affected by that poison. No other creatures are affected by the poison.

  An alchemist must be at least 4th level and have the poison use class feature before selecting this discovery.

Poisoner.name: Poisoner（Poisoner）
Poisoner.description:
The vigilante gains the alchemist閳ユ獨 poison use class feature. At 6th level, when he has 5 doses of a single kind of poison, he can synthesize a dose of that poison once per day at no cost. This process takes 1 minute. It doesn閳ユ獩 expend the 5 doses of poison, but the doses must be in the vigilante閳ユ獨 possession to perform the synthesis. The poison produced requires careful storage and special skill to use. It becomes inert if it leaves the vigilante閳ユ獨 possession and can閳ユ獩 be sold.

  The vigilante can maintain only 1 dose of synthesized poison for every 5 doses of that poison in his possession.

Politics Inquisition.name: Politics Inquisition（Politics Inquisition）
Politics Inquisition.description: 神授力量: Your divine guidance twists agreements, laws, and policies to suit the interests of the faith.

Pollute Water.name: Pollute Water（Pollute Water）
Pollute Water.description:
The witch can corrupt bodies of water with foul energies. This functions as the blight hex, except it affects only either an area of standing water or a creature with the aquatic or water subtype. A creature of any type that drinks water from a polluted area must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or become nauseated for 1d3 rounds and afflicted as if blighted with the blight hex curse.

  A creature that succeeds at this saving throw is immune to the effects of polluted water from this area for 24 hours.

  Polluted water does not quench thirst.

Polluting Glance.name: Polluting Glance（Polluting Glance）
Polluting Glance.description:
The witch can corrupt nonmagical liquid items (such as alchemical remedies) with a look. The witch can choose one liquid item she can see within 30 feet and change its contents into polluted water as per her pollute water hex (see above). The number of polluting glance hexes the witch can have active at one time is equal to her Intelligence bonus (minimum 1).

The witch must have the pollute water hex to select this hex.

Portal Subdomain.name: Portal Subdomain（Portal Subdomain）
Portal Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.jve8s6ut5yp4hht3]{Open And Shut}
  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.2o9tacbz7tbrlhvv]{敲擊術}
  • 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.v1nropy1tvj0476l]{Urban Step}
  • 9環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.if867t28tu6zxaei]{傳送法陣}

Possessed Bloodline.name: Possessed Bloodline（Possessed Bloodline）
Possessed Bloodline.description:
Possessed sorcerers channel their magic potential through a unique bond with a possessing spirit rather than through blood alone. These spirits take numerous forms, but such is their tenaciousness that they bond in a way that prevents their banishment from the host. Instead, both possessor and sorcerer work together, their joint nature allowing the sorcerer to unlock many unnatural abilities.

  The magical nature of a sorcerer閳ユ獨 bloodline means the sorcerer herself does not even need to be the creature initially possessed to have this particular bloodline. It may be that one of your ancestors was possessed by a powerful spirit, one whose presence was so overwhelming that it sends ripples of power down through the generations.

  本職技能: @JournalEntry[dfjwbMEdt062TJtE]{知識}：宗教.

  獎勵法術:

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ja1p1uuf8fp6fiox]{Anticipate Peril} (3rd),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.9hi94t05i449j5ul]{Share Memory} (5th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.l8xwrepcmkdgb2wf]{Purge Spirit} (7th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.flqg043abb5xryh5]{Entrap Spirit} (9th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.4mw83czf7b62rar3]{Possession} (11th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lovx4kiq18gbvg4e]{Telepathy} (13th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.s6q72tw2zra9sycu]{精神錯亂} (15th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.v39qnirlhgje2c0e]{Bilocation} (17th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.q8nety5obvbbd5xs]{Divide Mind} (19th).

  獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.u7rGDZUL296QIuA0]{戰斗施法},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.SUACufUXl12sUvnQ]{詐欺師}, 
  • Fearsome Spell,
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.cKxfEL5XOWuzLhfO]{精通鋼鐵意志},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.iAbIGhm7T2OK9Brt]{鋼鐵意志},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.L10V7jTzmMYz62zz]{談判專家}, 
  • Selective Spell,
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.7zJTztNW7hdaqjKc]{技能專攻}(唬騙 ),
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.V2zY7BltkpSXwejy]{法術專攻}, 
  • Traumatic Spell.

  血統奧秘: Whenever you cast a non-cantrip spell, you can roll the next Will save you attempt against a mind-affecting effect before your next turn twice and take the better result. If you have already failed a save against a mind-affecting effect, you can instead attempt another Will save against that ongoing mind-affecting effect after successfully casting your spell. You can use this ability only once against a given mind-affecting effect. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Pounce (1 pt).name: Pounce (1 pt)（Pounce (1 pt)）
Pounce (1 pt).description:
An eidolon gains quick reflexes, allowing it to make a full attack after a charge.

  This evolution is only available to eidolons of the quadruped base form.

Pounce (UC) (3 pts).name: Pounce (UC) (3 pts)（Pounce (UC) (3 pts)）
Pounce (UC) (3 pts).description:
Requirements: Summoner level 7th, quadruped base form.

  The eidolon gains quick reflexes, allowing it to make a full attack after a charge.

Power Over Undead.name: Power Over Undead（Power Over Undead）
Power Over Undead.description: You receive @Compendium[pf1.feats.CjLNTqNGz4zU4zpp]{命令死靈} or @Compendium[pf1.feats.O7Dn4bXZtMW0UstG]{驅散死靈} as a bonus feat. You can channel energy a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Intelligence modifier, but only to use the selected feat. You can take other feats to add to this ability, such as @Compendium[pf1.feats.pgRX4VpFemwv9R0E]{額外引導} and @Compendium[pf1.feats.1HfwfBOSWtdxFQ2s]{精通導能}, but not feats that alter this ability, such as @Compendium[pf1.feats.f5rgOsdDlseGr4o5]{元素導能} and @Compendium[pf1.feats.ieww7CP6JK5pwtpg]{陣營導能}. The DC to save against these feats is equal to 10 + 1/2 your wizard level + your Charisma modifier. At 20th level, undead cannot add their channel resistance to the save against this ability.

Power from Pageantry.name: Power from Pageantry（Power from Pageantry）
Power from Pageantry.description: When casting a spell with a casting time of 1 standard action or less, you can spend 1 point from your phrenic pool to extend the casting time to 1 full round. If you do, the caster level and saving throw DC increase by 2.

Power from Pain.name: 疼痛之力（Power from Pain）
Power from Pain.description: 若你的回味痛苦至少造成了5點傷害，那麼你的精神力池會恢復1點精神力。每日能夠以此方式恢復的精神力的最大數值等同於你的感知調整值。

Power of the Fallen.name: Power of the Fallen（Power of the Fallen）
Power of the Fallen.description:
You can touch a dying creature and channel its life energy into another living creature. This ability acts as @Compendium[pf1.spells.k0k8gvqyy3rd5gke]{死亡喪鐘}, except you can choose any ally (including yourself ) within 30 feet to gain the benefit of this effect, and you can apply the +2 enhancement bonus to either Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

  You must be at least 5th level to select this revelation.

Power of the Giants.name: Power of the Giants（Power of the Giants）
Power of the Giants.description: At 15th level, you may grow to Large size as a standard action. At this size you gain a +6 size bonus to Strength, a 閳? penalty to Dexterity, a +4 size bonus to Constitution, and a +4 natural armor bonus. You may return to your normal size as a standard action. You may remain in this size for up to 1 minute per character level per day; this duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be used in 1 minute increments.

Powerful Bond.name: Powerful Bond（Powerful Bond）
Powerful Bond.description:
As a free action, you can open a link to communicate telepathically with a single ally within 60 feet. The telepathic link is two-way and lasts for 1 minute. Unlike normal telepathy, this ability requires a shared language. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Touch of Good power of the Good Domain.

Powerful Connection.name: 強力連接（Powerful Connection）
Powerful Connection.description: 當你施放預言系法術（比如探知）時，若目標會因物理上的聯繫而在對抗該預言系法術時的豁免檢定承受罰值，你可以消耗1點心智點加倍這個因財物、衣服或身體部分等物理聯繫而造成的罰值。另外，當你釋放其它需要目標進行豁免檢定的預言系法術時，若你擁有目標的物理部分（比如物品、衣服或身體部分）作為法器成分且消耗1點心智點，該法術的豁免DC+2。

Powerful Smash.name: Powerful Smash（Powerful Smash）
Powerful Smash.description:
As a standard action, the shaman can attack an enemy with an unarmed strike as if she had the @Compendium[pf1.feats.2aTFNMs3pW6nUBlr]{精通徒手打擊} feat. If the shaman hits a creature in this way, that creature must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + half the shaman閳ユ獨 class level + her Charisma modifier) or be dazed for 1 round.

  The shaman can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Charisma modifier.

Pranked Curse.name: Pranked Curse（Pranked Curse）
Pranked Curse.description:
Capricious fey constantly bedevil you, playing pranks on you such as tying your shoelaces together, hiding your gear, making inappropriate noises or smells at formal events, and mimicking your voice to tell embarrassing lies. In addition to any social consequences of such mischief, you take a 閳? penalty on initiative checks. Furthermore, whenever you attempt to retrieve a stored item from your gear, there閳ユ獨 a 25% chance that you fail to find it with that action. Add @Compendium[pf1.spells.bl71og1gklwncmt7]{妖火} and @Compendium[pf1.spells.mtxqp85izkb20djq]{幻音術} to your list of spells known.

  At 5th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.ec2zmvdzi4m3puh4]{閃光塵} and @Compendium[pf1.spells.27o3msobhyghmfid]{弱效幻影} to your list of spells known.

  At 10th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.n0bsyxchnigkkuqo]{困惑術} to your list of spells known as a 5th-level spell.

  At 15th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.0w3hvcp3gb2bhtv5]{投影術} to your list of spells known. A possessed oracle can select this curse in place of the haunted curse.

Prayer Aura.name: 祈禱靈光（Prayer Aura）
Prayer Aura.description: 13級起，以自由動作，你能夠在自身展開一個靈光，來支持盟友和削弱敵人。每日使用這個靈光的輪數等同於你的異能者等級。這些輪數不必連續。該能力的功能就如同祈禱術（Prayer）一般，使你的所有盟友在攻擊檢定、武器傷害檢定、豁免和技能檢定中獲得+1幸運加值，並讓敵人的這些檢定受到-1減值。若你的陣營為混亂、守序、善良或邪惡，那麼靈光對對立陣營的生物所產生的減值提升至-2點。即便敵人的陣營在兩個陣營軸上都與你是對立的（比如混亂邪惡的生物對守序善良的異能者），靈光所引起的減值也不會進一步增加。

Precise Poison.name: Precise Poison（Precise Poison）
Precise Poison.description: The alchemist is adept at delivering poison to the most vulnerable areas of his targets. When the alchemist confirms a critical hit with a poisoned weapon, he increases the save DC of the poison by an amount equal to the weapon閳ユ獨 critical multiplier.

Presence of Dragons.name: Presence of Dragons（Presence of Dragons）
Presence of Dragons.description:
Those who would oppose you must overcome their fear of dragons or be struck with terror at your draconic majesty. As a swift action, you can manifest an aura of draconic might around yourself. Enemies within 30 feet who can see you when you activate this ability must attempt a Will save. Success means that the creature is immune to this ability for the following 24 hours. On a failed save, the opponent is shaken for 2d6 rounds. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.

  You can use this ability once per day at 1st level, plus one additional time per day at 5th level and for every 5 levels beyond 5th.

Primal Aether.name: Primal Aether（Primal Aether）
Primal Aether.description:
Element aether; Type utility (Su); Level 3; Burn 0

  You can gather strands of aether twisted and warped by your experiences in the Spellscar Desert, and wind them so tightly that they explode, creating a primal magic event with a CR equal to your kineticist level. See pages 12閳?3 of Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Inner Sea Magic for more information on primal magic events.

Primal Companion.name: Primal Companion（Primal Companion）
Primal Companion.description: You gain the service of a faithful animal of the night. You can select from a bear, boar, crocodile, shark, tiger, or wolf. This animal functions as a druid閳ユ獨 animal companion, using your oracle level as your effective druid level.

Primal Fury.name: 原始狂怒（Primal Fury）
Primal Fury.description: 13級起，以一個自由動作，你能釋放出自己更為原始的形態。除了以下方面，此功能如同轉變術（Transformation）。你能使用此能力的輪數等同你的異能者等級。這些輪數不需要連貫使用。你能以一個自由動作結束此效果。在使用此能力後，你陷入疲乏（Fatigued），持續的輪數等同使用原始狂怒的輪數的2倍。你不能在陷入疲乏（Fatigued）或力竭（Exhausted）狀態時啟動新一次原始狂怒。若你失去意識（fall unconscious），你的原始狂怒將立即中止。

Primal Speaker.name: Primal Speaker（Primal Speaker）
Primal Speaker.description:
The shaman can speak with mammoths and any other megafauna or elephant creatures as if she were under the effects of speak with animals.

  At 5th level, the shaman gains a bonus on Handle Animal checks when dealing with those animals equal to half her shaman level.

  At 10th level, the shaman can affect one such animal within 30 feet as if she閳ユ獓 cast charm animal (Will negates).

  Whether or not the target succeeds at the saving throw, it can閳ユ獩 be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.

Profane Bomb.name: Profane Bomb（Profane Bomb）
Profane Bomb.description:
When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it deal evil divine damage. Good creatures that take a direct hit from a profane bomb must succeed at a Fortitude save or be staggered on their next turn. Against a neutral creature, a profane bomb deals half damage, and the target is not affected by the bomb閳ユ獨 staggering effect. A profane bomb has no effect against evil-aligned creatures.

  An alchemist must be at least 8th level to select this discovery.

Progenitor's Sting.name: Progenitor's Sting（Progenitor's Sting）
Progenitor's Sting.description:
You can magically apply your toxic essence onto your weapon or onto the weapon of a willing ally within 30 feet as a standard action. (Poison閳ユ攰njury; save Fort DC 10 + half your sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1 Str, Dex, or Con damage [chosen when this ability is used]; cure 1 save).

  You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

  At 5th level, the ability damage of your poison increases to 1d3.

  At 7th level, each time you apply your progenitor閳ユ獨 sting, you can choose two ability scores for your bloodline poison to affect.

  At 11th level, whenever you apply your progenitor閳ユ獨 sting to a weapon, you can magically apply it onto all willing allies閳?weapons within 20 feet as well. This counts as one use of your bloodline ability.

Prohibition.name: Prohibition（Prohibition）
Prohibition.description:
As a standard action, you can command a creature within 30 feet to refrain from committing a particular action (including any referenced in the spell @Compendium[pf1.spells.mmdypasgl5us00wb]{Forbid Action}). If the creature performs the named action before the beginning of your next turn, it takes 1d6 points of damage + 1 point for every 2 cleric levels you possess and the effect ends. This is a language-dependent effect. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

If you have the spell rune domain power, you can attach a spell effect to the prohibition as if it were the spell rune domain ability; the spell takes effect if the creature performs the named action. This spell must be of at least 1 level lower than the highest-level cleric spell you can cast, and it must target one or more creatures. Regardless of the number of targets the spell can normally affect, it affects only the creature that triggers the rune. Attaching a spell in this way extends the duration of the prohibition by a number of rounds equal to the spell閳ユ獨 level, or until it is discharged.

  This power replaces the Touch of Law power of the Law Domain or the Blast Rune power of the Rune Domain.

Project Psyche.name: Project Psyche（Project Psyche）
Project Psyche.description:
You can project your psyche into another vessel. Once per day, you can possess another creature as if using the @Compendium[pf1.spells.8ai7fslz4zu8xe9s]{魔魂壺} spell, though this does not require a receptacle. You must be adjacent to the target creature, which receives a Will save against the effect.

  You must be at least 11th level to choose this revelation.

Promethean Curse.name: Promethean Curse（Promethean Curse）
Promethean Curse.description:
Your body is falling apart, forcing you to rely on mechanical augmentations or replacements to keep yourself alive. You take 1 point of Constitution damage each day, but you also ignore the first point of Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution damage you take for the remainder of that day.

  At 5th level, you gain a +2 bonus on all saving throws on effects that cause ability damage, ability drain, or ability score penalties.

  At 10th level, this bonus increases to +6.

  At 15th level, any effect that would normally deal ability drain on you instead deals ability damage whenever you successfully save against the effect.

Prophecy Subschool.name: Prophecy Subschool（Prophecy Subschool）
Prophecy Subschool.description:
Associated School: Divination.

  Replacement Powers: This subschool replaces the forewarned and scrying adept powers of the divination school.

Prophecy.name: Prophecy（Prophecy）
Prophecy.description: The witch can call on her prophetic ancestors and cast @Compendium[pf1.spells.pwueht12qqo0268e]{預言術} once per day. She can spend a full hour casting the spell in place of providing the usual material components.

Prophetic Armor.name: Prophetic Armor（Prophetic Armor）
Prophetic Armor.description: You are so in tune with your primal nature that your instincts often act to save you from danger that your civilized mind isn閳ユ獩 even aware of. You may use your Charisma modifier (instead of your Dexterity modifier) as part of your Armor Class and all Reflex saving throws. Your armor閳ユ獨 maximum Dexterity bonus applies to your Charisma, instead.

Propitiation.name: 慰靈之術（Propitiation）
Propitiation.description: 在9級時，通靈者學習了一些秘密的術式和祭儀，讓他可以安撫英靈，緩解英靈附體造成的負擔。每天一次，通靈者可以通過本能力減少1點自己承受的共鳴（最少降低到1）。每一個英靈都有屬於自己的獨有慰靈法，無論哪一種都需要至少10分鐘時間來執行，但是不需要物質獻祭（比如財產和祭品）。

Protection Patron.name: Protection Patron（Protection Patron）
Protection Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.yk5bgi6j9kbtigof]{聖域術}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.tkjnm3lw7ni82tag]{抵抗能量傷害}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.1gz3zdpxu7uic5ky]{狂怒斗篷}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.knyako6zopc1chrv]{石膚術}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.wu4y1ilg6iq28cr6]{護身掌}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.odel1qsctfkp8rdm]{禁制術}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.jg3p4t3dv1a7nqvo]{Spell Immunity, Greater}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ijwcwnt3oatnfghq]{虹光法牆}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.kdzx88z16gs8l392]{解錮術}

Protective Luck.name: Protective Luck（Protective Luck）
Protective Luck.description:
The witch can cause fate to twist so that it benefits a creature within 30 feet for 1 round. Whenever that creature is targeted by an effect that requires an attack roll, including weapon attacks, the attacker must roll twice and take the worse result.

  At 8th level and 16th level, the duration of this hex is extended by 1 round.

  A witch cannot use this ability on herself.

  Hexes that affect the fortune hex, such as cackle, also affect protective luck.

Psychedelia Discipline.name: 迷幻藥境界（Psychedelia Discipline）
Psychedelia Discipline.description:
你會使用致幻劑來拓展自身的心智。通過實驗與研究，你已經掌握了對自己來說能夠產生最佳效果的藥物劑量。服用藥劑會讓你的精神飛向與他人截然不同的層次，遺憾的是普通人絕對無法理解你的行為。

精神力池屬性 感知

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.azyo7xhfwdtjchtm]{Polypurpose Panacea} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.d4mp0m5xfnu9hbhn]{Mad Hallucination} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.zk334ykycwiwb0gn]{Synesthesia} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.n0bsyxchnigkkuqo]{困惑術} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.82vi1xife3nlu8a0]{海市蜃樓} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.2ip53auf03bqxkl1]{Joyful Rapture} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ni0okhagwuk0jbe9]{Waves of Ecstasy} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.xlzqpkl8fpm3sn4u]{愛與和平} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lnahlmp5mih2ongh]{星界投射} (18th).

Psychic Curse.name: 精神詛咒（Psychic Curse）
Psychic Curse.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點用異能魔法詛咒30尺內一個活物。你選擇下列一個效果：記憶流逝、心理閉鎖或疼痛混亂。記憶流逝效果為目標失去過去每秘學士等級1小時的記憶；心理閉鎖效果為你指定一個特定動作，比如“用某種武器攻擊”“施放一個特定法術”或“某種合適的選項（由GM裁定）”，目標若無法通過意志豁免檢定，則無法進行所選的動作，若目標接下來的輪內依然想進行該動作，那麼直到成功為止，接下來的豁免檢定會獲得+2加值；疼痛混亂效果為當目標被確認重擊時，會混亂1d4輪。目標可以進行意志豁免檢定來免除該效果。該效果持續每秘學士等級1天時間。單一生物無法承受超過一個的該效果。這是一個影響心靈的詛咒效果。你必須至少5級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Psychic Defense.name: Psychic Defense（Psychic Defense）
Psychic Defense.description: Reading small, invisible cues allows the psychic to take advantage of social circumstances and subtly influence her target. Casting a linked spell during a social encounter and spending 1 point from her phrenic pool allows the psychic to add a +4 bonus on her next Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, or Sense Motive check.

Psychic Discipline.name: 精神境界（Psychic Discipline）
Psychic Discipline.description:
每名異能者都可以通過一種特殊的理念來強化自身的精神力量，比如進行嚴格縝密的研究或者讓自己達到某種特別的心理狀態。這種理念被稱作她的精神境界。異能者會根據自身所選擇的精神境界來獲得額外的已知法術。精神境界的選擇必須在1級時做出；一旦選定，便無法更改。每個精神境界都會賦予異能者數個境界之力（在1級、5級和13級獲得），而且會賦予她額外的已知法術。此外，精神境界也決定了異能者的精神力池和精神增幅所使用的屬性類別。對抗精神境界能力（psychic discipline ability）的豁免檢定DC為10 + 異能者的等級的一半 + 異能者的智力調整值。

  1級起，異能者能夠根據自身的精神境界學會一個額外的法術。她會在4級以及之後的每2個等級再學會一個額外法術，直至18級時學會最後一個。這些法術不計入在表：異能者已知法術的數量中。通過精神境界知曉的法術無法在更高的等級時更換為其他不同的法術。

Psychic Fog.name: 精神迷霧（Psychic Fog）
Psychic Fog.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點創造出雲霧來。雲霧持續每秘學士等級1分鐘。它如同雲霧術般運作，只不過不會被風吹散。7級時，你可以在創造雲霧時額外消耗1點心智點，讓它變得粘稠，如同重霧術，但它不會減速具有異能之力或可施放異能法術的生物。以重霧術方式施放的精神迷霧持續時間縮短為每秘學士等級1輪。你必須至少3級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Psychic Impression.name: Psychic Impression（Psychic Impression）
Psychic Impression.description: Objects retain psychic impressions of those who come in contact with them, and a powerful mind can read these impressions. The mesmerist can trigger this trick when the subject touches an object that another creature with an Intelligence score of 3 or more has touched in the last 10 minutes. The mesmerist receives a psychic impression of the emotional state of the last such creature to touch the object. This impression contains no images or languages and can閳ユ獩 show the mesmerist who the creature was if the mesmerist doesn閳ユ獩 already know.

Psychic Inception (Stare).name: 開啟心智（Psychic Inception (Stare)）
Psychic Inception (Stare).description: 催眠注視以及它所帶來的懲罰還能影響無心智（mindless）或者免疫影響心靈（mind-affecting）效果的生物（比如不死生物或蟲類）。當此類生物受到催眠注視的影響時，催眠師還能夠用影響心靈的法術和能力對其產生一定的作用；目標會在豁免檢定中獲得+2加值（若允許豁免的話），而且就算受到影響，此類生物每輪還有50%的概率能夠忽略效果。忽略效果並不意味著效果的結束，但這讓目標生物能夠在該輪內正常行動。

Psychic Safeguard.name: 心靈屏障（Psychic Safeguard）
Psychic Safeguard.description: 13級起，你能構建出持續性的精神防護，這會讓你獲得法術抗力（spell resistance），數值為8 + 你的施法者等級。當你喚出黑暗半身後，這個法術抗力會增加至16 + 你的施法者等級。

Psychoactive Bomb.name: Psychoactive Bomb（Psychoactive Bomb）
Psychoactive Bomb.description:
Psychoactive bombs are mixed with neurotoxic extracts that heighten certain sensations. A creature struck by a psychoactive bomb takes a 閳? penalty on saving throws against charm, emotion, fear, and pain effects, and the DC for Intimidate checks against the victim decreases by 2. This effect lasts for 1 hour per alchemist level. These penalties do not stack, and a creature can only be affected by a single psychoactive bomb at a time. A psychoactive bomb deals 1d6 fewer hit points of damage than normal.

  An alchemist must be at least 6th level before selecting this discovery.

Psychofeedback.name: 精神反饋（Psychofeedback）
Psychofeedback.description: 異能者支付2點精神力及犧牲一個2環或以上的聯結法術，他的力量，敏捷或體質屬性會獲得每犧牲法術環級1點的增強加值，持續每異能者等級1分鐘。

Psychokinetic Tincture.name: Psychokinetic Tincture（Psychokinetic Tincture）
Psychokinetic Tincture.description:
Once per day, the alchemist can concoct a foul-tasting tincture that harnesses the power of the spirit. By drinking this tincture as a standard action, the alchemist can invite the latent spirits in the area to surround him. The alchemist can channel one spirit for every 4 alchemist levels he possesses. Each spirit channeled this way grants the alchemist a +1 deflection bonus to AC as the spirits whirl around his body. As a standard action, the alchemist can launch one of these spirits toward a target as a ranged touch attack. Launching a spirit this way reduces this discovery閳ユ獨 deflection bonus to AC by 1. As a launched spirit passes through its target閳ユ獨 body, it emits a terrible wail heard only in the target閳ユ獨 mind, causing the target to become frightened for 1 round per alchemist level (Will negates). This is a mind-affecting fear effect. A creature that successfully saves against the wail cannot be affected by this discovery again for 24 hours. The spirits whirl around the alchemist閳ユ獨 body for 10 minutes per alchemist level, or until the alchemist has launched all of the spirits.

  An alchemist must be at least 4th level to select this discovery.

Psychopomp Subdomain.name: Psychopomp Subdomain（Psychopomp Subdomain）
Psychopomp Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.s72y6ioltjbpucz0]{Chain of Perdition}
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.gfvnfa5k1tnpvg8v]{異界盟友} (psychopomps only)
  • 8環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.xmkvpl56appk20cl]{錮魂術}

Psychopomp Totem, Greater.name: Psychopomp Totem, Greater（Psychopomp Totem, Greater）
Psychopomp Totem, Greater.description:
While raging, the barbarian can detect and locate undead creatures within 30 feet, just as if it had the blindsight ability, and any weapons she wields are treated as if they had the ghost touch special ability.

  A barbarian must have the psychopomp totem rage power and be at least 10th level to select this rage power.

Psychopomp Totem, Lesser.name: Psychopomp Totem, Lesser（Psychopomp Totem, Lesser）
Psychopomp Totem, Lesser.description: While raging, the barbarian gains a +1 deflection bonus to AC against the attacks of undead creatures and a +1 bonus on saving throws against death effects, diseases, and poisons. This bonus increases by 1 for each psychopomp totem rage power she has, excepting this one.

Psychopomp Totem.name: Psychopomp Totem（Psychopomp Totem）
Psychopomp Totem.description:
The first time each round a creature with regeneration or fast healing is struck by the barbarian while she is raging, the creature must succeed at a Will save (DC = 10 + half the barbarian's level + the barbarian's Strength modifier) or that ability is suppressed for 1 round.

  A barbarian must have the lesser psychopomp totem rage power and be at least 6th level to select this rage power.

Psychosomatic Surge.name: 以心療身（Psychosomatic Surge）
Psychosomatic Surge.description: 精神魔法撫慰著受術者，暫時性地緩解了她所受到的創傷。當受術者受到傷害時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。受術者會獲得臨時生命值，數值相當於1d8 + 1/2催眠師的等級。若觸發詭計的攻擊所造成的傷害讓受術者的生命值降至0點或更低的話，該項詭計能額外賦予1d8點臨時生命值。這些臨時生命值持續1小時或者直至耗散為止。

Pull (1 pt).name: Pull (1 pt)（Pull (1 pt)）
Pull (1 pt).description:
An eidolon gains the ability to pull creatures closer with a successful attack. Select one type of natural attack. Whenever the eidolon makes a successful attack of the selected type, it can attempt a free combat maneuver check. If successful, the target of the attack is pulled 5 feet closer to the eidolon. This ability only works on creatures of a size equal to or smaller than the eidolon. Creatures pulled in this way do not provoke attacks of opportunity. The eidolon must have a reach of 10 feet or more to select this evolution.

  This evolution can be selected more than once. Its effects do not stack. Each time an eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a different natural attack.

Pull (UC) (1 pt).name: Pull (UC) (1 pt)（Pull (UC) (1 pt)）
Pull (UC) (1 pt).description:
Requirements: Reach of 10 feet or more.

  The eidolon gains the ability to pull creatures closer with a successful attack. Select one type of natural attack. Whenever the eidolon makes a successful attack of the selected type, it can attempt a free combat maneuver check. If the eidolon succeeds at this check, it pulls the target of the attack 5 feet closer to it. This ability works only on creatures of a size category equal to or smaller than the eidolon. Creatures pulled in this way do not provoke attacks of opportunity.

  This evolution can be selected more than once. Its effects do not stack. Each time an eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a different natural attack.

Pull into the Shadows.name: 拖走（Pull into the Shadows）
Pull into the Shadows.description: 以一個整輪動作，俠客可以移動最多相當於他移動速度的距離並且對一個尚未發現他的存在（或是將他視為盟友）的目標發動一次近戰攻擊。如果他的攻擊成功命中，那麼俠客可以對該目標發動一次拖拽戰技攻擊，這次戰技攻擊獲得+4加值且不觸發藉機攻擊。如果拖拽戰技成功，那麼即使俠客在本輪中已經沒有更多的移動距離，他也可以如同正常情況一般拖著他的敵人移動移動。俠客不能對自己真正的盟友或是一個自願的目標使用本天賦。

Pulling Infusion.name: Pulling Infusion（Pulling Infusion）
Pulling Infusion.description:
Element void; Type substance infusion; Level 1; Burn 1
Associated Blasts gravity, void
Saving Throw none

  Your kinetic blast pulls foes toward you. Attempt a drag combat maneuver check against each target damaged by your infused blast (the blast always drags the foe closer to you), using your Constitution modifier instead of your Strength modifier to determine your CMB.

  This infusion can pull a foe a maximum of 5 feet. You can increase the maximum distance pulled by 5 feet per additional point of burn accepted.

Pure Body.name: 純淨之身（Pure Body）
Pure Body.description: 13級起，你獲得免疫疾病（immunity to diseases）和免疫毒素（immunity to poisons）。

Pure Whimsy.name: Pure Whimsy（Pure Whimsy）
Pure Whimsy.description:
Once per day, you can release a stream of errant chaos from the First World as a standard action. When you do so, identify a target within 90 feet and generate a random effect as from a rod of wonder (or, at the GM閳ユ獨 discretion, another random or unusual effect of similar power). The DC of any required saving throw is 10 + half your oracle level + your Charisma modifier, and no effect from this ability persists for more than 1 day.

  You can use this ability once per day at 7th level and one additional time per day for every 4 levels beyond 7th. You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Pure of Mind.name: Pure of Mind（Pure of Mind）
Pure of Mind.description: At 3rd level, you gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against charm effects and a +4 bonus on saving throws against spells with the evil descriptor. At 9th level, your bonus on saving throws against charm effects increases to +4 and your bonus on saving throws against spells with the evil descriptor increases to +6.

Pure-Flame Infusion.name: 純焰注能（Pure-Flame Infusion）
Pure-Flame Infusion.description:
元素：火；類別：性質注能；等級：7；超載：4

  關聯念襲類別：藍焰擊

  豁免：無

  你打開一條直接連接著最純粹的火焰的通道，讓它噴湧出來。你的注能念襲會忽略法術抗力（spell resistance）。

Purge Corruption.name: 淨化腐濁（Purge Corruption）
Purge Corruption.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點從生物體內抽出濁物來。你必須用靈器觸摸目標來使用該能力。該能力如同中和毒素或移除疾病一般運作，用秘學士等級作為施法者等級。使用該能力單次只能治療一種毒素或一種疾病。你必須至少5級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Purge Disquiet.name: Purge Disquiet（Purge Disquiet）
Purge Disquiet.description:
At 13th level, you can banish mental distress. You become immune to fear spells and effects and to the confused condition.

  As a standard action, you can choose a willing creature that is either within 30 feet or in telepathic contact with you. For 1 round per psychic level you possess, you suppress any fear effect or confused, cowering, frightened, panicked, or shaken condition affecting that creature.

  You can suppress only one effect at a time with this ability, and choosing a new target ends the suppression for the character you previously chose.

Purging Flame.name: Purging Flame（Purging Flame）
Purging Flame.description:
Element fire; Type utility (Sp); Level 6; Burn 1

  You can purge yourself or another with flame, removing all impurities. This functions as @Compendium[pf1.spells.myg2b9ww43nnlbr2]{破除結界} on a single target. The target must be willing and takes 2 points of fire damage per character level as well as 1 point of burn (you do not need to accept burn unless you are the target). You can use this ability even when affected by an effect that denies you actions, so long as this effect is one that break enchantment could remove.

  If you burn rare incense or igneous rocks from Mount Kumijinja worth 100 gp or 1,000 gp as part of using purging flame, your target also benefits from restoration, as if the spell were cast using diamonds of equal value as a material component.

Purging Mutagen.name: Purging Mutagen（Purging Mutagen）
Purging Mutagen.description: The alchemist閳ユ獨 mutagen combines ipecac and other purgative components. A non-alchemist who consumes the mutagen is nauseated for only 1 round, during which time her body rapidly metabolizes or expels all extant toxins, granting her an immediate second saving throw against each ongoing disease and poison currently affecting her. Each successful save counts as two consecutive successful saving throws for the purpose of curing the affliction. Any failed saving throws do not result in additional damage or other effects. A non-alchemist who consumes a second purging mutagen in a 24-hour period is instead nauseated for 1 hour. When an alchemist drinks the mutagen, he can choose whether or not to also be affected by this discovery in addition to the mutagen閳ユ獨 other effects.

Purifying Flames.name: Purifying Flames（Purifying Flames）
Purifying Flames.description:
Element fire; Type utility (Sp); Level 4; Burn 1

  You use fire to burn poison from within a creature閳ユ獨 veins. You must attempt a caster level check (1d20 + your kineticist level) against the DC of each poison affecting the target. Success means that the poison is neutralized, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.6l904edkt8jv9jor]{中和毒性}.

  When you attempt to neutralize poison in this way, you can choose to deal a number of points of fire damage to the poisoned creature equal to the amount of damage you normally take from accepting burn in order to reduce the DC of one poison affecting the target by 2. This reduction remains until the end of your next turn.

Push (1 pt).name: Push (1 pt)（Push (1 pt)）
Push (1 pt).description:
An eidolon gains the ability to push creatures away with a successful attack. Select one type of natural attack. Whenever the eidolon makes a successful attack of the selected type, it can attempt a free combat maneuver check. If successful, the target of the attack is pushed 5 feet directly away from the eidolon. This ability only works on creatures of a size equal to or smaller than the eidolon. Creatures pushed in this way do not provoke attacks of opportunity.

  This evolution can be selected more than once. Its effects do not stack. Each time an eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a different natural attack.

Push (UC) (1 pt).name: Push (UC) (1 pt)（Push (UC) (1 pt)）
Push (UC) (1 pt).description:
The eidolon gains the ability to push creatures away with a successful attack. Select one type of natural attack. Whenever the eidolon makes a successful attack of the selected type, it can attempt a free combat maneuver check. If the eidolon succeeds at this check, it pushes the target of the attack 5 feet directly away from it. This ability works only on creatures of a size category equal to or smaller than the eidolon. Creatures pushed in this way do not provoke attacks of opportunity.

  This evolution can be selected more than once. Its effects do not stack. Each time an eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a different natural attack.

Pushing Infusion.name: 推行注能（Pushing Infusion）
Pushing Infusion.description:
元素：以太、氣、土或水；類別：性質注能；等級：1；超載：1

  關聯念襲類別：突風，風捲雪，帶電水，巖擊，熔岩流，轟鋼，硬泥團，沙塵暴，蒸灼，念動，水突

  豁免：無

  你的念襲勢頭洶湧，能夠將敵人擊退。嘗試一次衝撞（bull rush）戰技檢定對抗每個被你的注能念襲傷害的目標，使用你的體質調整值替代你的力量調整值來確定檢定的加值。這個注能最高可以把敵人推開5尺。你能夠增加這個注能的超載消耗來增加推開敵人的最高距離，每額外承受1點超載便能夠增加5尺距離上限。你無法將這個注能與不具有明確推行方向的塑形注能結合使用，比如雲形（cloud）。

Putrid Curse.name: Putrid Curse（Putrid Curse）
Putrid Curse.description:
Your presence stagnates water and befouls all liquids carried on your person, including magical items such as potions, and unattended sources of still water within 10 feet. Creatures who drink such a liquid are nauseated for 1 round (though potions and similar liquids still convey their usual benefits as well). Affected liquids remain stagnant for 1 hour after leaving your presence. @Compendium[pf1.spells.xi1uouy7qlpfaqlr]{淨化食糧} can cleanse a stagnant potion or water with a successful caster level check (DC = 15 + double the potion閳ユ獨 caster level).

  At 5th level, you become immune to the nauseated effects created by liquids your presence has befouled.

  At 10th level, your body is covered in noxious slime, and each creature adjacent to you at the beginning of its turn must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + half your oracle level + your Charisma modifier) or become sickened for 1 round.

  At 15th level, your slime coating grants you DR 10/閳?

Pyroclastic Shove.name: Pyroclastic Shove（Pyroclastic Shove）
Pyroclastic Shove.description:
As a standard action, you conjure a cascade of volcanic ash to bull rush a creature within 30 feet of you. The CMB of this cascade is equal to your base attack bonus + your Charisma modifier + 4 from the cascade閳ユ獨 Gargantuan size. If the bull rush succeeds, the creature takes 1d6 points of fire damage per oracle level.

  At 12th and at 17th level, you can use this ability one additional time per day.

  You must be 7th level to select this revelation.

Quenching Infusion.name: 猝熄注能（Quenching Infusion）
Quenching Infusion.description:
元素：水；類別：性質注能；等級：1；超載：1

  關聯念襲類別：帶電水，水突

  豁免：無

  你的念襲能夠熄滅非魔法火焰，就如同它們接觸到了水元素（water elemental）一般。若你將超載消耗增加至2點或者把念襲的傷害降至0點，念襲還會如同生命骰與你的操念使等級相同的水元素一般解除魔法火焰（dispels magical fires）。

Quick Change.name: 快速變裝（Quick Change）
Quick Change.description: 俠客學會了如何快速改變自己身份的方法。擁有本天賦的俠客可以以一個整輪動作而非一分鐘時間來轉換身份。但是如果他進行快速變裝後被任何同時認識他的兩個身份的生物遇到，那麼俠客就必須進行一個易容技能檢定來避免這個生物通過他雜亂的變裝看穿兩個身份事實上屬於同一個人。不過，俠客也可以在快速變裝後再花1輪時間來完善自己的變裝以避免該檢定。俠客必須達到7級才能選擇本天賦。

Quick Disguise.name: Quick Disguise（Quick Disguise）
Quick Disguise.description:
A rogue with this talent can use the items at hand and seemingly innocuous material hidden on her person to create startlingly effective disguises, reducing the amount of time it takes to create a disguise using the Disguise skill.

The time needed for the rogue to alter her appearance in this manner is based on the complexity of the disguise, as noted on the following table. The times are cumulative, so if a female rogue wants to disguise herself as a male of a different race, that takes 2 minutes.

Disguise Time
Minor details only 1 full-round action
Disguise as a different gender 1 minute
Disguise as a different race 1 minute
Disguise as a different age category 1 minute
Disguise as a different size category 1 minute

Quick Scrounge.name: Quick Scrounge（Quick Scrounge）
Quick Scrounge.description: The rogue can search a creature, object, or area in half as much time as normal. If her Perception check would normally require a full-round action or less, it becomes one step shorter along the following progression: full-round action, standard action, move action, swift action, immediate action. This talent has no effect on Perception checks that are attempted as free actions or Perception checks that don閳ユ獩 require an action.

Quickness.name: 急速（Quickness）
Quickness.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點讓你自己或你接觸的一個自願生物獲得超自然速度。該能力如同加速術運作，不過AC和反射豁免上的加值變為+2。該能力持續每秘學士等級1輪。你必須至少5級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Rabbit Punch (UC).name: Rabbit Punch (UC)（Rabbit Punch (UC)）
Rabbit Punch (UC).description:
The monk gives a sharp blow to the back of a foe閳ユ獨 head. The critical threat range and critical multiplier of this strike increase by 1, and the monk gains a +2 bonus on attack rolls to confirm a critical hit with this strike. This increase is not doubled by @Compendium[pf1.feats.TbOPtIL8Fv8obXtP]{精通重擊} or similar effects. Creatures without a discernible head are unaffected by this style strike (subject to GM discretion).

  The monk must attack with a fist to use this style strike.

Racial Paragon.name: Racial Paragon（Racial Paragon）
Racial Paragon.description:
The vigilante can take a move action to gain the benefit of a feat with a racial prerequisite he meets but doesn閳ユ獩 have. This effect lasts for 1 minute. The vigilante must meet all the feat閳ユ獨 prerequisites. He can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + 1/2 his vigilante level (minimum four times per day). The vigilante can use this ability again before the duration expires to replace a previous racial feat with another choice.

If a feat temporarily gained in this way has a daily use limitation, any uses of that feat while using this ability count toward that feat閳ユ獨 daily limit.

This vigilante talent can be selected multiple times. Each time it is selected after the first, the vigilante can use this ability to gain the benefits of one additional racial feat at the same time, or to reduce the action required to activate this talent by one step (a move action becomes a swift action, a swift action becomes a free action, and a free action becomes an immediate action). If the vigilante chooses to gain the benefits of multiple feats, the feats selected must share the same racial prerequisite. He can use one of these feats to meet a prerequisite of a second feat; doing so means he cannot replace a feat currently fulfilling another閳ユ獨 prerequisite without also replacing those feats that require it. Each individual feat selected counts toward his daily uses of this ability.

Racing Current (UC).name: Racing Current (UC)（Racing Current (UC)）
Racing Current (UC).description:
A monk with this ki power can create a wave to help him maneuver allies upon the battlefield, as if using the spell @Compendium[pf1.spells.7fvsn0gbv6ynlp63]{水流術}. Using this ability is a move action that costs 2 ki points, and the ability remains in effect for 1 minute.

  A monk must be 6th level to select this ki power.

Radiance.name: 輝光（Radiance）
Radiance.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點觸摸一個武器，讓它發散出光亮來。如同提供如同火炬一般的光。在確定黑暗法術或效果時，該輝光視為環級為0+每2秘學士等級1的光亮法術。輝光持續每秘學士等級1分鐘。另外，當該武器對一個敵人成功確認重擊時，武器持用者可以選擇結束輝光效果，讓目標被輝光環繞1d4輪。目標被輝光環繞時，無法從隱蔽或隱形中獲得好處，也無法嘗試進行潛行檢定。對被輝光纏繞的目標進行的攻擊檢定都獲得+2環境加值。

Radiating Touch.name: Radiating Touch（Radiating Touch）
Radiating Touch.description:
As a standard action that provokes attacks of opportunity, you can irradiate any unattended object for a number of rounds equal to your cleric level. While an object is irradiated, it emits a faint aura of transmutation. Any creature that passes within 5 feet of the aura must succeed at a Will save (DC equal to 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier) or become sickened. You閳ユ獧e immune to this object閳ユ獨 effect. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Acid Dart power of the Earth Domain.

Radiation Subdomain.name: Radiation Subdomain（Radiation Subdomain）
Radiation Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.sq5lzym6a8mmfl7l]{Defoliate}
  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.gq7np9mwtfd500zg]{枯萎術}
  • 8環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.e8zen5nzixnt7bde]{凋死術}

Rag Doll Mutagen.name: Rag Doll Mutagen（Rag Doll Mutagen）
Rag Doll Mutagen.description: When the alchemist imbibes a mutagen, his body and bones become rubbery and easy to contort. The alchemist gains a bonus equal to his class level on Escape Artist checks, can squeeze through places as if he were one size category smaller, and can make a Reflex save (DC equal to 15 + 1 for every 10 feet fallen) to take half damage from falling. At 10th level, all falling damage is considered nonlethal damage, and the alchemist can squeeze through places as if he were two size categories smaller than his size while under the effects of this mutagen.

Rage (Cleric).name: 狂暴(牧師)（Rage (Cleric)）
Rage (Cleric).description:
8級時，你每天能狂暴的輪數為牧師等級，該狂暴輪數和任何你從野蠻人等級獲得的狂暴輪數疊加。在12級和16級能分別選擇一個狂暴之力——但不能是有等級要求的，其它時候你野蠻人等級視為牧師等級一半。

  此能力替換毀滅領域的毀滅靈光能力。

Raging Flyer.name: Raging Flyer（Raging Flyer）
Raging Flyer.description: When raging, the barbarian adds her level as an enhancement bonus to Fly checks.

Raging Grappler.name: Raging Grappler（Raging Grappler）
Raging Grappler.description: While raging, the barbarian grapples her foes with the power and viciousness of a river crocodile. As long as she is raging, whenever the barbarian succeeds at a check to start a grapple, she can choose to deal damage as if she had also succeeded at a check to maintain the grapple. In addition, while she is raging, whenever the barbarian succeeds at a combat maneuver check to maintain a grapple, she can choose to give herself, the target of her grapple, or both the prone condition as a free action while continuing to maintain the grapple.

Raging Whirlwind.name: Raging Whirlwind（Raging Whirlwind）
Raging Whirlwind.description:
The barbarian can create a whirlwind with a powerful spinning move as an immediate action after she confirms a critical hit with a melee attack. The whirlwind circles the target of her melee attack, lifting it in the air slightly until the end of the barbarian閳ユ獨 turn. The creature can attempt a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + half the barbarian閳ユ獨 level + the barbarian閳ユ獨 Constitution modifier) to negate this effect. If it fails the save, the target loses its Dexterity modifier to AC for the rest of the barbarian閳ユ獨 turn and lands prone on the ground at the end of her turn. Raging whirlwind has no effect on flying creatures.

  A barbarian must be at least 12th level to choose this rage power.

Rake (2 pts).name: Rake (2 pts)（Rake (2 pts)）
Rake (2 pts).description:
An eidolon grows dangerous claws on its feet, allowing it to make 2 rake attacks on foes it is grappling. These attacks are primary attacks. The eidolon receives these additional attacks each time it succeeds on a grapple check against the target. These rake attacks deal 1d4 points of damage (1d6 if Large, 1d8 if Huge).

  This evolution is only available to eidolons of the quadruped base form. This evolution counts as one natural attack toward te eidolon's maximum.

  The summoner must be at least 4th level before selecting this evolution.

Rake (UC) (2 pts).name: Rake (UC) (2 pts)（Rake (UC) (2 pts)）
Rake (UC) (2 pts).description:
Requirements: Summoner level 4th, quadruped base form.

  The eidolon grows dangerous claws on its feet, allowing it to make two rake attacks against foes it is grappling. These attacks are primary attacks. The eidolon can make these additional attacks each time it succeeds at a grapple check against the target. These rake attacks deal 1d4 points of damage (1d6 if Large, 1d8 if Huge).

  This evolution counts as one natural attack toward the eidolon閳ユ獨 maximum.

Ranged Baptism.name: Ranged Baptism（Ranged Baptism）
Ranged Baptism.description:
When the alchemist uses holy water as a splash weapon, any squares subject to its effects (including creatures affected by splash damage) or that contain creatures subject to its effects are also affected as if by @Compendium[pf1.spells.zpav8ywcqwkcuojw]{祝聖術}, for a number of rounds equal to the alchemist閳ユ獨 Intelligence modifier. Undead struck by holy water remain affected by the @Compendium[pf1.spells.zpav8ywcqwkcuojw]{祝聖術} effect even if they leave the affected area.

  An alchemist must be at least 4th level before selecting this discovery.

Rapid Boost.name: Rapid Boost（Rapid Boost）
Rapid Boost.description: Once per day, the rogue can roll two dice while attempting a Sleight of Hand check and take the better result. She must choose to use this talent before attempting the Sleight of Hand check. A rogue can use this ability one additional time per day for every 5 rogue levels she has.

Rapid Perception.name: Rapid Perception（Rapid Perception）
Rapid Perception.description: A rogue with this talent can attempt a Perception check to intentionally search for a specific item or creature as a swift action instead of a move action. If she is intentionally searching for an invisible creature, the creature閳ユ獨 bonus on its Stealth check from its invisibility is halved. An investigator can select this rogue talent in place of an investigator talent. She must have the expanded inspiration investigator talent before selecting this talent.

Rapport Discipline.name: 和諧境界（Rapport Discipline）
Rapport Discipline.description:
和他人建立緊密的聯繫會引出你體內最好的一部分，這使得你可以更輕鬆地把精神和他人連接在一起。通過把自己的精神與他人相連，你能夠填補自身的心理缺陷，進而發展出全新的精神力量。

精神力池屬性 魅力

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.tjog6bufg5b08lvq]{魅惑人類} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.v3d3lnjj7ks0ztii]{注目術} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lisojmynoblunlex]{協調行動} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ofw6gnp6r7t2wcba]{Geas, Lesser} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lovx4kiq18gbvg4e]{Telepathy} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.eg3i21asvo69mbma]{Battlemind Link} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lf7xf41mmcdaaxzb]{Charm Person, Mass} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.q2r6jrgsbwjgssdg]{Charm Monster, Mass} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.xuuzj9lr2xbwaim4]{神威如獄} (18th).

Rare-Metal Infusion.name: 全金屬注能（Rare-Metal Infusion）
Rare-Metal Infusion.description:
元素：土；類別：性質注能；等級：3；超載：2

  關聯念襲類別：轟鋼

  豁免：無

  你能夠控制金屬的特性，讓你的轟鋼如同精金、寒鐵或者煉銀（由你選擇）一般克服傷害減免。若你的目標是需要正確的金屬類型才能夠克服的罕見傷害減免（比如DR/黃金），那麼你還可以選擇此類金屬以滿足要求。你使用這個注能創造的金屬會在不久之後逐漸消失，而且不具有任何金幣價值。

Ravenous Fury.name: Ravenous Fury（Ravenous Fury）
Ravenous Fury.description: At 9th level, you gain the benefits of @Compendium[pf1.spells.s9amdo5398alb5p0]{加速術} for a number of rounds per day equal to your sorcerer level. These rounds don閳ユ獩 need to be consecutive. Each time you hit a creature with two or more claw attacks during a full attack while affected by this ability, that creature takes 1d4 points of bleed damage.

Reach (1 pt).name: Reach (1 pt)（Reach (1 pt)）
Reach (1 pt).description: One of an eidolon's attacks is capable of striking at foes at a distance. Pick one attack. The eidolon's reach with that attack increases by 5 feet.

Reach (UC) (1 pt).name: Reach (UC) (1 pt)（Reach (UC) (1 pt)）
Reach (UC) (1 pt).description: One of the eidolon閳ユ獨 attacks is capable of striking foes at a distance. Select one attack. The eidolon閳ユ獨 reach with that attack increases by 5 feet.

Reach Spellstrike.name: Reach Spellstrike（Reach Spellstrike）
Reach Spellstrike.description:
The magus can deliver spells with a range of touch with ranged spellstrike up to a maximum range of close (25 feet + 5 feet per 2 caster levels).

  The magus must be at least 9th level and must have ranged spellstrike to select this arcana.

Reaper Final Revelation.name: Reaper Final Revelation（Reaper Final Revelation）
Reaper Final Revelation.description: Upon 20th level, you are a true reaper of death and no soul can escape your sight. You automatically confirm critical hits and creatures automatically fail Fortitude saves against your coup de grace attempts. In addition, you can notice, locate, and distinguish between living and undead creatures within 60 feet, just as if you had the blindsense ability. This sense does not allow you to detect objects, but it does allow you to notice living things that are not creatures.

Reaper Mystery.name: Reaper Mystery（Reaper Mystery）
Reaper Mystery.description:
本職技能: An oracle with this mystery adds Intimidate, Perception, Stealth, and Survival to her list of class skills.

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.to1cdmyh5rtfyg2s]{寒冷之觸} (2nd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.y4ztvvswf2uuwuqo]{Calm Spirit} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.l7tmsbg37zr1q382]{時之沙} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.l8xwrepcmkdgb2wf]{Purge Spirit} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.dg3mrasygkm83c3e]{殺生術} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lllhr9py6w44cxjm]{亡靈歸亡} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.rlfd7f64wgjfvg6e]{灰飛煙滅} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.e8zen5nzixnt7bde]{凋死術} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wplgawb6aznjx7se]{女妖之嚎} (18th).

Reaping Stalker.name: Reaping Stalker（Reaping Stalker）
Reaping Stalker.description: Some slayers prefer weapons with grim symbolism of lives cut short and can wield such weapons with unparalleled lethality. A slayer with this talent treats any sickle or scythe he wields as though it were one size larger for the purpose of determining its damage dice. In addition, the slayer increases the critical threat range of any sickle or scythe he wields by 1; this does not stack with other effects that alter a weapon閳ユ獨 threat range.

Rebel Leader.name: Rebel Leader（Rebel Leader）
Rebel Leader.description: At 8th level, you gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.R3a1OV18RwDJftvq]{領導力} as a bonus feat.

Rebirth Discipline.name: 重生境界（Rebirth Discipline）
Rebirth Discipline.description:
你的識海是由你往生中最強大的記憶所鑄成。你能把你前世所修化為今生的心靈力量。

精神力池屬性 魅力

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ndvks6ztnxhj6oxh]{Burst Of Insight} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.3ze0kso9hxff5u2f]{虛假生命} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.68ngvzmzvadhf6vs]{異界探知} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.0dcr75sqs8wpdrhg]{Ancestral Memory} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.3w1ozzzf8hk0gdzm]{轉生術} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.9pbl3ktd5oqejl19]{轉變術} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.btccs4sjo2nog1a0]{幻化靈體} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.v39qnirlhgje2c0e]{Bilocation} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.au6p72aztjhtokwr]{Akashic Form} (18th).

Rebirth.name: Rebirth（Rebirth）
Rebirth.description: At 20th level, the full power of a phoenix erupts from within you if you perish. When you die, you are brought back to life, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.mxqi375ya2rka7cp]{完全復生術}, after 1 minute. This ability can be used only once every 24 hours, and if you are slain again within this period, your death is permanent.

Recall Training.name: Recall Training（Recall Training）
Recall Training.description:
Samsaran only.

  By calling on the memories of previous incarnations, a samsaran slayer can use martial techniques that transcend his usual capabilities. Once per day, the slayer can take a move action to gain the benefit of a combat feat he doesn閳ユ獩 have. This effect lasts for 1 minute per slayer level he has.

  The slayer must meet all the feat閳ユ獨 prerequisites.

Reclusive Curse.name: Reclusive Curse（Reclusive Curse）
Reclusive Curse.description:
You are reclusive and paranoid to the point that your allies cannot easily help you in times of stress or unease. Whenever you are in combat, your allies must succeed at a melee touch attack to affect you with touch spells, and you must attempt saving throws to resist all spells cast by anyone other than yourself, even those cast by allies. Instantaneous spells you cast only on yourself affect you as though your caster level were 1 higher.

  At 5th level, any spells you cast only on yourself affect you as if they were modified by the @Compendium[pf1.feats.btXWioB3SKJv8YEG]{法術延時} feat. This does not increase their level or casting time.

  At 10th level, you are immune to charm spells and spell-like abilities.

  At 15th level, you gain spell resistance equal to 10 + your oracle level.

Recovery Patron.name: Recovery Patron（Recovery Patron）
Recovery Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.8jqq8kxdzx01ogl9]{Liberating Command}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.7xdn59ffjaqchhrz]{移除麻痺}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.75bgl52r3qmp1wh4]{神聖連結}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.lvzq2mwkqmozolpl]{行動自如}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.sbhij6pdo24wkm48]{清潔術}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.op40qjf9oohlx5nu]{英雄宴}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.2ip53auf03bqxkl1]{Joyful Rapture}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.0kppkhsencd6tzvh]{防護法術}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.klcvk9ct1l7mhjwp]{群體醫療術}

Redemption Subdomain.name: Redemption Subdomain（Redemption Subdomain）
Redemption Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.rue864nzo68esp30]{Qualm}
  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.98277u53x5r925cm]{強制懺悔}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.qr6qcx8zqum6jhc4]{贖罪術}

Redirect Force.name: Redirect Force（Redirect Force）
Redirect Force.description: If the ninja has a feat that allows her to attempt a combat maneuver without provoking attacks of opportunity, she can choose to provoke them anyway when she performs that maneuver. If she does so and takes damage from the attack of opportunity, the ninja adds the damage as a bonus on her attack roll instead of as a penalty.

Redirect Poison.name: Redirect Poison（Redirect Poison）
Redirect Poison.description:
The slayer can divert poisoned attacks against him. When a creature unsuccessfully attacks the slayer with a poisoned weapon or a natural weapon that would poison him, the slayer can attempt to redirect the attack to a creature within his reach (including, possibly, the creature that unsuccessfully attacked the slayer). As an immediate action, the slayer can make an attack roll against the creature to which he would redirect the poison. On a success, the poison is redirected to the target, and the target must attempt a saving throw against the poison as normal. This attack only redirects the poison and does not otherwise damage the targeted creature.

  This ability cannot affect a creature that attacked the slayer with a poisoned natural weapon, but it can affect a creature that attacked him with a poisoned manufactured weapon.

Redirect Primal Magic.name: Redirect Primal Magic（Redirect Primal Magic）
Redirect Primal Magic.description: If the arcanist triggers a primal magic event, she can spend 1 point from her arcane reservoir as an immediate action to redirect the event. The event occurs at a location of the arcanist閳ユ獨 choosing within a 20-foot radius. This radius expands by 5 feet for every 2 arcanist levels she has.

Reflect Fear.name: Reflect Fear（Reflect Fear）
Reflect Fear.description:
The mesmerist can trigger this trick when the subject is affected by a fear effect or is the target of an Intimidate check to demoralize it. When the trick is triggered, the subject suppresses the fear effect that triggered the trick for 1d4 rounds, and any creature that caused this effect must succeed at a Will save or become shaken for 1 round. The rounds during which the subject ignores the triggering fear effect still count against the effect閳ユ獨 duration.

  If the duration of the reflect fear trick is longer than the fear effect lasts, the subject isn閳ユ獩 affected by the fear effect at all.

Reflection of Weakness.name: 衰弱映射（Reflection of Weakness）
Reflection of Weakness.description: 當敵人將弱化效果強行加諸於受術者身上時，精神反饋會讓敵人自身也受到弱化。當一個敵人進行的攻擊或法術導致受術者受到屬性傷害（ability damage）、屬性吸取（ability drain）、出血傷害（bleed damage）、或者接觸療法（Touch Treatment）職業能力中列出的次級或中級狀態（minor or moderate condition）時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。當詭計被屬性傷害、屬性吸取或出血傷害觸發時，受術者承受的傷害或吸取量降低2點（最低降至0點），而進行攻擊或施放法術的生物會承受2點屬性傷害，哪個屬性受到傷害則由催眠師進行選擇。敵人能夠嘗試一次意志豁免來免受屬性傷害。若攻擊者是通過詛咒（curse）、疾病（disease）或毒素（poison）來對受術者承受屬性傷害或吸取的話，該項詭計也能生效，不過僅限於上述效果能立即造成傷害且沒有潛伏期的情況。當詭計是由於受術者承受了一個狀態而被觸發時，受術者仍會受到狀態影響，但是攻擊者也會按照催眠師的選擇承受一個狀態，持續1輪。該狀態必須為接觸療法（Touch Treatment）職業能力中列出的次級狀態（Minor Conditions）或中級狀態（Moderate Conditions）。敵人能夠嘗試一次意志豁免來抵禦這個狀態。催眠師不需要具有接觸療法（Touch Treatment）就能使用或選取該項催眠師詭計。

Reflexive Shadow Shield.name: Reflexive Shadow Shield（Reflexive Shadow Shield）
Reflexive Shadow Shield.description: Once per day as an immediate action, the rogue can gain an amount of cold resistance or electricity resistance equal to half the rogue閳ユ獨 level. This resistance lasts for 1 round. If the rogue has the shadowy resistance racial trait, the cold or electricity resistance stacks with the resistance that trait grants; otherwise, the energy resistance does not stack with any cold or electricity resistance the rogue has.
