The rogue must have the resiliencyPU rogue talent before choosing this talent.

Reforged Arms.name: Reforged Arms（Reforged Arms）
Reforged Arms.description:
The forge閳ユ獨 fire turns earthen ore into useful metal, and you can hone weapons in the same way. As a standard action, you can touch a metal or stone weapon and transform it into a masterwork equivalent if it is not already a masterwork or magical weapon.

  At 3rd level, you can also have the weapon act as if it were made of alchemical silver or cold iron (your choice when you activate this ability) for the purpose of bypassing damage reduction.

  At 7th level, 15th level, and 19th level, the weapon gains a cumulative +1 enhancement bonus, though this bonus does not stack with any enhancement bonus the weapon already has.

  At 11th level, you can have the weapon act as if it were made of adamantine rather than of alchemical silver or cold iron.

  This effect lasts for 1 minute per oracle level, and you can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Reforged Flesh.name: Reforged Flesh（Reforged Flesh）
Reforged Flesh.description: At 20th level, you become immune to fire damage and gain DR 10/adamantine and magic.

Refreshing Rain.name: Refreshing Rain（Refreshing Rain）
Refreshing Rain.description:
At 8th level, as standard action, you can call a brief shower of rain in a 30-foot radius. Creatures in the area are healed of an amount of nonlethal damage equal to double your cleric level and are no longer exhausted, fatigued, nauseated, or sickened. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and one additional time per day for every 4 levels beyond 8th.

  This power replaces the Lightning Lord power of the Weather Domain.

Regenerative Sinew.name: Regenerative Sinew（Regenerative Sinew）
Regenerative Sinew.description:
The witch can cause the debilitating wounds of a creature she touches to quickly close, helping it heal rapidly. The target either gains fast healing 5 for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 the witch閳ユ獨 class level or it heals up to 4 points of ability score damage from any two ability scores (witch閳ユ獨 choice).

  At 15th level, in addition to the chosen effect, the target閳ユ獨 severed body members, broken bones, and ruined organs grow back, as per regenerate.

  Once a creature has benefited from this hex, it cannot benefit from it again for 24 hours.

Relativity.name: Relativity（Relativity）
Relativity.description: At 15th level, you can traverse vertical surfaces as easily as you walk on the ground. When climbing, you move at your normal land speed and take none of the penalties associated with climbing. The surface must be able to support your weight, and difficult terrain affects your speed as normal. You are also immune to @Compendium[pf1.spells.3bdfw5f15hwcxlth]{反重力} and similar effects.

Relentless Casting.name: 強韌施法（Relentless Casting）
Relentless Casting.description: 異能者能夠從精神力池中花費1點精神力，來使得聯結法術在克服法術抗力（spell resistance）時需要進行的施法者等級檢定可以投擲兩次並取較好的結果。由於異能者必須在開始施放法術時決定是否花費精神力，因此她必須在GM要求進行施法者等級檢定之前決定是否使用該能力。

Remade Self.name: 重塑自我（Remade Self）
Remade Self.description: 20級起，異能者會受到後述法術之一的影響，作為常駐（constant）的類法術能力；秘法視力（Arcane Sight）、飛行術（Fly）、加速術（Haste）、英雄氣概（Heroism）、迴避偵測（Nondetection）或巧言術（Tongues）。該能力在異能者達到20級時進行選擇，且不能更改。若異能者處於這個類法術能力影響之下的話，每當她施放一個異能者法術（psychic spell）時，都可以從她已知的精神增幅或高等精神增幅中，選取一個在正常情況下花費1點精神力的精神增幅，然後在不消耗精神力的情況下聯結到法術上。而且這個精神增幅不被計算在每個法術最高只能受到一個精神增幅影響的正常限制中。

Remedy Extract.name: Remedy Extract（Remedy Extract）
Remedy Extract.description:
When the alchemist creates an extract, he can add one nonmagical alchemical remedy (such as an antitoxin) to it. When the extract is consumed, both the formula and the alchemical remedy take effect. The extract has a level 1 higher than normal. This discovery cannot be combined with other methods of combining multiple consumed items or extracts into one.

  An alchemist must be at least 4th level before selecting this discovery.

Remote Bomb.name: Remote Bomb（Remote Bomb）
Remote Bomb.description: The alchemist can spend two uses of his daily bombs to create a special bomb that is manually detonated. When the bomb is created, the alchemist also creates a catalyst distillate, which requires no extra time or cost. A remote bomb is inert unless triggered by this distillate. The bomb is detonated as a standard action when the distillate fumes are exposed to the rest of the bomb. An alchemist must be within 60 feet of the bomb for the distillate to successfully trigger the bomb. A catalyst distillate can detonate a bomb even if the bomb has already been hurled at a target. Triggering the distillate outside of the 60-foot range or after 1 hour has no effect.

Rend (2 pts).name: Rend (2 pts)（Rend (2 pts)）
Rend (2 pts).description:
An eidolon learns to rip and tear the flesh of those it attacks with its claws, gaining the rend ability. Whenever the eidolon makes two successful claw attacks against the same target in 1 round, its claws latch onto the flesh and deal extra damage. This damage is equal to the damage dealt by one claw attack plus 1-1/2 times the eidolon's Strength modifier. The eidolon must possess the claws evolution to select this evolution.

  The summoner must be at least 6th level before selecting this evolution.

Rend (UC) (2 pts).name: Rend (UC) (2 pts)（Rend (UC) (2 pts)）
Rend (UC) (2 pts).description:
Requirements: Summoner level 6th, claws evolution.

  The eidolon learns to rip and tear the flesh of those it attacks with its claws, gaining the rend ability. Whenever the eidolon makes two successful claw attacks against the same target in 1 round, its claws latch on to the flesh and deal extra damage. This damage is equal to the damage dealt by one claw attack plus 1-1/2 times the eidolon閳ユ獨 Strength modifier.

Renewed Vigor (UC).name: Renewed Vigor (UC)（Renewed Vigor (UC)）
Renewed Vigor (UC).description:
As a standard action, the barbarian heals 1d8 points of damage + her Constitution modifier. For every 4 levels the barbarian has beyond 4th, the amount healed increases by 1d8 (to a maximum of 5d8 at 20th level).

  This ability can be used only once per day.

  The barbarian must be at least 4th level to select this rage power.

Renown.name: 聲譽（Renown）
Renown.description: 俠客的作為和能力為他贏得了相當的知名度，無論他目前的身份是公開的或是私下的。聲譽讓俠客可以在進行社交時更為圓滑輕鬆，或是在他披上假面打擊敵人時用名聲威嚇自己的對手。

Reshape Space.name: Reshape Space（Reshape Space）
Reshape Space.description:
Whenever you cast a spell that creates an extradimensional space or demiplane, increase the duration by a number of units (rounds, minutes, hours, etc.) equal to 1/2 your wizard level (minimum 1).

  At 20th level, you can make one spell that creates an extradimensional space or demiplane permanent. You can have no more than one such spell made permanent in this way at a time. If you designate another spell as permanent, the previous permanent spell ends.

Resilience of the Faithful.name: 堅毅信仰（Resilience of the Faithful）
Resilience of the Faithful.description: 5級起，你的所有豁免檢定獲得+2抗力加值。這個加值在5級之後的每5個等級增加1點。

Resiliency (ORA) (Battle).name: 堅韌身軀(先知)(戰爭)（Resiliency (ORA) (Battle)）
Resiliency (ORA) (Battle).description: 當你的生命值降為0時你並不會陷入癱瘓，也不會再獲得恍惚狀態。7級你獲得“頑強”作為獎勵專長。11級你在陷入癱瘓時進行標準動作不會失去1點生命值。你不需要達到獲得頑強專長的先決條件。

Resiliency (ORA) (Godclaw).name: Resiliency (ORA) (Godclaw)（Resiliency (ORA) (Godclaw)）
Resiliency (ORA) (Godclaw).description:
Once per day, when you are brought below 0 hit points but not killed, you can act is if you are disabled for 1 round. At the end of your next turn, unless you are brought to above 0 hit points, you immediately fall unconscious and begin dying.

  At 7th level, you gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.O0e0UCim27GPKFuW]{頑強} as a bonus feat, even if you do not meet the prerequisite.

  At 15th level, three times per day, if you are disabled and take a standard action (or any otherwise strenuous action), you avoid taking 1 point of damage if you succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude saving throw.

Resist Primal Magic.name: Resist Primal Magic（Resist Primal Magic）
Resist Primal Magic.description: When attempting to cast spells in an area infused by primal magic, the arcanist can spend 1 point from her arcane reservoir as part of the casting to gain a bonus equal to half her arcanist level on Spellcraft checks to avoid triggering a primal magic effect.

Resistance (1 pt).name: Resistance (1 pt)（Resistance (1 pt)）
Resistance (1 pt).description:
An eidolon's form takes on a resiliency to one particular energy type, which is usually reflected in its physical body (ashen hide for fire, icy breath for cold, and so on). Pick one energy type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic). The eidolon gains resist 5 against that energy type.

  This resistance increases by 5 for every 5 levels the summoner possesses, to a maximum of 15 at 10th level.

  This evolution can be selected more than once. Its effects do not stack. Each time an eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a different energy type.

Resistance (UC) (1 pt).name: Resistance (UC) (1 pt)（Resistance (UC) (1 pt)）
Resistance (UC) (1 pt).description:
The eidolon閳ユ獨 form takes on a resiliency to one particular energy type, which is usually reflected in its physical body (ashen hide for fire, icy breath for cold, and so on). Select one energy type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic). The eidolon gains resistance 5 against that energy type. This resistance increases by 5 for every 5 levels the summoner possesses, to a maximum of 15 at 10th level.

  This evolution can be selected more than once. Its effects do not stack. Each time the eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a different energy type.

Resonating Rumbles.name: Resonating Rumbles（Resonating Rumbles）
Resonating Rumbles.description: When a rogue with this talent makes a successful sneak attack against a creature with tremorsense, the rogue can subtract 3 dice from her sneak attack damage to prevent the target from using tremorsense for a number of rounds equal to half her rogue level.

Restless Slumber.name: Restless Slumber（Restless Slumber）
Restless Slumber.description:
The witch causes a creature within 30 feet to fall into a sleep riddled with nightmares. This functions as the slumber hex.

  Additionally, the restless nature of the sleep causes the creature to violently toss and turn, dealing 1d10 points of damage to itself each turn. This damage does not wake the creature.

  When it wakes, the creature閳ユ獨 addled state causes it to be confused for a number of rounds equal to half the witch閳ユ獨 level.

  The witch must have the slumber hex to select this hex.

Restored Glory.name: Restored Glory（Restored Glory）
Restored Glory.description: At 3rd level, objects in your possession with the broken condition function as if they did not have the broken condition, though if they reach 0 hit points they are destroyed as normal. At 9th level, destroyed objects (objects with 0 hit points) in your possession function and appear as if they had only the broken condition, though if they reach a number of negative hit points equal to your level, they become fully destroyed and don閳ユ獩 function at all, even in your possession. At 15th level, destroyed objects in your possession function and appear as if fully repaired, though they can become fully destroyed as described above. Destroyed objects must have physical pieces left to be affected by this ability. Objects that leave your possession are affected normally by these conditions. This ability does not affect artifacts.

Restoring Flames.name: Restoring Flames（Restoring Flames）
Restoring Flames.description: At 15th level, you can cast @Compendium[pf1.spells.igmb8lisqcnsxd2d]{高等復原術} once per day as a spell-like ability.

Restriction (Stare).name: Restriction (Stare)（Restriction (Stare)）
Restriction (Stare).description: The target of the hypnotic stare treats all areas of dim light or darker as difficult terrain.

Resurgence.name: 復甦（Resurgence）
Resurgence.description: 在5級時，當你受到足以將你生命值降為0的攻擊時，你可以支付2點精神力以一個直覺動作回覆1D8+你的異能者等級的生命值。在10級時，這個數值增加到3D8+你的異能者等級。如果這次治療不能將你的生命值回覆到正數，則你會自動穩定。如果你依舊被這次攻擊殺死，則你會以你為中心作一次30尺半徑的正能量爆發來治療你所有盟友，其治療的生命值等同你受到的治療額度。

Retributive Spray.name: Retributive Spray（Retributive Spray）
Retributive Spray.description: At 12th level, whenever you閳ユ獧e hit by an attack or spell that deals slashing or piercing damage, your black blood sprays up to 10 feet toward the opponent who attacked you, striking the first creature along its path. That creature takes 1d8 points of cold damage + 1 point of cold damage for every 2 bloodrager levels you possess. A successful Reflex save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your bloodrager level + your Constitution modifier) halves the damage.

Return to Dust.name: Return to Dust（Return to Dust）
Return to Dust.description:
You call upon the inexorable ravages of time and entropy to damage an object or undead creature within 30 feet, dealing 1d6 points of damage per 2 oracle levels you have, ignoring hardness and damage reduction. If used against an undead creature or an object in another creature's possession, the undead creature or the creature possessing the object can attempt a Reflex saving throw to halve the damage.

  You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Returning Weapon.name: 武器回返（Returning Weapon）
Returning Weapon.description: 俠客擁有一種他標誌性的投擲武器，在把它丟出去的時候這件武器會自己飛回來。俠客需要選擇一種投擲武器如匕首或飛斧，每當俠客使用這種武器戰鬥時，它們會在被投擲後自動返回，如同擁有回返武器特殊附魔一般。在14級時，如果俠客選擇將一種可以視為彈藥的投擲武器（如手裡劍）應用本天賦，那麼如果他使用的這一組50發投擲武器均會在被扔出去之後自動返回，使俠客的投擲不會造成任何消耗。如果俠客選擇的是一種正常情況下不會消耗的投擲武器，那麼當他投出這把武器的同一輪中接下來他所有投擲的同種類非魔法武器都會自動繼承第一把武器的所有魔法品質，讓俠客可以在一輪中使用擁有同樣好處的武器發動整輪投擲攻擊——雖然它們仍然會在他的下回合才會飛回來。

Revelation Inquisition.name: Revelation Inquisition（Revelation Inquisition）
Revelation Inquisition.description: 神授力量: 摘下它們不配擁有的身份，在你的眼前，以良善為假面具的惡徒將被曝光於天下，接受制裁。

Revelation Subdomain.name: Revelation Subdomain（Revelation Subdomain）
Revelation Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.moftgchcn1d0p2t0]{偵測密門}
  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.nokru6mxk9p3r513]{識破隱形}
  • 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.u5rbvasnr78ifrp7]{表象祛除}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.jbqo4o2b2tmdz7wv]{真知術}

Revelry Subdomain.name: Revelry Subdomain（Revelry Subdomain）
Revelry Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.5nr9o7o0it6ewf17]{狂笑術}
  • 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.rgd5v3llwoptwcdb]{強大希望}
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.op40qjf9oohlx5nu]{英雄宴}
  • 8環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.oq3mqv5vovjkoa2p]{迷舞}

Revenge.name: Revenge（Revenge）
Revenge.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.cfzk3vkv1c7ncaug]{魔牙術}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.7fvsn0gbv6ynlp63]{水流術}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.8u1xa5javcxc6szk]{狂暴術}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.2mh7g81k30bv7b5m]{精神錯亂}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.w88ddxpu89qcr5c0]{野獸形態III}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.suilv5ug3tvbwuh2]{Vengeful Outrage}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.6jz03m4lryndt0kd]{復仇鬼影}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.o4rwtizvdj7216qd]{水幕天華}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.n4e35m6qu9nmkhgm]{復仇風暴}

Reverse Shift.name: 逆向遷躍（Reverse Shift）
Reverse Shift.description:
元素：通用；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：8；超載：0

  你將原本從靈界位面流向你的聯繫逆轉，把你自己的身體置於靈界位面中，就如同幻化靈體（ethereal jaunt）一般。只要你專注於逆轉聯繫，便可以維持在靈界位面中；當你在靈界位面中持續逗留的輪數等同於你的操念使等級時（以及之後每隔同樣長的時間段時），你必須承受1點超載。一旦你返回了主物質位面（the Material Plane），就會在一定時間內無法再次使用逆向遷躍，這段時間的長度和你身處靈界位面的輪數相同。

Ride the Blast.name: 隨念而動（Ride The Blast）
Ride the Blast.description:
元素：通用；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：6；超載：0

  你能夠在使用念動（telekinetic blast）之外的念襲時，以使用念襲的一部分使用該原力。你把自己轉化為元素或能量，並隨著念襲把自己發送出去。你會出現在唸襲路徑的最末端，並與念襲的目標相鄰。如果使用了連鎖（Chain）這樣的塑形注能，則與最後一個目標相鄰。如果使用了爆破（Explosion）這樣的塑形注能的話，則會出現在擴散或爆發區域的中心。該能力對涉及到近戰攻擊的塑形注能（比如念刃）或者噴湧（Spray）這樣的錐形注能無效。

Rider Bond (2 pts).name: Rider Bond (2 pts)（Rider Bond (2 pts)）
Rider Bond (2 pts).description:
You and your eidolon share an empathic connection while you ride it. You gain a bonus on Ride checks equal to one-half your summoner level and you also gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.0spsP9ylE3goD3jc]{騎乘戰斗} as a bonus feat when mounted on your eidolon.

  The eidolon must possess the mount evolution to take this evolution.

Rift Reach.name: Rift Reach（Rift Reach）
Rift Reach.description:
As a move action, you can tear open a small rent in reality just large enough to reach an arm through. The far end of this portal must be within 10 feet of you, but otherwise allows you to manipulate objects, perform melee attacks requiring a single hand, or even cast spells. If you cannot see your target, standard concealment penalties apply. You cannot move either end of the portal once it閳ユ獨 created, and the opening collapses immediately when you leave your current space or withdraw your arm, but it otherwise lasts for 1 round per psychic level. Your disembodied hand uses your AC with a +4 size bonus, should opponents target it. This size bonus does not apply to disarm combat maneuver checks.

You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

  At 11th level, the range of your rift reach increases to 20 feet.

  At 15th level, your range increases to 30 feet.

Righteous Fury.name: Righteous Fury（Righteous Fury）
Righteous Fury.description: At 9th level, once per day you can create a spear of pure light and throw it at a creature within 60 feet as a standard action. This is a ranged touch attack that uses your Charisma modifier in place of your Dexterity modifier to determine the attack bonus. The spear deals 1d6 points of damage per sorcerer level and ignores all damage reduction and hardness. This damage increases to 1d8 points of damage per sorcerer level against an evil creature. At 13th level, you can use this ability twice per day. At 17th level, you can use this ability three times per day.

Rime-Bound Gloom.name: Rime-Bound Gloom（Rime-Bound Gloom）
Rime-Bound Gloom.description:
The gloom creates an area of freezing shadow in its splash radius that deals 2d6 points of cold damage to all creatures in the area each turn. This effect lasts 1 round for every 2 alchemist levels.

  An alchemist must be at least 6th level to select this discovery.

Riot Subdomain.description:

Rites Subdomain.description:
替代神授力量 When casting a Rites domain spell with a costly material component閳ユ攼r casting permanency on any domain spell閳ユ敂educe the cost of the necessary components by 20%.

  替代領域法術

Ritual Unity.name: Ritual Unity（Ritual Unity）
Ritual Unity.description:
You receive a +2 bonus on all skill checks attempted as part of an occult ritual. When you take the aid another action to assist an ally with a skill check and succeed at a DC 20 check, you impart a +4 bonus to your ally instead.

  When you successfully aid an ally in this way, you regain 1 point in your phrenic pool.

Rivers Subdomain.name: Rivers Subdomain（Rivers Subdomain）
Rivers Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ohy0ty2dawfaaqwd]{水流衝擊}

Rivethun Discipline.name: Rivethun Discipline（Rivethun Discipline）
Rivethun Discipline.description:
You have embraced those aspects of your body that cause you agony, respecting the perspective they grant you if not necessarily the roles they閳ユ獫e condemned you to in life.

精神力池屬性 魅力

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.r8bhei88g6h26fp0]{Heightened Awareness} (1st),

Rocket Bomb.name: Rocket Bomb（Rocket Bomb）
Rocket Bomb.description:
Alchemists with this discovery can prepare special rockets to deliver their bombs. Rocket bombs travel farther and explode bigger than normal bombs, but cannot target individual creatures. Rocket bombs explode in a 20-foot radius, and all creatures in that area take the alchemist閳ユ獨 normal splash damage. The range increment on a rocket bomb is 50 feet. Rocket bombs cannot be used with the precise bomb or fast bomb discoveries.

  An alchemist must be at least 6th level before selecting this discovery.

Rogue Talent (VIG).name: Rogue Talent (VIG)（Rogue Talent (VIG)）
Rogue Talent (VIG).description: The vigilante gains a single rogue talent (not an advanced talent) of his choice. If he selects a rogue talent marked with an asterisk (*), that talent applies to his hidden strikes instead of to sneak attacks, and the talent counts as a stalker vigilante talent with an asterisk (*) for the limitation of only one applying to a given hidden strike. Only a stalker vigilante can select this talent.

Roiling Soil.name: Roiling Soil（Roiling Soil）
Roiling Soil.description:
Combining your mastery of earth and water, you shape the battlefield in your favor, bending the terrain to benefit you and your allies and hinder any who might oppose you. The ground within 5 feet per 2 oracle levels you have shifts and rolls unpredictably; if you use this ability underwater, the surrounding waters churn. This area moves with you, and you and your allies are unaffected by the roiling terrain. Other creatures can move within the area at half speed with a successful DC 10 Acrobatics check. Failure means they stop moving for the round, while failure by 5 or more causes them to fall prone; if underwater, creatures gain the effects of being off-balance (Pathfinder RPG Core Rulebook 433) instead of falling prone.

  This effect lasts a number of rounds equal to your oracle level, and you can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Rooftop Infiltrator.name: 大廈滲透者（Rooftop Infiltrator）
Rooftop Infiltrator.description: 俠客獲得相當於他基礎移動速度一半的攀爬速度，並且他在爬繩子的時候這個攀爬速度上升到等於他的基礎移動速度。

Roots.name: Roots（Roots）
Roots.description:
Element wood; Type utility (Su); Level 1; Burn 0

  Your body sinks roots into soft surfaces, making it hard to move you. This functions as the earth walk wild talent, except it works only on soft surfaces (like soil or snow) and not on stone.

  If you have both roots and earth walk, the bonuses stack while you閳ユ獧e on soft earth surfaces.

Rot Patron.description:

Rule Minds.name: 精神支配（Rule Minds）
Rule Minds.description: 20級起，催眠師能夠永久性地從精神上奴役一個生物。當催眠師成功用一個需要進行豁免檢定的附魔系（enchantment）法術影響了催眠注視（Hypnotic Stare）的目標時，他能夠迫使該名生物嘗試第二次意志豁免檢定，該次豁免的DC與法術的DC相同。如果目標是怪物（monster）而非類人生物（humanoid）的話，DC會降低5點。若該生物豁免失敗，它會如同受到支配怪物（Dominate Monster）法術一般成為催眠師的永久奴隸，直至死亡為止。若該生物豁免成功，則會在24小時內不再受到精神支配的影響。在同一時間，催眠師僅能擁有一名被支配的生物。如果他奴役了一個新的生物，原有的生物便會得到解放，但它並不會意識到自己受到了催眠師的奴役。

Rumormonger.name: Rumormonger（Rumormonger）
Rumormonger.description:
A rogue with this talent can attempt to spread a rumor though a small town or larger settlement by making a Bluff check. She can do so a number of times per week equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 0). The DC is based on the size of the settlement, and it takes a week for the rumor to propagate through the settlement. If the check succeeds, the rumor is practically accepted as fact within the community; succeeding by 5 or more over the DC decreases the time it takes the rumor to propagate by 1d4 days. A failed check means the rumor failed to gain traction, while failing by 5 or more causes the opposite of the rumor or some other competing theory involving the rumor閳ユ獨 subject to take hold.

Community Size DC
Small town 18
Large town 20
Small city 25
Large city 30
Metropolis 35

Rustling Grasp.name: Rustling Grasp（Rustling Grasp）
Rustling Grasp.description:
Once per day as a standard action, you can perform a melee touch attack that rusts iron, as the rusting grasp spell.

  At 11th level, and every four levels thereafter, you can use this ability an additional time per day.

  You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Sabotage (Stare).name: Sabotage (Stare)（Sabotage (Stare)）
Sabotage (Stare).description: The hypnotic stare penalty also applies to Diplomacy and Intimidate checks.

Sacred Sneak Attack.name: Sacred Sneak Attack（Sacred Sneak Attack）
Sacred Sneak Attack.description: When making a sneak attack against an undead creature or evil outsider, the rogue閳ユ獨 sneak attack damage is considered good-aligned for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. Normal weapon damage is unaffected for this attack. A rogue must have a good alignment to select this rogue talent.

Sacred Threshold.name: Sacred Threshold（Sacred Threshold）
Sacred Threshold.description:
As a standard action, you can bless a door, a window, or another portal with a touch. For 1 minute, you can increase or decrease the DC of any check to unlock or force open the portal by an amount equal to half your cleric level. In addition, your first ally to pass through the portal during this time gains an amount of temporary hit points equal to 1d4 + 1 for every 2 cleric levels you have. These temporary hit points last for 1 minute. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Agile Feet power of the Travel Domain.

Sacrifice (3 pts).name: Sacrifice (3 pts)（Sacrifice (3 pts)）
Sacrifice (3 pts).description: An eidolon can sacrifice its own hit points to heal another creature. As a standard action, the eidolon can sacrifice up to 2 hit points per Hit Die and then touch the target creature, thereby healing the creature for half the amount sacrificed.

Sacrifice Self.name: Sacrifice Self（Sacrifice Self）
Sacrifice Self.description: A rogue who makes a successful Reflex save against an area effect can ignore the benefits of her evasion ability to shield an adjacent ally against the effect, essentially halving the damage that ally would normally take. A rogue with improved evasion can attempt a secondary save against her ally閳ユ獨 damage. If the save is successful, neither she nor her ally takes any damage. A rogue must have evasion in order to select this talent, and she must have improved evasion to benefit from the secondary effect.

Safe Casting.name: Safe Casting（Safe Casting）
Safe Casting.description: Whenever you cast a spell that cures the target of hit point damage, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity for spellcasting.

Safe House.name: Safe House（Safe House）
Safe House.description:
The vigilante can establish a safe house in his area of renown, and he can change it every time he changes his area of renown. If he doesn閳ユ獩 have the renown talent, he can still select this talent and place the safe house in a single location to which he has access, but he can never move the safe house from its initial location until he gains the renown talent. This safe house must be an area no larger in volume than a cube that is a number of feet per side equal to 10 feet per vigilante level. The safe house can be arranged any way he likes and it can be part of a larger building, like a secret room or an underground cave. Objects within this safe house can閳ユ獩 be located by any effect that is less powerful than a discern location spell.

  At 7th level, this protection from being located also applies to creatures in the safe house.

  At 13th level, the entire area is protected from scrying effects (though not mundane snooping) like a mage閳ユ獨 private sanctum.

Safekeeping.name: Safekeeping（Safekeeping）
Safekeeping.description: At 1st level, you can touch a creature as a standard action, granting it a +2 insight bonus to AC for 1 round. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Sahkil Subdomain.name: Sahkil Subdomain（Sahkil Subdomain）
Sahkil Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2nd閳?@Compendium[pf1.spells.y71mqkh49c6lfgec]{Haunting Mists}

Salamander Bloodline.name: Salamander Bloodline（Salamander Bloodline）
Salamander Bloodline.description:
You are descended from the elemental outsiders known as salamanders. You wield flame as a weapon and a tool, and your smithing skills are unrivaled.

  本職技能: Acrobatics.

  獎勵法術:

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.cvv6oimqks9n62vy]{魔化武器} (3rd),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.6h3p3zr2hbrjea8k]{Molten Orb} (5th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.73han2zqxg59u18g]{魔化防具} (7th),

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.hfca2lb4tlmrzoxm]{火焰紋章} (15th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.h17ad4lpmphnospf]{熔岩牆} (17th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.xhzme0v6tjq95fg6]{流星爆} (19th).

  獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Zeq6RWYv5otvg8q7]{順勢斬},

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.7zJTztNW7hdaqjKc]{技能專攻} (察覺),
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.8snLqsJN4LLL00Nq]{健壯}.

  血統奧秘: The DCs of your sorcerer spells increase by 2 against creatures that are suffering ongoing fire damage.

Salamander Bloodrager Bloodline.name: Salamander Bloodrager Bloodline（Salamander Bloodrager Bloodline）
Salamander Bloodrager Bloodline.description:
Salamanders are fierce warriors and master smiths, and you wield their might and mastery of metal by birthright.

獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Zeq6RWYv5otvg8q7]{順勢斬}

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.cKxfEL5XOWuzLhfO]{精通鋼鐵意志}

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.FUW5mIXHNBBIQ1Sq]{猛力攻擊}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.7zJTztNW7hdaqjKc]{技能專攻} (Perception),
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.8snLqsJN4LLL00Nq]{健壯}

  獎勵法術:

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.d0rd4z2kcln69xif]{重壓之刃} (7th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.x23pz2agjub1eh89]{完全修復術} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.vjnynvz1omleni8a]{武器幻化} (13th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.nfm6i9z9r3n2fku7]{火焰護盾} (warm only) (16th).

Salamander's Scales.name: Salamander's Scales（Salamander's Scales）
Salamander's Scales.description:
At 4th level, you gain fire resistance 5 and a +1 natural armor bonus to AC.

  At 8th level, your fire resistance increases to 10 and your natural armor bonus increases to +2.

  At 16th level, your fire resistance increases to 20 and your natural armor bonus increases to +3.

Sand Bomb.name: Sand Bomb（Sand Bomb）
Sand Bomb.description: When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can pack the casing full of sand that explodes in an abrasive cloud on impact. A creature that takes a direct hit from a sand bomb is blinded for 1 round, as are any creatures in the splash radius that fail a Reflex save (DC = 10 + half the alchemist閳ユ獨 level + his Intelligence modifier).

Sandstone Solution.name: Sandstone Solution（Sandstone Solution）
Sandstone Solution.description: As a full-round action, the alchemist can convert any potion or extract into a solution that, when thrown or applied, solidifies sand or dirt to the hardness of stone for 1 hour, affecting an area with a radius of 10 feet 鑴?the level of the potion or extract. If this solution is thrown at or applied to stone, it instead causes a 5-foot cube of stone to become crumbly and soft for 1 minute, reducing its hardness by double the level of the potion or extract.

Sandwalker.name: Sandwalker（Sandwalker）
Sandwalker.description: At 15th level, you gain you gain a burrow speed of 30 feet and tremorsense with a range of 60 feet.

Sapped Magic (Stare).name: 魔力衰減（Sapped Magic (Stare)）
Sapped Magic (Stare).description: 催眠注視的減值還能應用至目標所使用的法術和類法術能力（spell-like abilities）的DC上，此外還可以對目標的法術抗力（spell resistance）生效（若有的話）。

Saurian Subdomain.name: Saurian Subdomain（Saurian Subdomain）
Saurian Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.choriern682hgptb]{召喚自然盟友 IV} (deinonychus or pteranodon only),
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.w88ddxpu89qcr5c0]{野獸形態III}
  • 7環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.jjmoi5qbwkbguzbn]{召喚自然盟友 VII} (brachiosaurus or tyrannosaurus only).

Savage Dirty Trick.name: Savage Dirty Trick（Savage Dirty Trick）
Savage Dirty Trick.description:
Once per round while raging, the barbarian can attempt a dirty trick combat maneuver in place of a melee attack. This attempt does not provoke attacks of opportunity. If successful, the target takes an amount of damage equal to the barbarian閳ユ獨 Strength modifier and must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 the barbarian閳ユ獨 level + the barbarian閳ユ獨 Strength modifier) or take an additional penalty from the dirty trick based on the type of dirty trick performed and the following table.

Initial Penalty Additional Penalty
Blinded Staggered
Dazzled Dazed
Deafened Staggered
Entangled Anchored in place and unable to move from that square
Sickened Nauseated

  
On a failed Fortitude save, the opponent takes this additional penalty on top of the dirty trick閳ユ獨 original effect. The additional penalty lasts for 1 round (though the initial penalty lasts as long as normal), and can be removed with a move action. The initial effect cannot be removed via mundane means until the additional penalty is removed (though magical effects like remove blindness/deafness work). Removing the initial effect also removes the additional penalty. If the target is immune to the initial penalty, then it is unaffected by the additional penalty.

For example, a barbarian using this rage power attempts a dirty trick combat maneuver against her opponent to blind him. She succeeds and her opponent fails his Fortitude save, so he becomes staggered as well as blinded. Regardless of whether he had succeeded at his saving throw, the opponent still takes an amount of damage from the barbarian閳ユ獨 combat maneuver equal to the barbarian閳ユ獨 Strength modifier (unless he has damage reduction or would otherwise be able to prevent this damage). Likewise, if her opponent were immune to blinding effects, he would not suffer from the blindness or the staggering effect, regardless of his saving throw.

This power can only be used once per opponent per rage. A barbarian must be at least 6th level to select this rage power.

Savage Intuition.name: Savage Intuition（Savage Intuition）
Savage Intuition.description: Your bestial senses allow you to sense danger and become enraged before you even have time to consciously react to danger. When combat begins, if you have rounds of rage remaining, you may automatically enter a rage without using an action at the start of the first round of combat (or at the start of the surprise round, if there is one), even if you are not otherwise aware that combat has begun.

Savage Jaw.name: Savage Jaw（Savage Jaw）
Savage Jaw.description:
While raging, the barbarian can open her jaw wide and latch her teeth firmly onto her opponent. While using the animal fury power, the barbarian can activate this power as a free action and gain the grab ability with her bite attack until the start of her next turn. This power can be used only once per rage.

  A barbarian must have the animal fury rage power to select this rage power.

Scaled Toughness.name: Scaled Toughness（Scaled Toughness）
Scaled Toughness.description:
You can manifest the scaly toughness of dragonkind. Once per day as a swift action, you can harden your skin, giving it a scaly appearance and granting you DR 10/magic. During this time, you are also immune to paralysis and sleep effects. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to your oracle level.

  At 13th level, you can use this ability twice per day.

  You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Scalykind Blessing: Scaly Touch.name: Scalykind Blessing: Scaly Touch（Scalykind Blessing: Scaly Touch）
Scalykind Blessing: Scaly Touch.description:
At 1st level, you can touch an ally as a standard action to grant it reptilian scales. For 1 minute, the ally gains a +1 enhancement bonus to its natural armor.

  At 5th level and every 5 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by 1 (to a maximum of +5 at 20th level).

Scalykind Blessing; Serpent Fang.name: Scalykind Blessing; Serpent Fang（Scalykind Blessing; Serpent Fang）
Scalykind Blessing; Serpent Fang.description:
At 10th level, as a standard action you can manifest venomous fangs for 1 minute. These fangs grant a bite attack that deals 1d4 points of damage (for a Medium warpriest, 1d3 if Small). A successful bite also afflicts the opponent with a debilitating venom. The poison閳ユ獨 save DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 your warpriest level + your Constitution modifier.

Serpent Venom (Ex): Bite閳ユ攰njury; save Fort negates; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d2 Con; cure 1 save.

Scalykind Domain.name: Scalykind Domain（Scalykind Domain）
Scalykind Domain.description:
神授力量: 你是爬蟲類的真神，只憑一撇便可令弱小的生物昏厥。

  領域法術:

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.cfzk3vkv1c7ncaug]{魔牙術}
  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.05m8kfc2u9cg528g]{迷惑動物}
  • 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.bgtmki0xl4xl4y91]{Magic Fang, Greater}
  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.vdh0yuzpjwhky6kr]{毒擊術}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.29cfi65seiajh5qv]{動物異變}
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.z8xnkfpufuqapseq]{攝心目光}
  • 7環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.f828mjoo5afszqnk]{漫天蟲蝕} (takes the form of Diminutive-sized reptiles),
  • 8環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.3ah9mmg0odateh8l]{動物形態}
  • 9環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.n3lp01euzcdmtbw5]{形體變化}*Only reptiles.

Scar Hex.name: Scar Hex（Scar Hex）
Scar Hex.description:
This hex curses a single target touched with horrible scars of the witch's choosing, whether something as simple as a single letter on the target's forehead or blotchy, burnlike scars on his body. The target may make a Will save to resist this hex. These scars do not interfere with the target's senses or prevent it from using abilities, but may affect social interactions. They persist through disguises and shapechanging.

  The witch can user her hexes on the scarred target at a range of up to 1 mile, and she is considered to have a body part from the target for the purpose of scrying and similar divination spells. The witch can withdraw this hex from a target as a move action at any range.

  The number of supernatural scars the witch can maintain at once is equal to her Intelligence bonus; once she reaches this limit, she must remove the scar from a current victim in order to mark another. Effects that remove curses can remove the scar.

Scavenger.name: Scavenger（Scavenger）
Scavenger.description: A rogue with this talent can pick up and stow an object as a swift action instead of two separate move actions. She gains a +2 bonus on Sleight of Hand checks to pick the pockets of creatures that are stunned or disabled.

Scent (1 pt).name: Scent (1 pt)（Scent (1 pt)）
Scent (1 pt).description: An eidolon's sense of smell becomes quite acute. The eidolon gains the scent special quality, allowing it to detect opponents within 30 feet by sense of smell. If the opponent is upwind, the range increases to 60 feet; if downwind, it drops to 15 feet. Strong scents can be detected at twice the normal range. Scent does not allow the eidolon to precisely locate the creature, only to detect its presence. It can detect the direction with a move action. The eidolon can pinpoint the creature's location if it is within 5 feet. The eidolon can use scent to track creatures.

Scent (UC) (1 pt).name: Scent (UC) (1 pt)（Scent (UC) (1 pt)）
Scent (UC) (1 pt).description: The eidolon閳ユ獨 sense of smell becomes quite acute. The eidolon gains the scent special quality, allowing it to detect opponents within 30 feet by sense of smell. If the opponent is upwind, the range increases to 60 feet; if the opponent is downwind, the range drops to 15 feet. Strong scents can be detected at twice the normal range. Scent does not allow the eidolon to precisely locate the creature, only to detect its presence. It can detect the direction as a move action. The eidolon can pinpoint the creature閳ユ獨 location if it is within 5 feet. The eidolon can use scent to track creatures.

Scorching Heat.name: Scorching Heat（Scorching Heat）
Scorching Heat.description: At 12th level, your weapons conduct heat. You deal 1d6 additional points of fire damage with natural weapons and melee attacks made with metal weapons. You also deal 2d6 points of fire damage per round to any creature you grapple. This does not damage your equipment.

Scorpion Aspect.name: Scorpion Aspect（Scorpion Aspect）
Scorpion Aspect.description:
The aspect of the scorpion invokes a hidden menace with a poisonous sting.

Minor Form: You gain a +2 competence bonus on Stealth checks and grapple combat maneuver checks.

  This bonus increases to +4 at 8th level and +6 at 15th level.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a giant scorpion. While in this form, you gain darkvision with a range of 60 feet, tremorsense with a range of 10 feet, two primary claw attacks (1d6) with the grab ability, and a secondary sting attack (1d6).

  At 8th level, the range of your tremorsense increases to 20 feet, and you gain a +4 racial bonus on Climb and Perception checks.

  At 15th level, when you make an attack of opportunity with your sting attack or maintain a grapple and deal damage with your sting attack, that attack also applies the following poison.

Poison (Ex): Sting閳ユ攰njury; save Fort DC = 10 + half your shifter level + your Constitution modifier; frequency 1/ round for 6 rounds; effect 1d3 Strength damage; cure 2 consecutive saves.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Pincers (B), sting (P)

Scorpion Bloodline.name: Scorpion Bloodline（Scorpion Bloodline）
Scorpion Bloodline.description:
Whether your ancestors served a scorpion goddess or simply worked closely with more mundane members of the species, the venom from these arachnids has seeped down through generations into your blood.

  本職技能: Climb.

  獎勵法術:

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.6vx3lvbhp6h220wq]{Thorn Javelin} (3rd),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.3mfmhx8avu7h3iom]{蛛行術} (5th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.vdh0yuzpjwhky6kr]{毒擊術} (7th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.pa6mgkl4caihdrhm]{巨蟲術} (scorpions only) (9th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.j8fufy7sr3bty5du]{Vermin Shape II} (11th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.nk37t5em8q4v1djs]{燃燒之風} (13th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.f828mjoo5afszqnk]{漫天蟲蝕} (15th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.e8zen5nzixnt7bde]{凋死術} (17th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jg2n48yy9pk9mpdr]{Transmute Blood To Acid} (19th).

  獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.QvlxYVVsBDlykPKe]{奧術打擊},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.pmAO1Sni8xx71pLF]{盲斗},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.h9nHYLxXvIXBTmup]{戰斗反射},
  •  Disruptive Spell,
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{精通先攻},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.VMVAqGze4cs3naya]{靈狐步},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.7zJTztNW7hdaqjKc]{技能專攻} (Climb),
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.f5FPqAYWlKj3zCIY]{隱秘}.

  血統奧秘: You are trained in the use of poison and cannot accidentally poison yourself when applying poison to a weapon.

Scourge Curse.name: Scourge Curse（Scourge Curse）
Scourge Curse.description:
You are a blight on the natural world. Bizarre natural hazards develop within a 300-ft radius around you whenever you linger in a natural area for more than 10 minutes, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.ug4qh4cuh5f9ralf]{Curse Terrain, Lesser}. You cannot choose the hazards or their locations. However, your movement is unimpeded by undergrowth, as a druid閳ユ獨 woodland stride ability, as plants wither away in your footsteps.

  At 5th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.23pgt0f34obki95q]{Feast Of Ashes} to your list of 2nd-level oracle spells known.

  At 10th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.1msv71n204g06fbe]{Explosion Of Rot} to your list of 4th-level oracle spells known.

  At 15th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.25iy235izs71qlns]{血肉蟲群} to your list of 6th-level oracle spells known.

Scrap Bomb.name: Scrap Bomb（Scrap Bomb）
Scrap Bomb.description: When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it explode into shards of shrapnel that deal piercing damage. A creature that takes a direct hit from a scrap bomb takes 1 point of bleed damage per die of bomb damage unless it succeeds at a Reflex save.

Scribe Scroll.name: Scribe Scroll（Scribe Scroll）
Scribe Scroll.description: At 1st level, a wizard gains @Compendium[pf1.feats.tlRu8SYjzA7WCHN7]{抄寫卷軸} as a bonus feat.

Scry Slip.name: Scry Slip（Scry Slip）
Scry Slip.description: Whenever a rogue with this talent is targeted by a scrying effect that allows a Will save, the caster of the divination must succeed at a caster level check (DC = 15 + the rogue閳ユ獨 class level). This talent wards the rogue and any objects she is holding or carrying. An investigator can select this talent in place of an investigator talent.

Scrying Familiarity.name: Scrying Familiarity（Scrying Familiarity）
Scrying Familiarity.description: You are well acquainted with scrying sensors. You can roll twice and take the better result on saving throws against divination (scrying) spells and effects, on Perception checks to notice scrying sensors, and on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance when you use a scrying spell or effect. If you notice a magical sensor, you can attempt a Stealth check opposed by the caster閳ユ獨 caster level check to avoid being detected by the sensor.

Sczarni Smuggler.name: Sczarni Smuggler（Sczarni Smuggler）
Sczarni Smuggler.description: The rogue has picked up Sczarni tricks for making masterful forgeries and using bribery to evade trade rules. The rogue needs to learn only the approximate appearance of a document that doesn閳ユ獩 require a particular person閳ユ獨 signature to accurately forge the document with Linguistics (gaining a +8 bonus on the check to create the forgery, as if she had seen a similar document before). The rogue needs only a small sample of a person閳ユ獨 handwriting to make a convincing forgery of great length in that person閳ユ獨 handwriting. The rogue can always take 10 on Diplomacy checks to offer bribes. In addition, the rogue automatically gains an extra advantage at the start of a pursuit (Ultimate Intrigue 142) in an urban environment.

Seamless Guise.name: 無痕偽裝（Seamless Guise）
Seamless Guise.description: 俠客學習過如何讓自己完全融入目前他所扮演的這個角色，而避免他人發現自己維持著其他身份的方法。任何懷疑俠客還擁有他目前處於的社交/俠客身份以外身份的人在嘗試看破他的身份時，俠客可以進行一次易容技能檢定以說服懷疑者他一定是認錯人了，並在這次檢定上擁有+20的環境加值。

Searing Flame.name: 枯萎之炎（Searing Flame）
Searing Flame.description:
元素：火；類別：通用（Su）；等級：2；超載：－

  前置：灼燒注能（Burning Infusion）

  隨著時間的經過，你的灼燒注能能夠將敵人的火焰抗力（fire resistance）燒燬。當你投擲來自灼燒注能的點燃傷害（burn damage）對抗敵人時，敵人的火焰抗力也會隨之減少，減少量等同於未受調整的點燃傷害；在判斷火焰抗力的減少量時，不能將火焰抗力應用至該檢定上。火焰抗力的減少所持續的輪數等同於你的操念使等級的一半。這些減少量會疊加，最低降低至0點。

Searing Flesh.name: 炎之血肉（Searing Flesh）
Searing Flesh.description:
元素：火；類別：護身原力（Su）；等級：－；超載：0

  你的身體散發出讓人疼痛的高溫。每當有生物用一個天生攻擊（natural attack）或一個徒手打擊（unarmed strike）命中你時，該生物會承受火焰傷害，具體數值為你每具有4個操念使等級1點（最低1點火焰傷害）。和你擒抱在一起的生物（A creature in a grapple with you）會在它的回合結束時承受雙倍於上述數量的傷害。擊中你的武器也會承受這個傷害，不過這點傷害一般無法克服武器的硬度。通過承受1點超載，你能夠將此傷害增加，增加量為你每具有4個操念使等級1點，直至你所承受的超載得以移除為止。你能夠以此方式增加傷害的次數最高為7次。

  每當你使用火原力（fire wild talent）並承受超載時，體內奔騰的烈焰會讓炎之血肉造成的傷害數量變為目前的兩倍，持續1輪（與你擒抱在一起的生物受到的總傷害為正常數值的四倍）。你能夠以直覺動作解消或恢復該效果。

Searing Heat.name: Searing Heat（Searing Heat）
Searing Heat.description: At 15th level, your body becomes as hot as a salamander閳ユ獨. You deal 1d6 additional points of fire damage with natural weapons and melee attacks made with metal weapons. In addition, you deal 2d6 points of fire damage per round to any creature you grapple. This heat does not damage your equipment. You can activate or deactivate this effect as a free action.

Sedition Inquisition.name: Sedition Inquisition（Sedition Inquisition）
Sedition Inquisition.description: 神授力量: Your deity calls you to cast down a hostile government. Stealth is a class skill for you.

Seduction Inquisition.name: Seduction Inquisition（Seduction Inquisition）
Seduction Inquisition.description: 神授力量: Your deity blesses your attempts to use sex and love for a higher purpose.

Seduction.name: Seduction（Seduction）
Seduction.description:
The witch uses enthralling movements to fascinate a single creature within 60 feet that can see the witch. A Will save negates this effect. If the target is (or could be) sexually attracted to the witch, the save DC is increased by 2. The effect lasts for 1 round, but the witch can extend this effect for 1 additional round (up to a total number of rounds equal to her class level) by taking a standard action to continue her enthralling movements. Whether or not the target succeeds at its save, it cannot be the target of this ability again for 1 day.

  At 8th level, the fascination effect lasts for 2 additional rounds after the witch ceases taking a standard action to maintain it. This is a mind-affecting charm effect.

See Invisibility.name: 識破隱形（See Invisibility）
See Invisibility.description: 在9級時，喚魂師可以看見許多普通人所看不到的事物，她回答每天一次以類法術能力的形式使用法術識破隱形的能力，這個效果持續10分鐘。

See It Coming.name: See It Coming（See It Coming）
See It Coming.description: At 3rd level, you gain a +1 luck bonus on the saving throw type of your choice (Fortitude, Reflex, or Will). As a full-round action, you can change which saving throw your luck bonus applies to. At 7th level and every 4 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +5 at 19th level.

See in Darkness (3 pts).name: See in Darkness (3 pts)（See in Darkness (3 pts)）
See in Darkness (3 pts).description:
An eidolon can see perfectly in darkness of any kind, including that created by deeper darkness.

  The summoner must be at least 9th level before selecting this evolution.

See in Darkness (ROG).name: See in Darkness (ROG)（See in Darkness (ROG)）
See in Darkness (ROG).description: The rogue gains the see in darkness ability (Pathfinder RPG Bestiary 2 301). A rogue must have darkvision before choosing this talent.

See in Darkness (SAM).name: See in Darkness (SAM)（See in Darkness (SAM)）
See in Darkness (SAM).description: At 15th level the samurai can see perfectly in darkness, even magical darkness, as the universal monster ability of the same name.

Seek Retribution.name: Seek Retribution（Seek Retribution）
Seek Retribution.description: At 8th level, once per day after receiving a request for aid from a legal authority or an aggrieved party regarding the breaking of an oath, whenever the cavalier encounters the oath-breaking creature, he can choose to vehemently exact retribution. As a swift action, the cavalier can grant himself a competence bonus equal to his Charisma modifier on all attack rolls, weapon damage rolls, and opposed checks against the oathbreaking creature. These bonuses last for 1 round per level.

Seemless Shapechanger.name: Seemless Shapechanger（Seemless Shapechanger）
Seemless Shapechanger.description:
The vigilante seamlessly adopts any persona he assumes with magic. The vigilante adds his seamless guise bonus to the bonus on Disguise checks that he gains to assume the shape of another creature with a polymorph spell or effect.

  A vigilante must have the shapechanger subtype to select this talent.

Seismic Master.name: 震顫之主（Seismic Master）
Seismic Master.description:
元素：土；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：9；超載：0

  你能夠將精神集中於自身和大地的聯繫，創造出地區性的震顫，就如同法術地震術（Earthquake）一般。

Self Telekinesis, Greater.name: Self Telekinesis, Greater（Self Telekinesis, Greater）
Self Telekinesis, Greater.description:
Element aether; Type utility (Sp); Level 5; Burn 0
Prerequisite self telekinesis

  You have greater control over your self telekinesis. Otherwise, this wild talent functions like greater flame jet.

Self Telekinesis.name: 念力御身（Self Telekinesis）
Self Telekinesis.description:
元素：以太；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：3；超載：0

  你可以使用念動能力搬運自己。這項原力在其他方面的功能就如同火焰噴進（flame jet）一般。

Self-Assurance.name: Self-Assurance（Self-Assurance）
Self-Assurance.description:
Overwhelming confidence in your success brings you closer to your goals, and you know that your superiority has destined you for greatness. As an immediate action, you can gain a morale bonus equal to half your psychic level (minimum 1) on a single ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check. You must declare that you are using this ability before attempting the roll in question. If you succeed at the check, you regain 1 point in your phrenic pool.

  You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

Self-Perfection Discipline.name: 自我完善境界（Self-Perfection Discipline）
Self-Perfection Discipline.description:
你對精神力量有一種全面的認識，相信必須讓精神和肉體都得到鍛鍊才能維持平衡。你發覺修行、斷食和其他磨練身體的訓練能夠拓寬你的精神力量。

精神力池屬性 感知

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.pysrx5kxfjvsjjsi]{腳底抹油} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.usdv1eqvibmxun6x]{熊之堅韌} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.s9amdo5398alb5p0]{加速術} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lvzq2mwkqmozolpl]{行動自如} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wuispaydz8jvw3io]{Echolocation} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.9pbl3ktd5oqejl19]{轉變術} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.btccs4sjo2nog1a0]{幻化靈體} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.mkrjbrp57yfdqrx0]{鋼筋鐵骨} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.au6p72aztjhtokwr]{Akashic Form} (18th).

Self-Realization Subdomain.name: Self-Realization Subdomain（Self-Realization Subdomain）
Self-Realization Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.5v3j49r4mdq9rbx6]{Paragon Surge} (Pathfinder RPG Advanced Race Guide 48; always matches your actual race)
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.dckgxyd6ariois1s]{Primal Scream}
  • 7環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.9pbl3ktd5oqejl19]{轉變術}

Self-Resurrection.name: Self-Resurrection（Self-Resurrection）
Self-Resurrection.description:
From the ashes of your body springs forth new life. At 16th level, once per day when you are reduced below 0 hit points while you are bloodraging, you can call upon the power in your blood to pull yourself back from death. This functions as a @Compendium[pf1.spells.qiiis9ekgy3syu7j]{生命之息} spell cast upon yourself.

  At 20th level, this instead functions as a @Compendium[pf1.spells.4re1j2w8wkvsvnsi]{醫療術} spell, except that the healing can return you to life as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.qiiis9ekgy3syu7j]{生命之息}, using your bloodrager level as your caster level. Using this ability does not take an action. This ability does not function if your body is completely destroyed by an effect such as @Compendium[pf1.spells.sxyiwj0z95piv96i]{解離術}.

Sensed (Stare).name: Sensed (Stare)（Sensed (Stare)）
Sensed (Stare).description: The hypnotic stare penalty also applies to Stealth checks.

Serpent Fangs.name: Serpent Fangs（Serpent Fangs）
Serpent Fangs.description:
At 1st level, you grow serpentine fangs. These fangs are treated as a natural weapon, granting you a bite attack as a primary natural weapon. This attack deals damage equal to 1d8 (1d6 if you are Small) + your Strength modifier.

  At 4th level, your fangs are considered magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

  At 8th level, the damage increases to 1d10 (1d8 if you are Small) + your Strength modifier.

Serpent in the Sun.name: Serpent in the Sun（Serpent in the Sun）
Serpent in the Sun.description:
So long as you are exposed to at least 4 hours of sunlight per day, you no longer need to eat to survive and you gain +2 bonus on saves against diseases.

  At 5th level, you become immune to nonmagical diseases and no longer need to drink water to survive.

  At 10th level, you become immune to magical diseases, gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against poisons, and only need to sleep half as long to rest or recover from fatigue or exhaustion.

  At 15th level, you become immune to poison and fatigue. You lose these benefits if you fail to spend at least 4 hours in sunlight in a 24-hour period.

Serpent's Tail.name: Serpent's Tail（Serpent's Tail）
Serpent's Tail.description: At 9th level, you can transform your legs into a slithering serpentine tail as a free action. Your speed is reduced by 10 feet (to a minimum of 5 feet), and you can閳ユ獩 be tripped. Your footwear melds into your body and is nonfunctional unless it provides a constant bonus and does not need to be activated. You also gain a tail slap natural attack that deals 1d8 points of damage (1d6 if you are Small) + your Strength modifier. At 15th level, your reach with your tail slap increases by 5 feet. These effects last a number of minutes per day equal to your sorcerer level; the duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be used in 1-minute increments.

Serpentine Swim.name: Serpentine Swim（Serpentine Swim）
Serpentine Swim.description: At 4th level, you can swim sinuously, like a snake. You gain a swim speed equal to your base speed.

Servant of Winter.name: Servant of Winter（Servant of Winter）
Servant of Winter.description:
As a full-round action, you can summon a single ice elemental (Pathfinder RPG Bestiary 2 114) to serve you.

  At 7th level, you can summon a Medium ice elemental, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.aqri3zf6mzgd4di6]{召喚怪物 IV}.

  At 11th level, you can summon a Huge ice elemental, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.mf6k8tg8xu0wedoz]{召喚怪物 VI}.

  At 15th level, you can summon an elder ice elemental, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.j91n23p4tfjixp3s]{召喚怪物 VIII}.

  You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day at 15th level.

  You must be at least 7th level before selecting this revelation.

Servitor.name: 僕從（Servitor）
Servitor.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點召喚一個僕從。該能力如同一級怪物召喚術，但你只能召喚1個生物，且只持續1分鐘。4級及之後每3級時，怪物召喚術的等級都增加1，最高在19級時達到七級怪物召喚術。同一時間你只能有一隻僕從。任何時候，你都可消耗1點心智點增加目前僕從的持續時間1分鐘。

Set-Up.name: Set-Up（Set-Up）
Set-Up.description: When you successfully hit a target with a sneak attack in melee, you can choose to forgo your additional sneak attack damage to make the target more vulnerable to one of your allies adjacent to it. The first melee attack that ally makes against the target before the beginning of your next turn treats the target as flanked, even if your ally is not flanking the target. This has no effect on creatures you could not flank with that ally, even if the ally was properly positioned.

Sever Alignment.name: Sever Alignment（Sever Alignment）
Sever Alignment.description: When making a sneak attack against an opponent with an alignment subtype, a rogue with this talent can forgo her sneak attack damage to scramble the creature閳ユ獨 metaphysical nature. If the attack succeeds, the rogue deals weapon damage as normal, and the target must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + half the rogue閳ユ獨 level + the rogue閳ユ獨 Intelligence modifier) or lose all damage reduction overcome by aligned weapons (such as DR 10/good), lose all regeneration overcome by aligned sources (such as regeneration 10 [good]), and lose the ability to cast spells and use spell-like abilities with alignment descriptors for 1 round for every 2d6 points of sneak attack damage the rogue would have dealt (minimum 1 round). The rogue must have the aligned sneak attack talent to select this talent.

Shackle Smash.name: Shackle Smash（Shackle Smash）
Shackle Smash.description: Perhaps trained to remove or destroy restraints from slaves and prisoners by the Twilight Talons or Bellflower Network, a vigilante with this talent can choose to make no more noise than people talking when he attempts a sunder combat maneuver check or attempts a Strength check to break an object. He ignores half an object閳ユ獨 hardness when attempting sunder combat maneuver checks and when attacking nonmagical objects.

Shades of Gray.name: Shades of Gray（Shades of Gray）
Shades of Gray.description: A rogue with this talent uses mental and emotional tricks to protect herself from attempts to discern her alignment. This offers her the benefits of @Compendium[pf1.spells.vsr1e8ib0hfhbnxb]{隱匿陣營} whenever she chooses, though she must be conscious to maintain the effect.

Shades of Rage.name: Shades of Rage（Shades of Rage）
Shades of Rage.description: At 4th level, whenever you enter a bloodrage, the light level within 30 feet of you decreases by one step. Natural light is always affected, but magical illumination dispels this ability if the caster of the light effect succeeds at a caster level check against a DC equal to 10 + your class level.

Shadow Beast.name: 暗影猛獸（Shadow Beast）
Shadow Beast.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點呼喚出一隻或更多暗影構成的猛獸。該能力如同幽影咒法術一般，但它只能用來複製怪物召喚術的效果。用此法召喚的生物對不相信的生物只造成50%的傷害，而且非傷害性效果只有50%機率影響不相信的生物。最高可用該能力複製出五級怪物召喚術來。9級後你每有2秘學士等級，最高可複製的怪物召喚術等級加1（最高17級時複製九級怪物召喚術）。無論法術複製什麼，此法召喚的生物持續每秘學士等級1輪。你必須至少9級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Shadow Blend (2 pts).name: Shadow Blend (2 pts)（Shadow Blend (2 pts)）
Shadow Blend (2 pts).description:
In any condition of illumination other than bright light, the eidolon disappears into the shadows, giving it concealment (20% miss chance). If it has the shadow form evolution, it instead gains total concealment (50% miss chance).

  The eidolon can suspend or resume this ability as a free action.

Shadow Blend.name: Shadow Blend（Shadow Blend）
Shadow Blend.description:
The mesmerist can trigger this trick whenever the subject attempts a Stealth check while in an area of dim or darker light. The subject gains total concealment from all enemies (50% miss chance) as long as it remains within areas of dim or darker light. Against creatures with darkvision, the subject gains concealment (20% miss chance) rather than total concealment.

  Once triggered, this effect lasts for 1 round per mesmerist level or until the subject enters an area of normal or brighter light.

Shadow Blessing: Flicker of Shadows.name: Shadow Blessing: Flicker of Shadows（Shadow Blessing: Flicker of Shadows）
Shadow Blessing: Flicker of Shadows.description:
At 1st level, you can cause a weapon you touch to warp and become insubstantial for a split second before an attack. The first attack made with this weapon each round ignores any shield bonus to Armor Class, as well as bonuses from cover. Total cover still provides a creature its full benefit.

  This effect lasts for 1 minute.

Shadow Blessing: Swift as Shadow.name: Shadow Blessing: Swift as Shadow（Shadow Blessing: Swift as Shadow）
Shadow Blessing: Swift as Shadow.description: At 10th level, you can spend a swift action to empower yourself or an ally within 30 feet to move over the ground as easily as its shadow. The subject閳ユ獨 land speed increases by 10 feet and it takes no movement penalties for darkness, difficult terrain, or slickness. The creature can safely move over areas of ice and even those affected by a grease spell. When a creature affected by this ability hits with a charge attack, that attack deals an amount of additional cold damage equal to your level.

Shadow Bloodrager Bloodline.name: Shadow Bloodrager Bloodline（Shadow Bloodrager Bloodline）
Shadow Bloodrager Bloodline.description:
Because of your heritage, you can move and see through shadows as if you are part of them. Your fury absorbs light, warmth, and strength.

獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.pmAO1Sni8xx71pLF]{盲斗}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.h9nHYLxXvIXBTmup]{戰斗反射}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{精通先攻}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.0bZf3SDkvVOe2ujH]{閃電反射}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.WKIVfdosc5SqYzmP]{即時備戰}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Mz8ZG6nqW3NKFZhK]{快步跟進}

  獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.mczdgwo3xl8c6e26]{衰弱射線} (7th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.mz9yr5yhr0f3oqtp]{黑暗視覺} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jdsvncnna6oy189a]{深幽黑暗術} (13th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ed7fvzc2p4m6n7a2]{幽影咒法術} (16th)

Shadow Discipline.name: Shadow Discipline（Shadow Discipline）
Shadow Discipline.description:
You perceive the space between light and darkness, and draw power from it. Shadows conceal and protect you, while revealing the locations of those who dare to hide within them. Over time, you develop the ability to deny the warmth of light or life to your enemies.

精神力池屬性 感知

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.h4hrop7rq2c9phyi]{Blurred Movement} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.advqdmonj6ro62u7]{Fear The Sun} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jdsvncnna6oy189a]{深幽黑暗術} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.cmwcavfyc1vbehy8]{Shadow Step} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.2q48ogrz3840xwi7]{幽影塑能術} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.btoow6tyv39443gh]{行影術} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.8rf2ucrtzmxooyw6]{Lunar Veil} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.h9dzj2fr5lksdjcp]{Umbral Strike} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.0mt9mso6wdhfafpo]{Polar Midnight} (18th).

Shadow Door.name: Shadow Door（Shadow Door）
Shadow Door.description: At 16th level, you can take any part of your movement through shadows, teleporting to another location within 60 feet. This ability functions as @Compendium[pf1.spells.ojwg1ki98tq8xyh9]{次元門}, except you can閳ユ獩 use shadow door in brightly lit areas. You can teleport in this manner a total of 10 feet per class level each day.

Shadow Duplicate.name: Shadow Duplicate（Shadow Duplicate）
Shadow Duplicate.description: Once per day as an immediate action when the rogue is hit, the rogue can create a single shadow duplicate of herself, as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.4jsss37x0pplib8f]{鏡影術}. The GM randomly determines whether the attack hit the rogue or the shadow duplicate. The shadow duplicate lasts for a number of rounds equal to the rogue閳ユ獨 level, or until the shadow duplicate is dispelled or destroyed. This ability does not stack with the mirror image spell. The caster level for this ability is equal to the rogue閳ユ獨 level. A rogue can use this ability one additional time per day for every 5 rogue levels she has.

Shadow Form (2 pts).name: Shadow Form (2 pts)（Shadow Form (2 pts)）
Shadow Form (2 pts).description: The eidolon's body becomes shadowy and more indistinct. This shadow form grants the eidolon constant concealment (20% miss chance), and its melee attacks affect incorporeal creatures as if it had the ghost touch weapon property. The eidolon's melee attacks deal only half damage to corporeal creatures.

Shadow Splinter.name: 嫁禍之影（Shadow Splinter）
Shadow Splinter.description: 催眠師能夠保護受術者對抗一次攻擊，並將傷害轉嫁至他人。當受術者由一次攻擊而受到傷害時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。受術者承受的傷害會被降低，降低的量為3 + 催眠師的魅力調整值（最高為攻擊造成的總傷害量）。在原始攻擊的攻擊範圍之內，且不是攻擊者的一個其他生物會受到幽影幻象的攻擊，這看起來就好像是攻擊者在攻擊該生物一般。該生物所承受的傷害數值相當於先前所減少的數額。幽影幻象並不需要投擲攻擊檢定便能命中，而且它也能忽視掩蔽（cover）和隱蔽（concealment），不過幽影的目標能夠嘗試一次意志豁免，成功則不相信該效果。若豁免成功，該生物就不會受到傷害，而且也不會相信是攻擊者對它發動了攻擊。如果攻擊範圍內沒有合適的第二個生物成為被轉嫁的傷害的目標，那麼該項詭計就無法被觸發。這是一個幻術系（illusion）幽影幻覺（shadow）效果。

Shadow Subdomain.name: Shadow Subdomain（Shadow Subdomain）
Shadow Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.mczdgwo3xl8c6e26]{衰弱射線}
  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.6efjgs1qvmj6yxqv]{魅影殺手}
  • 8環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.003tu19dpyoaj0se]{Orb Of The Void}

Shadow Vision.name: Shadow Vision（Shadow Vision）
Shadow Vision.description:
While bloodraging, you gain low-light vision if you don閳ユ獩 already have it. If you already have low-light vision, you gain darkvision to a distance of 30 feet.

  At 10th level, you gain darkvision with a range of 30 feet, or add 30 feet to the range of your darkvision if you already have it.

Shadow Warrior.name: Shadow Warrior（Shadow Warrior）
Shadow Warrior.description: At 20th level, you become shadow and fury personified. You see perfectly in natural and magical darkness. Whenever you deal hit point damage with a spell or attack, you also deal 2 points of Strength damage to each creature that took damage.

Shadow's Chill.name: Shadow's Chill（Shadow's Chill）
Shadow's Chill.description: When a rogue with this talent hits a creature with a melee weapon that deals sneak attack damage, a number of points of the damage dealt equal to the number of sneak attack dice rolled is cold damage. The remainder of the sneak attack damage and the normal weapon damage are unaffected. The rogue must have cold resistance from a racial trait before selecting this talent.

Shadow's Sight.name: Shadow's Sight（Shadow's Sight）
Shadow's Sight.description: The vigilante gains low-light vision and darkvision 60 feet. If he already had darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet.

Shadow's Speed.name: Shadow's Speed（Shadow's Speed）
Shadow's Speed.description:
The vigilante閳ユ獨 base speed increases by 10 feet.

  At 10th level, it increases by an additional 10 feet.

Shadowbound Curse.name: Shadowbound Curse（Shadowbound Curse）
Shadowbound Curse.description:
Your pigmentation is oddly colorless, and your eyes are highly sensitive to light. You are blinded for 1 round when exposed to normal or bright light and dazzled while in such a lit area. You gain darkvision to a range of 30 feet.

  At 5th level, the range of your darkvision increases by 30 feet.

  At 10th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.ed7fvzc2p4m6n7a2]{幽影咒法術} to your list of 4th-level oracle spells known and @Compendium[pf1.spells.2q48ogrz3840xwi7]{幽影塑能術} to your list of 5th-level oracle spells known.

  At 15th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.btoow6tyv39443gh]{行影術} to your list of 6th-level oracle spells known.

Shape Mastery.name: 塑形大師（Shape Mastery）
Shape Mastery.description: 作為你施放一個區域性質的塑能法術的一部分，你可以消耗一定量的心智點（最高達到你的智力調整值），使該法術排除同等量的格子區域。

Shape Wood.name: Shape Wood（Shape Wood）
Shape Wood.description:
Element wood; Type utility (Sp); Level 4; Burn 0

  You reshape wood to suit your purposes, as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.10e3iwsr5jkq4q73]{塑木術}.

Shapechanger Bloodline.name: Shapechanger Bloodline（Shapechanger Bloodline）
Shapechanger Bloodline.description:
Channeling the power of your shapeshifting ancestors that you carry in your blood, you gain powers that allow you to change your shape and alter your appearance and physical abilities.

  本職技能:易容.

  獎勵法術:

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.oj36nfak6jc2s5ky]{易容術} (3rd),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.kouqz0pm1xl8xilm]{變身術} (5th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.7d6sv5ecvi7kho3m]{飛行術} (7th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.774kmgcb7ygviht0]{野獸形態II} (9th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.d40ia71c2eljm91k]{變形術} (11th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.9pbl3ktd5oqejl19]{轉變術} (13th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.t44p3oeq43jwcgwg]{高等變形術} (15th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ukacuu0cvdjkqxwu]{Frightful Aspect} (17th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.n3lp01euzcdmtbw5]{形體變化} (19th).

  獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.u7rGDZUL296QIuA0]{戰斗施法},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.JreaiTHdyWFNj3Tb]{閃避},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.btXWioB3SKJv8YEG]{法術延時},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.fVRnBIHR4Jq6btvm]{強韌加強},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{精通先攻},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.0bZf3SDkvVOe2ujH]{閃電反射},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.7zJTztNW7hdaqjKc]{技能專攻} (Disguise),
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.8snLqsJN4LLL00Nq]{健壯}.

  血統奧秘: You are very skilled with magic that transforms you. Transmutation spells you cast only on yourself affect you as though your caster level were 1 higher.

Shapechanger Bloodrager Bloodline.name: Shapechanger Bloodrager Bloodline（Shapechanger Bloodrager Bloodline）
Shapechanger Bloodrager Bloodline.description:
The blood of doppelgangers, faceless stalkers, lycanthropes, or other shapechangers courses through your veins.

獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.JreaiTHdyWFNj3Tb]{閃避}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.BkKYCzEGNTzZRiTz]{快速移動}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{精通先攻}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.2aTFNMs3pW6nUBlr]{精通徒手打擊}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.0bZf3SDkvVOe2ujH]{閃電反射}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.FUW5mIXHNBBIQ1Sq]{猛力攻擊}
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.n250dFlbykAIAg5Z]{武器專攻}

  獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jnlr9cuepka1l26e]{變巨術} (7th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.kouqz0pm1xl8xilm]{變身術} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.7d6sv5ecvi7kho3m]{飛行術} (13th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.knyako6zopc1chrv]{石膚術} (16th)

Share Memory.name: 共享記憶（Share Memory）
Share Memory.description: 5級起，你能夠隨意使用共享記憶UM（Share Memory），但是僅限於自願的目標。

Share Spells (SU).name: 法術共享（Share Spells (Su)）
Share Spells (SU).description: 喚魂師可以將目標為自身的法術施展在魅影身上（如同接觸法術）而不是自己身上。即使某些法術通常不會影響魅影的生物類型（異界生物），喚魂師依舊可以對其施展。用這種方法施展的法術必須來自喚魂師的法術列表。這項能力不允許喚魂師分享法術以外的能力，即使它們的作用如同法術。

Shared Consciousness.name: 共享意識（Shared Consciousness）
Shared Consciousness.description: 在1級時，如果魅影停留在喚魂師的意念空間中（即沒有完全顯形或被放逐回靈界的狀態），它可以為喚魂師在兩項技能上提供專長技能專攻的好處，這兩個技能由魅影的情感羈絆（Emotional Focus）所決定，除非喚魂師已經擁有了相應的技能專攻專長。共享意識同樣為喚魂師在對抗影響心靈的效果時在豁免檢定上提供+4加值；在12級時，這個加值增加到+8.最後，每天一次，每當喚魂師在對抗一個影響心靈的效果但豁免檢定失敗時，她可以選擇改由自己魅影的意識負擔這個效果的影響而非她自己的。如果她這麼做的話，喚魂師自身將不會受到這個效果的影響，但同時，在該效果的持續時間內，她失去魅影提供的兩個技能專攻和對抗影響心靈效果時的豁免加值，並且無法要求魅影以任何方式顯形，或是讓魅影承受另一個影響心靈的效果。在此期間，施放到喚魂師身上的法術解除魔法和破除附魔仍然可以有效的解除由喚魂師（魅影）承受的影響心靈的效果，如同它處於喚魂師本身一樣。

Shared Evolution (1 pt).name: Shared Evolution (1 pt)（Shared Evolution (1 pt)）
Shared Evolution (1 pt).description:
Select a 1-point or 2-point evolution the eidolon has. As a standard action, the eidolon can touch the summoner and transfer the selected evolution to him. This functions as the summoner閳ユ獨 aspect ability, and the same limitations apply. The summoner can touch the eidolon as a standard action to return the evolution. The evolution returns to the eidolon automatically if the eidolon is dismissed by the summoner or sent back to its home plane.

  This evolution can only be taken by Summoners with the Twinned Summoner archetype.

Shared Evolution (UC) (1 pt).name: Shared Evolution (UC) (1 pt)（Shared Evolution (UC) (1 pt)）
Shared Evolution (UC) (1 pt).description:
Requirements: Twinned eidolon.

  Select a 1-point or 2-point evolution the eidolon has. As a standard action, the eidolon can touch the summoner and transfer the selected evolution to him. This functions as the summoner閳ユ獨 aspect ability, and the same limitations apply. The summoner can touch the eidolon as a standard action to return the evolution. The evolution returns to the eidolon automatically if the eidolon is dismissed by the summoner or sent back to its home plane.

Shared Seance.name: 降靈會（Shared Seance）
Shared Seance.description: 在2級時，通靈者可以在呼喚英靈時請求他們幫助與自己一起進行降靈的盟友。所有參加降靈會的盟友都可以在24小時內獲得該英靈的降靈獎勵的好處。

Shared Skill.name: 共享技能（Shared Skill）
Shared Skill.description: 13級起，每當你設定情感紐帶時，你能夠選擇一個基於智力或者基於魅力的技能，該技能要來自異能者的本職技能列表。任何情感紐帶的受術者在嘗試該技能時，只要情感紐帶仍然存續著，就能夠使用你的加值來替代他自己的加值。

Shared Slot (2 pts).name: Shared Slot (2 pts)（Shared Slot (2 pts)）
Shared Slot (2 pts).description:
Select a magic item slot. A magic item worn by the eidolon in that slot remains active even if the summoner is also wearing a magic item in that slot.

  This evolution can be selected more than once. Each time an eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a new slot. 

  This evolution can only be taken by Summoners with the Twinned Summoner archetype.

Shared Slot (UC) (2 pts).name: Shared Slot (UC) (2 pts)（Shared Slot (UC) (2 pts)）
Shared Slot (UC) (2 pts).description:
Requirements: Twinned eidolon.

  Select a magic item slot. A magic item worn by the eidolon in that slot remains active even if the summoner is also wearing a magic item in that slot.

  This evolution can be selected more than once. Each time an eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a new slot.

Shattered Psyche Curse.name: Shattered Psyche Curse（Shattered Psyche Curse）
Shattered Psyche Curse.description:
Your mind is crowded with dozens of voices, fragmented snippets of your past lives. You take a 閳? penalty on all Intelligence-based skill checks, Wisdom-based skill checks, and concentration checks. You gain a +4 competence bonus on saving throws made against mind-affecting effects.

  At 5th level, you閳ユ獧e immune to charm effects.

  At 10th level, you閳ユ獧e immune to compulsion effects.

  At 15th level, you閳ユ獧e immune to all mind-affecting effects.

Shed Skin.name: Shed Skin（Shed Skin）
Shed Skin.description: At 16th level, when your bloodrage ends, you can choose one spell or spell-like ability affecting you and attempt to shake it off as an immediate action. Attempt a dispel check (1d20 + your bloodrager level) as if you were casting @Compendium[pf1.spells.gmgwyjfpeuuc4t4o]{解除魔法}. If you succeed, the effect is dispelled.

Shell of Succor.name: Shell of Succor（Shell of Succor）
Shell of Succor.description:
You can surround an ally with bolstering energies that supplement its health and grant it extra vigor. With a touch from you (a standard action), one creature gains a ward of restorative energy, granting it a number of temporary hit points equal to your Charisma bonus + 1d6 per 2 oracle levels you have (maximum 10d6). These temporary hit points last 1 minute per oracle level you have.

  The target always loses these temporary hit points first, even before other temporary hit points (including those from, for example, the purify body spell on page 9 or a kineticist閳ユ獨 force ward defense wild talent). If an attack deals fewer points of damage than the target has as temporary hit points from shell of succor, it still reduces those temporary hit points but otherwise counts as a miss for the purpose of abilities that trigger on a hit or a miss.

  You can use this revelation once per day, plus one additional time at 11th and 19th levels.

  You must be at least 3rd level before selecting this revelation.

Sheltering Walls.name: Sheltering Walls（Sheltering Walls）
Sheltering Walls.description:
As a standard action, you can touch an ally to summon a floating blockade of stone, granting the ally the benefits of partial cover for 1 round plus 1 round for every 6 cleric levels you possess. This ability does not grant the ally enough cover to attempt a Stealth check or avoid provoking attacks of opportunity. If the ally benefits from any other form of cover against an attack, the bonuses to AC and on Reflex saving throws increase by 1. You can use this power a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This pwoer replaces the Resistant Touch power of the Protection Domain.

Shepherd of Souls Infusion.name: Shepherd of Souls Infusion（Shepherd of Souls Infusion）
Shepherd of Souls Infusion.description:
Element universal; Type substance infusion; Level 7; Burn 4
Associated Blasts any simple
Saving Throw Will negates

  When your blast kills a living creature, it helps shepherd the creature閳ユ獨 soul to the Boneyard, warding against effects of spells that would attempt to restore the creature to life.

  Spellcasters attempting to bring the creature back from the dead using raise dead or similar magic must succeed at a caster level check (DC = 11 + your kineticist level) or the spell fails and the material component is wasted.

Shield of Fury.name: 暴風盾（Shield of Fury）
Shield of Fury.description: 俠客獲得精通盾擊作為獎勵專長。如果他已經擁有了精通盾擊專長，那麼俠客可以轉而獲得一個他在獲得精通盾擊的那個等級上滿足先決條件的任意專長。除此之外，如果俠客達到至少6級，那麼他還會在至少有使用一面盾牌作為武器的時候視為擁有雙武器格鬥專長的好處，此天賦可以讓俠客選擇需要雙武器攻擊專長作為前置的專長而無視雙武器攻擊專長或敏捷需求的前置，但所有的這些好處都只在他有持有一面盾牌作為他的武器時才會生效（除非他自己再選擇雙武器格鬥專長，這樣他可以無視本限制）。幹你的P子有種你直接寫Fury`s SHIELD啊

Shift Earth, Greater.name: Shift Earth, Greater（Shift Earth, Greater）
Shift Earth, Greater.description:
Element earth; Type utility (Sp); Level 7; Burn 0
Prerequisite kinetic cover, shift earth

  You can move greater quantities of earth, as the spell @Compendium[pf1.spells.ukuyfbufbglbzfco]{地動術}.

Shift Earth.name: 地動（Shift Earth）
Shift Earth.description:
元素：土；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：4；超載：0

  前置：念力掩體（kinetic cover）

  豁免：見後文；法術抗力：否

  以標準動作，你能夠推拉30尺內一塊5立方尺的土或者未經加工的石頭，讓它向著任意方向移動5尺。你能夠創造出升高的平臺（raised platforms）、在懸崖上設定階梯、挖洞或者其他有用的地貌。該能力無法使泥土漂浮在空中，不過當你身處具有大量泥土的地方時，可以抬起立方體並創造出矮柱子。若你移動的泥土在生物的腳下，那麼它可以嘗試一次DC20的反射豁免來跳向別處，並以此來避免隨著土地一同移動。

Shift Focus.name: 心智轉移（Shift Focus）
Shift Focus.description: 4級起，秘學士可以將一件靈器裡的心智點轉移到另一件靈器中，不過會產生一點損耗。心智轉移首先先從某靈器內減去一定數值的心智點，然後將該數值-1的心智點填充進另一件靈器中；此舉需要1分鐘安靜的凝視和撫摸兩件靈器。秘學士只能將靈器內的心智點轉移進其他靈器中，而無法將共用心智點填充進靈器內。與一般的心智點消耗不同的是，這種轉移會讓心智點減少的靈器所提供的共鳴之力減弱，但不會讓填充進心智點的靈器提供的共鳴之力增強。

Shifter Aspect.name: 變形者擬態（Shifter aspect）
Shifter Aspect.description:
1級起，變形者獲得她的第一種擬態——一種與她的肉體和靈魂產生超自然調諧的動物。她每日可以進入她的擬態的次級形態（見P 28擬態）的分鐘數等於“3+變形者等級”，這些時間不需要連續，但是必須以1分鐘為使用單位。變形者可以在她的回合以迅捷動作進入次級形態，而終止這個效果是一個只能在她回合內作出的自由動作。在變形者達到9級獲得〖奇美拉擬態〗職業能力之前，她一次只能展現一種次級形態。進入新的擬態（或多個擬態，如使用〖奇美拉擬態〗或〖高等奇美拉擬態〗）將會終止目前已展現的全部次級形態。變形者擬態的次級形態不是變形效果（polymorph effects），變形者受變形效果影響期間不會失去次級形態帶來的好處。

  隨著變形者等級提升，她獲得更多的擬態；變形者在5級獲得她的第二種擬態，10級時獲得第三種擬態，15級時獲得第四種擬態。擬態的詳述內容在本書28頁的相關章節。

Shifter Claws.name: 變形者利爪（Shifter Claws）
Shifter Claws.description:
以一個迅捷動作，處於天生形態（natural form）的變形者可以任意生長出她的利爪作為武器使用（原文沒說爪子收回去的內容）。變形者依靠自身的天賦才能以及對自然的感悟推動了這種神奇的轉變。每隻手的爪抓攻擊都是主要天生武器，造成1d4（小體型1d3）點穿刺和揮砍傷害。如果她用一隻利爪發動攻擊的同時另一隻手持握（hold）武器，則此爪抓視為次要天生武器攻擊。

  隨著變形者等級的提升，她的利爪也成長的更為強大。

  3級起，她的爪抓忽略DR/寒鐵、DR/魔法和DR/銀。

  7級起，她的爪抓傷害提升至1d6（小體型1d4）。

  11級起，她的爪抓傷害提升至1d8（小體型1d6）。

  13級起，她的爪抓傷害提升至1d10（小體型1d8）。

  17級起，傷害不再提升，但是重擊倍率提升為X3。

  最後，19級時，爪抓忽略DR/精金和DR/-。

  當變形者使用自然變身展現出她的擬態中的專攻形態時，她的天生武器也會獲得變形者利爪能力賦予的相同好處〔譯註：推測此處指的是忽略DR和重擊倍率提升的能力〕。如果她從自然變身形態獲得了爪抓攻擊，她可以在她的變形者利爪的基本傷害或者自然變身形態的爪抓傷害，兩者取其高。若她的自然變身形態沒有爪抓攻擊，則她可以選擇至多兩個傷害低於變形者利爪傷害的天生武器，使之造成與變形者利爪相同的傷害作為替代。

Shifter's Fury.name: Shifter's Fury（Shifter's Fury）
Shifter's Fury.description: At level 6, a shifter gains the ability to make several ferocious attacks with the same natural weapon. Instead of attacking with all her natural weapons, the shifter can choose a single natural weapon and make a full attack with that natural weapon, gaining a second iterative attack at a 閳? as if it was a manufactured weapon. When she does so, all her other natural attacks count as secondary attacks and don閳ユ獩 benefit from shifter閳ユ獨 claws. At 11th level, she gains a third iterative attack at a 閳?0 and at 16th level, she gains a fourth iterative attack at 閳?5.

Shifting Aspect.name: Shifting Aspect（Shifting Aspect）
