Shifting Aspect.description: At 1st level, you gain the benefit of the Aspect of the Beast feat while bloodraging. As part of the action to enter a bloodrage, you can choose any one of the four manifestations to affect you for the duration of your bloodrage.

Shimmering Mirage.name: 微光幻影（Shimmering Mirage）
Shimmering Mirage.description:
元素：水；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：5；超載：1

  前置：水之護罩（shroud of water）

  你的護罩能夠偏折光線，形成閃亮的幻影。當你啟動的水之護罩後，對你進行的攻擊會由於隱蔽（concealment）而承受20%的失手率，直至你所承受的超載得以移除為止。

Shove Aside.name: Shove Aside（Shove Aside）
Shove Aside.description: When you and an adjacent ally are both in the area of an attack that requires a saving throw, you can take a 閳? penalty on your saving throw to grant your ally a +4 bonus on his saving throw. You lose the evasion ability against this attack. If you have improved evasion, it is reduced to evasion for this attack instead. A rogue must have evasion to select this rogue talent.

Shrinewalk.name: Shrinewalk（Shrinewalk）
Shrinewalk.description: Council agents can walk the mystic paths between Westcrown閳ユ獨 shrines. A rogue with shrinewalk can create her own shrine simply by designating an area in any urban region by placing a unique marking or rune on a wall or the ground. This marking is not magical, and if it is defaced or erased, it can no longer be used by the rogue (the marking can be hidden from view without removing its usability, including painting over the marking in question). Once placed, the rogue can use word of recall once per day to return to the shrine. A rogue can maintain one shrine at a time; if a new marking is created in a new location, the previous shrine becomes inactive.

Shroud of Retribution.name: Shroud of Retribution（Shroud of Retribution）
Shroud of Retribution.description:
As an immediate action, you can summon a shroud of spirits that reflects your attackers閳?damage back onto them. Any creature that strikes you deals normal damage to you, but at the same time the attacker takes 1d8 points of force damage + 1 point per 2 caster levels you possess (maximum +10). This effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

  You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day at 11th level and every 4 levels thereafter.

  You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Shroud of Water.name: 水之護罩（Shroud of Water）
Shroud of Water.description:
元素：水；類別：護身原力（Su）；等級：－；超載：0

  你讓一層由水、冰或者兩者混合構成的護罩包裹著身體，來保護你免受傷害。這層護罩可以像護甲一般覆蓋在你的身體上，也可以如同盾牌一樣環繞在你身邊抵擋攻擊。你的AC會獲得+4護甲加值或者+2盾牌加值，而且你可以用標準動作切換加值的類型。2級起你每具有4個操念使等級，這個加值便會增加1點。通過承受1點超載，你能夠讓上述加值增加1點，直至你所承受的超載得以移除為止。你可以以此方式多次增加加值，但是增加量無法高於起始數值的50%。當你將護罩切換為盾牌時，超出上述限制的加值無法生效，但是如果你將護罩切換回護甲，這些加值仍然保留。每當你使用水原力（water wild talent）並承受超載時，圍繞在你身邊的水流會使得你的護罩同時提供護甲加值和盾牌加值，持續1輪。你能夠以直覺動作解消或恢復該效果。

Sickening (2 pts).name: Sickening (2 pts)（Sickening (2 pts)）
Sickening (2 pts).description: The eidolon閳ユ獨 smell or appearance is so offensive it sickens nearby creatures. Any living creature except its summoner that approaches within 20 feet or begins its turn in that area is sickened for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + 1/2 the eidolon閳ユ獨 HD + its Con modifier). Creatures that successfully save cannot be affected by the same eidolon閳ユ獨 sickening effect for 24 hours.

Side Step.name: 隙間行走（Side Step）
Side Step.description: 你消耗1點心智點創造出臨時的隙間來。你可用用來移動的移動動作的一部分來施放該能力。隙間出現在你指定的任意格子，允許你傳送到每秘學士等級10尺範圍內的可見格子中。從隙間中行走需要消耗5尺的行動力，且穿過隙間的移動不會引發藉機攻擊。其他方面該能力如同傳送術般運作。你必須至少7級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Sidestep.name: Sidestep（Sidestep）
Sidestep.description: You can push your way through holes in reality, crossing vast distances in a single stride. At 13th level, you can teleport up to 10 feet per psychic level per day as a move action. This teleportation must be used in 5-foot increments and such movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. You must have line of sight to your destination to use this ability. You can bring other willing creatures with you, but you must expend an equal amount of distance for each creature transported.

Sight Unseen.name: Sight Unseen（Sight Unseen）
Sight Unseen.description: At 3rd level, you gain darkvision with a range of up to 30 feet. If you already have darkvision, its range instead increases by 30 feet. At 9th level, you gain lifesense with a range of 30 feet (lifesense allows you to sense and locate living creatures as if you had the blindsight ability).

Signature Arrows.name: Signature Arrows（Signature Arrows）
Signature Arrows.description:
The vigilante must select one type of bow or crossbow (such as shortbow or heavy crossbow) when he selects this talent. After the first time the vigilante buys a set of 50 pieces of magic ammunition intended for that type of bow or crossbow, he can pay the construction cost instead of the purchase price for additional ammunition with identical magical effects for the same weapon, even if he could not normally craft magic ammunition. This benefit applies only to the first type of magic ammunition that the vigilante buys 50 pieces of for the designated weapon. The vigilante can take this talent more than once; each time he takes it, he can purchase and gain this benefit with either a specific type of magic ammunition for a different type of bow or crossbow or a different type of magic ammunition for the original weapon.

  The vigilante must be at least 14th level to select this talent.

Signature Poison.name: Signature Poison（Signature Poison）
Signature Poison.description: A rogue with this talent chooses one poison (such as bloodroot or oil of taggit) as her signature poison. When she uses the chosen poison, the poison閳ユ獨 saving throw DC increases by +2. A rogue can take this talent multiple times, each time applying it to a new poison.

Signature Weapon.name: 鍾意武器（Signature Weapon）
Signature Weapon.description: 當獲得本天賦時俠客選擇一種武器（比如長劍或手弩），他對此武器獲得武器專攻作為獎勵專長。如果他已經擁有了武器專攻專長，那麼俠客可以轉而獲得一個他在獲得武器專攻的那個等級上滿足先決條件的任意專長。在8級時，俠客對他選擇的武器獲得武器專精作為獎勵專長，他無需滿足任何先決條件即可獲得這些專長。只有選擇復仇騎士之道的俠客才能選擇本天賦。

Silencing Strike (INV).name: Silencing Strike (INV)（Silencing Strike (INV)）
Silencing Strike (INV).description:
When the investigator deals damage with a studied strike, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + 1/2 the investigator閳ユ獨 class level + her Intelligence modifier) or be unable to speak (even for verbal components) for 1d4+1 rounds. A successful save reduces the duration to 1 round. This talent has no effect on creatures immune to critical hits.

  An investigator must be at least 15th level to select this talent.

Silencing Strike.name: Silencing Strike（Silencing Strike）
Silencing Strike.description: Using magic stolen from the Hellknights, Council agents can render foes silent. When a creature is damaged by the rogue閳ユ獨 sneak attack, the rogue magically renders the creature mute for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Will save (DC = 10 + half the rogue閳ユ獨 level + the rogue閳ユ獨 Charisma modifier). Silencing strike can be used a number of times per day equal to half the rogue閳ユ獨 level.

Silent Dispatch.name: 寂靜突擊（Silent Dispatch）
Silent Dispatch.description: 每當俠客對一個或一群未意識到他存在的目標發動伏擊時，俠客都可以再進行一個承受-5減值的潛行技能檢定。將這個檢定的結果作為目標在自己的行動之前可能聽到俠客的襲擊的察覺檢定DC。在俠客發動攻擊後，這個DC再多-5，達到正常的聽到戰鬥發生的察覺檢定的-10DC。其他的敵人仍然可能正常的看到俠客的行動，他們只是比較難因為聽到俠客而警告目標。

Silkstring Strike.name: Silkstring Strike（Silkstring Strike）
Silkstring Strike.description:
The shaman causes ribbons of spider silk to erupt from the ground beneath a single creature. The target must succeed at a Reflex save or be entangled and anchored in place. The foe can escape the silk as a standard action with a successful Escape Artist or Strength check at the same DC, or by dealing an amount of damage to the silk equal to double the shaman閳ユ獨 class level (the silk has hardness 0).

  This hex lasts a number of rounds equal to 3 + the shaman閳ユ獨 Wisdom modifier.

  A creature affected by this hex cannot be affected by it again for 24 hours.

Singularity Infusion.name: Singularity Infusion（Singularity Infusion）
Singularity Infusion.description:
Element void; Type form infusion; Level 4; Burn 3
Associated Blasts gravity, negative, void
Saving Throw Reflex half

  You create a growing singularity. Choose a grid intersection within 30 feet. All creatures and objects in a 5-foot-radius burst centered on the intersection take 1/4 your blast閳ユ獨 normal amount of damage (or half damage for a negative blast).

  On your next turn, the singularity deals damage in a 10-foot-radius burst, and on your turn after that, it deals damage in a 15-foot-radius burst. The DC is Dexterity-based.

Sink.name: Sink（Sink）
Sink.description:
The witch can cause a creature in water to struggle, imposing a 閳? penalty on its Swim checks and reducing its swim speed (if any) by 10 feet for 1 minute unless it succeeds at a Fortitude saving throw; on a successful save, the effect閳ユ獨 duration is reduced to 1 round.

  The duration of this hex can be extended with the cackle hex.

  This hex does not stack with itself.

Site-Bound Curse.name: Site-Bound Curse（Site-Bound Curse）
Site-Bound Curse.description:
You bond with a particular 10-foot square, and must remain within 1,500 feet of that site or immediately become sickened. You must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save each minute you spend outside of the boundary or become nauseated. For every hour spent outside of the boundary, you also take 1d4 points of Constitution damage (no save). When within range of your bonded site, you gain a +1 bonus to your caster level when casting oracle spells.

  At 5th level, the radius increases to 2,250 feet.

  At 10th level, the radius increases to 3,000 feet and the bonus to your caster level when casting oracle spells within the boundary increases by 1.

  At 15th level, you can move up to 1 mile from your bonded site.

Size Alteration.name: 變化體型（Size Alteration）
Size Alteration.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點觸摸一個生物改變他的體型。你可以增大或減小目標體型一階，如同人類變巨術或人類變小術，但不限制目標的生物類型。若目標與你態度為敵對，則使用該能力需要進行近戰接觸攻擊，且目標可以進行強韌豁免以免除該效果。該效果持續每秘學士等級1輪。你不能對已經改變了體型的單位使用該能力。

Skill Familiarity.name: Skill Familiarity（Skill Familiarity）
Skill Familiarity.description:
The vigilante choses four skills when he gains this talent. He can take 10 on checks with his chosen skills even when distracted or threatened. If he takes 10 on checks with these skills while not distracted or threatened, he gains a bonus on the check equal to one-quarter his vigilante level (minimum +2).

  A vigilante must be at least 9th level to select this talent.

Skilled (1 pt).name: Skilled (1 pt)（Skilled (1 pt)）
Skilled (1 pt).description:
An eidolon becomes especially adept at a specific skill, gaining a +8 racial bonus on that skill. This evolution can be selected more than once. Its effects do not stack.

  Each time an eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a different skill.

Skilled (UC) (1 pt).name: Skilled (UC) (1 pt)（Skilled (UC) (1 pt)）
Skilled (UC) (1 pt).description:
The eidolon becomes especially adept at a specific skill, gaining a +8 racial bonus on that skill.

  This evolution can be selected more than once. Its effects do not stack. Each time the eidolon selects this evolution, it applies to a different skill.

Skilled Kineticist, Greater.name: Skilled Kineticist, Greater（Skilled Kineticist, Greater）
Skilled Kineticist, Greater.description:
Element universal; Type utility (Su); Level 2; Burn 閳?br>Prerequisite skilled kineticist

  By delving into study of the Ethereal and Elemental Planes, you are able to use your primary element to assist with your skills in an unusual way. Add Knowledge ：位面 to your list of class skills.

  Choose one of your kineticist class skills that wasn閳ユ獩 granted by your primary element to also receive the bonus from skilled kineticist.

Skilled Kineticist.name: 熟練操念使（Skilled Kineticist）
Skilled Kineticist.description:
元素：通用；類別：通用（Su）；等級：1；超載：－

  對於你的首要元素（primary element）向本職技能列表中新增的技能來說，這些技能檢定均會獲得一個加值，加值的數值等同於你的操念使等級的一半，而且你能夠使用與首要元素相關的知識技能鑑別生物，不過僅限亞種類型和你的首要元素一致的元素（elementals）。

Sky Walk.name: Sky Walk（Sky Walk）
Sky Walk.description:
Element air; Type utility (Su); Level 7; Burn 1
Prerequisite air cushon or air's leap, wings of air

  By accepting 1 point of burn, you can enable your allies to fly, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.7d6sv5ecvi7kho3m]{飛行術}, except the duration of the effect is 10 minutes.

Slam (1 pt).name: Slam (1 pt)（Slam (1 pt)）
Slam (1 pt).description:
An eidolon can deliver a devastating slam attack. This attack is a primary attack. The slam deals 1d8 points of damage (2d6 if Large, 2d8 if Huge). The eidolon must have the limbs (arms) evolution to take this evolution. Alternatively, the eidolon can replace the claws from its base form with this slam attack (this still costs 1 evolution point).

  This evolution can be selected more than once, but the eidolon must possess an equal number of the limbs evolution.

Slam (UC) (1 pt).name: Slam (UC) (1 pt)（Slam (UC) (1 pt)）
Slam (UC) (1 pt).description:
The eidolon can deliver a devastating slam attack. This attack is a primary attack. The slam deals 1d8 points of damage (2d6 if Large, 2d8 if Huge). The eidolon must have the limbs (arms) evolution to take this evolution.

  Alternatively, the eidolon can replace the claws from its base form with this slam attack (this still costs 1 evolution point).

  This evolution can be selected more than once, up to the number of the eidolon閳ユ獨 limbs (arms) evolutions.

Slavery Subdomain.name: Slavery Subdomain（Slavery Subdomain）
Slavery Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.tjog6bufg5b08lvq]{魅惑人類}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.q070n0zoq3zojpas]{支配人類}
  • 8環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.gb7pxobi1za67p7g]{束縛大法}

Sleeper Agent.name: Sleeper Agent（Sleeper Agent）
Sleeper Agent.description:
The alchemist learns how to create a sleeper agent, whom he releases back into its original society none the wiser. The alchemist can create a sleeper agent in a ritual that takes 1 minute; the target must be unconscious for the ritual閳ユ獨 duration. At any time during the next year, as long as he is within 1 mile of the sleeper agent, the alchemist can activate the agent閳ユ獨 programming. When the sleeper agent is activated, treat her as if she were the target of a @Compendium[pf1.spells.q070n0zoq3zojpas]{支配人類} spell with a caster level equal to the alchemist閳ユ獨 level at the time the sleeper agent was created. If the sleeper agent is killed or the dominate person effect閳ユ獨 duration expires, the sleeper agent is permanently released from the alchemist閳ユ獨 control. The alchemist can also release any sleeper agent as a free action. The alchemist can have one active sleeper agent for every 6 alchemist levels he possesses.

  An alchemist must be at least 12th level before selecting this discovery.

Slick Infusion.name: Slick Infusion（Slick Infusion）
Slick Infusion.description:
Element water; Type substance infusion; Level 2; Burn 2
Prerequisite slick
Associated Blasts blizzard, charged water, cold, ice, water
Saving Throw Reflex negates

  Your blast leaves behind slippery water or ice in its area for as long as the blast is in that area and for 1 round thereafter, making the area difficult terrain and increasing the DC of Acrobatics checks attempted in the area by 5. You can use this infusion only if you also use a form infusion that has an area of effect.

Slick.name: 溜滑（Slick）
Slick.description:
元素：水；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：1；超載：0

  豁免：反射，通過則無效；法術抗力：否

  以標準動作，你能夠呼喚滑溜的水或冰，創造出油膩術（Grease）的任意效果，持續1輪。你能夠在你的下個回合開始時承受1點超載，來使得效果持續時間延長至每操念使等級1分鐘。

Slip Bonds.name: Slip Bonds（Slip Bonds）
Slip Bonds.description:
While implanted with this trick, the subject gains a +2 circumstance bonus on Escape Artist checks. If the subject becomes grappled, pinned, shackled, or otherwise personally restrained, the mesmerist can trigger the trick and cause the subject to become incorporeal just long enough to slip her bonds (unless they can otherwise restrain an incorporeal creature). This effect doesn閳ユ獩 last long enough for the subject to move through walls or other barriers.

  If the mesmerist is 12th level, the subject remains incorporeal until the beginning of the mesmerist閳ユ獨 next turn.

Slippery (1 pt).name: Slippery (1 pt)（Slippery (1 pt)）
Slippery (1 pt).description: Due to its slimy hide or a slick exoskeleton, the eidolon is especially slippery. The eidolon gains a +4 bonus to CMD to escape a grapple and on Escape Artist checks.

Sluggishness (Stare).name: 遲鈍（Sluggishness (Stare)）
Sluggishness (Stare).description: 催眠注視的目標所擁有的所有速度都會被減少5尺（最低降至5尺），而且催眠注視的減值還能應用至目標的反射豁免檢定上。

Sluggish.name: Sluggish（Sluggish）
Sluggish.description:
The shaman causes the speed of a creature within 30 feet to be halved. The target can attempt a Fortitude saving throw to negate this effect. The penalty lasts for a number of rounds equal to the shaman閳ユ獨 character level and does not stack with other effects that reduce speed.

  Whether or not the save is successful, the creature can閳ユ獩 be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.

Smoke Storm.name: 煙霧迸發（Smoke Storm）
Smoke Storm.description:
元素：火；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：3；超載：0

  豁免：強韌，通過則無效；見後文；法術抗力：否

  你將120尺範圍內的一處無遮蓋的火源變為嗆人的煙雲，充滿半徑20尺的擴散區域，而且還會如同發煙棒（Smokestick）一般影響視線。在自己的回合開始時處於煙雲內的生物會陷入噁心（sickened），只要沒有離開煙雲該效果便會持續下去，即便離開煙雲，該效果也會持續1d4+1輪（強韌豁免，通過則無效）。

Snake Aspect.name: 蛇擬態（Snake Aspect）
Snake Aspect.description:
蛇是一名鬼祟且致命的敵手，在意料不及時出擊並造成致命的效果，同時又避開對方的趁機回擊。

  次級形態：你進行藉機攻擊的攻擊檢定獲得+2加值，對抗藉機攻擊檢定的AC獲得+2閃避加值。8級時，這個加值提升至+4。15級時，這個加值提升至+6。

  專攻形態：你變身為一隻帝王眼鏡蛇（怪物圖鑑2 pg. 252）。當處於該形態時，你獲得30尺攀爬速度、30尺游泳速度、昏暗視覺、靈敏嗅覺（30尺）、2d6傷害的齧咬攻擊和戰鬥反射專長。如果你已經擁有戰鬥反射專長或者你的敏捷屬性值不足以獲得更多的藉機攻擊次數，則每輪獲得1次額外的藉機攻擊次數。8級時，你的特技和隱匿檢定獲得+4種族加值。15級時，當你用你的齧咬攻擊發動藉機攻擊時，這次攻擊還能附帶以下毒素。

  毒素（Poison）：齧咬—傷口；強韌豁免DC=10+1/2變形者等級+體質調整值；頻率：每輪1次，持續6輪；效果：1d3體質傷害；治癒：連續2次通過檢定。

Snake Infusion.name: 蛇形（Snake Infusion）
Snake Infusion.description:
元素：通用；類別：塑形注能；等級：3；超載：2

  前置：增距（extended range）

  關聯念襲類別：任意

  豁免：無

  你對自己的念襲有著良好的掌控力，這使得你可以調整它的路徑並且避免障礙。你可以為念襲勾繪出任意總長度不超過120尺的路徑，這使你能夠避免掩蔽（cover），甚至是全掩蔽（total cover）。你可以選擇通往自己無法看到的方格的路徑。

Snapping Turtle Aspect.name: Snapping Turtle Aspect（Snapping Turtle Aspect）
Snapping Turtle Aspect.description:
Long-lived and resilient, turtles embody wisdom and endurance in many cultures. Those who take this aspect gain profound insight as well as remarkable resilience. A snapping turtle閳ユ獨 alternate attack is bite (B, P, S).

Minor Form: You gain a +2 enhancement bonus to Wisdom.

  At 8th level, this bonus increases to +4, and at 15th level, it increases to +6.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a Large giant snapping turtle. While in this form, you gain low-light vision, scent (30 feet), a swim speed of 20 feet, and a bite attack (1d8 + 1-1/2 your Strength modifier damage).

  At 8th level, you gain an insight bonus equal to your Wisdom modifier to your CMD against bull rush, drag, overrun, reposition, and trip attempts.

  At 15th level, you gain DR 5/silver.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Bite (B, P, S)

Sneak Training.name: Sneak Training（Sneak Training）
Sneak Training.description: The rogue counts as having the sneak attack class feature of a rogue of her level for the purpose of meeting prestige class requirements, although this talent doesn閳ユ獩 improve the rogue閳ユ獨 existing sneak attack ability or grant her the sneak attack class feature if she doesn閳ユ獩 already have it. This talent is most useful for rogues that lack the sneak attack class feature, such as those with the phantom thief archetype.

Sneaky Maneuver.name: Sneaky Maneuver（Sneaky Maneuver）
Sneaky Maneuver.description: Anytime a rogue with this talent could hit an opponent with a melee sneak attack on her turn, she may take a 閳? penalty on her attack roll and attempt a dirty trick, disarm, steal, sunder, or trip combat maneuver instead of dealing sneak attack damage. If the attack succeeds, the rogue deals weapon damage as normal and then attempts a combat maneuver check as a swift action (the 閳? penalty only applies to the initial attack roll, not the combat maneuver check). This combat maneuver still provokes attacks of opportunity unless the rogue has a feat or ability that allows her to perform it without provoking attacks of opportunity.

Sniper (VIG).name: 狙擊手(俠客)（Sniper (VIG)）
Sniper (VIG).description: 俠客的遠程暗襲攻擊不再受到任何距離限制。只有達到6級且選擇詭秘獵手之道的俠客可以選擇本天賦。

Snow Sight.name: Snow Sight（Snow Sight）
Snow Sight.description:
You can see through falling snow and sleet without taking any penalties on Perception checks as long as there is enough light to allow you to see normally.

  At 11th level, in cold conditions or in icy or snowy terrain, you can learn about your surroundings as if using the @Compendium[pf1.spells.icjrw9y6pa1uatlz]{問道自然} spell.

  You can use the commune with nature ability once per day at 11th level, and twice per day at 15th level.

Social Grace.name: Social Grace（Social Grace）
Social Grace.description:
The vigilante selects any one Intelligence-, Wisdom-, or Charisma-based skill other than Perception or Use Magic Device. Whenever the vigilante is in his social identity, he receives a +4 circumstance bonus on checks with the selected skill.

  At 5th level and every 4 levels thereafter, he can select another skill (with the same restrictions) to gain this bonus.

Social Talent.name: 社交天賦（Social Talent）
Social Talent.description: 在1級以及之後每提升兩個等級時，俠客可以獲得一個社交天賦。除非特別提及，否則俠客的所有社交天賦只能被選擇一次。有一些社交天賦需要俠客在滿足特定的先決條件（比如其他的社交天賦或是達到一定的俠客等級）的情況下才能選擇。社交天賦一旦選取即無法改變。

Soiling Touch.name: Soiling Touch（Soiling Touch）
Soiling Touch.description: At 1st level, you can impose the broken condition upon one Medium or smaller object by making a successful melee touch attack. Magical items or objects carried or worn by a creature are allowed a Fortitude save to resist this effect. Multiple uses of this effect do not stack. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Solar Ascension.name: Solar Ascension（Solar Ascension）
Solar Ascension.description: At 20th level, as a full-round action, you can become an incorporeal being of light for 1 round per sorcerer level. While in this form, you gain the incorporeal subtype and take half the normal damage from corporeal magic attacks (you take no damage from nonmagical weapons and objects). Your spells deal half damage to corporeal creatures, but spells and abilities that do not deal damage function normally. The duration need not be continuous, but it must be used in 1-round increments. While in this form, any creature you move through (as the overrun combat maneuver) takes 2d6 points of fire damage.

Solar Bloodline.name: Solar Bloodline（Solar Bloodline）
Solar Bloodline.description:
Sorcerers who serve in the sun goddess閳ユ獨 court display powers infused with the glory of the sun itself.

  本職技能: 察覺.

  獎勵法術:

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.dnet1tyxbsnwailm]{灼熱光輝} (3rd),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.myeqz367l1vb5fje]{Fury Of The Sun} (5th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.7x2z0i8rcx7s81fk]{晝明術} (7th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.oz41554bzacn8szb]{Shield Of The Dawnflower} (9th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.gmugktarbieojt59]{焰擊術} (11th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.jbqo4o2b2tmdz7wv]{真知術} (13th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.vax8ojz8g3oovwzu]{陽炎射線} (15th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.j2mwv9wfxhqch10g]{陽炎爆} (17th),
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.xuuzj9lr2xbwaim4]{神威如獄} (19th).

  獎勵專長：

  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Q1cY8r0Pvb66pMG0]{警覺},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.u7rGDZUL296QIuA0]{戰斗施法},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.77gXSucrxfrE9yWk]{法術強效},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.Uuiu3p982omhMEPj]{精通先攻},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.0bZf3SDkvVOe2ujH]{閃電反射},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.wFoLrh5FeeqBXsQ8]{法術瞬發},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.V2zY7BltkpSXwejy]{法術專攻},
  • @Compendium[pf1.feats.nWFr8SNcjcMqsXSH]{法術穿透}.

  血統奧秘: Whenever you cast a spell with the fire descriptor, if it deals damage, it deals +1 point of damage per die rolled.

Solar Final Revelation.name: Solar Final Revelation（Solar Final Revelation）
Solar Final Revelation.description: At 20th level, yours becomes a journey without end. You cease aging, no longer suffer age-related penalties to ability scores, and cannot be magically aged. Any spells you cast of the conjuration (teleport) subschool or with the fire or light descriptor are automatically enlarged without affecting their spell level.

Solar Mystery.name: Solar Mystery（Solar Mystery）
Solar Mystery.description:
本職技能: An oracle with this mystery adds Fly, Knowledge (geography), Linguistics, and Survival to her list of class skills.

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.bl71og1gklwncmt7]{妖火} (2nd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lzos34s87qsc620l]{熾焰法球} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.7x2z0i8rcx7s81fk]{晝明術} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ojwg1ki98tq8xyh9]{次元門} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.evoz9r9n186nsjf0]{位面適應}n (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.nk37t5em8q4v1djs]{燃燒之風} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.vax8ojz8g3oovwzu]{陽炎射線} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.j2mwv9wfxhqch10g]{陽炎爆} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lxxliyxfw9uvbxmt]{虹光法球} (18th).

Solar Wind.name: Solar Wind（Solar Wind）
Solar Wind.description:
You can unleash a blast of searing wind at a single target within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack with no range increment. Your solar wind deals 1d6 points of fire damage + 1 for every 2 oracle levels you possess.

  At 7th level, you can also knock an opponent back, treating the blast as a bull rush combat maneuver that uses your caster level + your Charisma modifier in place of your CMB.

  You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Solid Ground.name: Solid Ground（Solid Ground）
Solid Ground.description: The alchemist launches an explosive paste bomb that bonds with any earthen surface. Each application of this paste deals no damage and affects a 5-foot-cube of dirt, loose soil, or stone, transmuting the earth for a number of minutes equal to the alchemist閳ユ獨 level. Creatures cannot use burrow, earthmeld, or similar abilities (such as the meld into stone spell) while the ground remains transmuted in this way.

Solitude Subdomain.name: Solitude Subdomain（Solitude Subdomain）
Solitude Subdomain.description:
Replacement 領域法術:

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ow4t1zox6dtybgji]{沉默術}
  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.viq93vkjaungdbul]{偵測探知}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.82vi1xife3nlu8a0]{海市蜃樓}
  • 9環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ngsn9j87t68uhysj]{Create Demiplane, Greater}

Song-Bound Curse.name: Song-Bound Curse（Song-Bound Curse）
Song-Bound Curse.description:
(Merfolk only) Whenever you speak, you are compelled to sing loudly, and you draw out even short utterances with vocal scales or simple melodies. You cannot speak in less than a loud voice, although you may choose not to speak. You can perform the countersong bardic performance (using Perform [sing] only) for a number of rounds per day equal to your oracle level. If you gain the bardic performance class feature, these rounds are in addition to any other bardic performance rounds you gain, but they can be used only for the countersong bardic performance.

  At 5th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.2p6fzj5t03oivndd]{命令術} and @Compendium[pf1.spells.zqj5qzyl46af27v0]{暗示術} to your list of spells known.

  At 10th level, add 1 to the difficulty class of saving throws against language-dependent spells you cast.

  At 15th level, add @Compendium[pf1.spells.l1zl69j95ad7l9dn]{高等命令術} and @Compendium[pf1.spells.52v3fogun1n9jzum]{群體暗示術} to your list of spells known.

Songbird.name: Songbird（Songbird）
Songbird.description: The vigilante gains the use of @Compendium[pf1.spells.0324zq42g3fu4kko]{動物信使} once per day as a spell-like ability, with a caster level equal to his character level. He also gains Handle Animal as a class skill.

Soothsayer.name: Soothsayer（Soothsayer）
Soothsayer.description:
The witch閳ユ獨 predictions become selffulfilling prophecies. When the witch uses the evil eye hex, fortune hex, misfortune hex, or retribution major hex, she can choose to delay the effect. If she does so, the hex takes effect the next time the target makes a roll that could be affected by the hex (such as an ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check) or is affected by an action that could be modified by the hex (such as being attacked when the hex would affect the target閳ユ獨 AC), whichever comes first (ignoring actions that are not in combat and actions that have no penalty for failure). The duration of the hex begins on the same round as the action that causes it to take effect.

  The hex is wasted if it is not triggered within 24 hours.

Sorrow Discipline.name: Sorrow Discipline（Sorrow Discipline）
Sorrow Discipline.description:
You draw strength from deep feelings of abandonment, loneliness, and sadness, turning these emotions into a powerful weapon or a barrier that protects you.

精神力池屬性 魅力.

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.yk5bgi6j9kbtigof]{聖域術} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ow4t1zox6dtybgji]{沉默術} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.awia42zci8nufpfl]{回避偵測} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.zt7cje76dck9hwp9]{極度絕望} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.dlmeq0hpxfbjtibb]{心靈迷霧} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.z8xnkfpufuqapseq]{攝心目光} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.c3qqu6l3vdcfaoh7]{隔離術} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.hi72gh3dlf7a1qyt]{迷宮術} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.esia6azb5g68tfs7]{禁錮術} (18th).

Soulbound Puppet.name: 魂縛木偶（Soulbound Puppet）
Soulbound Puppet.description: 以一個整輪動作，你消耗1點心智點用一塊骨頭、一個玩偶或一個骷髏頭創造出一個魂縛木偶。若你使用骨頭或骷髏頭，你的力量會讓骨頭重新長出模糊的肉，創造出超小型或小型的木偶，長得會模糊地與骨頭原主人相似。若使用玩偶，玩偶將獲得生命。將它視為魔寵，使用你的秘學士等級作為法師等級來計算力量和能力。通過使用適當生物的骨頭或骷髏頭，或用與適當生物相似的玩偶，你可以選擇任何法師可用的魔寵。你也可以使用類人生物的骨頭、玩偶或骷髏頭，來使得魂縛木偶獲得人造人（人彘）的基本資料，除了飛行速度和毒咬和心靈連結。無論什麼形態，該木偶還是一個構裝體，擁有與你相同的陣營。你同一時間無法擁有多於一個的魂縛木偶。該木偶只能活動每秘學士等級10分鐘的時間。

Soulstrider.name: Soulstrider（Soulstrider）
Soulstrider.description: The arcanist can, as a swift action while he casts a spell that targets one living creature, spend 1 point from his arcane reservoir to infuse his spell with a manifestation of fiendish energy called a 閳ユ笩oulrider.閳?The soulrider attaches to the target of the spell and buries itself in the target閳ユ獨 subconscious mind, persisting there as long as the arcanist maintains at least 1 point in his arcane reservoir, until the arcanist dismisses the soulrider (this requires a standard action), or until the arcanist successfully infects another creature with a soulrider. The target of the spell can resist having the soulrider attach to its soul with a successful Will saving throw (this is in addition to any saving throw the spell itself might or might not allow). If the target resists the spell閳ユ獨 effects with a successful save or other methods (such as via spell resistance or by being immune to that spell閳ユ獨 effects) the soulrider automatically fails to attach to the victim. @Compendium[pf1.spells.uqh87jz757r2cb7r]{偵測魔法} and @Compendium[pf1.spells.tr7m97npkbgm4wp7]{偵測邪惡} can uncover the presence of a soulrider. As long as the soulrider persists, the arcanist can track the targeted creature as if it were under the effect of @Compendium[pf1.spells.4ya1fs9tyvsqnwqx]{關照術}, and the creature takes a 閳? penalty to any saving throw against a mind-affecting effect created by the arcanist. While the soulrider remains bonded to the target, the arcanist can spend 1 point from his arcane reservoir to communicate with the target as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.d0d86z521shpman1]{短訊術}. Soulrider is a mind-affecting effect.

Soverignty Subdomain.name: Soverignty Subdomain（Soverignty Subdomain）
Soverignty Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.h8zit03e88jxrg9t]{嚴加斥責}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.k8va0g2bqb8w31q6]{Castigate, Mass}
  • 9環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.xuuzj9lr2xbwaim4]{神威如獄}

Space Patron.name: Space Patron（Space Patron）
Space Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.97mcivnu2owb8119]{Mirror Strike}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.4gs8xrmzy2bvfkr0]{Twisted Space}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.qmorw7eojkfqr00m]{閃現術}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ojwg1ki98tq8xyh9]{次元門}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.s0uh1psyg0cfd9e6]{Hostile Juxtaposition}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.5w1zrztwbvd6xkgj]{排斥術}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.oh6kkz31ai7eoxhp]{Walk Through Space}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.v39qnirlhgje2c0e]{Bilocation}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.if867t28tu6zxaei]{傳送法陣}

Space-rending Spell.name: 空間撕裂（Space-rending Spell）
Space-rending Spell.description: 異能者能夠使用自身的精神力扭曲空間，在施放聯結法術的同時傳送自己。異能者每從精神力池中花費1點精神力，便能夠將自己傳送10尺的距離，就如同任意門（Dimension Door）一般。以此方式花費的精神力數量最高等同於聯結法術的等級。

Spacious Soul.name: 伽藍之洞（Spacious Soul）
Spacious Soul.description: 在18級時，通靈者的心魂變得空無而遼闊，可以容納其他剛剛離世的盟友的靈魂。如果一個參加了通靈者的本日降靈會的盟友在通靈者擁有對他的效果線並且可以看到他時死亡，通靈者可以以一個即時動作將他的靈魂裝入自己體內。只要他保持容納著一個盟友的靈魂，通靈者就無法使用英靈，英靈之力和靈力奔湧能力。如果一個盟友的靈魂和通靈者共享他的身體，那麼他甚至可以在通靈者的行動輪中決定通靈者的行動。如果通靈者不同意盟友的行動，那麼他必須與盟友進行一個魅力對抗檢定來決定下一個小時他們中由誰獲得對身體的控制權，接下來的每輪中均由勝利者決定行動。盟友的靈魂保有他所有死亡時尚未使用的法術和每日能力使用次數（如氣池，靈感，派頭，勇毅，引導能量，等等）但他無法恢復任何已經使用掉的能力次數和能量點數。當盟友的靈魂控制通靈師行動時，他可以使用自己原本的基礎攻擊加值，施法者等級和職業能力（比如武器擅長），但必須使用通靈者的體能屬性。如果該盟友之後被複活，這個能力的效果立刻結束，否則它們將永遠共享通靈者的身體。即使自己的盟友不願意，通靈者也可以以一個標準動作結束共享身體，但是他必須成功通過一個DC=（10+盟友HD的一半+盟友的魅力調整值）的意志檢定，如果失敗，接下來的24小時內盟友的靈魂會控制他的軀體。

Spark Malfeasance.name: Spark Malfeasance（Spark Malfeasance）
Spark Malfeasance.description:
At 8th level, you can awaken the sinful desires of a target within 30 feet with a ranged touch attack. The target suffers extreme guilt and is sickened for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your cleric level. To end the effect earlier, the target can willingly commit an evil act (if it is of good alignment) or attempt a Will save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier) at the beginning of its turn each round. Creatures that succeed at their saving throws are immune to this ability for 24 hours. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and an additional time per day for every 4 levels beyond 8th.

  This power replaces the Scythe of Evil power of the Evil Domain.

Spark of Innovation.name: Spark of Innovation（Spark of Innovation）
Spark of Innovation.description:
Element earth; Type utility (Sp); Level 5; Burn 0
Prerequisite metal blast

  You shape metal into a clockwork creature, as spark of life except you summon a clockwork earth elemental. The elemental閳ユ獨 type is changed to construct (clockwork) and it gains construct traits and clockwork traits instead of elemental traits. The creature loses any spell-like abilities or supernatural abilities it normally has. If you have the greater elemental whispers utility wild talent, you can take a clockwork familiar as an improved familiar with that ability instead of an earth elemental.

Spark of Life.name: 生命閃爍（Spark of Life）
Spark of Life.description:
元素：通用；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：5；超載：0

  你把虛假的生命力量注入元素物質，這會形成一箇中型元素（Medium elemental），就如同使用召喚怪物 IV（Summon Monster IV）召喚的一般，元素的類型要從你所具有的元素中選擇，該效果的施法者等級等同於你的操念使等級，不過這個元素會獲得無心智（mindless）特性。每當輪到你的回合時，你必須使用移動動作指引元素，否則它便會坍塌成原本的元素構成物質。通過承受1點超載，你能夠將少部分自身的意志注入到元素中，移除它的無心智特性，並且讓它能夠存在每操念使等級1輪，在此期間你也不需要你執行進一步的動作維持它。12級起，你能夠形成一個大型元素（Large elemental），就如同使用了召喚怪物 V（Summon Monster V）一般；14級起，你能夠選擇形成超大型元素（Huge elemental），就如同使用了召喚怪物 VI（Summon Monster VI）一般；16級起，你能夠選擇形成一個菁英元素（greater elemental），就如同使用了召喚怪物 VII（Summon Monster VII）一般；在18級，你能夠選擇形成一個元素長老（elder elemental），就如同使用了召喚怪物 VIII（Summon Monster VIII）一般。

Spatial Switch.name: 空間換位（Spatial Switch）
Spatial Switch.description: 催眠師能夠讓自己和一名盟友交換身體所在的位置。當一個敵人移動至與受術者或催眠師相鄰的位置、或者攻擊受術者或者催眠師之時，如果受術者與催眠師之間相互的距離在100尺之內的話，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。受術者與催眠師會交換位置。如果觸發該項詭計的是一次攻擊，那麼換位會在進行檢定判斷攻擊是否命中之前作出。催眠師不能為自己植入該項詭計。這是一個咒法系（conjuration）傳送（teleportation）效果。

Speak with Animals (SHA).name: 動物交談(薩滿)（Speak with Animals (SHA)）
Speak with Animals (SHA).description: 選擇一個具體的動物種類（鷹、狐狸、狗等等）。薩滿能夠與該種動物交談，如同法術動物交談效果。每3個薩滿等級可以額外選擇1種動物進行交談（3級2種，6級3種，最高18級7種）。

Speak with Dead.name: Speak with Dead（Speak with Dead）
Speak with Dead.description:
At 8th level, as a standard action, you can ask one question of a dead creature as if using @Compendium[pf1.spells.byn5q46du0ck592a]{死者交談}. The dead creature you are questioning does not gain a Will saving throw if your alignments are different. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to your cleric level.

  This power replaces the Ward Against Death power of the Repose Domain.

Spectral Smoke.name: 鬼魅煙雲（Spectral Smoke）
Spectral Smoke.description: 一片煙雲突然籠罩在受術者的身邊妨礙他人攻擊。當受術者成為了一個攻擊或者需要攻擊檢定的法術的目標時，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。煙雲會出現在受術者所佔據的方格，並延伸出半徑10尺的範圍圍繞著她。這些煙雲的持續時間為每催眠師等級1輪。煙雲的作用就如同雲霧術（Fog Cloud）一般，不過這是一個幻術系（illusion）虛假幻覺（figment）效果，因此不會被風吹散，而且可以在水下使用。與煙雲產生互動的生物能夠嘗試一次豁免檢定來不相信該效果。催眠師每有5個施法者等級，煙雲的半徑便能夠增加5尺，至多為20級時的30尺。

Spectral Spells.name: Spectral Spells（Spectral Spells）
Spectral Spells.description:
You gain Ectoplasmic Spell as a bonus feat. In addition, once per day, you can cast a spell with the Ectoplasmic Spell metamagic feat as a standard action that does not increase the level of the spell.

  You can use this ability one additional time per day at 7th level and every 4 levels thereafter.

Spell Anticipation.name: 先製法術（Spell Anticipation）
Spell Anticipation.description: 催眠師能夠選取一個法術來回擊敵方施法者。當催眠師植入該項詭計時，他必須將一個已知法術與詭計相結合，這要花費適當環級的法術位。用於與詭計結合的法術的施法時間必須為標準動作或更快，而且能夠以一個生物為目標，支配人類（Dominate Person）這樣對目標有嚴格要求的法術可以使用，但如果觸發詭計的生物不符合法術要求，就不會產生任何效果。當受術者成為了一個敵人的法術目標之後，催眠師能夠觸發該項詭計。催眠師的法術也會隨之觸發，不過僅會影響敵方施法者。只有當敵方施法者處於法術的範圍內（以詭計的受術者為起點進行範圍測量）才能生效，這就好像催眠師在受術者所在的方格內施法一般。敵人的法術仍然會產生完整的效果，即便催眠師的法術在通常情況下能夠完美地對抗敵人、並讓施法者無法施法也是如此。

Spell Binding.name: Spell Binding（Spell Binding）
Spell Binding.description:
When a magus selects this arcana, he must select one spell from the wizard spell list that is of a magus spell level he can cast. He adds this spell to his spellbook and list of magus spells known as a magus spell of its wizard spell level. He can instead select two spells to add in this way, but both must be at least one level lower than the highest-level magus spell he can cast.

  A magus can select this magus arcana more than once.

Spell Blast.name: Spell Blast（Spell Blast）
Spell Blast.description: As a swift action whenever you confirm a critical hit against an opponent with a spell that requires an attack roll, you can immediately attempt to bull rush your opponent in any direction. You don閳ユ獩 provoke an attack of opportunity for this bull rush attempt.

Spell Deflection.name: 法術偏轉（Spell Deflection）
Spell Deflection.description:
元素：以太；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：7；超載：0

  你把以太編織起來環繞自身，以此來將目標型的法術偏轉回施法者身上。直至你的下個回合開始為止，每當你成為法術目標，並且這個法術可以被法術反轉（Spell Turning）影響時，投擲1d10-1並得出結果，就如同你的法術反轉剩下這麼多等級可供反轉一般判斷法術的效果。你可以承受1點超載來將效果的持續時間延長至每個操念使等級10分鐘，但是在此情況下，它的效果提早結束之前只能反轉總和為10個等級的法術（仍舊要逐次投擲1d10-1進行檢定）。

Spell Destruction.name: Spell Destruction（Spell Destruction）
Spell Destruction.description:
Element aether; Type utility (Sp); Level 7; Burn 0

  You weave strands of aether around yourself in order to deflect targeted magic back at the caster. Until the beginning of your next turn, every time you are targeted by a spell that could be affected by spell turning, roll 1d10閳? and determine the effects of the spell as if you had @Compendium[pf1.spells.uyn64zazmaydnk7o]{法術反轉} with that many spell levels remaining.

  You can accept 1 point of burn to increase the duration to 10 minutes per kineticist level you possess, but in that case, it deflects only 10 spell levels in total (still rolled 1d10閳? at a time) before ending early.

Spell Knowledge.name: Spell Knowledge（Spell Knowledge）
Spell Knowledge.description:
Your studies into how all things are interconnected have taught you to cast a very limited number of spells. Select a single spell from the sorcerer/wizard spell list that is at least 2 levels lower than your highest-level extract known. You can prepare and cast this spell as an arcane spell. Preparing the spell uses up an extract slot 1 level higher than the spell閳ユ獨 level. Your caster level is equal to your alchemist level, and your save DCs and concentration checks are Intelligence-based. You閳ユ獧e considered to have this spell on your spell list for purposes of prerequisites, spell completion items, and spell trigger items.

You may select this discovery more than once. Each time, it grants you access to another spell from the sorcerer/wizard spell list.

Spell Resistance (4 pts).name: Spell Resistance (4 pts)（Spell Resistance (4 pts)）
Spell Resistance (4 pts).description:
An eidolon is protected against magic, gaining spell resistance. The eidolon's spell resistance is equal to 11 + the summoner's level.

  This spell resistance does not apply to spells cast by the summoner.

  The summoner must be at least 9th level before selecting this evolution.

Spell Resistance (UC) (4 pts).name: Spell Resistance (UC) (4 pts)（Spell Resistance (UC) (4 pts)）
Spell Resistance (UC) (4 pts).description:
Requirements: Summoner level 9th.

  The eidolon is protected against magic, gaining spell resistance. The eidolon閳ユ獨 spell resistance is equal to 11 + the summoner閳ユ獨 level.

  This spell resistance does not apply to spells cast by the summoner.

Spell Storing.name: Spell Storing（Spell Storing）
Spell Storing.description: The rogue can store within himself a single targeted harmless spell of up to 2nd level. The spell must have a casting time of 1 standard action. Anytime a spell that meets these conditions is cast on the rogue, and he does not already have a spell stored, he can choose to store it rather than have it take effect immediately. Anytime afterward, as a standard action, the rogue can have the spell take effect (acting in all ways as if it had just been cast on him). A rogue must have 1 rank of Use Magic Device to select this talent.

Spellbreaker (BAR).name: 破法者(野蠻人)（Spellbreaker (BAR)）
Spellbreaker (BAR).description: 狂暴時，野蠻人獲得“破法者”作為獎勵專長。野蠻人必須習得【擾法者】且至少12級才能選擇這個狂暴之力。

Spellbreaker (MAG).name: 破法者(魔戰士)（Spellbreaker (MAG)）
Spellbreaker (MAG).description:
前提：魔戰士等級9

  效果：魔戰士得到@Compendium[pf1.feats.yE3hVOvBq9rx6TAw]{破法者}做為獎勵專長。

Spider Aspect.name: Spider Aspect（Spider Aspect）
Spider Aspect.description:
The spider is a patient hunter, sensing foes that struggle in its webs.

Minor Form: You gain a +2 competence bonus on Climb checks, Stealth checks, saving throws against web effects (magical or otherwise), and checks to break free of webs.

  This bonus increases to +4 at 8th level and +6 at 15th level.

Major Form: Your shape changes to that of a giant spider. While in this form, you gain darkvision with a range of 60 feet, tremorsense with a range of 10 feet, a climb speed of 30 feet, the web special attack, and a bite attack (1d6).

  At 8th level, you gain a +4 racial bonus on Perception checks, and the range of your tremorsense increases to 20 feet.

  At 15th level, you gain Improved Natural Attack (bite), and the range of your tremorsense increases to 30 feet.

Alternate Natural Attacks: Bite (B, P, S)

Spindle Infusion.name: Spindle Infusion（Spindle Infusion）
Spindle Infusion.description:
Element universal; Type form infusion; Level 2; Burn 2
Associated Blasts any
Saving Throw Reflex negates (see text)

  You throw a long, roughly 5-foot-by-10-foot spindle of elemental matter or energy (or nearby unattended objects in the case of telekineticists) up to 30 feet away, damaging all creatures and objects within any two adjacent 5-foot squares unless they succeed at a Reflex save.

  An energy blast infused with spindle deals its normal damage to each target, while a physical blast infused with spindle deals half its normal damage to each target. The saving throw DC is Dexterity-based.

Spines and Brambles.name: Spines and Brambles（Spines and Brambles）
Spines and Brambles.description:
With a beckoning gesture, the shaman conjures spiny shrubs in a number of squares equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1) within 30 feet. The squares become filled with light undergrowth (Pathfinder RPG Core Rulebook 426). The shaman can pass through the affected squares without impediment.

  When the shaman uses this hex again, any previously conjured undergrowth withers away.

Spire Totem, Greater.name: Spire Totem, Greater（Spire Totem, Greater）
Spire Totem, Greater.description:
While the barbarian is raging, all allies within 30 feet gain a +2 morale bonus on Will saves. When attempting a Will save against a fear effect, all allies within this area can roll twice and use the better result.

  A barbarian must have the spire totem rage power and be at least 10th level to select this rage power.

Spire Totem, Lesser.name: Spire Totem, Lesser（Spire Totem, Lesser）
Spire Totem, Lesser.description: While raging, the barbarian gains a +1 morale bonus on attacks against any creature that has targeted one of her allies with an attack or a harmful spell within the last round.

Spire Totem.name: Spire Totem（Spire Totem）
Spire Totem.description:
While raging, the barbarian takes no penalties for using a weapon to deal nonlethal damage. When dealing nonlethal damage, the barbarian adds a bonus equal to half her barbarian level on her damage rolls.

  A barbarian must have the lesser spire totem rage power and be at least 6th level to select this rage power.

Spirit Bonus.name: 英靈同調（Spirit Bonus）
Spirit Bonus.description: 當通靈者降靈了一個英靈以後，他可以在特定檢定和資料上獲得加值，具體加值類型取決於他召喚的英靈類型。在1級時，英靈之力的加值為+1，在4級和之後每提升4級時額外+1。

Spirit Channeling.name: Spirit Channeling（Spirit Channeling）
Spirit Channeling.description: As your self-awareness expands, you become increasingly attuned to the spirit world around you. At 5th level, as part of your meditation to initiate metamorphosis, you can invite a wandering spirit to share your body as if you were a shaman (Pathfinder RPG Advanced Class Guide 37). You gain the associated 1st-level spirit ability as long as you maintain your altered form, but your metamorphosis form also exhibits some aspect of the spirit you host, such as vivid red hair for a flame spirit or gauntness for a bone spirit.

Spirit Mastery.name: 英靈化（Spirit Mastery）
Spirit Mastery.description: 在19級時，通靈者本人已經位居傳奇之列，受到其他英靈特別是低級精魂的敬仰。通靈者可以每天多使用兩次靈力奔湧而不增加共鳴點數，並且無論他是否選擇遵守禁忌或是使用較弱的英靈都是如此。當他降靈較弱的英靈時，每放棄一個英靈之力通靈師可以獲得4次不增加共鳴的靈力奔湧而非兩次。

Spirit Shroud.name: 精魂罩衣（Spirit Shroud）
Spirit Shroud.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點用精魂能量籠罩自己。你獲得等同於1d6+秘學士等級的臨時生命值。罩衣持續每秘學士等級1分鐘時間，或直到臨時生命值全部耗盡。該臨時生命值可與其他資源疊加，但不與本能力疊加。4級時，當精魂罩衣存在時，你對抗死亡效果、恐懼效果、任何造成負向等級或造成負能量傷害的法術或類法術效果（若它允許進行豁免）時，豁免檢定獲得抗力加值。該加值等於1+4級後每有4個秘學士等級1點。你必須至少3級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Spirit Surge.name: 靈力奔湧（Spirit Surge）
Spirit Surge.description: 當通靈者做出任何一個享有英靈同調加值的d20檢定且失敗後，他可以藉助英靈的力量，以增加1點共鳴為代價為檢定結果增加1d6加值（不需要任何動作）。這個加值可能會使一個失敗的檢定獲得成功，但通靈者需要意識到自己這麼做才能使用這個能力，且每輪最多使用一次。在10級時，這個加值提升到1d8；在20級時，提升到1d10。

Spirit Touch.name: Spirit Touch（Spirit Touch）
Spirit Touch.description:
At 6th level, as a swift action, you can give your natural weapons or any weapons you wield the ghost touch weapon special ability. You can use this power a number of rounds per day equal to your cleric level. These rounds need not be consecutive.

  This power replaces the Death's Embrace power of the Death Domain or the Ward Against Death power of the Repose Domain.

Spiritual Awareness.name: Spiritual Awareness（Spiritual Awareness）
Spiritual Awareness.description:
While raging, the barbarian's dodge bonus to AC from trap sense applies against attacks made by incorporeal creatures.

  The barbarian must have trap sense to select this ability.

Spiritual Bond.name: 魅影聯結（Spiritual Bond）
Spiritual Bond.description: 在14級時，喚魂師的生命力在本質上與她的魅影的靈力存為一體。只要她的魅影至少還有1點生命值，當喚魂師的生命值因為受到傷害而被降到0時，這些傷害可以被傳遞到她的魅影身上。這些傷害會在全部被魅影吸收，或是對魅影造成能夠使其承受達到體質值負值的傷害時停止。在後一種情況下，多出來的傷害仍然會被喚魂師承受。本能力只對會造成生命值傷害的效果有效。

Spiritual Bulwark.name: Spiritual Bulwark（Spiritual Bulwark）
Spiritual Bulwark.description: At 5th level, you develop a deeper attachment to your lingering spirits, and learn to rely on their presence as protection from external spiritual attacks. You gain a bonus equal to your Charisma modifier on saving throws against effects generated by haunts, incorporeal undead, incorporeal outsiders, and on saving throws against possession attempts.

Spiritual Companion.name: Spiritual Companion（Spiritual Companion）
Spiritual Companion.description:
While ninjas are accustomed to solitude, some form pacts with magical beings to seek aid and advice. A ninja with this trick gains an improved familiar, treating her ninja level as her wizard level. The ninja can select any of the following as her familiar: calligraphy wyrm, pipefox, shikigami kami, or spirit oni.

  The ninja must have an alignment compatible with the chosen familiar.

Spiritual Defense.name: Spiritual Defense（Spiritual Defense）
Spiritual Defense.description:
Your chanting grants protection against your enemies. As a move action, you can begin chanting to gain the benefit of a protection spell (such as @Compendium[pf1.spells.skgjjub1hng29nwo]{防護邪惡}) using your oracle level as your caster level. This protection lasts until you stop chanting or for the spell閳ユ獨 normal duration, whichever comes first. Chanting after the initial round of the effect is a free action, and you can incorporate verbal components and communication into the chant; magical silence ends a chant and its protection effect.

  At 6th level, you can chant aloud to create a magic circle effect (such as @Compendium[pf1.spells.1i8b1v3dngkxj6jp]{反邪惡法陣}).

  You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Spiritual Interference.name: 魅影加護（Spiritual Interference）
Spiritual Interference.description: 在4級時，每當喚魂師處於自己的以靈質態顯形的魅影的觸及範圍內時，她都可以在自己的防禦等級上獲得+2盾牌加值，在所有的豁免檢定上獲得+2環境加值。當魅影被擒抱，無助或失去意識時喚魂師也會失去這些加值。每當喚魂師處於自己的以虛靈態顯形的魅影周圍30尺範圍之內時，她還會在對抗影響心靈的效果時在所有的豁免檢定上獲得+2環境加值，這個加值屬於超自然能力並會在魅影失去意識時同時失去。

Splash of the Styx.name: Splash of the Styx（Splash of the Styx）
Splash of the Styx.description:
Element water; Type utility (Sp); Level 5; Burn 1
Prerequisite tiefling or Planar Infusion (Abaddon, Abyss, or Hell)
Saving Throw Will negates; SR yes

  You can spend 1 full round to draw upon the waters of the River Styx to erase memories of a target. This functions as @Compendium[pf1.spells.5ll7q13p0skbgonc]{修改記憶}, except that it can only eliminate memories.

Splitting Mutagen.name: Splitting Mutagen（Splitting Mutagen）
Splitting Mutagen.description:
Once per day while under the effects of his mutagen, the alchemist can split into two identical copies of himself as an immediate action after being damaged by a piercing or slashing weapon. Each copy has an ooze-like complexion, most often manifesting as a slimy sheen to his skin. The alchemist splits his current hit points evenly between the copies. The copies use the same statistics, share the same resources, and have identical equipment (except artifacts, which only one copy has). Similarly, if one of the copies expends a charge or daily use from a magic item that a copy has, the charge or daily use is expended from both copies. If one copy drops or gives away an item, the duplicate item disappears from the other copy as well.

The two copies act independently and each one has a full set of actions. At the end of the alchemist閳ユ獨 next turn, he selects one of the copies, which loses its ooze-like complexion as it becomes the alchemist; the other copy dissolves into a fine mist and dissipates. If one of the copies is destroyed before this happens, the remaining copy immediately becomes the alchemist, and he gains 1 permanent negative level. If both copies are destroyed simultaneously (such as from a @Compendium[pf1.spells.6oq1wcryviik9ice]{火球術}), both copies collapse into formless goo; the alchemist can only be restored to life via @Compendium[pf1.spells.thh46ghi51lrl3cl]{復生術} or similarly powerful magic.

  An alchemist must be at least 12th level before he can select this discovery.

Spontaneous Change.name: Spontaneous Change（Spontaneous Change）
Spontaneous Change.description: At 4th level, when entering a bloodrage, you can cast a transmutation spell that affects only you as a swift action, provided that the spell閳ユ獨 normal casting time is 1 round or shorter. The spell lasts for as long as you continue bloodraging, regardless of the spell閳ユ獨 normal duration. You can use this ability only to cast bloodrager spells you know.

Spontaneous Generation.name: Spontaneous Generation（Spontaneous Generation）
Spontaneous Generation.description: At 3rd level, you gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.tD76K8QGco9scT0r]{制造奇物} as a bonus feat. In addition, when you craft a magic item (except a potion, a spell-trigger item, or a spell-completion item), you may ignore one spell prerequisite without increasing the creation DC. You can ignore an additional spell prerequisite at 9th, 15th, and 20th levels.

Spore Infusion.name: Spore Infusion（Spore Infusion）
Spore Infusion.description:
Element wood; Type substance infusion; Level 5; Burn 3
Associated Blasts autumn, spring, summer, verdant, winter, wood
Saving Throw Fortitude negates

  Creatures that take piercing or slashing damage from your blast are infected with spores. If a target fails its Fortitude save, it takes 1d6 points of damage per round for 10 rounds as plants and fungi grow out of its body. At the end of that time, the target is exposed to the pulsing puffs disease. This infusion is a disease effect. When using a wood kinetic blast against a creature infected by this infusion, you gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls, to saving throw DCs, and on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance.

Pulsing Puffs: Blast閳ユ攰njury; save Fort DC 18; onset 1 minute; frequency 1/day; effect 1d6 Dex damage; cure 2 consecutive saving throws.

Spray Infusion.name: 噴湧（Spray Infusion）
Spray Infusion.description:
元素：水；類別：塑形注能；等級：4；超載：3

  關聯念襲類別：帶電水，水突

  豁免：反射，通過則減半

  你能夠讓念襲宛如洶湧的波濤一般噴出。所有30尺錐形區域內的物體和生物都會受到傷害，數值相當於正常念襲傷害的一半。該豁免DC基於敏捷。

Spring Patron.name: Spring Patron（Spring Patron）
Spring Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.68m9du7zw2di7ew6]{羽落術}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.kouqz0pm1xl8xilm]{變身術}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.2jx5vqudbddi0a2w]{Pup Shape}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.rauee0gjmvenijmr]{現形術}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.wp6qm9gnjxoqww4h]{Lightning Arc}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.6vfauefzzmwl4az7]{連環閃電}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.578t0lra5ll3aifs]{操控天氣}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.f7gaaxcschrg2r0q]{雷暴箭雨}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.7mstq5c76h3e6zzx]{時間靜止}

Spying Touchsight.name: Spying Touchsight（Spying Touchsight）
Spying Touchsight.description:
Element aether; Type utility (Sp); Level 4; Burn 0
Prerequisite touchsight

  You attach a sticky strand of invisible aether to a target and then project your senses along the strand, allowing you to spy on that target. Attaching the strand of aether requires a ranged touch attack, but if you activate this ability while your target is under the effect of your touchsight, you can use the strands from your touchsight instead.

  Once you have activated spying touchsight, you can concentrate on it to spy on your target with any of your five senses (though your own body no longer benefits from the senses you project); the strand lasts as long you concentrate, though you can switch which senses you are projecting each round. A creature using see invisibility or a similar effect can notice the trailing strand of aether and follow it back to you.

  A creature can break your spying touchsight by dispelling it, but otherwise, the only way to break the strand is if one of you uses a teleportation effect, moves more than 1 mile from the other, or is completely blocked from the other in all directions (such as if one of you were inside a telekinetic sphere).

Squander.name: Squander（Squander）
Squander.description: At 15th level, you gain the ability to force others to waste the opportunities they are given. Once per day as a standard action, you can cause a target within 30 feet to gain the staggered condition for a number of rounds equal to your sorcerer level. The duration is halved if the target makes a successful Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your sorcerer level + your Cha modifier).

Stag Aspect.name: 牡鹿擬態（Stag Aspect）
Stag Aspect.description:
牡鹿幾乎可以在對抗任何敵人時都能跑贏或堅守陣地。這擬態提供了雄偉的優雅及迅捷的速度。

  次級形態：你的基本移動速度獲得5尺增強加值。8級起，這個加值提升至10尺。15級起，這個加值提升至20尺。

  專攻形態：你變身為一隻大型牡鹿（怪物圖鑑4 pg. 150），但是它的佔據變為10尺。當處於該形態時，你獲得50尺基礎速度、昏暗視覺、靈敏嗅覺（30尺）、1d8傷害的抵撞攻擊和2個1d4傷害的蹄踢。8級時，你在跳躍的特技檢定獲得+4種族加值。15級時，你獲得抵撞的精通天生武器攻擊專長和可怖毆擊專長（怪物圖鑑 pg. 314, 315），並且你能用可怖毆擊對抗體型跟你一樣或更小的生物。

Staggering Gaze.name: Staggering Gaze（Staggering Gaze）
Staggering Gaze.description: At 8th level, when a creature is affected by your gaze bloodline power, it is staggered in addition to being slowed.

Stalker Sense.name: 獵手直覺（Stalker Sense）
Stalker Sense.description: 俠客的第六感隨時警告他危險的迫近。俠客總是能在突襲輪行動。在6級時，俠客獲得直覺閃避能力；在12級時，俠客獲得精通直覺閃避能力。只有選擇詭秘獵手之道的俠客可以選擇本天賦。

Stalker Talent.name: Stalker Talent（Stalker Talent）
Stalker Talent.description: The rogue can select a vigilante talent. For the purposes of selecting and using this talent, she counts as a 10th-level vigilante with the stalker specialization, regardless of her actual rogue level. Her sneak attack counts as a hidden strike with reduced damage for the purpose of determining the effects of her vigilante talent, which means, among other things, that she can閳ユ獩 apply any of the vigilante talents marked with an asterisk (*) to her sneak attacks.

Stampede.name: Stampede（Stampede）
Stampede.description: At 15th level, as a standard action, the cavalier can incite any riderless and nonhostile animals and animal companions within 60 feet of him to stampede. Each affected creature gains a +4 bonus to AC (this bonus stacks with the benefits of the cavalier閳ユ獨 challenge), the trample universal monster rule, and a bonus to damage equal to half the cavalier閳ユ獨 level for 1 round. The save DC against an incited animal閳ユ獨 trample attack is 10 + half the cavalier閳ユ獨 level + his Charisma modifier. Incited creatures attack whatever targets the cavalier directs them to unless commanded otherwise by a bonded master (in the case of a familiar or animal companion).

Starlight Agility.name: Starlight Agility（Starlight Agility）
Starlight Agility.description:
You gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.JreaiTHdyWFNj3Tb]{閃避} as a bonus feat.

  At 8th level, you gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.9p0aAtCyLdcwnftS]{疾風步} as a bonus feat.

  At 15th level, you gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.jbvXxHpu7BVbCpwr]{閃電步} as a bonus feat.

  You do not need to meet the prerequisites to receive these feats.

Stars Subdomain.name: Stars Subdomain（Stars Subdomain）
Stars Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2nd - @Compendium[pf1.spells.zyfm6dq35i4hip4u]{催眠圖紋}
  • 7th - @Compendium[pf1.spells.vax8ojz8g3oovwzu]{陽炎射線}
  • 9th - @Compendium[pf1.spells.xhzme0v6tjq95fg6]{流星爆}

Startling Appearance.name: 驚愕現身（Startling Appearance）
Startling Appearance.description: 在5級時，俠客學會了如何利用他人的驚訝作為自己的優勢，他總是能在自己的目標毫無知覺的時候突然冒出來。每當擁有本能力的俠客嘗試對一個完全沒有意識到他的存在（比如通過隱形效果或是維持潛行）的敵人發動一次攻擊時，直到俠客的本回合結束前這個目標都視為對他措手不及（直覺閃避和類似效果仍然能避免該狀態，除非俠客的俠客等級比該目標至少高4級）。除此之外，在俠客的下一回合開始前，該對手對他發動的所有攻擊也在攻擊檢定上承受-4減值。

Steadfast Example.name: Steadfast Example（Steadfast Example）
Steadfast Example.description:
The shaman touches a willing creature and bolsters its mental and emotional defenses. The next time the target attempts a Will saving throw, the subject can use the shaman閳ユ獨 Will saving throw bonus instead of his own.

  The shaman can have only one creature under the effect of this hex at a time, and a creature affected by this hex cannot be affected by it again for 24 hours.

Steal Voice.name: Steal Voice（Steal Voice）
Steal Voice.description:
The witch can steal the voice of one creature within 30 feet, causing it to lose, for a number of rounds equal to the witch閳ユ獨 Intelligence bonus, all abilities that rely on speech, including talking, casting spells with verbal components, and using auditory bardic performances. A successful Will saving throw negates this effect. If this hex is used upon a willing target, the duration lasts for a number of hours equal to the witch閳ユ獨 Intelligence bonus.

  Additionally, the witch can change her voice to match that of any creature whose voice she has stolen with this hex, as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.26g4tysnax570dxo]{Vocal Alteration} (Pathfinder RPG Ultimate Magic 248).

Steel Soldier.name: Steel Soldier（Steel Soldier）
Steel Soldier.description:
Some vigilantes ceaselessly tinker with their armor until the two seem inseparable; masked maidens are particularly prone to developing this obsession. The vigilante can spend 1 day and 100 gp per class level modifying a set of armor with which he is proficient. The vigilante can conceal one set of unworn modified armor on his person as though it were an extraordinarily small object, as per Sleight of Hand, and can don modified armor without aid. The armor skin talent also applies to armor with this ability.

  At 8th level, the vigilante treats modified armor閳ユ獨 enhancement bonus (if any) as a weapon enhancement bonus when making attacks with the armor閳ユ獨 gauntlets, if the armor has any.

  Only an avenger vigilante can select this talent.

Steely Resolve.name: Steely Resolve（Steely Resolve）
Steely Resolve.description: Three times per day, as an immediate action when the vigilante fails a Will saving throw against a mind-affecting effect, the vigilante can delay the effect閳ユ獨 onset for a number of rounds equal to half his vigilante level, after which the vigilante is affected as normal by the entire effect. Rounds spent delaying the effect do not count toward the effect閳ユ獨 duration.

Stem the Flow.name: Stem the Flow（Stem the Flow）
Stem the Flow.description: When making a successful sneak attack against a creature with the ability to channel energy, the rogue may forgo 3d6 points of sneak attack damage to instead prevent the target from channeling energy for a number of rounds equal to half her rogue level.

Sticks and Stones.name: Sticks and Stones（Sticks and Stones）
Sticks and Stones.description: The slayer gains @Compendium[pf1.feats.bZ1YdzkT8NtRIEJ4]{隨手武器} as a bonus feat.

Sticky (1 pt).name: Sticky (1 pt)（Sticky (1 pt)）
Sticky (1 pt).description: The eidolon is especially sticky, whether from a coating of adhesive slime, partially congealed blood, or tiny barbed spines. The eidolon gains a +4 bonus on combat maneuver checks to initiate or maintain a grapple.

Sting (1 pt).name: Sting (1 pt)（Sting (1 pt)）
Sting (1 pt).description:
An eidolon possesses a long, barbed stinger at the end of its tail, granting it a sting attack. This attack is a primary attack. The sting deals 1d4 points of damage (1d6 if Large, 1d8 if Huge). The eidolon must possess the tail evolution to take this evolution.

  This evolution can be selected more than once, but the eidolon must possess an equal number of the tail evolution.

Sting (UC) (1 pt).name: Sting (UC) (1 pt)（Sting (UC) (1 pt)）
Sting (UC) (1 pt).description:
Requirements: Agathion, daemon, demon, devil, div, elemental, protean, or psychopomp subtype; tail evolution.

  The eidolon possesses a long, barbed stinger at the end of its tail, granting it a sting attack. This attack is a primary attack. The sting deals 1d4 points of damage (1d6 if Large, 1d8 if Huge).

  This evolution can be selected more than once, up to the number of tail evolutions the eidolon possesses.

Stone Resistance.name: Stone Resistance（Stone Resistance）
Stone Resistance.description: At 16th level, you gain acid resistance 10 and are immune to disease, poison, and the sickened and staggered conditions. You also cannot be flanked.

Stone Sculptor.name: 雕石者（Stone Sculptor）
Stone Sculptor.description:
元素：土；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：5；超載：0

  你可以將大地塑造成任意形態，就如同使用塑石術（Stone Shape）法術一般。

Stone Stabilitiy.name: Stone Stabilitiy（Stone Stabilitiy）
Stone Stabilitiy.description:
You receive a +4 bonus to your Combat Maneuver Defense when resisting a bull rush or trip attempt while standing on the ground.

  At 5th level, you gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.gTrGPxzN054GfpkM]{精通摔絆} as a bonus feat.

  At 10th level, you gain @Compendium[pf1.feats.lNyMFFQaOxxTOW7M]{高等摔絆} as a bonus feat. You do not need to meet the prerequisites to gain these feats.

Stony Skin.name: Stony Skin（Stony Skin）
Stony Skin.description: A rogue with this talent gains DR 2/adamantine. A rogue can select this talent up to three times; each additional time the rogue selects this talent, the DR granted by this talent increases by 1.

Storms Patron.name: Storms Patron（Storms Patron）
Storms Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.tuh5vc2bojaws3ig]{隱霧術}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.g33euis7yi9pwddy]{雲霧術}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.rrheoc0h80mbss7z]{召雷術}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.t1uhggjfimtabp4v]{冰風暴}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.dwb03nzhbwb1b5nr]{召喚雷暴}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.1mkigzpu5hohovgw]{御風而行}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.578t0lra5ll3aifs]{操控天氣}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.i9greyz3c0ap32vi]{旋風術}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.n4e35m6qu9nmkhgm]{復仇風暴}

Strangler.name: Strangler（Strangler）
Strangler.description: A ninja with this trick knows how to use a scarf, usually with a coin or large knot, as a lethal garrote. The ninja takes no penalties when using a scarf as an improvised garrote. In addition, as a free action when attempting a grapple combat maneuver check, the ninja can spend 1 ki point to gain the constrict special attack on that maneuver with damage equal to half the ninja閳ユ獨 sneak attack dice (minimum 1d6).

Strength of Shadows.name: Strength of Shadows（Strength of Shadows）
Strength of Shadows.description:
At 8th level, you gain cold resistance 10. Your melee attacks deal additional cold damage equal to the critical multiplier of the weapon you use.

  At 13th level, your cold resistance increases to 20.

  At 18th level, you become immune to cold damage.

Strike Through Shadow.name: Strike Through Shadow（Strike Through Shadow）
Strike Through Shadow.description:
At 12th level, you can declare a single melee attack as a strike through shadow. This attack moves through its target閳ユ獨 shadow and strikes from below or inside its armor. You make this attack against the target閳ユ獨 touch AC.

  You can use this ability once per day, plus an additional time per day each at 15th and 18th levels.

Strike the Unseen.name: 無形之敵（Strike the Unseen）
Strike the Unseen.description: 俠客獲得盲鬥作為獎勵專長。除此之外，他還可以對擁有全隱蔽的敵人發動暗襲攻擊。在11級時，俠客獲得精通盲鬥作為獎勵專長，並且他可以對擁有隱蔽或是全隱蔽的敵人造成任何種類的精準傷害。在16級時，俠客獲得高等盲鬥作為獎勵專長。俠客無需滿足任何先決條件即可通過本天賦獲得精通盲鬥和高等盲鬥專長。

Strong Impression.name: Strong Impression（Strong Impression）
Strong Impression.description: A rogue who selects this talent gains @Compendium[pf1.feats.O0jbkTJcIji9BNiF]{威逼} as a bonus feat.

Studied Ally.name: Studied Ally（Studied Ally）
Studied Ally.description:
The slayer can study an ally or friendly creature he can see as a move action. The slayer gains a +1 bonus on checks and attack rolls to use the aid another action to help with that ally閳ユ獨 skill checks, attacks, or AC. This bonus increases at the same rate as a slayer閳ユ獨 studied target bonus.

  At 7th level, a slayer can study an ally as a move or swift action. A slayer閳ユ獨 studied ally counts against the number of studied targets he can have active at once.

Studied Target.name: 殺戮目標（Studied Target）
Studied Target.description:
殺手能以移動動作研究他能看到的一個對手。殺手將對此目標的唬騙、知識、察覺、察言觀色和生存技能檢定+1，武器攻擊和傷害檢定+1，並且使殺手職業能力的DC +1。殺手只能同時保持對一個目標的研究；上述加值將持續到對手死亡，或殺手研究另一個目標為止。

  如果殺手對某目標造成了偷襲傷害，他能以直覺動作研究該目標，並獲得針對該目標的殺戮目標加值 (包括這次攻擊的正常傷害檢定)。

  5級、10級、15級和20級時，殺手對研究目標的武器攻擊加值、傷害加值、技能加值和DC各+1。此外，殺手在達到上述等級時，分別能夠同時研究1個新的目標。殺手能以自由動作放棄針對1個目標的專注，這允許他去研究下一個目標。

  7級時，殺手能以移動動作或迅捷動作來對目標進行研究。

Stunning Appearance.name: 震撼現身（Stunning Appearance）
Stunning Appearance.description: 在17級時，俠客可以在他的對手完全無以行動的間隙突然出現。每當擁有本能力的俠客嘗試對一個完全沒有意識到他的存在（條件見上驚愕現身）的敵人發動一次成功的攻擊時，這個敵人都必須超過的通過一個DC=（10+俠客的等級的一半+他的魅力調整值）的意志檢定否則將在俠客的下一回合開始前陷入震懾狀態。如果該生物擁有的HD比俠客的等級多，那麼他可以在這次檢定上獲得+4環境加值。一旦某個生物成為了震撼現身的目標（無論俠客的威嚇是否成功），他都會免疫同一個俠客的震撼現身能力24小時。本能力的效果與驚愕現身和駭人現身能力的好處疊加。震撼現身是一個影響心靈的恐懼效果。

Stylish Infusion.name: Stylish Infusion（Stylish Infusion）
Stylish Infusion.description:
Element universal; Type substance infusion; Level 3; Burn 2
Prerequisite brawler's flurry or flurry of blows class feature, kinetic fist
Associated Blasts any
Saving Throw none

  When you learn this infusion, select an unchained monk style strike. You can use that style strike during a flurry of blows with your infused blast, though you must still follow the limitation of one style strike per flurry of blows (or two if you are a 15th-level unchained monk). If you select flying kick, the distance is equal to your elemental overflow bonus on attack rolls 鑴?10 feet. You can use this infusion only while also using the kinetic fist form infusion.

Special: You can select this infusion multiple times. Each time, you must select a different style strike.

Subjective Truth.name: 主觀事實（Subjective Truth）
Subjective Truth.description: 俠客擁有的不同身份允許他對抗偵測謊言的魔法效果。只要俠客所說的內容從他的目前所處的身份視角為真的話，在受到諸如法術辨識謊言（Discern Lies）的偵測時即會顯示為真實，他也可以在諸如法術誠實之域（Zone of Truth）之類強迫他說出真相的效果內敘述這些真實的內容。俠客必須達到9級並擁有扮無辜社交天賦才能選擇本天賦。

Subordinate Spell.name: 附屬法術（Subordinate Spell）
Subordinate Spell.description: 異能者能夠一心二用，在施放聯結法術的同時對著自身施放較弱的法術。聯結法術不得低於5級，而且施放時間不得比1個標準動作更快。由於該能力會影響實際的施法時間，因此異能者無法對瞬發法術（quickened spell）新增附屬法術的效果。附屬法術的施法時間必須為1個標準動作或者更快，而且它的等級不能高於聯結法術的等級-5。附屬法術的目標必須是異能者自己（即便該法術在正常情況下能夠影響他人或者附屬目標也是如此）。異能者必須花費的精神力數量為3 + 附屬法術的等級的兩倍。附屬法術就如同它被正常施放一般生效，而且會用到一個異能者在對應等級上的每日法術位。兩個法術的效果是分開的，因此必須分別進行各自的專注檢定。

Substantiating Bomb.name: Substantiating Bomb（Substantiating Bomb）
Substantiating Bomb.description:
Your bombs are infused with ectoplasm and a longing for life, lending ethereal creatures a measure of substance. You can throw a bomb that inflicts no damage but instead creates a 10-foot-radius cloud of fog that functions as @Compendium[pf1.spells.g33euis7yi9pwddy]{雲霧術} and lasts for 1 round per alchemist level. Incorporeal creatures that pass through this cloud become partially solid, taking half damage from nonmagic attacks and full damage from magic weapons, spells, and spell-like abilities. This effect lasts for the duration of the smoke cloud, even if the incorporeal creature moves outside the cloud閳ユ獨 area. A creature affected by the cloud can attempt a Will saving throw to negate the substantiating effects of this bomb.

  An alchemist must be 10th level before selecting this discovery.

Subsumed Spirit.name: Subsumed Spirit（Subsumed Spirit）
Subsumed Spirit.description:
As the alchemist grows in power, his parasitic twin laps up a portion of his soul, like a dog feeding on its master閳ユ獨 scraps. The alchemist閳ユ獨 parasitic twin can now manifest or hide within the alchemist閳ユ獨 torso as a move action. As a standard action, the alchemist can cause his manifested twin to babble, driving listeners insane. All creatures without the insanity special ability that are within 60 feet of the alchemist must succeed at a Will save or be affected by confusion for 1 round per alchemist level. The alchemist can urge his parasitic twin to babble a number of times per day equal to 3 + the alchemist閳ユ獨 Intelligence modifier. Creatures that successfully save can閳ユ獩 be affected by this effect for 24 hours. The alchemist is immune to its sibling閳ユ獨 babbling. This is a sonic, mind-affecting compulsion effect.

  The alchemist must have the parasitic twin discovery before selecting this discovery.

Subtle Misdirection.name: Subtle Misdirection（Subtle Misdirection）
Subtle Misdirection.description: As a standard action, you can touch a creature or an object that weighs no more than 25 pounds per caster level to impart an illusory ward that lasts for 1 minute. Attacks against a warded creature suffer a 20% miss chance, and the ward ends once it negates an attack. The DC of any caster level check, skill check, or saving throw to detect or determine the properties of a warded item increases by 1, plus 1 for every 5 wizard levels you have. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Intelligence modifier.

Succor Final Revelation.name: Succor Final Revelation（Succor Final Revelation）
Succor Final Revelation.description: You become a beacon of aid and assistance to your allies and those you deem worthy of receiving your succoring magical benefits. You can apply any one of the following metamagic feats to any spell you cast that targets one or more of your allies without increasing the level or casting time: Enlarge Spell, Extend Spell, Silent Spell, or Still Spell. You do not need to have these feats to use this ability, and you can use this ability any number of times per day on any spell that can be affected by the listed metamagic feats.

Succor Mystery.name: Succor Mystery（Succor Mystery）
Succor Mystery.description:
本職技能: An oracle with the succor mystery adds Handle Animal, Knowledge ：自然, and Survival to her list of class skills.

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.mczdgwo3xl8c6e26]{衰弱射線} (2nd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.qc7vnye0x975gxdf]{Shield Of Fortification} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.lisojmynoblunlex]{協調行動} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.rxenoze8iyh9iyng]{Shield Of Fortification, Greater} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.knyako6zopc1chrv]{石膚術} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.z0duc2v2n3ioynta]{高等英雄氣概} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.uuzeynxotp9dzu15]{耗費術} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.cc0or00vpiky87n7]{Spellcrash, Greater} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.77bihy40diufd6p1]{抑制法牆} (18th).

Sucker Punch.name: Sucker Punch（Sucker Punch）
Sucker Punch.description:
Whenever the vigilante attacks a foe that is unaware of his presence (or who views him as an ally), and the attack deals nonlethal damage, the attack deals an additional 1d6 points of nonlethal damage. This additional damage increases by 1d6 at each of 6th, 12th, and 18th levels.

  Only an avenger vigilante can select this talent.

Sudden Attack.name: 瞬襲（Sudden Attack）
Sudden Attack.description: 當你發動整輪攻擊時，你可以以自己的最高基本攻擊加值額外發動一次攻擊。本能力與法術加速術提供的額外攻擊次數疊加，但是不與其他通過額外攻擊次數的特殊動作疊加，比如疾風連擊或法術戰鬥能力。在雙武器戰鬥時瞬襲正常生效。

Sudden Block.name: 突進格擋（Sudden Block）
Sudden Block.description: 每當一個敵人的攻擊即將命中你或一個鄰接生物時，你能使用你的靈力奔湧骰增加受害目標的AC，以至於有可能使攻擊失手。骰一次靈力奔湧骰，將數值加到防禦等級上對抗這次攻擊。你不能處於措手不及狀態且必須意識到這次攻擊才能進行格擋，如果敵人攻擊失手，那麼你可以有一個即時動作立刻以最高攻擊加值對他發動一次攻擊。

Sudden Insight.name: 瞬時洞見（Sudden Insight）
Sudden Insight.description: 以一個迅捷動作，你消耗1點心智點預見到瞬間未來。你可以在任一次能力檢定、攻擊檢定或技能檢定前自由動作使用獲得的預兆，讓該次檢定獲得等於1/2秘學士等級的洞察加值（最低為1）。該預兆每回合只能用一次，且若你未在該回合結束前使用掉，洞察到的預兆就會消失，沒有任何效果。

Sudden Speed.name: 瞬時加速（Sudden Speed）
Sudden Speed.description: 以一個迅捷動作，你消耗1點心智點讓自己爆發速度。1分鐘內，你的陸地移動速度增加30尺。該能力不與其本身疊加。

Sudden Sting.name: Sudden Sting（Sudden Sting）
Sudden Sting.description: At 9th level, when you are able to act in the surprise round, you can take a full round閳ユ獨 worth of actions rather than just a single standard action. You can also cast @Compendium[pf1.spells.3fkwj6d8s65ufwar]{加速毒發} and @Compendium[pf1.spells.l7e01shgg8c44zfg]{減緩毒發} as spell-like abilities a total of three times per day.

Suffocate.name: 窒息（Suffocate）
Suffocate.description:
元素：以太、氣或水；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：6；超載：0

  豁免：強韌，通過則部分生效；法術抗力：可

  你讓距離自己120尺內的一個生物窒息，這可以是使用以太扼住它的喉嚨、利用氣流在它周圍創造出無法呼吸的空氣，或者使用水來灌滿它嗓子。若目標需要呼吸，它必須在你維持專注期間屏住呼吸。在該生物的每個回合中，都需要嘗試一次強韌豁免才能說話，但是隻有在你的專注中斷、你離開距離該生物120尺的範圍、或者你打破效果線時，該生物才能夠呼吸。在啟動這個原力時，你能夠為了清空目標肺部的空氣而承受1點超載。若你這麼做，而且目標在第一次強韌豁免中失敗的話，它會陷入癱瘓（disabled）、生命值降至0點，而且在它再一次在強韌豁免中失敗時，便會陷入昏迷（falls unconscious）、而且生命值降至-1點。

Suffocating Grip, Greater.name: Suffocating Grip, Greater（Suffocating Grip, Greater）
Suffocating Grip, Greater.description:
When the barbarian is using the suffocating grip rage power, the grappled creature cannot hold its breath and immediately begins suffocating.

  A barbarian must be at least 12th level and have the suffocating grip rage power to select this rage power.

Suffocating Grip.name: Suffocating Grip（Suffocating Grip）
Suffocating Grip.description: While raging, when the barbarian successfully maintains a grapple, she can choke her opponent instead of dealing damage to, moving, pinning, or tying up her opponent. The grappled opponent cannot speak or breathe and must hold its breath or begin suffocating. The grappled opponent can take a breath during any round in which the barbarian does not maintain the grapple. Creatures that do not breathe are not affected by this ability.

Summer Patron.name: Summer Patron（Summer Patron）
Summer Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.k4whhwm1dsz2upkm]{神莓}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.lzos34s87qsc620l]{熾焰法球}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.7x2z0i8rcx7s81fk]{晝明術}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ph3krpxerzptnwbl]{Flaming Sphere, Greater}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.92hth51cs9oi0nfe]{火牆術}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.nk37t5em8q4v1djs]{燃燒之風}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.vax8ojz8g3oovwzu]{陽炎射線}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.j2mwv9wfxhqch10g]{陽炎爆}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.qk3oeq4awbc1smjw]{火焰之軀}

Summer's Heat.name: Summer's Heat（Summer's Heat）
Summer's Heat.description:
The witch surrounds her target with oppressive heat, dealing a number of points of nonlethal damage equal to her witch level and causing the target to become fatigued. The target can attempt a Fortitude save to reduce this nonlethal damage by half and negate the fatigued condition.

  Whether or not the target succeeds at this save, it can閳ユ獩 be the target of this hex again for 1 day.

Summon Monster (UC).name: 召喚怪物(掉鏈)（Summon Monster (UC)）
Summon Monster (UC).description: 1級起，召喚師能夠以類法術能力施放召喚怪物 I（summon monster I），這麼做的每日次數為3 + 他的魅力調整值。由於該能力和召喚師召喚幻靈使用了相同的力量。因此召喚師只能在沒有召喚自己的幻靈時使用該能力。召喚師能夠以標準動作使用該能力，而且召喚出的生物會持續每等級1分鐘（以取代每等級1輪）。在3級以及之後的每2個等級，該能力的力量都會增加1個法術等級，這使得召喚師能夠召喚更加強大的生物（最高為17級時的召喚怪物 IX）。在19級時，該能力可以作為異界之門（Gate）或召喚怪物 IX（Summon Monster IX）來使用。作為異界之門來使用時，召喚師必須支付任何必要的材料成分。召喚師以此方式在同一時間僅能讓一個召喚怪物或異界之門法術生效。若再次使用該能力，那麼由此類法術能力而正在生效的召喚怪物或異界之門會立即結束。在判斷法術觸發（spell trigger）和法術完成型（spell completion）物品時，這些召喚法術被視為包含在召喚師的法術列表內。此外，只要召喚師能夠使用該能力來施放造物需要的法術，他就可以花費該能力的使用次數來滿足任何由他製作的魔法物品的造物要求。

Summon Nature's Spirits.name: Summon Nature's Spirits（Summon Nature's Spirits）
Summon Nature's Spirits.description:
Once per day, as a standard action, you may cast a summon monster spell of a level up to the highest level you can cast. You may only summon elementals in this manner, but are treated as having the @Compendium[pf1.feats.7bJjKqNRrvpXJ4L3]{增強召喚} feat when you do so.

  You must be at least 5th level to select this revelation.

Sun Stride.name: Sun Stride（Sun Stride）
Sun Stride.description:
You can travel between areas of natural sunlight as if by means of a dimension door spell. This ability does not function in areas of less than bright light, though it does work within the area of a daylight spell.

  At 5th level, you can sun stride up to 40 feet per day; this can be a single stride of 40 feet or four strides of 10 feet each.

  At 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the distance you can sun stride doubles (80 feet at 9th level, 160 feet at 13th level, and 32 feet at 17th level). This amount can be split among many strides, but each one, no matter how small, counts as a 10-foot increment.

  You must be at least 5th level to select this revelation.

Sun Totem, Greater.name: Sun Totem, Greater（Sun Totem, Greater）
Sun Totem, Greater.description:
The barbarian takes on aspects of the sun. She gains fire resistance 20 when raging. While raging, she is surrounded by a halo of flame that deals 1d6 points of fire damage to anyone that hits her with a touch attack or unarmed attack or succeeds at a bull rush, drag, or grapple combat maneuver against her. Her unarmed strikes and attacks with natural weapons deal 1d6 additional points of fire damage.

  A barbarian must have the sun totem rage power and be at least 10th level to select this rage power.

Sun Totem, Lesser.name: Sun Totem, Lesser（Sun Totem, Lesser）
Sun Totem, Lesser.description: The sun閳ユ獨 fire invigorates the barbarian. She is immune to environmental effects from heat and severe heat, and she gains a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves against the effects of extreme heat. In addition, the barbarian gains fire resistance 5 while raging.

Sun Totem.name: Sun Totem（Sun Totem）
Sun Totem.description:
