The touch of flame fuels and bolsters the barbarian閳ユ獨 rage. She gains fire resistance 10 when raging. In addition, for 1d6 rounds after coming in direct contact with open flame, her speed increases by 10 feet.

  A barbarian must have the lesser sun totem rage power and be at least 6th level to select this rage power.

Sungazer.name: Sungazer（Sungazer）
Sungazer.description:
You can study the sun and gaze upon any place its light touches. You can use @Compendium[pf1.spells.6kmkxepwgsbta6ui]{銳耳術/鷹眼術} as a spell-like ability, but only for visual observation and you can only place your sensor in places currently being touched by sunlight.

  At 10th level, you can instead use @Compendium[pf1.spells.g66w32kdup1f43bp]{探知} to observe any area touched by sunlight.

  At 15th level, you can use @Compendium[pf1.spells.glt6uk3n6g6l2p6l]{高等探知} instead. You must be at least 5th level to select this revelation.

  You can sungaze for 1 minute per day per oracle level; the duration need not be continuous, but it must be used in 1-minute increments.

Sunlight Acclimation.name: Sunlight Acclimation（Sunlight Acclimation）
Sunlight Acclimation.description: Time spent in the bright light of day has partially inured the alchemist to its effects. When the alchemist would normally take Constitution damage as a result of vulnerability to sunlight, he can attempt a DC 11 Fortitude saving throw to negate the effects. The DC of this saving throw increases by 1 for each hour after the first spent in sunlight within the last 24 hours.

Sunlight Strike.name: Sunlight Strike（Sunlight Strike）
Sunlight Strike.description: The slayer can reflect sunlight (or other sources of bright light) into the eyes of an adjacent target as a swift action, causing it to gain the dazzled condition for 1 round.

Sunsight.name: Sunsight（Sunsight）
Sunsight.description: At 1st level, you gain low-light vision and cannot be dazzled. If you already have low-light vision, you instead gain a +4 bonus on saving throws against blindness effects.

Supercharge.name: 超聚合（Supercharge）
Supercharge.description: 11級起，當操念使以移動動作念力凝聚時，她可以讓單個原力的總超載消耗降低2點而非原本的1點。當操念使以1個整輪動作念力凝聚時，她可以讓單個原力的總超載消耗降低3點而非原本的2點。

Superior Automatic Writing.name: 高階扶乩（Superior Automatic Writing）
Superior Automatic Writing.description: 5級起，當你嘗試神秘技能解放（Occult Skill Unlocks）中的扶乩（Automatic Writing）時（詳細見本書第五章），你能夠將你的異能者等級 + 你的感知加值之和作為你在語言學技能中投入的技能點數。8級起，你會在使用扶乩時獲得一個額外選項，可以嘗試一次DC35的檢定來獲得訊息，就如同你使用了通神術（Commune）一般，來取代使用占卜術（Augury）或預言術（Divination）。如此使用的通神術不需要材料成分，而且持續時間等同於每個你所具有的異能者等級1輪。你會聯繫到一個具有大智慧的遙遠存在、阿卡西記錄的斷片（a fragment of the Akashic Record；見本書第六章 244)或者類似的知識堡壘（bastion of knowledge）以取代聯繫一名神祇。

Superior Psychic Magic (UC) (4 pts).name: Superior Psychic Magic (UC) (4 pts)（Superior Psychic Magic (UC) (4 pts)）
Superior Psychic Magic (UC) (4 pts).description:
Requirements: Aberrant subtype; advanced psychic magic evolution; summoner level 11th; Charisma 13.

  The eidolon has 7 points of psychic magic to spend each day. Select one spell from the following list: 

  • confusion, 
  • deeper darkness, 
  • displacement, 
  • jester閳ユ獨 jauntAPG, 
  • id insinuation IIOA, or 
  • mind thrust IIIOA.

  The eidolon can cast that spell as a psychic spell by spending 3 points of psychic energy. The caster level and save DC are the same as for basic psychic magic.

  This evolution can be selected more than once, selecting a different spell each time.

  The eidolon閳ユ獨 amount of psychic energy available to spend each day does not stack; it uses only the highest number of points granted by its most powerful psychic magic evolution.

Superior Sniper.name: Superior Sniper（Superior Sniper）
Superior Sniper.description: A rogue who selects this talent gains Expert Sniper (Dirty Tactics Toolbox 10) as a bonus feat. If she already has this feat, she can instead select any feat that lists Expert Sniper as a prerequisite, as long as she meets the feat閳ユ獨 prerequisites.

Superior Transformation.name: Superior Transformation（Superior Transformation）
Superior Transformation.description: At 15th level, you become master of your own shape and you fully understand the intricacies of all shapechanging magic. You are immune to polymorph effects unless you are a willing target. Once per day when you cast a polymorph spell on yourself, in addition to the normal effects of the spell, you can choose to gain a fly speed of 60 feet (average maneuverability), a swim speed of 60 feet, or an increase to your base land speed of 30 feet.

Superiority Discipline.name: Superiority Discipline（Superiority Discipline）
Superiority Discipline.description:
You know that you are far better than average creatures of your kind. The more you leverage your psychic talents to prove yourself superior, the more powerful you become.

精神力池屬性 魅力

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.6ux76jy9wbi88br0]{光榮時刻} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wrh3m8ad4l8sbisc]{Deflect Blame} (4th), 
  • unflappable mien (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.qy6sn5a4wrsa36yb]{Majestic Image} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.9v2s3xjlakjm1eq1]{法師密室} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.9pbl3ktd5oqejl19]{轉變術} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.0w3hvcp3gb2bhtv5]{投影術} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.9968j68bl9x9iq7u]{克隆術} (self only) (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.xuuzj9lr2xbwaim4]{神威如獄} (18th).

Supernatural Trap.name: Supernatural Trap（Supernatural Trap）
Supernatural Trap.description:
At 8th level, select a supernatural ranger trap (Pathfinder RPG Ultimate Magic 64). You can use this trap a number of times per day equal to your Wisdom bonus. The DCs for Perception checks, Disable Device checks, and saving throws against the trap are equal to 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Wisdom bonus. The trap lasts for 1 hour or until triggered.

  This power replaces the Dancing Weapons power of the Artifice Domain.

Suppress Poison.name: Suppress Poison（Suppress Poison）
Suppress Poison.description: A rogue with this talent can stave off the effects of a poison. As an immediate action when she fails a saving throw against a poison, the rogue can attempt the saving throw a second time. If she succeeds at this second saving throw, the poison does not affect her for a number of rounds equal to her Constitution modifier (minimum 1 round), but this time it counts against the poison閳ユ獨 duration. This talent has no effect on poisons with an onset longer than immediate.

Sure Footing.name: Sure Footing（Sure Footing）
Sure Footing.description: The slayer gains a +5 bonus on Acrobatics checks to move on narrow surfaces and loose or uneven ground.

Sure Soul.name: Sure Soul（Sure Soul）
Sure Soul.description:
Because of your experience with possessing spirits, you gain a +2 insight bonus on saving throws against possession effects such as magic jar, a ghost閳ユ獨 malevolence ability, or domination effects.

  At 7th level, this bonus also applies against death effects and mind-affecting effects.

  At 11th level, the bonus increases to +4.

Sure-Footed.name: 穩步（Sure-Footed）
Sure-Footed.description: 俠客可以以全速移動並進行潛行和特技檢定而不再這些技能檢定上承受減值。在8級時，俠客可以以全速在困難地形中移動。

Surprise Strike.name: 詭擊（Surprise Strike）
Surprise Strike.description: 你可以對一個在防禦等級上失去敏捷加值的對手在攻擊時造成額外傷害。你每擁有3個通靈者等級這個傷害就增加1d6點，本傷害是精準傷害。每天在你第一次攻擊一個目標時，他一定對你視為措手不及，即使他擁有可以避免措手不及的能力也是一樣。在你的第一次攻擊之後，這個生物將免疫因為你的詭擊使它措手不及，持續24小時。

Surprising Charge.name: Surprising Charge（Surprising Charge）
Surprising Charge.description:
Once per day, you can move up to your speed as an immediate action.

  You can use this ability one additional time per day at 7th level and 15th level.

Survival Instinct.name: 生存本能（Survival Instinct）
Survival Instinct.description: 通過純粹的意志力，你在到達極限後還能保持身體運作下去。你在決定死亡的體質屬性的負值，以及穩定或恢復意識（regain consciousness）的體質檢定中加上你的感知調整值。

Susceptibility (Stare).name: 多情（Susceptibility (Stare)）
Susceptibility (Stare).description: 目標用來對抗唬騙檢定的察言觀色檢定、以及對抗目標時的交涉和威嚇檢定DC均會受到催眠注視的減值。

Sustained Inspirational Expertise.name: Sustained Inspirational Expertise（Sustained Inspirational Expertise）
Sustained Inspirational Expertise.description:
When granting a bonus to allies via the inspirational expertise investigator talent (Pathfinder RPG Advanced Class Guide 33), the investigator can spend one use of inspiration as a swift action the following round to extend the duration of the granted bonus for 1 additional round. The insight bonus granted decreases by 1 each round this ability is used.

  The investigator must be at least 11th level and have the inspirational expertise talent to select this talent.

Swallow Reversal.name: Swallow Reversal（Swallow Reversal）
Swallow Reversal.description:
This technique, a creation of a legendary Minkaian duelist, mimics the movement of a bird in flight to pierce an opponent’s defenses. As an attack action, the slayer can make a single melee attack against his studied target at his highest base attack bonus. When attempting a swallow reversal, the slayer rolls two attack rolls and uses the highest result. If the attack is a critical threat, the slayer attempts to confirm the critical hit as normal.

  The slayer can use swallow reversal at will, but it can only be used against a given target once per day.

Swallow Whole (3 pts).name: Swallow Whole (3 pts)（Swallow Whole (3 pts)）
Swallow Whole (3 pts).description:
An eidolon gains the swallow whole ability, giving it the ability to consume its foes. If the eidolon begins its turn with a creature grappled using its bite attack (see the grab evolution), it can attempt a combat maneuver check to swallow the creature. The creature can be up to one size category smaller than the eidolon. Swallowed creatures take damage equal to the eidolon's bite damage each round plus 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage. A swallowed creature keeps the grappled condition, but can attempt to cut its way free with a light slashing or piercing weapon. The amount of damage needed to cut free is equal to 1/10 the eidolon's total hit points. The eidolon's AC against these attacks is equal to 10 + 1/2 its natural armor bonus. If a swallowed creature cuts its way out, the eidolon loses this ability until it heals this damage. Alternatively, the swallowed creature can attempt to escape the grapple as normal. Success indicates that it has returned to the eidolon's mouth, where it can attempt to escape or be swallowed again.

  The eidolon must possess the grab evolution, tied to a bite attack, to take this evolution.

  The summoner must be at least 9th level before selecting this evolution.

Swallow Whole (UC) (3 pts).name: Swallow Whole (UC) (3 pts)（Swallow Whole (UC) (3 pts)）
Swallow Whole (UC) (3 pts).description:
Requirements: Summoner level 9th; agathion, daemon, demon, devil, div, elemental, protean, or psychopomp subtype; grab (bite) evolution.

  The eidolon gains the swallow whole ability, giving it the ability to consume its foes. If the eidolon begins its turn with a creature grappled using its bite attack (see the grab evolution), it can attempt a combat maneuver check to swallow the creature. The creature must be at least one size category smaller than the eidolon. Swallowed creatures take an amount of bludgeoning damage equal to the eidolon閳ユ獨 bite damage each round + 1d6 points of damage. A swallowed creature keeps the grappled condition, but can attempt to cut its way free with a light piercing or slashing weapon. The amount of damage needed to cut free is equal to 1/10 the eidolon閳ユ獨 total hit points. The eidolon閳ユ獨 AC against these attacks is equal to 10 + 1/2 its natural armor bonus. If a swallowed creature cuts its way out, the eidolon loses this ability until it heals this damage.

  Alternatively, the swallowed creature can attempt to escape the grapple as normal. Success indicates that it has returned to the eidolon閳ユ獨 mouth, where it can attempt to escape or can be swallowed again.

Swamp Concoctions.name: Swamp Concoctions（Swamp Concoctions）
Swamp Concoctions.description:
Twice per day as a full-round action, the vigilante can use the environment weapon vigilante talent to improvise an alchemical weapon worth no more than 15 gp per vigilante level. This improvised weapon cannot be sold and must be used within 3 rounds before it becomes inert. The vigilante gains the benefits of the Throw Anything feat for the purpose of these improvised weapons. This ability cannot create improvised weapons that incorporate special materials unless those materials are also present.

  To select this talent, the vigilante must have the environment weapon vigilante feat, and he must have selected jungle, swamp, or water for that talent.

Swamp's Grasp.name: Swamp's Grasp（Swamp's Grasp）
Swamp's Grasp.description:
The witch can cause an area to become an entangling quagmire. One 10-foot square per witch level within 90 feet becomes difficult terrain for a number of rounds equal to 3 + the witch閳ユ獨 Intelligence modifier.

  If the witch uses this hex again before the duration of the previous use has expired, the effects of the previous use of this hex end immediately.

Swarming Attack.name: Swarming Attack（Swarming Attack）
Swarming Attack.description: Ratfolk ninjas use their large numbers to overwhelm their enemies with countless attacks. While using the swarming racial trait to share a space with an ally, a ninja with this talent gains a bonus on damage roles equal to the number of sneak attack dice her ally has. For example, a ninja would gain +3 damage if her ally has sneak attack 3d6.

Sweeping Impact.name: Sweeping Impact（Sweeping Impact）
Sweeping Impact.description:
You can shake the earth and buffet foes with the roaring force of wind you draw from the Elemental Plane of Air. When performing a bull rush as part of a charge, if you push the target at least 5 feet, you can attempt a trip combat maneuver against that creature as a free action. You are not tripped if you fail this check by 10 or more.

  At 7th level, you can bull rush or trip creatures two size categories larger than you; for every 4 levels you gain beyond 7th, you can bull rush or trip creatures an additional size category larger.

Sweeping Strike.name: Sweeping Strike（Sweeping Strike）
Sweeping Strike.description:
The vigilante gains @Compendium[pf1.feats.Zeq6RWYv5otvg8q7]{順勢斬} as a bonus feat.

  At 6th level, he gains @Compendium[pf1.feats.6HSMdwX1VS6nZ6Zf]{大順勢斬} as a bonus feat. He does not need to meet the prerequisites for these feats.

  At 12th level, while using Great Cleave, he no longer has to hit a target in order to make an additional attack against a foe that is adjacent to that target.

  Only an avenger vigilante can select this talent.

Swift Poisoner.name: Swift Poisoner（Swift Poisoner）
Swift Poisoner.description: A ninja with this trick can apply a dose of poison to a weapon as a swift action.

Swift Tracker (RNG).name: Swift Tracker (RNG)（Swift Tracker (RNG)）
Swift Tracker (RNG).description: Beginning at 8th level, a ranger can move at his normal speed while using Survival to follow tracks without taking the normal –5 penalty. He takes only a –10 penalty (instead of the normal –20) when moving at up to twice normal speed while tracking.

Swift Tracker (ROG).name: Swift Tracker (ROG)（Swift Tracker (ROG)）
Swift Tracker (ROG).description: While following tracks, the rogue can move at her normal speed without penalty while using the Survival skill. In addition, the penalty for moving at up to twice her normal speed while following tracks is reduced to –10.

Swim (1 pt).name: Swim (1 pt)（Swim (1 pt)）
Swim (1 pt).description:
An eidolon gains webbed hands, feet, or powerful flippers, giving it a swim speed equal to its base speed. This evolution does not give the eidolon the ability to breathe underwater.

  This evolution can be selected more than once. Each additional time it is selected, increase the eidolon's swim speed by 20 feet.

Swim (UC) (1 pt).name: Swim (UC) (1 pt)（Swim (UC) (1 pt)）
Swim (UC) (1 pt).description:
The eidolon gains webbed hands, webbed feet, or powerful flippers, giving it a swim speed equal to its base speed. This evolution does not give the eidolon the ability to breathe underwater.

  This evolution can be selected more than once. Each additional time it is selected, increase the eidolon閳ユ獨 swim speed by 20 feet.

Swine.name: Swine（Swine）
Swine.description:
The witch can partially transform an enemy into a pig. The effects of the transformation are mostly cosmetic and do not change the creature閳ユ獨 size category or overall shape, but the affected creature takes a 閳? penalty on Will saving throws for a number of rounds equal to the witch閳ユ獨 Intelligence modifier (Will negates).

  At 8th level, the affected creature閳ユ獨 hands (or paws) turn into hooves, preventing it from using claw attacks or taking any action that would require the creature to use its fingers.

Sworn Oathkeeper.name: Sworn Oathkeeper（Sworn Oathkeeper）
Sworn Oathkeeper.description: At 15th level, the cavalier can formally witness an oath or agreement between two creatures. If either creature breaks or reneges on the agreement and the cavalier becomes aware of this, he gains the bonuses from his seek retribution ability against that creature at all times. This ability ends when the creature fulfills the conditions of the oath or receives just punishment for breaking the oath. The maximum number of witnessed oaths cavalier can have active at a time is equal to his Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

Symbiosis Discipline.name: Symbiosis Discipline（Symbiosis Discipline）
Symbiosis Discipline.description:
Like pollen on the wind or the roots of plants in the ground, your thoughts permeate your surroundings, allowing you to study and manipulate the world around you.

精神力池屬性 魅力

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.zkvylzsupqboef0z]{動物無視術} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.yyzf346hiq8ixt0u]{動物定身術} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.io2yjhr42chvcfb4]{支配動物} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wi9uvm8p12qvq616]{命令植物} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.h9qiwo9kx8d1hqrn]{啟蒙術} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ed0epy1pofukpgm6]{橡樹守衛} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.glt6uk3n6g6l2p6l]{高等探知} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.szzwom7utm3sm15z]{操控植物} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.66s5qm8kwycgobce]{支配怪物} (18th).

Synaptic Infusion.name: Synaptic Infusion（Synaptic Infusion）
Synaptic Infusion.description:
Element air; Type substance infusion; Level 3; Burn 2
Associated Blasts electric, charged water, thunderstorm
Saving Throw Will negates

  Your blast sends strange electric signals through the target閳ユ獨 body, scrambling its synapses and causing it to become staggered for 1 round. The target is aware it can choose to take a move action to remove the staggered condition inflicted by this infusion. This infusion is a mind-affecting effect.

Synaptic Shock.name: 思維震撼（Synaptic Shock）
Synaptic Shock.description: 異能者使用殘暴的力量影響一名敵人的精神，在聯結法術生效前便對敵人造成了精神創傷。在施放影響心靈（mind-affecting）的聯結法術時，她能夠從精神力池中花費1點精神力從法術的目標中選擇一個。若這個目標受到聯結法術的影響，那麼該目標會在法術持續時間結束後困惑（Confused）1輪；如果法術的持續時間為立即（instantaneous）的話，便會即刻生效。若目標成功通過對抗聯結法術的豁免檢定，那麼它會立即困惑1輪作為替代。異能者每從自己的精神力池中額外花費1點精神力，她就可以讓額外一名聯結法術的目標陷入困惑。這項精神增幅僅能聯結到能夠影響多個目標或者影響一片區域的影響心靈法術上。除非聯結法術可以影響目標生物，否則該能力對免疫影響心靈效果的生物無效。舉例說明，通過雙重增幅來同時使用思維震撼和死之意志這兩個精神增幅，可以讓思維震撼對不死生物生效。

Synergistic Touch.name: Synergistic Touch（Synergistic Touch）
Synergistic Touch.description:
You can touch a creature as a standard action to confer upon it the benefits of any one Teamwork feat that you possess. This effect persists for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum 1). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Calming Touch power of the Community Domain.

Synergized Energy.name: 能量同調（Synergized Energy）
Synergized Energy.description: 當你使用電池（科技指南 39），發電機，或者是使用在異能科技-異能電池中的能力來為任何科技裝備充能的時候，你可以回覆一點精神力池。你每天通過這種方式回覆的精神力池的最大值等於你的感知調整值。

Syringe Stirge.name: Syringe Stirge（Syringe Stirge）
Syringe Stirge.description:
As a full-round action, you can expend two daily uses of bombs to create a syringe stirge, a tiny construct primed with a bomb (if you have multiple types of bombs, you must select which type the syringe stirge carries when created). Undirected, they take no actions except to flock around you in your square and follow you as best they can. They can be attacked normally, but gain cover while occupying your square. As a swift action, you can order one of your syringe stirges to attack an enemy it can see. Once ordered to attack that enemy, the syringe stirge will continue to attack every round, attempting to attach and deliver its payload.

A syringe stirge has all of the statistics of a stirge but lacks the blood drain ability. If it ends its turn attached to an opponent, it injects your bomb into the opponent閳ユ獨 bloodstream, dealing damage as a direct hit plus the alchemist閳ユ獨 Intelligence modifier (as the @Compendium[pf1.feats.gGfXQq0IZrxdcZDx]{隨手投擲} feat閳ユ敄his injection is a direct attack and doesn閳ユ獩 deal splash damage. A syringe stirge dies immediately after injecting its bomb. A syringe stirge lasts for 1 minute per alchemist level or until destroyed; if it has not attached to an enemy before the end of its life span it and its bomb payload fall inert. An alchemist must be at least 6th level before selecting this discovery.

Taboo.name: 禁忌（Taboo）
Taboo.description: 在2級時，通靈者可以在每日執行降靈時選擇接受英靈提出的一項禁忌以取悅它們。每一個英靈都有自己所要求的禁忌，GM也可以設計自己的禁忌。如果接受禁忌，通靈者可以每天發動兩次靈力奔湧能力而不承受任何共鳴增長。通靈者每次只能選擇遵守一項禁忌。不過，通靈者並不會被任何規則限制他去打破禁忌，然而一旦他這麼做了，通靈者就會在攻擊，傷害，豁免，屬性與技能檢定上承受-2減值，持續1小時，且英靈對他產生1點共鳴；如果通靈者繼續打破禁忌，這些數值懲罰的持續時間會延長，但英靈不會繼續對他造成額外共鳴。如果通靈者因為打破禁忌而使得自己與英靈的共鳴達到5點時英靈會拋棄通靈者的身軀，直到他下次降靈以前通靈者將失去英靈之力，英靈提供的加值和靈力奔湧能力。除此之外，這種行為還會損害英靈與通靈者的關係，在接下來的一週內隸屬該職階的英靈不會回應通靈者的召喚。並且下一次通靈者降靈此職階的英靈時，他承受2點而非1點共鳴。

Tail (1 pt).name: Tail (1 pt)（Tail (1 pt)）
Tail (1 pt).description:
An eidolon grows a long, powerful tail. This grants it a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks made to balance on a surface.

  This evolution can be selected more than once.

Tail (UC) (1 pt).name: Tail (UC) (1 pt)（Tail (UC) (1 pt)）
Tail (UC) (1 pt).description:
Requirements: Agathion, daemon, demon, devil, div, elemental, protean, or psychopomp subtype.

  The eidolon grows a long, powerful tail. This grants it a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks to balance on a surface.

  This evolution can be selected more than once.

Tail Slap (1 pt).name: Tail Slap (1 pt)（Tail Slap (1 pt)）
Tail Slap (1 pt).description:
An eidolon can use its tail to bash nearby foes, granting it a tail slap attack. This attack is a secondary attack. The tail slap deals 1d6 points of damage (1d8 if Large, 2d6 if Huge). The eidolon must possess the tail evolution to take this evolution.

  This evolution can be selected more than once, but the eidolon must possess an equal number of the tail evolution.

Tail Slap (UC) (1 pt).name: Tail Slap (UC) (1 pt)（Tail Slap (UC) (1 pt)）
Tail Slap (UC) (1 pt).description:
Requirements: Agathion, daemon, demon, devil, div, elemental, protean, or psychopomp subtype; tail evolution.

  The eidolon can use its tail to bash nearby foes, granting it a tail slap attack. This attack is a secondary attack. The tail slap deals 1d6 points of damage (1d8 if Large, 2d6 if Huge).

  This evolution can be selected more than once, up to the number of tail evolutions the eidolon possesses.

Tail Swipe.name: Tail Swipe（Tail Swipe）
Tail Swipe.description:
You express your wrath through sweeps of a wicked tail. You can grow a scaly tail. This tail can be used only to make attacks of opportunity, but it allows you to make one additional attack of opportunity each round. This tail attack deals an amount of bludgeoning damage equal to 1d8 (1d6 if you are Small) + your Strength modifier.

  At 10th level, you can attempt a free trip combat maneuver check against any creature damaged by your tail attack. This does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

Tainted Infusion.name: Tainted Infusion（Tainted Infusion）
Tainted Infusion.description:
The alchemist can mask murder behind beneficence. When preparing an extract with the infusion discovery, he can lace the extract with one of his bombs as long as the extract has a duration greater than instantaneous. If he chooses, the alchemist can reduce the duration of the extract to 1 round. As soon as the extract閳ユ獨 duration expires, it detonates, dealing 150% of the alchemist閳ユ獨 bomb damage to the drinker. This effect does not produce a splash radius. Producing a tainted extract consumes both an infusion slot and a daily bomb use.

  An alchemist must know both the delayed bomb and infusion discoveries to select this discovery.

Take 'em Alive.name: Take 'em Alive（Take 'em Alive）
Take 'em Alive.description:
The vigilante doesn閳ユ獩 take the usual -4 penalty on attack rolls made to deal nonlethal damage with weapons that normally deal lethal damage. In addition, the vigilante gains a +1 bonus on all attack and damage rolls for attacks that deal only nonlethal damage and have no secondary effects (such as poison).

  This bonus increases by 1 at 5th level and every 3 levels thereafter, to a maximum of +5 at 20th level.

Talons of the Dragon.name: Talons of the Dragon（Talons of the Dragon）
Talons of the Dragon.description:
You fight with the fearsome talons of dragonkind. You can grow claws as a free action. These claws are treated as natural weapons, allowing you to perform two claw attacks as a full attack action using your full base attack bonus. Each of these attacks deals an amount of slashing damage equal to 1d4 (1d3 if you are Small) + your Strength modifier.

  At 5th level, these claws are considered magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming DR.

  At 7th level, the damage die increases by 1 step, to deal an amount of slashing damage equal to 1d6 (1d4 if you are Small) + your Strength modifier.

  At 11th level, these claws deal an additional 1d6 points of damage of your chosen energy type on a successful hit.

  You can use your claws for a number of rounds per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. These rounds do not need to be consecutive.

Teaching Moment.name: Teaching Moment（Teaching Moment）
Teaching Moment.description:
At 8th level, when you or an ally within 30 feet rolls a natural 1 or a natural 20 on an attack roll, an ability check, a skill check, or a saving throw, as an immediate action you can grant all allies within 30 feet special insights that help them overcome similar challenges. Once during the next minute, each affected creature can choose to roll twice and take the better result before attempting an attack roll, ability check, skill check, or saving throw. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and one additional time per day for every 4 cleric levels beyond 8th.

  This power replaces the Unity power of the Community Domain or the Remote Viewing power of the Knowledge Domain.

Team Player.name: 好隊友（Team Player）
Team Player.description: 在5級和13級時，你能夠獲得一個獎勵團隊專長（bonus teamwork feat）。

Teamwork Mastery.name: Teamwork Mastery（Teamwork Mastery）
Teamwork Mastery.description:
You are an immaculate team player and can distribute your team-based insights to your allies with a touch. This revelation grants you a bonus teamwork feat. You must meet the teamwork feat閳ユ獨 prerequisites, if any. Additionally, you can touch an ally as a standard action to confer upon it the benefits of any one teamwork feat that you have. This effect persists for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your oracle level (minimum 1).

  You can confer the benefits of a teamwork feat you have a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier.

Teamwork Tricks.name: Teamwork Tricks（Teamwork Tricks）
Teamwork Tricks.description: At 8th level as a free action, the cavalier can use control the herd to handle allied and riderless animals and animal companions. Friendly and helpful animals that the cavalier commands with Handle Animal or his control the herd ability are considered to know any tasks or tricks the cavalier閳ユ獨 mount knows, in addition to any tasks or tricks they already know.

Telekinetic Boomerang Infusion.name: Telekinetic Boomerang Infusion（Telekinetic Boomerang Infusion）
Telekinetic Boomerang Infusion.description:
Element aether; Type form infusion; Level 1; Burn 1
Associated Blasts telekinetic
Saving Throw none

  This functions as telekinetic blast, except you maintain an elastic strand of aether attached to the object you throw. This allows you to pull it back to you after the attack and catch it if you have enough free hands (and assuming it is small enough for you to carry). This prevents the object from taking damage, but it also prevents you from loosening the strands of aether (see telekinetic blast).

  Alternatively, if the attack missed, on your next turn as a standard action, you can you can snap the elastic strand back to make another attack with the same substance infusion and metakinesis, as if using a normal telekinetic blast (at which point the object takes damage and doesn閳ユ獩 return to you, and you can閳ユ獩 try again).

Telekinetic Deflection.name: 念動偏轉（Telekinetic Deflection）
Telekinetic Deflection.description:
元素：以太；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：8；超載：0

  你能夠偏轉敵人的攻擊，就如同法術偏轉術（Deflection；APG）一般，不過持續時間只有1輪。你能夠承受1點超載，來使得持續時間增加至每個你具有的操念使等級1輪。

Telekinetic Finesse.name: 精密念動（Telekinetic Finesse）
Telekinetic Finesse.description:
元素：以太；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：1；超載：0

  你能夠在近距（close range）執行任意種類的精密操作，這包括嘗試巧手和解除裝置檢定。

Telekinetic Globe.name: 念動法球（Telekinetic Globe）
Telekinetic Globe.description:
元素：以太；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：8；超載：0

  前置：力場屏障（force barrier），力場結界（force ward）

  你能夠創造出力場球體，就如同靈動法球（Telekinetic Sphere）法術一般，只要你以標準動作維持專注，它就會一直持續下去，而且你可以以移動動作移動球體。你能夠承受1點超載來將持續時間增加至每等級1分鐘，而且不再需要進行專注來維持法球。

Telekinetic Haul.name: 念動牽引（Telekinetic Haul）
Telekinetic Haul.description:
元素：以太；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：2；超載：0

  前置：基礎心靈念力（basic telekinesis）

  當你使用基礎心靈念力時，你能夠移動一件重量不超過每個操念使等級100磅的物體。當你使用念動（telekinetic blast）時，可以投擲重量至多為每個操念使等級100磅的物體，但是這並不會增加傷害。若你承受1點超載，物體的重量上限會提升至每個操念使等級1000磅，持續時間會增加至每個操念使等級1分鐘。

Telekinetic Invisibility.name: 念動遁形（Telekinetic Invisibility）
Telekinetic Invisibility.description:
元素：以太；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：3；超載：0

  你編織著以太，偏折光線的同時抑制著聲音；該效果的功能如同隱形術（invisibility）一般，不過以太扭曲的視覺效果比普通的隱形更易於察覺，因此你在潛行檢定中獲得的加值減半（移動時+10點，靜止不動時+20點）。然而，對聲音的壓制使得你不會被基於聲音的盲感（blindsense）和盲視（blindsight）自動察覺到，但是這個原力也不會在你使用潛行檢定對抗具有此類能力的生物時提供加值。

Telekinetic Maneuvers.name: 念動戰技（Telekinetic Maneuvers）
Telekinetic Maneuvers.description:
元素：以太；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：4；超載：0

  豁免：無；法術抗力：可

  你能夠以心靈念力執行戰技，但是你會使用體質調整值來判斷戰技加值（Combat Maneuver Bonus），而非使用你的智力或魅力調整值。若你具有精密念動（telekinetic finesse）原力，則可以將陰招（dirty trick）和盜取（steal）戰技加到你能夠執行的戰技列表中；當你執行這些戰技時，使用敏捷調整值來判斷戰技加值，而非使用體質調整值。

Telekinetic Mastery.name: 念控大師（Telekinetic Mastery）
Telekinetic Mastery.description: 以一個標準動作，你消耗1點心智點讓你獲得念控能力。該能力如同心靈遙控法術，但你無需保持專注來維持效果，並且使用任何一效果都是一個標準動作。該能力持續每秘學士等級1輪。你必須至少9級才能選擇該靈器之力。

Telempathic Restoration.name: 心念復原（Telempathic Restoration）
Telempathic Restoration.description: 當異能者施放心靈聯結時，他可以支付1點精神力解除聯結對像正遭受的暈眩，驚懼，恐慌，顫慄或震懾狀態，這些狀態會按照剩餘的時間立即轉移到異能者身上。

Telepathic Bond.name: 心靈連線（Telepathic Bond）
Telepathic Bond.description: 9級起，異能者能夠以類法術能力每日使用一次心靈連線（Telepathic Bond），使用她的異能者等級作為她的施法者等級。異能者不能將自身排除在以此方式建立的心靈連線之外。她還能夠花費任意一個未使用的4級或更高等級的法術位來施放心靈連線。使用更高等級的法術位來施放心靈連線不會為異能者提供更多的好處，但是她可以以此方式應用會提升法術等級的超魔專長。舉例說明：若異能者擁有法術延時（Extend Spell），那麼她可以以整輪動作來使用5級法術位施放延時心靈連線。當已經知曉心靈連線的異能者獲得該能力時，她能夠習得一個不同的4級法術取代心靈連線，失去原本的法術並更換為新的法術。

Telepathic Link.name: Telepathic Link（Telepathic Link）
Telepathic Link.description:
The subject can communicate telepathically with the mesmerist during a crisis. The mesmerist can trigger this trick when the subject and her allies are outnumbered in combat. For 1 minute per mesmerist level, the subject and the mesmerist can communicate telepathically. If the subject and the mesmerist are more than a medium distance (100 feet + 10 feet per level) apart, the telepathic connection is severed and cannot be regained unless the trick is implanted again.

  The mesmerist and the subject must share a language to be able to communicate.

Telepathic Targeting.name: 心念尋的（Telepathic Targeting）
Telepathic Targeting.description: 支付2點精神力，異能者可以將聯結法術的目標指定為正與他進行心靈感應通信中的任意生物（不管是異能者的心靈聯結法術效應或者是其他的能力造成的心靈感應），即使目標超出正常的施法距離。該聯結法術必須擁有影響心靈描述符且施法距離為接觸或更遠。

Tengu Blade Lore.name: Tengu Blade Lore（Tengu Blade Lore）
Tengu Blade Lore.description:
Element universal; Type utility (Su); Level 1; Burn 0
Prerequisite tengu

  Whenever you use kinetic blade or an infusion that lists kinetic blade as a prerequisite, the weapon you create counts as having one of the following weapon special features of your choice: blocking, brace, deadly, disarm, distracting, sunder, or trip.

Tentacle (1 pt).name: Tentacle (1 pt)（Tentacle (1 pt)）
Tentacle (1 pt).description: An eidolon possesses a long, sinuous tentacle, granting it a tentacle attack. This attack is a secondary attack. The tentacle attack deals 1d4 points of damage (1d6 if Large, 1d8 if Huge). This evolution can be selected more than once.

Tentacle (UC) (1 pt).name: Tentacle (UC) (1 pt)（Tentacle (UC) (1 pt)）
Tentacle (UC) (1 pt).description:
Requirements: Daemon, demon, or protean subtype.

  The eidolon possesses a long, sinuous tentacle, granting it a tentacle attack. This attack is a secondary attack. The tentacle attack deals 1d4 points of damage (1d6 if Large, 1d8 if Huge).

  This evolution can be selected more than once.

Tentacle Mass (UC) (1 pt).name: Tentacle Mass (UC) (1 pt)（Tentacle Mass (UC) (1 pt)）
Tentacle Mass (UC) (1 pt).description:
Requirements: Aberrant subtype.

  The eidolon grows a thick mass of tentacles that can be used as a primary natural weapon. The tentacles deal 1d8 points of damage if the eidolon is Medium. Eidolons with the grab evolution that is linked to a tentacle mass can use that ability to grapple foes of up to the eidolon閳ユ獨 size, and they can also use this evolution in place of the serpentine base form to qualify for the constrict evolution.

Terminal Aura.name: Terminal Aura（Terminal Aura）
Terminal Aura.description:
You gain an aura with a 10-foot radius; any creature within that has fewer than 0 hit points but is stable must succeed at a Will save or be affected by the spell @Compendium[pf1.spells.n390v9tbwxya1tz4]{出血術}. A dying creature within range of this aura does not receive a Constitution check to stabilize unless it succeeds at a Will save, but it can still be healed as normal. A creature with fast healing or regeneration must also succeed at a Will save every round or that ability does not function for 1 round. You can suppress and resume this aura as a free action.

  You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

The Stars are Right.name: The Stars are Right（The Stars are Right）
The Stars are Right.description:
If you prepare your cleric spells while the stars are visible to you, you may spontaneously cast any of your Stars subdomain domain spells by swapping out a spell of an equal spell level. Any Stars subdomain spells that you cast while the stars are visible to you heal you of damage equal to the spell閳ユ獨 level as you cast the spell.

  This power replaces the Part the Veil power of the Void Domain.

The Unseen World.name: The Unseen World（The Unseen World）
The Unseen World.description: At 1st level, you gain @Compendium[pf1.spells.uqh87jz757r2cb7r]{偵測魔法} and @Compendium[pf1.spells.j0bc0iii8zp1jiwr]{閱讀魔法} as spells known. At 5th level, the phoenix閳ユ獨 blood drives you to find and save lost knowledge and magical items. As a swift action, you can automatically identify the properties of a non-cursed magic item you hold; you must still identify a cursed item as normal to correctly identify it as cursed. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier per day.

The Whole Time.name: The Whole Time（The Whole Time）
The Whole Time.description:
Mercenaries in the employ of the Aspis Consortium often use wands of @Compendium[pf1.spells.oylikodnyku2zewu]{隱形術} to attack protected targets, then blend into the crowd to escape or disguise the source of the next attack. A rogue with this ability is practiced at attacking from magical concealment. He can use spell-trigger and spellcompletion items as if the following spells were on a spell list to which he has access: @Compendium[pf1.spells.cxgi0ub77t6aink1]{高等隱形}, @Compendium[pf1.spells.oylikodnyku2zewu]{隱形術}, and @Compendium[pf1.spells.c11olzqztodz5o5x]{漸隱術}.

Additionally, if the rogue becomes visible as a result of a weapon or spell attack, he can sheathe his weapon as a free action and instantly adopt a neutral posture. With a successful Bluff or Disguise check (opposed by witnesses閳?Sense Motive or Perception checks, whichever is higher), there is no obvious sign that the rogue is the source of the attack (though a lack of any other reasonable candidate can still lead observers to draw the correct conclusion).

Thirst Subdomain.name: Thirst Subdomain（Thirst Subdomain）
Thirst Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ds011sdiv3d8c86w]{Cup Of Dust}
  • 9環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.e8zen5nzixnt7bde]{凋死術}

Thorn Flesh.name: Thorn Flesh（Thorn Flesh）
Thorn Flesh.description:
Element wood; Type utility (Sp); Level 3; Burn 1
Prerequisite flesh of wood

  You cover your body in barbed thorns that injure foes who strike you. This functions as the jagged flesh wild talent.

Thorns Patron.name: Thorns Patron（Thorns Patron）
Thorns Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.6vx3lvbhp6h220wq]{Thorn Javelin}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.5zrqn8bj3jxm05pl]{狂怒}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.b433azw2m5ov8pkq]{Thorny Entanglement}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.818uuekrao87o57u]{荊刺之軀}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.nqfoy30smshc3c6w]{棘牆術}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.z1j8oc2291czpinh]{劍刃護壁}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.5w1zrztwbvd6xkgj]{排斥術}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.96wkex2umgqrjwr4]{法師之劍}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.9fd7mcoint902oyb]{樹界降誕}

Thorns Subdomainf.name: Thorns Subdomainf（Thorns Subdomainf）
Thorns Subdomainf.description:
Replacement 領域法術:

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.6vx3lvbhp6h220wq]{Thorn Javelin}
  • 3rd閳?@Compendium[pf1.spells.b433azw2m5ov8pkq]{Thorny Entanglement}
  • 4環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.818uuekrao87o57u]{荊刺之軀}

Thorny Bomb.name: Thorny Bomb（Thorny Bomb）
Thorny Bomb.description: When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it deal piercing damage. Thorny bombs count as magic weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Threatening Coordination Hex.name: Threatening Coordination Hex（Threatening Coordination Hex）
Threatening Coordination Hex.description:
The shaman causes a creature within 30 feet to view the shaman閳ユ獨 allies as obstacles. The target treats squares adjacent to the shaman閳ユ獨 allies as difficult terrain for a number of rounds equal to the shaman閳ユ獨 level, or for 1 round if the target succeeds at a Will saving throw.

  Whether or not the save is successful, a creature affected by this hex cannot be the target of it again for 24 hours.

Threefold Casting.name: Threefold Casting（Threefold Casting）
Threefold Casting.description:
While you cannot join a true witch閳ユ獨 coven, you are nonetheless skilled at casting magic in conjunction with others. You gain a +2 insight bonus on skill checks for ritual magic in which you have at least two secondary casters.

  In addition, whenever you are within 30 feet of another hag, psychic, or witch, you can use the aid another action to grant a +1 bonus to the other spellcaster閳ユ獨 caster level for 1 round.

Thrill of the Chase.name: Thrill of the Chase（Thrill of the Chase）
Thrill of the Chase.description: The rogue revels in the thrill and adrenaline rush of a challenging chase. When engaged in a chase (Pathfinder RPG GameMastery Guide 232) or pursuit (Ultimate Intrigue 142), the rogue gains one d20 reroll which she can use at any time after the original roll is made but before the results of the roll are revealed; she must take the second result, even if it is lower. She can use this reroll once per chase or once per day during a pursuit. Additionally, she gains Run as a bonus feat.

Throat Crush (UC).name: Throat Crush (UC)（Throat Crush (UC)）
Throat Crush (UC).description: The monk gives a sharp blow to a foe閳ユ獨 throat, hampering its ability to speak for 1 round as if it had the caster croak spellblight. Creatures without a discernible throat, or with multiple vocal organs, are unaffected (subject to GM discretion).

Throat Jab.name: Throat Jab（Throat Jab）
Throat Jab.description:
The vigilante閳ユ獨 hidden strike jabs his opponent in the throat, preventing that opponent from speaking until the vigilante閳ユ獨 next turn. (If the vigilante uses this ability on the surprise round, it lasts until the end of his first full turn after the surprise round.) This prevents the target from calling out for help, using spells with verbal components, or doing anything else that requires speaking. The target cannot be affected by that vigilante閳ユ獨 throat jab again for 24 hours.

  Only a stalker vigilante of at least 4th level can select this talent.

Thunder Foot.name: Thunder Foot（Thunder Foot）
Thunder Foot.description:
The shaman閳ユ獨 body thickens and becomes more muscular. For the purpose of the overrun combat maneuver, she treats her shaman level as her base attack bonus when calculating her CMB and CMD.

  At 7th level, the shaman gains @Compendium[pf1.feats.go4xOiSUP8R1QJ5N]{精通闖越} as a bonus feat.

  At 11th level, the shaman gains @Compendium[pf1.feats.tkWfEP1fD7CZt8Kw]{高等闖越} as a bonus feat.

  The shaman doesn閳ユ獩 need to meet the prerequisites of these feats.

Thundering Infusion.name: 雷鳴注能（Thundering Infusion）
Thundering Infusion.description:
元素：氣；類別：性質注能；等級：1；超載：1

  關聯念襲類別：電刺，風雷擊

  豁免：強韌，通過則無效

  你的閃電會帶來隆隆雷響。每當你的念襲命中敵人，而且克服了法術抗力的話，該名敵人會變得耳聾（deafened），即便念襲並未造成傷害也是如此。

Tidal Wave.name: 海嘯（Tidal Wave）
Tidal Wave.description:
元素：水；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：9；超載：1

  你呼喚出強大的海嘯，如同津波（Tsunami；APG）法術一般。

Tiger Aspect.name: 老虎擬態（Tiger Aspect）
Tiger Aspect.description:
老虎是強大但優雅的野生獵手，悄悄地跟蹤它的獵物，然後用無情的效率拿下對方。

  次級形態：你的敏捷獲得+2增強加值。8級時，這個加值提升至+4。15級時，這個加值提升至+6。

  專攻形態：你變身為一隻兇暴虎（怪物圖鑑 pg. 265）。當處於該形態時，你獲得40尺基礎速度、昏暗視覺、靈敏嗅覺（30尺）、附帶攫抓能力的2d6傷害的齧咬攻擊、2個附帶攫抓能力的2d4傷害的爪抓攻擊和猛撲能力。8級時，你的隱匿檢定獲得+4種族加值。15級時，你的可以用你的後爪攻擊（back claw）發動耙抓攻擊（造成等同你的爪抓攻擊的額外傷害）。

Tiger's Claws.name: Tiger's Claws（Tiger's Claws）
Tiger's Claws.description:
The vigilante gains the ability to grow claws similar to a shifter閳ユ獨. These claws are natural weapons that can be extended at will and deal 1d4 points of piercing and slashing damage (1d3 if the vigilante is Small).

  At 11th level, the damage increases to 1d6 (1d4 if Small).

Time Seer.name: Time Seer（Time Seer）
Time Seer.description:
You can peer through the mists of time to see things as they truly are, as if using the @Compendium[pf1.spells.jbqo4o2b2tmdz7wv]{真知術} spell.

  At 15th level, this functions like @Compendium[pf1.spells.2vb5orfcy57lrfmc]{片刻預知}.

  At 18th level, this functions like @Compendium[pf1.spells.vl7yer8k1leyuxld]{預警術}.

  You can use this ability for a number of minutes per day equal to your oracle level, but these minutes do not need to be consecutive.

  You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

Timeless Soul.name: Timeless Soul（Timeless Soul）
Timeless Soul.description: At 20th level, the silver skies and conduits of the Astral Plane are permanently connected to you. You become immune to the retroactive aging side effects incurred when leaving a plane with the timeless planar trait. You do not gain negative levels when slain on the Astral Plane while using @Compendium[pf1.spells.lnahlmp5mih2ongh]{星界投射}, and any effect that would sever your silver cord instead returns you to your physical body if you succeed at a Will save (DC = 10 + the CR of the creature or caster level of the effect that severed the cord). In addition, when applying the @Compendium[pf1.feats.wFoLrh5FeeqBXsQ8]{法術瞬發} metamagic feat to a spell, it uses up a spell slot only 3 levels higher than the spell閳ユ獨 actual level. This ability does not stack with other abilities that would reduce the spell閳ユ獨 final adjusted level.

Timidity (Stare).name: 膽怯（Timidity (Stare)）
Timidity (Stare).description: 催眠注視的減值還能應用至傷害檢定上。

Tongues Hex.name: Tongues Hex（Tongues Hex）
Tongues Hex.description:
A witch with this hex can understand any spoken language for a number of minutes per day equal to her level, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.jcs7ba5depdyitey]{通曉語言}. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments.

  At 5th level, a witch can use this ability to speak any language, as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.m1rmcpcaixcpz9ib]{巧言術}.

Torag's Boon.name: Torag's Boon（Torag's Boon）
Torag's Boon.description:
As a standard action, you can call upon Torag閳ユ獨 protection to form a shield around you that blocks incoming attacks for a number of minutes equal to 1/2 your oracle level (minimum 1). The shield grants a +4 deflection bonus to your Armor Class.

  At 7th level, and again at 11th level and 15th level, this bonus increases by +1.

  At 19th level, the shield also grants you DR 2/chaos. The shield閳ユ獨 duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments.

Torch Touch.name: Torch Touch（Torch Touch）
Torch Touch.description:
As a move action, you can alter the amount of light shed by any nonmagical light source within 60 feet so that its light radius is either halved or doubled.

  At 1st level, you can affect light sources up to the size of a torch.

  At 7th level, you can affect any Medium or smaller nonmagical light source (such as a campfire).

  At 14th level, you can affect Large or smaller nonmagical light sources (such as bonfires) and magical light sources up to the size of an everburning torch. If a creature is holding the light source you are trying to affect, the creature can attempt a Reflex save to avoid the effect.

Tornado Blessing: Dust Devil.name: Tornado Blessing: Dust Devil（Tornado Blessing: Dust Devil）
Tornado Blessing: Dust Devil.description: When you hit with a weapon attack, you can use a swift action to cause a sudden burst of wind and debris to swirl around your target. The target is dazzled for 1 minute.

Tornado Blessing: Howling Gale.name: Tornado Blessing: Howling Gale（Tornado Blessing: Howling Gale）
Tornado Blessing: Howling Gale.description: At 10th level, you can invoke a howling windstorm around yourself as a standard action. For 1 minute, any Large or smaller creature takes twice as much movement to enter a space adjacent to you due to the winds, and thus can閳ユ獩 take a 5-foot step to move adjacent to you.

Torrent Infusion.name: 迸發（Torrent Infusion）
Torrent Infusion.description:
元素：氣、火或水；類別：塑形注能；等級：3；超載：2

  關聯念襲類別：突風，風捲雪，藍焰擊，帶電水，火衝，熔岩流，硬泥團，太陽風，沙塵暴，蒸灼，風雷擊，水突

  豁免：反射，通過則減半

Torture Subdomain.name: Torture Subdomain（Torture Subdomain）
Torture Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.jy64xofud29j5ju6]{痛苦打擊}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.k6nfhf1wvik082wu]{痛苦徽記}
  • 8環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.21r9ptvsjo99o3yw]{短訊暗示}

Torturer's Touch.name: Torturer's Touch（Torturer's Touch）
Torturer's Touch.description: You may use @Compendium[pf1.spells.t1w2zq5fx7mislq8]{疲乏之觸} as a spell-like ability. Creatures that are immune to pain effects are immune to this touch. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Touch Treatment.name: 接觸療法（Touch Treatment）
Touch Treatment.description:
3級起，催眠師能夠通過用手臂觸摸來傳導精神力量，並以此幫助盟友擺脫有害狀態——對那些會影響心智的狀態最為有效。接觸療法的每日使用次數等同於3 + 催眠師的魅力調整值。使用該能力是標準動作（如果催眠師要對自己使用則為迅捷動作），而且催眠師必須能夠接觸到目標。每次使用該能力，催眠師能夠從一個目標身上移除一個狀態。3級起，他能夠移除任何次級狀態列表上的狀態。6級起，他能夠移除任何次級或中級狀態列表上的狀態。在10級時，他能夠移除任何在次級、中級和高級狀態列表上的狀態。

  次級狀態（Minor Conditions）：迷魂（Fascinated），戰慄（shaken）。

  中級狀態（Moderate Conditions）：困惑（Confused），暈眩（dazed），驚懼（frightened），噁心（sickened）。

  高級狀態（Greater Conditions）：畏縮（Cowering），反胃（nauseated），恐慌（panicked），震懾（stunned）。

  14級起，催眠師能夠花費一次接觸療法的使用次數，並將其效果替換為破除結界（Break Enchantment）的效果。目標必須是催眠師正在接觸的一個生物，而且這麼做要遵循所有其他接觸療法的限制制約。

Touch of Loyalty.name: Touch of Loyalty（Touch of Loyalty）
Touch of Loyalty.description:
As a standard action, you can touch a willing creature, granting it a +4 sacred bonus on saving throws to resist charm, compulsion, and fear effects for 1 hour. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This replaces the Touch of Law power of the Law Domain.

Touch of Paranoia.name: Touch of Paranoia（Touch of Paranoia）
Touch of Paranoia.description:
You can imbue a target with great suspicion and doubt as a melee touch attack. A creature affected by your touch does not have allies and is not considered to be an ally to any other creature, including other creatures affected by this effect. The affected creature cannot move freely through its allies閳?spaces, flank creatures with them, cooperate with them using teamwork feats, or give or receive benefits from the aid another action or any spells or effect that affects only allies. This ability lasts for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum 1). You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

  This power replaces the Touch of Evil power of the Evil Domain.

Touch of Succor.name: Touch of Succor（Touch of Succor）
Touch of Succor.description:
The shaman can touch a willing creature as a standard action to remove one of the following conditions: fatigued, shaken, or sickened.

  At 8th level, she adds confused and frightened to the list of conditions she can remove.

  At 12th level, she also adds dazed, nauseated, and panicked.

  The shaman can use this ability a number of times per day equal to her shaman level.

Touch of Virulence.name: Touch of Virulence（Touch of Virulence）
Touch of Virulence.description:
As a standard action, you can touch a diseased creature and exacerbate its condition. If it fails a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier), the creature takes damage as though it had failed its Fortitude save against the disease and any remaining onset time for the disease ends. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, plus one additional time per day at 14th level and 20th level.

  This power replaces the Death's Embrace power of the Death Domain or the Touch of Evil power of the Evil Domain.

Touch of the Moon.name: Touch of the Moon（Touch of the Moon）
Touch of the Moon.description:
The exact effects of this revelation depend on whether you cast inflict or cure spells.

  If you cast inflict spells, these spells carry with them the taint of madness. Subjects who take damage from your inflict spells are also subject to confusion, as the spell, except the duration of this effect is a number of rounds equal to the level of the inflict spell. The save DC against this effect is 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Charisma modifier.

  Alternatively, if you cast cure spells, these spells are potentially more effective but entirely in the target閳ユ獨 mind. Whenever you cast a cure spell, you can cast it as though it were enhanced with the Empower Spell metamagic feat by expending two spell slots, except these hit points are temporary. This does not increase the level of the spell. Hit points healed this way expire after a number of minutes equal to half your oracle level.

  You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Touchsight, Reactive.name: Touchsight, Reactive（Touchsight, Reactive）
Touchsight, Reactive.description:
Element aether; Type utility (Su); Level 5; Burn 0
Prerequisite touchsight

  Your strands of aether surround you, making it virtually impossible for a violent motion to catch you off guard, so long as the motion originates within their range. You are never denied your Dexterity bonus to AC against attacks from within 30 feet because of being flat-footed or because your assailant is unseen or invisible. You always succeed at any Perception check to act on the surprise round against opponents within 30 feet.

Touchsight.name: 觸覺視界（Touchsight）
Touchsight.description:
元素：以太；類別：通用（Su）；等級：3；超載：0

  你將心靈念力可以觸碰的所有事物都附上一股以太。每當你使用念動（Telekinetic Blast）對生物造成傷害時，只要該名生物沒有使用傳送（teleportation）效果，你就可以如同使用盲視（blindsight）一般看到該名生物，無論你與他相距多遠都可以，不過該效果僅能持續至你的下個回合結束為止。在對生物造成傷害後的一瞬間，你能夠嘗試承受1點超載，以此來強化附著在該名生物身上的以太，延長觸覺視界對該名生物的持續時間至每操念使等級1輪。

Towering Ego.name: 強大自我（Towering Ego）
Towering Ego.description: 2級起，催眠師的意志豁免檢定會獲得加值，數值等同於他的魅力加值（最低為0點）。若催眠師正受到任何可能會防止他為異能法術（psychic spells）提供情緒成分（emotional component）的效果影響的話，他便會失去這些豁免檢定上的加值。

Toxic Blood Curse.name: Toxic Blood Curse（Toxic Blood Curse）
Toxic Blood Curse.description:
Your body is ravaged by a potent, slow-acting poison that resists all treatment. Whenever you must attempt a Fortitude save to resist a poison effect, roll twice and take the lowest result. Additionally, you need one more consecutive successful save to end an ongoing poison. You lose any immunity to poison you have upon receiving this curse, and you become immune to delay poison and neutralize poison, as well as other attempts to suppress or remove the poison from which you are suffering. You gain the poison use ability.

  At 5th level, you are so envenomed that your touch becomes poisonous. Once per day for every 4 oracle levels you have, you can deliver a unique contact poison as a touch attack or via an unarmed strike or natural weapon. This poison deals 1d2 points of Dexterity damage per round for 5 rounds. Poisoned creatures can attempt a Fortitude save (DC = 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Charisma modifier) each round. Success negates the damage and ends the affliction.

  At 10th level, the poison deals 1d3 points of Dexterity damage per round for 7 rounds.

  At 15th level, you can expend a use of your poison touch to transfer any poison effect you are currently experiencing from yourself to another creature. The touched creature must immediately attempt a saving throw against the poison (using the poison閳ユ獨 initial DC and duration for a single dose, regardless of how many doses are currently affecting you). If the creature fails its save, the poison ceases to act on you, as if you had succeeded at all the necessary saves (this bypasses your immunity to effects that remove poison).

Toxic Infusion, Greater.name: Toxic Infusion, Greater（Toxic Infusion, Greater）
Toxic Infusion, Greater.description:
Element wood; Type substance infusion; Level 7; Burn 4
Prerequisite toxic infusion
Associated Blasts autumn, spring, summer, verdant, winter, wood
Saving Throw Fortitude negates

  Your plant toxin is more virulent. Each time you use this infusion, choose a physical ability score. Creatures that take piercing or slashing damage from your blast are exposed to your poison.

Blast閳ユ攰njury; save Fort; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 damage to the chosen ability score; cure 2 consecutive saves.

Toxic Infusion.name: Toxic Infusion（Toxic Infusion）
Toxic Infusion.description:
Element wood; Type substance infusion; Level 4; Burn 3
Associated Blasts autumn, spring, summer, verdant, winter, wood
Saving Throw Fortitude negates

  The plants in your blast are mildly toxic. All creatures that take piercing or slashing damage from your blast are sickened for 1 round.

Toxic Regurgitation.name: Toxic Regurgitation（Toxic Regurgitation）
Toxic Regurgitation.description: A rogue with this talent can drink a noninhaled poison as a standard action and suspend it within her body. She is not affected by the poison while it is suspended within her, and she doesn閳ユ獩 need to attempt saving throws against it. She can suspend a poison within herself in this way for a number of hours equal to her Constitution modifier (minimum 1), after which she must immediately expel the poison or be affected by it as normal. At any time while the poison is suspended within her, the rogue can spit up the poison as a ranged touch attack at any creature within 10 feet. This does not provoke attacks of opportunity. On a successful hit, the struck creature is exposed to the poison as if it were a contact poison. The rogue can maintain only a single suspended poison at a time. If she suspends a new poison, any older suspended poison immediately affects her as normal.

Toxin Training.name: Toxin Training（Toxin Training）
Toxin Training.description:
The slayer builds resistance to certain poisons over time. Each time he chooses this talent, he chooses one ability score. He gains a +4 bonus on saving throws against poisons that deal damage to the chosen ability score. The slayer can choose this talent multiple times. Each time he does, he chooses a new ability score and gains the bonus on saves against poisons that target that ability.

  The slayer must be at least 4th level and have the poison use talent to select this talent.

Tracer Touch.name: Tracer Touch（Tracer Touch）
Tracer Touch.description:
Once per day, you can touch a creature or object and plant a scrying sensor on it, as if you had cast @Compendium[pf1.spells.b2yholbb5a0g8peg]{Vicarious View}.

  At 15th level, you can use this ability twice per day.

  You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

Trail of Flames.name: 烈焰之徑（Trail of Flames）
Trail of Flames.description:
元素：火；類別：通用（Sp）；等級：5；超載：0

  豁免：無；法術抗力：可

  當你進行撤退（withdraw）或奔跑（run）動作時，能夠在撤離經過的所有方格中留下火牆（wall of fire），持續1輪。

Trample (2 pts).name: Trample (2 pts)（Trample (2 pts)）
Trample (2 pts).description: An eidolon gains the ability to crush its foes underfoot, gaining the trample ability. As a full-round action, the eidolon can overrun any creature that is at least one size smaller than itself. This works like the overrun combat maneuver, but the eidolon does not need to make a check, it merely has to move over opponents in its path. The creatures take 1d6 points of damage (1d8 if Large, 2d6 if Huge), plus 1-1/2 times the eidolon's Strength modifier. Targets of the trample can make attacks of opportunity at a 閳? penalty. If a target forgoes the attack of opportunity, it can make a Reflex save for half damage. The DC of this save is 10 + 1/2 the eidolon's HD + the eidolon's Strength modifier. A trampling eidolon can only deal trampling damage to a creature once per round. This evolution is only available to eidolons of the biped or quadruped base forms.

Trample (UC) (2 pts).name: Trample (UC) (2 pts)（Trample (UC) (2 pts)）
Trample (UC) (2 pts).description:
Requirements: Biped or quadruped base form.

  The eidolon gains the ability to crush its foes underfoot, gaining the trample ability. As a full-round action, the eidolon can overrun any creature that is at least one size category smaller than itself. This works like the overrun combat maneuver, but the eidolon does not need to attempt a check; it merely has to move over opponents in its path. The creatures take 1d6 points of damage (1d8 if Large, 2d6 if Huge), plus 1-1/2 times the eidolon閳ユ獨 Strength modif ier. Targets of the trample can make attacks of opportunity at a 閳? penalty. If a target forgoes this attack of opportunity, it can attempt a Reflex save for half damage. The DC of this save is 10 + 1/2 the eidolon閳ユ獨 Hit Dice + the eidolon閳ユ獨 Strength modifier.

  A trampling eidolon can deal trampling damage to a specific creature only once per round.

Trance of Three.name: 三重降靈（Trance of Three）
Trance of Three.description: 在15級時，以一個迅捷動作，通靈者可以以目前附身的英靈對自己增加1點共鳴作為代價，將另一個職階的英靈招來並獲得該英靈的中等英靈之力，持續相當於他的通靈者等級輪的時間。如果第二個英靈提供的英靈之力有使用次數限制，那麼通靈者必須記錄自己的使用次數，即使該英靈之後離去；如果他在一天之內再次召喚第二英靈，這些使用次數不會恢復。如果在此期間通靈者使用了任何會堆積迴響的能力，這些迴響全部計算在第一英靈而非第二英靈與他之間。通靈者不會獲得任何第二英靈的降靈獎勵，他可以以一個自由動作送離第二英靈。

Tranformation Patron.name: Tranformation Patron（Tranformation Patron）
Tranformation Patron.description:
• 2級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.ns2zo6qgd9co02uf]{跳躍術}
  • 4級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.usdv1eqvibmxun6x]{熊之堅韌}
  • 6級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.tjdfluulncmqacc3]{野獸形態 I}
  • 8級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.774kmgcb7ygviht0]{野獸形態II}
  • 10級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.w88ddxpu89qcr5c0]{野獸形態III}
  • 12級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.iqcjiyi9leldfzxt]{巨龍形態 I}
  • 14級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.5icj4nasrlgqojqm]{巨龍形態 II}
  • 16級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.6qpg42rj70oi4css]{巨龍形態 III}
  • 18級——@Compendium[pf1.spells.n3lp01euzcdmtbw5]{形體變化}

Tranquility Discipline.name: 平和境界（Tranquility Discipline）
Tranquility Discipline.description:
Psychic magic flows through you when you attain a peaceful mental state. Regular meditation expands your mind, allowing new powers to develop.

精神力池屬性 感知

獎勵法術: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.2s198jpks0pvimjf]{Telempathic Projection} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.ow4t1zox6dtybgji]{沉默術} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.7no45vnykqt1azc8]{Mantle Of Calm} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.f0o357a1halsvm4p]{Daze, Mass} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.z8hhy7qitegvb7a4]{Serenity} (10th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.21yha04trfhj0ehd]{心智手術} (12th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.blvetbc929cfx4m8]{心靈屏障} (14th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.xlzqpkl8fpm3sn4u]{愛與和平} (16th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.7mstq5c76h3e6zzx]{時間靜止} (18th).

Transfer Fear.name: 轉移恐懼（Transfer Fear）
Transfer Fear.description: 當異能者對目標造成一個恐懼效應時，他可以支付1點精神力來移除他自己或處於心靈聯結中的一名盟友的恐懼狀態。

Transfer Magic.name: 妙手竊法（Transfer Magic）
Transfer Magic.description: 以一個標準動作，你可以通過增加1點共鳴為代價，對一個生物發動一次近戰接觸攻擊。如果你的攻擊成功命中，那麼你立刻將一個在此生物身上生效的隨機無害法術轉移到自己身上。這個生物立刻失去這個法術的效果，而你可以在它的持續時間內獲得法術的效果。本能力對範圍為個人或是持續時間為立即和永久的法術無效。

Transformation Sequence.name: Transformation Sequence（Transformation Sequence）
Transformation Sequence.description:
The vigilante閳ユ獨 transformation between identities is assisted by magic. This makes it faster than usual, but also more noticeable. The vigilante can complete the switch between his identities in 5 rounds, improving to a standard action if he has the quick change social talent, and to a swift action if he has the immediate change social talent. However, the transformation causes quite a spectacle, involving loud sounds or music, brilliant colorful energies, and swift motions.

  A vigilante can select this talent only if he is able to cast spells or spell-like abilities (this needn閳ユ獩 be from his vigilante class).

  A vigilante with the magical child archetype effectively gets this social talent for free at 1st level.

Transmutation Resonant School.name: 變化靈器（Transmutation Resonant School）
Transmutation Resonant School.description:
變化靈器可以修改物品或生物的基本屬性。

  靈器（Implements）：腰帶、靴子、涼鞋、背心、武器。

Trap Rune.name: Trap Rune（Trap Rune）
Trap Rune.description: At 1st level, as a standard action, you can sketch a single, nearly invisible magical rune on any 5-foot-square solid surface. When you create a rune, pick one of the following energy types: acid, cold, electricity, or fire. While the rune is active, the next creature other than you who steps on or touches the rune閳ユ獨 area causes the rune to explode. The rune閳ユ獨 explosion deals a number of points of energy damage equal to 1d8 + 1 per sorcerer level you possess to anything in its square. A Reflex saving throw halves the damage (DC 10 + 1/2 your sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier). The rune is considered a magical trap for the purpose of perceiving it or disabling it. The DC for both 察覺 and Disable Device checks is the same as the Reflex saving throw to halve the damage. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. Each rune lasts for 24 hours or until discharged.

Trap Sense (Sor).name: Trap Sense (Sor)（Trap Sense (Sor)）
Trap Sense (Sor).description: At 3rd level, you develop a sixth sense that helps you avoid traps. You gain a +2 bonus on 察覺 checks made to notice traps. You also gain a +1 bonus on Reflex saves to avoid traps and a +1 dodge bonus to AC against attacks made by traps. These bonuses increase by +1 at 7th level and for every four sorcerer levels you gain thereafter (to a maximum of +5 at 19th level). This bonus stacks with that provided by a rogue閳ユ獨 trap sense and similar abilities.

Trap Subdomain.name: Trap Subdomain（Trap Subdomain）
Trap Subdomain.description:
替代神授力量 Note: Only creatures with the Kobold Faith trait can take this subdomain.

  替代領域法術

  • 2環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.vhxezfop50r7z8zm]{圈套術}
  • 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.n156m0w3nga1tyqn]{Improve Trap}
  • 7環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.v58v451n6dj73wvc]{Teleport Trap}

Trapfinding (INV).name: 尋找陷阱(調查員)（Trapfinding (INV)）
Trapfinding (INV).description: 調查員可以將他的調查員等級的一半加在他用於尋找和定位陷阱的察覺技能檢定和解除裝置技能檢定上（最小為1）。調查員也可以使用解除裝置技能破解魔法陷阱。

Trapfinding (UC).name: 尋找陷阱(掉鏈)（Trapfinding (UC)）
Trapfinding (UC).description: 盜賊在用於定位陷阱的察覺檢定以及解除裝置檢定上獲得相當於1/2其等級的加值（最低+1）。盜賊能夠使用解除裝置技能來解除魔法陷阱。

Travel as One.name: Travel as One（Travel as One）
Travel as One.description:
When you cast a spell with the teleportation descriptor, treat your caster level as 3 higher for the purpose of determining how many additional creatures you can bring with you. In addition, you and any creatures you teleport gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your level that disappear after you reach your destination; these offset any damage you might take from teleportation mishaps or attempting to teleport into a solid body.

  This power replaces the base speed increase of the Travel Domain.

Tree Limb.name: Tree Limb（Tree Limb）
Tree Limb.description:
As a swift action, the shaman can turn one of her arms into a heavy, branch-like limb. She must drop anything held in that hand, and she can閳ユ獩 use this ability if she is wearing a shield on that arm. Until the beginning of her next turn, she gains a slam attack that deals 1d8 points of damage (for a Medium shaman; 1d6 if Small, 2d6 if Large).

  At 8th level, the reach of this slam attack increases by 5 feet.

  At 16th level, the shaman can transform both of her arms, gaining two slam attacks.

  A shaman can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Charisma modifier.

Tree Step.name: Tree Step（Tree Step）
Tree Step.description:
Element wood; Type utility (Sp); Level 7; Burn 1
Prerequisite greater woodland step, woodland step

  You can enter a tree and magically transport to a different tree of the same type within range, as per @Compendium[pf1.spells.6x6epf4g5wgzl1gh]{融身入林}. Each time you activate this ability, it lasts until you have taken a number of tree steps equal to your kineticist level, your burn is removed, or you accept burn again to refresh it.

  Each time your burn is removed, you can automatically activate this ability once and ignore the burn cost. You can accept 1 additional point of burn while this ability is active to use all remaining tree steps at once, adding up the total distance traveled and instantly reaching your destination tree even if there wouldn閳ユ獩 have been enough trees along the way to make the journey one at a time.

Tremor Infusion.name: Tremor Infusion（Tremor Infusion）
Tremor Infusion.description:
Element earth; Type form infusion; Level 5; Burn 3
Associated Blasts earth
Saving Throw none

  You send a tremor through the ground or other solid surface with which you are in contact, allowing you to affect a burrowing or incorporeal creature within that same surface with a normal kinetic blast.

  This infusion doesn閳ユ獩 allow you to attack creatures above the ground if you are burrowing or to ignore total cover provided by factors other than burrowing.

Tremorsense (2 pts).name: Tremorsense (2 pts)（Tremorsense (2 pts)）
Tremorsense (2 pts).description:
An eidolon becomes attuned to vibrations in the ground, gaining tremorsense out to a range of 30 feet. This works like the blindsense evolution, but only if both the eidolon and the creature to be pinpointed are in contact with the ground.

  The summoner must be at least 7th level before selecting this evolution.

Tremorsense (UC) (2 pts).name: Tremorsense (UC) (2 pts)（Tremorsense (UC) (2 pts)）
Tremorsense (UC) (2 pts).description:
Requirements: Summoner level 7th.

  The eidolon becomes attuned to vibrations in the ground, gaining tremorsense with a range of 30 feet. This works like the blindsense evolution, but only if both the eidolon and the creature to be pinpointed are in contact with the ground.

Tremorsense, Greater.name: Tremorsense, Greater（Tremorsense, Greater）
Tremorsense, Greater.description:
Element earth; Type utility (Su); Level 5; Burn 0
Prerequisite tremorsense

  You can spend 10 minutes to extend your tremorsense outward while in a natural underground setting, letting you learn three facts as if using @Compendium[pf1.spells.icjrw9y6pa1uatlz]{問道自然}, except your tremorsense can閳ユ獩 tell if a creature is a woodland creature or a powerful unnatural creature.

Tremorsense.name: 顫動感知（Tremorsense）
Tremorsense.description:
元素：土；類別：通用（Su）；等級：3；超載：0

  當你碰觸到任何土質或石質表面時，能夠以移動動作獲得持續1輪、範圍為30尺的顫動感知。你能夠承受1點超載來將持續時間增加為每個你所具有的操念使等級1輪。當你從這個顫動感知中獲益，且使用巖擊（Earth Blast）和其他包含土元素的複合念襲對抗被顫動感知偵測到的生物時，這些攻擊不會承受來自隱蔽（concealment）或全隱蔽（total concealment）帶來的失手率。

Tribal Bond.name: Tribal Bond（Tribal Bond）
Tribal Bond.description: The shaman and her tribe share a transcendent bond. Once per day when she communes with her spirit animal to regain spells, the shaman can select a number of creatures equal to half her shaman level to serve as her honorary tribe. These creatures can constantly communicate with each other, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.zuqlok69lapqc6lg]{心靈連線}.

Tribal Cooperation.name: Tribal Cooperation（Tribal Cooperation）
Tribal Cooperation.description:
The shaman gains a teamwork feat as a bonus feat. She must meet the feat閳ユ獨 prerequisites. As a standard action, the shaman can grant one of her teamwork feats to all allies within 30 feet who can see and hear her. Allies retain the use of this bonus feat for 3 rounds plus 1 round for every 2 levels the shaman has. Allies do not need to meet the prerequisites of this bonus feat.

  The shaman can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + her Charisma modifier.

Tribe Spirit.name: Tribe Spirit（Tribe Spirit）
Tribe Spirit.description:
A shaman who selects the tribe spirit strives to protect her allies, whether they be a traditional tribal unit or a chosen group of adventuring companions.

Spirit Magic Spells: 

  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.wa0zb2pncesmm9lz]{祝福術} (1st), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.menqakfoa1ftvi3f]{護衛他人} (2nd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.qn947hen3wrelxhz]{造糧術} (3rd), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.0lrux8tmaml5fkw6]{靈能盟友} (4th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.f6lqt3ju8m7r5la2]{維生氣泡} (5th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.eg3i21asvo69mbma]{Battlemind Link} (6th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.aqeaxoaozlv9vg35]{靈視} (7th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.gw2sgj93dgarpem8]{感知位置} (8th), 
  • @Compendium[pf1.spells.klcvk9ct1l7mhjwp]{群體醫療術} (9th).

  Spirit Animal: The shaman閳ユ獨 spirit animal has colorations or markings that resemble a totem or important symbol for the shaman閳ユ獨 tribe. When the spirit animal successfully performs the aid another action, the bonus it provides increases by 1.

Trickster Spirit.name: 詭術師英靈（Trickster Spirit）
Trickster Spirit.description:
詭術師英靈狡詐而多智，有著耍不完的花招。

  英靈同調：每當你降靈詭術師時，你在敏捷檢定，基於敏捷的技能檢定和反射豁免檢定上獲得加值。

  降靈獎勵：選擇一個技能，你在這個技能檢定上獲得+1加值，並且這個技能視為你的本職技能。

  偏好降靈區域：小巷，迷宮，喧鬧的酒館，陷阱地宮。

  共鳴懲罰：你堅信寧可我負天下人而絕不可天下人負我。你永遠不被其他生物在使用能力時視為一個盟友，也無法自願成為任何法術的目標。任何對你施放的需要遠程接觸的法術（包括有益法術）都必須通過一個近戰接觸攻擊檢定才能傳遞，但你無需再受到無害法術時被強制進行豁免。最後，你無法從援助他人動作中收益——你在每一秒中都能想出八百個他們在算計你的理由並且想方設法躲過去。

  禁忌：選擇下列禁忌之一：

  -你絕不向人揭露自己的真面目，任何人發現你的真實身份都視為你打破了禁忌，即使他們是你的盟友。

  -你絕不說實話。

  -你必須接受每一份比現在更優厚的酬勞，即使這意味著你將因此背叛。

Trickster's Edge.name: Trickster's Edge（Trickster's Edge）
Trickster's Edge.description: Choose any two skills. These skills count as class skills for you, and you are treated as if you had an additional number of ranks in those skills equal to your medium level (to a maximum of your character level).

Trip (2 pts).name: Trip (2 pts)（Trip (2 pts)）
Trip (2 pts).description:
An eidolon becomes adept at knocking foes to the ground with its bite, granting it a trip attack. Whenever the eidolon makes a successful bite attack of the selected type, it can attempt a free combat maneuver check. If successful, the target is knocked prone. If the check fails, the eidolon is not tripped in return. This ability only works on creatures of a size equal to or smaller than the eidolon.

  The eidolon must possess the bite evolution to select this evolution.

Trip (UC) (2 pts).name: Trip (UC) (2 pts)（Trip (UC) (2 pts)）
Trip (UC) (2 pts).description:
Requirements: Daemon, demon, devil, elemental, or protean subtype; bite evolution.

  The eidolon becomes adept at knocking foes to the ground with its bite, granting it a trip attack. Whenever the eidolon makes a successful bite attack, it can attempt a free combat maneuver check. If the eidolon succeeds at this check, the target is knocked prone. If the eidolon fails, it is not tripped in return.

  This ability works only on creatures of a size category equal to or smaller than the eidolon.

Triumphant Return.name: 英雄歸來（Triumphant Return）
Triumphant Return.description: 俠客的事蹟變得難以被人們忘記，這使他可以很容易地重建自己曾經在某地擁有的聲譽。當俠客嘗試在某個他曾經擁有過聲譽影響的地區再次建立聲譽時，他只需花費3天而非一週時間就可以重建自己的聲譽。俠客必須達到3級並且擁有聲譽社交天賦才能選擇本天賦。

True Death.name: True Death（True Death）
True Death.description: Those slain by your spells or by one of your attacks that deals negative energy becomes more difficult to bring back from the dead. Spellcasters attempting to bring such a creature back from the dead using @Compendium[pf1.spells.c5anior2ysy6s2xy]{死者復活} or similar magic must succeed at a caster level check with a DC equal to 15 + your oracle level or the spell fails and the material component is wasted. A successful casting of @Compendium[pf1.spells.o87h8gjxevcbztgd]{移除詛咒} (DC = 10 + your oracle level) before attempting to bring the creature back from the dead suppresses this effect for 1 minute.

True Petrification.name: True Petrification（True Petrification）
True Petrification.description: At 20th level, you can use your gaze bloodline ability to permanently turn a creature to stone, as @Compendium[pf1.spells.361rc74674l3zt9a]{石化術}. You can still use the less powerful versions of your gaze if you do not wish to turn the target to stone, but you must declare this at the time of the attack.

True Shapechanger.name: True Shapechanger（True Shapechanger）
True Shapechanger.description: At 20th level, you are immune to all transmutation spells and effects unless you are a willing target. You can also use @Compendium[pf1.spells.t44p3oeq43jwcgwg]{高等變形術} at will as a spell-like ability with a caster level equal to your bloodrager level targeting only yourself. These effects function even while you閳ユ獧e not bloodraging.

Truth Subdomain.name: Truth Subdomain（Truth Subdomain）
Truth Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 3環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.56atnwmo4s61hi45]{Wall Of Nausea}
  • 5環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.68ngvzmzvadhf6vs]{異界探知}
  • 6環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.cxp0vodhvuwnfmye]{Litany Of Madness}

Tundra Dweller.name: Tundra Dweller（Tundra Dweller）
Tundra Dweller.description:
The shaman touches a willing creature and grants it cold resistance 10 for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1). This resistance does not stack with any other cold resistance, such as from special abilities or magical items.

  At 8th and 16th levels, the duration of this hex is extended by 1 round.

  A creature targeted by this hex cannot be affected by it again for 24 hours.

Turn Aside.name: Turn Aside（Turn Aside）
Turn Aside.description: You can compress or inflate enough space around you to turn aside ranged attacks. At 5th level, you gain Deflect Arrows as a bonus feat. You can expend 1 point from your phrenic pool as an immediate action to gain a +4 deflection bonus against a single ranged attack.

Turnabout.name: Turnabout（Turnabout）
Turnabout.description: A vigilante with this talent can capitalize on any opportunities in combat. Whenever a foe provokes an attack of opportunity from the vigilante by attacking or casting a spell, the vigilante can attempt a dirty trick combat maneuver check in place of the attack of opportunity. If he succeeds at the check, in addition to the usual options, the vigilante can redirect the attack or spell to a new target or area the foe could have chosen.

Turning Blast Infusion.name: Turning Blast Infusion（Turning Blast Infusion）
Turning Blast Infusion.description:
Element void, wood; Type substance infusion; Level 4; Burn 3
Prerequisite duskwalker, or Planar Infusion (Boneyard)
Associated Blasts positive, negative
Saving Throw Will negates

  Undead that take damage from a turning blast must succeed at a Will save or flee for 1 round.

  An undead creature that succeeds at its saving throw against a turning blast is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

Turning Shield.name: 法術反轉護盾（Turning Shield）
Turning Shield.description: 異能者能夠將多餘的法術能量轉化為屏障，用以抵禦較弱的法術。她能夠從精神力池中花費等同於聯結法術等級的精神力，以此來獲得法術反轉（Spell Turning）的好處，持續時間為每個異能者等級1輪。她能夠反轉的法術等級數量等同於聯結法術的等級。

Twilight Influence.name: Twilight Influence（Twilight Influence）
Twilight Influence.description:
You can channel spell energy into spells drawn from the Darkness cleric domain. This ability functions similarly to the cleric閳ユ獨 ability to spontaneously cast cure or inflict spells, but you instead spontaneously cast Darkness domain spells. The domain spells don閳ユ獩 count as being on your psychic spell list for the purposes of any other effects (unless they are independently on your psychic spell list, such as blindness/deafness). Each day, you can convert up to one spell from each spell level you can cast.

  Each time you use this ability to convert a spell, you regain 1 point in your phrenic pool. The maximum number of points you can regain in this way per day is equal to your Wisdom modifier.

Twilight Talon Improvisation.name: Twilight Talon Improvisation（Twilight Talon Improvisation）
Twilight Talon Improvisation.description: Whenever the investigator deals studied strike damage with an improvised weapon, she can perform a dirty trick combat maneuver targeting that foe as a free action. This combat maneuver provokes attacks of opportunity as normal unless the investigator has a feat or other ability to prevent it.

Twin Eidolon (UC).name: 幻靈雙生(掉鏈)（Twin Eidolon (UC)）
Twin Eidolon (UC).description: 20級起，召喚師與幻靈真正地聯結到了一起。以標準動作，召喚師能夠呈現出他的幻靈的形態，複製所有幻靈的進化、形態和能力。召喚師的力量、敏捷和體質屬性也變為幻靈的基礎屬性（base scores）。召喚師可以選擇讓任何他所攜帶的裝備融入到新形態中，就如同變形子學派（polymorph subschool）的法術一般。產生持續性效果的物品在以此方式融入體內後仍舊會繼續產生作用。召喚師會失去所有自己的天生攻擊（natural attacks）和所有種族特性（獎勵專長、技能和語言除外），並以幻靈的進化所提供的能力作為替換。召喚師會保留所有他的職業能力。召喚師每日能夠保留在這個形態下的分鐘數等同於他的召喚師等級。這些持續時間不必連續，但是必須以1分鐘為單位來使用。召喚師能夠以自由動作結束該效果。

Twisted Fortune.name: Twisted Fortune（Twisted Fortune）
Twisted Fortune.description: At 1st level, you can use your supernatural insight to hijack the fortunes of a single target within 30 feet. For 1 round, the target becomes confused and cannot directly control its actions (Will negates). Once a creature has been affected by twisted fortune, it is immune to the ability閳ユ獨 effects for 24 hours. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Cha modifier.

Twisting Fear.name: 絞腸之懼（Twisting Fear）
Twisting Fear.description: 每當俠客成功地使一個敵人陷入戰慄，驚懼或恐慌狀態時，這個敵人還會同時因為極度恐懼而承受嚴重壓力，受到相當於俠客較弱的暗襲數量的非致命傷害。一個生物每輪只能因為絞腸之懼而承受一次非致命傷害。在恐慌狀態的敵人如果受到絞腸之懼的影響，那麼它們不但會開始逃跑，並且會同時崩潰般的大聲嚎叫。俠客必須達到4級才能選擇本天賦

Tyrannical Strike.name: Tyrannical Strike（Tyrannical Strike）
Tyrannical Strike.description:
At 8th level, as an immediate action upon successfully landing a melee attack on an opponent, you can choose to forgo the damage (but not any other effects of the attack) to instead affect the creature you hit as per a greater command spell, with a caster level equal to your class level. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and an additional time per day for every 4 levels beyond 8th.

  This power replaces the Staff of Order power of the Law Domain.

Tyranny Subdomain.name: Tyranny Subdomain（Tyranny Subdomain）
Tyranny Subdomain.description:
替代領域法術

  • 1環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.2p6fzj5t03oivndd]{命令術}
  • 3rd閳?@Compendium[pf1.spells.lsboosfk26m0ycqv]{降咒}
  • 7環——@Compendium[pf1.spells.1m5rpvirt48brv71]{說服徽記}

UItimate Magic (4 pts).name: UItimate Magic (4 pts)（UItimate Magic (4 pts)）
UItimate Magic (4 pts).description:
